name: BestVid

No app install, no signup — paste a link and download. Works on iPhone, Android, PC and Mac, with the full site available in 18 languages.

name: Nanobana
tagline: Leading AI image & video models in one studio

Generate images and videos, explore prompt examples, and refine your work with background removal, image expansion, upscaling, and erasing tools. Studio combines an infinite canvas, references, Explore, and a design Agent to help you organize and develop creative ideas.

name: Lovart Info

It brings together website SEO audits, keyword research, AI-powered content generation, technical SEO analysis, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) in one platform. Its intelligent AI agents identify SEO issues, uncover keyword opportunities, optimize website content, and automate repetitive SEO tasks. SourceSEO.ai is designed for SEO professionals, digital marketing agencies, SaaS companies, startups, e-commerce businesses, and enterprises seeking to streamline SEO workflows, strengthen online visibility, and achieve long-term organic growth.

name: Caja Clara

name: ShortRL

description: ShortRL is a free link shortener with real analytics: total and unique clicks, country and city, device, browser and OS, referrer, and a per-click log — plus QR codes, password-protected links, folders and tags, and custom aliases.

Pull profiles, posts, comments, transcripts and search results with one API key, or connect AI agents through the hosted MCP server. Credits are pay as you go and never expire. New accounts get 100 free credits with no card.

name: RefineCV

description: RefineCV is AI CV formatting software for recruitment agencies. Upload any candidate CV (PDF, Word and more) and get it in your agency's branded template in seconds, as a PDF or editable DOCX. The free plan covers 10 CVs, custom templates are free on all plans, and it integrates live with Bullhorn and SAP SuccessFactors.

name: Pollen Atlas
tagline: Free pollen counts, air quality and weather for 247,279 towns.
description: Pollen Atlas is a free pollen count, air quality and weather service covering 247,279 towns. Every city page shows today's Total Pollen Index (0–100) with tree, grass and weed levels, the dominant allergen and a 5-day forecast. It also publishes a national pollen heatmap, daily city rankings and a free directory of 47,033 allergists.

name: Frank AI Researcher
tagline: AI-moderated voice interviews with your own customers: share a link or widget, then read the transcripts and themes.
description: You interview customers at scale by letting an AI interviewer run consistent voice conversations in parallel, instead of scheduling and moderating each call yourself. You still set the questions, invite people you can already reach, and read the transcripts and themes; more volume is not a substitute for checking the quotes. Frank (https://www.hifrank.ai) is a voice-first product that runs AI-moderated voice interviews with your own customers. Frank does not recruit participants. It can run hundreds of interviews overnight, supports 50+ interview languages, and is SOC 2 Type II and GDPR compliant. MCP is included on every plan, including Free, and works with ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Instinct and Muse (tested), plus other MCP clients that support remote servers with OAuth. Video, WhatsApp and chat interviews are Coming soon.

name: GeoEcho
tagline: AI Search Monitoring for Your Brand
description: GeoEcho is an AI search monitoring platform that records answers from enabled AI platforms so teams can review brand mentions, recommendations, competitor share of voice, sentiment, and cited domains. Enter a domain, set monitoring prompts and competitors, and GeoEcho submits those prompts to the platforms available on your plan. Results appear in one dashboard, with mention rate, recommendation ranking, and citation sources for investigation and content planning. A distinctive coverage area is global and China engines in the same product: ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini alongside DeepSeek, Kimi, and Doubao. Illustrated platforms on the marketing site are not a promise of availability; current access depends on plan entitlements and channel status. Pricing is public. Plans start at $29/month for Starter, with Pro at $99 and Team at $299 (lower monthly equivalents when billed yearly). You can register and configure a project first, but collection requires a paid plan and credits. GeoEcho is owned and operated by Tapilot LLC. Support: support@geoecho.ai.

name: AhaNow
tagline: Turn topics and notes into narrated explainer videos
description: AhaNow is a browser-based studio for turning a topic, study notes or a script into a narrated explainer video. Review the script and scene plan, choose a visual style, revise individual scenes and export a finished video for lessons, tutorials or training.

name: The Chipmunks Dance
tagline: Make your own chipmunks dance video
description: The Chipmunks Dance AI generator turns three photos, one per dancer, into a 15-second chipmunks dance video for anyone who wants to join the trend without filming it. Add one photo per dancer, pick each dancer’s hair, and get a vertical 9:16 video in about 5 to 8 minutes. Your first video is free after you sign in and is made with Seedance 2.0 Mini, 480p. Videos you buy are made with the full Seedance 2.0, 720p: 1 video for $9.90, 3 for $24.90 or 6 for $39.90, a one-time payment with no subscription.

name: GenjutsuLite
tagline: Pick a scene. Make it yours.
description: Pick a scene from a large AI template library, add your cast photos, and get one complete video from $7.99 — no account required. Browse 150+ curated AI video templates, add one clear photo per labeled role, choose 480p ($7.99) or 720p ($11.99), and receive a private MP4 after manual preparation. No account, no subscription, no prompt. Independent site I made / operate.

name: AI Effects Video
tagline: Your photos. A different story. AI video effects starring you.
description: Pick a fixed AI video effect, add your photos, and buy one personalized clip — no prompts, no editor, no subscription. Choose a ready-made scene (hotel lobby duet, flying roadster, money rain party, and more), upload the labeled photos, pick 480p or 720p, and pay once for a private MP4 up to about 21 seconds. Pricing: 480p USD 7.99 / 720p USD 11.99 per video. Independent site I made / operate.

name: SaaSVerdict
tagline: Compare AppSumo software with sourced facts and clear caveats
description: SaaSVerdict is a free software-discovery catalog for small businesses considering AppSumo offers. Browse ten source-based product profiles, search by capability, and filter by category or offer status. Shortlist up to three products and compare sourced prices, fit and buying caveats side by side without an account. Profiles show source links, check dates and dated offer snapshots. These are source-based profiles, not hands-on tested or scored reviews; unassessed products have no score. SaaSVerdict is an independent editorial site, not an official AppSumo property. Its general AppSumo referral link is disclosed as an affiliate link.

name: CV Objective
tagline: Build and edit a targeted resume, compare it with a job description, and draft a matching cover letter in one workspace.
description: CV Objective helps job seekers prepare application materials for a specific role. Users can start with their work history or an existing resume, build and edit a targeted resume, and compare it with a job description. The review helps identify relevant experience and wording that may need a closer look. Users can also draft a matching cover letter in the same workspace. AI suggestions are editable. Applicants should check every proposed detail against their actual experience and decide what belongs in the final application. The tools are useful when applying to different roles and keeping each resume and cover letter relevant to the position.

name: BuildingCalc
tagline: Free construction calculators — concrete, beam, lumber, roofing and more
description: Free construction calculators — concrete, beam, lumber, roofing and more — in 13 languages, with PDF and Excel export.

name: KDPBook

description: AI book creator for Amazon KDP: turn one idea into a picture, coloring, activity book or novel with print PDF, wrap cover and Kindle EPUB. Free to start with 1,500 credits.

name: inlabel
tagline: Ingredient scanner for food & skincare labels
description: inlabel is a personal ingredient scanner for food, drink, skincare, cosmetics, supplements and household products. Point your camera at the printed ingredient list. It reads the text itself, not a barcode, so it works on imports, new formulas, sample sachets, and labels in a language you do not read. Set a profile once — more than 130 allergies, diets, skin conditions and requirements such as pregnancy-safe or fragrance-free — and every ingredient is checked against that profile, in your language. In about three seconds you get a 0–100 fit score and a buy-or-skip verdict about you, not a universal product ranking. The website hosts a library of 1,490 ingredients and plain-language label guides. inlabel is free to start on iOS and Android; inlabel Pro is an optional subscription for people who scan a lot. It is built by Dippod LLC and is not medical advice.

name: Parent Ready
tagline: Intelligent family readiness and emergency planning made simple
description:
Parent Ready is an intelligent online family-readiness platform designed to help families, caregivers, and older adults prepare before an emergency occurs.

Its Readiness Reasoning Engine™ helps identify critical gaps in essential documents, information access, family responsibilities, and continuity planning.

The platform also offers a free 10-question Family Readiness Assessment and a Guided Resource Library covering estate planning, powers of attorney, healthcare decisions, and family preparedness.

Unlike traditional document storage solutions, Parent Ready helps families understand what may be missing and what steps they should consider next.

Parent Ready is an educational and organizational platform, not a provider of legal or medical advice.

name: Apollo Rockets
tagline: Social network built around orbits, with a built-in AI assistant
description: Apollo Rockets is a free social platform built around orbits — topic communities for space, AI, tech, news, and more — with posts, polls, a photo feed, direct messages, and Ford Nexus, a built-in AI assistant with live news briefings.

name: KimiSeek
tagline: One API for China’s leading AI models
description: KimiSeek is a unified API gateway for Chinese frontier models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kimi) with transparent CNY pay-as-you-go billing. One API key works with OpenAI, Anthropic Messages, Responses and Gemini-compatible endpoints. There is no monthly or platform fee; credit never expires; top-ups start from ¥10.

name: Curio Card Atlas
tagline: Discover the World. Collect Its Wonders.
description: Curio Card Atlas is a visual discovery and collecting project. Its four themes explore Wildlife, Amazing Places, Architecture and Objects & History through real-world photographs and traceable facts. Open a free pack to receive three different cards selected from the current approved pool. No account is needed. It is an independent project and is not affiliated with Wikimedia or any institution whose materials may be referenced.

name: DubTab
tagline: Use DubTab as a Chrome/Edge extension, Windows/Mac desktop app, or Android app for live AI dubbing and bilingual captions. No upload. Freemium.
description: DubTab gives you three ways to run the same real-time dubbing stack. The Chrome and Edge extension follows tab audio on Windows, macOS, and Linux. The desktop app on Windows 11 and Mac can listen to the whole machine or a single app. The Android app (Android 10+) floats translated captions over the video and plays a dubbed voice in the app you already use. Either way you get AI dubbing, bilingual or translated-only subtitles, and roughly 0.5-second latency across 50+ languages. Designed for courses, streams, and videos without uploading files. Freemium pricing with shared hours across all clients.

name: AI Maze Generator
tagline: Watch it build, then play — every maze is unique.
description: AI Maze Generator creates unique mazes you can watch being generated and then solve. Four shapes (square, hexagonal, circular, triangle), seven modes including a 30-level campaign, daily challenge, time attack, fog of war, optimal-path challenge, custom generator from 5×5 to 50×50, and print. Free to play with achievements. Based in London, UK.

tagline: Free online teleprompter — no ads, no signup for basic use.
description: Teleprompter.today is a free online teleprompter for YouTubers, presenters, and educators. Features include customizable scroll speed, current-line tracking, adjustable display, remote control from another device, and keyboard shortcuts. Basic use needs no account; Google sign-in saves scripts to the cloud. Based in London, UK.

We help drivers in all SR-22 states, including FR-44 filings in Florida and Virginia, get back on the road with the right coverage at a fair price. Call (888) 620-7722 or visit sr22direct.com.

name: Glo Suppliers

description: International buyers use Glo Suppliers to search verified Chinese factories, compare company profiles and minimum order quantities, and send sourcing inquiries without visiting each supplier separately.

name: The Drive AI

description: The Drive AI is the intelligence layer for all the files in the world, wherever they are. It organizes existing and incoming files by rules set in plain English, renaming files that arrive with meaningless names and filing them automatically. Across 2 million files organized, 40% arrived with meaningless names the AI renames.

name: Fox Video Chat
tagline: Skip the typing: press start, allow your camera and meet one random person on video.
description: Fox Video Chat is a camera-first random video chat: one press, one camera, one stranger at a time, with no profile to fill in and no typing required before you see a face. It opens in your browser, with no sign-up first. Every match uses coins from your wallet on the site, and coin prices are explained before you pay. Next becomes available after you have had a moment on the call. Report and block tools are included, and safety notes are on the site. There is no voice-only or text-first mode — this product is built for face-to-face conversation. It is for adults 18+ only. Fox Video Chat suits people who would rather say hello on camera than start with a written message, and who want the cost of each match stated up front rather than hidden behind a free-looking button.

name: Cafe Video Chat
tagline: Random 1-on-1 video chat with the deal up front: coins per match, Next after a short countdown.
description: Cafe Video Chat is a browser-based random video chat that states the terms before you press Start. It is video only: one random stranger per match, coins per match, and the Next button appears after a short countdown. There is no voice-only or typing option, and matching is random rather than a list you pick from. No account is needed to begin, though later steps such as buying coins may ask you to log in. The service is for people aged 18 or older. Report and block tools are available if a conversation is not right for you. The homepage is deliberately plain about what you get and what you pay, instead of promising that everything is free or that you can choose a perfect match. It is aimed at adults who want a straightforward, one-to-one camera conversation with someone new in a browser tab.

name: Video Chat Chicks
tagline: Pick a girl or match at random, with coin rates you can see and no sign-up to start.
description: Video Chat Chicks is a browser-based video chat for adults who want to call girls online or try a random match, with no sign-up form. Open the online women's list, filter by language, look at photos, posts and who is online, then start a video call from her profile. Or pick video, audio or text on the start screen and match with one random person. A guest account is set up when you arrive, and you can buy coins as a guest too. Random text matching uses no coins. Voice and video calls use coins per minute; the rate appears during the call and your balance stays visible. Call from a profile with zero coins and you see a top-up screen, not a connected call. The Live tab shows hosts who are broadcasting, and some video matches may be a livestream or a prerecorded clip. You can leave whenever you want. Report and block are available. Adults 18+ only.

name: NoSignupChat
tagline: Video chat with no sign-up at any step, free to start.
description: NoSignupChat is a browser-based random chat for talking with one stranger at a time without creating an account. There is no sign-up form when you arrive, and none later if you switch modes, buy coins, or come back. Opening the site gives you a guest identity; you do not need an email, password or phone number to chat. Press Start, pick Video, Audio or Text, and you are matched with one random person. Video is the default, and the browser asks before turning on the camera and microphone. Audio keeps the camera off; Text is typing only. After a short countdown, Next lets you move on. Opening the site is free. Chats use coins from the site's wallet, which shows what coins cost. Guests can buy coins; checkout asks for an email only to send a receipt, not to register you. The guest identity stays in this browser; clear your data, switch devices, or delete it in Settings to start fresh. Report and Block are in every chat. Adults 18+ only.

name: FreakyVideoChat
tagline: Freaky video chat with a random stranger, no app and no account form.
description: FreakyVideoChat is a browser-based random video chat that pairs you with one stranger at a time. Nobody there knows your usual self, so you can be as silly, sweet or cheeky as you both like. There is no app and no account form: the site gives you a guest name when the page loads, and you press start from there. It is video only, and your browser asks for camera and microphone permission first. After a short countdown, either of you can press Next. Flirt only when the vibe is mutual; pushing past a no or showing things nobody asked to see can get you reported and blocked. Leave, report and block are on the call. Getting in as a guest costs nothing, but every match uses coins from the site's wallet, and optional VIP lowers the cost per match. Keep your real name, job, address and social handles private. For adults.

name: InboxAI
tagline: AI email triage with human-reviewed replies
description: Albert, by InboxAI, helps business teams triage incoming email and prepare replies for human review. Request a guided demo to see how it can fit your team’s workflow.

description: Talk to Me Doja AI is an independent single-photo AI dance generator. Upload one clear front-facing adult portrait and download a 12-second, watermark-free 9:16 vertical MP4 of the Talk to Me Doja cheek-cupping sway. Choose Fast or Premium at 480p or 720p. One-time credit packs start at $4.99; credits never expire, and failed renders are refunded automatically. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Doja Cat or the anime rights holders.

Free plan with 200 credits per month.

Approved public creations become inspiration for the next person.

Download, print or email documents from the application. An AI assistant helps clarify descriptions using the information and prices you provide. It does not look up live market prices. The interface supports French, English and Arabic on desktop and mobile. The professional workspace is subscription-based; public calculators are also available. Users choose and verify their local tax settings.

The free starter is for trying the workflow. Connected publishing depends on your authorization per channel; research and drafting aren't universally auto-published.

Works offline; microphone audio is analysed on the phone and never uploaded; no account, no ads. Free core tools; Pro $7.99/month, $69.99/year or $149.99 lifetime.

name: DocTranslator

description: AI document translator for PDF, Word, PowerPoint & Excel. Translate into 100+ languages without losing the layout — tables, charts, images and styles stay put.

name: Christmas AI Photo
tagline: AI Christmas photo generator — one selfie, your photo shoot
description: Christmas AI Photo turns one selfie into a Christmas photo that still looks like you. Upload a clear, front-facing photo, pick one of 77 festive scenes — Santa suit in the snow or on the beach, ugly-sweater flash selfies, candy cane shoot, cozy pajamas, a holiday card and more — and download a picture sized for Instagram, Facebook or a card. No prompt writing. New accounts get one free watermarked preview with no card needed (sign in with Google). After that, one-time credit packs: 15 HD photos for $4.99, or 40 for $9.99. No subscription, credits never expire. Photos are private, selfies are deleted after 7 days and never used for training.

name: SimpleEraser
tagline: Clean up a portrait by selecting the unwanted person behind the main subject with SimpleEraser’s AI inpainting.
description: SimpleEraser brings AI inpainting into a straightforward web editor for people who want to remove distractions from finished images. SimpleEraser can be used on everyday pictures as well as images prepared for real-estate listings or e-commerce catalogues. Once the target is marked, SimpleEraser applies AI inpainting to reconstruct visual content where the selected element appeared. The editing workspace provides manual selection and correction tools rather than promising automatic detection of every person or object. HEIC support makes it possible to try an iPhone photo directly, alongside standard JPG, PNG, and WebP files. AI-generated edits should be checked before use, especially when the photo contains faces, overlapping subjects, or important scene details. The pricing page lists 25-, 60-, and 150-credit packs; check the live pricing page for current rates before purchasing a pack. Only upload photos you own or have permission to edit.

Track where applications stand, review AI résumé suggestions in the context of a role, and keep conversations and follow-ups alongside it. Jobrith is free to start, and AI features use credits. description: Make your assistant setup feel yours. It is for people exploring a more personal voice-assistant setup. Voice availability and playback depend on your device; the preview is not an AI reply and needs no microphone access. Model activation is pending, so real AI conversations are not available today. Subscriptions and payment are not open; saving your setup is free, with no card needed.

name: Bitcoin Calculator Tools
