description: 49 free Bitcoin calculators, no signup: DCA backtester with data back to 2013, profit, retirement, mining, tax and what-if calculators

name: CheckAIVisibility
tagline: Free AI visibility checker: does ChatGPT recommend you?
description:
CheckAIVisibility is a free AI visibility checker. Enter your website and it asks AI models the buyer-style questions your customers ask, then shows whether your brand is mentioned, where it appears in the list, which competitors are named instead, and which third-party pages the answers cite, with one suggested action for each cited page.

The free check runs 5 questions on OpenAI with web search and adds on-site AI readiness checks: robots.txt rules for AI crawlers, llms.txt, JSON-LD, meta tags, server-rendered text and sitemap. It is limited to 3 free checks per day per network. No account is needed.

The full report is a one-time $9: 15 questions across OpenAI and Claude with web search plus Gemini from model knowledge, 2 runs each (90 answers), per-engine scores and one re-check after 30 days. No subscription.

Results come from the official APIs and can differ from the ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini apps. CheckAIVisibility is not affiliated with OpenAI, Anthropic or Google. It is a one-time audit, not ongoing monitoring.

name: Nexus Web Utilities
tagline: Fast, privacy-first web utilities with no account required.
description: Nexus Web Utilities is a growing collection of free browser tools for text, files, PDFs, media, images, notes, tasks, decisions, conversions, and everyday calculations. No account is required, and supported tools process data locally in the browser. The interface is designed to remain direct, responsive, and free from unnecessary clutter.

name: DocCount
tagline: Track telehealth visits and earnings across contracts
description: DocCount is a web app for 1099 telehealth professionals. Log visits at your contract rates, see earnings by day and month, and use your consultation history to check payouts and prepare invoices.

name: Avio — Agentic AI on WhatsApp
tagline: Just message it. It gets it done.
description: Avio is an agentic AI you text on WhatsApp — it makes calls, books appointments, arranges meetings, writes invoices and documents, tracks expenses from receipts, transcribes voice notes and remembers what matters, in five languages. No app, no sign-up and no password. Every user has a private agent and private memory, and data is never sold. Nothing is paid for or sent without your approval. Free forever: 250 messages/month, 2 calls, documents, reminders and one text-edited website. Paid plans from $25/month.

name: Rent Affordability UK
tagline: Free UK rent affordability calculator — work out how much rent you can afford
description: Free UK rent affordability calculator — work out how much rent you can afford on your salary using the 30x rule, with guarantor and deposit calculators and plain-English renting guides.

name: PDFkit
tagline: Free Online PDF, Image & File Tools
description: PDFkit is a free online platform offering PDF, image, and file tools. Users can merge, split, compress, convert, and edit PDF files directly in their browser. It also provides useful online utilities for everyday document and image tasks. PDFkit aims to make file management simple and accessible without requiring signup for available free tools.

name: LaneTime — Swimming Time Converter
tagline: Free SCY, SCM & LCM swimming time converter.
description: Convert competitive swimming race times between short course yards (SCY), short course meters (SCM), and long course meters (LCM) with event-specific conversion estimates. Includes a yard-to-meter distance calculator, pace calculations, transparent methodology and FAQs. Free to use, no signup required.

name: PestProof
tagline: Customer-ready pest inspection reports
description: Record findings and precautions during a pest control visit and turn them into a structured customer report.

name: ClipFirst
tagline: First to post. Only the bangers.
description: ClipFirst watches live Twitch streams for you. When chat spikes, an AI judge checks the moment is worth posting, then a captioned vertical clip lands in Telegram with 3 caption ideas. First 3 clips free, then $19/month.

name: GetStayGuide
tagline: Digital guest guides for holiday rentals
description: Create a mobile guest guide with arrival instructions, house rules and local recommendations. Share it by link or QR code. Guests can ask an AI concierge questions based on the guide.

name: TarotRead
tagline: AI tarot readings with a short free preview and paid full readings.
description: Ask a question, choose a tarot spread and pick an AI reader. You can try a short reading without signing in. Full readings require an account and credits bought as one-time purchases. TarotRead also has guides to all 78 tarot cards and a dream dictionary. Readings are for entertainment and self-reflection.

name: TurnReady
tagline: Make-ready inspections for property teams
description: Record inspection findings between occupants and organise them into a report for the team coordinating the turnover.

name: DreamerBuild
tagline: Build your football XI, make dream transfers and simulate matches
description: DreamerBuild is a free browser tool for football fans and content creators. Build a starting XI, choose a formation, make dream transfers, export your lineup as a PNG and play a match simulation with your edited club squad. No sign-up or download required. Simulated results are for entertainment, not real-world match predictions.

name: 舵手跨境 ERP (Duoshou ERP)
tagline: 舵手 ERP（duoshouerp.com）：面向 Temu、美客多、TikTok Shop 巴西、Walmart 卖家的多平台跨境 ERP
description:
舵手 ERP（舵手跨境 ERP，duoshouerp.com）是面向中国跨境卖家的多平台 SaaS ERP，通过官方 API 接入 Temu（全托、半托、本土）、美客多（跨境与巴西本土店）、TikTok Shop 巴西本土店和 Walmart。浏览器插件在卖家后台完成 Temu 活动批量申报和核价确认；系统覆盖备货发货、三方仓库存、全托半托分口径利润和异常预警，需邮件预约演示开通。

Duoshou ERP (duoshouerp.com) is a multi-platform ERP for cross-border sellers on Temu, Mercado Libre, TikTok Shop Brazil and Walmart.

name: Mexico Pterodactyl AI
tagline: Step into a Mexico pterodactyl scene with your selfie.
description: Mexico Pterodactyl AI places your selfie into a fictional Mexico pterodactyl scene. Upload a portrait, choose one of nine templates, and generate a still photo or vertical 9:16 video. Videos use Seedance 2 Mini; photos use Nano Banana 2. Paid one-time credit packs start at $5.99 USD. Fictional AI entertainment, not news footage or a real sighting.

name: LeadPilot AI
tagline: Arabic AI sales assistant for Saudi SMEs
description: Arabic AI sales assistant that explains services, qualifies business inquiries and introduces ready buyers to the owner. One-time SAR 499 customer inquiry audit plus automation plan and ten tailored Arabic responses. Built for Saudi SMEs; no guaranteed sales.

name: EclipseStay Spain
tagline: Connecting eclipse travellers with private local host proposals
description:
EclipseStay Spain is a digital directory connecting travellers planning for the 2 August 2027 solar eclipse with private local host proposals. Hosts may offer overnight accommodation, a viewing-only space, or both, and set the initial price. A viewing space is not automatically accommodation.

Host recruitment covers Spain, Gibraltar, Tangier, Oran, Sfax, Benghazi and Luxor. Recruitment areas do not confirm available inventory or totality at every address. Travellers should check the precise observing location and the site's current access, fees and terms.

The digital platform fee is separate from any stay. A winning bid opens contact, not a confirmed accommodation booking. Dates, final price, payment and cancellation terms are agreed directly with the host.

Submitted by EclipseStay Spain's authorized AI assistant on the owner's behalf.

name: EarnCalc
tagline: Free US paycheck calculator for all 50 states — see your take-home pay instantly.
description: EarnCalc is a free online paycheck calculator for employees and hourly workers in the US. Enter your salary or hourly pay, pay frequency, and state to see your take-home pay after federal tax, state tax, and FICA. It also includes overtime and bonus tax calculators. No sign-up or download needed.

name: Corplox
tagline: Free global trade data by country and HS code
description: Explore global imports and exports, compare trading partners and track historical trends. Based on UN Comtrade data. Free to use without registration.

name: Post Your Build Ideas
tagline: Launch your product free with one email, no account and no queue
description: Post Your Build Ideas is a free launch board for indie builders. Submit a product, confirm the email and publish your launch without creating an account or waiting in a queue. Visitors can discover new products, upvote launches and leave comments. A launch form collects the product description, links, media and pricing so people can see what it does before visiting. Publishing is free. Optional verification uses a website badge; a badge is not required for a regular launch.

name: fyslide
tagline: TikTok slideshows and Instagram carousels with your own AI
description: Fyslide is a desktop app for making TikTok photo slideshows and Instagram carousels. Choose a design, give it a topic and use your own AI to write the slide text. Edit text, images, stickers and shapes, then export PNG or JPG slides with captions. Batch-create slideshows, plan posts by account, and publish to TikTok or send drafts to your TikTok inbox. A local MCP server lets tools such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor create, edit and export slideshows. Bring your own AI login or API key, or run Ollama locally. Available for macOS and Windows Beta. One-time lifetime license for one computer, no subscription. A license is required; no trial mode. Instagram publishing is not yet available.

name: LocalASO
tagline: App Store keyword research and rank tracking, local on your Mac
description: LocalASO helps indie app developers research keywords, track rankings and prepare localized App Store listings across 52 storefronts. It shows keyword rank, estimated volume and difficulty, with daily history. Bring your own AI to write names, subtitles, keywords, descriptions and promo text. A local MCP server connects tools such as Claude Code and Cursor to the keyword board. Upload selected fields to an editable App Store Connect draft, never directly for review. Runs on macOS 14+ for Apple Silicon and Intel. $29 once for a lifetime license on one Mac, with updates included. A license is required to run the app.

name: Reflex Lab
tagline: Free browser test of visual reaction speed in milliseconds. No sign-up.
description: Reflex Lab is a free online reaction time test. Measure your visual reaction speed in milliseconds across five quick rounds, then try sequence, number, and visual memory tests. No account required, works on desktop and mobile.

name: Monty.fast
tagline: AI editor that turns talking-head clips into Shorts, Reels and TikToks
description: Monty turns a clip where you talk to the camera into a finished vertical video: it cuts the best parts, adds captions, music and b-roll, and on paid plans auto-posts to YouTube Shorts and TikTok. For creators, experts and small businesses who film themselves. Free plan: 3 videos a month. Also free browser tools with no signup: teleprompter with camera recording, safe zone checker for TikTok/Reels/Shorts, horizontal to vertical video converter.

name: QAVENRIX Etsy Free Profit Calculator
tagline: Estimate what you keep after Etsy fees and costs.
description: Free browser-based Etsy fee and profit calculator with adjustable costs, seller fee assumptions, profit estimates and CSV export. No signup required.

name: BuildItOmi
tagline: AI app builder: describe an idea, Omi builds a working app
description: Describe an idea in one sentence and Omi, the AI app builder from BuildItOmi, creates a working website or full-stack app with sign-in, a database and hosting. New accounts get 15 million free credits, no card. Then paid plans from $19/month.

name: GTA 5 Goodbye: One Last Ride
tagline: A GTA V farewell film and editing storyboard
description: An independent GTA V fan project with a short split-screen film, an interactive storyboard preview, and a guide to editing a 2013-versus-2026 farewell. The free preview helps plan a vertical edit; personalized rendering is not available.

name: Bolts
tagline: AI employees that work 24/7 on their own computers
description: Hire AI employees that work 24/7 on their own cloud computer. They research markets, find leads, track competitors and draft outreach, then ask before sending, posting or paying. Plans from $19/month. 30-minute trial of real work; a card is required.

name: Shelfcut Studio
tagline: One product photo, four listing and social crops.
description: Shelfcut Studio is a free browser workbench for online sellers. Open a product photo, frame each of four crops independently, and save a JPEG, PNG, or the full set in a ZIP. The selected photo is processed on the device, not uploaded.

name: Basileion Digital
tagline: Google review replies + GBP posts for contractors
description: Done-for-you Google review replies and Google Business Profile posts for US home-service contractors (HVAC, plumbing, roofing). Every new review gets a reply draft or live post within 24 business hours or that month is free. Four Business Profile posts per week, month-one profile cleanup, review-request kit, and a monthly three-competitor snapshot. Free public-data GBP scorecard before paying. Pricing: $99/mo founding, $149/mo standard, month to month.

name: Secret Santa Generator (secretsanta.name)
tagline: Free Secret Santa generator: no signup or email, couples/households and exclusions, draw checked by a solver, private link for each person.
description: secretsanta.name draws a Secret Santa for friends, families and teams. Add each person, keep couples and households apart, add rules like "Ana shouldn't give to Luis", and get a draw that is checked by a solver. If the combination is impossible it explains why and which rule to remove. Every participant gets a private link to reveal their match (easy to share by WhatsApp). No account, no email, free. Up to 40 people. Interface in English and Spanish. Also hosts sourced guides to gift-exchange traditions worldwide (Kris Kringle, Wichteln, lootjes trekken, Monito Monita and more).

name: OrbitDesk
tagline: AI-powered business enquiry management
description: OrbitDesk helps businesses organise customer enquiries, identify missing information, and prepare professional responses using AI. Designed for businesses across industries, it brings enquiry management and AI assistance into one workspace.

name: Dime Dime Baby AI
tagline: AI photo-to-dance video generator
description: An AI photo-to-dance video generator that works in your browser. Upload one or two photos of consenting adults, choose a scene, and get a short vertical video with template music. Party Bite is a 9-second solo entrance from one photo; Duo Dance is a 7-second two-person routine from one or two photos. Both deliver a 720p 9:16 MP4. Each video costs 10 credits. Packs are one-time, credits never expire, and confirmed failed jobs restore credits. Examples are free to watch. An independent creative tool. Consenting adults only; the tool does not support children or pets.

name: FoxDub
tagline: Free translation and dubbing for captioned videos in Chrome, without sign-up.
description: FoxDub offers free translation and dubbing for videos that already have subtitles or captions in Chrome, with no sign-up required. Support depends on captions, the site, and audio access. FoxDub is proprietary software with paid options beyond this free path.

name: Betnex
tagline: B2B casino technology provider: game aggregation, live casino and slots APIs
description: Betnex is a B2B casino technology provider headquartered in Malta. It offers game aggregation, live casino and slots APIs, sportsbook iframe integration and turnkey casino development for operators.

name: Inquiry Cloud
tagline: Inquiry Cloud helps export manufacturers and traders use Marketing CRM, RAG SEO, and RAG GEO to be found in search and generative answers, and to follow up inqu
description: Inquiry Cloud works with Chinese exporters — manufacturers and traders — on customer acquisition and account management. Products include Marketing CRM for inquiry follow-up, RAG SEO for knowledge-based search acquisition, RAG GEO for visibility in AI search answers, plus social media operations and foreign-trade website building. The goal is a process a team can actually run: content starts from the company’s own knowledge, the website can handle traffic, and sales can follow up inquiries.

name: SignalCat
tagline: A free dashboard for Polymarket markets and large trades
description: SignalCat is a free, read-only dashboard for Polymarket markets and large trades. Filter by listed market end time or price range. The Large trades tab shows recent large fills, trade direction, execution price, the latest available best bid, and first observed wallet activity. Available in English, Spanish and Chinese; no account required to browse. Outbound Polymarket links are referral links. SignalCat does not execute trades.

name: Steadyline
tagline: Reading ruler and word emphasis to help you keep your place on long pages
description: Steadyline helps you keep your place on long pages. Free: adjustable word emphasis that bolds the opening letters of each word, and a reading ruler that follows your pointer or arrow keys and dims the rest of the page. Pro (CA$19.99 a year or CA$24.99 once): a focus line, readable-font mode with OpenDyslexic or a system sans, per-site auto-on, and a reader for local PDF and EPUB files. Works in Chrome and Edge.

name: MuraTools
tagline: Free online tools for PDF, images, text and developer tasks
description: MuraTools is a collection of free browser-based utilities for everyday PDF, image, text, QR-code and developer tasks. Use tools directly in your browser without creating an account or installing software. Capabilities and file-processing behavior vary by tool; do not claim every tool processes locally or that no files are ever uploaded.

name: StreamRoute Lab
tagline: Can your upload handle Twitch and YouTube at the same time?
description: Enter your measured upload speed and bitrate for each stream to compare direct streaming with a cloud relay. Free to use, with no account or download. Some related guides contain disclosed referral links.

name: Anywear Studio
tagline: Try on clothes live with AI before you buy
description: Anywear Studio is a live AI fitting room for online shoppers. Add a clothing image, turn on your camera, and preview the outfit in motion on your phone or desktop. The desktop Chrome extension opens a fitting room beside shopping pages.

name: EQSay
tagline: AI communication assistant that suggests a copyable reply from chat screenshots
description: EQSay is an AI communication assistant for everyday, work, and customer conversations. It uses chat screenshots, including visible unsent drafts in the input box, to suggest a copyable reply and explain the reasoning, while keeping the user's own tone. It does not send messages for the user.

name: NeedGPT
tagline: Third-party ChatGPT and Codex membership top-up, not affiliated with OpenAI
description: NeedGPT is a third-party website for ChatGPT Plus, ChatGPT Pro, and related Codex membership recharge and membership account services. It is not affiliated with OpenAI, and it is not a ChatGPT chatbot or mirror.

name: Invosphere
tagline: Free online invoice generator — 134 document types, no sign-up
description:
Invosphere is a free browser-based invoice generator: 134 document types (invoices, quotations, receipts, credit notes, proforma and commercial invoices, packing slips), 16 country presets with VAT/GST, 35 languages including right-to-left Arabic and Urdu, and 8 print designs. No account needed — print or save as PDF in seconds. https://invosphere.com/ · Example template: https://invosphere.com/agriculture-invoice/

Website Design & Development — Designed and developed by ToolSphare – https://toolsphare.com/ | Developer: Muhammad Wasim, Software Engineer & Founder of ToolSphare | Email: contact@toolsphare.com | WhatsApp: +92 325 7627554

name: AI Tiny Desk
tagline: AI photo-to-mini-concert video generator
description: An independent AI photo-to-mini-concert video generator. Upload one clear adult portrait as the lead performer and, if you like, up to four bandmate photos for keyboard, sax and two backing singers; empty roles keep the template's fictional musicians. Choose a band template and get a roughly 19-second 9:16 video in clean 720p HD with the template's original soundtrack. Each video uses 10 purchased credits. Packs are one-time, never expire and never renew. No free credits.

name: TatMint
tagline: Describe a tattoo idea, get a design to show your artist
description: TatMint turns a few words into a tattoo concept. Describe your idea, pick one of six styles (fine line, minimalist, traditional, Japanese, blackwork, geometric), set placement, color and detail, and get a 1K PNG design saved privately to your account. A free try-on lets you place designs on sample body photos or your own photo right in the browser. Built as a reference to discuss with your tattoo artist, not a stencil.

name: VacationSelector
tagline: Compare two vacation destinations side by side and get a clear answer on which to choose.
description: VacationSelector lets you pick two destinations and what matters to you, then compares them category by category and month by month (weather, beaches, food, culture, cost and more) and tells you which one to choose and why. Free to use, no sign-up.

name: HeriBase
tagline: AI coin and banknote identifier for collectors — photograph both sides to identify an item and check its reference value.
description:
HeriBase is an AI app for identifying coins and banknotes from photographs. Capture both sides of an item to review a suggested catalog match, specifications, and a reference value, then save it to a collection, list it for sale, or request a specialist review.

It is made for coin and banknote collectors. The app is free to download on iOS and Android. The first three scans each day are free, and additional scans are available by watching ads or with an optional subscription (freemium). Human expert appraisal is billed separately. Identification results and reference prices are research aids, not authentication or a guaranteed sale price.

HeriBase is developed by Open Sky New Media Limited. The official site states it is used by 1M+ collectors in 195+ countries and regions (internal data as of May 2026).

name: GhostTalk
tagline: Anonymous text chat with strangers
description: GhostTalk is a free anonymous text chat site, an Omegle alternative — chat with strangers via text, no signup, no login.

name: Gift A Cartoon
tagline: Preview a photo as a cartoon, then order it printed on a gift.
description: Gift A Cartoon turns a photo into a cartoon portrait with an on-screen preview before ordering. Customers can choose a style and put the result on a mug, shirt, canvas or another printed gift. Previewing is free; printed products and shipping are paid.

name: imgtodo
tagline: Free online image tools. Compress, resize, crop and convert images in your browser.
description: imgtodo is a free online image editor for compressing, resizing, cropping, converting, watermarking, rotating, splitting, and enhancing images, plus a product photo maker. No account or software install is required. Some tools run fully in the browser; others send images to the server only when processing starts.

name: HourlyRateCalc
tagline: Free Salary, Hourly Pay & Take-Home Income Calculators
description: HourlyRateCalc offers free online calculators for US employees, freelancers, contractors, and job seekers. Convert hourly wages into yearly, monthly, and weekly income, estimate take-home pay after taxes, calculate overtime earnings, and compare salaries across US states. Additional tools help users evaluate job offers, calculate freelance rates, compare total compensation, and prepare for salary negotiations. Each calculator provides clear results and practical explanations to help users make informed financial decisions.

name: HZAPI
tagline: Enterprise-grade unified AI API gateway for developers and engineering teams.
description: An enterprise-grade unified AI API gateway built for developers and engineering teams. Call frontier reasoning, chat, and multimodal models through a single standard key with configured channel routing and request-level usage records.

name: AIBase
tagline: AI image and video generator in one workspace
description: AIBase is an independent AI image generator and AI video generator. It brings text to image, image to image, text to video and image to video into one workspace, with 4 image and 6 video models to choose from. Write a prompt, add one JPEG, PNG or WebP reference up to 10 MB where supported, review the model, settings and credit estimate before you submit, then follow progress and download the result. A free image trial on the homepage needs no account.

name: GetPDFMint
tagline: Free online PDF and developer tools
description: GetPDFMint is a free browser-based toolkit for converting, merging, splitting, compressing and editing PDFs, along with useful developer and text utilities. It offers no-signup access to website tools. Conversion results and processing vary by tool, so users should review downloaded documents and each tool's stated limits.

name: Match Asia
tagline: Match.asia is a Southeast Asian M&A marketplace connecting business owners with verified buyers and investors.
description:
Match.asia is a Southeast Asian M&A marketplace that connects business owners with verified buyers and investors. The platform uses AI-powered matching to help sellers find relevant acquisition opportunities and investors discover businesses that match their investment criteria.
Match.asia supports business owners throughout the business sale process, from preparing a company for sale and assessing its value to finding potential buyers and connecting with investors. The platform focuses on SME business sales and acquisitions across Southeast Asia, including Singapore, Vietnam, and Thailand.
For buyers and investors, Match.asia provides access to business acquisition opportunities across industries such as F&B, retail, manufacturing, technology, business services, and other sectors. The platform combines business listings, investor information, and technology-driven matching to help users discover relevant acquisition opportunities.
Match.asia operates on a success-fee model, with no upfront fee for sellers. The platform aims to simplify the process of buying and selling businesses across Southeast Asia.

name: EditBright
tagline: Free AI image editor — no sign up, no login
description: EditBright is a free AI image editor that runs in the browser — no sign up and no login. Upload a photo, edit or generate, and download. Image-to-image, background remover, and photo enhancer are available on day one. Default tools stay free; optional paid models are there for more power.

name: MTIStudy
tagline: Chinese-English translation and IELTS practice with AI feedback
description: MTIStudy is a Chinese-language practice platform for CATTI translation exams, MTI entrance exams and IELTS. Learners can work through exam materials, write translations, compare reference translations, save practice progress and review AI feedback on omissions, terminology and expression. IELTS practice covers listening, reading and writing. Some previews and limited trial practice are free; additional access and AI feedback require paid membership or credits. It is a study aid, not an official examination or certification service.

name: SaveAMedia
tagline: Save Instagram Reels, videos, Stories and photos in 1080p HD — free, no watermark, no login. Paste a public link and download MP4 or MP3 in seconds.
description: SaveAMedia is a free, browser-based Instagram downloader. Paste any public Instagram Reel, video, Story or photo link and save it in 1080p HD as MP4, or extract the audio as MP3 — no watermark, no login, no app to install. It works on iPhone, Android, Mac and Windows, and strips tracking parameters from the link before downloading.

name: huepick
tagline: Free image color picker that runs in your browser
description: huepick is a free online image color picker. Drop, browse or paste an image (Ctrl+V / Cmd+V), hover to see a pixel magnifier, and click to copy the exact HEX, RGB, HSL and CMYK values. It also extracts six dominant colors into a palette, keeps your recent picks, lets you nudge the cursor pixel by pixel with the arrow keys, and can pick from screen with the browser's EyeDropper. Images are processed locally with the Canvas API and never uploaded. No sign-up, no watermarks, no usage limits.

name: PRSNA
tagline: Create characters, write stories with them and roleplay in solo or group chats. Dozens of AI models, private chats, free to start.
description: PRSNA is a place to write with AI characters. Describe someone and PRSNA builds their personality, backstory and look in about a minute. Then chat one on one, put up to five characters in a group scene, or write a story in chapters. Dozens of models, free to start.

name: Nrity B2B
tagline: Cold email software with free mailbox warm-up
description: Nrity B2B is cold email software with free, continuous mailbox warm-up and weekly inbox placement tests. Every mailbox is capped at 30 cold emails a day, on every plan, and at 5 a day to any one company; more volume comes from more warmed-up mailboxes. Each lead is sent only from a mailbox whose latest test reached that lead's provider. A 7-day free trial needs no card; sending features are on every plan.

name: wobble image
tagline: Animate still images with playful wobble effects in your browser
description: wobble image is a free browser tool for turning still images into playful animations. Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image, paint the area that should move, and try motion styles such as wobble, jiggle, sway, bounce and jelly. Export a looping GIF or WebM for a reaction image, sticker, illustration or social post. Images are processed on your device without uploading them, and no account is required.

name: Jralo
tagline: Free WCAG 2.2 check, with dated proof of every scan
description: Jralo is a WCAG 2.2 Level A and AA website check that opens your site in a real browser (homepage plus up to five linked pages) and also reports broken links, page errors, broken images and slow pages. The free check is three times a day and needs no sign-up. Paid plans add daily checks and a dated, independently timestamped evidence log. Optional Website Mechanic opens suggested fixes as GitHub pull requests you review; it is not an accessibility overlay, and automated checks do not certify legal compliance.

name: IPIP-NEO
tagline: Big Five questionnaire with 30 facet scores
description: IPIP-NEO offers the 120- and 300-item versions of John A. Johnson’s public-domain Big Five questionnaires. Both measure five broad personality dimensions and 30 narrower facets. You can complete either version and see the score profile without an account; the optional written report is paid. The site documents its scoring and reference samples. It is for learning and self-reflection, not diagnosis or hiring.

name: AI Minecraft Skin Generator
tagline: Turn an idea, photo or avatar into your next Minecraft skin.
description: AI Minecraft Skin Generator turns an idea, photo or avatar into a playable Minecraft skin. Describe a character (up to 450 characters) or upload a selfie, character image or artwork (PNG, JPG or WEBP, up to 10 MB). Text-to-skin costs 1 credit. Image workflows create a character preview first (1 credit), then convert the look you confirm into a playable skin (2 credits). Failed generations return reserved credits. Preview the result in 3D, download a Classic 64x64 PNG, and refine it in the free editor. Other free tools include a local PNG format converter and a public Java player skin lookup. Sign in is required for AI generation and to save a private history; the 3D examples, editors and converter can be used without an account. New accounts receive 3 welcome credits. Credits, including welcome credits, never expire. Compatible with Java Edition; Bedrock custom-skin support depends on the device. This independent tool is not an official Minecraft product and is not approved by or affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.

name: Meowdoku by PurrTally
tagline: Cat placement puzzles with explained hints
description: Meowdoku by PurrTally is a free browser cat-placement puzzle. Put one cat in each row, column and colored region, with no cats touching, even at corners. Learn on three teaching boards and play nine practice puzzles with undo and explained hints. No account is needed.

name: Else
tagline: AI assistant for research and reports, billed by task
description: Else helps people research questions, work with source files and produce shareable reports through a web interface. It uses prepaid, task-based billing with a limited starting balance; costs vary and failed work can incur charges. Review important results independently. Submitted by an AI assistant on behalf of the Else team.

name: Frame Extractor
tagline: Free browser-local video frame extractor and frame grabber. No server upload, no watermarks.
description: Frame Extractor is a free browser-based tool for extracting still images from local video files. Videos are processed locally in the browser without server uploads. It offers frame selection, first-and-last-frame export, contact sheets, and image downloads.

name: desk4
tagline: desk4 is cloud ERP and inventory software by Dupp GmbH, Haiger (Germany). Quotes to e-invoices, stock, DATEV; from €9.90/month net; data hosted in Germany.
description:
desk4 is a cloud-based inventory management and ERP application from Dupp GmbH in Haiger, Germany, for freelancers, SMEs and start-ups in trades, retail, services, e-commerce, rental and manufacturing.

It covers the process from quotation and order to delivery note and invoice, and creates e-invoices in the XRechnung and ZUGFeRD formats. Other functions include inventory, purchasing, CRM, a TSE-certified POS till, manufacturing, DATEV, and shop and marketplace integrations.

desk4 runs in the browser and as an app for Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS and Android. Data is stored in data centres in Germany and processed in line with the GDPR. Development and support take place in Germany.

Plans start at €9.90 per month plus VAT. Billing is per concurrent logged-in user; employee accounts are unlimited. A test environment is free, with no contract and no time limit. Support: +49 2773 92090.

name: FrostRank
tagline: Free SEO and developer tools that run entirely in the browser — no sign-up.
description: FrostRank is a free suite of SEO and developer tools that run entirely in the browser — JSON formatter, password generator, JWT decoder, image compressor and more, with no sign-up. Everything runs client-side, so nothing you paste leaves your browser.

name: Easy Grid Maker
tagline: Copy a photo onto paper by following named squares, then print a blank grid that matches the photo sheet
description: When a sketch or mural has to keep the proportions of a reference photo, Easy Grid Maker splits the picture into named squares you can copy one at a time. Choose a photo in the browser (JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC); the grid can follow Fewer, Medium or More (3, 5 or 8 squares on the short side) or your own column and row counts. Print outputs the photo with the grid and a second, empty sheet of the same size. Related tools include printable grid paper, an art projector, paint-by-number and coloring-page exports, and small posters. Photos are handled only on the device. In most countries, saving and printing remain free for up to 300 files a day with no account; some countries require Pro for those steps. Pro is $88 a year or $139 as a lifetime license.

name: MomentRescue
tagline: Open closed eyes in group photos with a selected-person AI repair.
description: A blink can spoil an otherwise useful group portrait. MomentRescue lets you select that person and try an eye-area repair, optionally guided by an open-eye photo of the same person. Use the saved preview to inspect gaze and eyelid edges; outputs are AI estimates and vary with the source photo. One generation per account is free across the toolkit, with a watermarked preview. Clean downloads and further edits use one-time purchased Credits, starting at $1.49, with no subscription.

name: FB4KDownloader
tagline: Free Facebook video downloader.
description: Free Facebook video downloader. Download public Facebook videos and Reels in HD (1080p/720p), upscaled 4K, or MP3 audio. No sign-up, privacy-first, for personal backups.

name: MyLogoQR
tagline: Free QR code generator with logo, colors and shapes.
description: Free QR code generator with logo, colors and shapes. Create QR codes for URLs, WhatsApp, Wi-Fi, vCard, text and more — no sign-up, works right in the browser. Also available as an Android app and Chrome extension.

name: PuzzleBind
tagline: Free Chrome extension that makes solver-checked Sudoku, word-search and maze puzzle books for Amazon KDP. $0, 20 puzzles/book, 1 export/day, no account.
description: PuzzleBind is a free Chrome extension that makes solver-checked Sudoku, seeded word-search and maze puzzle books for Amazon KDP — 20 puzzles per book, 1 export per day, no account, no subscription. It makes KDP paperback interiors, not covers. Every Sudoku is solver-checked for a single solution before it goes into the book. Word searches and mazes are generated from a seed, so each volume in a series gets different puzzles. Every page is laid out against Amazon's own trim, gutter and margin rules, with even page counts and embedded fonts checked before you export. Free is $0 forever (20 puzzles/book, 1 export/day, all puzzle types, all trim sizes, AI Theme Words, footer watermark included). Pro is $19 one-time (lifetime license, no subscription, 30-day refund) and unlocks custom word lists and the large-print preset. It does not make covers, and it is not a free printable download — it makes a KDP paperback interior.

name: ACHIEVE
tagline: Business growth ideas turned into one next step.
description: ACHIEVE helps founders and small business owners act on good business ideas. The free weekly brief takes about five minutes to read and goes to more than 5,000 people. The iPhone app gives you a Daily Brief sized to your day. You choose a Play and finish the next step. You can listen to a brief out loud and read saved ideas offline. ACHIEVE is made by Stalin Kay LLC in Sheridan, Wyoming.

name: EchtCosplay
tagline: Cosplay costumes and wigs for fans, shipped online
description: German online shop with over 2,600 cosplay costumes, wigs, shoes and accessories for anime, gaming, Halloween and more. Fast shipping within Europe.

name: Hey Dream AI
tagline: Create AI videos and images in your browser
description: Hey Dream AI is a browser-based platform for generating videos from text or photos and creating or editing images with multiple AI models. Its free image-to-video tool lets users choose the opening and closing frames, then describe the motion between them. The platform offers free tools alongside paid credit options.

name: Abloom Play — Free Browser Games
tagline: Free browser games portal — 462 instantly playable games
description: Free browser games portal with 462 instantly playable games — puzzle, arcade, classic, brain, action and sports. No downloads, no sign-up, play on desktop or phone.

name: CollageMint
tagline: Free online photo collage maker — no signup, no watermark.
description: CollageMint is a free online photo collage maker with no signup and no watermark. Choose from six focal layouts and grid layouts, add up to 20 JPEG or PNG photos, and arrange a collage directly in your browser. Each photo can be up to 20 MB. Photos are processed locally in the browser rather than uploaded to a server. Download the finished collage as a PNG or JPG. CollageMint also offers a Photo Grid Maker and a Pinterest Collage Maker for related layouts. The tool does not use AI and does not require a subscription.

name: AI Image Extender
tagline: AI outpainting: extend photos to any ratio without cropping subjects.
description: AI Image Extender lets you upload a photo, pick a target frame, and generate matching background beyond the original edges. Batch up to five images; built for real estate, e-commerce, social, and poster reframes.

name: Virgínia Menino IA
tagline: Uma foto e você entra na serenata do estacionamento.
description: Virgínia Menino IA transforma uma ou duas fotos no Meme da Virgínia e o Menino. Em “Só eu cantando”, uma foto entra no lugar de quem canta; em “Nós dois”, duas fotos preenchem a cena. O MP4 vertical 9:16 segue os gestos do clipe original, sem clonar a voz, e a trilha entra depois. Você baixa vídeos de 10, 15 ou 25 segundos, em 480p ou 720p. Créditos avulsos desde US$ 5,99, sem vencimento e sem assinatura. Projeto independente, sem vínculo com TikTok ou com os criadores da trend original.

name: I Love the Smiths AI
tagline: Your own elevator moment from (500) Days of Summer
description: I Love the Smiths AI turns one or two adult portraits into the viral elevator exchange from (500) Days of Summer. Choose 15 or 23 seconds and download a landscape 16:9 HD MP4 with the prepared scene soundtrack. One-time credit packs from $9.90; no subscription.

name: EditableImage
tagline: Turn flat images into editable layers or diagrams.
description: EditableImage turns flattened graphics such as posters and product mockups into editable layers so you can revise individual elements. Its image-to-draw.io workflow converts diagram screenshots into editable shapes and connectors for further changes in diagrams.net.

name: BGRemover Online
tagline: Remove video backgrounds and export transparent clips.
description: BGRemover Online removes backgrounds from videos and images. Export transparent WebM clips for overlays, motion graphics, and web projects. Free format converters also help you work with alpha video and turn PNG sequences into WebM.

name: Sheru Bhai AI Video Generator
tagline: Create a Sheru Bhai video in 14 human-companion, couple and lion-persona scenes. Use 1–2 portraits for a new 10-second 720p video, 50 credits each.
description: Sheru Bhai AI Video Generator, on Sheru Bhai Hub, turns 1–2 clear, evenly lit adult portraits (with permission) into a new 10-second 720p MP4. Choose one of 14 fictional human-companion, couple or lion-persona templates, pick 9:16 or 16:9, and get generated instrumental audio with no dialogue. Preview clips illustrate the setting; they are not motion references. Videos cost 50 credits; 2K stills cost 5. One-time packs, no subscription: $5.99 / $14.99 / $29.99. Unused credits never expire. Adults 18+ only.

name: DateHub Today
tagline: Today's date in every calendar — Hijri, Bengali, Tamil, Punjabi, Nepali, Ethiopian, Hebrew and more
description: Free online calendar tools showing today's date in 12+ world calendars — Islamic Hijri, Arabic, Bengali/Bangla, Tamil, Malayalam, Nepali (Bikram Sambat), Ethiopian, Hebrew, Assamese (Bhaskarabda) and Punjabi (Nanakshahi / desi month date) — plus Holidays Today and date converters for any day. No sign-up, works instantly.

name: SubtitlePop
tagline: Generate, edit, and export word-timed video captions.
description: SubtitlePop generates word-timed captions from audio or video. Edit the text, timing, and style in your browser, then export SRT, VTT, ASS, TXT, or a video with burned-in captions. Free utilities convert subtitle files, shift timestamps, and check timing.

name: SkillSoniq
tagline: AI-matched hiring where you test-drive talent on real paid work before payroll
description: SkillSoniq is an AI-powered hiring app that lets companies test-drive talent on real, paid work before committing to full-time payroll. Employers post jobs for free and get AI-matched candidates within seconds, then either hire onto payroll from day one or start a paid project and convert when ready. SkillSoniq runs background checks, handles onboarding paperwork and weekly timesheets, and sends one consolidated invoice. Pricing: free to post and hire; a payment-processing fee plus up to 20% commission on paid trial work; a buyout fee on payroll conversion. Web and iOS.

name: Lewis Structure Generator
tagline: Free Lewis Structure Generator – Lewis Dot Calculator
description: Free Lewis structure generator: enter H2O or NO3- and get a reviewed Lewis diagram with valence electrons, lone pairs, formal charges, VSEPR geometry and bond angles. No signup; PNG and SVG downloads.

name: Klarr
tagline: Klarr: commission-free bookings and visibility on Google and AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini) for independent restaurants.
description: Klarr is an all-in-one platform for independent restaurants. It brings together commission-free online bookings (reservation book, floor plan, deposits paid straight to the restaurant's own account, private events), a website with the menu and allergens, the Google Business Profile and reviews, posts to Facebook, Instagram and TikTok, and table or takeaway ordering. What sets it apart: Klarr measures whether the restaurant is recommended when diners ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Google's AI Mode where to eat, and shows what to fix. Klarr is published by EDIREF, a Paris company that also runs a restaurant in Paris. Free trial, no credit card, no commitment.

name: NAVSMAP
tagline: Find AI tools, workflows, MCP servers and agent skills
description: NAVSMAP is a Chinese-first resource discovery site for AI and everyday productivity tools. Browse tool profiles with use cases, pricing notes and official links, explore task-based workflows, and find MCP servers and agent skills with setup references. Public browsing is free; third-party tools may charge separately.

name: Warta Kopi
tagline: Indonesian coffee shop review media — menu, price, vibe
description: Warta Kopi (wartakopi.net) is an online media that reviews coffee shops across Indonesia. Not a cafe or hotel. Readers get menus, price ranges, locations, hours, atmosphere notes, plus bean and roasting guides.

name: Peplio Background Remover
tagline: Remove image backgrounds in your browser and download a transparent PNG.
description: Peplio Background Remover cuts out the subject of a portrait or product photo and exports a transparent PNG. Image processing happens locally in the browser. The tool is free and requires no signup.

name: PsychologyTests
tagline: Short questionnaires scored privately in your browser
description: PsychologyTests gathers questionnaires on topics such as anxiety, mood, attention, personality, and stress. You can browse by category, see who the questions are for, and complete a tool in the browser; answers are scored locally and are not sent to a server. These screenings help you notice patterns, but they are not a diagnosis or a treatment plan. Discuss results with a qualified professional when they matter to care.

name: TechXaro Abandoned Form Recovery
tagline: Recover leads from forms your visitors never finished.
description: TechXaro Abandoned Form Recovery gives you a free, privacy-aware way to see where visitors start, stop, and abandon forms on your WordPress site. It helps you spot friction in the form experience and recover missed leads without sending form data to a remote service. Each form follows one lifecycle: started, in progress, abandoned or completed. Progress is autosaved while a visitor fills in a form. If they leave the page or stay inactive past the timeout you set, the entry is marked abandoned. Features: track started, in-progress, abandoned, and completed form sessions; dashboard with daily chart, device and date filters; entries list with search, filters, sort and bulk delete; landing page and UTM details; email alerts for abandoned forms; Minimal or Full capture mode; consent controls and GDPR mode; field safeguards (password, hidden, file upload, card and OTP fields skipped); AES-256 encryption at rest when OpenSSL is available; data retention controls (default 90 days); data stays in your own WordPress database — no subscription, no external account. Works with: Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Fluent Forms, Ninja Forms, Formidable Forms, Elementor Pro Forms, Bricks Forms, and any standard HTML form. Requirements: WordPress 5.8+, PHP 7.4+. Tested up to WordPress 7.1. Free. GPLv2 or later.

name: Spanish Word Unscrambler & Word Finder
tagline: Free Spanish word unscrambler & word finder
description: Free Spanish word unscrambler & word finder — unscramble letters into Spanish words, exact anagrams, Scrabble answers, with ñ and accent handling. No account, runs in browser.

name: EleganceFonts
tagline: Style text line by line for profiles
description: EleganceFonts is a free browser tool for styling Unicode text. Enter several lines, choose a style for each line, and leave other lines plain. Compare styles and compare text pasted back after using it in another app. Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese and English interfaces are available. It produces copyable characters, not font files; rendering depends on the app and device. No account is needed.

name: AI Matching PFP Maker
tagline: Upload two selfies, describe your vision, and get a personalized matching PFP in a square format made for social media.
description: The AI Matching PFP Maker turns your selfies into coordinated profile pictures. Upload your photos and describe the style you want — whether professional, casual, or themed — and AI creates the image for you. It's made for couples who want matching profile pictures on social media and messaging apps.

name: WordCam
tagline: Learn a Language by Taking Photos of the World Around You
description: WordCam is a photo-based language-learning product with four AI tools in one place: upload a photo, snap one on the spot, or paste a screenshot, and AI labels every object it finds in the picture in both your native and your target language; describe any scene to generate a practical dialogue; chat with AI by voice or text; or open your camera for real-time descriptions in your chosen language. WordCam currently supports 11 languages.

name: Max Maker AI
tagline: Turn text or photos into short videos with AI
description: Max Maker AI helps creators and online sellers make short videos and product visuals in a browser. Generate a clip from a text prompt or animate a still photo by describing the movement you want. The workspace also offers image generation, background removal, photo restoration, and virtual clothing try-on.

name: KlingVideo
tagline: Free Kling AI video generator: turn text, images, and motion control into cinematic videos with Kling 3.0, Seedance, Veo, Wan & more. Start with free credits.
description: KlingVideo is a free Kling AI video generator that turns text prompts, reference images, and motion-control inputs into cinematic AI videos. Create with Kling 3.0 plus Seedance, Veo, Wan, Hailuo, Grok and more—plan multi-shot scenes, keep characters consistent, animate stills, and transfer reference movement. New users get free starter credits; paid plans unlock more capacity. No watermark on supported exports. Start at https://klingvideo.app/

name: Sherlock Reverse Image Search
tagline: Web reverse image search to see where a photo appears online.
description: Sherlock Reverse Image Search is a web tool for checking where a photo appears online. Upload a JPEG, PNG, or WebP you have the right to check, or paste a direct image link. It is not facial recognition and does not identify anyone's legal identity.

name: Wechatai
tagline: Connect your own AI models and agents to WeChat
description: Wechatai connects your own model API or existing agents to WeChat through one-to-one ClawBot binding. Chat, generate images or receive notifications. BYOK; provider model fees are separate. Free daily credits and optional Plus. Not affiliated with Tencent.

name: AI Stack Lab
tagline: Dated price and feature data for the AI and cross-border ecommerce stack, with working cost calculators.
description: AI Stack Lab is a resource platform providing dated price and feature data for AI and cross-border ecommerce software tools. It offers working cost calculators including cross-border profit, advertising breakeven, SaaS stack costs, newsletter revenue, affiliate page value, and funnel break-even. The site organizes software into categories such as AI copywriting, video, voice, Amazon research, analytics, automation, customer support, design, ecommerce, email/SMS, hosting, model APIs, payments, productivity, SEO, translation, and website builders. It includes editorial best-picks guides for building stacks for specific use cases and clearly marks sponsored/referral affiliate links. Target audience: cross-border ecommerce sellers, indie hackers, marketers, and software evaluators looking for practical AI and marketing tool guidance with transparent pricing history.

name: VersusDeck
tagline: Short, cite-ready software comparisons
description: VersusDeck publishes short software comparisons you can cite: a direct answer first, a side-by-side table, and links to the official sources behind every claim. Pages cover things like free Photoshop alternatives and common tool-versus-tool questions. No ads and no software sales, just the comparison.

name: Fullweek
tagline: AI agents that keep your schedule full
description: Marketing and AI call answering for home service businesses (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing and other trades). AI agents answer calls, texts and forms, triage emergencies, block spam and book real jobs into your software, plus manage Google Business Profile, Local Services Ads and paid search. Paid per booked job, month-to-month, and you own everything.

name: Outlier Atlas
tagline: Free daily map game and independent geography guides
description: A free daily map game hosted on an independent Farflung player-guide website. Daily geography challenges and independent game guides. Not affiliated with Farflung LLC.

name: Need for Speed AI
tagline: Turn a car, truck, or motorcycle photo into a cinematic chase clip.
description: A paid photo-to-video tool that turns a car, truck, or motorcycle photo into a cinematic chase clip inspired by the Need for Speed AI social-video trend. Choose a 14-second or 30-second video. Independent service, not affiliated with EA, Need for Speed, or TikTok. Paid one-time packs: 14s $14.99/$39.99/$64.99; 30s $29.99/$79.99/$129.99.

name: Chat Met Vreemden
tagline: Chat met vreemden van over de hele wereld, 1-op-1 op video.
description: Chat Met Vreemden (Dutch for “chat with strangers”) is a one-to-one random video chat aimed at Dutch-speaking visitors who want to meet people from around the world, not only from their own neighborhood. Press start and you get one person on video; where they are from is something you find out by asking. No registration is required to begin, and nothing has to be downloaded — you open the site in the browser. The service is only for adults 18 and over. The landing pages are in Dutch, but the chat interface is in English, which the site flags before you start. Some free matches or coins may be given as a reward; prices are shown before you begin. Report and safety information are provided. It is a straightforward way for Dutch speakers to say hallo to a stranger on camera without creating an account first.

name: Voxxy
tagline: Random 1-on-1 voice calls with strangers. Camera off; just your microphone.
description: Voxxy is a voice-first random chat: you meet someone new one call at a time, with the camera left off. Audio mode asks only for your microphone. Press start in the browser, talk, and move on whenever you like. No account is needed to begin, and it is free to start. Coins may apply for extras or extra features, with the cost shown before you choose one — free to start does not mean everything stays free. Report and block controls are built in. The service is for adults 18+ only. Voxxy is for people who want a real conversation without turning on a camera or scrolling another feed: a simple “hey,” two voices, and the option to hang up and try someone else. It works in mobile and desktop browsers and also mentions an app.

name: Interview Copilot
tagline: Interview Copilot — Your Real-Time Interview Answer Assistant
description: Interview Copilot is your real-time interview answer assistant. It listens to your interview in real time, detects each question the interviewer asks, and delivers a first-person answer hint within seconds.

name: VibeCamz
tagline: Online speed dating that starts when you do: meet face to face in seconds, skip if you don’t click.
description: VibeCamz is an online speed-dating style video chat that does not make you wait for a ticketed event or a fixed-length round. You start a date when you are ready, meet someone face to face in seconds, stay if you feel a spark, and skip to the next vibe if you do not. Video, voice or text are all options, and no profile has to be filled out first. It is free to start, with no sign-up required; after the first few matches, video and voice calls use in-site coins. There is no event ticket to buy. The service is for adults 18 and over, with 24/7 moderation plus report and block tools. VibeCamz is aimed at people who like the curiosity of speed dating — a hello, a chance to see if you click — but want to do it on their own time, in the browser, instead of sitting through a scheduled session.

name: Dewdrop
tagline: A blind date app with no profiles to judge: press start and meet a random stranger.
description: Dewdrop is a blind-date style meeting app that skips the profile homework. There are no bios and no photos to judge: you press start and are introduced at random to someone you have not met yet, on video, voice or text. You can leave whenever you like. The idea is to meet the person before the preconceptions, rather than hiding a photo behind a blur. It is free to start and needs no registration or profile to begin. After a free introduction, continuing a call uses in-site coins; current coin requirements are shown before you choose to keep talking. The service is for adults 18+, with safety information on the site. Dewdrop is aimed at people who want a fresh hello with a little mystery, without swiping through a stack of profiles or writing a perfect opening line.

name: Umingle
tagline: Friendly 1-on-1 video calls with someone new, minus the pressure.
description: Umingle is a video chat with strangers designed to feel low-pressure and friendly. It drops you into a one-on-one video call with someone new from anywhere in the world. Before matching you can pick tonight's vibe, such as music, gaming, languages, travel, movies or just talk; the vibe is an icebreaker rather than a filter, so every match is still random. The flow is three taps: pick your vibe, meet on camera, then skip or stay. Umingle is built for talking rather than swiping, and you remain anonymous until you choose to share anything about yourself. The platform describes itself as a clean room with real rules: moderation runs around the clock, and it is clean by design. You can try it without signing up, and it is free to start. People are mingling 24/7 worldwide, so there is usually someone new ready to say hello.

name: MenuTicker
tagline: Real fast-food prices, sampled store by store.
description: MenuTicker tracks fast-food menu prices from 2,072 sampled US restaurants across 15 chains. Every price is a median with a typical range and sample size, updated monthly — plus cross-chain comparisons and nutrition value rankings.

name: FleetDesk Repair Handoff
tagline: Turn an open fleet repair into a clear shift handoff.
description: A free browser tool for small fleets, dispatchers, and equipment rental teams. Record the unit, confirmed repair status, who owns the next shop callback, and when it is due. Then generate a handoff note your next shift can actually use. No account required. A separate Excel tracker is available for teams that manage multiple repairs.

name: TokClip
tagline: Steal the trend. Keep your face.
description: TokClip turns one or two photos into short AI videos of viral TikTok and Reels trends. Try 5 seconds free, then get a 15-second clip in minutes. Packs from $9.99, no subscription.

name: Remix the Trend
tagline: Cut up the trend. Paste yourself in.
description: Remix the Trend turns your photos into 15-second AI videos of viral TikTok, Reels and Shorts trends — with your bestie too. Packs from $9.99, or an optional monthly plan.

name: LookalikeGuard
tagline: Find lookalike domains impersonating your brand
description: Finds lookalike and typosquat domains impersonating your brand, scores the risk, and alerts you when new ones appear. Free scan, no signup needed.

name: AI Shoulder Carry
tagline: AI video generator that makes the TikTok shoulder carry trend from two photos.
description: AI Shoulder Carry turns one photo of each of two people into the TikTok shoulder carry ("I'm the One") trend video. One person is carried across the other's shoulders, then swings down on the beat and takes over the lip sync. Output is vertical 9:16 with no watermark, delivered both without sound (ready to add the trend sound in TikTok or Reels) and with the original sound for personal viewing. Video is rendered with Kling 4.0 and reference images prepared with GPT Image 2.5. Photos are cleared after two days; finished videos stay in the account for 30 days.

name: Meloop
tagline: Clear makeup credits and family booking for independent music teachers.
description: Meloop helps independent music teachers keep lesson cancellations, cancellation rules and source-linked makeup credits together. Families can use private links to see their available credits and book an eligible makeup lesson. Try the free, fictional example at https://meloop.brainer.one/example: record a cancellation, see the policy outcome and book a sample makeup without signing up or providing personal information. The sample records disappear when you leave or reset. Real lesson records and private family makeup booking require a teacher account and Meloop Teacher, available at $10/month: https://meloop.brainer.one/pricing. Meloop is a focused credits-and-booking tool, not an all-in-one studio suite. It does not collect student tuition, send automated reminders or sync calendars.

name: VoiceFleet
tagline: AI inbound voice receptionist service.
description: AI inbound voice receptionist; configured instructions/FAQs, caller messages/details, compatible-calendar appointments, existing-number forwarding, configured escalation and call summaries.

name: Unrust
tagline: Unassisted JS/TS/Python coding diagnostic and practice.
description: Unassisted JS/TS/Python coding diagnostic/practice, without AI/autocomplete in the diagnostic. Recall, debugging, tracing, idioms, flaws, reviewing AI code.

name: ImageTo3D
tagline: Turn photos into 3D models with AI
description: ImageTo3D converts images into 3D models (GLB/GLTF) directly in the browser — no GPU, no installs. Made for game developers, 3D printing fans, AR/VR creators and e-commerce teams who need fast 3D assets from photos.

name: Reeling
tagline: Social publishing workspace and AI-assisted content preparation.
description: Social publishing workspace, AI-assisted content preparation/video ads, calendar, per-channel settings.

tagline: Every payout matched to the bank and the ledger
description: 16-62 is payment and bank reconciliation software for finance teams and their accountants. It matches Stripe, Shopify Payments, PayPal, Adyen and Amazon payouts to bank statements and the ledger, record by record, and explains every difference. A sample opens the whole product without an account; every plan starts with a free month.

name: Enclessa
tagline: EU-hosted teamwork with encrypted direct messages and calls
description: Enclessa is an EU-hosted collaboration platform for businesses and organisations, operated by Quavon UG in Germany. It combines team messaging, MLS-encrypted direct messages and video calls with optional boards, projects, GitHub sync, time tracking, people management and customer modules. Managed channels support server-side search and export; direct messages are end-to-end encrypted. A Free plan supports up to 10 members, with paid tiers for additional capacity and modules. The website describes Enclessa as open beta, but registration is currently closed to new organisations.

name: TixFin
tagline: Branded ticket shops, direct payments and QR event check-in
description: TixFin is a ticketing and event management platform for clubs, associations, venues, promoters, conferences and festivals. Organisers can create branded ticket shops, configure tiered prices and reserved seating, connect their own Stripe, Mollie, PayPal or Adyen account, and check guests in with QR codes. The platform also includes crew planning, memberships, CRM and analytics, with German and English interfaces and optional APIs. Published plans start at €0 per month plus 1% + €0.16 per paid ticket, excluding VAT and payment processing fees. Public testing has not opened yet; organisers can join the notification list on the website.

name: Hailbell
tagline: In-app support chat and push for iOS, Android and web
description:
Hailbell is in-app support chat plus push notifications for iOS, Android and web apps.

Customers write from inside your app. An AI answers first from your docs and real prices, and you finish the reply from the dashboard, a Discord thread, Telegram or an AI agent over MCP. The customer gets a push when you answer.

Each conversation shows the customer's plan, purchases, device and country. Hailbell can show an offer card that opens your paywall, and ask for an App Store review right after a problem is solved.

Push campaigns go to iOS, Android and web in one send, with segments, each person's local time, quiet hours and daily caps.

Native Swift and Kotlin SDKs and a web widget. Unlimited apps and seats. From $29/month, free for 14 days, no card required.

name: Sendhour
tagline: Paste your app link, get viral short videos made and posted
description:
Sendhour is an all-in-one short-form content tool for people marketing apps and small brands, from solo developers to agencies running many client accounts. Paste your app or product link and it makes and posts short-form videos for you.

It finds what's going viral: the viral library shows public TikTok, YouTube and Instagram posts in your niche that are getting far more views than the account usually gets.

Sendhour's AI writes scripts in those viral formats for your product, and the AI studio creates the videos: photo slideshows or short videos with voiceover, copying the structure, never the footage. You don't have to write anything, though you can write or edit your own version on the site if you want.

Sendhour schedules and posts to TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Threads, Bluesky, X and LinkedIn through each network's official API, and tracks analytics for what you post.

AI agents can search the library and schedule posts through Sendhour's API and MCP server.

Plans start at $29/month (5 accounts, 200 AI credits), or $23/month billed yearly.

name: CloudVerg
tagline: Private cloud and AI connectivity for US businesses
description: CloudVerg provides private cloud and AI connectivity for US businesses. It offers multi-cloud networking across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud and Oracle, AI infrastructure connectivity, zero-trust security and SOC 2 readiness, along with consulting and managed services. Its platforms are VergMesh, VergForge, VergMind, VergRail and VergShield, and ERPSav is a CloudVerg product.

name: ERPSav
tagline: Cost recovery ERP that finds money lost to billing errors and overcharges.
description: ERPSav is a cost recovery ERP, a product of CloudVerg. Its 15 rules-based recovery engines check for duplicate supplier payments, lease overcharges, utility and telecom billing errors, card fees, warranty claims, freight overcharges, SaaS waste, chargebacks, and sales tax errors. It serves businesses in the US, Canada, UK, Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand. ERPSav offers a 14-day free trial with every module, no card required.

name: GTA5Goodbye

name: Prompt Anatomy

The method is a structured way to design repeatable AI tasks for individuals and teams, so instructions are easier to reuse, evaluate, and improve.

META defines the AI's role, task objective, and operating boundaries. INPUT specifies the source data and context the AI may use. OUTPUT defines the expected deliverable, structure, and format. REASONING sets decision criteria as observable steps. QUALITY establishes checks for accuracy, completeness, and compliance. ADVANCED adds tools, retrieval, automation, or multi-step agent workflows when the task needs them.

Training runs in an interactive app on promptanatomy.app, with hands-on exercises and a certificate from a 70% score. Starter (39 EUR) covers modules 1-3: prompt engineering, the 6-block system, and six business scenarios. Core (99 EUR) covers modules 1-6 and adds context engineering, a sprint, and a project. Both are one-time payments with lifetime access and no subscription. AI training for teams is available on request.

A 500+ template library and free workflow tools complement the course. Trainings are available in English and Lithuanian. Founder and creator: Tomas Staniulis. Contact: info@promptanatomy.app.
