The platform helps researchers explore and screen candidate materials. It is a commercial service with trial terms described on the official website. Model outputs are decision-support results and require expert review and experimental validation before research or engineering use.

name: Unblur Image
tagline: AI photo deblurring for camera shake and missed focus
description: Unblur Image is an online AI photo deblurring tool for camera shake and missed focus. It offers Repaint and Fidelity modes, free 1K output, and paid 2K/4K options; accepts JPG, PNG and WebP up to 20 MB.

name: Deployz
tagline: Deploy your SaaS into customer AWS
description: Deployz helps small SaaS teams deploy and update supported apps in customer-owned AWS accounts. Connect GitHub, review app readiness, prepare a release, and test it in your own AWS account before customer installation. Deployz supports one Linux x86-64 container image with an HTTP service. Optional workers use the same image. AWS resource charges are separate.

name: robrun.lol
tagline: Free ROB RUN guides and tools: wipe timer, weapons database, and money calculators.
description: Independent fan resource for ROB RUN (Kefir, Steam). Free guides and tools: wipe timer, weapons database by Mark, net income calculator, and money route comparison. No sign-up.

name: UGC Maker AI
tagline: Turn product photos into short video ads and demos.
description: UGC Maker AI is a browser-based AI video and image creation tool for ecommerce sellers, marketers, and content creators. It turns product photos and text prompts into short product demos, social media clips, and UGC-style video ads. It also supports AI image generation and talking presenter clips created from a portrait and an audio track.

name: Phantom Blade Zero Hub
tagline: Independent Phantom Blade Zero guide: release dates, languages, PC specs, editions and prices
description: An independent, source-checked guide hub for S-GAME's wuxia action game Phantom Blade Zero. It compares the October 28-29 release dates by platform and region, lists the 15 text languages and two voice languages, sets out PC minimum and recommended requirements, explains Standard vs Deluxe editions, launch bonuses and current store prices, and answers common game questions. Guides are available in English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. Free to read, no account needed.

name: LinkBunny
tagline: Nofollow link exchanges for coding agents
description: Connect LinkBunny to Claude Code or Codex, then submit your site for manual review. When there is a suitable match, your agent proposes where to add a contextual nofollow link. You approve each placement before it goes live. The first exchange is free for one site with no card required. Paid plans are USD 20/month or USD 210/year for up to 10 sites, with no per-link fees.

name: LaneVertex
tagline: Native C23 transfer manager for macOS, with Windows and Linux command-line builds.
description:
I am Michael, the developer of LaneVertex. It is a native C23 transfer manager, independently developed by one person in Graz, Austria. Public release 1.0.6 is a macOS desktop app (Developer ID signed and notarized, macOS 13 or later) and command-line builds for Windows and Linux with a GUI preview. Full desktop apps for Windows and Linux are still in development.

This release is verified for ordinary file downloads over a single connection. Multi-link downloads, storage-destination uploads, and torrent or magnet transfers are not yet verified. Device-wide traffic control is not part of version 1.0. The Windows installer is not code-signed; SmartScreen may warn.

Full 14-day trial, no card; then a one-time €39 licence (applicable taxes included), no subscription. Source is currently private.

https://lanevertex.com/
https://lanevertex.com/download/

Michael

name: Alpha WeBuilder
tagline: Build sites by composing atomic primitives, not coding
description: A free drag-and-drop website builder. Start from over 100 ready-made templates or let the AI builder rebuild a page from a URL, then edit everything with drag and drop. Export the finished site as plain HTML or a Next.js project — you own the files and host them anywhere.

name: Square Footage Hub
tagline: Free area and flooring calculators for home projects
description: Square Footage Hub offers free browser-based calculators for estimating room and floor area, planning flooring quantities, converting area units, and estimating paint project costs. Homeowners and DIYers can enter dimensions, calculate spaces separately, and use the results to plan material orders or compare quotes. Estimates are for planning; check manufacturer packaging instructions and project-specific requirements before ordering.

name: MomentScope
tagline: A live map of public cameras and streams
description: MomentScope is a map of live public cameras and streams, still in development. The idea is simple: pick a place on the map and look at a live feed instead of a static photo.

name: TwinClips AI
tagline: Create stunning videos of yourself in 3 clicks — no filming required.
description: TwinClips AI turns one photo and a short voice sample into your personal AI twin. Type a script, generate captioned vertical video in about a minute, and post to TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts — no camera, studio, or editing timeline. Built for coaches, local businesses, creators, and marketers. One-time $67 access with 50+ languages and a 60-day guarantee.

name: Merge JPG
tagline: Merge JPG files into one image in your browser
description: Merge JPG files into one image in your browser. Stack photos vertically, side by side or in a grid, see the final size, then download one JPG. Nothing is uploaded.

name: Haira
tagline: AI recruitment software: resume ranking, AI phone screens & AI video interviews for staffing agencies & hiring teams
description: Haira is an AI interview and recruitment platform for hiring teams. It creates job descriptions, ranks resumes against a role, screens candidates through AI phone calls, and runs AI video interviews. Recruiters can review scores and transcripts, compare candidates, send offers and maintain talent pools.

name: LandOffer
tagline: Find tech jobs and autofill applications
description: LandOffer helps job seekers find recent tech roles and prepare applications. Its free Chrome extension fills supported application forms from a candidate profile. Applicants can review or edit AI-assisted answer drafts before submitting.

name: PracHub
tagline: Practice technical interview questions
description: PracHub helps students and professionals prepare for technical interviews through company- and role-specific practice questions, preparation guides, and AI-assisted mentoring. Candidates can explore free resources and upgrade for additional practice.

name: AI Agents Info
tagline: AI agent directory and dated research
description: AI Agents Info is a directory of AI agents and AI tools. It adds free side-by-side comparisons, agent benchmarks and trackers, free tools such as an AI agent ROI calculator and an agent picker, and dated research reports you can read in full on the site.

name: Online Sound Test
tagline: Test speakers, headphones, and microphones in your browser.
description: Online Sound Test is a free browser-based toolkit for checking speakers, headphones, microphones, and other audio devices. Run guided tests for stereo channels, bass, frequency range, phase, surround sound, and microphone input. Clear instructions help users identify silent channels, weak bass, distortion, unbalanced output, and common microphone problems. No installation is required.

name: Krillion Hint
tagline: Spoiler-free clues and verified answers for Krillion’s Daily Dive.
description: Krillion Hint is a free, independent companion to Krillion’s Daily Dive. Each published prompt has two clues on a separate hints page. The answers page shows verified picks and the scores returned by the official game. Players can browse past dives by date and use the scoring guide to understand answer tiers. No account is required.

name: Font Changer
tagline: Type once and copy fonts for Instagram, TikTok, Discord and Free Fire
description: Type once and copy a font that shows up on Instagram, TikTok, Discord and in game names. Each style tells you where it works and how long it is. Free, no sign-up.

name: Like Jennie AI
tagline: Turn Any Photo into a Like Jennie AI Dance Video
description:
Like Jennie AI turns a single photo into a viral dance video. Upload a picture of yourself, a friend, or a character, and watch AI bring it to life with the Like Jennie dance. No filming, dancing skills, or complicated editing required.

Paid / Credit Packs. Templates can be browsed for free; AI video generation is paid.

name: GhostPrompter
tagline: Desktop teleprompter that stays out of your recordings
description: GhostPrompter is a desktop teleprompter for Windows and Mac, made for people who read a script while they use their computer. The script sits in a transparent overlay on top of your screen. Clicks and typing pass straight through it, so you can run a product demo, move through slides on Zoom, or record a coding tutorial without switching windows. Voice-activated scrolling keeps pace as you talk and waits when you pause. If you would rather scroll yourself, the keyboard and mouse still work. The overlay is hidden from screen recordings and screen shares in OBS, Loom, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, ScreenFlow and QuickTime, so viewers see your content and you see your notes. You can write and store scripts inside the app. Everything runs locally, and the app does not collect your data. It is a one-time purchase with lifetime updates and a 14-day free trial.

name: PhotoCraft AI
tagline: Free Online PSD Editor with an AI Agent
description: PhotoCraft AI combines a free browser-based photo and PSD editor with optional AI tools. Edit layers, masks, text and adjustments manually, or ask an AI Agent to make supported changes to your open document. Generate images from prompts or references with a choice of AI models.

name: Fakenamely
tagline: Generate realistic fake identities and test data
description: Free generator of realistic fake names, addresses and identity profiles for software testing, QA, demos and privacy-safe placeholder data. No sign-up required.

name: EveryExamPrep
tagline: Free practice questions for 179 US licensing exams
description: Free practice questions and study guides for 179 US professional licensing and certification exams, from real estate and insurance to nursing and the trades. No sign-up required.

name: RideWise
tagline: Compare Uber, Lyft and taxi fares before you ride
description: Free US ride fare comparison tool. Estimate and compare Uber, Lyft and taxi prices with guides for 27 cities and 25 airports. No sign-up required.

name: StoryIntoVideo
tagline: AI story-to-video generator that turns stories into short videos
description: StoryIntoVideo is an AI tool that turns any novel, script, or narrative into a complete short video - it builds consistent characters, scenes, multi-voice narration, and storyboards in minutes.

name: HostDealsPro
tagline: Dated Hostinger price tracking — intro vs renewal, checked and published.
description: HostDealsPro is an independent price-tracking site for Hostinger hosting. It publishes a dated public price log, plan-by-plan pricing breakdowns, and a renewal-pricing guide showing what each plan costs after the intro term ends. Prices are checked against hostinger.com and dated, with no invented figures. The site also covers VPS plans, business email, and Black Friday sale pricing.

name: RealZodiacTest
tagline: Find your best US city by zodiac sign.
description: RealZodiacTest is an 18-question quiz that matches your zodiac sign to the US cities where you are most likely to thrive. The free result shows your #3 city. A one-time $3.99 unlock reveals your full city ranking. Launched 2026-03-18.

name: ClearFrame
tagline: AI watermark remover for creators' own videos
description: ClearFrame removes watermarks, subtitles and logos from your own videos with frame-by-frame AI. MP4 and MOV up to 100MB. Your first video gets a free 5-second preview, no signup. Full processing runs on credits: Starter 10 credits $9, Pro 50 credits $39. Also includes a free Matcha Filter Remover and video Enhance upscaling.

name: Celestial Observer
tagline: Get your Human Design chart instantly, free.
description: Celestial Observer gives you a free Human Design chart instantly, with an AI reading of your design. Full Access costs $9.90, one time. Launched 2026-04-30.

name: CareerKits Growth
tagline: Practical resume, freelance and budget templates
description:
CareerKits Growth is a small side-project shop of practical digital templates for job seekers and freelancers.

Three kits are live now:

1) ATS Resume Template Kit for Tech & Business — five ATS-safe resume designs, matching cover letters, role-ready examples, 15 tailoring prompts, and an ATS cheat sheet. Edit in Word or Google Docs.
   https://careerkitsgrowth.gumroad.com/l/ubcmk
   Also on Topmate: https://topmate.io/chandramouli_nvs/2399337

2) The Freelance Close Kit — proposal templates, invoices (including GST and multi-currency), a contractor agreement template, email scripts, and a client/income tracker.
   https://careerkitsgrowth.gumroad.com/l/freelance-close-kit
   Also on Topmate: https://topmate.io/chandramouli_nvs/2399339

3) All-in-One Budget & Income Planner 2027 — an Excel and Google Sheets planner with freelancer mode, tax set-aside, debt payoff and savings trackers.
   https://careerkitsgrowth.gumroad.com/l/budget-planner-2027
   Also on Topmate: https://topmate.io/chandramouli_nvs/2399345

The shop is CareerKits Growth on Gumroad. Built for people who need clean, usable documents this week, not a generic stock template.

name: PhoEdit
tagline: Free browser-based image and PDF tools—resize, compress, convert, remove backgrounds—no signup.
description: PhoEdit is a free online toolkit for everyday photo and PDF tasks. Resize, compress, or convert images, remove backgrounds or objects, upscale photos, and turn images into PDFs—all in the browser, with no account and no install. Many tools run locally on the device.

name: ZZLCS Field Notes
tagline: Stardew Valley guides for the farm and Pelican Town
description: An independent Stardew Valley guide for farmers diagnosing greenhouse watering, missing truffles or fish ponds. Villager guides cover birthday gifts and where to find residents.

name: Potato Please Guide
tagline: First-shift walkthroughs and machine troubleshooting
description: An independent English guide to Potato Please. Players can trace a blocked hopper, check the peeling and delivery steps, and compare train endings with spoiler labels.

name: DetailInbox
tagline: Track quote follow-ups and draft accurate customer replies from your own prices.
description: DetailInbox is a lead inbox for solo and mobile car detailers. Track customer inquiries and quote follow-ups, and draft first replies from your own service prices. The no-signup reply tool runs in your browser; messages pasted there are not sent to the server. A free workspace includes the first 15 total leads with no card; Starter is $29/month for up to 2,000 leads and Growth is $79/month for up to 5,000. Both paid plans are monthly and can be canceled any time.

name: AI Detector
tagline: Review text for AI-generated writing patterns — simple, free, and online.
description: AI Detector is a practical AI content detector for anyone who needs to review text for AI-generated writing patterns. It supports essays, articles, emails, reports, and assignments and is designed for academic review, editorial checks, and content quality control. Users can get started in a few clicks, without complicated setup. Key capabilities include an AI probability score, sentence-level insights, unlimited checks, and clear responsible-use guidance. Provides a low-friction browser-based check with no signup required.

name: Pdfable
tagline: Click existing PDF text to edit it, right in your browser
description: Pdfable is a browser PDF editor. Click existing text to edit it, add notes, images, and signatures, with no install and no sign-up to edit or download. Files stay on your device, except when you use Recognize text (OCR). Free plan: 1 edit + export per day, 10 MB. Packs from $9.99. $19.99/month or $99.99/year with 500 MB.

name: MP4toMP3
tagline: Convert video files into MP3 audio — simple, free, and online.
description: MP4toMP3 makes everyday work easier when you need to convert video files into MP3 audio. It is built for people who value a clean, accessible experience and want results without extra complexity. The tool supports MP4 and browser-supported video files; useful features include MP3 output up to 320 kbps, a simple browser workflow, and no watermark. Converts files locally in the browser, so videos are not uploaded to a server. It is a practical option for music, podcasts, lectures, and offline listening.

name: Bay Compress
tagline: Compress large video files — simple, free, and online.
description: Bay Compress makes everyday work easier when you need to compress large video files. It is built for people who value a clean, accessible experience and want results without extra complexity. The tool supports MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, AVI, and other browser-supported video formats; useful features include hardware acceleration when available, size estimates, compression levels, resolution controls, and watermark-free exports. Processes videos locally in the browser, so originals are not uploaded to a server. It is a practical option for email, Discord, social media, and storage.

name: Show Me My IP
tagline: Free internet speed test, password generator and static QR code generator. No signup.
description: Show Me My IP provides free browser-based utilities without signup: an internet speed test measuring download, upload, latency and jitter with Cloudflare’s network; a locally generated strong password tool; and a static QR code generator with PNG download. Individual pages: https://showme-myip.com/speed-test https://showme-myip.com/password-generator https://showme-myip.com/qr-code-generator

name: Enrolled Agent Practice Exam
tagline: Independent mock exams and practice for all three IRS SEE parts
description: Browser-based preparation for the IRS Special Enrollment Examination with timed mock exams, domain practice, answer explanations and official source links. Free samples and limited weekly practice are available; optional paid passes unlock full access. Independent of the IRS and PSI.

name: SeedreamX
tagline: Make and edit images with Seedream 5 in your browser
description: Write a prompt or upload a photo, pick Seedream 5 Pro, Lite or Flash, and see what the image costs before you run it. New accounts start with 10 free credits.

name: Talk to Me Doja
tagline: A talking and dancing video inspired by the Talk to Me Doja trend.
description: One adult photo to a talking and dancing video inspired by the Talk to Me Doja trend. Paid one-time packs: $9.99 for 1 video, $24.99 for 3, $39.99 for 5. No subscription or free generation. Independent tool, not affiliated with TikTok, CapCut or Doja Cat.

name: aiwizard
tagline: Discover the Best AI Tools
description: aiwizard is a directory of AI tools: apps, models and resources organized by category, tag and label so you can find a tool by what it does. Browsing and submitting are free.

name: PianoBlox
tagline: Free Roblox piano sheets with in-browser practice and challenges.
description:
PianoBlox is a free, fan-made library of Roblox piano sheets for people who want to go from "I found a song" to "I can actually play it." Each song page has copy-ready keyboard notes — letters, grouped chords, and spacing that paste cleanly into Roblox piano games or a virtual piano — plus multiple difficulties so beginners are not thrown into full arrangements.

The built-in practice view lets you slow a phrase down, repeat hard sections, and hear the pattern before you play in-game. When the notes feel solid, start a Challenge on that same song: play for timing and accuracy, save your score, share the challenge with friends, and climb the leaderboard.

PianoBlox is independent, free to browse, and requires no download.

name: Youzi Public AI Station
tagline: One API key for multiple connected models, with smart routing and usage-based billing.
description: Youzi Public AI Station (https://ai.bayunzi.shop/) lets you call connected models with a single API key, including Claude, GPT, Gemini, and Antigravity. It uses smart routing with automatic failover and bills by usage with quota limits. Sign-in currently supports QQ email, GitHub, and LinuxDo.

name: Slitherlinks
tagline: Play Slitherlink online free — 3,000 puzzles, daily challenge, no signup.
description: Slitherlinks is the free online home for Slitherlink puzzles (also known as Fences or Loop the Loop). 3,000 puzzles across 5×5 to 20×20 grids and Easy/Medium/Difficult levels, plus a daily challenge, mobile play, optional free account for progress, and printable PDFs. Based in London, UK.

name: Metric Converter
tagline: Free unit and file converter that runs entirely in your browser.
description: Metric Converter is a free, open-source conversion toolkit with 1162 unit pairs across 15 categories plus 93 browser-based file converters. Processing stays on your device; files are never uploaded. No signup or payment required (ad-supported). Based in London, UK.

name: Trip Split
tagline: Split trip expenses with friends. Everyone logs what they paid, we work out who owes whom.
description: Trip Split helps groups of friends and family split travel expenses. Travellers join from an invite link without creating an account, record what they paid in any currency (including what the card actually charged and their own cash exchange rate), work offline, then confirm one shared bill. Settling up is free; unlocking unlimited quick notes plus the full bill with share link and CSV is $10 per trip, paid once by one person. No subscription. For trips of up to about 10 people. Based in London, UK.

name: ToAPIs
tagline: One OpenAI-compatible API for text, image & video AI
description: ToAPIs is an OpenAI-compatible AI API gateway for text, image, video, and audio models. Use one API key and unified billing instead of juggling separate vendors for chat, image generation, and video jobs. Point an existing OpenAI SDK client at https://toapis.com/v1, pick a model such as gpt-5.6-terra (text), gpt-image-2 (image), or seedance-2 (video), and ship against production docs. Includes a playground for quick tests, a model list for pricing comparisons, documentation aimed at real integrations, and a remote MCP server (https://api.toapis.com/mcp) for AI agents.

name: WorkBuddy Skills Directory
tagline: Independent directory of Tencent WorkBuddy skills and connectors.
description: Browse skills, expert packs, and connectors for Tencent WorkBuddy. Independent directory — not an official Tencent product.

name: Fanfiction Generator
tagline: A private workspace for fanfiction and story continuity.
description: Fanfiction Generator is a private writing workspace for fanfiction authors. It combines AI-assisted drafting with author-confirmed canon, character relationships, chapter continuation and version management, keeping the author in control of story facts.

name: Rap Generator
tagline: Turn real moments into editable rap lyrics.
description: Rap Generator helps creators turn a real moment into editable verses and a hook. Writers supply details, tone and boundaries, review the lyrics, and optionally generate audio using Studio Credits.

name: BTCMox
tagline: Free crypto research, fee and portfolio-risk tools
description: BTCMox is a free browser-based workspace for cryptocurrency research and scenario analysis. It combines crypto charts, liquidity and funding research, Bitcoin fee and mining calculators, trading-cost comparisons, DeFi and portfolio-risk scenarios, and local CSV analysis. Built for researchers, traders and learners, BTCMox requires no account for public tools and does not hold funds or execute orders.

name: FOSS Desk
tagline: Open-source software guides with documented workflow checks
description: FOSS Desk helps people evaluate open-source alternatives for Adobe, Lightroom, and Figma workflows. Browse official project links, release information, and download sources, then read small Lightroom and Penpot migration tests that document what worked and where they fell short. The site is free to browse without an account.

name: Consignment Desk
tagline: Offline recordkeeping tools for small consignment shops.
description: Consignment Desk offers two separate downloadable HTML tools for small consignment and resale shops that keep records manually. Intake Desk tracks consignors, item details, condition, tag or SKU, received date, price, shelf age, and manual markdown or return reminders. Payout Desk records sales, refunds, adjustments, consignor and shop shares, partial payouts, and printable monthly statements. Both run in a desktop browser and store records locally, with JSON backup and restore. The free intake checklist and one-sale split calculator cost $0+. Paid tools are one-time purchases: Intake Desk $9.99, Payout Desk $14.99, or $19.98 for the bundle. The tools do not sync, connect to a POS, transfer payments, calculate taxes, or share records with each other.

name: ImgUnmark
tagline: Remove watermarks from images you have permission to edit
description: ImgUnmark repairs visible text, logos and date stamps in photos. Automatic mode looks for marks; Manual Erase lets you select a precise area and compare the result before downloading a PNG. Google sign-in grants one free credit on first use; each new repair uses one credit. Use it only on images you own or are authorized to edit.

name: Card Tab
tagline: See what your cards really made after fees and shipping
description: Card Tab is a purchase and sale tracker for trading card collectors (Pokémon, Magic, One Piece and more). If you buy and sell cards on eBay or TCGplayer, at shows, or from breaks, it's hard to know if you're actually making money. Snap a photo or type the card, and Card Tab finds the exact card with its picture. Log what you paid or sold it for, and it works out platform fees and shipping, so you see your real profit, where you spend the most, and which platforms earn you the most. Free for up to 20 entries per month. Premium is $8 per month, or $5 per month at founding pricing for early users.

name: Vaki
tagline: Answers your guests in their own language, day and night.
description: Vaki is an AI front desk for small tour, hotel and booking businesses. It replies on your website from your own information, in the language the guest writes in. Where Bókun is connected, guests can book in the chat.

name: GroupRoulette
tagline: Group chat roulette, one stranger at a time: meet at random, then build your own club.
description: GroupRoulette turns random chat into a group you actually choose. Every match starts with just two people: tap Start and you are paired at random by video, with voice and text a tap away. If you enjoy talking with someone, follow them; otherwise move on to the next match. Once you have met a few people you like, create a club with a short name and description, set whether people can join directly, need approval or must be invited, and invite people you follow or recently chatted with. Clubs may be reviewed, and starting one may ask you to sign in. There is no registration form to begin, since a guest account is created automatically. Text matching uses no coins; video and voice calls use coins, with pricing shown before any purchase. Report and block tools are built in. GroupRoulette is for adults 18 and older.

name: CamCam
tagline: Two cams, one hello: random 1-on-1 video chat straight from a browser tab.
description: CamCam puts your camera across from one random person's, straight from a browser tab. There is no app to install and no account needed to start: press Start, allow camera and microphone, and you are matched with one person at random, with no profile picking and no filters. Say hi, see who waves back, and once a short countdown ends the Next button appears so you can meet someone different. Video is the default, but you can also choose Audio or Text on the start screen, and each is still a random one-on-one match. A camera test page helps you check your webcam first. Calls use coins from the CamCam wallet, spent by the minute. Report and block are available during every call, and personal details can stay personal. CamCam is for adults 18 and over only.

name: ICanHazChat
tagline: Press start and you’re paired with someone new on video — or use voice or text instead.
description: ICanHazChat is a playful, question-named random video chat: press start and you are paired with someone new. Prefer not to be on camera? Voice and text work too. No sign-up form is required to begin, and chats are usually free to start. If you want to choose who you call, you can browse who is online and call someone directly; a direct call can use coins, and pricing is explained on the site. Video asks for camera and microphone access and shows your own preview first. Report, block and safety guidance are provided. The service is for adults 18+ only. It is a straightforward yes to “can I chat with someone new?” — in the browser, without an account wall, with the option to go random or pick from the online list.

name: TopLive
tagline: Watch live streams, chat with hosts, then make it one-on-one.
description: TopLive is a live streaming and video call site where you start with the crowd and see where it goes. Open the list of streams available right now and drop into a host's stream; on your phone, it plays right in the browser. Catch the conversation and add your voice to the chat; if a message is in another language, tap it to translate. Follow a host you would like to find again, send a gift if you want to show appreciation, or call the host on video when you want to talk directly, one-on-one. Regular streams cost nothing to watch. Coins are for gifts and calls, and the wallet shows prices before you buy, so you decide whether to take that next step. There is also a random video chat for meeting someone new. You can report someone from a stream or a call, and moderation runs day and night. TopLive is for adults 18+, with age confirmation at entry.

name: FunChatt
tagline: Video chat with strangers: no sign-up, no app, no paywall to start.
description: FunChatt is a video chat with strangers built to skip the usual hurdles: no sign-up form, no email verification code, no app-store download and no paywall two lines in. Press start in your browser and you are connected to a random person; not a fit, skip and you get the next one. You choose video, voice or text. Matching is genuinely random, with no filter for gender, country or interests. The site explains what you see and what the other person sees, so you know what is shared. Blocking stops a pairing coming back, and reporting sends it to moderation, which runs around the clock. FunChatt works on phones without installing an app, with a guide for adding it to your home screen. It is free to start, and optional coins are available, with all twelve packs published exactly as the system charges.

name: Thundr
tagline: Random video chat with a new face every few seconds.
description: Thundr is a random video chat built for speed. The match starts the moment you land on the site, so there is nothing to set up and nothing to scroll before you are talking with a stranger somewhere in the world. Next is always one tap away. You stay anonymous: Thundr does not ask for an email, a phone number or a profile, and you can choose video, voice-only or text. Like a true roulette, you do not pick who appears and there is no gender or country filter. It is a browser-native cam chat that works with a webcam in Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge on desktop, Android or iPhone, with no download or app store. Live moderation runs 24/7, and you can report or block from any profile. Thundr is free to start, with free chats and coins waiting for new visitors, and it is for adults 18+.

name: Rastgele Görüntülü Sohbet
tagline: Üyeliksiz 1v1 rastgele görüntülü sohbet (Turkish random 1-on-1 video chat).
description: Rastgele Görüntülü Sohbet (Turkish for 'random video chat') is a Turkish-language site that connects you one-on-one with someone you do not know at the press of a single button. There are no rooms to pick, no queue to wait in and no profile to fill out: the system pairs you with one person at a time. You choose the mode, camera, microphone or text only, but nobody chooses the other person; if you do not want to turn the camera on, you can continue by voice or in writing. If the conversation does not click, you simply move on to the next person without any explanation. No membership is required, and starting is free. The site also offers an app for those who prefer to install it. It is designed for Turkish speakers who want quick, anonymous 1v1 webcam chats without registration.

name: StrangerSites
tagline: A site to talk to strangers like the person in the next seat: one random conversation, then you can go.
description: StrangerSites is a site to talk to strangers the way you might talk to the person in the next seat: no shared history, and no need to keep anything up. Press start and you are paired at random with one person by video, voice or text, still in your browser, with no sign-up to begin. Video is the default, but you can choose Audio (camera off) or Text (typing only) on the start screen, and you can choose differently next time. It is one conversation at a time, not a group and not a profile search. When the talk has run its course, it is okay to say goodbye. Safety tools are on the site. StrangerSites is for adults 18 and over only.

name: VideoChatSites
tagline: Video chat sites, minus the tab-hopping: one button, one random 1-on-1 match.
description: VideoChatSites is built for people tired of opening tab after tab to start a video chat. There is one button: press it, allow the camera, and a stranger picked at random joins you on video, still inside this browser tab. There is no sign-up to start, nothing to download, and no phone number is asked for then or later. Matches are random and one at a time. If you are not in a camera mood, pick Audio (voice only) or Text (typing only) on the start screen; both are still random one-on-one. Chats use coins from the site wallet, with pack prices shown before you buy. Report and block stay on screen while you chat. VideoChatSites is for adults 18 and over only.

name: AnonVideoChat
tagline: Anonymous video chat under a made-up name: one random person, no sign-up form.
description: AnonVideoChat is a browser-based random video chat for adults who want a guest identity rather than a profile. There is no form asking for your real name, email, phone number or social accounts to start; the site invents a display name and gives you a default avatar, then pairs you on video with one random person. Anonymous covers who you are, not what your camera shows: a match sees and hears whatever you allow into the frame. Starting never asks for an email; checkout only asks for one if you buy coins. Report and safety tools are on the site, and there is no app to install. Photos of hosts on marketing pages are not a live call. AnonVideoChat is for adults 18 and over only.

name: Stand Out Codes
tagline: Unofficial Stand Out codes list & redemption guide. Not affiliated with Roblox.
description: Stand Out Codes is an independent unofficial fan reference for players of Stand Out, a Roblox experience by Studio Umbra: Europa. The site lists codes from the official developer Trello with their stated rewards, keeps expired codes in a clearly separated archive, and explains how to redeem a code in the game: get the Phone, open Gifts (Codes), and paste one code. Related pages cover a Stand Out tier list, stands and arrows, a beginner guide, and resource values based on developer-listed costs, not player-trade prices. A source-listed active status is a check against the developer board, not a record of a successful in-game redemption on every server. Codes can expire at any time. This website is not operated by Roblox Corporation or the Stand Out developers, does not redeem codes on the site itself, and never asks for Roblox passwords or account details.

name: ComicIdeas
tagline: One sentence to a finished AI comic
description: AI comic book maker: free scripts (10/day), consistent characters, editable bubbles. Pay per panel. Export PNG/PDF/CBZ.

name: Stream Budget Lab

Stream Budget Lab is a free browser-based calculator that helps creators estimate the upload bandwidth needed to stream to Twitch and YouTube simultaneously.

Enter video and audio bitrates for each platform, adjust the safety margin, and calculate your estimated upload requirements.

No registration, downloads, or stream keys are required.

This tool is intended for bandwidth planning, not live internet speed testing.

name: TidyQuote
tagline: Quotes and job planning for independent cleaning businesses
description: TidyQuote helps independent cleaners calculate estimates, account for labour and other entered costs, plan jobs and keep client notes. A separate downloadable desktop toolkit includes a simple printable invoice generator and costs EUR 19 once through Payhip: https://payhip.com/b/KiPZl . No subscription. Desktop/laptop browsers recommended for the offline edition; mobile local-file support is limited. No cloud sync or automatic customer payments.

name: DeleteMetadata

description: DeleteMetadata is a free browser-based tool for inspecting and removing metadata from photos and audio files before sharing them. It supports JPEG, PNG, WebP and MP3 files, with a separate batch-cleaning tool. Processing happens locally in the browser, so files do not need to be uploaded to a server. No account is required.

name: Rooted Little Learners Studio

The first paid subscription costs $4.99 USD for the first month, then $9.99 USD per month. Review each generated activity for your group and supervise children during use.

name: AI Baby Generator

You can choose a family portrait, a mother-and-baby photo, a father-and-baby photo, or a single baby photo. Each image generation costs 1 credit. name: AIMusixer
tagline: Free AI music generator: songs, vocals, speech, and videos.

name: iLoveSong.ai
tagline: Anyone can make a song: AI lyrics editor, full songs and music videos in minutes.

name: AI Virtual Try On
tagline: Upload your photo and a product image to compare options before you buy.
description: The all-in-one AI virtual try on for every kind of item: tops, dresses, outerwear, swimwear, shoes, and accessories. Upload a person's photo and any garment, shoe, or accessory image — the AI generates a virtual try-on preview in 10-30 seconds. You may also upload an optional reference image to keep the model in that pose. The result is delivered as an HD image with no watermark added. Please log in to start the AI virtual try on.

name: Leva Financing Intelligence Desk

Files are processed in the browser; projects are saved on the device, not in a cloud account. Built-in paper styles are decorative, not real articles.

tagline: Characters with a life of their own.

tagline: Track subscriptions before they charge you.

The free plan covers 3 channels with 1 post a day; Pro is $13.99/month and Business is $39.99/month.

name: Bizfindesk
tagline: Free Business Calculators & Financial Tools | BizFinDesk
description:
BizFinDesk provides free online business calculators and practical financial guides to help small business owners, freelancers, and entrepreneurs make informed decisions.

Explore useful tools for pricing, profit margins, break-even calculations, salary, invoicing, and VAT.

name: Marketsy.ai
tagline: Create, Sell, Succeed: AI-Powered Stores in Minutes
description: Marketsy.ai is an AI-powered commerce platform that helps creators and small businesses start selling products online without technical barriers. Users can build personalized e-commerce websites through simple prompts and launch professional storefronts without coding. Artificial intelligence helps automate product listing creation and simplifies the process of preparing products for sale. From downloadable resources and e-books to online courses and memberships, the platform supports a wide range of digital business models. Sellers can also offer physical products and accept payments securely through Stripe. With zero-commission sales, customizable storefronts, analytics, inventory management, and Zapier automation, Marketsy.ai reduces the complexity of managing an online shop. It gives entrepreneurs the tools to focus on their products, customers, and business growth.

name: DumbCMO
tagline: Free plain-words notes on SEO, ads and social, plus a CAC calculator and an ads checker.
description: DumbCMO is a free notebook that explains SEO, ads, social media and analytics in plain words. Every note starts with the answer. Two free tools sit beside the notes: a CAC calculator and a "Should I run ads yet?" checker. No signup, not an agency, nothing to sell you. It's a solo project.

name: Spin the Wheel
tagline: Free online spin-the-wheel randomizer for picking names, prizes, numbers or choices. No signup, works on any device.
description:
WheelSpinFree is a free, browser-based spin-the-wheel tool for making random picks from a list. Enter names, options, prizes or numbers, spin, and the wheel lands on a random result. It is used for classroom activities, giveaways, streams, family decisions and team games.
Entries can be typed, pasted as a list, or imported from a .txt or .csv file, and the list can be shuffled or sorted A–Z. The wheel can be customized with color presets (Rainbow, Pastel, Ocean, Sunset, Forest, Candy, Mono), spin sounds, spin speed and optional confetti. A remove-winner mode draws each entry only once, and a results history keeps track of past spins, which can be downloaded.
Ready-made wheels include a Prize Wheel, Name Picker, Yes or No Wheel, Number Picker (1–100), Food Picker, Truth or Dare, Chore Wheel and a Random Wheel Generator. Customized wheels can be shared by link.
No account, download or payment is required. The site works on phones, tablets and desktops, supports light and dark themes, and is available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, German and French.

name: ColoringMonday
tagline: Free printable coloring pages for kids and adults
description: Free printable coloring pages for kids and adults, including Christmas and holiday pages, animals, flowers, mandalas, and a name coloring page generator. Pages are US Letter PDFs.

name: WPCraftEngineer
tagline: WordPress development, maintenance, plugins and tutorials
description: WPCraftEngineer provides WordPress and WooCommerce development, website maintenance and speed optimization services. It also publishes practical WordPress tutorials and develops plugins, including Glitzy Booking Suite. Visitors can explore services, read website guides and contact the team for project support.

name: RoomDesign Genius
tagline: AI room design from one photo, with free in-browser floor plan tools.
description: RoomDesign Genius is a web-based AI room design studio. Upload a photo of a living room, bedroom, kitchen or bathroom, pick a style, and compare up to four redesigns designed to preserve your walls, windows and perspective. You can also describe a room in words, furnish or empty a space, or generate a floor-plan concept. Two free 2D planners let you draw layouts to scale in the browser with no account. AI designs use credits from a monthly or yearly plan or a one-time pack. New accounts get free credits to try, and no card is required to start. Results are visual concepts, not construction drawings.

name: Ragdoll Sandbox
tagline: Free ragdoll physics games in your browser
description: Ragdoll Sandbox is a free browser game hub featuring ragdoll physics and arcade games. Browse the catalog, open a game page, and play online without installing an app.

name: Peat Flow
tagline: Free multi-image capture for Mac, with cloud AI to turn spoken feedback into clearer instructions.
description:
Peat Flow is a Mac app that brings screenshots, speech and intent together for clearer communication with AI.

Capture several views, such as an overall layout, a close-up and a reference, then paste multiple screenshots together into an input that supports images. Screenshots and multi-image paste are free forever.

With Point & Say, mark a location and speak naturally. Cloud AI removes filler, resolves spoken corrections and separates changes into clearer instructions. Review the prepared images and text, then send them to the AI you already use. Peat Flow does not press Send for you.

Screenshots themselves are not uploaded. Point & Say sends audio and text within marked areas to the cloud for transcription and organization; history stays on your Mac. Automatic pasting requires a compatible input and focus; manual paste is available when needed.

Requires Apple silicon and macOS 14 or later. Point & Say uses product credits and needs an internet connection. Eligible new users receive a one-time $30 product-credit grant, valid for 90 days, without a card. This is not a subscription trial and does not trigger automatic billing.

name: SellViaApp
tagline: Mobile storefronts for independent merchants
description: SellViaApp gives merchants a mobile sales channel through one shared iOS and Android app. Each merchant manages an independent storefront, catalogue, orders and notifications from a dashboard, with options to connect an existing ecommerce system or move to a dedicated branded app. Customers can save favourite products and follow their orders. A 30-day free trial is available.

name: Izračun postotka
tagline: Free Croatian percentage and VAT (PDV) calculator
description: A free Croatian online percentage and VAT (PDV) calculator — calculate percentages, percentage increase and decrease, discounts and VAT quickly and accurately, online and completely free.

name: MigraMemo
tagline: The migraine diary that works mid-attack.
description:
MigraMemo is a private migraine diary for iPhone and Android, built for the moment you need it: when the light hurts and you can barely look at your screen. One dark, low-glare screen, huge tap targets and no typing required.

Start an attack with one tap, rate how bad it is from 1 to 10, and tap your symptoms and the medication you took. Everything saves as you tap. About two hours after a dose, a quick check-in asks whether it helped, so over time you see your own medication response picture.

MigraMemo watches the 7-day barometric pressure forecast for your area and gives you a quiet heads-up before sharp drops. A history calendar and plain-number trends show your patterns, and one tap builds a PDF with your MIDAS score to bring to your neurologist.

No account and no servers: your diary stays on your phone. MigraMemo does not diagnose, predict or treat anything. Coming soon to the App Store and Google Play.

name: The Solo Consultant's AI Team
tagline: AI agent playbooks for solo consultants
description: The Solo Consultant's AI Team publishes written playbooks for setting up AI agents in a one-person consulting practice. The $29 Your First AI Chief of Staff guide sets up a morning brief and an end-of-day close-out with a persona and six skills, in about two hours. The $89.99 Full AI Team Kit adds five roles (chief of staff, sales, content, client delivery, research) with 22 skill files and a weekly check. It works with Claude, ChatGPT, Grok Bot or any AI tool. A free AI Agent Org Chart PDF is on the site.

name: Claim Your Landing
tagline: Digital Martian plots on a public Mars map. Not physical land, and not advertising. From $50.
description: Claim Your Landing is a public map of digital Martian plots. You are not buying physical land, ads, traffic, or rankings. Pick a spot, name it, and it is live in seconds. From $50, tax included. You get a public plot page, a shareable deed, a PDF deed, and a private edit link by email. A plot can also be a gift.

name: PromptCrate
tagline: Free AI video prompts for Veo 3, Seedance, Kling & Google Flow
description: PromptCrate is a free library of 500+ ready-to-use master prompts for viral AI videos — written for Veo 3, Seedance, Kling and Google Flow. Open any prompt, copy it in one click, and start creating.

name: Big Number Calculator
tagline: Add, subtract, multiply, and divide large integers or exact decimals.
description: Add, subtract, multiply, and divide large integers or exact decimals. View the full integer answer or reduced fraction, with rounded displays labelled separately. It is free and needs no signup.

name: Desktrack
tagline: Smarter Computer Monitoring for Better Workforce Visibility.
description: DeskTrack offers powerful computer monitoring software to help businesses track employee computer activity, monitor application and website usage, capture screenshots, and analyze productivity. Gain better workforce visibility, understand work patterns, and manage remote or office teams efficiently. Start your 15-day free trial today!

name: FontKerenPro
tagline: Free cool-font generator for Instagram, TikTok and gaming nicknames
description: FontKerenPro is a free cool font generator that converts plain text into stylish Unicode fonts — bold, script, bubble, gothic and aesthetic styles — for Instagram bios, TikTok captions, WhatsApp and gaming nicknames. No sign-up, copy and paste in seconds.

name: Endlessle — Krillion Unlimited
tagline: Free rare-answer trivia game in your browser — 7 prompts per dive, rarer answers dive deeper, perfect dive 7,000m, no daily cap
description: Krillion Unlimited is a free browser trivia game: each prompt gives you a category and 25 seconds, you type one answer, and the rarer it is the deeper you dive. Modes: Daily Dive, Endless, Geography/Movies/Sports themed packs, Puffer Party multiplayer for up to 6 players, 1 vs 1 ELO duels, leaderboard. Free, no download, no sign-up, no paywall.

name: Clientish
tagline: All-in-One Client Management Software for Agencies, Freelancers & Teams
description:
Clientish is a cloud-based CRM and client management software platform built for freelancers, digital agencies, consultants, and service-based businesses. Founded in 2026, Clientish helps businesses manage customer relationships, projects, team activities, payments, and support through one connected workspace.

Managing a service business often requires multiple applications for tracking leads, preparing proposals, assigning tasks, sending invoices, and communicating with customers. Clientish brings these activities together, allowing businesses to manage their work from the first customer inquiry to project delivery and ongoing support.

The platform includes CRM and lead management, sales pipelines, proposal creation, service catalogs, project and task management, invoicing, subscription billing, workflow automation, and business reporting.

name: PopFestive
tagline: AI Christmas photos and videos from one picture
description: PopFestive is an AI Christmas photo and video generator. Upload one clear photo of yourself, your child or your pet and get a Christmas profile picture, a Santa Nice List certificate or a festive pet portrait in minutes.

name: Power Size Guide
tagline: Free portable power station size calculator — pick your appliances and hours, get the Wh capacity, watts and surge you need.
description: Free portable power station size calculator — pick your appliances and hours, get the Wh capacity, watts and surge you need.

name: UGCraft
tagline: Make Roblox accessories and clothing with AI
description: UGCraft is an AI Roblox UGC creator. Describe an accessory or outfit in text, or upload a reference image, and it builds a marketplace-ready 3D item, no Blender needed. Make layered clothing, accessories, classic shirts and pants, R15 emotes and animations, or cages; free tools include a Clothing Tester, UGC Checker and UGC Ideas. Free plan includes 20 credits; paid plans add commercial rights and remove the watermark.

name: MakeFacelessVideo
tagline: AI faceless videos with narration and synced captions
description: MakeFacelessVideo turns topics or scripts into review-ready faceless episodes with scene-specific AI visuals, narration and word-synced captions. Series Autopilot schedules creation. The series wizard supports English and Mandarin, with 13 voices and 9:16/16:9 formats. Posting depends on connected channels and platform capacity; manual downloads are available. Free plan: one 30-second video/month, no card required; paid from $19/month.

name: AutoLoga
tagline: Your car's service history, ATO logbook and mechanic finder in one app.
description: AutoLoga is the digital car service history and ATO vehicle logbook for Australian drivers, fleets and workshops. Keep every service, invoice and odometer reading in one place, log business and private trips for a 12-week ATO logbook, and never miss rego, roadworthy or insurance dates. Find a local mechanic and book a service online. Free for up to 5 cars, with iOS and Android apps.

name: RapTake
tagline: Turn photos into solo or duet rap videos
description: RapTake creates short solo or duet rap videos from permitted adult portraits. Choose a prepared track with lyrics, vocals and backing music, select a scene and portrait or landscape format, then review the character image before generating. One-time paid packs start at $7.99 for solo and $12.99 for duet videos.

name: your first time in a fancy cafe
tagline: The wrong seat. The right joke.
description: Fancy Cafe AI is an independent browser studio for the “first time in a fancy cafe” wrong-seat trend. Upload one portrait (Solo) or two separate selfies (With a friend), pick a cafe case style, and generate a 15-second 720p video in 9:16 or 16:9 with audio enabled. Photo 1 takes the wrong seat on the tiny table; photo 2 is the guest who walks in. No filming, no prompt to write, no editing app. Preview and browsing are free; generation is paid only via one-time credit packs, no subscription: Single $8.90 / 20 credits / 1 video; Five Pack $29.90 / 100 credits / 5 videos; Studio Pack $99.90 / 400 credits / 20 videos; 20 credits per 15s 720p clip.

name: Rubricfy
tagline: AP Lang essay scoring with feedback for each rubric row
description: Rubricfy helps AP English Language students practice synthesis, rhetorical analysis, and argument essays. It scores practice drafts on the six-point rubric and provides explanations and revision suggestions for thesis, evidence and commentary, and sophistication. Free to try without signing up, with daily limits and optional one-time credit packs. Feedback is for practice, not an official exam score.

name: You Never Let Her Pay
tagline: The dinner meme starring you
description: You Never Let Her Pay is an independent browser-based photo-to-video studio for the wallet-sponge dinner meme. Upload one consenting adult portrait, pick Seedance 2.5, Seedance 2.0 Fast, or Seedance 2.0 (all 20 credits, 480p, 11 seconds, original audio, 9:16 or 16:9), and generate the diner who offers to pay. Watch example TikToks and check your portrait in the browser for free. The studio adds no watermark; watermark behavior in rendered provider files is still unverified. Not affiliated with the original TikTok creators or music rights holders.

name: CalendarShelf
tagline: Free printable 2026 and 2027 calendars with US holiday dates.
description: CalendarShelf is a free website that publishes printable calendars for 2026 and 2027. No account or email sign-up is required. The main resource is a 2027 US holidays calendar that lists federal holidays with both the actual date and the observed date, so a three-day weekend is easy to see. You can download a full 12-month calendar as a PDF or as PNG images, and a ZIP is available if you want every month at once. Paper size can be US Letter or A4. Weeks can start on Sunday or on Monday. Holiday markings can be turned off, limited to federal holidays, or set to federal holidays plus observances. The calendars are simple black-and-white pages meant for home, office, or classroom printing. The site also offers a one-page 2027 year view and individual monthly pages. It is a January–December calendar, not a school-year layout from August to July. The holidays calendar is at https://calendarshelf.app/2027/holidays/

name: msgboard
tagline: A public board for AI agents. No account or API key required.
description: AI agents can read and post messages over HTTPS after fetching skill.md. msgboard is free and needs no account or API key.

name: OnlineBiller
tagline: Free bill, receipt & invoice generator for India
description: OnlineBiller creates GST invoices, rent receipts for HRA, and 29 other bill and receipt formats as PDFs for free, with no sign-up. Built for bookkeeping, small businesses, freelancers and anyone recreating a lost receipt. Available in English, Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, Telugu and Tamil.

name: Soul Virtues Extractor
tagline: Soul Virtues Extractor is a free Undertale-themed quiz that reads your soul traits and tells you which virtue you carry.
description: Soul Virtues Extractor is a free Undertale-themed quiz that reads your soul traits and tells you which virtue you carry.

description: Rumpelstiltskin AI turns photos into a 10-second tiptoe dance video with music and no watermark.

tagline: Discover useful Grok bots and community feedback
description: Bot Hunt is an independent discovery directory for Grok bots. Browse handpicked bots, their descriptions and linked community feedback to find useful AI teammates and follow setup links. Entries identify official Marketplace sources. Displayed heat includes labeled starting values, so it should not be represented as a count of verified users or real votes.

name: How to Use Muse
tagline: Independent Meta Muse guides and workflow examples
description: How to Use Muse is an independent guide to Meta Muse prompts, workflow examples and reported use cases. Browse practical prompts for organizing receipts, reviewing recurring charges, preparing bill-negotiation scripts and planning tasks. Reported outcomes are labeled as self-reports rather than independently verified savings. The site is not an official Meta service.

name: Youmiro
tagline: Your all-in-one AI video generator with audio and images.
description: Youmiro is an all-in-one AI video and image workspace. Describe a scene or upload a reference photo, pick a model, and create text-to-video or image-to-video clips with optional native audio. Build longer stories shot by shot with reused character references, and use the AI Image Maker for text-to-image or reference-guided stills. Start free for music videos, product ads, social clips, and short films.

name: Christmas Pajama Dance
tagline: Watch the Christmas Pajama Dance and plan your own duet.
description: Christmas Pajama Dance is an independent guide to the matching-pajama holiday dance trend on TikTok. Watch two real pajama duets from the original creators, find the Deck the Halls remix used in the trend, and read step-by-step guides on framing, left/right positions and checking the final beat. The free photo preview lets you add one portrait (Solo) or two portraits (Duet: Photo 1 left, Photo 2 right) to check placement before you film or edit; photos stay in your browser. Video export is not available on the site. Independent fan guide, not affiliated with TikTok, the example creators, or Deck the Halls rights holders.

name: Image Text Editor
tagline: AI image text editor for posters, screenshots, menus and ads. Replace or remove one text block.
description: Image Text Editor is an online tool for editing text in finished images: posters, banner ads, menus, screenshots, product photos and YouTube thumbnails. Pick one text block, enter new words or remove it, review a before-and-after comparison, and download a flattened PNG.

name: Unblurfy
tagline: Fix blurry, pixelated and low-resolution photos with AI. Free to try, no watermark.
description: Unblurfy uses AI to fix blurry, pixelated and low-resolution photos in your browser. Upload a photo, choose 1K or 2K, and compare the result with a before-and-after slider before you download. Free to try every day, with no watermark, and uploads are deleted after 24 hours.

name: Glide
tagline: An AI agent on the job seeker's side of hiring
description: Glide is an AI agent that takes on the legwork of your job search: finding roles worth your time, researching each company and drafting applications written for the person who will read them. You approve everything. Currently invite-only - join the waitlist on the site.

name: Qlyro
tagline: 52 free online tools, right in your browser
description:
52 free online tools that run entirely in your browser, including JSON
formatter, Base64 encoder, hash generator, Markdown to HTML, and QR code
generator. No sign-up, no API keys, no server uploads.

name: H3 Image
tagline: Make 2K and 4K pictures with MiniMax H3 Image online, then turn them into H3 videos
description: H3 Image is a web app for MiniMax H3 Image, the open-weight image model MiniMax released in November 2026. Write a prompt or upload photos to edit, get 2K or 4K pictures in about 20 seconds, and turn any picture into a MiniMax H3 video. New accounts get free credits to try it.

name: Footbillion
tagline: The Final Ledger. Seven football questions on the rooftop court.
description: Footbillion (dailyfootbillion.com) is an independent daily football quiz called The Final Ledger, built for this site. Each day has seven cards with four team choices. You choose a team across four real finals and look for the one-time pick, then compare seven-card scores with friends on the same UTC date. Once per match, a Scout can cross out one wrong choice and caps that card at 100. The deck draws from the men’s Champions League, men’s EURO and Women’s EURO. A Champions League card asks for a club; a EURO card asks for a national team. Results are cross-checked against UEFA records. This site is dailyfootbillion.com, distinct from similarly named products.

name: 7 Deadly Sins Test
tagline: Which deadly sin sounds most like you?
description: The 7 Deadly Sins Test (deadlysinstest.com) is an original, 14-question quiz about everyday reactions. You answer how much a possible reaction sounds like you, then see all seven scores, each from 0 to 6. Each of the seven impulses gets two prompts: “Not like me” earns zero points, “A little like me” earns one, “Often like me” earns two, and “Very like me” earns three. The site says this is a quiz for fun and self-reflection and that it has not been validated as a measure of personality. It works on a phone, with no sign-up or app needed.

name: Remvora
tagline: Every life has a story
description: Share what you have. Remvora creates a life story, a film, and a place to remember someone you love. Public V1 preview with a fictional example; it does not accept orders.

name: Pettenderly
tagline: Turn pet photos into portraits worth keeping
description: Pettenderly turns photos of your cat or dog into AI portraits. Choose a watercolor, royal or studio look, then download your image.

name: Anxinzhuan
tagline: Offline speech-to-text with batch audio and video transcription
description: Anxinzhuan is an offline speech-to-text application for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android. It transcribes audio and video locally with batch imports, automatic queuing, timestamps and speaker labels. Media and transcripts remain on the user’s device.

name: Tiny Desk AI Video
tagline: AI band video generator — your cast, your concert
description:
Tiny Desk AI Video is an AI band video generator built around a fixed performance template. You pick optional cast photos for each of the five slots - back left, back right, keys, lead and sax - and every spot without a photo falls back to its fixed dog character, so the tool works with no uploads at all.

Before generating you confirm the age, permission and acceptable-use declarations, then choose a format: 9:16 vertical for TikTok, Reels and Shorts, 1:1 square for social feeds, or 16:9 landscape for YouTube and wide-screen posts. Quality is 720p or 1080p. Credit cost is shown before you submit, and videos are stored for 30 days.

Five photos are supported, JPG, PNG or WebP up to 8 MB each. Celebrity and public-figure photos are not allowed.

Tiny Desk AI Video is an independent AI effects tool by One Hub All AI, not affiliated with NPR or its Tiny Desk concert series.

name: Files.fm
tagline: Cloud storage for sharing, delivering and selling files
description: Files.fm is a cloud storage and file sharing service made in Latvia. Back up your files, send large files and folders with a link, set passwords and expiry dates on shared links, collect files from others with upload links, and deliver or sell photo galleries and digital downloads. Desktop sync for Windows and macOS, iOS and Android apps and WebDAV access are included. Start on the free plan; PRO begins at EUR 8.18 per month.

name: Morse Zone
tagline: Free online Morse code translator with audio and practice tools
description: Morse Zone is a free online Morse code translator — convert text to Morse code and Morse code back to text instantly, with a Morse code alphabet chart, audio playback, and practice tools. Free, no sign-up.

name: OpenLegion
tagline: The AI agent platform for SaaS and AI apps
description: OpenLegion is an AI agent platform for SaaS: secure agents call your functions, with a workspace per customer, approvals, spending caps and receipts.

name: silo.host
tagline: AI website builder with hosting included. Describe a site in plain words and watch layout, design and content change live.
description: silo.host is an AI website builder where a website is described in plain words and the layout, design and content are rewritten while you watch. Hosting, pages and a blog are included. Every instruction is kept and can be undone, posts and pages live in a real database, and every site gets a free address on day one with an optional custom domain. A Claude MCP connector is also available.

name: CryptoShep
tagline: Model Bitcoin purchases and portfolio value in rubles
description: CryptoShep helps Russian-speaking readers check cryptocurrency calculations. Set a recurring Bitcoin purchase amount and date range to compare total contributions, accumulated coins, and ending portfolio value using historical prices. The site also includes a portfolio calculator, coin conversions and beginner guides.

name: MakeFont
tagline: AI font generator for handwriting, images and prompts
description: MakeFont is an AI font generator: describe a style or upload handwriting, let AI draw the full character set, edit glyphs in your browser, and download a TTF.

name: Photo to Sticker
tagline: Turn your photo into stickers — free instant stickers and AI expression packs.
description: Photo to Sticker turns portraits, pets and group photos into stickers. Create a free transparent PNG sticker with a white outline instantly in your browser, no account needed, or generate AI cartoon expression packs for WhatsApp, Telegram and Discord. Accounts include 3 free AI uses shared across all tools, with optional one-time USD 5.90 paid packs and no subscription.

name: Elunvi Games
tagline: Free indie browser games for desktop and mobile
description: Browse a multilingual browser arcade with original AI-assisted games and indie releases credited to their creators. The catalogue lets players filter by genre, device and language before launching a game.

name: fancyfontgenerator
tagline: “Transform Your Text into Stylish & Fancy Fonts Instantly!”
description: FancyFontGenerator.in is a free online Fancy Font Generator that transforms ordinary text into stylish, creative, and unique fonts instantly. Create fancy text for Instagram bios, WhatsApp messages, Facebook posts, gaming usernames, and social media profiles. Choose from multiple stylish text designs, copy your favorite font with one click, and make your text stand out. No signup, payment, or installation required.

name: PDF2MD
tagline: Free PDF to Markdown converter in your browser
description: Convert PDF files to Markdown in your browser with heading and list detection. Preview the result, then copy it or download a .md file. Up to 100 files per batch, 50 MB each; conversion runs on your device so files are not uploaded. An OCR converter is available for scanned PDFs and images. Paid plans allow downloading all files as one ZIP.

name: TattooGenerator
tagline: Design original tattoos from text or a photo, in any style, with print-ready stencils.
description: TattooGenerator is an AI tattoo generator: describe an idea or upload a photo, pick a style and placement, and get original tattoo designs in about twenty seconds, plus print-ready stencils your artist can actually use. Features include a tattoo simulator to preview designs on your own skin photo, 12 tattoo fonts with instant preview, and a prompt generator. Free account with starter credits (free images are watermarked); paid credit packs from $4.90 and monthly plans from $8.90. Styles include fine line, blackwork, traditional and Japanese. Every design is drawn fresh from your description, so nobody else has the same tattoo.

name: Tarot Fortune Cards
tagline: Free AI tarot reading with a straight answer
description: Tarot Fortune Cards is a free online AI tarot reading. Ask about love, an ex, or a crush, draw three cards, and get a straight answer instead of vague hints.

name: Peeve
tagline: AI customer support agent that resolves tickets, not just replies
description: Peeve is an AI customer support agent for SaaS teams. It answers questions from your docs, shows users where to click inside your product, takes actions like resetting a password or changing a plan, and hands off to your team when a human is needed. It works in your in-app widget and over email, and remembers each customer across conversations. Pricing is credit-based, with plans from $40/month and a 14-day free trial.

name: RobThumbnail
tagline: Make high-CTR Roblox thumbnails in seconds with AI.
description: RobThumbnail is an AI thumbnail studio for Roblox creators. Describe the game moment you want and the AI generates a 16:9 (1920×1080 PNG) thumbnail ready to upload to Roblox Studio; 1:1 is also supported. Refine through conversation, upload an avatar reference, and iterate until it clicks. Free to try with 15 free AI credits renewed monthly; paid plans add 2K & 4K output and a commercial-use license.

name: StemTab
tagline: Separates vocals and stems, then drafts an editable MIDI/MusicXML score you still correct by hand.
description: Separates vocals and accompaniment, splits stems, and drafts an editable MIDI/MusicXML score that still needs manual correction. Available on Web, iPhone/iPad, and Android; the Mac app is coming soon and has no public installer yet. One 5-minute free preview per verified email on Web only; Android can preview the first 30 seconds free, then unlock with a one-time purchase. Web export is paid and billed by processing minutes. Does not generate guitar TAB, does not separate different singers, and does not identify timbre. Only use audio you have the right to process.

name: No Scrubs AI
tagline: Turn portraits into a short music dance video with sound
description:
No Scrubs AI turns one to three consenting adult portraits into an approximately 16-second music dance video with sound. Choose a lead and up to two supporting cast members. The fixed sequence is delivered in 4:3 at 720p.

Generation requires an account and paid credits. Non-expiring one-time packs cost US$6.99 for 1 video, US$19.99 for 3, or US$29 for 5. No free generation credits or recurring subscription. Public examples and a how-to guide are available before purchase. Independent product, not affiliated with TLC.

name: BratGeneratorPro
tagline: Free brat text, font, meme, album cover and lyric video maker — no sign-up, no watermark.
description: Free browser tool that turns any text into the lime-green, lowercase brat look. Text, font, meme, album cover, sticker and lyric video makers, no sign-up, no watermark.

name: H3 Max
tagline: Turn a prompt or still into a 5–15 second MiniMax H3 Max video
description: Turn a prompt or still into a 5–15 second MiniMax H3 Max video. Choose 480P or 768P, review the result, and create your next take on H3 Max. Write one line or drop a single still frame. MiniMax H3 Max hands back a 5–15 second clip with the audio already synced — watch it, change a word, run the next take.

name: Zombie Couple Video Maker
tagline: Zombie Couple Video Maker – Turn 2 Photos Into an AI Zombie Romance
description: Zombie couple video maker: upload two photos, one turns into a grey-green zombie, the other holds their hand. 10s with sound, gore-free, no subscription.

name: A11yRemedy
tagline: WCAG 2.2 monitoring for every client site you manage
description: A11yRemedy checks websites against WCAG 2.2 Level A and AA on a schedule and tells your developer what to change. Scans run axe-core in headless Chrome from our side, so nothing is installed on the site and there is no overlay script. Findings are grouped by root cause, so one fix can clear the same problem on many pages. On WordPress sites, A11yRemedy names the plugin, Elementor widget or theme setting behind the issue. Agencies and freelancers can file sites under each client and send PDF reports with their own logo and colours. Clients can ask for a quote on the fixes from inside the report, and the request lands in your workspace. You get an alert when an update breaks something. Automated testing finds only part of WCAG issues, and every report says so.

name: ANTK2AZENG — Free Apparel Costing Tools
tagline: Free garment cost, MOQ, profit and wholesale pricing calculators for clothing makers.
description: ANTK2AZENG provides free browser-based calculators to help independent clothing brands, merch sellers and small garment makers estimate fabric consumption, unit costs, landed costs, order margins, MOQ pricing and wholesale prices. No signup is required for the calculators. Optional downloadable Excel workbooks cover clothing costing and production order management.

name: Pet Portrait AI
tagline: Pet Portrait AI | AI Pet Portrait Generator from Photo
description: Pet Portrait AI turns one photo of your dog or cat into a royal, Renaissance, watercolor or memorial portrait. Pet photos only.

name: Streakdle
tagline: A free independent browser game for finding rare answers
description: Streakdle is my independent rare-answer browser game. Each round has seven prompts and 25 seconds per prompt, with one answer each. Try to find valid answers that other players use less often. Rarity reflects this site’s player answers, not a worldwide survey. Play unlimited rounds free in the browser, without an account or download. I am Winson, the maker. This is an independent project, not the official Krillion game.

name: Kaomoji Copy & Paste
tagline: Browse 559 Japanese text faces by mood, animal, or gesture — click to copy and paste.
description: Free kaomoji copy-and-paste library: 559 Japanese text faces in 13 categories, plus an optional AI generator.

name: Hair Type Quiz
tagline: Free 2-minute quiz: find your hair type and get a routine matched to it
description: Free 2-minute quiz from Hairsloom: answer a few questions and find your hair type (straight, wavy, curly or coily) with a routine matched to it. Free hair-care guides and tools, no sign-up.

name: NGIN360
tagline: AI agents that run the work around you
description: NGIN360 is an AI agent team for business work. You describe an outcome, it writes a plan you can approve, hands each step to a specialist agent (development, marketing, research, design) and checks each result against stated criteria. It stops for a person before anything consequential, such as sending or publishing, and runs scheduled and event-triggered work across connected apps like Gmail, Google Calendar and GitHub. It is for people running a business or a small team who want agents to do the work while people keep the decisions. Free during early access.

name: TinyCommand
tagline: Forms, workflows, tables and AI agents in one no-code platform
description: TinyCommand is an all-in-one no-code automation platform for founders, operators and business teams. It connects forms, visual workflows, data tables, AI agents and email tools so teams can collect information, manage data and automate follow-up in one place. Forms can look up data and branch while people fill them in, and workflows connect business apps. TinyCommand offers a free plan and paid plans. AI agent steps run on every plan; building custom agents starts on Professional. TinySEO and TinyAnswers are paid tools with a seven-day trial on Free.

name: Vars Health
tagline: Healthcare staffing software for staffing agencies
description: Healthcare staffing software for staffing agencies — scheduling, credentialing, float pool, workforce management and AI tools for healthcare staffing; founded 2024, San Francisco, CA, USA; contact Aditya Mangal, Healthcare - Digital Content Writer, hello@varshealth.com.

name: ValeKit
tagline: Ticketless valet parking software with digital tickets
description: ValeKit is ticketless valet parking software that replaces paper tickets, walkie-talkies and end-of-shift cash counts. Attendants check cars in from a phone with AI plate, make and model recognition; guests get an SMS link to track and request their car with one tap. Payments, tips and discounts are captured digitally and reconciled automatically. ValeKit works offline and scales from one location to hundreds, for hotels, restaurants, hospitals, events and valet companies.

name: Prixie
tagline: Built for agents, not HR software.
description:
Built for agents, not HR software: your AI agent can run recognition, goals, reviews and surveys in Prixie. Prixie works with Slack, MCP, and Google and Microsoft sign-in, with HRIS and ATS integrations (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, ADP, UKG, Greenhouse) on Team and Business plans. Prixie is employee recognition and performance management for teams that already work in Slack. Prixie Recognise covers daily recognition, rewards, and recognition analytics. Prixie Perform covers goals, review cycles, engagement surveys, continuous feedback, and 1:1 notes. Review cycles are available on Team and above.

Your AI agent can work in Prixie too. Connect your AI agent (Claude, ChatGPT) to the Prixie MCP server and sign in with your Prixie account. From there your agent can send a recognition, list goals you can see, open and submit reviews or surveys assigned to you, and check what is waiting in your inbox.

name: Printbaba Instant Print Quote Calculator
tagline: Estimate custom printing prices online
description: Printbaba’s online calculator lets individuals and businesses estimate prices for custom printing by selecting product options and quantities. Printbaba offers paid printing and nationwide US delivery; prices depend on specifications and shipping.

name: Sunday Visit
tagline: A calm, simple phone for seniors, set up by family
description: Sunday Visit is a calm, Australian-made phone app for seniors and elderly people.
