It turns the phone into six big buttons for gentle sounds, family photos, easy movement, quiet games, Old times and calls to people they trust. Family choose what is on it in a linked second app, Sunday Visit Carer. Both apps are on Google Play.

name: Live Face Swap
tagline: Real-time AI face swap for streaming, video calls, and webcam creators.
description: Live Face Swap is a browser-based real-time AI face swap workspace for independent creators. Choose a reference character, enable your camera, and create live face transformations for livestreams, video calls, OBS, and entertainment content.

name: KAVOMAZ Scout
tagline: Free profitability calculators for ecommerce sellers
description: KAVOMAZ Scout is a free web tool for ecommerce sellers to estimate product profitability, fees, margins, and break-even points before making sourcing or pricing decisions.

name: PhotoLike
tagline: Realistic dating profile photos made from your selfies
description: PhotoLike turns 8-10 everyday selfies into realistic dating profile photos. The photos have natural light, real skin texture and believable places like coffee shops and rooftop bars, so they look like a friend took them on a good day. Use them on Hinge, Bumble, Tinder and other apps. Try one free preview photo first to check it works on your face, then get the full pack. No subscription and no photoshoot.

name: ZoneFee
tagline: Research local development and zoning fees
description: ZoneFee helps real estate developers and analysts research jurisdiction-level development impact fees, zoning application fees, utility connection charges, and proffers. Search by jurisdiction and consult dated data linked to official fee schedules and ordinances for early-stage due diligence.

name: PermitPrice
tagline: Estimate residential building permit fees
description: PermitPrice helps homeowners and contractors estimate residential building permit fees from official jurisdiction fee schedules. Enter your location and project details to see a line-by-line estimate for charges such as the base permit fee, plan review, and applicable surcharges. Browse local guides for Virginia, Maryland, Washington, DC, and Texas.

name: CountyTaxTools
tagline: Local property and vehicle tax calculators
description: CountyTaxTools helps residents estimate local property and vehicle taxes and compare rates across counties and cities. It combines free calculators with tax rates and guides for Virginia, Texas, and Kentucky, citing official government records for the rates and rules it publishes.

name: AI SaaS Dir
tagline: Find the right AI software for the job
description: Hand-reviewed AI SaaS for work, sorted by what it does, what it costs and who it is for.

name: AI Face Swap Live
tagline: Browser-based real-time AI face swapping for webcams, with restyling and outfit try-on.
description: AI Face Swap Live swaps a single portrait onto a live webcam in the browser. It also offers anime, 3D and clay-style restyling and outfit try-on. Works in Chrome and Edge on Windows and Mac, and can be captured in OBS for livestreaming. New accounts get 60 seconds with a watermark; paid plans remove it.

name: FeeState
tagline: Free landlord fee checker for Illinois' 2027 rental fee law (HB 3564)
description: FeeState is a free fee-compliance checker for Illinois landlords. Enter the fees you charge and it checks each one against HB 3564 (765 ILCS 705/35): the 11 prohibited fee types, the $50 application fee cap, and first-page and listing disclosure rules — then gives you a fix-it report.

name: QRCodeBrain
tagline: Dynamic QR code generator for editable QR codes.
description: QRCodeBrain is a dynamic QR code generator for links and other content. Create a code, download it for use in print or on screen, and update its destination after printing. It also offers static QR codes.

name: TokCapture
tagline: Capture TikTok LIVE. Keep every moment.
description: TokCapture is a free browser-based TikTok LIVE recorder. Paste a live share link and it captures the source stream in the cloud—no install, and you can close the tab once recording starts. Each recording can run up to 2 hours. You get a clean, seekable MP4 in original broadcast quality, without comments, notifications, or interface overlays. Files stay in My recordings for seven days and are ready for CapCut, Premiere, or Final Cut. Ended broadcasts cannot be recovered. Works on mobile.

name: Christmas AI
tagline: Make Christmas photos, printable cards, pet portraits, ugly sweater pics, and personalized Santa videos from your browser. Try free with 10 sign-up credits.
description: Christmas AI is a browser-based holiday studio with eight tools for Christmas photos, printable cards, pet portraits, ugly sweaters, Santa hats, and personalized Santa videos. Upload a photo or choose a style, then download images or MP4 clips. New accounts get 10 free credits; one-time pay-as-you-go credit packs are available with no subscription.

name: Stand Out Tier List
tagline: Unofficial fan-made Roblox STAND OUT companion with all 48 Stands by rarity and a drag-and-drop tier-list builder.
description: Stand Out Tier List is a free, unofficial fan-made ranking tool for STAND OUT, the Roblox game by Studio Umbra: Europa. STAND OUT launched on 14 November 2026 with 48 documented Stands and, according to the game’s own FAQ, no definite best Stand and no published damage values. This site gives the verifiable roster — all 48 Stands, their rarity, Part, skill and EX counts, and which arrows can produce them, plus the rarity-level odds the game prints for Lucky and Bizarre Arrows — and then hands ranking to the player through a drag-and-drop tier list builder. On desktop you drag a card into a slot; on mobile you tap the card and then the slot. There are five slots (S / A / B / C / D), a fill-by-rarity option, reset, copy-as-plain-text, and fullscreen. The board is stored in the browser only; no account or download is required, and the tool is free. You cannot play STAND OUT here. The site is not affiliated with Roblox and does not host the game, its art, or its audio. Roster data is a snapshot dated 16 November 2026.

name: AI Generator Hub
tagline: Make AI videos, images, music and voice from one credit balance
description: AI Generator Hub is a browser-based SaaS for generative media. Video can start from a text prompt or from an uploaded image; the same account also generates images, music tracks and voice audio. Usage is credit-based across all generators. Free plan with 20 trial credits; Starter $9.9/month, Premium $29.99/month, Enterprise $49.99/month. English and Chinese UI.

name: Work Hours Calculator
tagline: Free work hours and timesheet calculator — no signup.
description: Free work hours and timesheet calculator — no signup. Calculate net hours, overtime and pay from start/end times and breaks, in the browser. Includes timesheet, overtime, bi-weekly and part-time calculators, with country pages for the UK, USA and others.

name: TransParrot
tagline: Bilingual subtitles and synced translated audio for YouTube
description: TransParrot is a Chrome extension that turns any captioned YouTube video into a bilingual experience. See the original line and its translation together, switch on natural translated audio that stays in sync with playback (it resumes after seeking and ads), and open a full transcript you can search, click to seek, and export as TXT. Broken auto-captions can be rewritten into full sentences. 100+ languages, Shorts supported, no uploads, free guest trial, right on the YouTube page.

name: MyAIRap.video
tagline: Turn photos and everyday stories into short Rap videos
description: MyAIRap.video turns personal photos and everyday stories into short Rap performances. Adults can create Solo, Duo or Pet videos, edit AI-drafted lyrics, choose a scene, Rap style and voice direction, and download the finished video. Available Style Remix and Character Swap templates show their required photos, soundtrack options and credit quote before submission. Results, including lip sync and movement, can vary. Browsing examples is free; generation requires an account and paid credits. One-time credit packs start at US$11.49, with no subscription. I am Leon Reed, the independent maker.

name: TRXEnergy.rent
tagline: Rent TRON energy for USDT (TRC-20) transfers via Telegram.
description: TRXEnergy.rent is a TRON energy rental and purchase service for people sending USDT on TRC-20. Users can obtain energy through its Telegram Mini App. The service offers 65,000 or 131,000 energy, with delegation in 1-3 seconds and 1-hour validity. Telegram users can claim 2 free daily energy rentals. It is non-custodial and requests only a public TRON address, without requiring private keys or a wallet connection. I am a founder of TRXEnergy.rent.

name: Bazi Diff
tagline: See which BaZi pillars hold when your birth time is uncertain.
description: Bazi Diff is a free Four Pillars calculator for people who remember a rough birth time or only know their birth date. Compare an entire interval across five calculation settings and see which pillars agree. A worked midnight example shows the result before you enter any details. The calculator supports 14 birth cities, needs no account and calculates birth details in your browser.

name: Image Layered
tagline: Turn a flat image into editable layers and export a PSD
description: Image Layered is an AI decomposition tool that splits a flat poster, product photo or AI image into separate transparent layers, rebuilds covered backgrounds, and exports a layered PSD or PNG ZIP for Photoshop, Figma, Photopea or Affinity.

name: Quillora
tagline: Free tool comparisons and a local character and word sample check
description: Quillora helps people starting affiliate sites choose content tools with free comparisons of costs, limitations and fit. Its homepage links directly to a free character and word counter: paste or type a sample to see characters including spaces, words and the characters-per-word ratio for that sample, with no sign-in. The counter processes sample text locally in browser memory rather than uploading or saving it. Clear the sample or leave the page to discard it. Counting methods and limitations are explained on the page. This is a sample text check, not AI generation or verified Rytr billing. Tool comparisons separate provider-reported facts from qualified suggestions and disclose affiliate relationships; Quillora may earn a commission through labeled affiliate links.

name: Website Summarizer
tagline: Free no-signup tool that summarizes a webpage from a URL.
description:
Website Summarizer is a free tool for summarizing a web page you already have a URL for. The site is https://websitesummarizer.org/. You paste the address of a page and choose how you want the result written. The live options are a Quick Summary, Key Takeaways, Study Notes, or SEO Analysis.

No account is required to start. The input is a single page URL, and the output is a summary of that page. This listing does not claim batch processing, whole-site summaries, PDF export, or Q&A, because those features are not live.

name: Boyi Lottery Draw API
tagline: Lottery draw results API for developers
description: Lottery draw results API for developers — live JSON/XML draws, history by date, free trial.

name: Dinero
tagline: Compare personal finance software and tools.
description: Dinero helps readers compare personal finance software for their needs. Explore budgeting and other categories, compare products side by side, and use personal finance calculators. The site also lists selected financial products by market.

name: StatRadar
tagline: Live esports scores, match stats, and forecasts you can check against results
description: StatRadar helps esports fans follow live scores, upcoming matches and team form in CS2, League of Legends, Dota 2, VALORANT and Rocket League. It compares published match forecasts with final scores. The public CS2 barometer shows calibration by confidence band, sample sizes and performance against public prediction-market probabilities. Scores and match previews are free. Detailed analysis is available with paid access.

name: Moon Sweepers Guide
tagline: Independent field guides for Moon Sweepers tasks, systems, and checks.
description: Moon Sweepers Guide is a public field guide for the game Moon Sweepers. It covers beginner tasks, robots, factories, power, money, achievements, co-op, and save backups, with practical steps and connection checks. It also includes a conveyor budget calculator and a conveyor route planner.

name: Marlin Fuel & Transport
tagline: Dockside and commercial fueling in the Florida Keys
description: Marlin Fuel & Transport provides dockside and commercial fueling across the Florida Keys and South Florida from Tavernier, Florida.

name: Stitch Pattern Studio
tagline: Turn photos into printable cross-stitch patterns with DMC colors and a symbol chart. Free in-browser preview; images never leave your device.
description: Stitch Pattern Studio turns your favorite photos into ready-to-stitch cross-stitch patterns. Upload an image, choose your canvas size and color count, and instantly get a full-color stitch chart complete with a DMC thread list and symbol key. Preview the result free right in your browser—your photos never leave your device. Subscribe to export the complete high-resolution PDF: pattern grid, color legend, and thread quantities, ready to print and stitch. Perfect for crafters, handmade gifts, and custom needlework. No design skills needed—pick your palette and stitch your memories today at crossstitchgen.com.

name: LaunchNest
tagline: Free, manually reviewed software listings for startup founders
description: LaunchNest helps software startup founders explain their products through clear public listings with direct website links. Visitors can browse software by category without signing in. Founders can request a listing without an account; listings are free for now and every request is manually reviewed before publication. Approved listings remain while the product is active. Submit your product: https://launchnest.brainer.one/submit

name: ClickPop
tagline: AI video generator: type an idea, get a cinematic VFX video.
description: ClickPop is an AI video generator and AI video editor: text to video, AI UGC ads, character swap and faceless YouTube videos with cinematic VFX.

name: Slot & Shaft
tagline: Design DIY extrusion furniture, get the exact parts list
description: Slot & Shaft helps you design DIY furniture from aluminum extrusion and linear shafts. Pick a desk, table, workbench or shelf, set your size in 3D to the centimeter, and get a parts list generated from that exact model, with links to US sellers.

name: Sheet Music to MIDI
tagline: Turn sheet music PDFs and photos into MIDI and MusicXML.
description: Sheet Music to MIDI reads printed sheet music from a PDF, scan or phone photo and returns MIDI and MusicXML for each page in about 20 seconds. The original page sits next to the redrawn score, with browser playback and tempo control. For choir singers, piano learners, arrangers and teachers. First 3 pages free.

name: RainSleep
tagline: Rain sounds for sleep, relaxation and focus
description: RainSleep is a browser-based app for sleep, relaxation and focus. Listen to rain and ambient sounds, set a sleep timer, or combine sounds in the mixer. Core listening and mixing features are free. An optional AI audio generator creates sleep music, bedtime stories and guided meditations using paid credits.

name: Free Image Converter
tagline: Convert images to JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or PDF on your device.
description: Free Image Converter is a free browser tool that converts images to JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or PDF on your device. Files stay in the tab and are never uploaded to a server, and you can start without an account. It also includes bulk conversion, compression, resizing, cropping, metadata removal, and image-to-PDF / PDF-to-image tools.

name: Image to Image AI — Tancky AI
tagline: A new look for an existing image, directed by text
description: A different look does not have to start with a different photo. Tancky AI takes an uploaded image and a written request for changes to its style, backdrop or clothing. Its image-to-image workflow aims to retain the subject, faces, products and composition while applying the edit. The browser workspace also contains background removal, upscaling, old-photo restoration and compositing tools. No installation or GPU is needed, and both English and Chinese interfaces are available.

name: VocalRemoverApp
tagline: Free vocal remover that runs in your browser.
description: Split any song into vocals and an instrumental. The free mode runs in your browser with no upload, no account and no preview cap. HQ cloud mode works on phones and tablets, adds lossless WAV and takes songs up to 30 minutes.

name: MuseMate
tagline: AI music videos, Canvas loops and covers for musicians
description: MuseMate is an AI music video generator for independent artists: upload a song for a beat-synced video, plus Spotify Canvas loops, album covers and press photos.

name: PNG Compressor
tagline: The lossless PNG Compressor built for screenshots, app UI, logos, and icons.
description: The lossless PNG Compressor built for screenshots, app UI, logos, and icons. Shrink PNG files — often by 40-80% — while every pixel, color, and transparent detail stays exactly as it was. Images are processed in memory and never stored on their servers. Completely free, with no account or sign-up and unlimited compressions. Each image can be up to 10MB, and you can select several images at once for batch compression. The uploader accepts PNG, JPG/JPEG, GIF, and WebP. PNG files are compressed losslessly. Four compression levels are available: Low, Medium, High, and Maximum.

name: Username Generator
tagline: Free username generator for gaming, social media, and other platforms
description: Username Generator is a free web tool that generates usernames for gaming, social media, and other platforms. Users describe a handle, pick from nine styles (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Historical, Horror, Mythology, Nature, Sci-Fi, Strategy), optionally add special characters, and copy results in one click. Free to try, no account needed.

name: MemeWink
tagline: Free original WhatsApp stickers and browser-based image tools
description: MemeWink is a Brazilian Portuguese sticker library and browser-based image toolkit. Visitors can download original transparent PNG stickers for WhatsApp, browse themed collections, or turn their own photos into stickers without installing an app. It also offers background removal, meme-making tools and practical guides.

name: AI Room Design
tagline: Redesign a room from a photo or a description
description: AI Room Design helps homeowners and renters visualize a room makeover before buying furniture or changing their layout. Upload a photo or describe a space, choose a style and specify what should stay, then compare and download design concepts. The room design tool can be tried without creating an account.

name: AI4MEME
tagline: Turn photos into short meme videos using published scene templates.
description: AI4MEME is a browser-based image-to-video studio that turns uploaded photos into short meme clips using published scene templates. Each scene displays its photo count, duration, aspect ratio and credit cost before generation. Users choose a scene and upload photos without a free-form prompt or editing timeline. Creations are private, with no public gallery. Failed generation jobs refund credits. JPEG, PNG and WebP uploads are supported up to 8 MB. The service is intended for photos of consenting adults, with credit-based plans and one-time packs listed on its official pricing page.

name: DictoText
tagline: Turn audio and video into editable transcripts and subtitles.
description: Transcribe short voice memos, interviews and creator videos without an account. Optionally reduce background noise in your browser, edit the text and export TXT, DOCX, SRT or VTT. Free with limits: 25 MB and 10 minutes per file, 5 upload attempts per IP per hour, and 100 transcription minutes shared across all visitors per UTC day. Transcription uploads prepared audio for cloud processing; local noise reduction can be used separately.

name: Dizy
tagline: Weekly charts of AI-made music, ranked by listeners
description: Dizy publishes weekly AI music charts ranked by listener votes. Listen, vote and submit tracks for free across a Top 40, Top 100 and 34 genre charts.

name: WiringCert
tagline: EICR, EIC and Minor Works electrical certificates on your phone
description: Fill in, sign and issue EICR, EIC and Minor Works electrical certificates on your phone, on site, with no signal and no account. Schedules of test results and inspection checklists are included. Sign, preview the PDF, issue and lock it with a SHA-256 checksum. Free: 3 new Minor Works certificates a month plus a 14-day free trial of EIC and EICR; Pro removes the limits. Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.skyseedtech.wiringcert

name: Imanuve
tagline: Create images from text in Portuguese or remove a photo background without signing up.
description: Imanuve combines text-to-image generation, a visual prompt library, and a browser-based background remover. Browse examples for product photos, social posts, and posters, then adapt a prompt in the studio. Image generation uses an account and credits. Background removal runs in the browser and lets you download a transparent PNG for free without an account.

name: HouseChief
tagline: One family plan for the calendar, meals and chores.
description: Calendar, meals, groceries and chores in one place for the whole family. Works in any browser. Free for 30 days, no card needed, then $9.95/month.

name: Start Quitting Smoking
tagline: 30-day taper tracker and free calculator that steps cigarettes, vapes, or weed to a planned zero.
description: Start Quitting Smoking is a 30-day taper tracker for cigarettes, vaping, or weed. You enter a typical day's count and get a plan that falls in a straight line to a planned 0 on day 30. The first 24 hours of the tracker are free, then $9 once. Entries stay on the device. It is a planner, not a treatment. Free no-signup calculator: https://startquittingsmoking.com/30-day-taper-calculator

name: Trail Tracker
tagline: Blood Trail Tracker App for Deer Recovery
description:
Trail Tracker is an offline-first GPS blood trail app for marking blood sign, recording your recovery path, and navigating back to your truck during wounded deer recovery.

One-tap pins for first blood, heavy, last, bedded, and arrow, large enough for gloves. Live GPS path, bearing and distance back to your start, and GPX export to onX, Gaia, or Google Earth. Satellite, hybrid, topo, and street maps cache for offline use. Blood Detector can highlight possible blood-colored spots and drop a GPS pin. It assists detection and is not guaranteed; always confirm sign with your own eyes.

The full app is $9.99 one-time and stays on your phone. Cloud backup is an optional $2.99/mo add-on after you own the full app. Install on iPhone from Safari: Share, then Add to Home Screen.

name: Nuzza AI
tagline: Turn your photos into trending AI videos
description:
Nuzza AI is a photo-to-video platform that turns your photos into AI videos. Choose a trending effect (dance, music, meme and social video trends), upload a photo and create your own video for TikTok, Instagram Reels or YouTube Shorts, with no prompt writing needed.
For custom work, Nuzza AI Studio gives access to leading video and image models including Seedance, Kling, Google Veo, Hailuo, Wan, Flux and Nano Banana. Brands can turn product photos into ads, UGC-style videos and launch promos.
It also includes AI video tools (upscaler, extender, enhancer, background remover, reframe) and image tools (upscaler, background remover, inpaint, uncrop, object/text remover). Sign up free with welcome credits; credit packs and subscriptions are available when you need more.

name: Invoicing Agent (IA)
tagline: Hire a shop secretary that never goes home
description:
IA is a simple secretary for the shop that does the work: estimates, schedule, invoices, and follow-up, at a price a one- or two-person crew can keep.

Tell IA what you need, review the draft, then approve and send it to Wave, QuickBooks, Xero, or FreshBooks. It tracks unpaid invoices and emails a polite follow-up so you get paid without chasing paper. Schedule jobs on Google Calendar or iOS Calendar.

For small contractors and mom-and-pop shops. Start free for 30 days. Cancel before day 30 if it isn't a fit. Solo is 30 days free, then $9.99/mo for 1 user. Company is $24.99/mo for up to 3 users. Shop is $99/mo for up to 10 users.

name: Salt Tidings
tagline: Free email alerts for your NOAA tide station, only when something happens
description: Pick one of 3,502 NOAA tide stations and Salt Tidings emails you only when the National Weather Service issues a marine or coastal alert there (small craft advisories, gale warnings, coastal flood, rip currents, dense fog and more) or NOAA predicts an unusually high or low tide. Live NOAA and NWS data, free, double opt-in, one-click unsubscribe. No digest, no ads, no spam. Also has free tide charts for each station.

name: Admirers
tagline: AI videos from a photo or short clip and a voice sample
description: Admirers creates AI videos from a photo or short clip and a voice sample. Type a script to generate a video in your cloned voice, with support for 44 languages. Offers a free one-minute trial.

name: GetRandomName 1000 Random Names
tagline: Generate 1,000 random full names at once — free, no sign-up.
description: Free tool that generates 1,000 random full names at once from US Social Security Administration and Census Bureau data. No repeats in a batch, filter by culture or gender, copy the list or download CSV, TXT or JSON. No sign-up.

name: CareHub
tagline: Shared inbox and AI agents for business messaging
description: CareHub is a customer communications platform from Kazakhstan. It brings WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram and website chat into a shared workspace for sales and support teams. Teams can manage conversations, use AI agents, send broadcasts, build automations and track communication analytics. CareHub supports WhatsApp Business API and WhatsApp QR connections. A free trial is available.

name: BirthdayWebsite
tagline: Personal Birthday Website
description: Create and preview a personal birthday website in your browser with a letter, photos, optional music, countdown, and PIN. Official one-time price is US$9.99. Paid publishing is not enabled yet. Not an AI writer.

name: Project Moon Life
tagline: Free Online Life Simulator
description: Unofficial fan-made free browser urban life simulator. Not an official Project Moon game. The base game is free and unlimited; optional AI is a separate one-time $10 unlock. Ages 15+.

name: OpenFirmList
tagline: Global B2B company search and AI agent API
description: OpenFirmList helps buyers find suppliers and sellers discover potential customers through a global B2B company search index. Search by product, sector and location, or connect an AI agent through the search API.

name: Audio to Video AI
tagline: Audio to Video AI turns sound (speech, music, SFX) into video; add a picture or describe the scene.
description: Audio to Video AI turns sound (speech, music, or sound effects) into video. You can optionally add a picture or describe the scene. Features include Audio to short video (5–10s, MP4 1080p), Talking Photo (photo or character plus a voice recording), and Music Video (song plus a performer photo, up to about 10 minutes, 480p/720p, 16:9 or 9:16). Examples can be previewed free. Generation uses credits. A watermarked download is available; paid credit top-ups unlock watermark-free downloads.

name: BlockPoster.ai
tagline: Free block poster maker: split one image into A4 pages
description: BlockPoster.ai is a browser-based block poster maker that turns one image into a wall-sized poster printed across standard sheets on your home printer. Upload a photo or create artwork with AI, crop it, choose from five paper sizes and the page grid, preview the layout, and download a PDF with an assembly guide and predictable page order. Free PDFs need no account (up to 150 DPI, up to 5 sheets across, small watermark). Paid plans add unlimited HD, watermark-free PDFs up to 300 DPI, up to 10 sheets across, batch ZIP export and AI credits. Ordinary uploads are processed locally.

name: VibePico
tagline: AI family photo generator for people photographed apart
description: VibePico is an AI family photo generator for families who are never all in the same place at once. Add a separate photo of each person or pet, choose a scene such as a cozy Christmas living room, a golden-hour beach or a classic studio backdrop, and VibePico builds one portrait in which everyone keeps their own face. Extra tools cover multi-generational portraits, couple photos, pet portraits, memorial family photos, a Christmas card maker with printable 4x6 and 5x7 layouts, an age filter, photo-to-coloring-page and a short animate-a-photo clip. New accounts get 10 credits for one watermarked preview; credit packs and subscriptions start at $9.99.

name: Ody Ai Business Phone
tagline: Shared workspace phone + highly manageable AI agents. Trusted by 4K+ businesses.
description: Already trusted by 4K+ businesses. Ody Ai Business Phone combines a shared team workspace on one business number with highly manageable AI agents. Rare to get both. Native iOS and Android (+ web). AI calls inbound and outbound, AI texting, AI voice-to-text, link tracking, plus REST API, SDKs, MCP, and Switchboard. 7-day free trial.

name: AI Video Expand
tagline: AI video expander that fills the sides of a vertical clip, no black bars
description: AI Video Expand is a video outpainting tool: upload an MP4 or MOV of up to 60 seconds, choose 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 or 5:4, and the AI paints the missing edges around your untouched original. You get a 720p or 1080p MP4 with the original sound and no watermark. Paid per clip, no subscription.

name: Fancy Cafe AI
tagline: First Time in a Fancy Cafe AI: your photo becomes the viral POV video
description: Fancy Cafe AI is a browser tool for making your own version of the TikTok trend "POV: your first time in a fancy cafe". Upload one photo of yourself, a friend or a pet, optionally add a second photo for the guest, and get a 10 to 15 second vertical MP4 with sound, up to 720p and no watermark, usually within minutes. Made for TikTok, Reels and Shorts creators; no prompts, no app and no account needed for one video. Videos start at $3.99.

name: Signature Plan Finder
tagline: Compare selected e-signature plans by send volume, senders and billing term.
description: A free, independent calculator for people comparing selected SignWell, DocuSeal and DocuSign plans. Enter sending volume and sender count, choose monthly or annual upfront billing, and compare base costs with links to the vendors' pricing pages. No signup or document upload. Not a signing service and not legal advice. Allowances, features, taxes and current vendor terms need checking before purchase. No active affiliate links at launch.

name: AI Dance Trend
tagline: AI dance trend video generator: turn one photo into a viral dance clip
description: AI Dance Trend makes a 10-second vertical dance video from a single photo of you or your pet. Pick a viral dance trend such as the Rumpelstiltskin tiptoe dance, Raindance AI or the pet dance, upload one clear photo and get an MP4 with original music and no watermark, ready for TikTok, Reels or Shorts. No app and no subscription: pay once from $9.90. Photos are deleted automatically.

name: Daily Krill
tagline: Krillion answers today, with hints and rarity tiers
description: Daily Krill is a tidy, fast daily log of Krillion's Daily Dive answers. Krillion is a free daily word game: each dive asks seven "name a…" prompts and scores every guess by how rare it is, and the rarest pick is the One in a Krillion answer, worth 100 points. For each dive, Daily Krill shows the seven prompts, two gentle hints for every One in a Krillion answer, and the full list of accepted answers ranked by rarity tier. An archive keeps a page for every recorded date, and search covers recorded dives. It is an independent fan site, not affiliated with or endorsed by Krillion.

name: Hokio
tagline: Stable HTTPS links for local webhooks and applications
description: Hokio gives local applications stable public HTTPS links for webhooks, demos, automations, and AI workflows on Windows and Linux. Install the native connector, sign in, choose a local port, and keep the assigned link through connector restarts.

name: Who Are You
tagline: See what a website can tell about you before you ever log in
description: Who Are You is a free, open-source page that shows what any website can infer about you without a login or a permission prompt: your exit IP and ASN, whether that matches your timezone and language, WebRTC and DNS leak signals, a browser fingerprint (canvas, WebGL, fonts, screen), and the mismatches that often give away a VPN or proxy. Checks run in the browser; the page does not keep your IP or full fingerprint, and anonymous counts can be turned off. I'm Yang, the author. Source (MIT): https://github.com/yt1988/who-are-you. I used AI assistance while building it.

name: Solari
tagline: Cloud browsers, sandboxes and desktops for AI agents through one API.
description: Solari provides cloud browsers, isolated code sandboxes and full Linux desktops for developers building AI agents. Agents can browse websites, run code and control desktop applications through one API. Use Playwright or a CDP client for browsers, SDKs for sandboxes and desktops, or the Solari MCP server. Persistent browser profiles, session replays, snapshots and forks support longer-running automation. A free plan is available for prototyping, with paid plans for production workloads. Documentation: https://docs.getsolari.com/ . Benchmarks: https://getsolari.com/benchmarks .

name: ComicStory AI
tagline: Turn a story and one photo into a comic book with consistent characters
description: ComicStory AI turns a written story and one character photo into a print-ready comic book. Paste a script, upload one reference photo of the main character, and the tool lays out pages, draws every panel and places speech bubbles. Unlike other AI image tools that redraw the character each panel, it locks one reference across the whole project so the face, hair and outfit stay consistent from page one to the last page. Twelve art styles, editable layouts, print-ready PDF export and a shareable web reader. Fifty free credits on sign-up.

name: LLMBrake
tagline: Per-customer dollar caps for OpenAI and Anthropic API calls
description: LLMBrake is an open-source (MIT) TypeScript library that puts a monthly USD budget on each customer of an AI app. It runs in-process with no proxy. Past a threshold it switches to cheaper models, and at the limit it blocks the call before it reaches the provider. Install with npm install llmbrake.

name: Open Desk
tagline: Simple, no-subscription spreadsheets for small shops and personal finance
description: Open Desk makes finished spreadsheet tools you buy once: a Google Sheets work order tracker that moves jobs to the right tab by status, a small-shop inventory tracker with monthly counts and automatic Short / Over, plus a paycheck budget, bill tracker, debt snowball vs avalanche calculator, net worth tracker and workout log for Excel, Google Sheets and Numbers. No macros, no subscriptions.

name: Signvisit
tagline: Work order app: PDF service report, photos and customer signature
description: Signvisit is a work order app for field technicians: write a field service report on site, mark up photos, and get the customer signature before you leave. The signed PDF goes out by email or messenger. The general service form is always free with 5 complete reports a month; Signvisit Pro adds 12 trade forms (incl. HVAC), unlimited sending, due dates, reminders and QR labels. Data stays on the device. Get it on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.skyseedtech.signvisit

name: InvoicePlank
tagline: Invoice maker with estimates, PDF and CSV export, one ledger per job, offline.
description: InvoicePlank is an invoice maker for contractors, handymen and other small businesses. Make an invoice or an estimate on your phone, with one ledger per job. Let the customer sign on the screen, turn an estimate into an invoice in one tap, and record each payment. Everything stays on your phone: no account, no upload, no tracking. Free includes the job ledger and the first 5 new documents each month; Pro is optional. Get it on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.skyseedtech.invoiceplank

name: Destiny Matrix Now
tagline: Free Destiny Matrix calculator — no sign-up, no paywall.
description: A free, no-sign-up Destiny Matrix calculator. Enter a date of birth and get the full interactive chart — personality, talents, love and money lines, karmic tail, purposes, health map, and year-by-year energies — plus a two-person compatibility calculator. All calculations run in the visitor's browser; no birth date is stored.

name: tutor.com.pk
tagline: Find the perfect tutor in Pakistan
description: tutor.com.pk is a free tutor marketplace for Pakistan. Students and parents can browse 2,046 tutor profiles across 143 cities and 57 subjects, compare them, and contact tutors for home or online lessons. No joining fee and no commission.

name: ContactsPlus
tagline: The contact manager that keeps your contacts unified.
description: ContactsPlus is a contact manager and personal CRM for contacts scattered across several accounts. Connect Google, iCloud and Microsoft/Outlook and choose a sync direction per account. Free syncs one account and up to 1,000 contacts daily. Premium syncs up to five accounts with Quick Sync about every 15 minutes, holds 25,000 contacts, and adds automatic duplicate merge with undo, contact enrichment and a business card scanner. Every contact can carry notes, tags, documents and follow-up reminders. Runs on the web, iOS and Android. ContactsPlus for Slack works on every plan: type /contacts to look up a person, add a note or save a contact, privately. Contact Grabber, a free Chrome extension, saves contact details from web pages, Gmail or Outlook (15 new contacts on Free, unlimited on Premium). Premium also connects Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Grok to search your contacts and propose updates that wait for your approval; it can never delete or export them.

name: SideLedger HMRC limit checker
tagline: Free checker for UK Vinted, eBay and Depop sellers: see if your sales are near HMRC's reporting limits.
description: Free checker for UK Vinted, eBay and Depop sellers: see if your sales are near HMRC's reporting limits.

name: 12Axes.cc
tagline: Free political ideology quiz across 12 dimensions
description: 12Axes.cc is a free browser-based political ideology quiz with 36, 60 or 240 questions across 12 dimensions. Results compare answers with ideologies, countries and political figures, with a full report, PDF export and a shareable card. No sign-up is required; answers are scored locally rather than uploaded.

name: DFGQM – Delta Force Loadout Codes
tagline: Delta Force loadout codes, tier list & daily codes
description: Unofficial Delta Force (global servers) fan site: Operations loadout codes by weapon tier, one-click copy, plus daily codes. Chinese & English.

name: Today's Mealow
tagline: Can't decide what to eat? Get 3 real dishes nearby
description: Free food picker: answer a few quick questions and a cat mascot picks 3 dishes from real places near you. No sign-up, English and Chinese.

name: Neon Blue
tagline: Test decisions on simulated audiences before you spend
description: Simulated audiences of your customers and market, grounded in real interview and survey data. Test pricing, product, creative and UI decisions before you spend, and follow up with live AI interviews.

name: FujinAI
tagline: Free Shopify image tools for product photos, with optional paid AI generation.
description: Submitted by an owner-authorized AI assistant. FujinAI provides free Shopify image tools for resizing, compressing, cropping and converting product photos. Merchants can prepare product imagery through an independent website. Optional AI product-scene and white-background generation require paid credits; the ordinary free image tools are not AI generation, and no free AI trial is claimed. This is not an official Shopify product, verified Shopify app, or proven store integration. Source and tool example: https://www.fujindeai.com/tools/resize-image . No revenue or conversion improvement is promised.

name: MisDerechosWeb
tagline: Free Spanish-language calculators and checklists for freelancers
description: MisDerechosWeb provides Spanish-language informational guides and free browser tools for freelancers in Spain. Tools include a VAT calculator to add or extract VAT, recurring-expense and break-even calculators, and a document-review checklist. No registration or purchase is required to use these tools. Find the tools at https://www.misderechosweb.com/herramientas/#herramientas-autonomos . Calculations are illustrative, not tax filings or individual legal advice. The website includes clearly labelled affiliate advertising for optional third-party services such as Quipu; using the free tools does not require purchasing those services. MisDerechosWeb is not a law firm or government body.

name: PlanForge PDF Editor
tagline: PDF markup, drawing measurement and takeoff for web and Windows
description: PlanForge is an alpha PDF editor for everyday documents and technical drawings. Add text, highlights and annotations, organize pages, and export PDFs. Calibrate a known dimension to measure lengths, areas and perimeters, count items, and export takeoff tables. Available on the web and Windows; Mac users can use the browser editor. Projects are stored locally and do not automatically sync between web and desktop. Try it free for 7 days with no card required, then $19.99/month or $190/year. A future CrewLedger integration is planned.

name: Auzmor Learn
tagline: Get people hooked to learning.
description: Auzmor Learn is a corporate LMS with a built-in learning experience platform. Build courses in minutes or let ARIA, Auzmor’s AI assistant, draft them from documents. Combine courses and live events into learning paths, assign training by team, track compliance with due dates, certificates and e-signatures, and run mentorship and on-the-job training. Includes up to 30K ready-made courses, 50+ integrations, mobile apps, cloud or on-premise. Security and compliance: SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, CMMC, ISO 27001 and GDPR.

name: DragonTraveler.gg
tagline: Dragon Traveler tier list, teams, codes and wiki
description:
DragonTraveler.gg (https://dragontraveler.gg/) is an independent, fan-run wiki and strategy site for Dragon Traveler, the free-to-play idle RPG published by GameTree for Android, iOS and PC (released in Japan as ドラベル~Dragon Travel~). It is not the official site and is not affiliated with the developer.

The tier list ranks all 85 Luminaries from T0 to T4, filterable by class (Guardian, Assassin, Warrior, Mage, Archer, Priest) and by faction. Rankings weigh PvP arena, campaign progress, guild boss damage, team flexibility and value for free-to-play players; the October 2026 T0 is Athena, Hades, Ares and Poseidon. Each character page covers skills, talents, divinity, relics, gear, strengths, weaknesses, counters and best teammates.

The Dream Teams page gives 14 example lineups with front line, back line, faction mix, Overdrive order, win condition and budget substitutes, for campaign, PvP defense, guild bosses, Temporal Rift and Colosseum.

The redeem codes page lists gift codes from official announcements with the date and occasion of each, explains how to redeem one (finish the tutorial, open the profile's Redeem Code field, codes are case-sensitive, rewards arrive in the in-game mail) and why a code fails. Codes are not called active unless confirmed.

Reference pages cover the banner schedule (current and past), the 2026 event skins, the six factions, the glossary of status effects, and the Steam version with system requirements and Mac/Linux status. About 90 guides cover beginner tips, rerolling, star-up costs, divinity, Temporal Rift and the current meta.

It is free, supported by ads, and needs no account.

name: Syllapass
tagline: Exam practice by syllabus topic
description: Syllapass helps secondary students revise for international exams. Browse syllabus-mapped questions, check available mark schemes, practise online, or build printable topic tests. The catalogue spans IB, A-Level, IGCSE and AP, with Cambridge International AS & A Level Chemistry (9701) open to the public.

name: YVE MEDIA
tagline: Romanian digital agency: web development, SEO and Google Ads
description: YVE MEDIA is a Romanian digital agency (not a software product) working with clients across all of Romania, with its registered office in Iasi. It offers professional web development, search engine optimization (SEO), Google Ads management, digital marketing and custom software solutions. Founded in 2017, it helps businesses strengthen their online presence through modern website technologies, technical SEO, responsive design, performance optimization and digital automation.

name: Image to 3D Model
tagline: Image to 3D model from a photo or illustration, for indie games and AI creators.
description: Image to 3D Model turns a photo or illustration into a 3D model in the browser. Sign in for 20 welcome credits (one Trellis model). Export GLB for editing or STL for slicing. A multi-view workspace accepts 2–8 photos of the same object. Built for game assets, prototypes, and concept art.

name: Masterii
tagline: Adaptive CAEC math prep — 1,000+ practice questions, worked explanations, 3 mock papers
description: Masterii is an adaptive learning platform. Its first course is CAEC math prep: 1,000+ practice questions across CAEC Math Part I and Part II, worked explanations, mistake review, and 3 original mock papers. CA$29 one-time for 90 days of access, 72-hour refund. Independent prep product, not the official test and not endorsed by TVO ILC.

name: Xun Qiao
tagline: Follow the news. See the market.
description:
Xun Qiao is a free research workspace for cryptocurrency and U.S. stocks. It lines up news headlines with related market context, so a story, the affected assets and the price picture can be reviewed in one workflow.

The public homepage can be browsed without an account. A free account unlocks the news reader, workbench, markets and published AI research. It covers 1,200+ sources, is available in English and Chinese, and does not execute trades.

Optional Gold membership adds GPT conversations and a developer API, and a Premium subscription includes a paid read-only news API. The core research workflow stays free.

Website: https://xunqiao.qq10.fun/
GitHub: https://github.com/xunqiao111/xunqiao-market-intelligence

name: Menutto
tagline: Digital menus and online ordering for restaurants
description: Menutto helps restaurants publish a branded digital menu and receive delivery and takeaway orders online. Customers order through a link or QR code; staff manage incoming orders in a dashboard. Fixed monthly plans with no per-order commission.

name: EmpleosPR
tagline: Bolsa de empleos para Puerto Rico
description: EmpleosPR es una bolsa de empleos para Puerto Rico con nuevos empleos publicados todos los días: tiendas, restaurantes, salud, oficinas, almacenes, servicio al cliente y primer empleo. Busca por pueblo e industria.

name: FlyerCareers
tagline: Free job board for US aviation maintenance careers
description: FlyerCareers is a free job board for US aviation maintenance careers — Avionics, A&P mechanics, Structures/sheet metal technicians, plus entry-level New Talent roles. New jobs posted daily with free email alerts.

name: Sheru Bhai AI
tagline: Paid photo-to-video lion-story scenes
description: A paid photo-to-video tool that places a person's photo into original Sheru Bhai lion-story scene templates and renders a short 9:16 video. Each video uses 100 paid credits; completed files last 30 days. The current public FAQ describes the output as an approximately six-second 1080p silent video.

name: Visual Timer
tagline: Free visual timers you can read from across the room
description: Visual Timer is a free collection of 600+ online timers, countdowns and time tools that show time passing instead of just counting it. A shrinking red disc, an hourglass, a liquid fill, a traffic light. Teachers put them on the projector, speakers keep one on screen, kids see "how long is left" without reading numbers, and people use them for focus sessions, workouts, cooking and games.

name: FullCastBook
tagline: AI audiobook maker with a full cast: every character gets its own voice, then export M4B with chapters or MP3.
description:
FullCastBook turns a manuscript into an AI audiobook with a full cast. Upload an EPUB, PDF, DOCX, TXT or Markdown file, or paste a chapter, and it finds the chapters, works out who is speaking in each line and gives every character a distinct voice alongside an AI narrator. Swap any voice from a library of standard and premium voices (built on Gemini and ElevenLabs voice models), and keep the same cast across a series.

Direct any line in plain English by adding a note in brackets, such as [whisper, like sharing a secret], and drop sound tags like [laugh], [sigh] or [breathe] exactly where they belong. Regenerate a single line without redoing the chapter, then export the finished audiobook as one M4B with chapter markers, MP3 files or a ZIP. It also works for two-voice podcasts and dialogue, audio drama, bedtime stories and book trailers.

Signing up is free with no card, but there are no free credits: audio is paid with credits from a plan (from $9.90 a month) or a one-time top-up, and cost depends on how much text is voiced. You can publish exported files wherever you hold the rights to the text; store policies on AI narration vary, and Audible and ACX do not currently accept AI-narrated audiobooks. English works best today, scanned page images are not supported, and voice cloning is not available yet.

For indie and self-published authors, web novel and LitRPG writers, fiction podcasters and audio drama makers, YouTube storytellers, and teachers making classroom read-alouds.

name: UCAT Practice Test UK
tagline: Timed UCAT practice and mocks for UK medical applicants
description: Independent online UCAT preparation for UK medicine and dentistry applicants. Practise four timed subtests, complete mock exams and review worked explanations. Free practice with optional paid plans. Not affiliated with the UCAT Consortium.

name: Breed Climate Checker by Petsarina
tagline: Find out if your dog breed truly fits your climate
description: Thinking of a Husky where summers are long and hot? The Breed Climate Checker gives you a straight answer before you commit. Choose from 14 popular breeds, enter the highest temperature your summers reach, say whether your home has air conditioning, and tell it how much time the dog would spend indoors. You get one of three honest verdicts: the breed fits your climate, it can work with real effort, or it would honestly not be fair on the dog. Every verdict comes with a practical care plan covering walk times, cooling, grooming and indoor life. It is free, works on any phone, and needs no account. Try it at https://petsarinaofficial.com/breed-climate-checker.

name: UCAT Practice Test ANZ
tagline: Independent UCAT ANZ practice tests and preparation resources
description: UCAT Practice Test ANZ provides timed practice questions, full mock tests, worked explanations and preparation guides for applicants to medicine and dentistry courses in Australia and New Zealand. It covers Verbal Reasoning, Decision Making, Quantitative Reasoning and Situational Judgement, with free practice and optional paid plans. The site is independent and not affiliated with the UCAT ANZ Consortium or Pearson VUE.

name: Musely
tagline: AI creation for images, music, voiceovers, and text
description: Musely is an all-in-one AI creative platform that transforms simple prompts into images, music, voiceovers, and written content through intelligent tool selection and streamlined workflows.

name: SparkMeld
tagline: AI video and image generator from text or reference images.
description: SparkMeld is an AI video and image generator. Start with a text prompt or a reference image, choose a model and an aspect ratio, and generate in a workspace. Results are saved privately. The workspace shows each model's credit cost and deducts credits when a job is submitted.

name: Carnet
tagline: A digital bullet journal, between paper and Notion
description: Carnet is a calm digital bullet journal on the web. Your weekly spread is already drawn, tasks use the classic BuJo key, and an unfinished task stays a plain dot: no red overdue wall, nothing moves on its own. You migrate by hand when you look back at your week. Structure that forgives.

name: LiquidMap
tagline: Order book heatmap, footprint and bursts in your browser
description: LiquidMap is a crypto order-flow terminal in the browser. It shows the resting order book as a heatmap (one exchange, or up to 15 books from 10 exchanges), large market orders as bursts that were absorbed or broke through, and the footprint inside each candle. Plus spot CVD, funding, open interest and liquidations. Desktop and phone. It does not connect to your exchange account, gives no signals and promises no profits. 3 days for €1, then €10/month.

name: ScanRead.ai
tagline: Extract text from any image or document free
description: Drop a photo, screenshot, or PDF — get copyable text in seconds. Free, no signup needed.

name: BoardClash
tagline: Free hidden-rank browser strategy against the computer or a friend.
description: BoardClash is a free browser strategy project. Its first game is an independent, unofficial Stratego-style contest with 40 pieces on a 10 by 10 board. Arrange your army, learn from the ranks revealed in combat, and capture the opposing flag. Play against the computer at three difficulty levels or invite a friend to a private match. A tutorial and rules, piece and strategy guides help new players get started. English, German, Spanish and French are available. No account or download is required. One game is live; a broader collection of 2D strategy games is planned.

name: PawLine
tagline: AI pet care guidance for every whisker, wing, hoof and paw
description: PawLine is an empathetic AI assistant guiding pet owners through animal health, first aid and behavior questions across species - dogs, cats, birds, reptiles, horses and more. Answers are shaped to each pet's profile, and a Places feature finds nearby vets, parks and pet services. PawLine complements, never replaces, your veterinarian, and says plainly when a clinic visit is the right call. On iOS, Android and web. Plans: Weekly $3.99, Monthly $9.99, Yearly $99.99 USD.

name: Questry AI
tagline: Dutch AI SDR for B2B companies selling to the Netherlands
description: Questry AI is a Dutch AI SDR for B2B companies that sell to the Dutch market. You describe your ideal customer; we start from the official Dutch business register, find every company that fits and, at each company, the person who decides. Each company gets a file with what we know about it and a personal first email, sent from separate sending domains that we set up and warm up for 14 days, so your own domain stays out of it. No reply? We follow up. When someone replies, we answer and propose a time, and the meeting lands in your calendar. You lead the sales conversation. Questry AI connects with Gmail, Outlook, Google Calendar, Microsoft Teams and Slack. Plans: Start €299, Groei €649 and Schaal €995 per month, excluding VAT, no setup fee. Built in Amsterdam by co-founders Luuk van de Ven and Mats Driessen.

name: Kinjar
tagline: A shared budget for couples. The AI types in the receipts.
description: Kinjar is a household ledger for couples who plan money together. Split your income into envelopes by percentage, invite your partner to the same ledger, and let the AI read receipts and bank statements so nobody types transactions by hand. No bank login needed. Web app that installs on your phone. 27 currencies, English and Romanian, 30-day free trial without a card.

name: Agent Barn
tagline: Run your AI agents from one place
description: Agent Barn is an open-source (Apache-2.0) control plane for AI agents. Your team talks to agents in Slack, Teams, Telegram, Discord or email, agents work across Jira, GitHub, Confluence and more, and every conversation, tool call, log and cost is recorded. It runs agent runtimes like Hermes and OpenClaw on your own Kubernetes cluster, deployed with Helm.

name: SunTimeToday
tagline: Free sunrise & sunset times, golden hour and twilight calculators for any city
description: Free sunrise and sunset times, golden hour, blue hour and twilight calculators for any city, with monthly tables and dedicated pages for 33 cities. Tools run entirely in your browser.

name: RecetaFlow
tagline: Automation recipes for Latin American businesses
description: RecetaFlow is a free directory of step-by-step Make and n8n automation recipes, written first for Latin American small businesses, with an English section for US shops. There are 38 Spanish recipes and 9 English ones. Each recipe states the problem, who it is for, the tools, and the steps. Thirteen include a downloadable Make blueprint you can import. Spanish recipes cover shops, accountants, invoicing, real estate, restaurants, and services. A free newsletter announces new recipes only, after you confirm your email.

name: All Tools Max
tagline: 31 free online tools — no signup, no paywall.
description: 31 free online tools that work instantly in your browser — ATS resume checker, cover letter generator, overtime and paycheck calculators, PDF tools, paint calculator and more. No account, no free-trial trap.

name: StarAlly
tagline: Your AI assistant. Your choices. Everything handle
description:
StarAlly is your AI-powered personal assistant designed to take care of everyday tasks and simplify your life. From booking restaurant tables and travel arrangements to managing shopping, subscriptions, bills, returns, and reminders, StarAlly handles the tasks that take up your valuable time.

Simply communicate with StarAlly through text or a call using natural language. It finds suitable options, compares prices, completes bookings, places orders, manages requests, and follows up on tasks through the provider's own websites.

With a user-controlled approval process, StarAlly ensures that no booking, payment, or important action is completed without your explicit confirmation. Your sensitive information is protected in a secure vault, and every action is recorded for transparency.

Whether you need to organize your schedule, plan a trip, manage subscriptions, or take care of daily errands, StarAlly acts as your personal AI companion, helping you get things done without the hassle of managing everything yourself.

name: fundmysaas
tagline: Reward crowdfunding for SaaS. Back the products you want to exist.
description:

description: Bgbye removes image backgrounds in seconds. Upload PNG/JPG/WebP/AVIF (max 19MB), preview the cutout (including hair/edges), then download a transparent PNG or keep editing with a new background, text, or crop. Built for product photos, portraits, and social creatives.

name: Dime Dime Baby AI
tagline: Turn one authorized adult portrait into an approximately 8-second AI party video.
description: Dime Dime Baby AI turns one authorized adult portrait into an approximately 8-second video in a fixed party scene. Download a 4:3 MP4 in 480p or 720p. One-time credit packs start at $4.99; there is no free preview or subscription. This is an independent third-party tool, not affiliated with the artist or social platforms. No commercial music license is included; users are responsible for music rights. Do not upload images of children, public figures, or people without permission.

name: Image Studio
tagline: Create watermark-free high-res AI images from a text prompt in about 30 seconds.
description: Image Studio is a credit-based web app for text-to-image generation and AI photo editing. Type a prompt to get a no-watermark, high-resolution image in about 30 seconds, with six size presets and custom sizes from 1024 to 4096 pixels, plus poster, holiday-card, and editor tools. It markets itself as an independent alternative to Bing Image Creator and is not affiliated with Microsoft or Bing.

name: RapAI
tagline: AI rap video generator from photos, lyrics, and audio
description: RapAI (rapai.video) is an AI rap video generator that turns photos into a 15-second 720p rap video with no watermark, ready for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. Users can let AI write the lyrics for free, paste their own verse, or use a song they already have, and can star in the video alone or add a friend's photo for a duo. The site offers Quick Video and Custom Rap paths. One full 15-second 720p video costs 10 credits (2 for the song and 8 for the video). Official pricing includes one-time credit packs that never expire and monthly or yearly plans; failed steps are refunded. The site states guests can write 1 lyric draft a day, signed-in members 3, and plans 20 to 200.

name: Flying Broom AI
tagline: One photo. One magical flight. AI broomstick video generator.
description: Flying Broom AI (flyingbroomai.com) is an AI video generator that turns one photo into a short broomstick-flight video. Users add a clear photo of one person or pet (JPG, PNG, or WebP, up to 10 MB), choose a prepared scene, and review its duration and 10-credit cost before creating. Homepage examples include Street flight (6 seconds, 720p), Beside the car (6 seconds, 720p), and Police stop (11 seconds, 720p). After creation, the video can be watched and downloaded as an MP4. Official pricing is one-time USD credit packs; credits never expire, and failed renders are refunded in credits. Sign-in is required to use credits and create a video.

name: Hit the Road Dude AI
tagline: One photo. Your private property. AI meme video generator.
description: Hit the Road Dude AI (hittheroaddudeai.video) is an AI video generator for the "Hit the Road Dude" private-property meme. Users choose a setting, upload a character photo they own or have permission to use, and create an 11-second 720p video that keeps the attitude and original English audio. Scene options on the homepage include keeping the reference scene, Classic pickup, Block-world boat, Moon-base rover, and Fantasy castle gate. Each video uses 10 credits. The official pricing page lists one-time USD credit packs; credits never expire, and failed renders are refunded in credits. Watching the example and previewing a photo does not require an account; creating a video and buying credits requires sign-in.

name: Ozil AI
tagline: AI football goal video generator from one photo
description: Ozil AI (ozilai.app) is an AI football goal video generator. Users upload a JPG, PNG, or WebP photo up to 10 MB and become the scorer in a famous goal sequence, then preview and download a vertical 9:16 720p MP4. The shorter format is 5 seconds at 720p for 5 credits; the standard clip is 15 seconds at 720p, 24 fps, for 10 credits. Official pricing is one-time USD credit packs, and credits never expire. Sign-in is required to check the balance, buy a pack, and create a video.

name: Astrocartography Chart
tagline: Free astrocartography chart calculator, no sign-up
description: Astrocartography Chart (astrocartographychart.net) is a free astrocartography calculator. Users enter a birth date, time, and birthplace to generate a world map of planetary lines and explore guides for interpreting those lines and comparing locations. The homepage states that no sign-up is required, and that the map and planetary lines can be generated without paying. Full reports and PDF downloads are offered through the report option in the chart results. The calculator is a starting point for exploring location themes; it does not replace personal judgment or professional advice.

name: Nano Banana
tagline: AI image generation and editing with Nano Banana 2.1 and 40+ models
description: Nano Banana is an AI image generation and editing platform with Nano Banana 2.1 and 40+ image/video models—text to image, photo editing, and video—in one generator. nanobanana0.com lets you type a prompt or drop in a photo to create and edit images with models from Google, OpenAI, ByteDance, Kling, and more. Failed outputs are refunded; commercial use is supported on paid plans. Not affiliated with Google.

name: YuE2 Music
tagline: AI music creation with a score-first workflow
description: YuE2 Music is an AI music studio that lets you inspect and edit a symbolic score before synthesizing audio. Exports include ABC, MIDI note tracks, MusicXML and FLAC. Pricing is freemium: 20 signup credits, valid 7 days; paid credit packs and optional subscriptions. There are no separated audio stems.

name: ProductViews
tagline: Turn one product photo into catalog angles and short video ads
description: ProductViews is an AI ecommerce visual studio that generates additional camera angles, batch SKU-normalized assets, and 10-second video ads from a single product photo.

name: 114Ya
tagline: Free, privacy-first image compressor that runs entirely in your browser
description: 114Ya is a free image compressor that runs 100% locally in your browser. No upload, no account, no watermark, unlimited use. JPG, PNG and WebP are re-encoded with WASM engines (MozJPEG, libimagequant, oxipng) and EXIF/GPS metadata is stripped. Available in 14 languages.

name: Broken Defaults
tagline: Curated interactive, weird and experimental websites with case notes
description: Broken Defaults is a free discovery and research site for interactive, weird, experimental and creatively useful websites. Browse focused collections, search the catalog or use a surprise link, then read evidence-linked case notes about what each project does and why its mechanism is interesting. Candidate patterns and project ideas are research notes, not endorsements or rankings. No account needed.

name: SpriteAI
tagline: Create, edit and export game sprite sheets in your browser
description: Generate game sprite sheets from a prompt or reference image. Preview and edit frames, then export PNG, GIF or JSON. Free tools convert GIFs or video clips to sheets and split grids into individual PNGs. SpriteAI is built for game developers and artists who need reusable character animations. Start with an image or a written prompt and create different actions for a character. The three conversion tools run on your device, without uploading the source file or requiring an account.

name: ZekaChat
tagline: Free Turkish and Persian AI chat assistant
description: ZekaChat is an AI chat assistant with Turkish, Persian and English language choices for writing, coding and learning. A no-signup mode is available.

name: SCAIL-2
tagline: Transfer motion from a reference video to character images
description: SCAIL-2 is an AI character motion-control studio that transfers movement from a reference video to one or more character images, with virtual camera controls and a template library.

name: ImageToVector
tagline: Convert PNG and JPG images to clean, editable SVG paths
description: ImageToVector traces PNG, JPG or WebP logos, icons, line art and illustrations into editable SVG in the browser. Three conversions a day are available without an account, up to 2000 px. Photographs and soft gradients are a poor fit. This is a tracer, not a generative AI vectorizer.

name: TrueGrid Graph Paper
tagline: Free printable graph paper PDFs for A4 & Letter
description: TrueGrid offers free printable paper templates as vector PDFs for A4 and US Letter, with no sign-up and no watermark on the grid. Ready-made sheets cover graph paper in several square sizes, dot grid, isometric, hex, coordinate plane, engineering, millimeter, lined, polar and logarithmic paper. A free in-browser generator lets you set the pattern, spacing, paper size, orientation, line weight, colour, margins and page count. Free for personal and classroom use.

name: Santa in House
tagline: Photo-based Santa scenes with a home-camera look, bought by credit pack.
description: Use a vacant-home photograph to give an invented Santa visit a recognizable setting. Santa in House turns the picture into eight seconds of landscape video with sound or into one still image, choosing among porch-door, yard-facing-house and room night-vision looks. Standard output is 480p and HD is 720p. The smallest credit purchase is $1.99 for a photo; Standard video starts at $5.99. Balances remain valid without a renewal, and the site states that photos are removed within a day.

name: PDF Quiz Desk
tagline: AI Quiz Generator from PDF – Questions & Answer Keys
description: PDF Quiz Desk helps teachers, tutors and trainers turn a text-based PDF (handouts, readings, textbook chapters) into an editable quiz draft. Choose a page range in the file's page order (not printed textbook labels), pick a template (Quick check, Chapter test, Reading comprehension, Vocabulary check, Exit ticket, or Training knowledge check), set Easy/Medium/Hard difficulty, and choose Single choice, Multiple select, True/False and Short answer questions. Review quoted source evidence, edit the draft, then export a student worksheet (questions only) and a separate teacher answer key as PDF or Word, Letter or A4. It does not collect student responses or issue certifications. AI-generated answers need teacher review before use. Upload only materials you are authorized to use. Freemium: 2 free trials, 5 questions each, no sign-in required.

name: Active Order
tagline: Launch your Arabic online store with no monthly fees
description: Arabic-first no-code ecommerce store builder for online merchants. Create a mobile-friendly store with customizable templates, manage orders, products, inventory, coupons, shipping settings, marketing pixels and analytics. Free signup, no monthly subscription. Launch promotion first 50 orders free of order fees, afterwards EGP 2/order, with wallet terms published on https://activetecno.software/pricing

name: IMTools — Free Online Tools IMTools (imtools.my.id)
tagline: Qr Code Generator
description:
IMTools — Free Online Tools
