Indonesian: image compressor, image resizer, QR code generator, word
counter, password generator, parcel tracking, prayer times, crypto
converter and more. No sign-up, works right in the browser.

name: Redvers Digital — Agent Skill Packs Starter Bundle
tagline: Five installable agent skills for Cursor and Claude. Early bird HK$229.
description: Redvers Digital’s Starter Bundle is five ready-made agent skills (each a SKILL.md plus a short install note) for people who build with Cursor-style skills and Claude Projects. The pack covers PR Reviewer (verdict-first reviews), Email Triage (Today / This week / Waiting / Noise), Meeting → Actions (owners and deadlines, no invented assignees), Debugging (reproduce → isolate → fix → verify), and Landing Page Copy (hero, sections, and CTAs from a real offer). One-time purchase, early bird HK$229, with email delivery after Stripe checkout.

name: Lorem Picsum
tagline: Get a real placeholder photo at the size you need
description: Lorem Picsum is a free random image generator and API. Choose a size, preview the crop, then copy a link or download a CC0 photo in JPEG or WebP—no sign-in or key. Independently operated and inspired by the open-source Picsum Photos project, with its own photo collection and IDs. AI image/video tools are freemium with one-time packs from $9.9, no subscriptions.

name: RankHush Tools
tagline: Free browser tools for images, QR codes, and developer tasks
description: RankHush Tools offers 14 free browser tools. Compress or convert images, remove backgrounds, mute videos, create and scan QR codes, and format JSON. Tool inputs are processed in your browser, and no account is required.

name: TradeKit
tagline: HS code lookup and export compliance guide for traders
description: Free HS code lookup and export compliance reference for importers and exporters. Search harmonized system codes by product keyword, check chapter and heading structure, and read practical guidance on classification and export documentation.

name: CodeMechanic
tagline: Forklift and construction machinery fault code lookup - 1,015 codes
description: Free fault code reference for forklifts and construction machinery. Search 1,015 diagnostic trouble codes by brand, model and code, with meaning, possible causes and repair guidance for mechanics and fleet operators.

name: ImgLoop
tagline: Edit, restore, and generate photos in your browser
description: ImgLoop is an online AI photo editor. Upload a photo, describe an edit or restoration, check the credit cost, and compare the result with your source. Local canvas tools (crop, rotate, brush, eraser, text) use no credits. Freemium: guest credits and daily sign-in rewards; monthly plans from $14.99; one-time credit packs from $4.99.

name: Get Your AI Rap Videos
tagline: Turn photos of people or pets into AI rap videos
description: AI Rap Video is an online AI rap video generator that turns photos of two people or pets into a rap performance with music and synced vocals. Start with a photo together or two individual portraits. Upload your own background or choose a preset scene. Let AI create a surprise rap, share an idea to guide the performance, or add your own lyrics. Choose your video length, quality, and aspect ratio, then generate and preview the result. Finished videos are saved to My Videos and can be downloaded as watermark-free MP4 files to share. Create personalized birthday raps, videos with friends, and short clips for social media without writing a detailed prompt. AI Rap Video uses one-time credit packs starting at $8.99 with no subscription. Credit usage depends on video length and quality, and the total is shown before generation.

name: Stela Writing Studio
tagline: Manuscripts, novels, and screenplays in one desktop studio, with optional BYOK AI and local MCP.
description:
Stela Writing Studio brings manuscripts, novels, and screenplays into one desktop app for Windows and macOS. Organize chapters and scenes, keep planning beside the draft, compile DOCX or book PDFs, and use Fountain, FDX, and paginated screenplay PDF workflows.

Drafts stay in local files with autosave, crash recovery, and save points. The optional Writing Assistant supports your own Gemini, OpenAI, or Anthropic API key, and you review suggested edits. A bundled opt-in local MCP server lets compatible agents work in approved writing workspaces with read-only or write permissions that can be paused or revoked. Stela must be running.

Free during beta; optional AI provider or agent-service charges may apply.

name: Nopturnia Countdown
tagline: Free shareable countdown links with a sealed surprise reveal at zero.
description: Nopturnia Countdown (https://nopturnia.com/tools/countdown): make a countdown to anything - a launch, a wedding, a book release - and share it as a short link. Every viewer sees a live ticking timer in their own time zone. A message or link you seal inside stays genuinely hidden (not in the page source) until the clock hits zero, when the page flips live with confetti and the reveal. Free, no account. Submitted by the makers, Indroid Studio.

name: Loreform
tagline: Turn a sentence or sketch into a printable tabletop miniature
description: Loreform is a mini maker for D&D, Pathfinder and Warhammer players. Type a description or upload a reference image, refine the result with AI edits, and export STL files prepared for FDM and resin printers with pre-built supports. Plans from $19.99/mo; new accounts get 20 starter credits for 7 days.

name: ExcelErrorFinder
tagline: Free browser-based Excel auditor that finds formula errors, hidden sheets and broken links — no signup, files never leave your browser.
description: ExcelErrorFinder is a free browser-based Excel spreadsheet auditor. It finds formula errors (#REF! and more), hidden and very-hidden sheets, broken external links, hardcoded values, division without IFERROR, hidden rows and columns, volatile functions, and deeply nested IFs. 100% free with no signup — your files stay in your browser and 0 bytes are uploaded. It also includes 25 free Excel tools and 74 Excel templates (8 free).

name: Picture Editor
tagline: Free online photo editor: crop, resize, compress, convert and enhance pictures
description: Picture Editor is a free online photo editor with 30+ tools to crop, resize, compress, convert and enhance pictures. Everything runs in your browser, so it's fast and private, with no sign-up needed.

name: HubIQ
tagline: Connected intelligence and margin analytics for staffing agencies
description: HubIQ is a connected intelligence platform for staffing agencies, headquartered in San Francisco. It connects to the ATS an agency already runs and brings orders, talent, risk and gross profit into one clear view, so leaders see true profitability by client, branch and recruiter after real costs such as claims and unbilled pay. Modules include HubAI, Risk, Smart Drive, Contracts, CRM, Legal and Finance. HubIQ is typically live in two to three weeks.

name: MyStore99
tagline: Shop more, spend less.
description: Free iPhone shopping app with $1 Mega Finds, daily deals and flash sales across fashion, electronics, home & kitchen, beauty, toys, jewelry and more. iOS only. Download on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/pk/app/mystore99/id6783310832

name: Cat Village
tagline: Build better habits. Collect cute cats.
description: Cat Village is a cute, gamified habit tracker. Set a 7-day goal, check in daily, and unlock a collectible cat each time you show up. Your village grows as you do. Free to play, no account needed.

name: Newly Startup
tagline: Your Curiosity Deserves a Better Radar
description: Newly Startup is a discovery and launch directory for new SaaS products, startups, AI tools and websites. Visitors can browse recently launched digital products by category, and founders can submit their own product for review and possible inclusion.

name: Locke by Sonomos
tagline: Privacy everywhere you use AI.
description: Keep sensitive information out of your AI conversations. Locke detects and masks private data on your device before it reaches supported AI tools, across browser, desktop and terminal workflows. Keep using the tools you already rely on, with your sensitive details protected before you hit send.

name: Free Online Convert
tagline: 393 free online converters, calculators and generators
description: Free Online Convert is a free online toolbox with 393 converters, calculators and generators in one place. Convert files and units, run everyday calculations — BMI, VAT, percentages, age, interest — work with colours and text, and use creator tools for TikTok, YouTube and social media. Every tool is free with no sign-up, and files are processed in your browser rather than uploaded, so nothing you convert is stored on a server. One site instead of a dozen single-purpose tools.

name: NotchLive
tagline: Live captions and dictation for Mac with on-device speech recognition
description: NotchLive provides live captions for system audio and microphone input on Mac without adding a meeting bot. Captions and dictation are free. A one-time Pro upgrade adds translation and audio/video file transcription. It works on Macs with or without a notch. Requires macOS 14 or later; translation requires macOS 15 or later.

name: Freelance Rate Calculator
tagline: Free freelance rate calculator — work out the hourly rate you need to charge. No signup, runs in your browser.
description: A free tool from Practical Templates that works out the hourly rate a freelancer actually needs to charge. Enter your target salary, business expenses, tax loading, time off and billable share, and it gives you the revenue you need, your break-even and target hourly rates, a day rate, project quotes with a project minimum, and a reality check on the rate you charge today. Home to 11 free freelance calculators in total — Etsy fees, offer comparison, invoice and late fees, tax estimator, hourly-to-salary, day rate, project profitability, retainer vs hourly, break-even and rate increase. Runs entirely in your browser — no signup, nothing uploaded.

name: WarpTool
tagline: 260 free tools that run 100% in your browser. No uploads.
description: WarpTool is a free toolbox of 260 browser-based utilities for developers, marketers and creators. Format and convert JSON, XML, YAML and CSS, compress and convert images in bulk, build UTM links, and generate meta tags and schema. Nothing is uploaded, there's no sign-up, and it works offline.

name: Tufton
tagline: Canceled lessons. Clear family balances.
description: Tufton helps small multi-teacher music schools reconcile prepaid tuition alongside the spreadsheets and school tools they already use. Try the free adjustable fictional calculation at https://tufton.brainer.one/: change the canceled lesson amount and rule inputs, see the reason for the tuition credit and closing balance, and download the current illustrative summary as a .txt file without an account. Adjusted inputs stay in your browser and do not carry into a workspace. In the signed-in product, owners can upload fictional or fully anonymized attendance, payments and opening balances as CSV/XLSX, review source-linked adjustments, and download approved balance CSVs and individual family PDF statements. The planned price is USD 19 per school per month; checkout and the planned 14-day trial are not open. Real personal-data uploads await approved terms.

name: Spreadsheet to App
tagline: Build web apps with AI. Keep your data in Google Sheets.
description: Spreadsheet to App turns Excel, CSV, or Google Sheets into hosted web apps with AI. Describe your workflow in plain language, refine the generated interface in Studio, inspect the code, test a private preview, and publish. Business records stay in Google Sheets. Uploaded files are imported into Google Sheets in your account; existing sheets connect directly. Use it for inventory tracking, customer lists, dashboards, and internal tools.

name: Craft Fair Profit Calculator
tagline: Free vendor booth break-even calculator for craft fairs and holiday markets
description: Free craft fair profit calculator and vendor booth break-even calculator. Enter booth and application fees, travel, mileage, hours, materials margin, card fees, and expected traffic to see break-even sales, sales needed to pay yourself, and a worth-it / skip verdict. Runs in the browser with no account.

name: SumHatch
tagline: Free math and finance calculators with worked examples.
description: SumHatch offers free browser-based tools for math learning and everyday finance estimates. SumHatch Math plots functions with parameter controls, tables of values, and worked examples. SumHatch Finance provides calculators for SIP, loan and EMI, fixed deposits, savings, and compound interest for India and the US. Assumptions are explained and no account is required.

name: Test Print Page
tagline: Free printer test pages matched to your symptom
description: Test Print Page is a free, brand-neutral printer test page utility built by Derek Roga at Essence Technologies in Vilnius, Lithuania. It gives you five printable test sheets, Quick, Color, Black and White, CMYK and Alignment, each matched to a symptom, as PDFs in A4 and US Letter. Print at 100 percent (Actual Size) and compare the sheet against the on-screen reference to pinpoint whether the problem is a clogged nozzle, low ink, wrong colour settings or misalignment. It also includes symptom-based troubleshooting guidance for HP, Canon, Epson, Brother and other printers. Free, no account, no uploads, no install.

name: Reformer Connect
tagline: Connect Pilates equipment owners with UK service specialists
description: Reformer Connect is a UK introduction and equipment-care platform for Pilates studios, instructors, equipment owners and service engineers. Customers organise equipment information, submit repair, servicing or assembly enquiries, compare specialist quotations and choose whom to appoint. Engineers maintain their skills and coverage profiles and review suitable opportunities. Customer enquiries are free; physical engineering work, equipment and any applicable engineer commission are separate. Reformer Connect connects customers with specialists; it is not the attending engineer or a Pilates studio. Its Android app has a public Google Play listing and uses existing customer or engineer accounts.

name: Heel & Home
tagline: Find local UK dog services, practical advice and dog-day tools
description: Heel & Home is a UK dog-services directory and practical dog-care resource. Its web platform helps owners find relevant local providers, browse activities and local guides, use dog-day tools and save useful information. Directory browsing and the published guidance are free to access. Services and products are supplied and priced by the listed providers or retailers. Heel & Home is an online directory and resource, not a trainer, groomer or veterinary practice. It is operated by Flying Penguin AI Limited.

name: KStream
tagline: Free web app for discovering movies, television, and anime. KStream helps visitors browse titles and follow available streaming links.
description: KStream is a free web app for discovering movies, television, and anime. Browse a large catalog and follow available streaming links from one place.

name: AP Stats Calculator
tagline: Free online AP Statistics calculators with step-by-step explanations for students and teachers.
description: AP Stats Calculator is a free online collection of AP Statistics calculators — binomial distribution, chi-square, normal distribution, t-test, z-score, p-value, confidence intervals, regression, margin of error and more — each with step-by-step explanations, built for AP Statistics students and teachers.

name: Calcul Volume
tagline: Free volume calculators in French and 18 other languages.
description: Calcul Volume is a free online collection of volume calculators — cube, cylinder, sphere, cone, concrete, swimming pool, pipe and more — available in French first and 18 other languages, with formulas and step-by-step results for students, builders and DIYers.

name: ZapVid
tagline: Make playful AI videos of yourself from trending templates.
description: ZapVid lets you pick a trending AI video template, upload your photo, and generate a playful AI video featuring yourself. The service is paid: buy credit packs or choose a monthly plan. See https://zapvid.ai/pricing.

name: Valmera
tagline: Edit your recorded footage by describing the cut
description: Valmera is an AI video editor for creators editing their own footage. Describe the cut you want, review the preview, ask for a change and export the finished MP4. Work in Valmera Studio or connect a compatible AI assistant through MCP.

name: TikTok Song Finder
tagline: Find Music from a Public TikTok Link
description: Song identifier for public TikTok videos: paste a link to get the song title, artist and listening links when matched. TikTok Song Finder looks up the music in a video from its link. Only a successful match uses a credit. Edited audio and music outside the recognition catalog may not match.

name: Stories Download
tagline: Instagram Story Downloader — Free, No Login, HD Quality
description: Instagram Story Downloader to save public Stories, highlights, Reels, and posts in HD. Free, no login, no watermark — paste a link and download. Public Reels and posts usually work; Stories and highlights are often behind a sign-in, and this site never logs in. Not affiliated with Instagram or Meta.

name: ReeLoop
tagline: Draft and review YouTube titles, descriptions and tags for existing videos.
description: ReeLoop helps YouTube creators research keywords and draft metadata for videos already on their connected channel. Review and edit the proposed title, description and tags before choosing to apply changes. For eligible Shorts, a connected professional Instagram Business or Creator account and authorization are required to post a Reel.

name: Images26
tagline: Images26 is a GPT Image 2.6 generator and editor—create or edit with Flare and Sunburst, see the credit price up front, and download PNG or WebP.
description: Images26 (images26.org) is an independent GPT Image 2.6 workspace, not affiliated with OpenAI, for text-to-image and image editing with the Flare and Sunburst model variants. Describe a prompt to create, or choose Edit an image and upload up to four PNG, JPEG, or WebP references to describe the changes. Every plan includes generation, reference editing, transparent backgrounds, and PNG plus WebP downloads. Credit cost depends on the model, image size and quality; the quote is shown before you create, and confirmed failed generations return the credits charged (not an automatic cash refund). One-time credit packs stay valid for 365 days (Starter 350 credits at $29.90, then Creator, Studio, Max, and Agency). Monthly and yearly subscriptions issue a monthly allowance that does not roll over; annual plans charge the year upfront and can save up to 50% versus monthly billing, with the largest stated saving on the Pro plan at 600 credits per month for $174 per year. Welcome credits, if any, depend on current account settings. Only upload images you have permission to use, and review outputs before publishing. Directory listings: Free, support@images26.org.

name: HowMuchToConstruct
tagline: Instant per-square-metre residential construction cost estimates across Australia.
description: HowMuchToConstruct breaks down Australian residential building costs from slab to lockup and turnkey finish across single-storey, double-storey, and custom homes. (ABN 58 612 928 284)

name: KDRCost
tagline: Compare knockdown-rebuild costs, demolition fees, and site works across Australia.
description: KDRCost helps Australian homeowners calculate demolition, asbestos removal, site connections, and new-build costs when replacing an older house with a modern custom home. (ABN 58 612 928 284)

name: DuplexCost
tagline: Calculate side-by-side and dual-occupancy duplex construction costs in Australia.
description: DuplexCost helps Australian property investors and homeowners estimate duplex design, fire-wall construction, strata titling, and rental/sale feasibility. (ABN 58 612 928 284)

name: Gestione Paghe
tagline: Distribute payslips and Certificazioni Uniche with a secure email link — no payroll calculation.
description: Gestione Paghe distributes payslips and annual tax certificates (Certificazioni Uniche) to employees: you upload a single combined PDF and each employee receives a secure email link to download their own document, with open and download tracking. It costs €9 per month or €99 per year per company, with a 30-day free trial. It does not calculate payroll: it distributes it.

name: Giant Cat AI
tagline: Turn one cat photo into a giant cat video set in New York.
description: Giant Cat AI turns one clear cat photo into a 10-second video of your cat towering over a New York street. No prompt is required: upload a photo, preview it, and use the preset scene. Download the finished clip as a 720p vertical MP4 (9:16). The public sample was generated with Kling 4.0. You can watch it for free; generating a video uses one-time credit packs starting at $9.90, with no subscription.

name: ScanMyDocz
tagline: PDF and document tools with clear browser and server processing labels
description: ScanMyDocz offers 33 tools for compressing, merging, splitting, converting, signing and scanning documents. Each tool explains whether the selected file stays in your browser or goes to a server. Most browser tools are free; paid plans cover selected limits and server processing.

name: FastBillGen
tagline: Free invoice and billing tools for freelancers and small firms
description: Create invoices, receipts, quotations and estimates in your browser without an account or watermark. FastBillGen offers 24 generators, calculators and templates. An optional paid workspace stores records for people who need that workflow.

name: OffLadder CV
tagline: Know which jobs are worth it.
description: OffLadder CV is a desktop Chrome extension, free to try, that helps you know which jobs are worth it. Checking a job needs no account. It shows the job's must-haves against your CV, and lists the nice-to-haves without counting them. When it tailors your CV, it won't add experience you don't have. It can fill application forms on tested systems including Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and Workday, and it never submits for you: you review and submit every application yourself. Membership is $9 a month or $79 a year.

name: Sello.club

Markdown takes caller-supplied HTML and never fetches URLs. The scan is a heuristic checklist of supplied site materials, not a prediction of rankings, citations or traffic. tagline: Learn languages by reading books you love
description:
Eppika is a language learning app for adults who want to move beyond repetitive drills and start understanding complete stories.

Learners can explore 3,000+ adapted books across 17 languages, with content for different proficiency levels. Read or listen with native audio narration, tap unfamiliar words for instant translation and pronunciation, save new vocabulary, and review it later with flashcards.

Eppika combines reading, listening, translation, and vocabulary practice in one experience, helping learners develop language skills in context rather than through isolated exercises. The library includes classics, fiction, and adapted nonfiction titles.

Eppika is available on iOS and Android and is used by 100K learners, with a 4.8-star rating from 15,000+ reviews.

name: Cross-Stitch Studio
tagline: Turn your photos into editable cross-stitch patterns
description: Turn a photo of your pet, a favorite place, or an illustration into an editable cross-stitch chart. Choose a stitch count and a DMC palette, then preview the result on fabric. Direct photo conversion and the guest editor are free. Optional AI photo preparation and printable PDFs use paid credits. Available in English and French.

name: Unlock with Fitness
tagline: Turn screen time into fitness time
description:
Unlock with Fitness is an app blocker for iPhone and Android. Distracting apps stay locked until you hit daily movement goals. Free includes steps, active minutes and calories, each with your own target, plus Apple Health and Google Health Connect. When today's goals are done, your apps open again; tomorrow you earn them again. Pro is a one-time upgrade, not a subscription: more health goals, day and time-of-day targets, and streak trophies (1 trophy = a 5-minute unlock, up to 3 a day).
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/unlock-with-fitness-app-block/id6774741283
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.unlockwithfitness

name: FreeLogoGen
tagline: FreeLogoGen — Free Logo Maker & Brand Kit Generator
description: Design a professional logo in minutes. Free online logo maker with 60+ vector icons, 12 premium fonts, instant PNG & SVG export — no signup, no watermark.

name: Famed
tagline: Get famed by AI.
description: Famed shows local businesses how often ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI, Perplexity, Claude and Grok recommend them, and fixes what holds them back. Free AI check.

name: Letras Diferentes
tagline: Gerador de letras diferentes e bonitas para copiar e colar
description: Letras Diferentes is a free, in-browser generator that turns plain text into Unicode styles (bold, cursive, gothic, bubbles, small text and more) you can copy and paste anywhere. Built for Portuguese speakers: it keeps accents like ç, ã and é in the same style, shows a character counter for Instagram bio, Free Fire nick, TikTok, Discord and WhatsApp limits, and includes a symbol keyboard. No signup, no install.

name: Tangram Daily
tagline: A free daily tangram puzzle. One shape a day, the same for everyone.
description: Tangram Daily is a free daily tangram puzzle in your browser. Every day there is one new silhouette, the same for everyone. Fit the seven classic tangram pieces into it with no gaps or overlaps, and the shape comes to life as a little creature. Earn stars, keep a streak, and collect creatures in your zoo. No account, no ads, works on phone and desktop. Launched 12 Nov 2026.

name: AIVideoFree
tagline: Free AI Video Generator with No Restrictions
description: Make AI videos free with Veo, Kling, Seedance and more. Text or image to video, no watermark, credits that never expire, commercial use. No card required.

name: Grease Pencil Co.
tagline: Free reseller fee & profit calculators plus simple profit-tracking spreadsheets for flippers
description: Grease Pencil Co. makes plain, no-signup tools for resellers and side hustlers. Free in-browser calculators cover eBay and Poshmark/Mercari fees, reseller profit, max buy price and sell-through rate. The paid Flip Profit Tracker ($9.99, Google Sheets/Excel) logs every buy and sale and totals your profit and ROI per item. No subscription, no account.

name: Remove BG Video
tagline: AI video background remover in the browser
description: Remove BG Video is a browser AI tool that removes or replaces video backgrounds. Download one processed 5-second WebM free; credits cover longer clips.

name: Live Face Swap
tagline: Real-time AI face swap on your webcam, in the browser
description: A browser tool for real-time webcam AI looks. Choose a gallery reference or a portrait you have permission to use; preview live in your browser. Try 20 seconds free as a guest.

name: RepMaxLab
tagline: Free One Rep Max Calculator — 6 Formulas
description: RepMaxLab is a free one rep max calculator that compares six proven formulas (Epley, Brzycki, Lombardi, Mayhew, O'Conner and Wathan) and shows your training percentages and training max. It also includes free DOTS, Wilks and RPE calculators and strength standards. No sign-up, works on any device.

name: MorseHub
tagline: Free Morse Code Translator with Audio
description: MorseHub is a free online Morse code translator. Type text to get Morse code, or decode dots and dashes back to text — with sound playback, speed control and a light-flash mode. It also includes a full Morse code alphabet chart, an SOS guide and guides for learning Morse code. No sign-up, works on any device.

name: Photo Retouch Ease
tagline: Natural AI photo retouching, never overdone
description: Photo Retouch Ease is a browser AI workspace for portrait touch-ups, object cleanup and old-photo restoration. Guests can try one basic edit without signing in; one-time credit packs are available for further edits.

name: roTEAMnet
tagline: Find global jobs and build a CV from facts you confirm
description: roTEAMnet is a career workspace for job seekers exploring worldwide, remote, part-time and flexible opportunities. Browse jobs and open original application links for free. Create a free account to save opportunities, set up alerts and organize applications. Free browser tools check the text extracted from a CV PDF and compare posting words. Optional AI workflows review a CV, compare job requirements with your experience and prepare tailored CV drafts from facts you confirm. A verified free account includes 15 initial AI credits; paid plans and top-ups support further AI work, with costs shown before use. The interface is available in English, German, French, Romanian, Dutch, Italian and Spanish. A remote MCP connector supports compatible AI clients with scoped OAuth access.

name: Wasim Free Tools
tagline: 50 free browser tools — converters, calculators, PDF and text tools, no signup needed.
description: Wasim Free Tools is a free collection of 50 browser tools that run entirely in your browser, including Word Counter, Password Generator, Image Compressor, Currency Converter, BMI Calculator and Handmade Pricing Calculator. No signup needed, free forever, and it works on mobile and desktop.

name: Countdown
tagline: Free online countdown timers for durations and future dates
description:
Countdown is an online timer for a duration or a future date and time. Use it to follow the moments you look forward to, from a holiday or New Year to a personal anniversary, or set a shorter timer for an everyday task. The remaining time is shown in a clear display that can be opened fullscreen.

Choose a quick timer or open the settings to enter your own duration or deadline. Add a message, choose a theme and enable a sound reminder. Pause, resume or restart a duration timer, and add separate countdowns when you want to keep more than one event in view.

Holiday pages offer ready-made countdowns for familiar dates, while custom settings handle your own occasions. Countdown is useful on a desk, a shared screen or during a small celebration when you want everyone to see how much time remains.

name: Vellivex
tagline: Try 11 experimental privacy tools for web and Android
description: Vellivex is an experimental suite of 11 privacy tools for web and Android. Start with a fictional VVault note, save the encrypted file, and reopen it to check the round trip. The hosted tools use email-code sign-in and are unaudited. The testing page welcomes candid workflow feedback. There is no purchase or public review requirement.

name: HIVE402
tagline: Discover pay-per-call APIs for AI agents.
description: HIVE402 by Script Master Labs helps agents discover and inspect x402 API offers before paying. Sellers can list endpoints for free, and developers can browse offers on the web or connect through a remote MCP server.

name: Tolvix
tagline: 77+ Free Online Tools for PDFs, Images, Calculations and Productivity
description:
Tolvix is a free online toolkit designed for students, professionals, developers and creators. It offers 77+ useful tools in one place, including PDF merging and splitting, image compression and conversion, QR code generation, calculators, text utilities, SEO tools and physics calculators.

No software installation is required. Simply open a tool in your browser and get things done quickly. Our goal is to make everyday digital tasks easier, faster and accessible to everyone.

name: Fierro Fitness
tagline: Writes your 12-week lifting plan and logs every set
description: Fierro Fitness is a bilingual (English/Spanish) 12-week workout log. It writes your lifting plan, lets you log every set, and sets your daily protein and calorie targets. Built for gym-goers who want a clear training block in one place — no spreadsheet required. 100% free.

name: Workavelle
tagline: Find UK event caterers and request quotes
description: Workavelle is a UK-wide online catering marketplace for weddings, private celebrations and corporate events. Organisers share an event brief and can receive quotes from suitable caterers. Caterers, private chefs and food trucks can join free during launch and choose which requests to quote for. Customers and caterers agree the booking directly.

name: AI photo checker
tagline: Detect AI-generated images instantly, free.
description: AI Picture Checker is a free browser tool that analyzes an uploaded image to estimate whether it was generated by AI. It can flag likely AI images, identify common source models such as Midjourney, DALL·E, Stable Diffusion, Flux, and Gemini, and check for deepfakes.

name: Wander Cambodia
tagline: Free Cambodia travel guide and blog — Phnom Penh, Siem Reap, Angkor Wat, islands, visas, costs and itineraries.
description: Wander Cambodia is a free Cambodia travel guide and blog founded in October 2026 by Sigma Design LLC. Plan your trip with guides to Phnom Penh, Siem Reap and Angkor Wat, the islands, visas, costs and itineraries.

name: NextReset
tagline: Independent Codex reset tracker
description: NextReset monitors public OpenAI Codex reset announcements and presents clearly labelled current status and forecast information for developers.

name: TellMeFirst
tagline: Event updates in Apple and Google Wallet.
description: Create an event page and share its link. People save a pass in Apple or Google Wallet to receive relevant updates without a TellMeFirst account or separate app. Wallet updates are free. An optional EUR 9 upgrade per event, plus applicable VAT, adds email subscriptions, custom branding and website embeds. The first event upgrade is free per account. Publish up to three updates in any rolling 24 hours; notification arrival depends on device settings.

name: Lalawe
tagline: Things to do in Toronto and the GTA this weekend, updated daily
description: Lalawe lists things to do in Toronto and the GTA this weekend: events, festivals, markets and family activities, updated daily so locals and visitors can plan quickly.

name: USA Intelligence
tagline: Ask anything about America — sourced answers, no account
description: USA Intelligence is an independent AI information service. Ask questions about U.S. government, public services, civics, and history — every answer links to official sources. No account, nothing saved. Includes a directory of 31,874 verified government sites.

name: Create Image
tagline: A browser workspace to create AI images and videos from text prompts.
description:
Create Image is a browser-based workspace for turning a written idea, and optionally a reference image, into still images or short videos.

In the workspace you choose image or video, write a prompt, and, when the selected model supports it, upload a reference image you have permission to use. The site shows the currently available models and the settings for that model �ü such as aspect ratio or video length �ü before you submit. It also shows the credit cost for that generation.

Create Image currently sells monthly plans billed in credits: Starter at $9.99 for 100 credits, Creator at $19.99 for 300 credits, and Pro at $49.99 for 1,000 credits, as listed on the pricing page on 14 November 2026.

name: Sheru Bhai AI
tagline: Turn your photo into a lion-boss portrait or video
description: Sheru Bhai AI is an independent AI photo and video generator for fictional lion-boss scenes: turn your photo or a short prompt into a white-lion portrait or a 5–10 second Reels-ready video, with optional Hindi, Hinglish or Urdu dialogue.

name: Linnk AI
tagline: The AI workspace for global documents.
description: AI document translator & summarizer for 50+ formats. Read PDFs, contracts, and slides in 154 languages & dialects, layout intact. Free preview, no signup.

name: Large Trader AI
tagline: Conversational AI for financial-market research
description: Research stocks, US options, forex, crypto and penny stocks through conversational questions. Large Trader AI lets users explore companies, markets and trading ideas in a web interface. Freemium; AI-generated information is not investment advice.

name: FotoApta
tagline: Local document-photo editing and separate AI headshots
description: Maker disclosure: I maintain FotoApta. The free document-photo editor crops, sizes and prepares print sheets locally in the browser. Check the receiving organization’s requirements before changing a document photo. A separate English/Portuguese AI headshot workflow sends a selfie to external generation providers. It offers a free watermarked preview and an optional US$9.99 one-time pack of six HD portraits, without a subscription. AI can change facial details and the paid batch may differ from the preview. Generated portraits are for professional profiles, not passports or official ID; generated photos are kept up to seven days for order recovery.

name: AI选聘 (Looplood)
tagline: Organize selected resumes in your own Feishu Bitable
description: AI选聘 helps HR teams organize recruiter-selected information in their own Feishu Bitable for human review and collaboration. It supports visible profiles from supported recruiting websites, selected attachments in supported webmail, and local PDF, DOCX, PNG or JPG resumes. Annual plans are CNY 199 for email, CNY 299 for recruiting platforms and CNY 399 for the full plan. Three basic syncs are a trial and exclude AI analysis.

name: Campfire SMS
tagline: Let your AI agent text you
description: Campfire SMS gives your AI agent a phone line to you. When a long-running agent needs an answer, you get a real text and your plain-language reply goes back to the agent. Works over MCP. Free demo, then pay-as-you-go credit packs from $5.

name: Lifeskill Studio
tagline: Practice real conversations with live AI voice coaching
description: Practice interviews, meeting contributions and assertive conversations aloud with a live, topic-specific AI voice coach. Choose one skill and a real situation, rehearse in your browser, then review a saved recap and practical next step after a completed conversation. A paid introductory session covers one topic for up to 20 minutes, with no subscription required. Optional plans are available; see current local prices on the site. Adults 18+. AI coaches, not human professionals. Skills coaching, not therapy or mental-health care. No guaranteed outcomes.

name: Headcanon Generator
tagline: Brainstorm character details, relationships, and scene ideas for fanfiction and original stories.
description: Headcanon Generator gives fanfiction writers and original character creators a starting point when a character feels flat or a scene stalls. Use it to brainstorm character details, relationship dynamics, and scene prompts, then decide what fits your story. Writing guides and a character worksheet are free; AI generations use paid credits.

name: What Will My Baby Look Like AI
tagline: Upload two photos and see what your future baby could look like
description: What Will My Baby Look Like AI is a browser-based AI baby generator for couples. Upload one clear photo of each partner, choose a girl, boy, twins or a surprise, and the AI draws 2 pictures of a child mixing both faces. It is made for fun, not as a prediction. The first preview is free.

name: AIDEN
tagline: A macOS workspace for Claude Code and Codex agents
description: AIDEN is a desktop workspace for planning, building and reviewing software with Claude Code and Codex. It combines project boards, parallel coding agents, isolated Git worktrees, a code editor, terminals and browser previews. Available for macOS 12 and later on Apple Silicon and Intel. Developers use their existing Claude Code or Codex setup. The free plan includes one project, with paid plans for unlimited projects and team features.

name: OnARM.Net
tagline: Windows on Arm app & game compatibility
description: OnARM.Net answers one question: will your Windows software run on an Arm PC? We track compatibility for thousands of apps and games on devices such as Snapdragon X laptops, noting native Arm64 builds versus Prism x86/x64 emulation, and when each entry was last verified. Data is derived from the open-source Linaro works-on-woa project.

name: Duebell
tagline: Free daycare renewal checklist and saved location dashboard
description: Duebell helps independent daycare owners organize food-safety and staff-training renewals by location. Its free browser-only checklist brings together a location label, document type, owner-confirmed date and next action; print or download PDF, text or CSV without an account, or export real dates as a one-time calendar snapshot. The initial account dashboard saves locations and renewal records, supports private PDF/image source files, date sorting and filtering, completion or reopening of next actions, replacement renewal dates and CSV export. Billing is not enabled; $29 per location per month is a proposed price, not a currently purchasable plan, and initial dashboard access is not a free trial or a promise of ongoing free access. Owners confirm dates and applicable requirements themselves. Duebell does not verify legal compliance, extract dates automatically or send email/text reminders.

name: FN Power Hour
tagline: Plan Fortnite Treasure Hours in your time zone
description: FN Power Hour (fnpowerhour.com) is a free fan-made planner for Fortnite Treasure Hunters’ Treasure Hours — the Saturday sessions players often call Power Hour — in Battle Royale and Zero Build. Check session times in your city, add a calendar reminder, plan a chest or Sprite run, and use guides for Pirate Shop Access, Map Fragments, vault locations and chest rewards. A local chest tracker saves your manual log in the browser. There is no Epic login or reward-claim service.

name: Scrapewise
tagline: Turn ALL your competitors' pages into clean data.
description: Scrape, clean, match: ready data APIs and AI scrapers that end in a competitor price comparison. Pay as you go, 5 free requests. REST API, CSV, MCP.

name: Random Topic Generator
tagline: Free random topic generator for speaking practice
description: Free random topic generator, no sign-up. Draw 1, 3 or 5 topics to talk about in one click, then practice impromptu speaking with a 1-minute timer. Built for language learners, teachers and anyone who wants quick speaking or writing prompts.

name: MendPhoto
tagline: Focused AI photo repair for old and damaged pictures
description: MendPhoto offers online AI photo repair tools for fading, scratches, creases, noise and blur. Upload an image, review the before-and-after result and download the repair. Processing uses paid one-time credits.

name: MICGameBox
tagline: Free browser games across puzzle, racing and casual genres
description: MICGameBox is a free browser-game portal offering puzzle, racing, casual and card or board games. Visitors can browse game categories and play without downloading a separate application. The site has multilingual navigation and brings games from third-party providers into one place for quick play sessions.

name: Rapid Feedback
tagline: Google review requests from your own email
description: Rapid Feedback is a review request tool for local service businesses. After you've helped a customer, it sends them a short email from your own Gmail or Outlook address asking how it went. Everyone you ask gets your Google review link, and anyone who wasn't happy can also tell you privately, so you can make it right. 90-day free trial, no credit card. Five Star Local, the maker of Rapid Feedback, is based in Canada.

name: The Nooks
tagline: Public and invite-only communities without like or dislike counters
description: The Nooks is a free community platform from Greenlyz LLC for families, clubs, teams and people with shared interests. Create or join public Nooks, use private invite-only spaces, and share posts and replies without like or dislike counters. The core service is free on the web, with an Android app also available on Google Play. Marketplace, advertising campaign management and Nooks+ are marked coming soon in the current store listing.

name: AceStack AI
tagline: Practice technical interviews for your engineering role and level
description: AceStack AI helps frontend, backend, and full-stack engineers prepare for technical interviews. Choose a role-based path, practice HR and technical screening, algorithm and platform coding, and SQL cases. Save solutions, review your reasoning, and see what to practice next. Start free; Focus adds an AI Coach and behavioral practice.

name: Protocol Explorer
tagline: Watch the internet work, packet by packet
description: Protocol Explorer is a free interactive network simulator: watch HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, TLS, DNS and 35+ protocols in motion, with every packet decoded byte by byte. Animated lessons in 8 languages.

name: SpriteSkin
tagline: AI Minecraft skins from photos or text, plus a free browser skin editor
description: SpriteSkin helps Minecraft players create personalized skins from a photo or text prompt, preview them in 3D, and edit skins in the browser. It also offers free manual skin and cape tools. AI generation uses credits; paid options and download restrictions are shown on the site. Free promotional credits vary by region. SpriteSkin is an independent tool and is not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.

name: JellyMate
tagline: AI plush-style image and video generator for pets
description: JellyMate is an AI plush-style image and video generator. Turn pet photos into plush-style portraits and short videos. From $9/month with commercial use included. Not affiliated with Jellycat.

name: BrickGPT
tagline: AI brick-model instruction board and assembly video generator
description: BrickGPT turns a photo of a finished brick model into an AI-generated visual step-by-step instruction board plus a short assembly video. Independent product, not affiliated with any university research project.

name: XDReality
tagline: AI image-to-3D model generator
description: XDReality is an AI image-to-3D model generator. Upload a photo and download a GLB 3D model.

name: Utilgo
tagline: Free online tools for PDFs, images, media and everyday calculations
description: Utilgo is a free browser-based toolkit available in nine languages. Merge and compress PDFs, convert documents, extract text from images with OCR, resize images, edit subtitles, create QR codes and run everyday calculations. No account is required. Many tools run on your device; some document and media conversions use server processing.

name: Taste Stack
tagline: Installable design skills for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.
description: Taste Stack provides installable design-skill packages for existing AI coding agents. Choose a visual direction for web interfaces and visual assets, then use it inside Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. Four starter tastes are free with an account; listed paid tastes cost $3.99 once, with optional Pro access. Agent and model access are separate. Commercial use in personal and client work is allowed; redistribution or resale of the packages is not. Free Swiss starter: https://tastestack.dev/skills/swiss . Install guide: https://tastestack.dev/docs . Self-submission by the Taste Stack team, prepared with AI assistance.

name: Prompty by Lumly
tagline: Turn a rough request into a prompt and a follow-up in your AI chat
description: Prompty is a Windows app for people who already use ChatGPT, Claude, Grok or Perplexity. Describe something you need, such as turning rough meeting notes into an email. Prompty asks for missing details, sends the prompt to your chosen AI, then follows up on its first answer. Download Prompty and create a free account to try one task. Feedback on your first run is welcome at hello@lumlyai.com.

name: ResizesImage
tagline: Free online image resizer — no signup, no upload
description: Free browser-based image tools — resize, crop, compress to KB, convert JPG/WebP/HEIC, AI upscale, background remover, passport photos — no signup, no upload, no watermark

name: KeyTrove
tagline: KeyTrove – Roblox Codes, Checked & Dated
description: KeyTrove tracks Roblox codes for Anime Zero, Fishing Master, Kaiju Alpha and Makeup Mania, each cross-checked against two dated sources.

name: Hyzocool
tagline: MCIO/OCuLink cables, PCIe adapters and cooling for AI/HPC servers.
description: Hyzocool Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures MCIO and OCuLink high-speed cables, PCIe adapters and cooling solutions for AI and HPC servers, with in-house cable assembly and ISO 9001 certification.

name: VideoEnhancer
tagline: AI Video Enhancer — Enhance Any Video to 4K
description: Enhance video quality online with AI. Upscale soft footage to 1080p, 2K or 4K and reduce noise and motion artifacts. Browser-based; one 5-second free trial, then paid processing in credits.

name: PixelFx Studio
tagline: Free animated pixel effects and sprite sheets for games
description: Browse, preview and recolor animated pixel effects, then download transparent PNG sprite sheets and animation JSON. The MIT-licensed library is built on Patch's open-source pixelfx.

name: Padel Relay
tagline: Find UK padel courts, coaches and events in one online directory
description: Padel Relay is a UK padel directory and playing resource, helping people find courts, coaches and events, follow booking links and read practical guides. Its court finder is available on the web. Directory browsing is free; venue bookings and coaching are provided and priced by the listed operators. A separate online equipment shop sells padel rackets, clothing and accessories. Padel Relay does not operate the listed courts or provide their coaching. Its Android app is described as coming to Google Play, so this listing covers the current web platform.

name: Motion TMS
tagline: Transport management software for UK haulage teams
description: Motion TMS is transport management software for UK haulage operations, bringing orders, planning, drivers, delivery evidence and draft invoicing workflows into one workspace. It is in an early operator rollout. Its free plan is for operators running 1 to 50 trucks; live telematics, driver-hours feeds, route optimisation and accounting sync are separate paid tools. The public walkthrough uses fictional sample records and does not book real slots, track vehicles or send invoices. Motion TMS is operated by Flying Penguin AI Limited.

name: Fitness Vault
tagline: Find UK personal trainers, gyms, studios and fitness classes
description: Fitness Vault is an online UK fitness directory for finding personal trainers, gyms, studios and classes. Search by location and speciality, compare provider profiles and contact providers directly. Browsing and enquiries are free; trainer profiles cost £1.99 per month, with no commission on PT sessions. Equipment pages help visitors compare products and buy from the supplier. Fitness Vault is a directory, not a gym or training provider.

name: VerifyMailHQ
tagline: Clean an email list before you send
description: VerifyMailHQ is pre-send hygiene for a list you already have. Clean a CSV or TXT for syntax, duplicates, role inboxes, disposable domains, and missing MX, then download classified files with no signup. Check one address separately; existence spends a credit. Not a sending platform. Cleaning is not proof a mailbox exists.

name: Traductor Total
tagline: Traduce imágenes, PDF y audio con IA al español
description:
Traductor Total (traductortotal.com) es una web gratuita, en español y sin registro, que usa inteligencia artificial para pasar al español todo lo que no está escrito: imágenes, documentos, audio y vídeo. Reúne cinco herramientas en un solo sitio, cada una pensada para una tarea concreta, y funciona igual en el móvil que en el ordenador, sin instalar nada ni crear una cuenta.

La portada combina OCR y traducción automática: un modelo de visión localiza el texto de una foto o captura y lo traduce. Admite JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, GIF y BMP de hasta 10 MB, detecta el idioma de la imagen y devuelve las frases listas para copiar o descargar en TXT, con el original debajo. La página Imagen a texto hace solo la extracción, sin traducir, para quien únicamente quiere copiar lo que dice una captura.

Traductor de imágenes usa IA de visión para localizar cada bloque de texto, traducirlo y devolverlo a su sitio: el fondo se limpia sin recuadros blancos y la descarga conserva el tamaño original, sin marca de agua. Sirve para carteles, cartas de restaurante, fichas de producto, cómics, infografías y diapositivas.

Traductor PDF traduce documentos PDF, también los escaneados, con OCR para las páginas que son imagen, y conserva tablas, imágenes, firmas y maquetación. Acepta hasta 20 MB y 50 páginas y deja comparar cada página con la original antes de descargar.

Transcribir audio a texto usa reconocimiento de voz con IA para convertir notas de voz de WhatsApp, entrevistas, clases y reuniones en texto con marcas de tiempo, identificación de hablantes y exportación a TXT o SRT. Admite MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG/OPUS, AAC, FLAC y más, hasta 100 MB y 30 minutos. Transcribir vídeo a texto hace lo mismo con MP4, MOV y WebM y genera subtítulos, y Traducir audio transcribe y traduce lo que se dice, frase a frase.

Traduce al español por defecto y a 20 idiomas de destino: inglés, catalán, euskera, gallego, francés, portugués, alemán, italiano, neerlandés, rumano, polaco, ucraniano, ruso, árabe, chino, japonés, coreano, hindi y turco. Todo es gratis, sin registro y sin marca de agua. Es útil para estudiantes, oficinas, tiendas online, hostelería, investigación, medios y para cualquiera que reciba un documento, una imagen o un audio en otro idioma y lo necesite entender en español.

name: tatbot
tagline: Ask several AIs at once. Then check who's right.
description: tatbot sends one prompt to several AI models at once, shows the answers side by side, then a judge model critiques them, corrects what's wrong and gives a verdict. Free for up to 5 models per comparison; Pro is $9/month after a 7-day trial.

name: Israelingo
tagline: Practice conversational Hebrew with an AI tutor
description: Israelingo helps you practise conversational Hebrew on Android and iPhone. Speak or type with an AI tutor, role-play everyday situations in Israel, and review corrections, translations and vocabulary. The app is free to download, with some paid features and plans.

name: CatalogGuard: Product SEO
tagline: Find Shopify catalog gaps and review AI-assisted product SEO fixes.
description: CatalogGuard audits Shopify product data, descriptions, image alt text, and SEO fields. It drafts AI-assisted improvements for merchant review, so merchants can check changes before saving them to Shopify.

name: 63Hours
tagline: Florida real estate study with text, audio and practice quizzes.
description: 63Hours is an online Florida real estate learning platform from Florida Listings Real Estate School. It combines course chapters, audio lessons and practice quizzes for people preparing for the Florida sales associate licensing pathway. Study access is free; enrollment is required for course progress. The course-completion certificate costs $175 after passing the separate school final, plus applicable tax. State application, fingerprinting and licensing exam fees are separate. Passing the school final does not replace the state licensing examination.

name: StuffWatch
tagline: Track warranties, returns, recalls, contracts and food dates from receipts—with reminders.
description: StuffWatch is a web app that keeps track of the things you own. Snap or upload a receipt and it saves the item with its price, warranty end and return deadline, then emails you before deadlines pass. It also watches official product recall feeds, reminds you when to cancel contracts, and counts down food best-before dates. Try one free scan. 10 free scans a month on a free account; typing items in is unlimited. Pro: CHF 3.90/month or CHF 36/year. Works in any browser, in English and German.

name: Best Daily Games
tagline: Find daily browser puzzles and keep a personal checklist
description: Best Daily Games is a curated directory for finding a quick browser puzzle. Explore word, geography, trivia, music and logic games. The directory identifies games that play on the site and those that open on the developer’s website. Save a daily lineup and mark games complete with My Daily, which stores your list in the current browser without an account.

name: FreeToolBox: Free AI Background Remover Online
tagline: Remove the background from any photo in your browser, free, with no sign-up and no watermark, and download a full-resolution transparent PNG.
description: FreeToolBox removes the background from any photo right in your browser. There is no sign-up, no watermark, and no upload, because the AI runs on your device, so your photos stay private. Download the result as a full-resolution transparent PNG, or place it on white or any colour for listings and social posts.

name: DownSwift
tagline: Download public social videos and photos from supported platforms.
description: DownSwift is a free web tool and Chrome extension for saving publicly accessible social videos and photos. Paste a public link into the website, or use the extension’s in-page control on supported sites. Available downloads vary by source and may include video, audio, photos and carousels.

name: BillToPDF
tagline: Create an invoice, estimate, or quote PDF
description: BillToPDF turns line items into an A4 PDF. Use an invoice after the work, an estimate while pricing a job, a quote for a client quotation, or a receipt after payment. Fill the form, preview it, and download with no account. Free files include a small Made with billtopdf.com line. It does not file taxes or give legal or tax advice.

name: Qlii
tagline: One QR. Your Entire Business. In 26 Languages.
description:
QLII is a multilingual mini-website builder and digital storefront platform designed for small businesses, local shops, and independent professionals.

Create a beautiful, customizable, mobile-friendly page that brings together everything your business needs: services, menus, booking links, opening hours, location, social media, and contact information.

Every storefront comes with a permanent QR code that you can print and share anywhere. Update your content, add new links, or change booking providers without replacing your QR code or modifying your existing website.

Why choose QLII?

26 languages, including Catalan, Breton, and Corsican, to connect with local and international customers.

Permanent QR codes linked to customizable digital storefronts.

Booking integrations with Booking.com, Airbnb, TheFork, and other reservation platforms.

Smart links and click analytics to optimize customer interactions.

Customer contact collection to stay connected with visitors.

Easy setup, with no coding skills required.

Free plan available, with no credit card needed.

Unlike traditional link-in-bio tools such as Linktree, QLII is specifically designed for real-world businesses, including restaurants, cafés, hotels, vacation rentals, beauty salons, shops, and independent professionals.

Whether you run one small business or manage multiple locations, QLII makes it easy to create and maintain a professional digital presence.

One QR. Your Entire Business.

name: CartonVista
tagline: Free Packing, Box Size & Shipping Calculators
description:
CartonVista is a free, browser-based packing and shipping toolkit designed for ecommerce sellers, small businesses, and individuals.

It helps users choose suitable box dimensions, check item fit with optional clearance, calculate box volume, estimate dimensional shipping weight, and explore multi-item packing arrangements.

The website also offers educational packaging guides and a downloadable CSV reference containing 15 illustrative shipping-box sizes.

All calculators are available without registration or a paid subscription. CartonVista provides practical packaging estimates while clearly explaining limitations such as protective clearance, carrier-specific rules, and physical fit verification.

name: IndexToast
tagline: Bulk URL Indexing Made Simple, Fast, and Efficient.
description: IndexToast solves the time-consuming and repetitive process of managing and submitting URLs for search engine indexing. SEO professionals and website owners often struggle to handle large volumes of URLs, especially when managing backlinks, guest posts, blog articles, and multiple websites. IndexToast simplifies this process with bulk URL submission, organized tracking, and centralized management, helping users save time, reduce manual work, and manage their indexing workflow more efficiently.

name: Scan Perks
tagline: QR stamp loyalty cards for cafes, pubs and bars
description: Scan Perks is a QR stamp loyalty card app for cafes, pubs and bars. Customers scan a QR code at the counter to collect digital stamps and earn rewards — no paper cards. Owners get a simple dashboard to manage rewards and see repeat visits. Built for small independent hospitality businesses.

name: Wassup in a Minute (.net)
tagline: Turn a character image into a Wassup sway video while keeping its original look.
description: Wassup in a Minute at wassupinaminute.net turns an image of a person, illustrated character or animal into a white-background waist-sway video, aiming to preserve the subject's appearance, outfit and original visual style. Upload a JPG or PNG up to 10 MB and generate a 6-second, 720p, 9:16 video without audio. No dance recording or custom prompt is needed. Google sign-in and paid credits are required: each generation uses 36 credits, and the smallest pack costs $4.99 for 50 credits. Credits are purchased once without automatic renewal. Music must be added separately, and AI results may change details. Input/output examples and photo tips are available before creating.

name: CERO
tagline: Notion planning template and digital guides for personal growth and startups
description: CERO is a Gumroad store for paid digital resources. Its catalog includes the Ultimate Daily Action Notion Template for planning, tasks and habits, a guide with 250+ methods to grow a startup, The Wisdom Theory, a 7 Day Brain Boost Challenge, a short procrastination guide and sleep affirmations. The Notion template is listed at $9 and the other five products at $49 each. Products are purchased separately through Gumroad. CERO is a collection of templates and guides, not standalone software. These resources are for learning, planning and personal reflection; no health, financial or business outcome is guaranteed.

name: Syaxis
tagline: AI presentations from files, research or a topic, with editing and exports.
description: Syaxis creates presentations from source files, research or a topic. It researches, writes and designs slides, supports direct editing and chat revisions, and lets users present in the browser or export PowerPoint, PDF and PNG. The free plan uses credits, supports up to 12 slides per presentation and adds a Made with Syaxis mark to exports.

name: Clueffy
tagline: One word. Follow the clues.
description: Clueffy is a free daily word puzzle game that runs in the browser with no account, payment or download. Each original puzzle has one six-letter answer and five clues: you start with one clue, and each valid wrong guess unlocks the next. Green means the right letter in the right spot, orange means the letter belongs elsewhere, and dark means that copy is not in the answer. The daily puzzle resets at midnight UTC and is shared worldwide; practice mode draws from a rotating collection of 60 original puzzles and does not affect the daily record or streak. Three optional hints offer a gentle nudge, a clearer connection, then the first letter.

name: Facebook Video Download
tagline: Free Facebook video downloader — instant HD and SD downloads, no sign-up
description: Free Facebook video downloader. Paste any public Facebook video link and get instant download links in HD and SD quality. Works with Reels, Watch videos, and Group or Page posts. No software, no sign up, no watermark, unlimited downloads. Public videos only.

name: PikoZip
tagline: Local image compression, KB targets and responsive website packs
description: PikoZip helps designers, website owners and people preparing form photos compress, convert and resize images in their browser. Image bytes are processed on the device without uploading them. Compress PNG, JPEG, WebP and AVIF batches, compare previews, or choose a target file size and check whether it was reached. Website Ready Pack exports responsive widths with modern formats and fallbacks in a ZIP. Current image tools are free, with up to 30 images per batch and 10 MiB per image. Published benchmarks include source files, output bytes and limitations. No account is needed for the image tools.

name: Сейка AI
tagline: AI SEO assistant for audits, keywords and content
description: Seyka AI is a conversational SEO assistant built for the Russian-speaking web. It checks website metadata, technical SEO, page speed and Yandex indexing, researches keywords using Yandex Wordstat, and helps with SEO content. Basic checks are available without registration; accounts and subscriptions unlock advanced tools and models. Submitted by Харитон М, SEO-специалист команды «Сейки».

name: Temp Mail PW
tagline: Free disposable temporary email — instant inbox, no sign-up.
description: Temp Mail PW is a free disposable temporary email service. It gives you an instant inbox with no sign-up, so you can register for services, receive confirmation codes and keep your real inbox free of spam. It offers timed inboxes lasting 5, 10, 20, 30 or 60 minutes, custom addresses, an EDU mail generator, email forwarding to a real inbox and a random name generator. The free tier covers everyday use; Basic is $2.99 per month and Pro is $9.99 per month.

name: Snapchat Video Download
tagline: Free Snapchat video downloader for public Spotlight videos
description: Free Snapchat video downloader for public Spotlight videos. Paste a public Spotlight link, download in HD, no watermark, no login, no app, free, MP4.

name: Instapvstory
tagline: Free anonymous Instagram story and followers viewer
description: Free anonymous Instagram story and followers viewer. No login required, for public profiles only, with HD downloads and no watermark.

name: Image2Img
tagline: Transform a reference photo into a new AI image.
description: Image-to-image AI: upload a reference photo and add a prompt to generate a new image. It transforms styles, scenes, and details while using the input as a visual reference. Freemium: one free generation per day with or without an account; no sign-up and no watermark.

name: Beauto
tagline: Android AI photo and video face swap
description: Beauto is an Android AI face-swap app for photos and videos. Single custom photo swaps are free, with watermark-free exports and core on-device processing. Batch, multi-face, video and template features use credits or PRO. Download the APK from the official website.

name: Decision Oracle
tagline: Free I-Ching decision games and strategic consultation reports — cast a hexagram and get a structured reading for your next decision.
description: Decision Oracle is Master Fenghuawang's free I-Ching decision lab: interactive decision games, a three-coin hexagram cast with plain-language interpretation, face-reading reports based on the 12 Destiny Palaces, and structured strategic consultation reports for business and life decisions. Free to play, no account needed; readings are for self-reflection, not predictions.

name: Classroom Noise Meter
tagline: Free classroom noise meter that calibrates to your room.
description: Classroom Noise Meter is a free noise monitor teachers can project in seconds. Ten quiet seconds set the room's floor; the screen then shows Quiet, OK, Noisy or Too loud, words the back row can read. Scenes for tests, independent work, group work and free time sit above that floor, so it works on a Chromebook or a gym webcam. Pick a traffic light, bubbles, bouncing balls or custom pictures, and optionally fill a Quiet jar. A seating chart, name picker and group generator share one class list. Nothing is recorded or uploaded. No account needed. Optional Pro is $36 a year.

name: ClassPaws
tagline: AI lesson planning and classroom rewards for teachers
description: ClassPaws is a classroom workspace for teachers. Use AI to draft lesson plans and quizzes, recognize progress with points and virtual pets, and organize classroom groups and seating. Try the public practice classroom without adding a real student roster. The free plan supports one class with up to 60 students.

name: MapToSite
tagline: Paste a Google Maps link and get a one-page shop site in 30 seconds — free, or $49 once with the printed kit.
description: MapToSite turns a Google Maps listing into a mobile page for a small shop: menu or price list, hours with an open-now state, tap-to-call, directions, photos and reviews — in about 30 seconds, with no account and no card. The free Card tier ($0) keeps the page at /s/your-shop with one footer credit line. Paid tiers add a gallery, a notice line and your own domain (Board $6.99, Sign $13.99 a month). The $49 one-off turnkey kit adds the printed half: A4 QR poster, printable price list, table cards, stickers, table tent, review cards and the Google Business Profile kit, delivered in 24 hours. Built for restaurants, cafés, barbershops, food trucks, repair shops and market stalls — any business whose Google listing is the only thing online. A free three-year cost calculator compares a builder subscription with a page paid for once.

name: SEOPush
tagline: Choose backlink types and quantities. Track orders and download CSV reports.
description: SEOPush is a self-serve backlink platform for SEO freelancers and business owners. Browse the catalog, choose link types and quantities, and order on a pay-as-you-go basis without an agency contract. Services include DA-based backlinks, Web 2.0 blogs and SEO campaigns. Track order status and download a detailed CSV backlink report when delivery is complete. Create a free account to access the full catalog; backlink services are paid. Delivery reports document the links provided, not guaranteed rankings or traffic gains.

name: Genify
tagline: Turn your story into consistent illustrations. Same character. Every scene. Every outfit.
description: Genify turns your text into illustrated stories with one consistent character across every scene, outfit and style. Built for picture books, comics and storyboards. Features include custom reference images, style extraction, @character and @style in the prompt box, a character library with multiple looks and outfits, automatic character extraction and linking from story text, and full storyboard editing. Made for AI picture book creators, KDP self-publishers, illustrators and parents making personalised books for their kids.

name: MamaTool
tagline: 51 free browser tools that run entirely in your browser. No signup, no install.
description: MamaTool offers 51 free browser tools that run entirely in your browser. No signup, no install. Includes a password generator, word counter, image compressor, JSON formatter, QR code maker and calculators.

name: Hourly Journal
tagline: Make every hour of your day count
description: Hourly Journal is a small daily habit: each hour, write down what happened while it is still fresh, with a few words, a tag and a mood. Split an hour into 15-minute slots when needed. Reminders are scheduled by your phone itself, so they arrive even in airplane mode. Free core journal on iOS, Android and web; optional Premium. I built it as Knev at One Simple Life, a small indie studio in India.

name: SpacebarX
tagline: The local-first outliner that stays fast as your notes grow
description: SpacebarX is a local-first, keyboard-first outliner for notes and tasks. It stays on your device, works offline, and is built to stay fast as your notes grow.

name: reinwatch
tagline: See, warn about and stop the subagents, teammates and workflow agents Claude Code runs for you.
description: reinwatch is a free, open-source (MIT) Claude Code plugin/mod that shows per-agent token counts for subagents, warns you when an agent runs too long, burns too many tokens or gets stuck, keeps 30-day totals, and lets you stop a single agent — even inside a workflow.

name: Motion Control
tagline: A motion control workspace for turning images and movement into videos.
description: Motion Control is a freemium web app for generating a new video from photos and a reference clip. The reference video guides the action, timing and framing, while the photos guide the subject’s visual details; use a prepared motion template or upload a compatible clip.

name: UnitConverterWorld
tagline: Free online unit converter for length, weight, volume, temperature and power
description: Free online unit converter with 28 converters across length, weight, volume, temperature and power. Every converter uses the exact international conversion factors and includes the formula, a conversion table and an FAQ. No sign-up, and it works on any device.

name: Motion Transfer
tagline: Make your photos move with motion transfer.
description: Motion Transfer is a freemium web app that creates a new video from a character photo and a reference clip. The photo guides the subject’s appearance while the clip guides movement, pacing and framing; use a prepared trend or upload a compatible clip.

name: Audora OS
tagline: Free AI workspace in the browser: chat, images, tasks and tools in one place
description: Audora OS is a free AI workspace by Audora Tech. It combines an AI chat assistant, image generation, task lists, a drawing board, a terminal and small utilities in one browser app.

name: AI SVG & GIF Generator
tagline: Free in-browser SVG and GIF tools: view, convert, compress, resize, and make typing-text GIFs.
description: AI SVG & GIF Generator offers free, browser-local tools for everyday SVG and GIF work. Open an SVG to inspect and sanitize it, convert it to PNG with transparency, compress or resize an animated GIF while keeping frames and timing, or make a typewriter-style text GIF. Parsing, preview, conversion, and encoding run on your device—the source file is not uploaded to an application server. Credit-based AI tools for text-to-SVG, text-to-GIF, and photo-to-GIF emoji packs are planned and not yet open.

name: Kovio
tagline: Free QR toolkit: make, scan and preview QR codes with no account
description: Kovio makes styled QR codes for links, text, Wi-Fi, contacts and email, scans a code and shows the destination before you open it, and makes UPI payment QR codes for shops. Free for small shops, cafes, events and creators. No account or card.

name: GraphGan
tagline: Free crochet & knitting chart maker — photo to graphgan
description: Free crochet and knitting chart generator — free up to 60x60, no signup. Six crafts, US yarn shades from Red Heart, Lion Brand, Caron, Bernat and Premier.

name: ChartAStitch
tagline: Turn any photo into a stitchable cross stitch chart — free
description: Free online cross stitch chart generator — turn any photo or text into a stitchable chart. Free up to 50x50, no signup. Real DMC colours with CIEDE2000 matching, printable A4 PDF, AI pattern generator.

name: Hectares to Acres
tagline: Precise hectares to acres converter with a farm-size chart
description: Precise hectares to acres and acres to hectares converter built on the exact legal definitions of both units (1 ha = 2.4710538 acres). Includes a hectare-acre chart for farm size, land area and property listings.

name: DogPrompt
tagline: AI portraits and shared photos that still look like your dog.
description: DogPrompt turns an everyday dog photo into a polished AI portrait while preserving the dog’s face, coat colours, markings, ear shape and expression. Pet owners can also upload one photo of themselves and one of their dog to create a new image together. Templates cover Christmas, Thanksgiving, birthdays, weddings, memorials, studio portraits, royal portraits, watercolor, oil painting, sketches, cartoons and more. The first preview is free, credit packs are one-time purchases, and there is no subscription.

name: CD Calculator
tagline: Free in-browser certificate of deposit calculators
description: Free in-browser certificate of deposit calculators: CD maturity value, interest earned, APY vs APR, CD ladder planning and early withdrawal penalty estimates, all from the standard compound-interest formula with no account and no stored data.

name: PastaCommerce Free Cleaning Quote Calculator
tagline: Check cleaning job costs, fees and target margin before quoting.
description: A free browser calculator for cleaning business owners who want to model quotes using their own costs. Enter cleaner-hours, loaded labor cost, supplies, travel, overhead, payment fees and target margin. No signup or Excel needed for the browser calculator. Taxes excluded; results depend on your inputs, not published local market rates. PastaCommerce makes templates, not cleaning-operator advice. A separate optional $15 Excel quote calculator and 100-job tracker is available; Excel is required and not included for that paid kit, and other spreadsheet apps are unverified.

name: Teaspoon to Grams
tagline: Ingredient-aware teaspoon to grams converter for accurate baking
description: Ingredient-aware teaspoon to grams converter. Instead of one generic number it uses each ingredient's bulk density, so sugar, salt, flour, yeast and baking powder each convert correctly in both directions (tsp to g and g to tsp), with handy baking conversion charts.

name: ClearPDF
tagline: Browser-based PDF merging, page organization and text comparison.
description: ClearPDF provides browser-based PDF tools for merging documents, splitting and reordering pages, adding page numbers, and comparing selectable text page by page. Its homepage states that the core browser tools are free, require no account and add no watermark. The site also lists separate server-based conversions; those should not be confused with local browser processing. This listing describes the free browser toolkit, not a claim that every server feature is free or that scanned-page comparison includes OCR. Review exported documents before sharing. This is an authorized product description, not an independent hands-on test.

name: DeepSearch
tagline: Explore possible people matches starting with a name
description: DeepSearch helps users search for possible people matches by name and review a candidate list. Limited candidate-list previews are free without login; full reports are paid. Results are leads that need independent verification against original sources. Submitted by the product team.

name: Text to Cursive
tagline: Text to cursive: copy styled text or download a PNG
description: Text to Cursive is a free cursive text generator with two outputs.
