Copy styled text in 19 Unicode styles for bios, captions and usernames, or render your words in 10 digital script fonts and download a PNG with your own size, colour, spacing and transparent background. No account is needed and your text stays in the converter.

name: CardPiko
tagline: Gift card reference prices and a naira calculator for Nigeria.
description: CardPiko helps gift card holders in Nigeria check reference values in naira. Match brand, issuing country, format and face value in its calculator and read the applicable conditions. Guides explain card details and code safety. Estimates are indicative; trading is not yet open.

name: CrocLeads
tagline: Verified homeowner construction & renovation leads for Australian custom builders.
description: CrocLeads connects verified Australian custom home builders and renovators with pre-qualified, high-intent homeowner leads across Melbourne, Sydney, Brisbane, and Perth. (ABN 58 612 928 284)

name: CanIBuildOn
tagline: Check zoning, bushfire/flood overlays, easements, and slope buildability in Australia.
description: CanIBuildOn explains Australian planning zones, BAL bushfire ratings, flood overlays, covenants, and sloping-block engineering costs before you buy or build. (ABN 58 612 928 284)

name: YouTube Kids Alternatives
tagline: Curated alternatives to YouTube Kids that give parents real channel-level control.
description: YouTube Kids Alternatives helps parents move beyond algorithmic feeds by comparing whitelist-based video players, educational streaming apps, and ad-free kids platforms.

name: ScribeAny
tagline: Turn audio, video, and public video links into editable transcripts, translations, summaries, and subtitles.
description: ScribeAny is a free online AI transcription tool that turns audio, video, and public video links into editable text. Upload MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG, MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM and more (up to 100 MB per file), or paste a public YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, or Facebook video link. The spoken language is detected automatically and you get a timestamped transcript you can search and edit. Optionally translate the transcript and generate an editable summary with key points. Export as TXT, DOCX, PDF, SRT, VTT, or CSV. No account or payment is required.

name: DivvLaunches
tagline: Launch your product and get a dofollow backlink
description: DivvLaunches is a launch platform for indie makers and startups. Launch your product, get discovered by other builders, collect upvotes and earn a dofollow backlink that helps your SEO. Free to launch, built by a solo founder for the indie hacker community.

name: GrixTrack
tagline: Track Google rankings and AI citations in one dashboard
description: GrixTrack is a rank and AI-citation tracker built by Grixhub in Bangkok. Track Google positions for your keywords in any country, city and language, and see whether ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Mode mention or cite your brand for the prompts your customers ask. Compare against competitors, see which domains AI engines cite, and follow changes over time. The free plan includes 10 keywords, 5 AI prompts and 2 competitors with no card; paid plans start at $17.99 a month.

name: Outsmart Notes
tagline: Fast, private online notepad.
description: Outsmart Notes is the fastest private notepad online: plain JavaScript, no framework, notes in IndexedDB, offline PWA, sub-second load. Free: 5 saved notes, 100 MB, 5 tags — try it with no signup for 60 minutes, then sign up to keep them. Pro ($5/mo or $49/yr): unlimited notes, password-locked vault (AES-GCM), wiki links, smart reminders, multi-device sync. Sharing is zero-knowledge — the key is in the URL hash, so the server never sees it. No trial; first month free: 1STFREE27 on /pricing.

name: FableClip
tagline: Turn one story idea into a consistent-character faceless video series
description: FableClip is an AI faceless video series generator. Design a character once, keep it consistent across episodes, generate scripts, voiceover and visuals, and auto-publish to TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Reels. Plans from $19/month.

name: What to Wear Atlas
tagline: Plan practical outfits and layers for the weather
description: What to Wear Atlas is a free website for planning everyday outfits around the weather and your plans. Its Today tool accepts supported U.S. cities or ZIP codes, or a manually entered temperature, and turns the selected conditions and comfort preferences into a layered clothing checklist with reasons. Use it before a commute or casual outing, then consult the weather and occasion guides for context. No account, wardrobe photo or purchase is required. Suggestions are rule-based guidance rather than AI photo styling.

name: Remove Watermark from Video
tagline: Remove watermarks from your videos — no blur, no crop.
description: Remove Watermark from Video is an online AI tool that cleans watermarks, logos and text overlays off videos you own. It detects the mark automatically and rebuilds the area behind it instead of blurring or cropping. Upload MP4, MOV or WebM (up to 100 MB / 10 minutes) in the browser; credits are charged per second and failed jobs are refunded.

name: YuniWish
tagline: Turn a blessing into a gift
description: YuniWish turns a blessing into a gift you can open, save, and share. It supports occasions such as birthdays, Christmas, and New Year, in the form of interactive H5 pages, short blessing videos, and image cards. The H01 interactive prototype (starry envelope and birthday cake) can be experienced now; official generation, high-resolution download, orders, and payment are not live yet.

name: BeamPetal
tagline: Turn clothing product photos into AI fashion model images
description: BeamPetal helps clothing brands and ecommerce sellers create AI fashion model images from product photos. Upload clothing images, choose a model, background and pose, and generate on-model visuals for product listings and marketing. Review generated garment details before publishing. The AI Fashion Model tool is available at https://beampetal.com/tools/ai-fashion-model.

name: ReddTrends
tagline: Reddit buyer-thread reports and reply monitoring
description: ReddTrends finds Reddit threads ranking on Google and cited by AI search for buyer keywords, suggests which conversations to join and how to reply, then tracks comments and thread rankings weekly. You reply from your own account; it never posts for you. Free preview: 3 thread verdicts, no account or card. Freemium: launch prices through 15 Dec 2026 — Single report $9 one-time, Pro $19/month, Agency $49/month.

name: PiSpace Maps – Printable Maps & Worksheets
tagline: Free printable maps and geography worksheets
description: A free library of 1,258 printable geography resources for every country and continent, including blank and labelled maps, quizzes and worksheets. Each comes as A4 and US Letter PDFs for classroom and home learning.

name: Ontoloop
tagline: Shared, human-confirmed team facts for every agent via MCP
description: Ontoloop connects your team's Claude Code and Codex over MCP to one shared space where agents propose, people confirm, and every agent builds on the same facts.

name: PetTravelBook
tagline: Entry rules and airline policies for pet travel
description: PetTravelBook is a reference for people planning a journey with a dog or a cat. It brings together country entry requirements, airline pet policies, and practical guides so you can review identification, vaccination, and document conditions before booking. The site is a planning aid, not a substitute for official government or airline instructions.

name: öIF B1 Prüfung ben
tagline: Fr die IF Integrationsprfung B1 üben: Modelltest mit Audio, Werte-Fragen, Korrektur für das E-Mail und Auswertung beim Sprechen.
description: Kostenlos für die öIF Integrationsprfung B1 üben: Modelltest mit Audio, alle Teile einzeln, 70 Werte-Fragen, E-Mail-Korrektur, Sprechen mit Auswertung und ein Punkterechner. Unabhängiges Angebot.

name: DTZ B1 Prüfung üben
tagline: Für den Deutsch-Test für Zuwanderer (DTZ) üben: Modelltest mit Audio, Korrektur fr den Brief und Auswertung beim Sprechen.
description: Kostenlos fr den DTZ (A2B1) üben: Modelltest mit Audio, alle Teile von Hren und Lesen einzeln, Korrektur für den Brief, Auswertung beim Sprechen und ein Punkterechner. Unabhängiges Angebot.

name: Test B1 Cittadinanza
tagline: Practise for the Italian B1 citizenship exam (CILS B1 Cittadinanza): audio, writing and speaking feedback, grammar and a score calculator.
description: Free practice for the Italian B1 citizenship exam in the CILS B1 Cittadinanza format: a full paper with audio, listening and reading practice, writing and speaking feedback, B1 grammar and a score calculator. In Italian and English.

name: Word Trail
tagline: Free browser word ladder: change one letter at a time to reach the target word
description: Word Trail is a free browser word ladder game. Turn one word into another by changing one letter at a time. It has a Daily Challenge, a Practice mode, progressive hints, saved progress and a word ladder solver for custom 3-6 letter word pairs. Core play is free with no sign-up.

name: 01Router
tagline: One API key for video, image, audio, and chat models.
description: 01Router is one API for all the best AI models. Generate AI videos and images in the web studio, or integrate leading video and image models into your product through one AI video API and AI image API.

name: Krillion Hints
tagline: Progressive hints and tested answers for the daily Krillion trivia puzzle.
description: Independent, fan-made companion for the daily trivia game Krillion at krillion.io. Spoiler-controlled progressive clues, gameplay-tested answers, and a dated archive. Not the official game and not affiliated with Krillion. This is krillionhints.org, a web companion tool, and is not Krillion Games, Guessto, Dive Krillion, Rarity Game, or other unofficial companions on other domains.

name: Text Wingman
tagline: Know what to text back. 3 kind replies, ranked.
description: Paste a dating text or screenshot and get a quick read of the conversation, plus 3 natural replies ranked, each with why it works. It is soft and kind with no pickup lines, and it never touches your messaging apps, so you always press send. The free plan needs no card.

name: InkRoom AI
tagline: AI image generation, reference editing and product visuals
description: InkRoom is a browser-based AI image workspace for individual creators and small teams. It combines text-to-image generation, reference-led creation, visual editing and image enhancement for product photos, posters and related visual variations. Usage is credit-based and paid; eligible visitors may try text-to-image under the current live configuration. Users should check available models, permissions and estimated costs, then review generated text, colors and product details before publishing.

name: VocRemover
tagline: Keep speech intact and export a finished MP4
description:
The third tool in the VocRemover workspace is labeled Keep the voice intact. It is meant to preserve speech and effects while removing background music, then hand back a finished MP4. The site states that this does not change video quality, because the picture is copied and only the audio is replaced.

Video files can be MP4, MOV, WEBM, or M4V, up to 90 MB. The soundtrack model named in the FAQ is DBS-TIGER. As with the other tools, you preview first and you sign in to process and store the file.

Credits start with the Free plan's 30-credit sign-up grant. The pricing page also estimates monthly video counts on Lite, Pro, and Studio (for example, about 13 / 40 / 133 videos per month on the yearly cards). Failed jobs are refunded automatically.

name: Trajeto
tagline: AI resume tailoring and interview preparation for Brazilian job seekers
description: Trajeto helps Brazilian job seekers create professional resumes, analyze their fit with job descriptions, and tailor applications using AI. A free plan offers an initial resume diagnosis and adaptation. Paid plans provide higher usage limits, premium templates and additional preparation tools, including voice interview practice on Pro. Explore the website to choose the plan that fits your job search.

name: RapAI
tagline: Turn a photo into an AI rap video.
description: RapAI (airapvideo.design) is a browser-based AI rap video maker that turns one or two photos into a short two-person rap performance with generated vocals — no camera, editing, or crew. Pick a theme or paste your own lyrics; export 9:16 for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. No free plan; one-time credit packs from $6.90; failed videos refunded.

name: LIFE — Your Next Step
tagline: Free, private help to turn an everyday decision into one manageable action.
description: LIFE helps people who feel overwhelmed or stuck choose a practical next step. Its free public tool works in Spanish, English, French and German without signing up. Visitors can compare three suggestions based on their time, energy and situation, try a voluntary 60-second starting action, and review what happened. Guest notes stay in their browser. A separate registered experience offers personal follow-up. Advanced AI features may be unavailable.

name: VocoType
tagline: Offline voice typing for Windows and macOS
description: VocoType is an offline voice typing application for Windows and macOS. Hold a keyboard shortcut, speak naturally, and release it to insert recognized text directly into the active input field. On-device speech recognition keeps voice recordings on the computer and works without an internet connection. The application supports mixed Chinese and English dictation, custom replacement dictionaries, imported audio and video transcription, and SRT subtitle export. Optional AI features help refine text, correct mistakes, and produce summaries. An MCP integration lets AI clients such as Claude and Cursor request transcription through the local VocoType application. Core features are free.

name: Match By Zodiac
tagline: Real connections. Written in the stars.
description: Match By Zodiac is a free dating web app where your zodiac sign comes from your birth date at sign-up — and never changes. Profiles carry a full chart (Sun, Moon and Rising signs, decan, and Chinese zodiac), and compatibility is scored in both directions from planetary aspects and elements, with a "why you matched" on every profile. When both people share their birth times, a Vedic Guna Milan score appears beside the Western percentage. Messages are end-to-end encrypted.

name: WIKIpdf
tagline: Windows desktop PDF viewer for technical drawings, manuals & marine engineering
description: WIKIpdf is a free Windows desktop application for viewing PDF files, designed especially for marine engineers and maintenance technicians who work with technical drawings, manuals, and schematics. It features a fast, native PDF viewing engine with optional AI-powered Codex chat and Wiki generation capabilities for document analysis. Free download with optional in-app purchase. AI provider account required for the Chat/Wiki features.

name: Roofsyra
tagline: Roofing CRM, takeoffs, estimates and crew timecards
description: Roofsyra connects residential and commercial roofing customer records, manual aerial tracing, entered pitch, estimates, invoices, project photos and crew timecards without employee GPS tracking. AI drafting tools support contractor review. Explore current plans on the website.

name: Replay
tagline: Play your memories.
description: Replay turns your photos with friends into a game about your memories. Create a Replay, invite friends, and see who remembers the moments best.

name: MM Edge Journal
tagline: The execution intelligence journal
description: MM Edge Journal is a private cloud trading journal for discretionary traders. It connects Daily Bias, setup validation, execution and post-trade review. Results are measured in R. Early, Developing and Reliable labels describe sample size, not guaranteed performance. A 14-day trial of the complete journal requires no card; after it, data stays saved, but editing and cloud sync lock until you subscribe. Journal plans are $12.50 a month, $35 for three months, or $109 a year, VAT included. Optional MM Intelligence add-ons are billed separately. There is no broker auto-sync, replay or backtesting. It is not a signal service and does not offer courses or trading advice. Trades are logged manually or imported as structured CSV or JSON.

name: Image to Image
tagline: Change any photo with a simple text prompt.
description: Image to Image is an online AI editor that changes a photo you already have, guided by a text prompt. Upload up to three JPG, PNG or WebP images, describe the change, and get a new picture in about 20 to 40 seconds that keeps the subject, pose and composition of the original. Restyle photos with one-click templates, edit details in plain words, and make product photos on new backgrounds. New accounts get 2 free credits.

name: CareOps Maeumi
tagline: AI counseling conversations, self-checks and between-session practice
description: CareOps Maeumi is an AI counseling app for Korean- and English-speaking users. It combines self-assessments, voice or text conversations, and exercises such as thought records, with saved notes and practice between sessions. Conversations draw on established approaches including CBT and ACT. It is available on iPhone, Android and the web. Free sign-up, intake and initial self-checks are available; session offers and prices are shown in the app. It is not a substitute for professional diagnosis, medical treatment or emergency care.

name: Blur Picture
tagline: Blur faces, text or the background online
description: Blur Picture is a free, no-sign-up tool for blurring or covering anything in a photo: faces, plates, screenshot text or the background. Work stays in the browser and the saved file has the pixels replaced, not hidden.

name: Retouch Picture
tagline: Natural portrait retouching in your browser
description: Retouch Picture is a free, no-sign-up portrait retoucher that runs in the browser. Soften skin, heal spots and fix red-eye while keeping a natural look; every control is capped, and the photo is never uploaded.

name: Create a Collage
tagline: Free photo collage in about a minute
description: Create a Collage is a free, no-sign-up photo collage maker: pick up to 30 photos, choose a layout for Instagram, WhatsApp or print, and save it in about a minute. Photos stay on your device and the download has no watermark.

name: Image Collage Maker
tagline: From camera roll to a wall-ready collage
description: Image Collage Maker is a free, no-sign-up collage tool for two photos or two hundred. Arrange a board, pick a print or Instagram size, and download a sharp JPG, PNG or PDF with no watermark. Photos are processed in the browser and never uploaded.

name: Image Lookup
tagline: See what any photo says about itself
description: Image Lookup is a free, no-sign-up metadata viewer that reads a photo on your device and shows what the file would give away if you shared it: camera, dates, location, generator tags and hidden thumbnails. The picture is never uploaded.

name: Describe Photo
tagline: Write and check alt text with the picture open
description: Describe Photo is a free, no-sign-up alt text checker that keeps the picture beside the words as you write. You name the subject; the page measures colour, light and layout, grades the sentence as you type, and never uploads the file.

name: Pips2 Daily
tagline: Three daily domino logic puzzles, plus unlimited practice.
description: Pips2 Daily is an independent browser-based domino logic game with three original generated puzzles each day: Easy, Medium and Hard. Place every domino once so the colored regions satisfy sums, equal or different values, and comparison rules. Each daily board is fixed for everyone. Play free without an account or download, compare daily solving times, and visit Pips2 for unlimited practice. Pips2 is not affiliated with The New York Times.

name: InPlaceText
tagline: InPlaceText edits words already visible in pictures, making it easier to update image text when editable files are unavailable.
description: To change words inside an existing picture, InPlaceText provides an editor that runs in a browser. If a shop has a price tag photo with an outdated amount or a flyer contains the wrong date, the tool offers an alternative to recreating the entire design. Users upload a JPG, PNG, or WebP file and type both the original wording and its replacement. AI looks for the specified text and redraws it in place with a similar style, size, weight, colour, and perspective. The user does not have to know which font was used. The service can attempt script, handwriting, and decorative lettering as well as more ordinary text, although results are not guaranteed for every image. Repeated words can be targeted with a selection box. Images can be downloaded without a watermark, and the first edit needs no account.

name: TrendVido
tagline: Photo-to-video creation using ready-made trend templates
description: TrendVido lets creators make personalized short videos by choosing a preset trend template and uploading their own photos. No prompt writing is needed. The independently operated web service uses one-time credit packs, starting at $9.99 for 10 credits, without a free trial or subscription. It is intended for template-based social clips, not unrestricted text-to-video editing.

name: Online Hourglass
tagline: Watch time pass through a 3D hourglass in your browser.
description:
Online Hourglass turns a countdown into a moving 3D sand timer. Set the minutes and seconds, then watch the remaining time pass through a virtual hourglass instead of relying only on digits. Use it for focused work, a study session, brewing tea, a short break or a classroom activity.

Choose a theme and layout to suit the way you want to see the timer. Pause, resume or restart a countdown, and enable a sound reminder when the time is up. The settings also let you add independent countdowns so that more than one timed activity can be visible together.

The timer runs in the browser and saves its settings locally for later visits. Its visual display is useful when you want a visible sense of time passing, with minutes and seconds available alongside the sand animation.

name: Online Ruler
tagline: Calibrate your display and measure objects or images in real units.
description:
Online Ruler provides a calibrated ruler and screen measuring guides for real objects and uploaded images. Start by calibrating the display with a known reference so that the on-screen units match your physical screen. Then read measurements in centimeters, millimeters or inches.

Use the Screen Ruler's X/Y guides to check width, height and alignment, or open a larger fullscreen measuring area. You can place a small object against the screen or upload an image to measure and mark dimensions. Keep the display calibration appropriate to the screen you are using.

The product also includes a quadrant layout, concentric circles, a tape-measure workflow and a protractor. These views support different tasks, such as locating a center, comparing radii and diameters, or exploring an angle. Online Ruler is useful for quick size references, drawings, product photos and teaching measurement concepts.

name: Business Ideas Atlas
tagline: Explore Business Ideas and Business Models
description: Business Ideas Atlas organises business-model archetypes and matches them to constraints such as capital, time, skills, location and sales preferences.

name: StatDuels
tagline: Statistics Card Games and Head-to-Head Challenges
description: StatDuels is a head-to-head card game using labelled real-world statistics and game scores, with themed decks, AI opponents and a shared Daily Duel.

name: Hyperfolio
tagline: Free Hyperliquid wallet & portfolio tracker, read-only
description: Hyperfolio is a free, independent portfolio and wallet tracker built natively for Hyperliquid. Paste any public Hyperliquid address (no wallet connection, no signatures, no private keys) to see live equity, realized and unrealized PnL, open perps with leverage and liquidation risk, spot, HYPE staking, and HIP-3 stocks and commodities. Follow wallets with push alerts, browse the Top 100 traders by 30-day PnL, and watch Smart Money radar. Pulse shows sharp movers on HL perps and Pump.fun; the PnL calendar and Perp Calculator help explore performance and liquidation risk. Aggregates AsterDEX, Lighter, Robinhood Chain, Solana, and Pump.fun. Mobile-first installable PWA in English, Spanish, and Chinese. Free, no subscription. Note: independent, not affiliated with Hyperliquid; not hyperfolio.xyz or hyperfolio.io.

name: Leah
tagline: Leah is an enterprise agentic AI company. Built on a decade of contracting, legal, and procurement expertise, it autonomously runs complex work across the enter
description: Leah is an enterprise agentic AI company. Built on a decade of contracting, legal, and procurement expertise, it autonomously runs work across the enterprise, from the contract lifecycle and legal requests to source-to-pay. Founded in London in 2015 and backed by SoftBank and Insight Partners, Leah serves 400+ global enterprises and supports mission-critical processes in regulated industries. Leah works with partners including Microsoft, Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, PwC and KPMG to support enterprise transformation programs globally.

name: Shinai — Young Karateka’s Path
tagline: Free bilingual Shotokan learning program for children
description: A free Ukrainian-English introduction to Shotokan karate for children aged 5–10. Explore 12 lessons, a 90-term glossary and attention games. Designed as a companion to in-person coaching; technique is learned with a trainer.

name: ALEXZ.US
tagline: Free Triadic Intelligence™ tools to see energy, attention, and uncertainty clearly.
description: ALEXZ.US offers free in-browser tools based on Triadic Intelligence™: three complementary lenses on everyday experience. Try a Charge Check (where energy goes), a Digital Sins check-list (what pulls attention), or a Fog Map (where uncertainty sits). First checks need no account and are not a diagnosis — you get a named picture and a small next step. If you want saved results, re-checks, and the full set, Member · Continue is $19.99/month or $199.99/year. Cancel anytime from your Account.

name: Invest Platforms
tagline: Compare UK Investment Platforms, ISAs and SIPPs
description: Invest Platforms compares UK brokers and investing accounts with scenario-based fee tools, platform profiles, downloadable facts and comparison guides.

name: Wisdom Sparks
tagline: Research Podcasts Through People, Themes and Books
description: Wisdom Sparks helps research long-form podcasts through people, episodes, themes and books, with connected discovery and a shareable learning-playlist builder.

name: Arty Ideas
tagline: Art and Photography Project Ideas
description: Arty Ideas provides artist research, project prompts, experiment planning and writing scaffolds for GCSE and A-Level Art, Photography and Textiles work.

name: Timeline Quiz
tagline: Interactive Timeline Quizzes Across History and Culture
description: Timeline Quiz is a browser game for placing events in chronological order, with themed decks, director filmographies, separate score modes and daily play.

name: Geography Practice
tagline: Interactive Geography Quizzes and Practice
description: Geography Practice offers free map, flag, capital and city quizzes, a shared daily challenge, sourced Learn Cards and printable maps for individual learners.

name: OpenShield
tagline: Content moderation and fraud prevention APIs
description: Moderate what your users and agents post, and stop sign-up fraud. One API call each: accept, review or reject content, allow or block an event.

name: LingoRove
tagline: Learn languages by listening, anywhere you go.
description: LingoRove is an audio-first, concept-based language learning app for iPhone, CarPlay and Apple Watch. Lessons are organised around concepts and meanings, not word-for-word translation lists, so you can listen and practise in the car, then use phrase matching, Story Time, characters, speech practice and quizzes on your phone. The Starter Pack is free. Full Access ($49.99/yr) unlocks all language packs, five learning games, custom content and profiles. Languages include Spanish, French, Hungarian and more. Submitted on behalf of developer Gordon Carter.

name: SyncBooster
tagline: SyncBooster: upload a photo, an assistant drafts a post for each platform, you hit publish.
description: SyncBooster is a panel for scheduling and publishing social media posts. You upload photos and write a sentence, and an assistant drafts a separate version of the post for each platform: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, TikTok and Google Business Profile, with YouTube on paid plans. You edit the text by chatting ("shorten it", "add the price"), then publish right away or pick a day and time. The assistant saves a profile of your business, so each new post does not start from zero. The panel also includes an image generator, a gallery and carousels. You can start free: 100 tokens, no card. The Business plan (3 brands) is 249 PLN a month, VAT included, or 2,490 PLN a year. The offer is for consumers in Poland and for businesses in the EU with a valid EU VAT number.

name: Trade Me Up
tagline: European marketplace for Pokémon, One Piece and Disney Lorcana cards.
description: Trade Me Up is a European trading card marketplace from Luxembourg, operated by TTA Technologies. Collectors can buy, sell and trade Pokémon, One Piece and Disney Lorcana cards.

name: Toolsped
tagline: Free library of 800+ calculators, converters and everyday tools that run instantly in your browser — no sign-up.
description: Toolsped offers 800+ free online calculators, converters and everyday tools, including finance, mortgage, math, health, home and unit-conversion tools. Every tool runs instantly in the browser with no sign-up, no download and no cost, giving clear step-by-step results for everyday questions — from converting ml to oz to working out a monthly mortgage payment.

name: Remove Music From Video
tagline: Remove background music from any video and keep the voice.
description: Remove Music From Video is an online tool that takes the background music out of a video and keeps the people talking, singing or narrating. Choose an MP4, MOV or WebM file up to 500 MB and 30 minutes; the audio is read in your browser and only the audio is uploaded. Download the MP4 without music, the voice track or the music track. For creators, video editors and teachers.

name: Paste2
tagline: Share text and links across devices without signing in.
description: Paste2 is a free online clipboard for transferring text, code snippets, or links across devices without signing in. Content auto-saves and can be opened via a unique short link, a custom slug, a QR code, a 6-digit PIN (valid for 10 minutes), PWA share, or a curl pipe to /api/quick. It includes live Markdown split-view with 12-language syntax highlighting, JSON and Base64 tools, client-side PBKDF2-SHA256 (210,000 iterations) plus AES-256-GCM encryption, burn-after-reading, and sliding expiry of 15 minutes, 1 hour, 24 hours, or permanent. Each paste can be up to 200 KB. Paste2 is not affiliated with paste2.org or Pastebin.com.

name: Jargonaut
tagline: A shared dictionary for your company's jargon
description: Jargonaut gives your team one place to define the acronyms and internal terms that pile up at work. Members add terms, suggest definitions, and vote the best ones to the top, so new hires stop guessing what "QBR" or "the Atlas migration" means. Free for teams up to 3 members; paid plans add more members, admin controls, and SSO.

name: ChibiStyle
tagline: Turn photos or text into chibi avatars, emotes and stickers
description: ChibiStyle creates chibi avatars, Twitch emotes and Discord sticker PNGs from photos or text for creators and communities. Up to four images per generation with mood presets. Independent product with 15 signup credits, paid credit packs and a monthly plan; not affiliated with OpenAI.

name: CostCue
tagline: Free home-service cost estimators — roof, fence, deck, remodel and repair prices for 2026.
description: CostCue offers free home-improvement cost estimators for roof replacement, fencing, decks, driveways, painting, kitchen and bathroom remodels, HVAC and electrical work, with itemised price breakdowns so homeowners can budget before calling a contractor.

name: CalorieMath
tagline: Free calorie calculators — TDEE, BMI, protein and water intake, explained in plain English.
description: CalorieMath offers free calorie and health calculators — TDEE, maintenance calories, BMI, protein and daily water intake, plus calories-burned estimates for walking — each with a plain-English guide explaining the formula and its limits.

name: QuickFreeTools
tagline: Free collection of 71 online tools that run entirely in your browser
description: QuickFreeTools is a free collection of 71 online tools for everyday calculations and conversions. Finance calculators cover mortgages, loans, income tax, paychecks, compound interest, credit card payoff, retirement and net worth. Converters cover units, currency, time zones, fuel cost and rent. Text and file tools cover word counting, case conversion, QR codes, password generation and image resizing. Every tool runs in the browser — no sign-up, no downloads, no cost — and every calculator shows its working with step-by-step examples.

name: BG Remover
tagline: Full-resolution HD with a one-time pack, valid for a year
description:
When you need the original resolution, BG Remover is an HD background remover that uses prepaid packs rather than a free full-size download. The account FAQ says HD downloads need an HD pack, use one credit per image, and that the original image is processed on their servers.

The live pricing page lists three packs: 10 HD downloads for $2.99, 50 for $9.99, and 200 for $24.99. Each is described as a one-time payment, no subscription, paid by card, and valid for 1 year, at original resolution.

A free path remains for smaller files: no sign-up, no watermark, up to 800 px on the long side. Monthly and Annual subscription tabs exist on the same pricing page if a pack is not the right fit.

name: WageCue
tagline: Free salary calculators — what an hourly wage is per year, and what cities really cost.
description: WageCue offers free salary and cost-of-living calculators: hourly-to-annual conversions, take-home estimates, side-by-side job-offer comparisons, and cost-of-living breakdowns for major US cities.

name: RateCue
tagline: Live USDT P2P rates — compare Binance, OKX and Bybit prices in PKR, NGN, KES, GHS and more.
description: RateCue tracks live USDT P2P rates across Binance, OKX and Bybit for local currencies including PKR, NGN, KES and GHS, with fee comparisons and step-by-step safety guides for buying and selling USDT P2P.

name: SolarMath
tagline: Free solar calculators — how many panels you need, what they cost, and what they save.
description: SolarMath offers free solar calculators and guides: a system-size calculator, panel counts for real homes, solar cost and payback estimates, lease-vs-buy and battery comparisons, all worked through with transparent numbers you can check.

name: PassDrill
tagline: Free DMV permit practice tests — 154 questions, road signs and state-by-state study guides.
description: PassDrill offers free US driving-test practice: full permit practice tests, road-sign drills and state-specific study guides (including pass marks and test-day checklists) that help learner drivers pass the written exam on the first try.

name: StubWhiz
tagline: Free US paycheck calculators — take-home pay, FICA, overtime and hourly-to-salary, state by state.
description: StubWhiz offers free US paycheck and tax calculators, including take-home pay by state, FICA and federal withholding estimates, overtime pay, raise and hourly-to-salary calculators, plus plain-English guides that show exactly how each number is worked out.

name: Named
tagline: Be the name AI recommends.
description:
Named (named.khanex.ai) is an AI visibility service for small businesses. When a buyer asks ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok or Muse for the best option in your category, the answer names a few companies. Named works to get you into that answer.

We run a fixed set of your buyers' questions on each engine, count how often each one names you and who it names instead, and log the links it cites. Then we change what the engines read about your site, starting with what moves that count most, and run the same questions again every week. Answers vary from run to run, so we track each engine separately.

It's done for you. Our AI agents, the Namies, run the questions, and a person checks every change before it goes live. Nobody can guarantee what AI says, and we don't sell placement. The audit is free.

name: TimeCubby
tagline: Free calendars, date calculators and group scheduling tools.
description: TimeCubby brings everyday time tools together in one browser-based collection. Organizers can share availability polls for group meetings, families can customize and print calendars, and users can calculate dates and workdays. The site also includes time-zone planning, world clocks, timers, stopwatches and countdowns. Its group-scheduling tool supports one-time, weekly and monthly availability polls without requiring accounts. This submission is made on behalf of TimeCubby.

name: Pips Hints
tagline: Daily NYT Pips hints and answers, plus free unlimited Pips domino puzzles
description: Pips Hints gives spoiler-free hints and answers for the daily NYT Pips puzzle (Easy, Medium and Hard), and a free Pips Unlimited mode with endless domino logic puzzles in your browser.

name: WD Tools
tagline: Useful online tools for images, PDFs, text and more. Get everyday tasks done with less effort, right in your browser.
description:
Clear controls and focused tools help you finish tasks without a learning curve.

Works across devices
A responsive experience designed for phones, tablets and desktop screens.

Privacy-aware processing
Where supported, files are processed in your browser instead of being uploaded.
tags: text and more. Get everyday tasks done with less effort

name: Neither
tagline: Interview scorecards and interview notes for recruiting teams.
description: Neither's recruitment module creates prioritized interview scorecards from job ads, captures timestamped interview notes with candidate quotes, schedules interviews, and builds candidate profiles from CVs. It is for recruiting teams; free to start, no card.

name: Online Display Ruler
tagline: Free Online Ruler for CM, MM, Inches and Pixels
description: Online Display Ruler is a free browser-based measuring tool that turns your computer, tablet or smartphone screen into a ruler. Measure in centimeters, millimeters, inches and CSS pixels. Calibrate your display using a supported device profile, screen diagonal, standard card or known physical length. No installation or account required.

name: CopyPlaintext
tagline: Paste without formatting and clean text in your browser
description: Free browser-based tools for removing formatting, joining wrapped lines, cleaning spaces, removing duplicate lines and counting words. Core text processing runs locally, with no account required.

name: Vault Security
tagline: Your AI-Powered Digital Safety Assistant
description:
Vault Security is your personal AI safety assistant for the internet. It helps protect your digital life across web and mobile by spotting scams, phishing links, suspicious texts, fake websites, risky pages, and data threats before they turn into real problems.
Built for Android, iOS, and browser use, Vault gives you clear, real-time warnings in plain English, so you know when something looks unsafe and what to do next. It also supports privacy and identity protection with features like breach monitoring, VPN protection, ad blocking, aliases, and safer browsing guidance.
Unlike traditional antivirus tools, Vault is built for the threats people actually face today: scam messages, fake websites, phishing pages, leaked personal data, trackers, and identity risks. It works quietly in the background, helping you browse, shop, bank, and work online with more confidence.

name: SimpAudit
tagline: SAP Audit & ITGC Compliance Management Software
description: SimpAudit helps organizations manage SAP security audits, IT General Controls (ITGC), risk assessments and compliance workflows through a centralized platform.

name: AILEX
tagline: AI legal workspace for Japanese law firms
description: AILEX is an AI-assisted legal workspace for Japanese law firms. It brings case records, document reading, draft preparation, deadlines and billing into one workflow. Lawyers can review source material and activity records while preparing documents and evidence packages for mints. Final legal decisions and court submissions remain with the lawyer. AILEX is provided by AILEX LLC in Tokyo, Japan. A one-month trial is available; the paid plan is JPY 13,200 per seat per month, including tax.

name: Food Compliance Solutions
tagline: Food safety checks, records and staff training for independent kitchens
description:
Food Compliance Solutions is a web-based food-safety and training platform for independent cafes, restaurants, takeaways, caterers, delis and other food businesses. It brings daily kitchen checks, temperature records, cleaning schedules, allergen and supplier records, and inspection documentation into one place.

Teams can log checks on a phone or shared kitchen device, sign records with individual staff PINs, and scan QR stickers to open equipment records. Out-of-range readings require a recorded corrective action. Managers can see outstanding checks and download dated records for inspections.

Depending on the plan, the platform also includes HACCP and Safer Food Better Business document builders, risk assessments and COSHH records, delivery scanning, staff timesheets, training courses and certificates, and multi-site support. Documents are drafted from the business's own answers for the operator to review and approve.

Built around the day-to-day work of UK independent kitchens, Food Compliance Solutions helps operators keep their food-safety records and staff training organised as they work.

name: iGCORE
tagline: B2B sportsbook and online casino software
description: iGCORE provides B2B software for online casino and sportsbook operators, including white-label and turnkey platforms. Products include sportsbook software, live match trackers, odds feeds, agent management, Telegram casino, payment aggregation, statistics hubs and affiliate systems. Services include API integration, custom development, risk management and sports trading.

name: Acre to Bigha
tagline: A free, state-wise acre-to-bigha converter for India that shows pucca, kaccha and regional variants, because a bigha differs by state.
description: Acre to Bigha converts acreage to customary bigha measures using state-specific and regional values. Enter an area, choose a state and direction, and cross-check the result in square feet, square yards, square metres or hectares. The tool covers 13 Indian states, is free, and does not store what you type. Values are references, not official land records.

name: Ft to Miles
tagline: A free, real-time feet-to-miles converter using the exact 5,280-foot international mile, with both directions, adjustable precision and no signup.
description: A straightforward distance converter built around the exact relationship that one international mile is 5,280 feet. Results update as you type, with adjustable precision from 0 to 10 decimal places. Companion tools cover reverse conversion, nautical miles, feet-per-second to mph, square feet to square miles and mils. Nothing is sent to a server.

name: CrCl Calculator
tagline: A free Cockcroft-Gault creatinine clearance calculator with actual, ideal and adjusted body weight and mg/dL or µmol/L support.
description: Clinical utility for estimating creatinine clearance with the Cockcroft-Gault equation. Supports renal-dosing calculations for pharmacists, prescribers, nurses and students; all calculations run locally in the browser, and no patient data is transmitted or stored. Educational aid, not a substitute for clinical judgement.

name: Njawib
tagline: ai automation b2b saas
description: automates instagram + whatsapp replies for businesses where you book before you go so that they stop losing costumers to slow replies

name: SinomedTrip
tagline: Plan medical treatment in mainland China, with travel support.
description: SinomedTrip helps international patients plan medical treatment at hospitals in mainland China, with travel support before and after care. Costs are often much lower than in the US or Europe.

name: Arbeitszeitrechner Pro
tagline: Kostenloser Arbeitszeitrechner nach dem Arbeitszeitgesetz — ohne Anmeldung.
description: Kostenloser Arbeitszeitrechner nach dem Arbeitszeitgesetz — Arbeitsstunden, Überstunden, Dezimalstunden, Pausen, Feierabend und Gleitzeit berechnen, ohne Anmeldung.

name: Reletter - AI Image Text Editor
tagline: Edit existing image text with local OCR or Pro AI redraw
description: Reletter helps designers, small businesses and ecommerce sellers update text in screenshots, menus and product images. Standard mode runs OCR in the browser and makes text regions independently editable. Optional Pro AI redraw edits selected regions on more complex backgrounds; review AI output before use. Editing and watermarked previews are free without an account. Clean Standard PNG downloads cost 5 credits per result; Pro redraw costs 10 credits including download. Paid features need Google sign-in and credits. One-time packs start at $4.99 for 100 credits. English and Simplified Chinese are supported.

name: YTAPI
tagline: Fast, reliable API for YouTube transcripts, metadata, playlists, channels and search.
description: Extract YouTube transcripts, video metadata, playlists, channel details and search results with simple HTTP requests. Word-level timestamps, output in JSON, text, Markdown, SRT or VTT, and batch extraction for up to 100 videos per request. Official Python and TypeScript SDKs, plus a remote MCP server so AI agents can call it directly. Free 200 credits on signup, no card required; packs $9/2,000 credits, $29/10,000, $79/50,000; credits never expire; no subscription.

name: MeshCrate
tagline: Preview GLB files locally in your browser
description: MeshCrate offers a free browser-based GLB viewer and a library of licensed 3D model references. Open a self-contained GLB file up to 50 MB, rotate and zoom the model, switch material views, or play embedded animations. Files are processed locally in your browser.

name: Highest Net Worth
tagline: Free net worth, retirement, loan and savings calculators that run in your browser.
description: Highest Net Worth offers free online calculators for personal finance: a Net Worth Calculator, Compound Interest Calculator, Savings Goal Calculator, Loan EMI Calculator, Retirement Calculator, Mortgage Calculator, SIP Investment Calculator, Inflation Calculator, Debt Payoff Calculator, Emergency Fund Calculator and FIRE Calculator. Every calculator is free, needs no sign-up, runs in your browser and never saves or shares your numbers.

name: SafeOrStolen
tagline: Check used items against stolen-property reports
description: SafeOrStolen helps people check used goods against available stolen-property reports using a serial number, IMEI, VIN or license plate. Results identify sources for further review; a no-match does not guarantee that an item is legitimate. It is useful for buyers and resellers checking items before a purchase.

name: fazoli's menu prices and nutrition
tagline: Fazoli's menu prices and nutrition, updated across the US.
description: I keep Fazoli's menu prices, nutrition and new items updated across the US. I check baked spaghetti, breadsticks and family meals so you can see current prices before you order. I update the guide regularly to help you plan a quick, affordable Italian meal.

name: Chiffre en romain
tagline: Free Roman numeral conversion tool
description: Free Roman numeral converter: numbers from 1 to 3999, dates and years, or Roman-to-Arabic. Includes a printable 1–100 PDF chart, a 1950–2030 year table, and batch conversion of an Excel or Word list. No sign-up. Results are indicative only.

name: Chiffre en lettres
tagline: Free French number-to-words converter
description: Free French tool that writes a number or amount in words, with usage for France, Belgium, Switzerland and Quebec, 1990 hyphenation, reverse conversion, batch mode, and a cheque or invoice preview. No sign-up. Conversions are indicative only.

name: Orar Tren
tagline: Train timetables for all Romanian rail operators.
description: Orar Tren is a free website with train timetables for all seven Romanian rail operators (CFR Călători, Regio, Transferoviar, InterRegional, Astra, Ferotrafic, Softrans), station departure and arrival boards, plus Bucharest metro and STB. No account needed. Romanian-language, built by an independent developer in his spare time.

name: MHD Česko
tagline: Prague public transport timetables and live departures.
description: MHD Česko is a free website with Prague public transport timetables and live departures from PID open data: metro, trams, buses, stop map and service disruptions. It works on phone and desktop without registration. Czech-language, built by an independent developer in his spare time.

name: Calculatrice-Facile.com — Calculatrice en Ligne Gratuite
tagline: Calculatrice en Ligne Gratuite
description: Calculatrice en ligne gratuite, basique et scientifique, avec bloc-notes et historique exportable en CSV/PDF.

name: Starbucks Nutrition Calculator
tagline: Check calories, sugar and carbs for every Starbucks drink.
description: A free online calculator with nutrition data for 1,000+ Starbucks menu items (calories, sugar, carbs, caffeine, protein), plus a published methodology page. No sign-up needed.

name: Pickle
tagline: An AI agent that runs your everyday errands from your phone
description: Pickle is an AI agent app for iPhone and Android that handles everyday tasks for you - looking things up, drafting messages, booking, errands - and talks with you by voice or text. Access is invite-based. Invite link: pickle.com/i/RDKXK77G9ZRT - when a friend joins with your link and finishes signing up, both get full reset tickets for the app's daily usage limit (the free daily cap resets at 4 AM).

name: AegisRunner
tagline: AI-assisted website and mobile app testing
description: AegisRunner helps developers and QA teams inspect public websites for broken links, accessibility issues, search visibility, security settings and performance. It offers AI-assisted test drafting, reviewable findings and screenshots, with supported web suites exportable as Playwright TypeScript. A permanent free plan is available, with paid plans for additional capacity and mobile testing. Customer sign-in testing and local-runner activation are pending.

name: CastRemix
tagline: AI Video Character Swap & Video Remakes
description: CastRemix remakes a short video using your own characters from a 2–30s reference clip plus a character photo. Uploads are private. A quote is shown before generation. It does not guarantee exact face replacement, unchanged backgrounds, or lip sync. Plans: Starter $9.9 USD/month with 500 credits, Creator $29.9 with 1,800 credits, Studio $99.9.

name: AIGCPanel
tagline: Open-source desktop studio for AI digital-human video
description: AIGCPanel is a free, open-source desktop app for AI digital-human (talking avatar) video production on Windows, macOS and Linux. Upload a portrait plus text or audio and it generates a lip-synced talking-head clip using open models such as MuseTalk, LatentSync, Wav2Lip and Heygem, with green-screen avatars and a template manager. It also includes text to speech (CosyVoice, FishSpeech, IndexTTS, GPT-SoVITS), zero-shot voice cloning, FunASR speech recognition with subtitle export, and a 25+ tool media toolbox. Everything runs locally once models are installed, so private footage never leaves your machine. Apache-2.0, optional Pro features.

name: Christmas Dance
tagline: Christmas Dance turns your photos into a holiday dance video—pick a solo, duo, or group template with music, then download a 480p or 720p MP4.
description: Christmas Dance (christmasdance.org) is an AI Christmas dance video generator: upload photos (JPG, PNG, or WebP, up to 10 MB each; one person per photo, clear face and good light), match each shot to the labeled dancer slot, pick a solo, duo, or group template with music, and download an MP4 with the selected soundtrack. Templates on the homepage include Matching Pajamas, Solo Christmas Groove, Bestie Christmas Dance, and The Christmas Crew; durations are 4–15 seconds (the featured packs are 12 seconds). Output is 480p for 1 credit or 720p for 2 credits, including solo and group dances, aimed at TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. Credits are one-time packs with no subscription and do not expire: Stocking Filler $9.90 (2 credits), Christmas Party $24.90 (6 credits), The Whole Crew $59.90 (16 credits); mix resolutions from the same balance. Confirmed generation failures return the credits charged (not an automatic cash refund). Only use photos and audio you have permission to use. Directory listings: Free, support@christmasdance.org.

name: KeySprint PRO
tagline: Free typing speed tests and practice for English, numbers, and code
description: KeySprint PRO is a free online typing test and practice platform for students, job seekers, programmers, and anyone who wants to improve typing speed. Test your WPM and accuracy, practice English, numbers, and code, identify weak keys, and track your progress. No account is required to start typing.

name: Alkademy
tagline: AI-Powered Online Learning Ecosystem
description: Alkademy is an AI-powered online learning ecosystem offering practical courses, professional certifications, live classes, workshops, and mentorship to help individuals and organizations build in-demand skills and achieve professional growth.

name: Guess the Jumpshot
tagline: Daily basketball guessing games for NBA fans
description: Guess the Jumpshot offers browser-based basketball guessing games, including a daily NBA player challenge using basketball clues. Players can test their basketball knowledge without installing software.

name: AtsWay
tagline: Avec AtsWay, un CV mieux adapté à chaque offre.
description:
ATSway est une application web gratuite propulsée par l’intelligence artificielle, développée par le studio de création numérique Vagabond.work.
Son objectif principal est de rendre les CV hautement compatibles avec les logiciels ATS (Applicant Tracking Systems). Ces logiciels sont utilisés par la majorité des entreprises pour trier, scanner et filtrer automatiquement les candidatures avant même qu’un humain ne les lise.

name: MakeASong
tagline: Make a song with AI in about a minute: describe an idea, pick a style, and get two full songs. Start free.
description: MakeASong is an AI song maker that turns ideas or your own lyrics into complete songs. Describe what you want or paste lyrics, pick a style, and get two full takes each time. Includes AI song generator, lyrics-to-song, and AI lyrics generator. Songs stay private by default. Freemium: free credits on signup, then subscribe or buy credit packs.

name: Look Morph
tagline: AI Clothes Changer: try outfits and hairstyles on your own portrait
description: Look Morph is a web-based AI clothes changer for adults exploring personal style. Upload a portrait and a clothing or accessory reference to generate a new look that aims to keep your identity. Tool pages cover outfit, hairstyle, hat, bag, shoes and pants, and Outfit can change clothes and haircut in one still. A finished still can become a turnaround GIF, a creative preview rather than a fitting. Stills cost 10 credits; a GIF costs 30 more. Every account gets 10 free credits daily, no payment card required; free results include a watermark. Uploads stay private.

name: Visual Maker AI
tagline: AI images, image-to-video and film projects in one app
description: Visual Maker AI is a credit-based AI visual creation workspace for creators, marketers and teams. Write a prompt or add a reference image to generate photoreal, illustrative or 3D images with models such as GPT Image 2 and Seedream 5.0 Pro, at 1K or 2K output. Turn a still photo or generated art into a 3–30 second clip with Veo 3.1, Seedance 2 or Kling 3.0, using image-to-video, text-to-video, first/last-frame or reference-led modes, with control over aspect ratio, duration, resolution and quality. The AI Film Studio breaks a script into scenes, keyframes and video clips, and the Product Ad Workflow builds a product story from hook to final shot. A curated prompt library and reusable character, product, location and style assets help you start quickly. New accounts receive 10 credits; subscriptions and one-time credit packs are available.

name: FontKite
tagline: Fancy Unicode fonts and text art to copy and paste
description: FontKite is a free, non-AI browser-based text toolkit: compare 84 copy-and-paste Unicode styles and symbols, make text-to-ASCII art, create kaomoji and username ideas, and export names as SVG for cutting. No account required.

name: Cyber CLAY
tagline: Fixed-fee PCI DSS, ISO 27001 and SOC 2 consulting
description: Cyber CLAY helps merchants and service providers achieve PCI DSS, ISO 27001, and SOC 2 readiness with fixed-fee consulting across Singapore and India. Gap assessment, VA/pentest coordination, and attestation-ready evidence.

name: cryptobattlefield
tagline: Live crypto markets as a 3D bulls vs bears battle
description: Crypto Battlefield transforms live crypto market data into an interactive 3D battle between bulls and bears. Price movements shift the front line, large trades send reinforcements, order-book walls become rocket batteries, and liquidations trigger airstrikes. Explore 300+ cryptocurrencies with real-time order flow, market depth, and recording tools. Free to use directly in your browser.

name: gaash.ai
tagline: AI Search Visibility Tracking, Brand Mention Monitoring
description: Gaash AI is an AI-powered platform focused on SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). We help businesses strengthen their online visibility, improve search presence, and stay ahead in the evolving AI-driven digital landscape. Our goal is to make businesses more discoverable across traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences.

name: Letter4U
tagline: Digital love letters, made personal.
description: Letter4U turns your words, photos and favorite song into a little page just for them. Writing, previews and drafts are free. Paid publishing is not enabled yet, so you can still create and share letters free during launch. It is not an AI writing tool.

name: Interoperia — JoomShopping Plugins
tagline: EveryPay, payment and shipping plugins for Joomla/JoomShopping stores
description: Interoperia develops payment and shipping plugins for Joomla/JoomShopping stores. EveryPay for JoomShopping connects an existing EveryPay merchant account to the store. The range also includes PayPal, Stripe, Paysera and CoinGate payment plugins, plus DPD and Omniva shipping plugins. Product pages provide compatibility requirements, installation guides and pricing. Plugin code is licensed under GPL version 2 or later; purchases include 12 months of updates and email support for one nominated website. Payment-provider and carrier accounts and their fees are separate.

name: H3 Image Studio
tagline: Browser workbench on MiniMax H3 Image: generate from text or a reference, and edit photos with prompts.
description: H3 Image Studio is a browser workbench on the MiniMax H3 Image model. Generate images from text or a reference, and edit photos with prompts. The studio currently offers one reference slot and aspect ratios 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, and 4:3. New accounts get 8 welcome credits. Paid plans add monthly credits (Basic, Pro, and Max), and one-time credit packs are also sold; the pricing page FAQ states that those packs do not expire.

name: ITJobs in Pakistan
tagline: Find latest IT jobs in Pakistan and apply online for free.
description: ITJobs in Pakistan is a job portal for IT jobs in Pakistan. Find latest IT jobs including software, web development, data and networking jobs, and apply online for free.

name: Sleep Debt Calculator
tagline: Free Sleep Calculators to Understand and Improve Your Sleep
description: SleepDebtCalc is a free online sleep toolkit featuring 34 interactive calculators to help users understand their sleep patterns, calculate accumulated sleep debt, plan recovery, optimize bedtime, track sleep cycles, calculate caffeine cutoff times, and improve sleep habits. All tools are accessible online without registration.

name: TrustMyIP
tagline: Free IP lookup and network tools
description: Free IP lookup and network tools — check your IP address and location, run ping and speed tests, calculate subnets, and verify AI crawlers and bots. No sign-up needed.

name: RepairAmigo
tagline: Free repair shop management software that runs on your own computer.
description: RepairAmigo is free repair shop management software for cell phone, computer and console repair shops. It covers intake, instant pricing, repair tickets, live inventory, cash management, users and roles, warranty tracking, reports and a cash sale screen. It runs as a virtual machine on a computer in your shop (installers for Windows PCs and Intel Macs), so your data stays on your network. Free forever with no trial and no subscription; an optional one-time Paid Version (currently US $49) adds Stripe credit card processing.

name: Vidglory
tagline: AI Video Cloner — Paste a Viral Video, Swap In Your Product｜ Vidglory
description: Vidglory is an AI Video Cloner. Paste a viral video, swap in your own product, and create a video that features your product.

name: SoundTester
tagline: Free online speaker and headphone sound test in your browser.
description: Free browser audio checks: left/right/stereo channels, speaker and headphone tests, tone generator, bass and phase checks. No sign-up, nothing to install.

name: ComfortZoneCheckin
tagline: The Digital Wellness Guardian
description: ComfortZone is a digital wellness tool that helps users reduce unproductive screen time and become more aware of their scrolling habits. It detects potential doom-scrolling loops and provides gentle, mindful check-ins to encourage users to pause and refocus. Rather than blocking websites or apps, ComfortZone takes a flexible approach to digital wellness, helping people build healthier screen habits while staying in control of their online experience.

name: Calculadora de Horas
tagline: Free online hours calculator for Brazil.
description: Free online hours calculator for Brazil (in Portuguese). Calculate hours worked, overtime, banked hours (banco de horas) and work shifts, add and subtract hours and minutes, and convert time — fast, simple and free, with no sign-up.

name: StatePaycheck
tagline: Free 2026 paycheck calculators for all 50 US states.
description: Free 2026 paycheck calculators for all 50 US states. Estimate federal tax, FICA and state income tax to see your real take-home pay — no sign-up needed.

name: OfferWoo
tagline: Interview preparation and real-time talking points grounded in your experience
description: OfferWoo helps job seekers prepare for interviews and suggests real-time talking points based on their resume, job description and project notes. A limited free trial and paid time packages are available.

name: Clivra
tagline: Copy once. Keep creating.
description: Mac visual clipboard history, local-first, with OCR and Quick Paste. Clivra keeps text, links, screenshots and colors in a visual history on your Mac. Search, collections, on-device OCR, Quick Paste and sensitive-content controls. Local by default. One-time purchase of $15 for up to 2 Macs, no subscription. Works on Apple silicon and Intel, macOS Sonoma 14 or later.

name: ASOClimb
tagline: ASO keyword research and rank tracking for indie apps
description: ASOClimb helps indie app developers rank higher on the App Store and Google Play with keyword research, daily rank tracking and competitor keyword gaps. ASOClimb is an app store optimization tool for the App Store and Google Play, built for indie developers and small app teams. It tracks keyword ranks daily by store and country, shows the terms a competitor ranks for that you don't, checks your title, subtitle and keyword fields for wasted characters, and drafts listing copy from the keywords you track. It also has review themes with reply drafts, competitor listing change alerts, top charts, a weekly digest, webhooks, and an API and MCP server. Free plan with every feature at small monthly volumes and no card; Pro is $10 a month or $100 a year for up to 50 apps.

name: Lyria 3 Pro
tagline: AI music generator for full-length custom tracks
description: Lyria 3 Pro is an online AI music generator for longer custom tracks, instrumentals, jingles, and soundtrack ideas. Free to try in the browser.

name: Seedream 6.0 AI
tagline: Seedream 6.0 AI image generator online
description: Seedream 6.0 AI generates images from text prompts and references, with image editing and HD downloads, plus prompt workflow guides.

name: Emagia Cash Application  Software
tagline: Automate Cash Application. Accelerate Payments. Improve Cash Visibility.
description: Emagia Cash Application Automation Software helps businesses automate payment matching, remittance processing, invoice reconciliation, and cash posting. Its AI-native capabilities help accounts receivable teams reduce manual work, improve cash application accuracy, resolve payment exceptions, and accelerate the order-to-cash process. Emagia supports enterprise finance teams in improving cash visibility and managing receivables more efficiently.

name: CFor Calculators
tagline: 31 free online calculators for finance, construction, fitness and education.
description: Free online calculators for finance, construction, fitness and education — 31 tools including home addition cost, loan and RPE calculators. Simple inputs, instant results, no sign-up.

name: duct tape ai
tagline: AI image generation and editing in one place
description: Duct Tape AI is an online AI image generator for prompt-based creation, editing, and text rendering. Credit-based downloads, built for teams that need images fast.

name: Slovio
tagline: AI-Powered Customer Engagement Platform for Every Conversation
description: Slovio is an AI customer engagement platform for businesses in India, offering AI chatbots, AI Agents, AI Calling, WhatsApp automation, customer support automation, lead generation, appointment booking, campaigns, CRM, and omnichannel messaging. Businesses can engage customers on WhatsApp, Instagram, RCS, SMS, web chat, email, and phone calls from one platform. Slovio helps businesses automate sales, support, lead qualification, follow-ups, and bookings while giving teams a unified customer inbox and CRM.

name: CalcRight
tagline: Free mortgage and loan calculators for the US, Canada and Australia
description: CalcRight gives homebuyers and borrowers clear mortgage and loan numbers without sign-ups or paywalls. Country-specific calculators for the US, Canada and Australia include local taxes, insurance, PMI and full amortization tables, with instant scenario comparison. Free, no account, available in English, French (Canada) and Spanish (US).

name: BrandPatrol
tagline: Stop Brand Bidding & Ad Hijackers
description: BrandPatrol scans paid search for affiliates and hijackers running ads on your branded keywords, follows the tracking/redirect link back to whoever placed it, cross-checks your authorized partner roster, and turns each incident into evidence-grade, timestamped cases (SERP and landing-page screenshots, full redirect chain, country, device) your team can act on. It works from public data only — no access to your ad accounts, affiliate platform or CRM is needed. Available as a one-time snapshot audit or continuous monitoring.

name: Avatiko
tagline: Create AI influencers and put them in your videos.
description: Avatiko is an AI influencer generator for creators, shops and brands. Design a character once - face, hairstyle, outfit and style - and reuse it so every video and image shows the same recognizable person. Upload a reference video or paste a video link, and your character takes the place of the person in it, repeating the original moves, gestures and timing. Make UGC-style product ads, promo videos and daily short clips without hiring a creator or scheduling a shoot. Freemium: your first character image is free.

name: Miraj News Now
tagline: Urdu news coverage from Pakistan and around the world
description: Miraj News Now is an Urdu-language online news publication covering Pakistan news, world affairs, business, sports and culture with daily reporting.

name: Global Prism
tagline: Global news, business and technology coverage in English
description: Global Prism is an English-language online news publication covering world news, business, technology, sports and culture with daily reporting and analysis.

name: JustPDFit
tagline: Free PDF tools in your browser
description: Free privacy-first PDF tools to create, merge, split, annotate, edit and sign PDFs in your browser. No account needed. Advanced PDF editor; exports free with clickable JustPDFit watermark, optional watermark removal for €1.99. Available in 27 languages.

name: FrameTest
tagline: Free browser FPS and frame-time testing with adjustable animation workloads
description: FrameTest helps developers and browser users inspect animation smoothness. It measures requestAnimationFrame timestamp intervals, shows live FPS and frame-time statistics, and offers an adjustable moving-ball workload and motion comparisons. The free English and Chinese interfaces need no account or installation. Results describe browser callback timing, not hardware refresh rate or game FPS. Submitted by an authorized representative of FrameTest.

name: OraStage
tagline: AI video generator that turns two photos into a Hotel Lobby rap-duo video
description: OraStage is an AI video generator that turns two photos into a short Hotel Lobby-style rap-duo video. Upload two photos, choose the format (9:16 or 16:9), and generate a 5-15 second MP4 with an original AI beat. It is built for quick social clips, memes and promotional videos. New accounts receive 10 free credits, and failed jobs refund credits. The workflow is browser-based and requires no video editing experience.

name: Velapic
tagline: Free AI-generated images & HD wallpapers, no sign-up
description: Velapic is a free library of high-resolution AI-generated images and phone & desktop wallpapers. Free for commercial use, no sign-up, no watermark.

name: AI Santa Video
tagline: Personalized AI Santa videos that say your child's name
description: AI Santa Video helps parents make a personalized Santa Claus video message for a child. Pick one of nine magical scenes, add the child's first name or nickname and your own words, and Santa speaks the message in any of 13 languages. No photo of the child is required — Santa is the only person on screen. You can hear how Santa says the name for free before buying. Messages are reviewed for kid-safe content. Credits are sold as one-time packs from $9.99 with no subscription, and credits never expire. Works in the browser on phone or computer.

name: ToolFigure
tagline: Free online calculators and converters
description: ToolFigure offers hundreds of free online calculators and unit converters — finance, health, math, date and everyday tools — with verified results and no sign-up required.

name: Macswarm
tagline: A hosted Mac for Claude Code and Codex
description: Macswarm runs macOS Pods on Apple silicon so Claude Code and Codex can build and test iOS apps with Xcode and Simulators. Free includes 3 Pod-hours without a card. Pro is $99 per month, Team is $399, and Enterprise starts at $3,000 per month.

name: DoorFound
tagline: Show first-time visitors the right door with one photo link
description: DoorFound helps places with hard-to-find entrances (upstairs clinics, in-mall studios, laneway venues) make a photo step-by-step guide to their door and share it as one link. It's free to create and share.

name: CollabPin
tagline: Collect client and team feedback directly on websites, keep every comment in context, and collaborate without traditional accounts.
description:
CollabPin is a Chrome extension for collecting and managing website feedback directly on the page being reviewed.

Clients and team members can click any website element, leave contextual feedback, reply to comments, assign items, and mark them open or resolved without relying on scattered screenshots, email threads, or messaging apps.

Project owners manage collaborations from Chrome, while invited collaborators can join without creating a traditional account or buying their own license.

CollabPin is built for web designers, developers, agencies, product teams, and anyone who needs a simpler way to review websites with clients or teammates.

name: Central Alberta After Dark
tagline: Platonic community for Central Alberta night owls & shift workers
description: Central Alberta After Dark is a free platonic friendship and community platform for night-shift workers and night owls in Red Deer, Edmonton, and Central Alberta. Share schedules to meet local buddies for coffee, gaming, gym, or fishing. Android app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.centralalbertaafterdark.app | Support: https://www.paypal.com/donate?hosted_button_id=UE9MSKDH4ULH2

name: SoundTest
tagline: Free browser noise meter: live dB/dBA and LAeq, GPS evidence photos, SHA-256 reports. Audio never leaves your device.
description: SoundTest measures environmental noise in your browser. Live dB/dBA, LAeq, GPS-stamped evidence photos and tamper-evident PDF/CSV/JSON reports. Free; Pro $24.99/year. A documentation-grade reference tool, not a certified sound level meter.

name: RabbitCode
tagline: Independent API relay with prepaid request packs and time passes
description: Submitted by the RabbitCode operator. RabbitCode is an independent, unofficial API relay for developers. It offers prepaid request packs and time passes rather than automatic recurring subscriptions. The site provides client setup documentation and an account workspace for keys and usage. Current plans start at US$2.99; check the published pricing, limits and client compatibility before purchasing. RabbitCode is not affiliated with Anthropic, OpenAI or Google. API use requires an eligible plan; this listing does not promise free credits or an active promotional code.

name: FranVetted
tagline: Independent franchise due-diligence platform with a free library of 1,447 FDDs covering 4,700+ brands.
description: FranVetted is an independent franchise due-diligence platform. Search 4,700+ brands and read free FDDs (Items 7, 19, 20) before you invest. Single-brand audit reports from $39.

name: Servana
tagline: Booking pages for US local service pros, with a "Request a Quote" form and a Booking Agent that follows up and sends qualified requests.
description:
Servana is a booking platform for local service pros in the US: cleaners, organizers, handymen, pet services, event photographers and other local service businesses.

Each vendor gets a clean, shareable vendor page with a "Request a Quote" form. Servana's Booking Agent captures details and follows up with customers, sending the vendor only qualified requests ready to book. The vendor can accept or decline as needed.

Vendors customize the page with their rates and service areas, can edit it anytime, and can add "quote on request". Customers can browse local providers by city and category on Servana, compare profiles and message providers directly.

Pricing: Currently free during launch, pricing coming soon.

name: GifLoom
tagline: Free browser-based animated GIF editing tools
description: GifLoom provides free browser-local tools to compress, resize, reverse, merge, trim and split animated GIFs, extract frames, convert GIFs to WebP and more. Files stay in the browser, with no account or watermark.

name: The Even Table
tagline: Free calculators and printable worksheets for splitting bills, rent, and receipt items.
description: The Even Table offers browser-based tools for splitting shared expenses. Its receipt splitter allocates selected receipt items among named participants, while rent and bill calculators help groups compare allocation methods. Printable templates support recording and checking amounts. Users should confirm entered amounts and agree on their own sharing rules.

name: Wavebench
tagline: Free browser audio editing with on-device processing
description: Wavebench is a collection of free browser-based audio tools for trimming, joining, converting and adjusting recordings. It includes volume and bass controls, audio effects, metadata editing and tools for voice and music. Audio files stay on your device, and the core tools can be used without creating an account.

name: ClipNoter
tagline: Video to Notes — AI Video Note Taker with Key Frames.
description: ClipNoter is an AI video note taker. Upload one MP4, MOV, or WebM file and get a timestamped transcript, summary, key points, and timed sections, with optional key frames. Export Markdown, ZIP+images, TXT, SRT, or VTT. Start free with weekly credits.

name: ClipStills
tagline: Extract video frames at original size, right in your browser
description: ClipStills is a browser-based video frame extractor. Save stills at original dimensions as lossless PNG or high-quality JPG, with no upload and no watermark. Use frames for thumbnails, reference images, presentations and storyboards.

name: dar-ion
tagline: AI chat, images and video with optional prepaid credits
description: dar-ion is a browser-based AI workspace for writing, exploring ideas, creating images and generating video. Start with 10 guest chat messages without an account or payment card. name: UIUF Lighting
