name: Colab Content
tagline: Custom AI systems your business owns, built in Boston.
description:
ColabContent is a Boston AI consulting company, formed in 2020 and led by founder Brandon Rodriguez. We build custom AI systems that the client owns at handoff: the code, the prompts and the accounts. There are no per user fees and no hourly rates.

Work starts with a first piece built on sample data before any fee, or with the $499 AI-Ready Audit (money back) for an owner who wants the whole business looked at first. Custom systems start from $10,000, with a fixed fee for each phase and a written acceptance test before a phase counts as done. You can stop after any phase and keep what was built. Optional care after handoff is $997 a month and cancels on 30 days notice.

We have delivered 40+ builds (counted September 2026). For Jim Glaser Law we built five AI phone lines, one per advertising channel, which handled 3,787 calls (counted August 2026); Jim Glaser takes reference calls. We also built a practice platform for a law firm that holds 13,296 matters and reconciles client trust accounts every night (measured August 2026).

name: UploadOff

Image tools: HEIC to JPG or PNG with the date taken kept; WebP, PNG and JPG to each other; AVIF to JPG; SVG to PNG. Compress an image to a set size such as under 200 KB, resize to a width, crop to a frame or an exact size, rotate and flip.

PDF tools: images, Markdown, HTML or text to PDF; merge, split and rotate; remove pages; PDF pages to PNG or JPG.

Batches download as a ZIP. A finished result offers a Next step: the file goes straight to the next tool, with no download and re-upload in between. It is a web page, so there is nothing to install or update, and it works on phones, tablets, Windows and Mac alike.

name: Paceflow
tagline: Performance Review and 1:1 for Engineering managers
description:
Paceflow - Helping Engineering Managers Lead Better Teams

Managing engineers isn't just about making sure projects get delivered. It's about understanding the people doing the work, recognizing their contributions, helping them grow, and making difficult decisions fairly.

But that becomes increasingly difficult as teams grow.

An engineering manager might be responsible for several engineers, each working on different projects, facing different challenges, and contributing in ways that aren't always visible.

Some engineers ship features. Others prevent incidents, mentor teammates, resolve complex technical problems, or keep critical systems running. All of that work matters, but not all of it is easy to see or measure.

And when it's time for a performance review, a promotion decision, or a difficult feedback conversation, managers are often left trying to reconstruct months of work from scattered information and memory.

**Paceflow helps engineering managers understand what's actually happening in their teams, so they can lead with context rather than assumptions.**

Instead of spending hours gathering information from different tools, managers can focus on understanding each engineer's contributions, identifying where support is needed, and making decisions based on real evidence.

That changes how everyday management works.

Performance reviews become conversations supported by specific examples, rather than judgments influenced by recent events or personal impressions.

One-on-ones become opportunities to discuss challenges, growth, and meaningful feedback, rather than another meeting spent asking for status updates.

Engineers get clearer expectations, better recognition for their work, and a stronger understanding of what they need to improve or achieve to progress in their careers.

And managers can identify problems earlier, offer support when it matters, and follow through on the commitments they make to their teams.

Paceflow isn't about monitoring engineers or reducing their performance to activity metrics. It's about giving managers the context they need to exercise better judgment while keeping engineers informed about the information used to understand their work.

**Because good engineering management isn't about tracking everything people do. It's about understanding their contributions, removing obstacles, and helping them succeed.**

Paceflow makes that easier, helping engineering managers build teams where expectations are clear, contributions are recognized, feedback is useful, and people have the support they need to do their best work.

name: 巧手打字通
tagline: 打字练习,打字训练,打字游戏,打字工具
description:
1.1 网站简介
巧手打字通（https://laidazi.com）是一款专为初学者设计的在线打字练习网站，以其友好的界面和丰富的练习内容深受家长和孩子们的喜爱。平台提供了从基础到高级的多种练习模式，适合不同年龄段的孩子使用。
1.2 主要特点
儿童友好界面：界面设计简洁明了，色彩鲜艳，符合儿童的审美习惯，能够有效吸引孩子的注意力。
循序渐进的学习模式：从最基本的字母练习开始，逐步过渡到单词、句子和段落的练习，帮助孩子逐步提高打字速度和准确性。
趣味性练习：通过游戏化的练习方式，如打字比赛、打字闯关等，激发孩子的学习兴趣，让打字练习不再枯燥。
实时反馈与奖励机制：提供实时反馈，帮助孩子及时纠正错误，并通过奖励机制激励孩子不断进步。
打字竞技比赛：可以与其他小伙伴一起进行在线打字比赛。
1.3 使用建议
每日练习：建议孩子每天进行15-30分钟的练习，逐步提高打字速度和准确性。
家长陪伴：在孩子初学阶段，家长可以陪伴孩子一起练习，帮助孩子克服困难，增强学习信心。
1.4 应用场景
学生党练基础：刚学打字的小朋友，用它纠正 “一指禅” 的坏习惯，打课文里的句子还能帮着预习复习；高中生想提升英语词汇量，练托福雅思单词的时候顺便把打字速度提上去，写作文、查资料都更顺手。
老师辅助教学：语文课让学生打生字词，英语课练单词拼写，既活跃课堂，又能让学生熟练键盘，以后用电脑做作业更高效。
想提升效率的人：不管是上班族还是普通人，打字慢总耽误事，用它系统练一阵，查资料、发消息都能快不少，还不用死记硬背键盘位置，靠练习形成肌肉记忆。
总的来说，这就是个 “边学边练” 的打字辅助工具，把学习和打字结合得很巧妙，不管是学生还是想提升打字速度的人，用起来都觉得实用又不枯燥。

Cases stay in the user’s browser; no account or case upload is required. This is a free public beta, independent of marketplaces, and it does not automatically submit disputes or guarantee refunds.

name: Personalized Song Gift
tagline: A personalized song gift with their name in the chorus, written from your story.
description: A personalized song gift with their name in the chorus, written from your story. Hear two versions free in minutes, then keep the one that sounds like them. Type their name and a few real details (how you met, the inside joke, the nickname), pick genre, tempo and voice, and two sung versions come back in one to three minutes. Unlock one to get both MP3s, the lyrics and a gift page with a QR code. One song is $9.99, three are $19.99, paid once with no subscription.

name: Booking Path Checkup
tagline: A free checklist for reviewing public booking and quote paths.
description: A free, browser-based self-check for service businesses that accept appointments or quote requests. Walk through eight manual checks on a public route, record what you observe, then download your notes or build a prompt for an AI assistant you choose. This tool does not inspect or change websites, call an AI model, send your notes to iTeam, or predict bookings. No account, upload, or API key.

name: TailGPT
tagline: An AI agent that answers every visitor from your own pages
description: We built TailGPT for businesses whose website is where enquiries start: clinics, coaching institutes, real estate firms, travel agencies. Paste one script tag and an AI agent appears on your site, no plugin needed. It reads only the pages you tick and any files you upload, so when someone asks "Are you open on Saturday?" the reply comes from your own page. If the answer is not there, it says so. Every fact it gives is checked against the source page. No AI is perfect, and we would rather you see that up front: test it in the dashboard and check which page each answer used. When a visitor wants to go further, it asks for a name and phone number and adds them to your leads list and Google Sheet. The dashboard also lists the questions your website doesn't answer, most asked first. It is not a helpdesk: it won't look up orders, book, refund or hand off to a person.

name: PWA² Advanced Website Audit
tagline: Advanced Website Audits for SEO and Performance
description:
PWA² Advanced Website Audit is a website auditing tool developed by Hendler.pro, designed for SEO professionals, digital marketers, agencies, and website owners.

The platform helps users identify technical SEO issues, evaluate website performance, review user experience, and discover opportunities for conversion optimization.

PWA² combines multiple areas of website analysis into structured reports with prioritized findings and actionable recommendations.

Key benefits:

- Technical SEO analysis to identify website optimization issues.
- Website performance assessment to highlight potential improvements.
- User experience and conversion-related analysis.
- Clear, structured reports with practical recommendations.
- A streamlined auditing process that reduces manual analysis.

PWA² helps businesses and marketing professionals better understand website health, identify opportunities for improvement, and make informed optimization decisions.

Developed by Hendler.pro, PWA² aims to make professional website auditing more accessible and actionable.

name: Vault-Seek
tagline: Trace clues from a forgotten crypto gift, reward or airdrop
description: Vault-Seek helps people investigate whether an old crypto gift, app reward or airdrop left a trace. Start with the platform name, an approximate date, an old email or a public transaction ID. Vault-Seek helps check what can be verified and never asks for private keys or a recovery phrase. There is no upfront fee. A success fee relates to assets actually recovered under the agreed terms.

name: SIGNUM HQ
tagline: US stocks: expected earnings move before the report, actual move after
description: US stocks: the expected earnings move before the report, and what actually happened after. SIGNUM HQ is a US stocks app with an earnings calendar, the options-implied expected move, after-report scoring of the actual reaction against that range, alerts for the stocks you follow, and short AI summaries. Information only, not investment advice.

name: OmniaKey
tagline: Unified AI API for text, image, video and music models
description: OmniaKey provides a unified AI API for developers building agents and applications. It offers OpenAI-compatible text endpoints and asynchronous image, video and music generation through one prepaid account. Developers can compare supported models and pricing, integrate with coding tools, and track usage in one dashboard.

name: Numalio
tagline: Free online calculators with formulas and worked examples
description: Numalio provides free browser-based calculators for percentages, ratios, fractions, averages, geometry, unit conversion and selected finance scenarios. Each tool explains its inputs and calculation method and includes worked examples. No account is needed. Available in English, Turkish, German and Spanish.

name: WidgetCalc
tagline: Embeddable lead-gen calculators for your website, no code
description: WidgetCalc lets small businesses and agencies build ROI, pricing and savings calculators from ready-made templates and embed them on any website in minutes to capture leads. Built and operated by an AI-run company, Rock Software Oy.

name: Flag Maker
tagline: Free browser flag maker: 28 layouts, 197 country templates, SVG/PNG/HOI4 TGA—no account.
description: Flag Maker draws each layout to its real proportions at the ratio you choose, then saves SVG, a 9,000-pixel PNG or a Hearts of Iron IV TGA set. 28 layouts, 197 country flags to start from, 172 emblems, colour checks inspired by NAVA’s Good Flag Bad Flag. No account, watermark, download limit or ads—design stays in your browser.

name: Listing Bench
tagline: Etsy listing audits that explain every deduction and rewrite weak copy in your voice
description: Listing Bench helps Etsy sellers improve existing listings. It checks titles, tags and description openings against marketplace limits, quotes the phrases that need work, and explains each rule. Sellers can paste listing details or connect a shop through read-only access, then rewrite weak sections in their own voice. A product photo can also be used to draft a listing. The initial audit is free with no card required.

name: LevelSpender
tagline: Know your numbers in two minutes
description: LevelSpender is three free money calculators that run in your browser. The 50/30/20 budget calculator turns take-home pay into needs, wants, and savings targets. The debt payoff calculator compares snowball and avalanche on your own debts and shows a debt-free month and the interest you will pay. The subscription calculator totals what small monthly charges really add up to. Results update as you type, and nothing you type is stored or sent anywhere. Educational only, never financial advice. Free, no account, built by Reseed LLC.

name: PlantTasks
tagline: A watering schedule for your actual plants
description: PlantTasks builds a watering schedule around the plants you actually own. Pick from a 60 plant library with care guides and photos, see next watering dates, and print the list or export repeating calendar reminders. A sitter sheet hands your plants to a friend while you are away, and a winter mode stretches intervals for low light. Every interval is a starting point for a typical home, so the schedule reminds you to check the soil, and the soil decides. Free, no account, built by Reseed LLC.

name: LevelFiles
tagline: Free file tools that never upload your files
description: LevelFiles is five free file tools that run entirely in your browser. Merge PDFs, compress and convert images to a target size, turn images into a PDF, split a PDF or pull pages out, and stamp, number, or clean a PDF. Your files are read on your device, worked on in memory, and downloaded straight back to you. There is no upload step, no account, and no file history. The page keeps a copy of its own code on your device, so the tools keep working offline after the first visit. Free, no ads, built by Reseed LLC.

name: Workpex CRM
tagline: Leads, calls and follow-ups, all in one CRM
description:
Workpex is a sales and lead management CRM built for small and growing businesses. It brings every lead, call and follow-up into one place, so your sales team never misses an opportunity.

Key features:

Lead management: capture and assign leads from multiple sources automatically
Call tracking & recording: log and review every sales call
GPS tracking: see field sales visits and routes in real time.
Follow-up reminders: automated alerts so no lead goes cold
WhatsApp integration and a mobile app for iOS and Android

Workpex suits telecalling teams, field sales teams, and sales managers who want clear visibility into team performance. Plans start at ₹599/user/month.

name: NanoPic
tagline: Edit photos by text with image-to-image AI
description: NanoPic edits existing photos from a plain-language instruction instead of layers, masks or brushes. It can restore and colorize old prints, remove tourists and objects, swap product-photo backgrounds, change season or weather, restyle portraits as Ghibli, Pixar or anime art, and preview new hair colors or outfits while keeping the subject intact. Users pick GPT Image 2/2.5 or Nano Banana 2/2.1/Pro per request, and new accounts get 10 free credits with no card required.

name: Mons
tagline: Continue the same coding-agent terminal session on iPhone and iPad
description:
Mons is a native iPhone and iPad terminal for developers who use coding agents on their own Mac or Linux host. Start work at a computer, continue the same persistent terminal session on iPhone, then use iPad when you want more room. Keep your existing agent accounts and tools.

The public TestFlight beta is available at https://testflight.apple.com/join/QrKBvj5S. A host that stays awake and online with SSH enabled is required. Setup instructions and an illustrated three-device workflow are at https://mons.cc/beta.html. Mons is a paid product with trial access; it does not include an AI model subscription.

name: ReplyDesk
tagline: Done-for-you Google review replies for local businesses
description: ReplyDesk writes and posts thoughtful replies to every Google review for local businesses (restaurants, dentists, contractors, salons). The owner gets 3 free sample replies first, then it's a flat $49/month. No setup, and the owner approves the tone.

name: Create AI Tattoo
tagline: Create your next tattoo with AI. Choose a style, explore personal ideas and download your design.
description: Create personal tattoo concepts with AI, compare visual styles and prepare a clear reference for your tattoo artist.

name: PhotoRestore
tagline: Photo restoration that revives every detail
description: PhotoRestore is an AI photo restoration tool that repairs scratches, dust, fading, and color loss, and sharpens faces while preserving textures. Slide to compare the original against the restored image. Every job generates three versions so you can pick the best one. It works on color and black-and-white photos (optional colorization), supports JPG and PNG, and exports in 1K, 2K, or 4K. Private by default.

name: NovelSift
tagline: Discover web novels across romance and fantasy
description: NovelSift helps readers discover web novels across romance and fantasy. Browse genres, tropes, curated lists, and reading editions to find your next read. Free, no login needed.

name: YATools
tagline: 78 free online tools — PDFs, images, audio, QR codes, converters. No signup, no watermarks.
description: YATools is a free collection of 78 online tools — PDF converters, image compressors, background remover, text-to-speech, QR generator, calculators and more. Everything runs in your browser, no sign-up or watermarks.

name: English Rove
tagline: English practice resource for A1–B2 learners
description: English Rove is an English practice resource for A1–B2 learners, with lessons and activities in grammar, vocabulary, reading, listening, use of English, and writing, plus explanations and review. Free.

name: Blox Fruits Trade Calculator
tagline: Check Win / Fair / Loss before accepting a Blox Fruits trade.
description: Free Blox Fruits trade value calculator for Roblox — check Win / Fair / Loss before accepting a trade. Compare Physical vs Permanent fruit values, with demand ratings. Example values: Dragon 5.6B, Kitsune 700M.

name: Mervadon: NotebookLM Workspace
tagline: Capture pages and selections into NotebookLM without constant tab switching
description: Local-first Chrome extension for NotebookLM research workflows. Capture webpage text or a selected passage into a local inbox, then import into a chosen notebook. Browse notebooks, sources, and artifacts using your existing signed-in NotebookLM session. Artifact generation runs through NotebookLM. Independent project—not affiliated with or endorsed by Google or NotebookLM.

name: Lovart ME
tagline: On Lovart ME, a design agent sits at the center of Lovart AI. Type a brief for a poster, card or social graphic, or begin with an image,
description: On Lovart ME, a design agent sits at the center of Lovart AI. Type a brief for a poster, card or social graphic, or begin with an image, and the agent drafts the visual; a short video is optional.

name: MyPetMath
tagline: Free dog and cat calculators that show the vet math.
description: MyPetMath is a free site of dog and cat calculators for everyday questions: age in human years, pregnancy due dates, daily calories, food portions, puppy growth and chocolate toxicity. Each tool uses published veterinary formulas (AAHA, WSAVA, NRC and Merck), shows step-by-step math, and links to its sources. There is no sign-up and nothing to buy. Results are estimates for healthy pets, not veterinary advice, and every page says when to check with a vet. Free widgets include no ads or tracking.

name: Deleted Tweet Finder
tagline: Find saved tweet snapshots by username or tweet link
description: Deleted Tweet Finder searches saved snapshots of public X/Twitter tweet pages. Preview by username or check a link for free. Paid archives process up to the newest 1,000 tweets found, with search, filters, CSV/JSON export and 30-day private access.

name: MyRecipes
tagline: Find home-cooking recipes by name, meal or ingredients
description: MyRecipes is a free recipe-search website for home cooks. Search by recipe name, meal or ingredients, then view ingredient quantities and step-by-step cooking instructions without creating an account. The website offers English, German, French, Italian and Spanish editions, with links to companion iPhone, iPad and Android apps.

name: YoAIRap
tagline: Turn your photos into AI rap videos
description: YoAIRap is a web-based AI rap video generator. Add a photo of a person, a pet or a drawn character, type what the rap should be about, and the AI writes rhyming lyrics, picks a hip-hop beat and renders a 15 or 30 second video of the photo performing the song with vocals. Hot templates also remake viral rap memes such as Hotel Lobby with your faces (template clips are silent). Lyrics in 35 languages; watermark-free MP4 in 9:16 or 16:9 up to 1080p. Paid, from $4.99 per video.

name: Launcholio
tagline: Free SEO audits and launch tools for indie founders
description: Launcholio helps indie founders audit their websites with practical SEO reports, sitemap error checks, and re-scans after fixes. It also provides directory listing verification and evidence-based guides for SaaS launches, with free basic tools and optional paid manual directory services.

name: WebTestNavi
tagline: Practice Japan's job-hunting web tests with AI photo explanations
description: WebTestNavi helps university students and job seekers prepare for Japan's SPI and Tamatebako web tests with practice questions, answers, explanations, and an AI photo solver.

name: AgentShed.io
tagline: Hand the repetitive work to an agent. Keep the decisions.
description: AgentShed is a free site of plain-English guides to AI agents and automation for small businesses and sole traders. Each guide walks through a real workflow step by step, says what the tools cost, and flags what can break, so owners can hand repetitive work to an agent and keep the decisions.

name: Fortnite Chest Tracker
tagline: Track Fortnite Treasure Hunt chests, collect weekly rewards, calculate drop chances, and plan your island route.
description:
Track Fortnite Treasure Hunt chests, collect weekly rewards, calculate drop chances, and plan your island route. Free, independent, and saved in your browser.

An independent Fortnite fan project. An independent companion for your Treasure Hunt chest log, collection, and island plans. Chest Tracker brings your manual chest counts, collected rewards, map pieces, and route notes into one place. Progress stays in your browser, and tracker backups can be exported without creating an account.

This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by Epic Games.

name: GuanPalm
tagline: AI palm reading cards for entertainment
description: GuanPalm is a browser-based AI palm reading tool for entertainment. Upload a palm photo to generate a magazine-style reading card based on traditional palmistry, with options in Traditional Chinese, Japanese and English. A free reading is available, with a paid deeper analysis option.

name: College Essay Checker
tagline: AI college essay grader: a 1–10 score and specific feedback
description: College Essay Checker is an AI grader for college application essays. Paste a Common App personal statement or a supplemental essay and, in about a minute, you get an overall score from 1 to 10 plus separate scores for hook, structure, voice, specificity, and grammar and style. The report names your strongest and weakest lines and explains why, lists the few changes to fix first, and gives notes on each area. The tool gives feedback, not rewrites: it does not write your essay for you. Essays are never published or used for training. It is an independent tool and is not affiliated with the Common App or any college. Your first review is free, with no account and no card; after that, one-time packs of 10, 30 or 60 reviews cost $9.90 to $29.90 and last a year, with no subscription.

name: TTSMint
tagline: Turn text into speech in your browser
description: TTSMint is a browser-based text-to-speech tool that converts written text into spoken audio. It offers AI voices for creators, educators and others making voiceovers or listening to written material. New users can try the service with introductory credits; paid options are also available.

name: Tooldex
tagline: AI tools directory that shows prices and real free plans
description: Tooldex is an AI tools directory that sorts more than 500 tools by the job you need done: writing, images and design, video, audio and voice, coding, research, productivity, marketing, education, data, automation, business and AI assistants. Each of the thirteen categories comes with a short guide on what to look for before you pick a tool. What makes it different is that it tells you what is actually free. For the most popular tools, Tooldex reads the official pricing and feature pages and writes down the plans, the free tier and its limits, along with the pages it used and the date it last checked. A dedicated "Free AI tools" list only includes tools with a confirmed free plan, and editor's picks give one strong starting point for each kind of job. A "Latest AI tools" section is updated every few days from public launch posts. Every listing links to the tool's official site, and makers can submit a new tool. The directory is free to use with no sign-up.

name: Brain Break Lab
tagline: Free classroom riddles, movement breaks and games
description: Brain Break Lab offers free riddles, movement breaks and browser games for elementary classrooms. Teachers can choose grade-tagged riddles, This or That and Would You Rather activities, and quick games. Presenter features include hidden answers, a timer and team scores. No account is required.

name: Normal Map Generator
tagline: Free normal, height and AO maps from any image in your browser
description: Normal Map Generator turns a texture, photo or sprite into a full set of material maps right in your browser: normal, height, roughness, metallic, ambient occlusion, edge and packed ORM. Drop in a PNG, JPG or WebP, tune maps on a live 3D preview (material ball, sphere, cube, your own .glb, .gltf or .obj model, and studio, outdoor or night lighting), then download a ready-made set for Unreal Engine, Unity, Unity HDRP, Godot or Blender, or every map separately. The free maps are made on your own device, so nothing is uploaded, there is no sign-up and there is no limit. Transparent sprites keep their outline, which makes it handy for 2D games with dynamic lighting as well as 3D materials. The free maps read height from brightness, which suits clean textures and sprites. For photos of real surfaces with shadows or mixed metal and non-metal parts, there is an optional AI texture set: an AI model built for PBR materials reads the surface and returns base colour, normal, roughness, height and metalness maps. New accounts get one free AI set; after that, one-time packs of 15, 50 or 150 sets cost $4.99 to $29.99 and last a year.

name: Daily Games Page
tagline: A free daily word ladder puzzle: change one letter at a time
description: Daily Games Page is a small, independent puzzle site built around Rungs, a free daily word ladder game. Each day you get a start word and a goal word, and you climb from one to the other by changing a single letter per step, with every rung a real four-letter word. Unlimited mode serves random ladders, and the site also publishes hints and answers for other popular daily word games. Everything is free, with no account and no app.

name: DuoShot
tagline: App Store screenshot generator for iOS devs, iPhone Duo included
description: DuoShot is a browser-based App Store screenshot studio for iOS developers: build iPhone and iPhone Duo screenshots at Apple's required sizes and export them as a ZIP. No install.

name: Photo to GIF
tagline: Turn one still photo into a looping animated GIF with AI
description: Photo to GIF is an online tool that turns a single still photo into a short animated GIF. Upload a portrait, a pet, a product shot or a drawing (JPG, PNG or WebP), describe in a few words how it should move, or tap a ready-made motion such as "wave hello", "blink and smile" or "wagging tail", and an AI image model draws eight new frames and plays them as a seamless loop. You don't need a video, extra frames or any editing software.

name: HeySupa
tagline: AI-powered operations for behavioral health practices
description: HeySupa is an AI-powered platform built to help behavioral health practices manage their everyday operations more efficiently. From administrative workflows and clinical documentation to revenue cycle management, HeySupa helps healthcare teams reduce manual work and spend more time focusing on patient care.

name: PagalHo
tagline: Free online calculators and everyday tools: age, percentage, word, unit, QR code and link tools.
description: Free online calculators and everyday tools: age, percentage, word, unit, QR code and link tools. All tools are free, run in the browser, with no sign-up.

name: Onsite Teams
tagline: Easy to Use. Hard to Breach.
description: Onsite is a construction management and ERP platform built for contractors, builders, EPC firms and growing construction businesses. Teams use it to plan budgets with BOQ and cost codes, track daily site progress, control materials and purchase orders, record labour attendance, manage subcontractors and handle billing and payments. It works on mobile and web, with Tally and Zoho Books integration.

name: ChatNory
tagline: AI chatbot for websites and WhatsApp that replies in 11 languages
description: ChatNory is an AI chatbot for websites and WhatsApp. It learns from your website, files and price list, then answers customers on website chat, WhatsApp, Messenger and Telegram in Bangla, English, Hindi, Arabic and more. It hands over to a human when needed, can check orders and book slots, and sets up in minutes with no code or as a WordPress plugin. Free plan available.

name: LaunchAssetKit
tagline: Free tools to launch your app — app pricing calculator, ASO keyword checker, screenshot sizes and a launch checklist.
description: LaunchAssetKit gives indie app makers free launch tools: an app pricing calculator that models subscription revenue and break-even, an ASO keyword checker, app store screenshot size guides, and a step-by-step app launch checklist, plus an affordable launch asset review service.

name: AwesomeDevKit
tagline: Free online developer tools — JSON formatter, cron parser, llms.txt validator and AI crawler access checker.
description: AwesomeDevKit is a free collection of browser-based developer tools: JSON formatter and validator, cron expression parser, regex tester, UUID generator, plus GEO tools — an llms.txt validator and an AI crawler access checker for AI search readiness.

name: Tintmill
tagline: AI image, photo editing and video creation studio
description: Tintmill helps visual creators generate images from text, edit photos and create short videos with a choice of AI models. Paid credits are shared across workflows. Eligible Google users can claim one free image, subject to a shared daily limit.

name: Transcribe Video: To The Text
tagline: Turn videos, audio and live voice into searchable text on iPhone.
description: Transcribe Video: To The Text is an iPhone app that turns video files, audio files, YouTube and Vimeo links, and live microphone recordings into searchable text. It can split the transcript by speaker, summarize it, and export to TXT or DOCX. A free tier is available; Pro unlocks more transcription time via in-app purchase.

name: MadeInRed
tagline: Free AI search audit & GEO readiness report for websites.
description: Free AI search/GEO audit: read-only checks of public pages, robots.txt and sitemaps, then score plus PDF/Markdown report after login.

name: RemakeAds
tagline: Discover what sells. Remake it.
description: RemakeAds helps find short-video ideas from sales-related snapshots, then remake creatives; public metrics cite Tabcut snapshots, not live data. Public video browsing is available without an account.

name: Valimail
tagline: Automated DMARC, SPF, DKIM and BIMI email authentication to stop phishing and domain spoofing.
description: Valimail, a DigiCert company, is a cloud DMARC platform that automates email authentication (DMARC, SPF, DKIM, and BIMI) to stop phishing and exact-domain spoofing. Monitor is free with no credit card; Enforce and Amplify are paid subscriptions. Founded in 2015. Headquarters: Boulder, Colorado.

name: AI Clothes Change
tagline: AI Clothes Change: change outfits in your photos
description: AI Clothes Change is an online photo outfit editor. Upload a portrait, describe a look, add a clothing reference or pick a template, then compare and download the edit. Includes 1K/2K output, clothes color changer, suit photo editor, AI photo editor, AI video generator and single-person face swaps. Credits-based paid plans start at $29.90/month.

name: Hop Hop Hop Dance
tagline: Turn two photos into playful dance videos
description: Hop Hop Hop Dance is a browser-based AI video tool that turns two photos into a silent eight-second vertical dance clip. Download an MP4 and add licensed audio in your social app. The site also explains the hop hop hop trend and how to film it yourself. Free trial clip, then optional one-time credit packs; no subscription.

name: Whisk AI
tagline: Try Whisk AI free with 10 signup credits
description: Whisk AI is an online workspace for AI image generation, reference remixing and image-to-video. Generate images from text, remix up to three subject/scene/style references, or animate a still image. Whisk AI is an independent creative workspace and is not an official Google Labs product.

name: Kling 4.0 AI
tagline: Create AI videos with Kling 4.0 on kling4.pro
description: Kling 4.0 AI is a browser-based AI video generator on kling4.pro for turning text prompts and photos into cinematic clips: text to video, image to video, text to image and Motion Control AI. Freemium with free signup credits; paid plans from $19.9/mo. kling4.pro is an independent product and does not claim an official Kuaishou Kling 4.0 release.

name: FestiveLooks
tagline: Turn one photo into a holiday portrait with AI
description: Upload one photo and get an AI holiday portrait of you, your family, your partner or your pet. Christmas is live with 20 looks. First photo free, no watermark. After that, each photo costs 1 credit.

name: Stitchidy
tagline: Find the embroidery designs you already own, without digging through folders
description:
Stitchidy is a Windows 10/11 desktop organizer for machine-embroidery designs. Turn scattered folders into a searchable collection, keep related sizes and formats together, and browse designs that fit your machine and hoops. Optional AI Smart Labeling identifies subjects and visible text in design previews, helping you find a birthday bear instead of remembering a filename. Original embroidery files stay on your computer; Smart Labeling processes previews online.

Try Stitchidy for free for Windows. The limited free version includes 100 manually labeled design families, three saved search tabs and 100 total family exports. Sign in to receive 50 starter Smart Label credits. A paid Full Version and additional Smart Label credits are available.

name: Aitopkit
tagline: Discover 203+ free AI tools — reviews, comparisons, guides
description: Aitopkit is a free AI tools directory with 203+ hand-reviewed tools, side-by-side comparisons, 439+ prompts, and daily AI news. No sign-up needed.

name: Random Pokemon Generator (Fan Tools)
tagline: Free browser tools: random Pokemon picker with filters, team picker, nuzlocke helper, smash-or-pass game, roulette and shiny odds.
description: Random Pokemon Generator is a free, fan-made web toolkit. Roll random Pokemon with filters, build challenge teams, spin a roulette, play smash-or-pass, and check shiny odds. No install, shareable results, Japanese pages under /ja/. Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Nintendo.

name: Meishiki
tagline: Free Japanese Four Pillars (四柱推命) chart with a short AI-generated reading. No sign-up.
description: Meishiki is a free Japanese-language Shichusuimei / Four Pillars (命式) chart tool with English and Chinese versions. Enter birth date, time and place for a chart and short AI-generated reading, optional fuller interpretation. Cultural exploration only, not scientific/medical/investment advice.

name: Bazi Pan
tagline: Free BaZi (Four Pillars) birth chart with a short AI-generated reading from birth date, time and place.
description: Bazi Pan is a free online BaZi / Four Pillars chart calculator in Traditional Chinese with Simplified and English versions. Enter a birth date, time and city; solar or lunar input and optional true solar time. Get a free chart and short AI-generated reading, with optional fuller interpretation. For cultural exploration and self-reflection, not scientific, medical or investment advice.

name: AIGPTImage
tagline: Private AI image studio for production-ready art
description: AIGPTImage is an independent AI image studio for people who need usable visuals. Describe an image, or upload up to 16 reference photos to edit or restyle, and get one to four results in several aspect ratios. Output runs from 1K to 4K. The credit cost appears before you generate, and your history stays private. Built-in tools handle background removal, upscaling, old photo restoration and image-to-prompt. New accounts get 20 free credits. AIGPTImage is an independent service and is not affiliated with OpenAI.

name: AI Raphael
tagline: Generate and edit images with plain-language prompts
description: AI Raphael (Raphael AI at airaphael.org) is a web-based AI image generator and photo editor. Type what you want, or upload a photo and describe the change in plain language. It keeps faces and characters consistent across edits, preserves the rest of the scene, and can blend several images into one. Extra tools cover background removal, upscaling, old photo restoration and image-to-prompt. It uses models such as Nano Banana Pro and GPT Image. New users get 10 free credits.

name: Duo Studio
tagline: Free in-browser App Store screenshot / mockup generator
description: Duo Studio is a free in-browser App Store screenshot and marketing-image generator. Place app screenshots in iPhone Duo (folded or unfolded), iPhone 17 Pro, or iPad Pro frames, add titles and a custom background, and export PNG or an ordered ZIP. No sign-up. Images are processed locally in the browser, not uploaded. Device frames are for layout and presentation and are not official Apple marketing assets.

name: WaveMira
tagline: Turn photos into stylized images and short videos
description: WaveMira turns photos and drawings into stylized images and short videos. Browse effect examples and input requirements in English or Chinese. Creating images or videos uses paid credits.

name: Zip Opener
tagline: Open ZIP, RAR & 7z on iPhone
description: Zip Opener is an iPhone utility for extracting ZIP, RAR, and 7z files, opening password-protected ZIP and RAR archives with their passwords, and creating ZIP archives. Preview common file types and share or save the ones you need. Free to download; some features require an in-app purchase. The app does not collect user data.

name: HiRentalsHQ

Cloud images are normalized to at most 768 by 768 pixels, and output is limited to 512 tokens.

Cloud packs cost $9.99 for 50 pages or $19.99 for 150 pages as one-time purchases. Cloud provider retention and training controls are unverified, so personal or confidential inputs must not be uploaded. This is not full-book conversion, general-language handwriting recognition or exact layout reconstruction. Shared Beta capacity can pause. Buying requires Google sign-in; pages are added to that account after a verified payment notification. An earlier private purchase key is backup only. Unknown requests are not automatically retried.

DenoiseKit is a browser-based speech-noise reducer for short voice recordings. Audio processing runs locally, so the recording is not uploaded to a cloud denoising service. Compare the source and processed audio before exporting a WAV file. Results depend on the recording and should be checked by listening.

The free tool supports up to five minutes per file and three successful runs per local day. Paid packs support files up to ten minutes, with $6.99 for 60 minutes or $14.99 for 180 minutes of processing. These are one-time purchases. Buying requires Google sign-in; minutes are added to that account after a verified payment notification. An earlier private access key is backup only. The tool is not music separation, echo removal or video editing, and it does not export MP3. Paid duration is rounded up per file.

name: PdfTableKit

PdfTableKit is a browser-based table extractor for people working with selectable-text PDF reports and lists. The selected PDF and grid are processed locally rather than uploaded for extraction.

The free tool allows three text pages per day, counted on the server and resetting at 00:00 UTC. One-time packs add 30 pages for $9 or 100 pages for $19. Buying requires Google sign-in; pages are added to that account after a verified payment notification. An earlier private purchase key is backup only. Scans, image tables and password-protected PDFs are outside this version. All spreadsheet values start as text, and manual proofreading is required.

Calculations and supported file processing run in the browser. File-size and browser-memory limits vary by tool. Practical guides include worked conversion examples.

Paste or share signals from Telegram, size trades by risk percentage, and track win rate, profit factor, drawdown and average R across separate virtual portfolios. Free with ads; no payments or subscriptions. The app does not place trades, connect to a broker or hold money, and no account is needed. Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aitradingbot. Signals are general information, not trading advice. Trading forex and gold on margin carries a high risk of loss; past results don't guarantee future results.

name: Alarm Clock
tagline: Free online alarms, countdown timers, and local event reminders
description: Alarm Clock is a free browser-based clock for everyday time management. Set alarms, run quick countdown timers, and add dated event reminders without an account. Kahrbon is workplace software built in The Woodlands, Texas, by founder Donovan Brown. It pairs two jobs most offices handle with separate tools.

Visitor management: guests check in at a kiosk, at the front desk or by scanning a QR code. Hosts are alerted by e-mail, in-app and in Microsoft Teams, a watchlist flags visitors who need attention, and the full visit log exports to CSV.

Teams Note Taker: meetings become speaker-labeled transcripts plus minutes that record decisions and action items with a named owner.

Kahrbon offers a 15-day free trial with no credit card. Paid plans are quoted by sales.

name: Flagish
tagline: Green flag or red flag? The party game for judging friends' takes.
description: Flagish is a free browser party game. Read a scenario, everyone votes green flag or red flag, then see who agrees. No sign-up, works on any phone, and you can share a link to challenge friends. The Everyday pack is free; Dating, Roommates, and Chaos Mode packs unlock for a one-time $4.99.

description: NexBill (nexbill.pro) helps freelancers and small businesses get paid without the awkward follow-ups. Premium adds Stripe payment links so clients can pay by card in a click, plus expense tracking and subscriptions. Plans: Basic $15/mo, Premium $39/mo. Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial.

name: Best AI Image Generator
tagline: Paid AI image generation and editing from text prompts or reference images in the browser.
description: Paid AI image generation and editing in the browser using text prompts or reference images, with upscaling, background removal, image extension, and SVG generation.

name: Proficio
tagline: SME credit intelligence for banks and MFIs.
description: Proficio is SME Credit Intelligence for banks and MFIs. Millions of small businesses are invisible to lenders. We make their value visible. Our platform, SMEVE, brings a valuation specialist's way of reading a business to every SME loan. It shows lenders the good businesses thin paperwork hides and gives the committee evidence to approve them and size the loan correctly. Your team writes the recommendation and the committee decides.

name: Colquhoun.shop
tagline: Read web pages, examine keyword density and explore imported analytics.
description: Colquhoun.shop is a browser-based website research workspace for website owners and marketers. It brings together public website metadata scanning, a web reader, keyword-density analysis and dashboards for imported analytics. Users can explore traffic channels, countries and keywords from their own measurements. Built-in page tools are public; additional research tools require owner-authorized access.

name: Seedream Best
tagline: Independent multi-model AI image studio. Text-to-image and image-to-image up to 4K. Start free.
description: Seedream Best is an independent, third-party AI image studio that brings several leading image models together in one workspace. It supports text-to-image and image-to-image generation, selectable aspect ratios and output up to 4K (4096x4096). Use it for social media visuals, marketing creatives, concept art and illustrations. Credit-based pricing, and new users can start free. Not affiliated with ByteDance, Google or OpenAI.

description: AI Viral Video is an AI video template site for social media trends. Pick a trend, upload one to three photos (solo, duo and pet templates), and get your own version of the trend. Pay per video with no subscription: a single video is $9.98, and packs start from $6.99 per video. Failed generations are refunded to your balance automatically, and uploaded photos are deleted after 30 days.

name: Mortmeter

Free, no signup, for fun. Beta, not medical advice.

Independent product, not affiliated with ByteDance or the official Dola app.

name: Topicut

description: Topicut offers free browser tools for planning YouTube documentaries, including a voice-over script template, an editable shot list, subtitle conversion, and frame extraction from your own video. Creators can also request a quote for documentary production.

name: ScanMySaaS
tagline: Website scans and AI security review for SaaS code

Website checks cover public headers, cookies, TLS, CORS and exposed files. Repository rules check committed secrets, dependency advisories, risky GitHub Actions and Supabase signals. Automated findings require verification and do not replace human review or penetration testing.

name: FindKeyBPM

description:
Essentia Memoria is an experimental browser-based 3D universe for self-reflection and exploration, currently in active development. Its emotional Atlas connects moods and places, alongside a reflective guide. Visitors can enter for free without an account; some additional capabilities are paid. Available activities and performance vary by build and device.

For people interested in creative digital experiences, the current world offers a way to explore the relationship between mood, place and meaning. Our longer-term aim is to develop infrastructure that helps people turn their strengths into professional creative work. This is a development direction, not a ready-made creator platform or community-hosting service.

Current scope and limitations: https://essentiamemoria.com/en/about

description: ToHD is a free AI video upscaler that runs entirely in your browser. No signup, no watermark, clips up to 10 minutes.

name: OutboxWatch
tagline: Free SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX and blacklist checker for cold email domains
description: OutboxWatch reads a sending domain's public DNS and checks SPF (including the 10-lookup limit and duplicate records), DKIM on common or custom selectors, DMARC, MX and domain blocklists such as Spamhaus DBL and SURBL, then explains each problem and how to fix it in plain English. The checker is free with no signup, and a free weekly email report covers one domain every Monday. Paid plans re-check domains daily and alert when something breaks. It is not a sending tool, warm-up service or inbox-placement test.

name: Email Header Analyzer
tagline: Free email header analyzer with SPF, DKIM, DMARC
description: The Email Header Analyzer turns a raw email header into a clear report. Paste any header dump to map each server hop with delays, read SPF, DKIM and DMARC results, flag spoofing signs such as Reply-To mismatches, and get a plain-English LLM explanation. It runs in the browser, stores nothing and needs no account. Built for IT admins, deliverability work and anyone checking a suspicious Outlook or Microsoft 365 message. Published by MailboxInsights, which also covers Outlook, Microsoft 365 and email guides.

name: TriviaEdge
tagline: Free Interactive Trivia Games
description: TriviaEdge offers free browser trivia across general knowledge, film, music, geography and science, with quick rounds, endless play and a daily challenge.

name: Decision Margin

description: Decision Margin offers guided journeys and browser-based calculators for comparing money, time, career choices and the economics of creator work.

name: Stuvelo

description: Stuvelo brings leads, projects, shot lists, client feedback, contracts and Stripe invoicing into one workspace for filmmakers and video studios.

tagline: Perpetual futures market intelligence for crypto, metals and energy.
description: PerpSignal Desk is a web-based perpetual futures market intelligence and analytics product of Apex Intelligence Analytics LLC for traders and market researchers. It brings price charts, order-book depth, executed trades, liquidity heatmaps, funding and open-interest analysis together across crypto, metals and energy markets. Free tools, educational guides and simulated paper trading are available, with paid upgrades for additional analytics. The public Cipher preview is simulated. It provides information and analytics and does not execute trades. Official representative: Casey Galos — Director of Operations & Client Relations. Current P logo: https://perpsignaldesk.com/brand/v2/icon-512.png . Official product details: https://perpsignaldesk.com/about .

name: Chess Move Finder

description: Browser-based Stockfish 17.1 chess analysis with FEN position input, PGN game review, tactics puzzles, and beginner lessons. No signup and no ads.

description: ShipGuard is a security scanner from AgenticCLI that your coding agent runs on each change, on your machine. It checks for leaked keys, open routes, unsigned payment webhooks, risky migrations and loose deployment configuration. Machine-readable JSON and exit codes let agents and CI act on findings. Source code available (Elastic-2.0).

name: Net Pay Calculator Canada
tagline: Free take-home pay calculator for Canada
description: Net Pay Calculator Canada is a free take-home pay calculator for all 13 Canadian provinces and territories. Enter a salary to see federal and provincial tax, CPP or QPP, and EI or QPIP deductions for 2026, plus plain-English guides to pay stubs, tax brackets, and salary comparisons. No sign-up required.

name: Loomwise Lead Lists
tagline: Fresh public-records lead lists (new LLCs, building permits, contractor licenses, federal contracts) as ready-to-use datasets.
description: Loomwise runs 22 pay-per-use data tools on the Apify Store that pull public government records: new business filings, building permits from 50 US cities, contractor licenses across 9 states, SAM.gov federal opportunities and awards, and SEC Form D raises. Free sample data and n8n/Make templates are at loomwise.app/data.

It is an independent community project and is not an official Grok Bot or xAI product.

name: Face Analysis
tagline: Free on-device AI face analysis & face shape tools
description: Free browser face analysis for a photo-geometry score, face shape, symmetry and related tools. Landmark detection runs on-device; original photos are not uploaded to our servers. Free core tools need no sign-up.

name: Kamriyal
tagline: Compare prices across Saudi retailers in SAR.
description: Kamriyal ("Kam Riyal?", meaning "how many riyals?") helps shoppers in Saudi Arabia find the lowest price before they buy. It compares what Saudi retailers charge for the products people check most, including smartphones, laptops, TVs, game consoles, graphics cards, headphones, monitors, smartwatches and PC components, with prices in SAR updated several times a day. Each product page shows how many stores carry it and which one is cheapest, so shoppers can compare offers in one place for free.

name: PSL Scale
tagline: Free AI face rating on the strict 1-8 PSL scale.
description: PSL Scale rates facial attractiveness with AI on the 1-8 PSL scale, where 4 is the true average - stricter and more meaningful than 1-10 scales. The AI analyzes 68 facial landmarks across 8 dimensions: symmetry, harmony, proportions, skin quality, facial structure, averageness, sexual dimorphism and memorability. Choose a Scientific breakdown or a Roast mode, get results in seconds, and receive a personalized improvement plan. Photos are never saved. Free evaluations available.

name: Trymusic AI
tagline: AI Song Generator — text or lyrics to royalty-free music in seconds.
description: Trymusic AI (trymusic.ai) is a browser-based AI Song Generator and music toolkit for creators. Paste any text or lyrics and get professional-quality, royalty-free tracks in seconds. Beyond text-to-song, it includes Cover, Extend, Stems, and Remove Vocals, plus light music-analysis helpers like tempo/key tools. No install required — ideal for short-form video soundtracks, podcast intros, indie demos, and everyday creative experiments.

tagline: Remove road cones, parking signs, and street barriers from city travel photos with Ediroo's object removal features.
description: Urban photos often include traffic signs, parked scooters, or warning cones. Ediroo lets photographers highlight these fixtures and replace them with matching street textures. Check sidewalk paving and facades after each generation.

name: Crealo AI
tagline: AI tools for marketing content and social media
description: Crealo AI helps agencies, small businesses and marketing teams create content with artificial intelligence. It brings together tools for marketing copy, ads, images, videos, voiceovers and social media content in one platform.

tagline: Calculator.now: 1,600+ free online calculators for finance, health, math, science, food and unit conversions. Fast, accurate, mobile-friendly, no sign-up.
description: Calculator.now is a free library of more than 1,600 online calculators. It covers mortgages, loans, taxes and retirement; BMI, calories, pregnancy and fitness; algebra, statistics, calculus and geometry; physics and chemistry; cooking and nutrition; and hundreds of unit, time and date converters. Every calculator shows instant results with clear breakdowns, formulas and worked examples, works on phones and desktops, and needs no account or download.

name: SermonRecap
tagline: Sunday's sermon, texted to your church Monday morning in English and Spanish.
description: SermonRecap helps pastors keep Sunday's message alive through the week. The pastor uploads sermon notes in whatever form they already use, such as a Word file, PDF, slides or plain text. On Sunday afternoon a preview arrives by phone, and the pastor approves it, asks for another version or skips the week. On Monday at 9 AM every member gets a text with a link to a clean, mobile-friendly recap: the message in about two minutes of reading, the pastor's own lines quoted word for word, key points with Scripture references, questions for families and small groups, a Bible reading for each day and a closing prayer. Spanish-speaking members receive the same recap in Spanish at the same minute, which makes it a natural fit for bilingual congregations. Nothing goes out without the pastor's approval, and members do not need to install an app. SermonRecap was built by Pastor Bernhard Suppan for his own church, New Life Hutto in Hutto, Texas. The first four Sundays are free with no card required.

name: AgentLingo
tagline: Five-minute, game-style lessons to pass the real estate salesperson exam, including Texas.
description: AgentLingo is a game-style study app for people working toward a real estate salesperson license. Instead of long video courses, it breaks exam prep into five-minute lessons with streaks, XP and quick practice questions, so studying fits into a lunch break or a commute. Content covers the national portion of the exam plus Texas-specific material, covering topics such as contracts, agency, property ownership, finance and license law. Free study guides on the site explain how many questions the Texas exam has, what it costs, how hard it is and how to prepare, and a free practice test lets learners check where they stand before exam day. The app is built for career changers, part-time students and anyone who has struggled to stay consistent with traditional prelicensing material. Progress tracking shows which subjects need more review, and short daily goals keep momentum going. The goal is simple: show up for five minutes a day and walk into the testing center ready.

Pay per video with one-time credits that never expire, failures auto-refunded, free 15-credit trial without a card.

description:
VOLT is built to notice moments: a fall, a possible fight, someone where they shouldn't be. VOLT detects possible handguns, long guns, and knives visible to the camera. A VOLT reviewer checks a moment by default before staff are notified.

VOLT is built to run on the cameras you already have. VOLT serves K-12 districts, colleges and universities, and other organizations.

Independent project, not affiliated with HP.

description: Chato is a multi-number WhatsApp web inbox for businesses. Connect several WhatsApp numbers, let your team reply from one shared inbox, assign conversations, and turn on an AI chatbot that answers common questions automatically around the clock. Pricing is simple: €5 per WhatsApp number per month. Used by businesses worldwide, especially in Brazil.

name: FixSTL
tagline: Check and repair STL files in your browser, free
description: FixSTL checks and repairs STL files directly in your browser, for anyone preparing models for 3D printing. Drop a file to see open boundaries, non-manifold edges and vertices, flipped normals, self-intersections and duplicate faces, then apply conservative repairs and download the result. Every repair is checked against the original surface and dropped if it would change the shape; the report says plainly what remains. Files are processed locally in a Web Worker and never uploaded. Free, no account, no watermark, no download limit. The engine is written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly. Built by Tripo.

Export ABC, MusicXML and MIDI.

name: Two Minute Drill Game
tagline: Free daily football challenge: two minutes, one drive, your call.
description: Two Minute Drill Game puts you in the headset for a late-game football drive. Read the defense, pick plays, manage the clock, and chase a winning touchdown in Daily, Practice, or Survivor modes. Situations draw from a historical game archive; outcomes are simulated. Free to play in the browser with device-local stats and an optional nickname leaderboard.

name: Nebula by BreachLine Labs
tagline: Fully autonomous AI security engineer that works for you.
description:
Nebula is a fully autonomous AI security engineer that works for you. It finds security flaws, proves impact with working exploits, explains the fix and retests it once you have made the change.

Nebula tests web apps, APIs, mobile, cloud and AI systems. Each finding comes with evidence and reproduction steps, is mapped to OWASP and MITRE ATT&CK, and is scored with CVSS.

You can talk to Nebula over a call or by email, and it can walk you through its findings as slides in a live video meeting. Small and non-technical teams use it as their security engineer. Technical and larger teams use it to refine their research, loop through findings and understand each one in depth. Retests use credits.

BreachLine Labs is based in London, sells worldwide and is Cyber Essentials certified by CDS Defence & Security.

name: MyType Test

Not a downloader and not for stripping marks from content you do not own.

name: CopyToInk
tagline: Turn PDFs, images, and typed text into handwriting on paper.

name: video translate
tagline: Video Translate: AI Video Translator in Your Voice
description:
Video Translate is a browser-based AI video translator at https://videotranslators.com. It helps YouTube creators, marketers, educators, and localization-minded teams **video translate** existing footage into new spoken languages without hiring a different narrator for every market.

Core workflow: sign in with Google when you are ready to run a job, upload MP4/MOV/WebM (up to 500 MB per file), pick source and target among 23 languages, and let the cloud pipeline dub your clip. Output is a downloadable MP4 where dialogue is translated and re-voiced using voice cloning aimed at your source timbre, background music stays in the mix, and timing follows your edit. That combination is what differentiates an **ai video translator** built for dubbing from generic caption-only tools.

Processing steps (simplified): vocal separation → speech recognition and translation → cloned speech synthesis → remix with non-vocal stems → export. You choose languages explicitly; the product does not auto-guess source language. Each job handles one upload at a time; link-based imports are not supported.

Languages supported in production (23): Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Russian, Portuguese, Arabic, Danish, Greek, Finnish, Hebrew, Hindi, Malay, Dutch, Norwegian, Polish, Swahili, Swedish, and Turkish—verify the live upload menu before quoting a list in a submission.

Getting started: Google sign-in grants 30 starter credits once (~30 seconds of dubbed output; valid one year; no card required to try). When you need more capacity, subscribe to Starter, Pro, or Studio (monthly or annual) or purchase a one-time credit pack. Dubbing consumes 1 credit per second of output (rounded up). Annual plans bill once per year with credits upfront; credit packs never expire. Studio and some annual/pack tiers note commercial use on the pricing page—follow live Terms and Pricing copy.

What Video Translate is not: it is not a desktop install, not unlimited free dubbing, and not a place to invent user counts or ratings for directories. Quality depends on clean single-speaker audio; overlapping speech and heavy noise reduce results like any speech-heavy pipeline. Uploaded media retention follows the published Privacy Policy (typically on the order of weeks unless stated otherwise on-site).

Platform: modern desktop and mobile browsers; English and Chinese UI. Checkout for paid plans uses Waffo Pancake secure payment (card details handled by the payment provider). Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, and Refund Policy are public. For directory editors and partners: support@videotranslators.com.

In short: Video Translate packages honest free trial credits and transparent per-second billing into an **AI video translator** focused on dubbed MP4 output—your voice, your music, 23 languages.

Organizers can manage player registrations, generate single- and double-elimination brackets, schedule matches, assign tables, and publish live scores and standings. Match results can also be kept private. The interactive bracket generator lets you try a draw for 4, 8, or 16 players in your browser without creating an account.

name: Planloom

tagline: Convert floor plan images into editable, layered DXF files.

Preview the traced layout free without an account, set a real-world scale from a known length, then download the DXF for AutoCAD or other compatible CAD software. One-time credit packs work without a required subscription; confirmed failed tasks restore generation credits (not an automatic cash refund). JPEG/PNG/WebP inputs up to 10 MB; download from My Films. name: Striptu
tagline: Stripe to local e-invoicing, automated
description:
Short description: Striptu syncs Stripe payments with local e-invoicing and accounting tools (InvoiceOcean, KSeF, Fakturownia, iFirma, wFirma, inFakt, QuickBooks, Sage and more). Automate invoice creation and delivery for 150+ apps like Kajabi, Substack and Podia — setup in about 5 minutes.

Long description:
Striptu connects Stripe to the accounting and e-invoicing systems businesses already use — so every Stripe payment becomes a compliant invoice without manual work.

Founders and online sellers often take payments in Stripe, then spend hours copying transactions into local invoicing tools. Striptu bridges that gap: connect Stripe once, pick your accounting destination (InvoiceOcean, Poland’s KSeF / Fakturownia / iFirma / wFirma / inFakt, QuickBooks, Sage, Zoho Invoice, and more), and invoices are created and delivered automatically after each payment.

It works with 150+ upstream tools that settle through Stripe — including Kajabi, Substack, Podia, MailerLite, LearnWorlds, Lovable and Replit — so digital products, subscriptions and courses stay bookkeeping-ready across borders. Setup typically takes a few minutes; the first 10 transactions are free to test, with no card required.

Striptu is built for operators who want Stripe’s checkout experience and local tax/invoicing compliance without spreadsheet glue or weekly firefighting.

Pricing: Freemium — the first 10 transactions are free, then from 11.99 EUR/month.

description: FormuCore helps startup ecommerce founders launch a supplement or cosmetic brand without an R&D team. Describe your product, get a costed formula, start free with 25 credits a month. Peakfinity Labs, a leading contract supplement and cosmetic manufacturer, makes the products.

name: Amia

description: Amia is a relationship-wellness app for iPhone and Android. It starts with a free Blueprint assessment about closeness, conflict, intimacy and shared direction. Amia is guided relationship practice, not therapy.
