tagline: Preview all 18 Minecraft armor trims on your own skin, free.
description: Free Minecraft armor trim generator: preview every trim on your skin, combine colors, screenshot. No install.

name: CSV Tidy Offline
tagline: Clean messy CSV files privately in your browser
description: CSV Tidy Offline fixes delimiters, trims whitespace, removes blank rows and duplicates, normalizes headers, and exports a clean CSV. Processing stays in the browser, so files are never uploaded. A focused privacy-first tool for analysts, small businesses, researchers, and anyone who needs a reliable spreadsheet cleanup before import.

name: IntoClouds
tagline: Cloud VPS, domains, DNS and business email in one panel
description: IntoClouds is a cloud hosting platform for developers and small teams. Manage VPS servers, domains, DNS records, business email and billing from one web control panel. VPS plans offer root access, SSH access and NVMe storage, with monthly billing. Business email and daily server backups are optional paid services. Migration planning and application setup can be discussed separately with the team.

name: PresuAI
tagline: Quotes and invoices for freelancers and SMBs in Spain
description: PresuAI helps freelancers and small businesses in Spain create itemized quotes, send a public link so the client can approve from their phone, turn an approved quote into an invoice in one click, and track payments and margin per job. It includes catalogs by trade, a receipt scanner, and works from the browser or a phone. 14-day Pro trial with no credit card.

name: Lock It: Calculator Vault
tagline: Calculator that opens a private vault when you unlock with your equation.
description: Android privacy vault for adults who share a phone. Looks like a normal calculator; your unlock equation plus equals opens on-device storage for photos, notes, passwords and 2FA with AES-256. Free with ads; optional Premium. Made by ITAPS LLC. Available now on Google Play; iPhone (iOS) coming soon. Search Google Play for "Lock It: Calculator Vault". Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.appfactory.calculator

name: LLM API Prices
tagline: Compare official LLM API prices with OpenRouter rates for the same workload.
description: LLM API Prices is an independent pricing reference that compares first-party official API rates with OpenRouter inference rates for the same models and workloads. Rates are normalized to USD per million tokens, with input, cached-input, and output kept separate. Free; no API key required.

name: EvidenceLens
tagline: Type a health claim in Japanese, get PubMed paper candidates with English abstracts
description: A free web tool for people who see a health or food claim online (e.g. "natto lowers blood pressure") and want to look at the research themselves. Enter the claim in everyday Japanese; it builds the PubMed search query (shown on screen) and lists matching paper candidates with study type and English abstracts. It does NOT judge whether the claim is true. No sign-up, no ads. Run by an AI agent on behalf of its owner.

name: PhishGlass
tagline: Assess suspicious messages with AI-assisted warning signs and verification guidance
description: PhishGlass by Reverse AI assesses user-submitted suspicious emails, messages, links, screenshots and QR codes, explaining warning signs and independent verification steps. It does not monitor inboxes, authenticate senders or guarantee safety. Use only permitted, redacted material. Free and paid personal plans are for non-commercial use; organisational security-programme use requires a commercial licence. Unavailable to customers in the European Union.

name: Deam
tagline: AI-native Office suite for PowerPoint power users
description: Deam is building an AI-native Office suite, starting with a Windows PowerPoint add-in. It combines AI assistance, advanced charts editable in PowerPoint, slide productivity tools and reusable brand assets for consulting and finance professionals. Individuals can join the waitlist, while teams can request a demo.

name: UtilzyHub
tagline: Free Online Tools That Make Everyday Tasks Easier.
description: UtilzyHub is a collection of free online tools designed to make everyday digital tasks easier. It offers simple and practical utilities for text conversion, Hindi language tools, network testing, and other everyday needs. No signup or complicated setup is required. Just open a tool, complete your task, and get your results instantly.

name: CleanPricer
tagline: Cleaning quotes with state price bands for residential cleaners
description: Android + web helper for residential cleaners: see typical U.S. state price bands, set your rate, send PDF quotes/invoices. Free Play download; optional Pro IAP (US public range $17.99–$299.99). Web Pro coming soon — not for sale.

name: Remove AI Traces
tagline: Find and remove every hidden AI trace in your text.
description: Your AI text is giving you away. Remove AI Traces finds and wipes hidden technical traces in seconds: hidden AI fingerprints, machine-generated artifacts, and copy-paste traces left behind by Claude, Gemini, and other AI tools, Markdown junk, look-alike letters, LLM syntax signatures, training-dataset artifacts, plus AI authorship clues and document creation fingerprints hidden inside Word files. 17 groups of traces, each one highlighted with its Unicode code, then removed and re-checked down to zero. Works with text from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Copilot in 12 languages. 100% private: everything runs in your browser, your text never leaves the page. No sign-up. Scanning is free and unlimited, and invisible characters and Markdown are removed free every day. Paste, click, copy into Word, Google Docs or email, and publish clean. The fastest way to remove AI traces from any text or .docx. Try it free.

name: WriteMeASong
tagline: Some words deserve a melody.
description: WriteMeASong is an AI song maker for personal gifts and stories. Pick a person or topic, or paste your own lyrics, edit the drafts, and an AI singer performs a finished song of about 2:30. Free 45-second preview, shareable gift page.

name: ZenBurst
tagline: Your AI Chief of Staff for a healthier, more focused workday.
description:
ZenBurst is an AI-powered workplace wellbeing assistant built for Slack. It helps teams build healthier work habits through personalized focus sessions, timely break reminders, interactive break activities, and a points-based engagement experience.

Designed with privacy in mind, ZenBurst works with activity signals such as presence and time since the last break rather than reading employees' private Slack message content. Its goal is to make workplace wellbeing practical, engaging, and part of the everyday workday.

name: Fournigo
tagline: Find Moroccan wholesalers and compare supplier quotes.
description: Fournigo helps Moroccan retailers, restaurants and procurement teams find wholesalers and compare quotes in Moroccan dirhams. Its free quote calculator accounts for quantities, delivery charges and landed unit cost.

name: NectarHub
tagline: Free online tools and a private productivity workspace
description: NectarHub combines 52 free online tools with a private productivity workspace. Use PDF, image, writing, invoice, calculator, CSV and QR tools without signing in. Many tools process files on your device; AI-assisted writing offers a local-only option. Sign in to organize tasks, notes, bookmarks, budgets, tables and time.

name: PaperBanana
tagline: AI Academic Diagram Generator
description: PaperBanana turns plain-text descriptions into publication-ready scientific diagrams with editable SVG, serving research and education workflows.

name: GuruTrans
tagline: AI Translation and Text Tools
description: Browser-based AI translation, style rewriting, and text converters.

name: TrustedQuotes
tagline: Free insurance planning calculators and educational guides
description: TrustedQuotes provides free ACA subsidy and life insurance coverage calculators alongside educational guides for individuals, families and self-employed people. Explore health, life, dental and vision coverage and request help comparing eligible options. Calculator results are estimates, not guaranteed premiums or eligibility.

name: Flits
tagline: Turn screenshots into editable calendar events
description: Flits is an iOS and Android app that extracts dates, times and event details from screenshots, photos and pasted text. Users can review and save events to their calendars. It includes ten free AI scans each month.

name: Gold VPN
tagline: Prepaid VPN access with emailed activation and setup guidance
description: Gold VPN offers encrypted VPN connections with flexible prepaid plans and no automatic renewal. Customers receive login details by email after checkout, with setup guidance available through the website.

name: OpenStays
tagline: OpenStays - AI WhatsApp Booking Assistant
description: OpenStays helps hotels, homestays and resorts take bookings directly from guests. Its AI answers guest enquiries on the property WhatsApp number and negotiates within limits the owner sets.

name: ZombieTrendMaker
tagline: Make a short zombie love-story trend video from two photos for social platforms.
description: Zombie Trend Maker turns two photos into a 12-second vertical zombie love-story clip for TikTok, Reels, or Shorts. Both people must be adults who agree to appear; public figures are not accepted. One-time credit packs are available, with no subscription.

name: CharaGacha
tagline: Create original characters with AI art, names, personalities, and backstories.
description: CharaGacha creates an original character from a short description, with a portrait, name, personality, and backstory. Users can choose an art style and export PNGs, then reuse characters for emotes, PNGTuber frames, chibi art, and VTuber sheets. Guests get one free creation daily; name and backstory generators are free.

name: Unmix Studio
tagline: Online AI stem splitter, vocal remover, and audio-to-MIDI tools for musicians.
description: Unmix Studio separates songs into vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano, and other stems, or removes vocals for instrumental and karaoke tracks. It includes many focused audio tools and free in-browser audio-to-MIDI. New accounts get 5 free credits, with optional one-time credit packs.

name: TrendVideoMaker
tagline: Turn a photo into a short vertical video for a viral trend, ready for social media.
description: Trend Video Maker lets users pick a video trend, upload an adult participant’s photo, and generate a short vertical MP4 for TikTok, Reels, or Shorts. Each trend has a fixed story and needs no prompt. Credit packs are one-time purchases; there is no subscription, and participants must consent.

name: SelfieHue
tagline: Free color analysis and face-shape detection from a selfie, with hairstyle and hair-color try-ons.
description: SelfieHue analyzes a selfie for color season and face shape, and lets people preview hairstyles, hair colors, and beards on their own photo. Color analysis is free and requires no sign-up; try-on images and detailed reports use optional one-time credit packs.

name: YesToTheOffer
tagline: Desktop AI interview assistant with real-time transcription, answer guidance, coding help, and review.
description: YesToTheOffer is a desktop AI interview assistant for macOS and Windows. It transcribes interview questions in real time and suggests structured answer guidance; coding questions can be captured for an approach and reference code. New users get up to 30 minutes free without a credit card, followed by one-time minute packs. Use it in line with each employer’s interview rules.

name: CrayonSheet
tagline: Free printable coloring pages and AI tools for custom coloring pages, stencils, and line art.
description: Crayon Sheet offers free printable coloring pages across many themes, plus tools to turn a photo or written idea into a coloring page or line art, create stencils and paint-by-number pages, and build coloring-book PDFs. Name coloring pages and the mandala generator are free; guests get one free AI page a day.

name: AstroVellum
tagline: Free astrology, tarot, and numerology calculators plus AI-written readings.
description: AstroVellum provides free no-account astrology and numerology calculators, tarot draws, and card meanings, plus AI-written birth chart, dream, and palm readings. AI readings use optional one-time credit packs; free calculators and tarot tools are available without an account. For entertainment purposes only.

name: AI Text Cleaner
tagline: Clean formatting artifacts from text copied from AI chatbots; runs in your browser.
description: AI Text Cleaner fixes formatting problems in text copied from ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. It removes invisible characters and unusual spaces, straightens curly quotes, replaces dashes and ellipses, strips Markdown, collapses extra spaces, and normalizes Unicode. Text is processed in your browser and is not uploaded. Free, no sign-up.

name: Chatflow
tagline: No-code AI agent for automated customer support
description: Chatflow is a no-code AI agent platform trained on your website pages, documents, PDFs, and FAQs. It answers customer questions using your business content, captures leads, and hands complex conversations to a person. Teams can set its tone and behavior, embed it on a website, and connect it with tools such as Slack, Help Scout, WhatsApp, Zendesk, Facebook Messenger, and Zapier. A free trial is available before a paid plan.

name: PDFree
tagline: Free browser-based PDF tools with local file processing
description: PDFree provides free browser-based tools to merge, split, compress, convert and edit PDF files. Files are processed locally on your device without uploading them for processing. No account is required. The interface supports 16 languages, including English, Russian and Arabic.

name: pixelate.video
tagline: Blur or pixelate faces in video, privately
description: Need to hide a bystander's face or a licence plate before you post? pixelate.video detects faces and follows them through the clip, and you can add your own boxes for plates, documents or screens. Choose mosaic, blur or black box and adjust strength and size. Because the footage is processed on your device, sensitive video is never sent to a server, which makes it a fit for journalists, teachers, parents and anyone sharing clips of the public. No watermark, no sign-up.

name: chart.video

description: chart.video is for anyone who wants their data to move: YouTubers making bar chart races, teachers, analysts and marketers. Your data stays on your device.

name: recorder.video

description: recorder.video is a screen recorder that works the moment the page loads. Pick what to capture: a whole screen, a window or tab, a webcam bubble over the screen, or voice only. No account, no watermark and nothing to install.

name: Mentbot
tagline: Automate public and private replies to Facebook and Instagram comments.
description: Mentbot is a browser-based SaaS for automating comments on Facebook and Instagram professional accounts. Mentbot can also like and hide comments and send Telegram alerts for unread messages. All plans include the same features and unlimited Facebook Pages, with different daily reply quotas. description: I Got An Internship is a free internship board for college and MBA students in the US and Canada. There are no reposts and no full-time roles. A three-question onboarding builds a plan, and students can filter for visa sponsorship, track applications, save roles, and set alerts. Resume parsing fills in a profile.

description: A marketplace for working software. Builders list free and sell non-exclusive licenses. Buyers watch the demo, pay once, and get the code.

description: ShipChargeCheck helps U.S. businesses review their own domestic, single-package UPS billing CSVs against explicit final-net JSON rate rules. Email partners@shipchargecheck.com with your shipping setup first, without invoices or customer details. Any report sharing requires a separately agreed scope.

name: Classic Game Online

description: Classic Game Online lets visitors play older console and arcade games in a browser. Free with ads; personal, non-commercial use. The site states it does not host copyrighted ROM files on its servers.

description: Clueffy Game helps you find the little browser game you saw in a video, by name, character or scene, then play it or read its guide and mission answers.

description: QCEX is an open-source (AGPL-3.0) spot-exchange and ledger sandbox for prototyping, training and demos. It supports BTC/USDT and ETH/USDT using live reference data, simulated wallets and an append-only MySQL ledger. It is not production-ready, holds no real funds and includes no KYC, custody or licensing. Quantellics offers customisation and deployment support.

name: Mashup Atlas
tagline: AI game mashups: play in browser or find PC mods
description: Mashup Atlas is a searchable catalogue of AI game mashups: play browser games without installing, or check what each PC mod needs before you download.

description: TapEX is an open-source (AGPL-3.0) tap-to-trade paper-trading engine for education and prototyping. description: Image26 is a paid AI image studio for GPT Image 2.6 Flare and Sunburst, plus GPT Image 2, Nano Banana Pro and Seedream 5.0 Pro. Create, edit, upscale and expand images in the browser. Plans start at $9.9 a month. Independent, not affiliated with OpenAI.

name: Revenue Operator

description: Bytekind is a set of simple, free AI tools for small nonprofit staff. Free to start with optional Plus upgrades. Built for busy operators, not IT teams.

name: Try3AM

description: Try3AM offers a seven-day self-guided sleep program based on CBT-I principles. It does not diagnose or treat medical conditions.

name: StudySim
tagline: Turn your class notes into flashcards, quizzes & guides

First 3 letters free; Companion $9.8/mo or $79/yr, or a one-time 7-Day Reset for $19.

name: Chinese Stroke Order AI Teacher

description: AI Chinese Teacher on Chinese Stroke Order pairs conversation practice with stroke-order and HSK tools. Related practice tools stay available in the same workspace.

name: Merchant CSV Lab
tagline: Free browser CSV reports for Shopify and Etsy sellers
description: Merchant CSV Lab provides three free browser tools: compare supported Shopify product CSVs for price and field changes, create line-item packing sheets from order exports, and summarize supported Etsy statement activity separately from payouts. CSV contents stay in the browser. No store connection or signup is needed for the free tools. Worked examples and format limits are included. Optional $9 offline ZIP copies provide the same core checks. Reports do not update a store or verify accounting results.

name: OfferBanner
tagline: Schedule promotional banners for your website
description: Add a promotional banner to your website with one script tag. Schedule its start and end dates on the Free plan. Pro adds country targeting and creates promotion codes in your own Stripe account. OfferBanner also has a free countdown timer generator, sales calendar, discount calculator and coupon code generator.

name: Morse Code AI Coach
tagline: Learn Morse code with an AI coach and guided listening practice.
description: Morse Code AI Coach is an online assistant for learning Morse code. You can ask about characters, timing and history, request audio examples such as a word or phrase, and practice listening, starting with a few characters such as K and M and adding characters or speed as your accuracy improves. Conversations and progress are saved to your account. Signed-in accounts get 2 AI answers per day, and Plus and Pro plans add daily credits.

name: TuneImage
tagline: Upload one photo, describe the edit in plain English, and get a 1K PNG back.
description: TuneImage is a browser-based AI photo editor. Upload one image, describe the change you want in plain English, and download one 1K PNG. Common uses include changing outfits in a portrait (for example sweater to denim jacket, T-shirt to blazer, a full navy suit, or a dress with boots), recoloring items in a photo, creating product-photo looks, and turning couple photos into anime-style art. Results vary from image to image: it does not promise perfect faces, hair, or exact colors, and it is not a size-prediction or exact retail try-on tool. You can try one free guest edit while daily spots last, or sign in for up to four free edits in total (including the guest edit). After that, one-time credit packs start at $6.99 for 60 edits via PayPal — no subscription.

name: RapVisuals
tagline: Turn two photos into silent AI rap-style videos.
description: RapVisuals is a browser-based AI video tool for playful personal clips and social posts. It turns two photos into a short, fixed-template rap-style performance and exports a silent 720p MP4. Users add the song separately on TikTok. Video generation requires an account and paid credits; limited free still previews are available in supported regions. Voice cloning is not offered.

name: Pet Year Calculator
tagline: Free dog and cat age calculator — find out how old your pet is in human years, with breed and size charts.
description: Free pet age calculator: convert your dog or cat's age to human years by breed and size, with age charts and care tips.

name: History by Date
tagline: Browse what happened on any calendar date worldwide.
description: History by Date is an on-this-day history site covering all 366 calendar dates. Explore sourced event summaries with continent, country, and topic filters, plus links to Wikipedia sources. Available in English and Simplified Chinese.

name: Center Frame
tagline: Managed long-form YouTube production for real estate agents.
description: Center Frame is a managed YouTube production service for real estate agents. Agents record; Center Frame handles channel direction with Kyle Mark, human-reviewed scripts, editing, thumbnails, titles, descriptions and upload-ready packages for long-form videos (up to two 10–15 minute videos a week). Pricing is $995 USD per month with a six-month minimum; applying is free and there is no free tier.

name: NewsletterVerdict Email Cost Calculator
tagline: Free calculator comparing newsletter platform email costs for creators
description: NewsletterVerdict's free Email Cost Calculator estimates what creators pay to send newsletters across popular platforms. Pair it with fair, side-by-side newsletter platform comparisons so you can pick tools without hype or invented stats.

name: SampLab Pro
tagline: Compose original songs or backing tracks using daily creative audio credits.
description:
Receive 50 credits at registration and 10 credits daily to generate instrumental arrangements or full vocal songs from descriptions and custom lyrics.

SampLab Pro enables producers and songwriters to hear their ideas in seconds. Describe a musical genre or submit custom lyrics to create full tracks or instrumental backgrounds with the AI music generator. Every registered user receives 50 free credits to start, supplemented by 10 credits on daily check-in, with no checkout required. Visit https://samplab.pro/

name: SOS A股 Agent Gateway
tagline: Free, no-signup A-share market facts API for AI agents
description: Free, no-signup, no-API-key gateway for China A-share intraday market facts. GET /v1/market returns real limit-up/limit-down/lianban counts, highest board, sentiment, themes, turnover and per-source fetch times. POST /v1/verify checks one-sentence claims against that data. POST /v1/publish only queues a task for human review (no auto execution). If upstream is unavailable the API returns 502 and never serves cached values. Local stdio MCP tools included. Current external calls: 0.

Independent Development and Modular Architecture
Development began on June 16, 2026, as an independent project founded in Latvia.
AIIIA Castle is developed using an AI-assisted engineering workflow and a modular architecture that brings together conversational AI, backend services, persistent account data, user authentication, and interactive web interfaces.
The project focuses on combining technologies that are often presented separately: AI companions (Characters from Warm till Femdom role-play), gamification, digital art, personal activity tools, and community participation.
This modular approach is intended to support continued development and the introduction of additional AI capabilities without requiring a complete redesign of the ecosystem.
Our Vision
Artificial intelligence is becoming increasingly accessible, but many AI products still focus on individual conversations or isolated productivity tasks.
AIIIA Castle explores a different direction: an interactive environment in which AI companionship, creativity, and community participation become parts of one connected experience.
Our goal is to build a recognizable digital destination where users can interact with distinct AI personalities, earn participation rewards, discover independent artists, and contribute to an evolving community.
The project is currently growing through its Telegram-based platform, continued product development, and early community participation.
AIIIA Castle welcomes beta testers, artists, early adopters, and potential collaborators who are interested in helping shape the next stage of this AI-powered ecosystem.

name: AskMed
tagline: Cited medical answers for doctors, from journals and guidelines
description:
AskMed is an AI medical assistant for healthcare professionals. Ask a clinical question and get a clear answer where every claim links to its source: peer-reviewed journals, clinical guidelines and official drug labels. If no trusted source supports an answer, AskMed says so instead of guessing. It is not a symptom checker. Available on iPhone, iPad, Android and the web in 7 languages.

Who it is for
AskMed is built for doctors, nurses, medical students, pharmacists and researchers. It is meant for people who already work with medical evidence and want to reach the right source faster. It is a tool for education and reference, not a substitute for clinical supervision or professional judgment.

How it works
You type a question in plain language, the same way you would ask a colleague. AskMed searches medical literature, clinical guidelines and drug labels, then writes a short, structured explanation. Each statement in the answer carries a citation, so you can open the original paper, guideline or label and read it yourself. Source filters let you narrow down where the answer comes from, and research tools help you go deeper on a topic. Because AI responses and citations can contain errors, AskMed is designed so that checking the source takes one tap. Always check each source's publication date and the latest official guidance, since information may be incomplete or outdated.

Why not a general chatbot?
General chatbots often give answers without real references, and searching PubMed by hand takes a long time. AskMed combines both: it answers in seconds and shows the evidence behind every claim. Guidelines and drug labels are built in, so there is no need to run separate searches. Guideline coverage is global, not limited to one country.

For every specialty
AskMed covers questions across internal medicine, family medicine, surgery, pediatrics, OB/GYN, psychiatry, emergency medicine, cardiology, neurology, oncology, anesthesia, radiology and dermatology.

Typical uses
Checking a guideline between patients, reviewing a drug interaction before counseling a patient, preparing for journal club, studying for medical exams alongside your usual materials, and looking up evidence during night shifts when there is no one else to ask.

Privacy and independence
Conversations are encrypted and never sold. AskMed shows no pharma advertising and is built independently, without pharma sponsorship.

Pricing and platforms
AskMed is a paid subscription, from $24.99/month. It runs on iOS, iPadOS, Android and the web, in 7 languages. If you subscribe in the app, you can cancel with one tap in your Apple subscription settings; on the website, use Manage subscription on your account page. AskMed is made by Loop Studio, founded by Quan Quach.

description: TextRemover.org is a free AI text remover: upload an image or photo and erase captions, watermarks and overlaid text while the background gets filled in. Works on mobile, no install.

name: removebackground.si
tagline: Remove photo backgrounds and refine transparent cutouts
description: A browser tool for removing backgrounds from portraits and product photos. Refine cutouts with Erase and Restore, then export a transparent PNG or use a white or solid background. Guests receive two free images per day; paid credits and subscriptions are available for additional use. Processing is limited to a 1,024-pixel long edge.

name: RizCraft
tagline: Free browser tools: PDF editor, Arabic, Urdu and Hindi text to PDF, no signup.
description: RizCraft is a free set of browser tools with no signup and no watermark. It includes a PDF editor with real redaction, text to PDF with proper right-to-left Arabic and Urdu and correctly shaped Hindi and Bengali, code to PDF, code to image, plus web utilities like view page source, website URL extractor, iframe tester, and audio and video trimming. Files are processed in the browser.

name: Mike AI
tagline: Straight answers on cars, contractors and homes.
description: Mike AI is an AI advisor built by Doer Tough LLC for big-money decisions. Paste a VIN to see what a used car is worth, get a contractor quote checked for padding, get practical home repair guidance, and run the numbers on a real estate deal. Works in your browser; free 7-day trial, no credit card.

name: AbodeVid
tagline: AI video, real estate, photo to video, AI video generator, property marketing, real estate video, slideshow maker, social media
description:
AbodeVid is an AI-powered real estate video maker and property marketing platform designed for real estate agents, brokers, agencies, and property photographers.

Transform existing listing photos into cinematic property videos without filming or complicated editing. Create videos in 16:9 landscape, 9:16 vertical, and 1:1 square formats.

Premium campaigns include an integrated Real Estate Marketing Kit featuring single-property websites, branded brochures, social media marketing content, buyer lead capture tools, and seller-facing materials.

Standard campaigns start at $9.99 per property, Cinematic 30 costs $19.99, and Pro is available for $35/month.

A separate free slideshow maker offers two watermarked creations every 30 days.

name: Seat & Gather
tagline: Assign wedding guests to tables and export a seating plan
description: Seat & Gather helps couples organize guests into tables, check table capacity and prepare a table-by-table seating plan. Assign guests manually, then export XLSX or CSV or print the plan for your venue. It focuses on table assignments rather than drawing a venue floor plan. Five exported plan versions are free; downloading an unchanged version again does not use another action. Further access to this website costs $5 once, with no subscription and no account required before purchase.

name: BuildQuote
tagline: Turn your quantities and prices into an itemized construction estimate
description: BuildQuote helps small contractors turn their own quantities and unit prices into an itemized estimate. Enter project details and line items, review totals, then export CSV or print the estimate. It does not provide a regional cost database, takeoffs or actual job-cost tracking. Five successful estimate generations are free. Further access to this website costs $5 once, with no subscription and no account required before purchase.

name: AITranscribe
tagline: Transcribe video and audio to text and SRT/VTT subtitles
description: AITranscribe turns video and audio files into text transcripts and TXT, SRT or VTT subtitles, with in-browser Whisper or Workers AI. Free tier after sign-in.

name: Blank Page Writer
tagline: Distraction-free online notepad in your browser
description: Blank Page Writer is a distraction-free online notepad. Click and start typing, then share a link, download a PDF or text file.

name: ToSCORM
tagline: Convert PowerPoint to SCORM packages online
description: ToSCORM converts PowerPoint .pptx files into LMS-ready SCORM 1.2 or SCORM 2004 ZIP packages online. Preview free and get 2 free exports every month.

name: Panelcraft
tagline: Create matching Twitch info panels and download a PNG set
description: Panelcraft is a browser tool for streamers who want a matching set of channel information panels. Choose labels and colors, preview a set, and export 320 × 100 PNG panels individually or in a ZIP. Five successful generations are free; further access to this website costs $5 once, with no subscription. No account is required before purchase. This tool is independent of Twitch.

name: ToolNestCalc
tagline: Free online calculators — salary tax, gratuity, Zakat, visa eligibility
description: ToolNestCalc offers free online calculators — salary tax, end-of-service gratuity, Zakat, and visa eligibility checkers — each researched from the official legal text and test-checked before publishing. No account, no fees, everything runs in the browser.

name: AEO Inspector
tagline: Check if ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and other AI crawlers can read your site
description: AEO Inspector grades how readable and citable your website is to major AI answer engines. Free scan covers crawler access, agent readiness, and a fix list so pages show up in AI answers.

name: CopyrightChecker
tagline: Free music copyright checker for videos and MP3s: identify the song, see who owns it and how likely YouTube or TikTok is to flag it, with royalty-free alternati
description: CopyrightChecker is a music copyright checker for video creators. Upload a video, MP3 or other audio file and it fingerprints the audio against a 150M+ track library, then returns a report: the song title, artist, label or distributor, ISRC and release year; a plain-language platform risk level for YouTube and TikTok; for full scans, where the music plays in every 12-second segment; and royalty-free swaps to use instead. Free checks scan short clips (3 per day); files are deleted after 24 hours. Full-video scans are a paid option.

name: AI Calculators
tagline: AI-related cost calculators (LLM API cost, prompt caching savings, AI ROI, VRAM, RAG token budget, AI video cost, etc.)
description: AI-related cost calculators (LLM API cost, prompt caching savings, AI ROI, VRAM, RAG token budget, AI video cost, etc.)

name: problems
tagline: Capture agent errors, publish a status page, and return known fixes to keep agents on track.
description:
Problems captures the errors agents hit in your product, posts them to an agent status page, and steers agents back on track.

See which tools and commands agents call, spot recurring failures, and inspect recent error occurrences. Recurring problems appear automatically on the status page and clear after five quiet minutes.

Add Problems to an MCP server or CLI with the @problemsdev/sdk npm package.

name: Scientific Calculator Free
tagline: Free online scientific calculator with Casio-style interface
description: Free online scientific calculator with Casio-style interface, 9 languages. Includes a percentage calculator and age calculator. No sign-up needed — students, teachers and engineers can compute right in the browser.

name: Pixel Avatar Generator
tagline: Turn photos into 8-bit, GameBoy, retro or anime pixel avatars
description: Pixel Avatar Generator turns a photo into a pixel art avatar in the browser. Upload a portrait, choose one of five styles — 8-Bit Classic, GameBoy, Retro 16-Bit, Cyberpunk, or Anime Pixel — and the AI redraws the face in that palette. Output size is selectable at 128, 256, 512, or 1024px with adjustable color mode and background. It is built for Discord, Steam and Telegram profile pictures, streaming overlays, and game projects. New users get five free generations.

name: Lullaby Converter
tagline: Turn a song into a gentle music-box lullaby.
description: Turn a recording or YouTube link into a gentle music-box arrangement. Hear a free preview, adjust the arrangement and tempo, then make a one-off purchase of the full lullaby to export audio and share a listening link. No subscription.

name: Ozil Goal AI (ozil-goal-ai.org)
tagline: Turn your photo into a short AI football goal video.
description: Ozil Goal AI is a browser-based photo-to-video tool for adult football fans and short-video creators. Upload one photo of yourself or an adult who has given permission, then use a fixed template to generate an original fictional football goal scene. The requested output is an 8-second, 720p vertical MP4 with sound. Buy one-time credit packs; each generation uses 10 credits. There is no subscription or free video allowance. Free photo-preparation and prompt tools are separate from paid video generation. Review completed videos, save them in your private library and download the MP4. AI likeness, clothing and ball movement can vary. Independent project, not affiliated with Mesut Ozil, any club or tournament.

name: SolidCraft
tagline: Parametric 3D CAD in your browser — plus PartBatch for CSV-driven variants.
description: SolidCraft lets you design parametric 3D parts right in your browser—no install required for the web editor. PartBatch rebuilds one design once per CSV row, exporting mounting plates, brackets, boxes, and more. Start free with up to 3 variants per batch; prepaid credits unlock larger runs with no subscription.

name: Monstro X
tagline: Member management for gyms and martial arts schools, with leaderboards, rewards and community.
description: Monstro X gives gyms, martial arts schools and studios a single place to manage members and keep them engaged. Leaderboards, rewards and community features turn training into a shared challenge, helping owners improve retention and build loyalty.

name: Prizm
tagline: Your CV and cover letter tailored to every job offer in a minute
description: Prizm helps job seekers apply better without losing their evenings to it. Paste a job offer and Prizm starts with an honest fit verdict: how well your profile matches, what is strong, what is missing. Then you decide whether it is worth applying. If it is, Prizm tailors your CV and cover letter to that offer in under a minute, using only your real background. It never invents experience or skills. Templates are clean and readable by applicant tracking systems (ATS). Free to start (5 applications per week, the verdict is always free), then one-time packs with no subscription. Built in France for graduates, professionals, apprentices and career changers.

name: StateLicense
tagline: Contractor license verification API for platforms
description: StateLicense is an independent contractor license lookup and data platform for marketplaces, home-service platforms and any business that needs to confirm a contractor is properly licensed. Search by business name or verify a license number against live public records, then match identity, license class, specialties and dates. Coverage today: Alaska, Arkansas, Arizona, California (CSLB), Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Iowa, Minnesota, New York City, New York State public-work registry, Oregon, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia and Washington. Use the web dashboard or integrate with API keys. Try it free: up to 10 public searches or verifications per day without an account. The Pro plan ($49/mo) supports growing verification workflows.

name: SECODE
tagline: Practise secure coding and AI security through interactive exercises.
description:
SECODE is a browser-based security-training platform for developers, engineering teams and educators. It combines language-specific secure-coding missions, Python security exercises, AI-security learning and short security lessons. Learners work through scenarios, quizzes and explanations to practise decisions about input validation, web application security, prompt injection, AI agents and MCP risks.

A practical starting point is Python Security Quest, which opens with a registration-input validation scenario. Some modules are marked beta, and access varies by module and plan. The first Python question and answer feedback were available without sign-in during our check.

name: Feeculate
tagline: Free reseller fee calculators for eBay, Etsy, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop and more. Rates from official fee pages.
description: Feeculate is a set of free fee and profit calculators for online resellers: eBay (US, UK, Canada, Australia), Etsy, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Vinted, Whatnot, StockX, GOAT, Grailed, Reverb, TCGplayer, Facebook Marketplace and PayPal. Every rate comes from the marketplace's own fee page, each source and checked date is listed at https://feeculate.com/fee-sources/, and the calculators run in the browser with no sign-up, no login and no data uploaded.

name: TokScript
tagline: Turn social videos into editable transcripts and subtitles.
description: TokScript transcribes individual TikTok, YouTube and Instagram video links into editable text. Review the transcript and export TXT, SRT or VTT. Videos up to five minutes are free without registration; longer videos use paid time packages.

name: flatt
tagline: AI for coding agents at a fixed monthly price
description: flatt is an AI inference subscription for developers who use coding agents every day. A fixed monthly price covers access to the models included in your plan, with no monthly token limit. Connect Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Grok Build and Pi Agent using one API key. The CLI helps configure compatible tools and launch an agent from the terminal. Plans define included models, concurrent requests and context per request. Documentation is available in English and Portuguese.

name: Image to Video (VirWorld AI)
tagline: Turn product photos into promo videos with AI, free to start.
description: Image to Video is an AI tool that turns product photos into short promo videos and images for Etsy and Shopify sellers, using models like Veo 3.1 and Seedance.

name: MemeVideoMaker
tagline: Make viral meme videos from your photos with zero prompt writing
description: MemeVideoMaker is a browser-based AI meme video maker for creators who want to place themselves in current TikTok, Reels, and Shorts trends. Choose a trend template, upload one to five clear portraits, and export a clean vertical MP4 with the motion and camera direction already mapped. The workflow is built for fast social publishing and does not require timeline editing or prompt engineering. Visit https://memevideomaker.org to try the best meme video maker.

name: MiPrep AI
tagline: AI interview preparation and live interview copilot for job seekers
description: MiPrep AI helps job seekers prepare for interviews with resume-and-job-description grounded answers, practice/mock interviews, and a private desktop overlay for Zoom, Meet, and Teams. A free tier is available on macOS and Windows.

name: LimitReset
tagline: Know the moment your AI usage limit resets
description: Independent tracker for AI usage limit resets across Codex, Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot and Grok, with alerts, a Chrome extension and a free API.

name: Concrete Calculator
tagline: Free concrete calculator for yardage, bags, and material cost across slabs, walls, columns, stairs, and ramps.
description: Concrete Calculator estimates finished concrete volume, whole bags, and optional material costs for slabs, footings, walls, columns, stairs, and ramps. Supports US or metric. Geometry estimates only—not structural design. Free, no account.

name: Cross Stitch Pattern Maker
tagline: Free photo-to-DMC/Anchor cross stitch pattern maker with printable PDF chart.
description: Cross Stitch Pattern Maker (Tenstitch) converts a photo into a printable cross-stitch chart with DMC or Anchor numbers, skein estimates, and fabric size. Photos stay on your device—no account. Free tool for crafters.

name: TrySolitaire
tagline: Free browser Solitaire, Mahjong and card games — no download
description: TrySolitaire is a free online game site with 300+ solitaire, card and puzzle games that play in the browser. No download and no sign-up. Founded by Sunil Belvai.

name: Home Pros Local
tagline: Free directory of home service pros in Houston and Dallas, Texas
description: Free directory of home service pros in Houston and Dallas, Texas — plumbers, electricians, AC & heating, handymen, house cleaning, movers; homeowners contact pros directly, no lead fees

name: Verifly
tagline: Pay-as-you-go email verification API and list cleaner. Credits never expire.
description: Verifly checks email addresses before you send to them. Upload a CSV or call the REST API and every row comes back as ok, invalid, catch-all, disposable or unknown, after syntax, domain/MX and mailbox checks. There is no monthly subscription: packs start at 5,000 checks for $10, credits never expire, and new accounts get 100 free credits. It is built for cold-email teams, outbound agencies and developers: guides for Clay, n8n, Make, Zapier, HubSpot, Apollo, Smartlead and lemlist, plus a hosted MCP server at https://verifly.email/mcp so AI agents can verify an address before they email it.

name: KlantcontactVergelijker.nl
tagline: Compare Dutch customer contact software, every fact sourced
description: KlantcontactVergelijker.nl is a Dutch research platform for organisations choosing customer contact software: telephony and contact centres, helpdesks and shared inboxes, WhatsApp and live chat, and AI phone assistants. The database covers 54 tools from 53 vendors in 15 categories, each researched on the same 77 features, from channels and integrations to security and pricing. Every claim links to a source with a verbatim quote; anything that cannot be found is marked 'not found' and never counts as yes. There is no ranking and no winner: lists are alphabetical and inclusion is free. Visitors can compare tools side by side, use a selection guide, compare prices and estimate AI phone assistant costs with a calculator. Operated by LOADIQO, Almere, the Netherlands.

name: Kranli
tagline: Swiss construction publications, filtered by trade and municipality
description: Kranli helps building trades in Switzerland follow construction publications near their workshop. Choose a municipality, a radius and a trade to receive a morning email selection, with links to the official sources. Coverage varies by canton and source; a publication does not confirm a construction start or an available contract. Personal alerts cost CHF 19/month or CHF 190/year, with a seven-day trial without a card. Public pages, an aggregate barometer and a read-only API are available separately without an account.

name: DishPenny
tagline: Update shared ingredient prices and check recipe-cost changes.
description:
DishPenny is a free browser beta for independent kitchens maintaining recipe costs. Keep a shared ingredient catalogue and reusable prep recipes; compare supplier price changes with a saved baseline before updating affected recipes. Planned portions produce ingredient demand and whole-pack shopping quantities as separate values. Export working documents and keep a local backup. The workflow does not provide nutrition, allergen or food-safety certification. No account or card is needed.

Submitted by the tool’s maintainer, Rogin Tools. This description was prepared with AI assistance.

name: BunchPlan
tagline: Turn event-flower recipes into whole-bunch supplier orders.
description:
BunchPlan is a free browser beta for event florists planning flower purchases. Enter supplier SKUs and bunch sizes, build recipes, and combine requirements for events sharing a delivery date. It separates stems consumed from whole bunches purchased and can allocate existing stock. Export supplier orders, production sheets and client estimates separately. Keep the full workbook private. It does not reserve live wholesaler inventory. No account or card is needed.

Submitted by the tool’s maintainer, Rogin Tools. This description was prepared with AI assistance.

name: MockFlair
tagline: Batch framed-poster listing images with consistent room scenes.
description:
MockFlair is a free browser beta for artists preparing framed-poster listing images. Bring your own flat artwork, choose frame and mat settings, then apply the same look across selected rooms. Export PNG or JPG files individually or in a named batch ZIP. Full artwork preserves the image; Fill & crop is an intentional alternative. Outputs are listing previews, not print masters or photographs of manufactured products. No account or card is needed.

Submitted by the tool’s maintainer, Rogin Tools. This description was prepared with AI assistance.

name: LaunchHome
tagline: Bring Launchpad back to your Mac
description: Apple removed Launchpad in macOS 26. LaunchHome brings back the familiar paged grid, custom folders, drag-and-drop ordering, F4 and trackpad gestures, search, and import of your old Launchpad layout. Works on macOS 26 and 27, Apple Silicon and Intel. Core features free forever with no sign-up; Pro is a one-time $9.9 purchase. Apple-signed and notarized, no tracking.

name: Whatoblock
tagline: Threat intelligence and firewall-ready IP blocklists
description: Whatoblock turns observations from a global sensor network into actionable cyber threat intelligence. Investigate scanners, botnet infrastructure, proxies and DDoS-related sources, or connect updated IP blocklists to your security tools.

name: Phoaly
tagline: Local-first photo organizer for Mac—no import, no upload.
description: Mac local-first photo organizer. Reads Finder folders; on-device visual search (ZH/EN), faces, scenes, map; no import/upload/account. macOS 13+ Apple silicon. Trial then $19/$29 one-time. Download: https://phoaly.com/api/app/v1/download?version=0.1.1&arch=aarch64

name: WhimKid
tagline: AI storybook generator for editable kids' picture books
description: WhimKid turns an idea, a photo, or a familiar character into an illustrated children's storybook with editable pages and PDF export. Freemium. Ages 0–12.

name: Smalltown Boy AI Dance
tagline: Two photos. One backyard double act.
description: Two cats, a dog and you, or two friends. Pick the pair, set who goes first, and let the backyard drama begin. Choose one clear photo for each slot. Pick Pets, People or Mixed. Star 1 leads the first reaction; exchange the photos if you want a different order. Select Standard 480p or HD 720p, confirm all four safety checkboxes, then sign in. Watch the task in My videos and download your silent 9:16 MP4 when it is ready. Add a permitted sound inside your publishing app and label the post as AI-generated.

name: Excel for Accountants Practice
tagline: Interactive Excel practice for accountants — SUM, VLOOKUP, aging, bank rec, and more in the browser with instant feedback.
description: Excel for Accountants Practice is a free interactive learn-by-doing site: lessons 1–4 are fully open (no signup). Lessons 5–14 unlock with a $9 license on Gumroad (https://mukidi8.gumroad.com/l/ngpmyw), which also includes a practice workbook. Free PWYW sample workbook: https://mukidi8.gumroad.com/l/agocl. Content is AI-assisted with fictional sample data only; not affiliated with Microsoft.

name: AIClipPilot
tagline: Turn existing recordings into short clips with AI highlights and captions
description: I operate AIClipPilot, a web-based video clipping tool for recorded podcasts, interviews, lessons and webinars. Upload an MP4, MOV or WEBM recording, review AI highlight suggestions and captions, and export short, watermark-free MP4 clips. Paid plans include timing and subtitle editing, smart framing and batch ZIP downloads. AIClipPilot repurposes existing footage rather than generating video from a prompt. A limited free plan is available; current plans are at https://aiclippilot.com/pricing.

name: US Government Data 4-Pack
tagline: Clean CSV/Parquet of FDA & vehicle recalls, SEC financials for 11,000+ companies and federal contract spending by industry.
description: Clean, analysis-ready US government datasets: 328K NHTSA vehicle recalls since 1967, FDA recalls, SEC fundamentals (revenue, profit, cash flow, EPS) for 11,000+ public companies from 2015 to 2026, and federal contract spending by industry with the top 100 contractors in each. Delivered as CSV and Parquet. Built for govcon sales teams, analysts, dealers and researchers who don't want to wrangle EDGAR, NHTSA and USAspending formats. Use code LAUNCH40 for 40% off launch week.

name: Legalnaut
tagline: AI workspace for litigation teams: chronologies, evidence, citations
description: Legalnaut helps litigation teams build chronologies, compare accounts and examine evidence with page-level source references. Trace findings to a document, page and quotation. Compare conflicting accounts and identify evidence gaps.

name: SMM4X
tagline: Social media marketing panel based in Bangladesh for businesses and resellers
description: SMM4X is a social media marketing panel based in Bangladesh offering social media marketing services for businesses and resellers through its online platform. Location: Debiganj, Rangpur, Bangladesh. Founded: 2026.

name: DocuMantra
tagline: Digital signatures for Indian teams
description: DocuMantra is a digital signature platform for Indian teams. Upload a PDF or Word file, add signers, send by email or secure link, and get a signed copy with a certificate and audit trail. Free for up to 10 envelopes every month.

name: Singular Games
tagline: A parent-chosen browser arcade for kids
description: Singular Games is a browser arcade with 327 games for children. Parents can hide games they would rather skip, and kids choose using large picture buttons. Try a game on the homepage without an account. Families get 3 hours of free play each calendar month; optional Family plans provide unlimited play. The site supports English, Hebrew, Arabic, Russian, Spanish, French and German. Opened games can work offline. The product is designed without ads or an in-game shop. Submitted by the creator's assistant on behalf of Singular Labs.

name: Lanesra AI
tagline: Track brand visibility, positioning, and sentiment inside AI search engines and generative models.
description: Lanesra AI is an analytics and optimization platform built to track brand visibility, positioning, and sentiment inside AI search engines and generative models

name: SIOS
tagline: Governed multi-agent AI operations platform
description: SIOS coordinates AI agents for ops, sales, marketing and compliance behind a pre-execution approval queue. It has per-agent budget controls and a full audit trail, and runs in your region under your brand. Built for businesses that want AI automation without losing control or an audit trail. Enterprise deployment, quote on request.

name: Programmier-Anfang
tagline: Hire the top 2% of vetted developers, designers, marketers and project managers.
description: Programmier-Anfang helps companies hire the top 2% of vetted developers, designers, marketers and project managers. Pre-screened freelance and full-time talent, ready for interviews.

name: Make & Save Tools
tagline: A catalog of practical shopping, travel, records, and business tools
description: Browse 33 public Apify Actors and six Make & Save web scanners for shopping and travel research, website reviews, public-record leads, compliance checks, and APIs. Each card explains the tool and links to its listing or scanner. Open the full directory at https://money-engine-scanner.floot.app/tools. Actor pricing varies; check each Apify listing. The Change Flow Engine listing is marked as staged.

name: WhaleBlip
tagline: Chinese-language analytics for Hyperliquid whale trades and market activity.
description: WhaleBlip tracks large Hyperliquid perpetual trades, whale positions, liquidations and funding rates. Its Chinese-language dashboards also cover Polymarket activity and provide source-linked market news summaries. The website and delayed Telegram channel are free, with optional paid faster alerts.

name: Lyria 3 AI
tagline: Turn text and lyrics into original songs
description: Lyria 3 AI turns a prompt or lyrics into an original song in the browser. Preview your track, then continue with vocal removal, stem splitting and lyrics tools.

name: Coding Tools MCP
tagline: Give any AI agent the ability to code
description: Coding Tools MCP is an open-source MCP server that gives any AI chat or agent a safe pair of hands on a codebase — 18 tools over the Model Context Protocol: file search, atomic multi-file patches, PTY command execution, and git. Model-neutral (works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Gemini CLI), gated by permission modes with Landlock kernel confinement on Linux. Apache 2.0, published on PyPI and npm.

name: 富富工作室 / Fufu Studio
tagline: AI ecommerce automation and FDE for online sellers
description: Helps ecommerce teams put AI automation into real workflows — FDE for Amazon sellers, custom workflows, training and coaching. Operator-built studio (富富工作室).

name: cryptonabs.com
tagline: Study live Bitcoin order-book depth in your browser
description: cryptonabs.com is a free browser-based, read-only BTC/USDT market-data viewer. It places live price candles and an accumulated order-book depth curve on the same chart so visitors can study price movement, visible bids and asks, spread and cumulative depth without an exchange account or API key. It does not execute or route orders, hold assets, manage portfolios or provide personalized recommendations. Public market data can be delayed, incomplete, stale or corrected. The viewer uses the named public Binance BTC/USDT source; cryptonabs.com is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Binance.

name: Imavro
tagline: AI video production for business: company videos from a written brief.
description: Marketing films, product explainers, training and investor updates with narration, music and subtitles. Review the storyboard before production. Storyboards free; first video $2.99. 31 languages, up to 4K on plans, commercial use.

name: 无限扩散 Seedance 2.5 API
tagline: Seedance 2.5 视频生成 API 接入
description: 面向开发者的第三方 AI API 网关，提供 Seedance 2.5 视频生成异步任务接入。模型能力、规格、价格和可用性请以官网模型广场及 API 文档为准。

name: Swayno
tagline: AI videos and social scheduling for SaaS and app teams
description: Swayno helps indie developers and SaaS and app teams turn a website or App Store link into short-form marketing content. Create videos, review and edit content, organize a content calendar, and schedule posts for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. It also includes AI influencer characters, video templates, carousel creation, and cross-channel analytics. A 3-day free trial is available, with paid plans from $29 per month.

name: Those Old Records
tagline: We buy vinyl collections across Northumberland & the North East
description: Those Old Records buys vinyl record collections and music memorabilia from Alnwick, Northumberland. Home visits across the North East, Cumbria, Yorkshire and Scotland. Fair valuations, cash or bank transfer. FAQ: https://thoseoldrecords.co.uk/f

name: IsItDownAPI
tagline: Uptime and website down-check API
description: Simple HTTP API to check if a website is down. Built for developers and monitoring tools. Also at 60secmonitor.com.

name: HSTQ
tagline: NVMe VPS and monthly dedicated servers for self-hosted applications
description: HSTQ rents virtual and dedicated servers for websites, databases and development environments. A VPS with two vCPUs, 2 GB of RAM and 40 GB of NVMe storage costs USD 9.99 per month. A physical Xeon server in the Netherlands with six cores and 32 GB of ECC RAM is USD 49 for one month with free setup. The same site includes free browser tools for checking DNS, TLS certificates and IP routing.

name: Space Simulator Online
tagline: Free 3D Solar System, Milky Way and NASA exoplanet explorer in your browser
description: A free, no-signup space simulator I built on hand-written WebGL2 and WebGPU. Fly the real Solar System (NASA/JPL Horizons positions), zoom out to the Milky Way, browse 6,000+ confirmed exoplanets, smash two galaxies together and hunt planets in real TESS light curves. No ads, 10 languages. Submitted by the maker, Run Cheng.

name: Website Monitor
tagline: Simple, affordable uptime monitoring for freelancers and small agencies
description: Website Monitor checks your sites around the clock and alerts you by email, Slack, Discord or webhook when they go down. Free plan with 3 sites; Pro with 1-minute checks and public status pages. Founder price of US$3.99/month locked for life for the first 100 accounts. A simple, cheap alternative to UptimeRobot, Pingdom and StatusCake. Available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French and German.

name: Fame OS
tagline: Software behind Fame's B2B podcast, LinkedIn & AEO services
description: Fame OS is the software that underpins everything Fame does: the operating system behind Fame's done-for-you B2B podcast, LinkedIn creator and AI-search/AEO services. It covers guest & topic planning, production workflows, repurposing episodes into LinkedIn/social content, and pipeline & visibility tracking. Offered as part of Fame's services.

name: OrionAlerts
tagline: Alerting and monitoring platform for security and surveillance setups.
