A 10-report one-off pack is US$2.99. This is an early paid pilot; it does not provide cloud photo storage, verified timestamps, inspection certification or separate team accounts.

name: The GPA Calculator
tagline: Free GPA and grade calculators with formulas shown. No login
description: The GPA Calculator is a free, independent set of in-browser tools for students: semester, cumulative, weighted, high school, and college GPA on a 4.0 scale, plus grade, final grade, and retake calculators. No account needed; each page shows the math.

name: Tella
tagline: AI social media manager for small business
description: Tella is a social media assistant for small businesses: you send a photo, a clip or a few lines, and Tella prepares draft posts for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and TikTok for you to review before anything is published. The first 5 posts are free.

name: Watchr
tagline: Competitor monitoring with AI insights, reports, and MCP access
description: Watchr tracks competitor websites, social posts, ads, newsletters, and news. It qualifies relevant changes with AI, links each signal to its source, and makes the resulting intelligence available through reports and a hosted MCP connector for compatible AI assistants. Built for marketing, product, and sales teams. One-month free trial without a payment card; paid plans start at EUR 9.90 per competitor per month.

name: Street Cart Recipe Costing Sample
tagline: Free smash-burger food-cost demo for food trucks
description: Offline-style demo for street-cart operators: yield → recipe cost → menu floors. Full kit sold separately. Free sample: https://capitalgame.itch.io/street-cart-recipe-costing-kit-free-sample

name: Tidyroll for Clio Manage
tagline: Review duplicate Clio contacts before eligible cleanup
description: Tidyroll by Atesen Software helps US-region Clio Manage firms review likely duplicate contacts. The free read-only scan shows counts and three sample groups. Paid cleanup prepares supported merges with a preview and typed confirmation; financial records, balances and access conditions can block a merge. Duplicate contacts are retained, not deleted. It is not an unrestricted merge of every relationship type.

name: Blank Calendar
tagline: Free printable blank calendar maker—dated 2026 or undated PDF with custom week start, paper size, and notes.
description: Blank Calendar Maker builds print-ready monthly calendars in the browser: dated 2026 or undated, Monday/Sunday/Saturday start, Letter/A4 and more, lined or grid day boxes, notes column, and holidays for multiple countries. Type into days before download as vector PDF, PNG, or SVG. Free, no account, no watermark.

name: Attachment Bundler
tagline: Filter and export QuickBooks Online attachments with a readable index
description: Attachment Bundler by Atesen Software helps bookkeepers export a selected set of QuickBooks Online attachments. Filter supported transactions by date, type, vendor or customer, account and amount, then preview matching files before downloading ZIP parts with readable filenames and CSV/Excel indexes. QuickBooks Online already provides bulk ZIP downloads; Bundler adds transaction filtering and organised indexing. Unlimited previews and the first 25 files per company are free. It reads QuickBooks Online without changing records. QuickBooks Desktop is not supported, and this is not a full backup service.

name: Wanted Poster AI
tagline: Turn any photo into a vintage Wild West wanted poster
description: Wanted Poster AI converts a photo into an authentic-looking Wild West wanted poster. The AI redraws the portrait as a 19th-century pencil sketch on aged paper with burnt edges, then lets you set the name, a bounty from $1 to $1,000,000,000, and the crime — or generate a funny one automatically. Generation takes 10 to 30 seconds and downloads at print-ready 300 DPI. A 720p download is free with no credit card required.

name: TeleWizard
tagline: Managed AI phone agents for calls, intake and scheduling
description: TeleWizard provides managed AI phone agents that answer business calls, collect intake details, book appointments and route requests. It supports more than 50 languages and connects workflows with calendars and CRM tools. Law firms can use it for legal client intake. Pricing is based on a tailored quotation.

name: ProductPost 360
tagline: Launch campaigns drafted for about 200 communities
description: ProductPost 360 builds launch campaigns from your homepage, changelog or blog. It picks fitting communities from about 200 channels and drafts a post for each. Includes an AI visibility check. 14-day free trial, no card; plans $29, $39 or $49 a month.

name: FaceRef.org
tagline: 3D head reference generator for face angles and portrait lighting
description: FaceRef is a browser-based 3D head reference tool for artists and AI portrait workflows. You orbit a 3D head to set an exact yaw and pitch, move the key light to study portrait shadow design, then export structure-first output — Loomis construction sketches, Asaro plane studies, and depth or edge maps ready for ControlNet in Stable Diffusion, FLUX, and ComfyUI. The 3D viewport and three low-resolution exports per day are free in the browser; Pro adds 1024px exports and higher daily limits.

name: Immigration Reviews
tagline: Source-linked U.S. immigration provider profiles and review evidence
description: Immigration Reviews is a directory of U.S. immigration service providers with English and Russian pages. Readers can browse company profiles by immigration pathway, compare stated services and inspect linked review evidence with dates, sample sizes and limitations. The methodology separates provider statements, platform observations and owner-provided accounts.

name: ai kissing video generator
tagline: Turn one or two photos into AI kissing videos
description: AI Kissing Video Generator turns one or two portrait photos into short romantic kissing animations for couples and social posts.

name: ResaleMargin
tagline: Free marketplace seller fee and profit calculators
description: ResaleMargin helps online sellers estimate marketplace fees and net profit before listing. Free web calculators cover eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Etsy, Whatnot, PayPal, Stripe and more. Compare payouts across marketplaces or calculate a listing price from a target profit. Fee breakdowns and comparison guides link to source schedules. No account is required to use the calculators.

name: unscene
tagline: Pick a movie night everyone wants to watch.
description: Unscene brings private movie and TV answers into a shared movie-night plan. Create a room, invite friends and answer title cards privately, then compare the choices your group shares. Choose a title and coordinate a date together, or use the solo quiz to explore your own next watch. A free account is available, with optional account subscriptions and one-time room add-ons. Users watch through their own viewing services.

name: Taromi
tagline: Ask a question. Draw your cards. Find a fresh perspective.
description:
Taromi is an AI-powered tarot reading platform that helps you explore personal questions and gain fresh perspectives through personalized tarot interpretations.

How It Works

Start by asking a question in your own words, then draw your tarot cards. Taromi interprets the cards in the context of your question, turning traditional tarot symbolism into clear, accessible explanations tailored to your situation.

Key Features

- AI Tarot Readings: Get personalized interpretations powered by AI.
- Interactive Card Drawing: Draw tarot cards as part of your reading experience.
- Question-Based Readings: Explore personal questions about relationships, life decisions, and personal challenges.
- Contextual Interpretations: Understand card meanings in relation to your question.
- Clear Explanations: Explore tarot symbolism without needing prior knowledge.
- Self-Reflection: Use tarot readings to consider different perspectives and possibilities.

Who Is It For?

Taromi is designed for people interested in tarot, self-reflection, and personal insight. Whether you are new to tarot or already familiar with the cards, Taromi offers an accessible way to explore your questions through personalized AI interpretations.

Use Taromi to reflect on relationships, consider important decisions, and explore personal challenges. Readings are intended for reflection and entertainment, offering perspectives to consider rather than guaranteed predictions or professional advice.

name: TattooJinn
tagline: Turn your tattoo ideas into custom AI-generated designs
description:
TattooJinn is an AI-powered tattoo design generator that helps you turn your ideas into custom tattoo concepts without needing drawing skills.

How It Works

Describe your tattoo idea using a text prompt and optionally upload a reference image to guide the design. TattooJinn uses your input to generate visual concepts, making it easier to explore different ideas and styles.

Key Features

- AI Tattoo Generation: Turn written ideas into visual tattoo concepts.
- Text-to-Image Creation: Describe the design you imagine and generate a visual concept.
- Reference Image Uploads: Use inspiration images to help guide your design.
- Personalized Concepts: Explore tattoo ideas based on your preferences and creative vision.
- Design Exploration: Experiment with ideas before deciding on your next tattoo.

Who Is It For?

TattooJinn is useful for tattoo enthusiasts, people planning their first tattoo, and anyone looking for inspiration for a custom design. It can help users explore possibilities and prepare visual references to discuss with a professional tattoo artist.

Whether you have a detailed concept or just a few words describing an idea, TattooJinn makes it easier to visualize potential tattoo designs with AI.

name: 52XUEAI API中转站
tagline: OpenAI-compatible LLM API relay with public pay-as-you-go pricing
description: 52XUEAI is an OpenAI-compatible LLM API relay built on new-api, offering GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Qwen, Kimi and image models with pay-as-you-go pricing published on its pricing page (https://52xueai.site/pricing). API base URL: https://52xueai.site/v1. For developers who need a single OpenAI-format endpoint for many models. 中文：52XUEAI 是基于 new-api 搭建的大模型 API 中转站，兼容 OpenAI 接口格式，按量计费。

name: SKPDowngrade
tagline: Downgrade SketchUp files online to open them in older SketchUp
description: SKPDowngrade is an online converter that saves a SketchUp 2024, 2025 or 2026 .skp file as an older version (SketchUp 2017 through 2025) so another computer can open it. Geometry and layers are kept. The first file up to 100MB is free without an account, no install, and uploads are deleted within 15 minutes.

name: Observeri
tagline: AI-powered cybersecurity GRC platform
description: AI-powered GRC platform that automates cyber risk assessment and quantifies threats financially, with an AI Risk Operations Center that continuously scores assets, predicts risk 30-90 days forward, and expresses residual risk as expected annual loss. Headquarters: Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

name: BoostGeo
tagline: Website evidence and AI visibility insights for SEO and marketing teams
description: BoostGeo helps SEO, growth and digital marketing teams measure brand visibility in AI answers, assess website readiness, prioritize fixes and recheck changes. Its free public checker provides page-level SEO evidence and a separate AI-readiness assessment without an account or credit card; usage limits apply. Separate workspace plans support AI visibility tracking, site health, buyer-journey tests, prioritized fixes and verified facts. AI readiness does not measure independent AI recommendations or guarantee mentions, citations or rankings. Paid plans start at $29 per month, with a 10-day free trial and no credit card required.

name: Sponsorella
tagline: Get paid. Not just posted.
description: Sponsorella helps Instagram micro-creators (10K–100K) turn stats into brand deals — show your numbers, set your price, reach out to brands. 7-day free trial, then $24/month or $199/year. 0% take on deals.

name: EternalEngineOS
tagline: EternalEngineOS combines CRM, invoicing, payments, booking, and email in one app for solo founders and small service businesses.
description: EternalEngineOS combines five business functions — CRM, invoicing, payments, booking, and email — in one app for solo founders and small service businesses. Free tier $0, no credit card. Basic $9.95/mo with a 30-day no-card trial.

name: Cloudbrowser
tagline: Persistent cloud browsers for AI agents
description: Cloudbrowser provides persistent cloud browser sessions for AI agents and automation workflows. Isolated Chrome profiles preserve state across tasks, while concurrent sessions support parallel work. Teams can pause and resume sessions, fork paused browsers into separate copies, and monitor activity through live view.

name: ctxd
tagline: Context infrastructure between agents and data
description:
ctxd is open-source context infrastructure between agents and data.

Its local tracker syncs source content into ctxfs, a context filesystem. Agents can inspect paths and read files or selected line ranges. Python and the CLI also provide exact text search. Edits and removals reach the store after synchronization.

Use it through Python, the command-line interface (CLI) or Model Context Protocol (MCP). The local MCP bridge uses standard input/output (stdio).

Install: pip install ctxd
Website: https://ctxd.dev/_ixy/

name: Other Lives Browser Life Sim
tagline: Gentle browser life simulation
description: A gentle life simulation in the browser. Start from birth or adulthood in cities, advance month by month through studies, work, money, relationships and family, then revisit memories and shareable life cards. Free to play.

name: Mp3toMidi
tagline: Turn MP3, WAV, and M4A audio into editable MIDI online.
description: Convert clear melodies, vocals, piano, and guitar riffs into editable MIDI files online. Upload MP3, WAV or M4A, preview, and download a .mid file for your DAW.

name: PixPurge
tagline: AI text and watermark remover — auto-detects text, watermarks and date stamps, rebuilds the background.
description: PixPurge is an online AI image text remover. Upload a photo or screenshot; AI finds text regions (captions, watermarks, date stamps), erases them and rebuilds the background. New accounts get 10 free credits; results are not re-watermarked. Formats: JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC.

name: Paysweep for Xero
tagline: Record Xero invoice and bill payments from CSV or Excel.
description: Paysweep helps Xero bookkeepers and finance teams record payments against existing invoices and bills from a CSV or Excel file. Upload one row per payment, review the checks and matching preview, then type a confirmation before anything is recorded. It records accounting entries; it does not move money or reconcile bank feeds. Free upload and preview are available, with the first three payments per organisation free. Standard paid options are US$39 for a seven-day pass covering up to 300 payments, or US$19/month per organisation, excluding applicable taxes. Built by Atesen Software, independently of Xero; not endorsed or certified by Xero.

name: Valheim Seed
tagline: Preview any Valheim world map from its seed
description: Valheim Seed is a free Valheim seed viewer and world map generator. Enter any seed and preview the whole world in your browser: biomes from Meadows to Deep North, boss altars, the location of Haldor the trader and dungeons, with in-game coordinates. It supports the 1.0 Deep North update, works on mobile and needs no login.

name: Hellraiser Games
tagline: Hellraiser: Revival guide, keypad hints & crafting plan
description: Hellraiser Games is an independent fan guide to the survival horror game Hellraiser: Revival. Before buying, compare platforms, PC requirements, editions and reviews. During your run, track recipes, calculate missing materials, find your next checkpoint, and get keypad hints before revealing a code. Your plan stays in your browser.

name: Soul Virtues Extractor
tagline: Free unofficial Undertale soul quiz: see all 7 colors
description: Soul Virtues Extractor is a free, unofficial Undertale soul quiz. Answer 66 original questions to discover your leading pair of virtues, trace the result back to the answers that shaped it, and see all seven soul colors on one spectrum. No account is needed, the full result is free, and you can compare with a friend.

name: Bubble Word Jam Answers
tagline: Bubble Word Jam answers for 1,500 levels
description: Free, unofficial answer key for 1,500 Bubble Word Jam levels. See every category and word in game order, or type 2-3 words from your screen to find your level.

name: CarbMeNot
tagline: AI nutrition tracker for keto, low-carb, GLP-1 and calorie goals
description: CarbMeNot is an AI-powered nutrition app that makes tracking carbs, calories and macros effortless. Snap or describe a meal to log it, check whether a food is keto-friendly, and get AI-generated meal plans tailored to keto, low-carb, or GLP-1 weight-loss journeys. Free calculators and meal plans are available on the website, with full tracking in the iOS and Android apps.

name: CloudEmailVerification
tagline: Verify Emails, Reduce Bounces & Improve Deliverability
description:
CloudEmailVerification is a SaaS-based email verification and validation platform designed to help businesses maintain clean and accurate email lists. It provides bulk email verification, real-time email validation, and API integration to help identify invalid email addresses, reduce email bounce rates, protect sender reputation, and improve email deliverability.

It is suitable for marketers, sales teams, agencies, SaaS companies, and businesses that rely on email marketing and outreach campaigns.

name: ig.tools
tagline: Download Instagram Reels, Videos, Photos & Stories Free
description: Free Instagram downloader and viewer. Paste a link or @username to save public Reels, videos, photos, carousels and Stories in original quality. No login needed. Also includes an anonymous story viewer, HD profile picture download, highlights, comments viewer, font generator and a Chrome extension. Built for creators, marketers and social media managers.

name: Prepti
tagline: Free practice for employer assessment tests and interviews - CCAT, PI, Wonderlic and more.
description: Prepti is a free website that helps job candidates prepare for employer assessment tests and interviews. Practice questions and step-by-step guides for the aptitude, psychometric and job-specific tests used by large employers, with links to the official test providers. Free to read, no signup.

name: Edit Image Text Online
tagline: Change the words, keep the picture.
description: Edit image text online with AI. Change words in a JPG, PNG or WebP while matching the original lettering and background. 1 free edit, packs from $3.90, no subscription.

name: Unshift
tagline: Build a website visually and try the Editor before signing up
description:
Unshift is a visual website builder for freelancers, consultants and small service businesses. Start from a template or connect a supported AI chat, then edit the website visually.

Try the actual Editor without an account at https://playground.unshift.ai/. Sample edits stay in your browser. An account is needed to retain and publish your own website.

Free supports up to three sites. Pro selected-site capacity starts at $12/month for one site, whether published or not. Domain registration and any connected AI subscription are separate. Free and Pro are available; Business is not currently available. Current pricing: https://unshift.ai/pricing.

name: Pinniq
tagline: Public AI API gateway: one key and one OpenAI-compatible endpoint for 50+ models.
description: Pinniq is a public AI API gateway for 50+ models. One account, one API key, and one OpenAI-compatible endpoint for OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Mistral and more. Prepaid usage billing.

name: dessa ai
tagline: Real-time AI voice chat and text-to-speech.
description: Dessa AI is a real-time AI voice chat and TTS product with 46 voices across 39 languages. Pay for usage.

name: Lead Atlas by Tasksmith Software
tagline: Research business leads by industry and location, then save and export your list.
description: Lead Atlas is a web-based business research product from Tasksmith Software. Research companies by industry and location, review results, save requests and download CSV lists. Local and nationwide searches are available across supported countries, subject to coverage. Business listings come from Google Maps. Optional enhancement adds available public emails and social links, but does not guarantee a named decision-maker or mailbox verification. Previously delivered leads are excluded on repeat searches for the same account; paid accounts can upload website-domain exclusions. Matching depends on listing identifiers and normalised domains. New accounts receive 50 free tokens, enough for up to 100 standard business leads. Paid tokens start at £5 for 125 tokens, equivalent to 250 standard leads at the standard rate. Enhanced and harder-to-find leads cost more, as shown before submission. Lead Atlas is independent and not endorsed by Google. Public contact data does not imply marketing consent. Tasksmith also offers the separate Sheets Fix-It product.

name: PrayForMe
tagline: A garden for prayers, good wishes and loving-kindness
description: PrayForMe is an AI temple for all faiths. It turns personal intentions into secular good wishes, Christian prayers or Buddhist loving-kindness practice in a private illustrated garden. The first prayer or wish is free without an account or card. Paid gardens return to intentions on a schedule while the browser is closed and save completed sessions in history. Users can choose to share selected texts. Practices are in English. Monthly gardens start at $10 and one-time options at $3. AI-generated content does not promise spiritual outcomes.

name: FreeBillKit
tagline: Free business document generator. No signup.
description: FreeBillKit helps freelancers, contractors, startups, and small businesses create professional business documents in seconds. Generate invoices, estimates, quotations, purchase orders, receipts, delivery challans, credit notes, and more — completely free, with no signup or watermark. Everything runs in your browser, and documents can be customized and downloaded instantly as PDFs.

name: Stundenrechner Pro
tagline: Free German working-hours calculator with breaks and decimal-hour results
description: Stundenrechner Pro is a free German-language web tool for calculating working hours from start and end times, including unpaid breaks and overnight shifts. It shows results in hours and minutes as well as decimal hours. The website also offers a weekly working-time calculator with CSV export, time converters, and guides for people working in Germany. The calculators work in a browser without registration.

name: Hacker Podcasts
tagline: The podcasts Hacker News keeps recommending
description: Ranked list of podcasts Hacker News keeps recommending — by all-time mentions, rising titles, and long-running favorites across separate months. Hacker Podcasts aggregates which podcasts people on Hacker News actually recommend to each other. Free web directory for engineers, founders, and HN readers.

name: MuseWonderVs
tagline: Estimate Muse Wonder and Spark API costs with sourced pricing
description: MuseWonderVs is a free independent guide and token-cost calculator for Meta's Muse Wonder and Spark APIs. Estimate monthly costs from total input, cached input, output tokens and search queries. The calculator runs locally in the browser. The guide links to official pricing and explains Muse Code subscriptions, Wonder Full access and Contributor mode. No signup or API key is needed to use the calculator.

name: chainjobs
tagline: A free Web3 and freelance job board with 0% platform commission.
description:
chainjobs connects clients and freelancers for Web3 and freelance work. Post a job, offer a service, apply and chat directly. Agree on the work and payment together, in crypto or by bank transfer. Free to join, with 0% platform commission.

Submission disclosure: Money Work Agent is an AI-assisted paid submitter authorized by chainjobs, not the founder or owner.

name: Online Dinheiro
tagline: Free financial calculators and education for Portugal
description:
OnlineDinheiro is a free financial education platform designed for people in Portugal. It combines practical financial calculators, educational guides and structured learning paths to help users understand money and make better financial decisions.

The platform covers a range of personal finance topics, including savings, loans, mortgages, investments, interest rates and taxation. Users can explore financial concepts, calculate different scenarios and learn how financial decisions affect their everyday lives.

Unlike generic international finance websites, OnlineDinheiro focuses on the Portuguese market, with content adapted to the local financial landscape, products and tax rules.

Whether you want to calculate a mortgage payment, understand loan costs, plan your savings or improve your financial knowledge, OnlineDinheiro brings useful tools and accessible explanations together in one place.

Free to use, directly in your browser, with no account or installation required.

name: CloneCut AI
tagline: Product placement inside existing short videos
description:
Over at https://clonecutai.com, CloneCut AI lets you swap person, outfit, product, or background in a short video.

You upload a short clip, choose what to replace — person, outfit, product, or background — and the model rebuilds the frame sequence so pacing stays intact. The stack is built on Seedance 2.0.

Typical uses include viral remakes, outfit try-on in motion, product placement inside existing shorts, and background swaps for social ads. Motion and camera path stay close to the source.

It suits content creators, social marketers, and brands testing UGC hooks without a full reshoot.

Learn more about CloneCut AI (https://clonecutai.com).

name: Pika H3 Flex
tagline: Pika H3 Flex turns text, images, and references into short AI video scenes with sound—credits shown before you create, failed jobs refunded.
description: Pika H3 Flex (pikah3flex.app) is an AI video studio for short scenes with synchronized audio from text, keyframe images, or reference media. Choose duration, aspect ratio, and resolution; see credit cost before you create. Text and image modes cost 2/4/7/8/16 credits per second at 480p/768p/1080p/2K/4K; prompt refinement adds 4 credits; reference mode uses a higher rate with a fixed 15-second input allowance when video references are included. 480p and 768p are native; higher resolutions use an upscale (Draft to Video) that preserves scene and audio. Video duration is 5–15 seconds. Confirmed provider failures restore credits; timed-out jobs stay saved in My videos.

name: TripDeputy
tagline: A trip planner for every link you save
description: Save the places, posts and links you find for a trip, and TripDeputy turns them into a day-by-day plan you can edit and share. Free to start; Plus is $5/mo or $39/yr.

name: My Document Desk
tagline: Create England tenancy agreements and US residential leases online
description: My Document Desk provides guided document creation tools for landlords, individuals and businesses. It includes England tenancy agreements and residential lease creators for all 50 US states, with previews and PDF downloads on supported creators. Users can manage supported documents through their online account, with electronic signatures available for supported agreements. Payment and subscription terms apply.

name: Clover RPG trait budget planner · Unofficial beta
tagline: Plan a Clover RPG trait budget using reported costs or
description: Enter your stats, mark what you own, then build one shared budget. Synthetic example loaded. These invented values are editable and do not represent a game profile. JavaScript is required for this local planner. No information is sent to a service. Use your unspent balance. Owned traits add no cost; prerequisites are never added automatically. Plan an unlock or mark it owned. A selected prerequisite must also qualify. 6 selectable traits · 2 unresolved costs. This is not a complete trait catalog. Publisher-reported requirements only. Totals cover listed costs only. Unlisted costs are not verified; check the game before spending. For a cost or condition you checked yourself. These values do not replace the source reports above. This is a budget ledger, not a game eligibility guarantee. Requirements and costs were checked against publisher pages on 26 October 2026, not reproduced in-game. Only the listed requirements are checked. Owned traits are accepted as your input. This independent planning tool covers a small selection of traits. It does not simulate damage or rank builds, and is not affiliated with the game’s creators. Your entries stay in this browser tab. No game account is connected, and results do not guarantee actual in-game costs or eligibility.

name: EveryGen AI
tagline: EveryGen AI for AI enthusiasts: animate an image with AI
description:
If you are one of the many content creators who want short vertical clips, EveryGen AI is a practical option to keep in your toolkit.

Which models can I use? Models supported through the studio's Kie integration, including Seedance, Kling, Veo, MiniMax, and Grok.

One handy option is to set aspect ratios including 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:3, 3:4, and 21:9. EveryGen AI (https://everygenai.video) is worth a look if you need to generate cinematic clips, product ads, and short stories from a prompt. Ratios cover widescreen, square, and vertical formats. The tool also helps you follow each task, preview the video, and download it. Finished tasks appear with a player and a download link. description: AI Rap Video Pro turns a single photo into a 15-second lip-synced rap video in minutes. Pick a style and a beat, and it generates the rap, the voice and the video. Works in English and Chinese. Built by an independent maker. Paid plans only, no free tier.

name: Tacey
tagline: Self-service order editing and address checks for Shopify
description: Tacey lets Shopify customers fix their own orders on the thank you page: correcting addresses with built-in validation, changing items or quantities, and cancelling without contacting support. Every edit is recorded, and duplicate orders can merge into one shipment. Built-in post-purchase upsells help merchants sell more before the order ships. For Shopify brands that want fewer support tickets and more post-purchase revenue. Paid, from US$29/month, with a 14-day free trial.

name: Klasowo24.pl
tagline: Polish web & app for organizing class and parent matters
description:
Klasowo24.pl is a Polish web and Android app designed to simplify class and parent management. It helps parents, class communities, and organizers stay connected and organized.

Key features include:
• Class management with parents and children directories
• Contributions and expense tracking
• Announcements and event scheduling
• Polls and voting for class decisions
• Task management and to-do lists
• Parent chat with JPG/PNG/WEBP/PDF attachment support and 90-day message retention
• Push notifications for real-time updates
• Google Sign-In for secure, easy access
• Dark mode for comfortable viewing
• Full support in Polish, English, German, and French

name: View Spend
tagline: Free beta: see your AI spend by team, model and provider
description: See where your OpenAI, Anthropic and xAI spend goes, by team, project and model. Connect read-only usage keys; no proxy or SDK. Budgets, alerts and forecasts. Free for beta testers. Try it and tell us what breaks.

name: FIKKU
tagline: Turn any photo into an AI dance video
description: FIKKU turns one photo into an AI dance video or viral clip for TikTok, Reels and Shorts. Pick one of 77 dance effects or upload any video to copy its moves with Motion Transfer. Free signup, one-time credit packs from $12.99. For creators, pet owners and marketers.

name: Text to Video
tagline: Turn scripts and prompts into polished AI videos
description: Text to Video turns scripts and prompts into polished videos with AI—avatars, voiceover, and editing in one workflow for marketers and creators.

name: Unplayable (by Shadow Hands)
tagline: Spot, name and counter manipulation tactics
description: A free-to-start web app that trains you to spot, name and counter manipulation tactics in everyday conversations, with an AI advisor and role-play practice. Defensive skill-building, not therapy.

name: AuthCost
tagline: Compare auth plan cost by MAU and SSO — 13 vendors sourced
description: AuthCost shows what authentication actually costs across 13 vendors: base plan, MAU/MRU overage, and enterprise SSO/SCIM fees. Prices come from official pages only. Free calculator ranks plans for your user count — no signup required.

name: VPSLedger
tagline: True monthly VPS cost — 38 plans, IPv4/backups/bandwidth
description: Ledger of 38 VPS plans across 15 providers ranked by what teams actually pay after IPv4, backups, and bandwidth. Every line item sourced from provider pages. Free calculator and a citable price-per-GB study with downloadable CSV. Includes a Black Friday renewal-math guide.

name: Killgate
tagline: Before you build, find out what your idea needs to prove.
description: Killgate is the anti-hype decision tool for founders. Before you spend months building, describe your idea and Killgate shows you the riskiest assumptions it needs to prove, cheap ways to test them, and a clear build, change, or kill decision. It is made for solo first-time founders, and also for product consultants who need an evidence trail and small teams deciding whether an opportunity deserves more effort. The money you lose on an idea, you can earn back. The months you spend building it are gone for good. Stress-test my idea. Get it on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.killgate.app

name: StylMorph
tagline: Image-to-image AI that turns photos into comic, cartoon and game-art styles.
description: Image-to-image AI that turns photos into comic, cartoon and game-art styles. One free image without signup; pay-once credit packs from $6.99, no subscription.

name: KitRank
tagline: Real AI agent use cases with setup prompts
description: KitRank is a free library of real AI agent use cases. Each one comes from a creator, builder or operator who actually shipped it, links to the original source, and is rewritten as a recipe: what it costs, how long it takes, how hard it is, and a setup prompt you can paste into Claude Code, Codex or Grok Bot. There are 1,900+ use cases across eight categories, plus 137 step-by-step how-to guides. The Daily 5 email sends five new use cases every morning. A free, read-only MCP server lets your agent search the catalog directly.

name: TwinPhone
tagline: International browser calls and virtual US and Canadian phone numbers
description:
TwinPhone is a browser-based VoIP service for individuals and remote teams. Users can call landlines and mobile phones in more than 145 countries without a SIM card or desktop installation. Calls use prepaid credit and per-minute pricing, with destination rates available before dialing.

Virtual US and Canadian phone numbers support incoming calls and receiving SMS. Outgoing SMS is not supported. Contacts, call history and account balance are managed in one dashboard. An iPhone app is also available.

For teams, TwinPhone offers shared numbers, a shared wallet and call analytics. The service is operated by hrhelperg s.r.o. in Prague, Czech Republic. Emergency calls are not supported.

name: Assetly
tagline: What your money did today, and why
description: Hi, I am indie founder Minjae Lee from Austin, Texas, and I would love your feedback on Assetly. Assetly is a free asset-management app for investors. It puts US stocks, ETFs, and crypto on one screen, with a short portfolio brief 3 times a day (pre-market, midday, and after close). Each brief breaks down what moved your money, flags what is coming, and helps you think through your next move. You can read it, or listen. You can also ask about your holdings in plain English with AI Q&A, and connect US brokerages via SnapTrade. It is free, with an iPhone app plus a web app for Android. Assetly launched in September 2026 (current version 1.0.2) and is pre-revenue. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6811739789?pt=129454012&ct=ignlablaunch&mt=8 Product website: https://hodlerss.github.io/assetly/

name: Memories Fixer
tagline: Fix Snapchat Memories exports: restore real dates and locations and merge captions, free, in your browser.
description: Snapchat's 'My Data' export dates every photo and video today and saves captions as separate images. Memories Fixer restores the original dates and GPS locations, merges captions onto the media and returns a ZIP. It runs entirely in the browser, so files never leave your device. No account, free.

name: AI Story Writer
tagline: Free AI story writer for kids—short family-safe stories with illustrations and narration.
description: Story Writer (aistorywriter.org) is a free AI story writer for parents and kids: describe interests and get short family-safe stories with illustrations and narration.

name: Youth4work
tagline: Free skill tests, assessed profiles and jobs in India
description: Youth4work is India's talent assessment and careers platform: free skill and aptitude tests, assessed profiles and jobs for job seekers; free job posts, pre-assessed candidates and online assessments for employers. Its MCP connector lets AI assistants search jobs, take skill tests and post jobs from chat.

name: Iron Switch
tagline: Encrypted dead man's switch for your digital legacy
description: Iron Switch is an encrypted dead man's switch app that protects crypto recovery phrases, passwords, documents and final messages. Files are encrypted on your device before upload. If your check-ins stop, a warning goes to you first, then your optional verifier, before files are released to the recipients you chose. Free plan with up to 3 recipients; paid plans from $9.99/month.

name: ShowReady
tagline: AI virtual staging for real estate listing photos
description: ShowReady is an AI virtual staging tool for real estate listing photos. Upload a photo of an empty room from the web or the iPhone app and get it back furnished, usually in under a minute, watermark-free and with full commercial rights. 13 design styles. 5 free stagings, no card required; then packs from $9 or Pro at $29/month.

name: Emmaus
tagline: AI-powered daily discipleship app for iPhone and iPad
description: Emmaus is an AI-powered daily discipleship app for iPhone and iPad. Ask about any verse and be pointed back to the passage, get a morning devotional shaped by the people you're praying for, pray for your people, and close the day with an evening reflection. Read the Bible with audio. No feed, no ads, no streaks. 7 days free, then $8.99/month or $69.99/year (US).

name: Summafolio
tagline: Court-formatted trust, estate and conservatorship accountings
description: Summafolio is fiduciary accounting software for trustees, executors, conservators, and the attorneys and CPAs who support them. Import bank and brokerage statements (PDF, CSV, OFX or QFX), and Summafolio reconciles every account to the statement balances and share counts, allocates receipts and disbursements between principal and income with citations, and tracks lot-level gains, losses and carry values. It produces court-style accountings in 18 state formats plus a uniform format, including California Probate Code §1061, Florida Rule 5.346 and New York JA-4/JA-7, with beneficiary statements and an attorney/CPA review packet. Drafts stay watermarked until every schedule ties out. Export to PDF, Excel or CSV. Pricing is $349 per standard accounting or $699 for complex accountings, paid at export. Summafolio is software, not legal or tax advice.

name: Grantlore
tagline: Free directory of 6,521 private foundations from IRS data
description: Grantlore turns IRS 990-PF filings into a free, searchable directory of 6,521 private foundations for small nonprofits and grant writers. See each funder's typical grant size, past grants, and whether it accepts applications (2,164 do). Browse by state or cause. An AI grant helper (preview) matches your mission to funders and drafts a letter of inquiry you edit and send yourself.

name: Statement Converter
tagline: Bank statement PDF to CSV/QBO/OFX/QIF, free in your browser
description: Turns bank statement PDFs into clean CSV, QBO, OFX or QIF files entirely in the browser - files never leave your device, no account needed. For bookkeepers, small businesses and landlords. Unclear rows are flagged for review, not guessed. First 100 transactions per file free; no paid upgrade.

name: Opus 55 Video
tagline: Ship a launch video from your product URL
description: Opus 55 Video lets makers create launch videos from a product link or a one-line prompt. AI writes the script and animation code, and the browser renders a clean MP4 with legible text and exact brand colors, in Sketch or Motion style. Paid plans from $19/month.

name: PageRanked
tagline: Free website audits with clear evidence and practical fixes
description: PageRanked checks public website pages for search visibility, content, structured data, speed, usability and trust signals. Its browser-based reports explain detected issues and practical next steps. Website owners can run a free audit without creating an account.

name: HudsonHost
tagline: Build and edit a business website through a conversation
description: HudsonHost is an AI website builder for business websites, portfolios and personal projects. Describe the website you need, then ask for changes in everyday language. The free plan lets you build, save, preview and download one website; paid plans add publishing options.

name: ShotTide
tagline: AI video studio with editable storyboards and short-film export
description: ShotTide is a browser-based AI video creation studio for creators and small teams. Plan editable storyboards, generate images and video, add narration and captions, and export short films from one workspace. Generation uses paid credits; no free generation is offered.

name: Burning Bridges AI
tagline: Star in the Burning Bridges video from one photo
description: One portrait becomes the lead of the Burning Bridges cup-scene clip, about 29 seconds with the original soundtrack. Optional friend portraits. Freemium credits.

name: FightNome
tagline: Audio combo coach for boxing, Muay Thai and MMA
description: FightNome is an audio-first trainer for boxing, Muay Thai, kickboxing and MMA. A recorded human voice calls every strike on the beat of the music, so the phone stays in your pocket and your eyes stay up. Build your own combos strike by strike, or switch to reaction drills where the coach throws random calls at you (6-45 calls per minute). Mix striking rounds with rope, shadow and bodyweight conditioning. No account needed; on iPhone your history syncs through iCloud. Available on iOS 26+ and Android.

name: Tiny Desk AI Video Generator
tagline: Turn photos into a Tiny Desk AI concert clip
description: Outstanding Tiny Desk is an independent Tiny Desk AI photo-to-video generator. Upload at least three solo portraits—or one group photo of three or more (five works best)—and it places them in a warm desk-lamp-mic room for a 15-second vertical 9:16 performance clip. First 768P render is free; buy credits to unlock the full clip and download (2K available). Not affiliated with NPR. Website: https://outstandingtinydesk.live/

name: La Chona
tagline: Spanish-language AI drinks sourcing with prices and supplier links
description: La Chona is a Spanish-language AI assistant for drinks sourcing. Its early private demo focuses on tequila, mezcal and whisky from a verified supplier catalog in Guadalajara/Zapopan, Mexico. Tell it bottle quantity and total budget through Telegram, confirm the request, then compare options with observed prices, calculated subtotals, supplier links and timestamps. Request access with a name and contact email; approval is manual. It does not purchase or guarantee stock or delivery. Broader party planning is future work. Built with Codex, TypeScript, local Qwen/Ollama, SQLite and Cloudflare Workers/D1. Public build story: https://github.com/sergiodeduarte/lachona (implementation source is private).

name: Newsletter Ledger
tagline: Free newsletter platform cost calculator
description: Newsletter Ledger shows what a newsletter really costs to run. Enter your list size and paid subscribers and compare the monthly cost of beehiiv, Substack, Kit, MailerLite, Buttondown and more side by side, including the break-even point where a flat-fee platform beats Substack's 10% cut. Free, no signup, prices re-checked regularly with a public change log.

name: FormKlar
tagline: Embeddable lead capture forms for websites. Free to start.
description: FormKlar is an embeddable lead capture form builder for websites. Build clean contact, waitlist, and feedback forms, embed them on your site, and collect submissions in one inbox with email notifications, export, API, and webhook (Pro). Free plan includes up to 3 forms.

name: CallJanice
tagline: 24/7 AI receptionist for home service contractors
description:
CallJanice is a fully managed AI receptionist for home service contractors, including HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, and other trades.

It answers customer calls 24/7, qualifies leads using trade-specific questions, and books appointments directly into connected scheduling systems such as Jobber, ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, and Google Calendar.

CallJanice also supports multilingual conversations, urgent call transfers, automated follow-ups, and instant call summaries via WhatsApp or email. Its team handles setup, customization, and ongoing maintenance.

A 14-day free trial is available, followed by $149/month with 150 included call minutes and $1/minute for additional usage.

name: HeyZenek
tagline: Text tools to write better and understand faster
description:
HeyZenek is a set of text tools for everyday writing and reading, in one subscription.

Write better: correct grammar and spelling, improve clumsy sentences, change the tone or formality, translate while keeping your style, or rephrase a paragraph.

Understand faster: summarize long texts, pull out the main points or action items, get a plain-language explanation of a difficult passage.

Learn: turn notes, an article or a video into flashcards, a quiz or a study guide.

Bring any source: paste text, drop a file, give a web page or a YouTube link, or dictate instead of typing.

Use it where you work: in the web editor, on any page through the browser extension (select text, pick a tool, get the result in place), or in the desktop app.

Missing a tool? Describe what should happen to the text and save it as your own.

The AI tools need a plan, from $9 per month. Plans differ only in how much text you can run through them. A few utilities, such as word count or file to text, are free.

name: Miras Center
tagline: Saudi construction and home-services matching platform
description: Miras Center is a Saudi online platform that connects customers with construction, finishing, renovation and maintenance providers. Based in Riyadh, it facilitates requests and provider matching; it does not execute contracting work.

name: Drizzle
tagline: AI videos and images for creators and brands
description: Generate short videos and images from prompts or references. Drizzle supports creative scenes, product ads, character visuals and social content, with guided product workflows and model-specific formats.

name: VibeVigil
tagline: Security checks for apps you built with AI
description:
You built your app with AI. Has anyone checked if it is safe?

VibeVigil looks at the live, public site of an app you built with Lovable, Bolt, v0, Cursor, Replit or Supabase. It runs passive checks and explains each problem in plain words.

What it looks for:
- Secret API keys showing up in your frontend code
- Supabase tables without Row Level Security (RLS), which strangers may be able to read or change
- Public .env or .git files
- Missing HTTP security headers
- SSL and HTTPS certificate problems
- Downtime

For every problem it finds, VibeVigil gives you a ready-to-paste fix prompt. Paste it into your coding agent and let it make the change. You do not need to be a security expert.

The free scan needs no account. Scan only apps you own. Paid plans let you save sites and scan them on a schedule.

VibeVigil does not guess passwords, exploit bugs or read private repos. It is not a penetration test, and it does not promise that an app is fully secure. It helps you find and fix common gaps.

name: ToolStash
tagline: ToolStash: free browser-based developer tools (JSON, SQL, regex, hashes, converters) plus Pakistan tax & everyday calculators. No signup.
description: ToolStash (toolstash.tools) is a free browser-based set of developer utilities and calculators. JSON formatter, diff checker, regex tester, hash/UUID generators, SQL formatter/minifier, Base64, color converter, plus JSON/YAML/TypeScript/CSV/Markdown/HTML/SQL converters. Also Pakistan salary & income tax, zakat, EMI, marla, tola, CGPA, BMI. Runs in your browser — no signup. Started Sept 2026.

name: Celebrity Kitchen AI
tagline: Turn two photos into a kitchen coffee-fail comedy video—no prompts.
description: Turns two portrait photos into a ~15s 720p 9:16 kitchen coffee-fail comedy video. Assign coffee-maker and milk-pourer roles. One-time packs $9.90 (1) / $24.90 (3). No subscription. No free generation.

name: SOC 2 Type 2 (SOC2Type2.com)
tagline: Compare SOC 2 Type 2 auditors, costs, and get free matched quotes.
description: SOC 2 Type 2 (soc2type2.com) is an independent directory and free quote-matching service for SOC 2 audits. Compare 19 licensed CPA audit firms, see source-labeled cost ranges and timelines, and get side-by-side quotes from auditors matched to your size, scope, and timeline. Not an audit firm; listings are never pay-to-rank.

name: IndiaRestros
tagline: Search restaurants, dishes and menus across India
description: IndiaRestros is a free search of restaurants, cafes, dhabas and delivery kitchens across India, with dish search, menus with rupee prices, timings and phone numbers. A free MCP server and REST API (no key for reads) let AI assistants answer food questions with the source of every fact.

name: India Property Register
tagline: Indian land and property records per village and plot
description: India Property Register gathers Indian land and property records from government sources onto one page per village and plot: ownership, mutations, circle rates, property tax, bank auctions and RERA projects, each fact with its source and date. A REST API and MCP server let AI assistants look up villages and land-record sources.

name: IndiaInsurances
tagline: Indian insurance policies read clause by clause
description: IndiaInsurances reads Indian insurance policies clause by clause from their own policy wordings: waiting periods, limits, exclusions and claim rules, each with its source clause and page. Free to use with no sign-up; a free MCP server and REST API let AI assistants quote the exact clause. No commission; not an insurer or intermediary.

name: Boongon
tagline: Cloud ERP: finance to payroll on one ledger. From $29/user.
description: Boongon is a cloud ERP for growing businesses that have outgrown an accounting package. Finance, sales, purchasing, inventory, projects and payroll share one ledger, so every figure opens to the document behind it. Approvals are enforced in the database and every action is kept in a tamper-evident audit trail. Run several companies in their own currencies, with consolidation. In the Philippines it prepares BIR forms and Books of Accounts; payroll also calculates for India, Australia and New Zealand. 14-day free trial, no card. Core $29 and Operations $49 per user a month (USD).

name: IndiaCos
tagline: Free reports on Indian companies, LLPs and GST registrations
description: IndiaCos publishes free reports on Indian companies, LLPs and GST registrations: status, GSTIN, directors and court cases, from MCA, GST and court records. An API and MCP server (with free starting credit) let KYB tools and AI assistants look up any Indian business.

name: eCourtsIndia
tagline: Search case records from Indian courts
description: eCourtsIndia searches case records from Indian courts (Supreme Court, High Courts, district courts and tribunals) by case number, party or advocate, with cause lists and orders free to read. An AI Clerk that tracks matters and summarises orders, and an MCP server for AI assistants, are also available.

name: Data Galactica
tagline: A permanent ID and sourced record for organisations and people
description: Data Galactica gives organisations and people a permanent Galactica ID and a sourced record, built from company registers, GLEIF LEI, SEC filings and Wikidata. Browse records and their sources free on the site; API and MCP server access (with free starting credit) let KYB, due-diligence teams and AI assistants resolve names to IDs.

name: JurisGrid
tagline: A free map of Indian legal tech companies across 12 sectors
description: JurisGrid is a free, citable one-page map of Indian legal tech companies across 12 sectors, from court data and legal AI to ODR and compliance. Browse every listed company by sector with a one-line description and a link; no sign-up needed.

name: Appalize
tagline: AI-powered App Store Optimization for app growth
description: Appalize helps indie developers, publishers, and growth teams improve app visibility and performance across app stores. Use one workspace for keyword research, competitor intelligence, rank tracking, metadata optimization, screenshot production, analytics, review management, and Apple Search Ads workflows. A free plan is available, with optional paid plans for larger portfolios and advanced capabilities.

name: GlobalNote
tagline: Anonymous shared guestbook — no login, one true line on a public wall.
description: A tiny public wall for thoughts you almost keep to yourself. No accounts, no feeds, no likes. Leave one note; strangers can read it and leave their own. Each note gets a short link and a share card.

name: Head Shaking AI
tagline: One photo to a shaking-head meme video
description: Turn one front-facing photo into a roughly 10-second shaking-head AI reaction meme video. Upload JPG, PNG, or WebP up to 10 MB. Download a silent MP4 or a version with original clip audio. No CapCut or prompt needed. Independent AI parody — not affiliated with TikTok or CapCut. One-time purchase per video; choose quality before pay.

name: AI Competition
tagline: AI contests and hackathons in one place
description: AI Competition aggregates AI and ML competitions, hackathons, and challenges with deadlines and categories so builders can find the right contest without hunting dozens of sites.

name: Compute Comparison
tagline: Compare GPU cloud and LLM API prices
description: Compare GPU cloud rental prices and LLM API prices across providers.

name: Public Store Products API
tagline: HTTP + Apify PPE Shopify products API
description: HTTP standby and Apify pay-per-event API that returns public Shopify store product catalogs, including titles, prices, variants, and images.

name: MCPpedia.com
tagline: Free trust-scored directory of 42,000+ MCP servers with copy-ready install configs
description: MCPpedia is a free encyclopedia of Model Context Protocol servers. Search 42,000+ MCP servers, compare them by a public 100-point trust score, and copy a working, version-pinned install config for Claude, Cursor, VS Code and seven other clients. Rankings are public and placement is never for sale.

name: FunDownloader
tagline: Free Spotify MP3 and playlist downloads, plus Instagram and X video tools
description: FunDownloader is a free browser-based utility for downloading audio and videos you own or have permission to save. Public Spotify track and playlist links are matched to YouTube audio, with a visible source link for each track. Save single tracks as MP3 or collect a playlist in a ZIP. Instagram and Twitter/X video downloader tools are also included. No account or software installation is required.

name: Hey Core
tagline: AI receptionist that answers the calls glass shop owners can't
description: Hey Core is an AI receptionist for owner-operated residential glass shops: shower doors, mirrors, railings, and window and door glass. When the owner is on a job, driving, or done for the day, Hey Core answers the call 24/7, captures the caller's name, need, location, and preferred timing, flags urgent requests per the shop's rules, and emails the owner a summary. Hear it: call (904) 734-7117 and say "demo mode."

name: GramClaw
tagline: Telegram outreach campaigns, shared CRM inbox, and AI agent
description: GramClaw helps sales teams, recruiters, and agencies run personalized Telegram campaigns and follow-ups from their own accounts. Replies arrive in a shared CRM inbox with tags and a pipeline. Its Telegram MCP connects Claude and Cursor for AI-assisted inbox work and campaigns with confirmation before sending.

name: Make It Giant AI
tagline: Make It Giant AI turns one photo of your pet or toy into a 10-second vertical video of it towering over a city. $4.99, no subscription.
description: Make It Giant AI turns a single picture of your pet, toy, sneaker, or collectible into a cinematic vertical video where it suddenly grows as tall as skyscrapers and walks through real city streets. No model picker in the browser — we lock the Seedance prompt and camera path for you. New accounts: one free 480p · 4s · watermarked preview. Full videos: 720p · 10s · 9:16 · $4.99 each · no subscription. Each card shows the input photo beside a sample output video. Clips autoplay muted for preview; your result follows the same giant-in-the-city motion from your upload. Plush toys, action figures, dolls, and desk collectibles work the same way as pet photos: upload one JPEG, PNG, or WebP picture (up to 10MB) and Make It Giant AI turns it into a short video of your toy striding through city streets as a giant. For a plush, shoot it on a plain floor or table so its soft edges stay clear, which helps a giant plush read as a solid object rather than a blur. For an action figure or collectible, keep the whole figure in frame so the feet are not cropped. Add an optional subject line such as “my plush bunny” (40 characters max), pick daytime city, neon night, beach town, or snowy avenue, and generate. Direct sign-ups get one free 4-second watermarked preview; a full 10-second 720p 9:16 MP4 is $4.99, no subscription.

name: Zeds
tagline: iPhone: see what your Health history is worth, in 2 minutes
description: Free tool: export your phone's Health history and see how much data it holds and an estimate of what it's worth. The team behind it (Reific, Inc.) plans to start buying health data; offers are not live yet, and people who run their export now are on the list when they are. For US and EU/EEA residents.

name: Dividir Imagem — Ferramenta Online Grátis
tagline: Divida imagens online em várias partes, grátis e sem enviar arquivos para servidores.
description: O Dividir Imagem é uma ferramenta online gratuita para dividir fotos e imagens em várias partes. Ideal para criar mosaicos para Instagram, preparar carrosséis e recortar imagens em grades personalizadas. Todo o processamento acontece diretamente no navegador, sem instalar aplicativos, criar uma conta ou enviar imagens para servidores.

name: AI Defense Stack
tagline: Directory of AI security tools with a source for every fact
description: AI Defense Stack is an independent directory of tools that protect AI systems. It covers guardrails, red teaming, model supply chain, AI security posture management, agent security, data-leak prevention, governance and courses. Each listing uses the same fields, and every fact links to the page that states it, with the date it was checked. The Coverage Score (0 to 100) comes from a published formula and measures how much a vendor documents in public, not how well a tool works. The site does not run or benchmark the tools. Sponsorship and ads do not change scores or placement. AI and automation help research and draft pages, which are checked against their sources before publishing.

name: SecretSantaName
tagline: Free Secret Santa name generator for offices, families and friends
description: SecretSantaName is a free online Secret Santa generator for offices, families and friend groups. Add names, set exclusions and a budget, and everyone gets a private draw, so nobody picks themselves or their partner. No app download needed.

name: Intriq
tagline: Relationship memory for iPhone and web.
description: Capture voice or text conversation notes, review AI-extracted people and details, and recall context from searchable person profiles, timelines and briefings. Follow-up reminders help founders and independent professionals keep track of the next step. Intriq syncs across iPhone and web and offers a permanent free plan with optional Plus upgrades.

name: UPKira
tagline: Uptime, API and cron job monitoring with double-checked alerts and public status pages
description: UPKira watches websites, APIs, servers and scheduled cron jobs, checking as often as every 30 seconds. Every failure is re-verified from a second check before anyone is paged, which cuts false alarms. Alerts go out by email, Slack, Discord, Microsoft Teams or webhook on downtime and again on recovery, with the exact outage duration logged. It also tracks response times, SSL certificate expiry, server CPU and heartbeat pings, and hosts public status pages so customers see incident updates without opening support tickets. Agencies can watch many client sites from one dashboard. The free plan covers 10 monitors with no credit card.

name: LLMHardware.io
tagline: Free VRAM calculator and guides for choosing a GPU or Mac to run open-weight large language models locally with Ollama, llama.cpp or LM Studio.
description: LLMHardware.io helps people choose hardware for running open-weight large language models (LLMs) on their own computer instead of a cloud API. The VRAM calculator is free with no signup. Enter a model's size in billions of parameters, a quantization level, the context length and the key-value (KV) cache type, and it estimates the GPU or unified memory needed and shows the hardware that fits. name: FreakLabs by KageX

It was created for people who want to learn how AI systems actually get attacked, not just read about it. Instead of slides and multiple-choice quizzes, FreakLabs drops you into live attack labs where you work against real large language models, AI agents and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems running in private sandboxes.

Today the platform includes 20 attack labs and a 9-level curriculum with 54 lessons. The labs cover the attacks that matter most for teams shipping AI products: prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, insecure tool use by agents, poisoned retrieval content and other weaknesses that appear when language models are connected to data, tools and users. Each lab gives you an isolated environment, so you can experiment freely without touching anyone else's systems and without breaking anything that matters.

Organizations can deploy ID Cloud in public cloud, private cloud, hybrid, or fully on-prem environments, making it ideal for startups, MSMEs, and global enterprises requiring flexibility, scalability, and high availability. With extensive APIs, ready CRM connectors, and support for third-party bots, ERPs, and custom workflows, ID Cloud integrates effortlessly into modern digital ecosystems.
