name: ColorSeason AI
tagline: Seasonal color analysis that shows which colors suit you best
description: Not sure whether warm or cool tones suit you? ColorSeason AI reads a selfie and assigns one of twelve seasonal palettes. You then see flattering shades for outfits, lipstick, blush and hair color, so shopping gets easier and your wardrobe stops being a pile of near misses. Built for anyone curious about color theory.

name: Regimen
tagline: The practice system for independent oncology and infusion centres. So the doctor can stay the doctor.
description: Regimen is EMR software for independent oncology and infusion centres. It holds the chemotherapy regimen linked to the diagnosis and the patient, captures the administration log with batch and expiry, and keeps the chart so the next step is already written. Built so the doctor can stay the doctor.

name: ActCheck
tagline: EU AI Act readiness map for SMEs
description: ActCheck helps SMEs organise EU AI Act readiness with a structured map from answers to obligation themes, evidence gaps, and priority actions. Start with a free four-question screen, explore the €29 self-serve map, or consider the optional €129 human sanity pass. It is a preparation tool, not an audit or legal advice.

name: Jobzhub Resume Roast
tagline: Free resume score and top fixes. Upload a PDF, no sign-up.
description: Upload your resume or CV as a PDF and get a free score, your top fixes, and a marked-up copy showing what to cut and what's working. No account needed. Built for job seekers in the US, UK and Canada.

name: InkPages
tagline: Free printable coloring pages—or make custom ones from a photo.
description: InkPages offers free gallery coloring sheets (PDF/PNG, A4 & Letter) plus a maker that turns a photo or idea into a custom printable. Ready-made gallery downloads never use credits. Built for parents, teachers, and hobbyists.

name: Random Animal Generator
tagline: Hybrid creature generator for writers, gamers and artists
description: Random Animal Generator stitches together parts of real animals across 11 slots to create original hybrids. Lock favourites, reroll the rest, and tweak theme and weirdness. Each creature includes a name, traits and an AI image prompt. Free with no signup; Pro adds HD renders. Free to start, with optional paid plans.

name: WearTryOn
tagline: AI virtual try-on with your own photo
description: WearTryOn helps online shoppers decide with confidence. Drop in your photo and a garment image from any shop, and the AI shows the item on you while keeping your face, pose and background as they are. Try up to three pieces together, chat with the AI stylist, and score your outfit. Free to start, with optional paid plans.

name: OpenFile
tagline: 360+ free file tools that run in your browser. No uploads, no account.
description: I built OpenFile as a free MIT licensed app to handle files in the browser. It covers PDF tasks like merge, split, compress, sign and OCR, plus images such as HEIC, WebP and AVIF with local AI background removal, and video and audio work using ffmpeg in WebAssembly. It also handles fonts, archives and dev formats. The app works offline and your files never leave your device.

name: Minute Cryptic
tagline: Minute Cryptic daily practice clue
description: Solve an original Minute Cryptic-style clue with golf scoring, progressive hints, and a free archive. An original cryptic clue each day; unlimited archive practice; no login required for core play.

name: Shout My Post
tagline: A free directory of useful websites, apps and online tools
description: Shout My Post helps people discover useful websites, apps and online tools. Listings are organized into clear categories with short, honest summaries instead of marketing copy. Makers can submit their own projects for a free review, and every entry is checked by a human before it goes live.

name: EngineSteps
tagline: Interactive engine repair guides with 3D models and PDF checklists
description: EngineSteps is a browser-based repair reference for selected Mercedes-Benz and BMW engine variants. Choose an engine and repair, then follow a checklist linked to selectable 3D components. Users can inspect component relationships, save completion marks locally and download illustrated PDF checklists with completion boxes.

name: TaleScene
tagline: Write a paragraph. Get a voiced multi-scene film.
description: TaleScene is an AI video generator that turns a short story into a screenplay, storyboard, and voiced multi-scene film with consistent characters. Free credits to try; no card for the storyboard.

name: Comicory
tagline: AI comic generator with consistent characters
description: Comicory is an AI comic generator that turns your story into a scripted, multi-panel comic, manga or webtoon with consistent characters. Free to try, no card.

name: QueryCherry
tagline: A little more delightful. A lot more useful.
description:
QueryCherry is a collection of 22 free online tools for working with SQL, CSV, JSON, data cleaning, and everyday developer tasks.

It's built for developers, data analysts, students, and anyone who works with data and needs simple, handy tools to get things done.

No fuss. Just useful tools, all in one place, with a little more personality.

name: Bulk QR Code Generator
tagline: Generate hundreds of QR codes from Excel or CSV at once
description:
Bulk QR Code Generator turns a list into many QR codes in one go. Enter one URL or line of text per row, or upload a CSV or Excel (XLSX) file; example files show the expected layout. Generate the batch and download every code in a single ZIP file.

You can choose foreground and background colours, an image size from 200 to 600 pixels, PNG or SVG output and a filename prefix. Pro users can also add a logo or background image. The codes are static: they do not expire, have no scan limit, and can be used commercially. For print, SVG is recommended.

The free plan makes up to 50 QR codes per batch; the Professional plan allows up to 1,000 per batch. Downloading the ZIP needs a free account. Chrome and Edge extensions are available. Typical uses are product and asset labels, event tickets, classroom handouts and printed marketing material.

name: Bulk Barcode Generator
tagline: Create barcodes in bulk from Excel or CSV, download as ZIP
description:
Bulk Barcode Generator is a web tool for making many barcodes at once. Enter one value per line, or upload a CSV or Excel (XLSX) file; example files are provided so you can match the layout. Then generate the whole batch and download it as a single ZIP file.

It supports CODE 128, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC, EAN-5, EAN-2, CODE 39, ITF-14, MSI, Pharmacode and Codabar. You can set foreground and background colours, bar width and height, margin, font and font size, whether the text is shown and where, and a filename prefix. Images are saved as PNG or SVG.

The free plan creates up to 20 barcodes per batch; the Professional plan raises that to 1,000 per batch. Downloading the ZIP needs a free account. There are also Chrome and Edge extensions and a UPC lookup page. It is useful for product labels, inventory, warehouse shelves and small shops.

name: RapCraft
tagline: Rap lyrics and lyric-led AI video creation for music creators
description: RapCraft helps music creators draft and edit English and Mandarin rap lyrics. Its official website describes turning an uploaded finished rap and performed lyrics into aligned AI video scenes, captions and downloadable MP4. A separate free browser beat sketcher uses local synthesis, not AI-generated audio, and exports WAV. Free entry features coexist with paid generation credits. Video and song capabilities are described by the official site and have not been independently tested end to end.

name: Paper General
tagline: Free printable graph paper—34 grids, PDF download, no signup
description: PaperGeneral is a free online generator for printable graph paper with 34 grid styles, six paper sizes, live preview, and print-ready PDF download. No account, no watermark, no paywall.

name: Christmas Cookie Menu Card Maker
tagline: Printable Christmas cookie menus for homemade gift boxes
description: Cookie Card Maker helps home bakers create a menu for their Christmas cookie boxes. Add cookie names, optional descriptions and photos, choose one of three festive designs, and download a printable PDF. No account is required. Editing stays in the current browser tab; designs are not saved to an account. All current designs and PDF downloads are free during launch. Paid plans are planned for a future release; pricing and timing have not been announced.

name: Apk Free Cine
tagline: FreeCine APK download info and install guides for Android.
description: Apk Free Cine helps Android users find verified FreeCine APK release details, install steps, and safety guidance. It covers movies, TV, live channels, and sports info for the free FreeCine app, plus phone, TV, and PC notes. Independent informational site, not the app publisher.

name: AI Rap Videos
tagline: Create rap music videos with AI
description: AI Rap Videos helps musicians and creators turn their ideas into AI-generated video scenes for rap music videos. Create visuals for music releases, promotional clips and creative projects.

name: AprireP7M
tagline: Preview signed P7M documents locally in your browser
description: AprireP7M helps Italian-speaking users read supported PDF or XML content inside digitally signed P7M files. Documents are processed locally in the browser without uploading them. Preview and technical signature checks are free, with no registration. Downloading an embedded original PDF is a separate paid service; XML is not converted to PDF. These technical checks are not a qualified signature validation service.

name: Trial Reels Daily Count Tool
tagline: Trial Reels Daily Count Tool records every Trial Reel in a posting day, marks baseline and added positions, and compares the batch using only the readings and w
description:
Trial Reels Daily Count Tool records every Trial Reel in a posting day, marks baseline and added positions, and compares the batch using only the readings and work time the user enters.

Each entry stays in the user's own browser local storage. The tool does not collect or upload entries.

Calculations are planning comparisons, not Instagram metrics or a posting target; when a required reading is missing the calculation is left unavailable.

name: LayerGrab
tagline: Separate AI images into editable transparent layers
description: LayerGrab is an AI image layer separator. Upload an AI-generated image and get each element as a transparent PNG with the background filled in for Canva, Figma, or Photoshop.

name: VEIL
tagline: Hide a playful secret inside an ordinary-looking text message
description: VEIL is a freemium web app that hides a surprise inside ordinary-looking text. Write a secret and a cover sentence, copy the result, then paste it into VEIL to reveal the hidden message. Its homepage has a recipe-app cover. An account is required; messaging-app compatibility can vary, and hidden text is not a guarantee of secure messaging. Watch the real-screen demo at https://veil-intro.stamoss.chatgpt.site/. Submitted on behalf of the creator.

name: AI Connections Solver
tagline: Free NYT Connections helper — hints, practice, and grouping help without spoiling the whole board.
description: AI Connections Solver is a free independent helper for the NYT Connections puzzle: spoiler-light hints, a practice board, archive, and optional AI grouping help when you paste your 16 words. Free, no signup, not affiliated with the New York Times.

name: Printable Calendar PDF
tagline: Free printable calendar PDFs
description: Printable Calendar PDF is a free productivity tool to generate and print monthly or yearly calendars as PDFs. Add personal notes, include US holidays, choose Sunday or Monday week start, and download PDF or Excel templates. https://printablecalendarpdf.com/

name: birthchart.io
tagline: Free birth charts, Moon phases and astrology tools in your browser
description: birthchart.io offers nine free tools in English and Simplified Chinese: birth charts, rising and Moon signs, today’s Moon phase, Saturn return, transits, synastry, solar return and Chinese zodiac. No account or download is required. Calculations run in your browser, with optional local memory for birth details that can be turned off or cleared. The site explains chart symbols, calculation methods and limitations. Astrological interpretations are symbolic material for reflection, not scientific predictions.

name: SavvyToolz
tagline: Free browser utilities for everyday code, text and file tasks
description: SavvyToolz offers 42 free tools in one browser-based collection. Use it to format or repair JSON, see differences between two versions of text, convert time zones, and handle PDF and image tasks. There is no account requirement for using the tools, and the site is available in eight languages. It is a practical starting point for small jobs that would otherwise send you looking for several separate utilities.

name: Prmbr
tagline: Curated AI prompts and prompt examples for better LLM results
description: Prmbr is a curated collection of high-quality AI prompts and prompt examples for ChatGPT, Claude, and other LLMs. Browse categorized prompts to get better results faster. Free to explore at https://prmbr.com.

name: MotifDeck
tagline: Animate characters and choose your game-ready frames
description: MotifDeck is an AI game art workspace for creators. Generate a motion video from character art, extract frames, clean backgrounds, and choose frame order and timing. Limited previews are free; downloading generated files requires a paid unlock.

name: MorsePass
tagline: Free FCC ham radio practice tests plus a Morse code trainer
description: MorsePass offers free FCC ham radio license practice tests (Technician, General, Extra) with official question pools, plus a Morse code trainer and translator with sample-accurate Web Audio practice to build real copy skill.

name: QuantSprint
tagline: Free Optiver 80 in 8 and quant mental math practice tests
description: QuantSprint offers free Optiver 80 in 8 and quant mental math practice tests for trading firm online assessments (IMC, SIG, Flow Traders, Akuna). Practice firm-calibrated mental math, number sequences, probability and cognitive assessments with question-level response telemetry.

name: XCoffee (小咖拼豆)
tagline: Photo to bead pattern: free editing, color counts, A4 PDFs
description: Free in-browser photo to perler/fuse bead pattern converter. Adjust grid and colors, check MARD, Perler, Hama or Artkal counts, export A4 tiled PDFs.

name: TallyClip
tagline: Bank PDFs → Excel, CSV & QuickBooks Online imports
description: TallyClip turns messy bank-statement PDFs into structured Excel/CSV files ready for bookkeeping or QuickBooks Online import. Built for bookkeepers, accountants, and small businesses who waste hours retyping statements. A focused SaaS for converting bank statements into clean, import-ready data—without the spreadsheet grind.

name: Asia Miles Calculator
tagline: Free Asia Miles and Cathay mixed-cabin mileage calculator plus award-seat search bookmarklet
description: Free Asia Miles / Cathay Pacific mixed-cabin mileage calculator plus bookmarklet for bulk Cathay award-seat search (also https://asiamiles-calculator.site/award-search).

name: Remit.ee
tagline: Free image to URL converter, no signup
description: Free image hosting with no signup. Upload JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP or HEIC up to 20MB and copy a direct HTTPS URL or Markdown, HTML and BBCode embed codes.

name: DocToMD
tagline: Free PDF, Word & webpage to Markdown
description: DocToMD converts Word, PDF, Excel, PowerPoint, EPUB, HTML, CSV, JSON and public webpage URLs into Markdown you can preview, copy or download. 3 free conversions a day with no signup; paid passes add OCR for scanned PDFs and ZIP.

name: BoreGame
tagline: Discover 1,776 free daily Wordle-like games across 17 categories.
description: Discover 1,776 free daily Wordle-like games across 17 categories. Browse most played titles and jump to each official site.

name: Best for Kids
tagline: Parent-checked websites, games, apps, and videos by age.
description: Parent-checked websites, games, apps, and videos by age. Short lists with ads, account, and content notes before you hand over the screen. Browse by ages 3–5, 6–8, 9–12; doors for play, learn, apps, and shows.

name: What Shoes Are These?
tagline: Identify any shoe or bag from a photo
description: Free AI shoe and bag identifier. Upload or paste a photo and it names the brand, model and colorway with a confidence score, plus where to buy it and cheaper lookalikes. Covers sneakers, boots, sandals and loafers, and handbags, totes and backpacks. Free to try: 1 ID/day without an account, 3/day with a free account.

name: PicTranslate
tagline: AI image translator: translate photos, manga, menus and documents in 46 languages, keeping the original layout.
description: PicTranslate is an AI image translator and OCR tool. It extracts and translates text from photos, screenshots, menus, manga pages and documents in 46 languages while keeping the original layout, so translated text stays where it belongs. Batch translation handles whole sets of images at once, and travel, menu, product and screenshot translators cover the most common everyday cases without retyping.

name: CelebrateYou
tagline: Personalized AI birthday songs from your memories
description: CelebrateYou creates personalized birthday songs from their name and your shared memories—ready in minutes, with a free preview. Unlock full MP3, lyrics PDF, and a private gift page at https://celebrateyou.app/

name: Sticker Banner
tagline: Free TikTok sticker banner maker from any photo or video. Not affiliated with TikTok.
description: Sticker Banner is a free browser tool that cuts one photo, GIF or video into 3, 6 or 9 square MP4 sticker videos that line up as a banner in your TikTok profile's Stickers tab. No sign-up, no watermark. Not affiliated with TikTok.

name: AIComics
tagline: Turn any story into a comic with AI.
description: AIComics is an AI comic maker that turns your story into fully illustrated comic pages, with consistent characters, panel layouts and editable speech bubbles. Free to start with 500 credits; pay-as-you-go credit packs from $0.99; no subscription. Creators own their work including commercial use. Web studio: write or paste a story, get a script, consistent characters, and illustrated pages. Edit bubbles/text, export, or publish to the gallery. Five art styles. English and Simplified Chinese.

name: NamePractice
tagline: Free name and letter tracing worksheets for preschool
description: Free name tracing worksheets for preschool and kindergarten: type a name, pick an age band, and print a Trace, Copy, Write PDF in US Letter or A4.

name: Victoria Secret AI
tagline: Unofficial Victoria Secret AI: one photo → angel runway video. Not affiliated with Victoria's Secret. Paid from $9.99/video.
description: Unofficial Victoria Secret AI trend video generator. Turn one photo of you or your pet into a 10 to 12 second angel runway video with wings, stage lights and sound. HD, no watermark. Not affiliated with Victoria's Secret. Paid from $9.99/video.

name: FancyFont
tagline: Free fancy text you can copy and paste
description: Free fancy text generator with 30 Unicode styles, gaming nicknames, and symbols. Copy and paste into a bio, chat, or profile. No sign-up and no font to install.

name: SKY-001 Guide
tagline: Explainer and waitlist for Skyfall AI's SKY-001 model
description: An informational site about SKY-001, Skyfall AI's engineering world model for 3D CAD and BIM design: capabilities, benchmark figures, FAQ and a waitlist. It does not run the model and is not a Skyfall AI account.

name: Wonder Agent Play
tagline: Independent playground for Muse-Wonder-1.0 (coming soon)
description: An independent, unofficial workbench for the Muse-Wonder-1.0 coding model with prompt templates for code fixes, unit tests and JSON output. The playground is locked until the model goes live; not affiliated with Meta.

name: IG Story Viewer
tagline: View and download public Instagram Stories without logging in
description: IG Story Viewer lets you view public Instagram Stories in your browser without logging in to Instagram. Type a public username, see the current Story photos and videos, and download individual items. No registration, no app and no Instagram account needed. Only public accounts work; private accounts are not supported. There is a free lookup every day; if you need more, one-time packs start at $3.99 for 50 successful lookups (no subscription). Not affiliated with Instagram or Meta.

name: Clef Omni Demo
tagline: Try the Clef Omni multimodal decision model online
description: A demo playground and hosted API for Clef Omni, a multimodal decision model that reads text, images, audio or video and returns probabilities for each allowed option. Free anonymous runs; prepaid packs from $5.

name: OneSMM
tagline: SMM panel for Telegram, TikTok, YouTube, X and Facebook services
description: OneSMM is a social media marketing (SMM) panel. Customers compare services for Telegram, TikTok, YouTube, X (Twitter) and Facebook, see the price, minimum and maximum quantity and refill conditions of each service before ordering, and track their orders from one account. Payment is per order, and some services can be tested with free trial credit first. Resellers can connect through the panel API.

name: Remove Background From Video
tagline: AI Cutout Studio — remove video background online
description: Remove a video background online with AI, no green screen. Upload up to 60 seconds (MP4, MOV, WebM, or GIF, up to 200MB); export transparent WebM, ProRes 4444 MOV, GIF, or green-screen MP4 with source audio. One-time credit packs, no subscription, credits never expire, no watermark on paid exports. Built for creators who need clean footage in the browser.

name: HipGen
tagline: Turn a selfie into a rap video in minutes.
description: HipGen is an AI rap generator. Upload one or two photos and get a 12- or 24-second rap video with lyrics, voice, beat, and lip-sync — ready for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.

name: TinyGIF
tagline: Free browser GIF compressor — no upload, no signup
description: TinyGIF is a free suite of browser-based GIF tools for creators, Discord moderators, Twitch/Kick streamers, and anyone who needs a smaller animated file without installing software or uploading media. All processing runs client-side with WebAssembly. Compress GIFs toward common caps (256KB, 512KB, 1MB, 10MB) or Discord limits, convert video, MP4 and WebP to GIF, make Discord banner GIFs, resize Discord/Twitch/Kick emotes, and convert GIF to APNG. No signup, no watermark, no cloud upload — files stay on your device.

name: MeloSkill
tagline: Frontend and UI skills for coding agents — see the file before you install.
description: MeloSkill is a directory of frontend and UI skills for coding agents. Each listing quotes the public SKILL.md, shows an install command that points at GitHub, and lets you read the file before you install. For Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. Free — no account.

name: Classroom Games
tagline: Free browser games
description: Classroom Games is a free browser games site with racing, driving, sports, puzzles, strategy, clickers and 2-player games. Play without signing in; favorites and recently played stay in the browser. Built for short sessions and classroom-friendly breaks.

name: सरकारी सेवक टूलकिट
tagline: Practical Online Calculators for Government Employees Across India
description: सरकारी सेवक टूलकिट (GovSevak.com) is an independent online platform providing practical calculators and digital tools for government employees across India. It covers Central Government, all State Governments, Union Territories and UGC-related employees. Its tools support salary, Dearness Allowance (DA), pension, retirement benefits, income tax and other employee-related calculations. The platform aims to make complex government employee calculations easier and more accessible.

name: Step Into the Scene
tagline: AI trend videos from one photo
description: Step Into the Scene turns a single photo into short AI trend videos (TikTok/Reels style). Pick a scene template, upload one clear photo, and get a ready-to-share clip in a few minutes. Trends update weekly; named AI models shown per template. Includes talking pets, dance, birthday, and holiday scenes. Paid packs from $9.99.

name: ScanMyTerms
tagline: Find the contract clauses that work against you
description: ScanMyTerms helps freelancers, small studios and cross-border sellers spot the clauses that work against them before they sign. Upload a contract or terms of service as a PDF, DOCX, TXT or MD file, or as a photograph, up to 30 pages. In about a minute you get each risky clause with its risk level, the exact wording, why it hurts you and how to change it. A free preview, with no sign-up, shows the risk count and the first two findings. The full report costs $5. Your documents are not used to train AI, and reports are deleted after 7 days. 100 free guides are at scanmyterms.com/guides. Not legal advice.

name: PawPortrait Lab
tagline: Freemium AI pet portrait studio — 50+ styles.
description: Freemium AI tool: pet photo → 50+ portrait styles. Free preview, paid HD unlock. Built for pet parents and gift buyers.

name: Take Dictation
tagline: Fast, private dictation. Your words where you want them on your Mac.
description:
Fast, private dictation. Your words where you want them on your Mac.

Finish talking and keep going. Take Dictation puts your words at the cursor, with speech recognition and cleanup happening on your Mac. No upload. No cloud round trip. No chatbot rewriting your sentences. No app account. No subscription.

name: Overdrive Lab
tagline: Your AI social media agency. Built around your brand.
description:
A good agency gets to know you before it writes a word.

Your business. Your audience. The way you talk. The work you’ve already put out.

Overdrive Lab brings that approach to social media. An agency run by agents that studies your brand, researches your market and uses what you’ve already written to shape what comes next.

Research, writing, artwork and publishing work together. You review the ideas, shape the finished posts and decide what goes live. Your revisions, rejections and approvals teach the Lab your brand.

Get more from the content you already have. The Lab shows you which connected channels a post hasn’t appeared on yet, helps you adapt it for those platforms and handles publishing once you approve.

Your AI social media agency. Built around your brand. You still call the shots.

Founding Beta applications are open. Accepted testers use the app without a subscription charge and cover their metered usage costs.

name: RedNote Market-Entry Toolkit
tagline: Self-serve Xiaohongshu/RedNote launch checklists for overseas DTC
description: For overseas DTC teams launching on Xiaohongshu (RedNote). A self-serve markdown + CSV checklist zip, $39 via Creem. Free 1-page sample while validating demand: https://rednote-market-entry.tiiny.site/sample-checklist.html

name: VeritasChain Protocol (VCP)
tagline: Open specifications (VAP/VCP) for cryptographically verifiable AI decision records.
description: VeritasChain Co., Ltd. (Tokyo, Japan; founded 2025-12-12) operates the VeritasChain Standards Organization (VSO) secretariat and develops VAP/VCP for cryptographically verifiable AI decision records. Open specifications under CC BY 4.0. Fintech Association of Japan member.

name: Xiaohongshu Downloader
tagline: Free Xiaohongshu / RedNote video & photo downloader — paste a link, preview, save MP4 or images, no install.
description: xiaohongshudownloader.com lets you download public Xiaohongshu (RedNote) videos without watermark when the public CDN allows it, plus photos and albums. Paste a share link or short link, preview title/author/media, then save MP4 or original-quality images in your browser. No app install, no signup. For personal use of content you own or have permission to save.

name: FestivalPlot
tagline: Plan your festival campsite to scale before you pack.
description:
FestivalPlot is a free campsite layout planner for music festivals and RV camping.

Enter your campsite dimensions, add your car, tent, canopy or RV, and move everything around to see how the setup works.

You can start with an example layout, customize the measurements, check for overlaps, and share your plan with friends.

There's also a festival camping checklist and practical setup guides.

Everything runs in your browser, and you don't need an account to use the planner.

name: AI Agents Watch
tagline: Reviews of AI agents and workflow automation — who each tool fits, what to skip, and how you're billed.
description: AI Agents Watch publishes scenario-first reviews of AI agents and workflow automation—who each tool fits, what to skip, and how you're billed.

name: VPS Hosting Radar
tagline: Managed VPS and cloud hosting picks with clear tradeoffs.
description: VPS Hosting Radar publishes scenario-first shortlists for managed VPS and cloud hosting—what fits, what to watch, and who each option is wrong for.

name: QuickSinq
tagline: Sync PayPal into Wave, split fees cleanly
description:
Month-end. That PayPal spreadsheet is still waiting.

Payments. Fees. Totals that don’t line up.

And tax time brings the same question: where did those PayPal fees go?

QuickSinq prepares your PayPal sales and fees for Wave, keeps them separate, and lets you review the entries before they reach your books.

Connect your PayPal Business account and Wave. Bring the sales and fees into one review, then send the entries you approve to Wave.

name: ScopePress
tagline: Free proposal generator for freelancers and independent consultants
description: ScopePress turns project details into a proposal draft with scope, fees, schedule, payment terms, and exclusions. The free generator runs in the browser and exports text or printable PDFs without an account. Practical proposal guides are free. An optional $19 one-time bundle includes ten editable business templates; no subscription is required.

name: Huiyuan Xiaopu (会员小铺)
tagline: AI plans & gift card shop
description: Huiyuan Xiaopu is a self-serve digital-goods shop for Chinese-speaking users. It offers ChatGPT Plus/Go/Pro top-ups, Codex API credits, Gemini Pro and US-region Apple gift cards. Most items are delivered automatically as card keys, payment is via Alipay, and the blog has step-by-step guides on ChatGPT Plus top-up, Apple gift card redemption and Codex API key setup. Independent reseller; not affiliated with OpenAI, Google or Apple.

name: WebDir.SI
tagline: Human-edited web directory with an AI assistant
description: WebDir.SI is a human-edited web directory covering more than 15,600 reviewed websites across 97 categories, from news and travel to software and shopping. It is built for people who want a curated starting point instead of sifting through search results. The built-in AI assistant, Ask SI, answers questions in plain language and points visitors to the right category or listing. Website owners get free listings reviewed by editors; visitors get a faster way to find trustworthy sites in any niche. No account needed to browse.

name: TinyKit
tagline: 31 free developer tools that run 100% in your browser
description: TinyKit is a collection of 31 free online tools for developers — encoders, converters, generators and utilities (Base64, URL, UUID, JWT decoder, hash generator, JSON tools and more). Everything runs client-side in the browser; no sign-up, no data uploaded.

name: Two Minute Drill
tagline: Call the plays. Beat the clock.
description: Two Minute Drill is a free American football decision game. Call plays, manage the clock and compare your choices in practice with previews and Undo. Eight original scenarios rotate through a shared daily challenge. Play on desktop or mobile without signing up.

name: ClearList
tagline: AI sale manager for people clearing out a home
description: ClearList is an AI sale manager for people clearing out a home. Photograph your items, review AI-written listings and suggested prices, and share one sale page. Buyers reserve through a queue and book pickup appointments. Automatic confirmations and reminders keep the sale organized. Built for moving sales, decluttering, garage sales and downsizing. You can also connect ClearList to Claude or ChatGPT and have your own assistant help manage the sale and respond to buyers. Free for three live items at a time, with prepaid passes for larger sales. No subscription and no sales commission.

name: Games4Rewards
tagline: Game tasks, surveys and referral bonuses; cash-out requests from $0.50
description: Games4Rewards is a web rewards platform offering game tasks and surveys. description: AppShotMaker helps indie developers create App Store and Google Play screenshots, check store sizes, and craft ASO keywords. Free online tools.

name: Tenacove
tagline: Your rental record, ready for the next step
description: Tenacove helps US renters keep a clear record from move-in to move-out. Follow photo checklists, save observations, compare the same places over time, and download original photos with a readable report. Prepare email drafts to review and send yourself, or export a Markdown brief for your personal agent. Start free with 3 tenancies, 100 records, 200 MB and complete export. An optional $19 Lease Pass lasts 12 months and adds storage and opt-in reminders, with no automatic renewal. Explore a sample without an account.

name: ProtectSmartly
tagline: Family safety app with one-tap SOS alerts and live location sharing.
description: ProtectSmartly is a personal and family safety app for Android. Press and hold the SOS button to instantly alert your trusted contacts and share your real-time location. Create family circles, get smart alerts, and use geofencing to know when loved ones arrive safely. Built privacy-first: end-to-end encryption, family-only access, and no data selling. Useful for students walking home late, parents, elderly relatives, solo travelers, lone workers, and drivers. Free on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.protectsmartly.bb2fe610e54446cebdf627db55227d7d

name: ImageGPT
tagline: Generate images and videos with AI, no subscription required
description: ImageGPT is a web-based tool for generating and editing images or videos using AI models. Users pay only for what they create, with credits that never expire. There are no subscriptions, and credits are deducted only for successful generations. The platform supports a variety of AI models and offers features such as image and video editing, background removal, and template use. ImageGPT is independent and not affiliated with OpenAI, and provides a pay-as-you-go approach for creative projects.

name: Block Poster
tagline: Free block poster maker for home printers
description: Block Poster is a free block poster maker. Turn any photo into a large poster printed across A4 or Letter pages on your home printer. Posters are made right in the browser, with no signup and no watermark.

name: Bastify
tagline: Web hosting, WordPress, VPS and dedicated servers
description: Bastify is a Spanish web hosting provider. It offers WordPress hosting plans from 6.99 EUR per month, dedicated servers with fixed monthly plans, and usage-billed VPS servers. Customers can also register domains. Plans, prices and features are listed on the public website.

name: Get Vocal Remover
tagline: Free AI vocal remover: split any song into vocals + instrumental
description: Free online AI vocal remover. Upload a song, get vocals and instrumental (2 stems). Free up to 2 minutes, 3 times/day; one-time credit packs $4.9/20min, $9.9/50min, $19/120min, no subscription. Files auto-deleted after about an hour.

name: GoodToolOnline
tagline: Discover and launch new software tools every week.
description: GoodToolOnline is a product launch platform where makers can introduce software tools and visitors can discover and vote for new products. It offers free and paid launch options.

name: Window Dance AI
tagline: Turn your photo into the Window Dance video.
description: Window Dance AI turns one adult portrait into a short video of the Window Dance trend. Upload a photo in your browser, check your preview, and download an MP4 of about 12 seconds at 480p, with silent and sound versions. It costs $9.90 per video, paid once with no subscription; generation is not free. Payments support PayPal, cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay, depending on device and region. Facial details may not stay exactly the same. The site also has guides on how to make a Window Dance AI video, prompts and a CapCut template comparison.

name: HAICE DATA
tagline: Overseas public web data collection, delivered as XLSX, CSV or JSON.
description: HAICE DATA collects public web data from overseas websites for procurement, operations and marketing teams — product listings, prices, supplier and competitor information, reviews and market signals — and delivers clean, ready-to-use datasets in XLSX, CSV or JSON.

name: Castaly
tagline: Beyond imagination. Bring it into motion.
description: Castaly is an AI video and image studio. Generate with leading models (Seedance, Kling, Wan, MiniMax, HappyHorse for video; GPT Image, Gemini Image, Seedream, Wan Image for images), compare specs and prices side by side, control every parameter, and remix community prompts. Pay per generation - no subscription, no minimum. Pricing: https://castaly.ai/pricing

name: Kolect
tagline: Customer voice discovery, competitor reports, and AI creator search
description: Kolect helps marketers and brand teams understand customer needs, research competitors, and discover creators. Customer Voice Discovery analyzes US-market Reddit customer experiences with Amazon product context to surface frustrations, workarounds, valued experiences, and unmet needs, with original sources and an interactive audience map. Brand Report starts from a website and produces a US-market report covering market and competitors, SEO and GEO, TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, and X and Reddit topics. Both research tools are free to try. Kolect also offers freemium natural-language creator search across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube, with similar-creator discovery, audience-authenticity checks, creator emails, and CSV exports. Explore the research tools at https://www.kolect.ai/tools/product-research and https://www.kolect.ai/tools/brand-report.

name: PITEVA
tagline: Staff scheduling and team management for care organizations
description: PITEVA is a German software platform for shift scheduling and workforce organization in four areas: residential care, home care services, hospitals and emergency medical services. The platform helps staff and managers organize shifts, qualifications, availability and staffing overviews. An Android app is available on Google Play. Explore selected workflows in a free, no-signup interactive demo with sample data. Some sector-specific features are still in development, and availability varies by operational area.

name: Nestack Agent Care
tagline: Managed AI agent operations for production AI agents
description: Nestack Agent Care is a managed AI agent operations service from Nestack (nestackagents.com). It runs production AI agents end to end across goals, workflows, tools, LLMs, evaluations, guardrails and human review. The team watches for failures and performance drift, manages policy risk, coordinates incidents and costs, and reports on business outcomes, then verifies each improvement as conditions change. It suits companies that already have agents live and want them operated reliably instead of babysitting them in-house.

name: Vastu CRM
tagline: Smarter CRM for Real Estate Businesses
description: Vastu CRM is a real estate customer relationship management (CRM) software designed for builders, property developers, real estate brokers, and channel partners. It helps businesses manage the entire property sales cycle, from capturing enquiries and nurturing leads to scheduling site visits, closing bookings, tracking payments, and managing post-sales activities. The platform brings lead management, property inventory, sales pipelines, automated WhatsApp and email follow-ups, cost sheets, booking management, payment plans, demand letters, and collection tracking into one system. It integrates with lead sources such as Facebook Lead Ads, 99acres, MagicBricks, Housing.com, and business websites, helping sales teams organise enquiries and assign them to the right representatives. Its reporting and analytics tools help managers monitor lead conversion, sales performance, and follow-up activities, while its mobile apps allow teams to access customer and project information while on the move. By connecting sales, inventory, bookings, and collections, Vastu CRM helps real estate businesses reduce manual work, follow up with prospective buyers on time, maintain accurate property availability records, and manage customer relationships from the first enquiry to final possession.

name: BDLG (Big Data/Little Guy)
tagline: Free value check for your company's operating data
description: BDLG (Big Data/Little Guy) is a marketplace for the data seller. Companies with 50+ employees can get a free value check that uses metadata only, then license de-identified operating data to AI companies. Common sources are work orders, service records, support conversations and workflow logs. Nothing is licensed without the owner's approval. Operated by Unlockt, LLC, Sacramento, CA. Founded 2026.

name: QuickImgTools
tagline: Free browser-based image tools: compress to an exact KB size, HEIC to JPG, EXIF/GPS remover, image splitter, resizer and more.
description: QuickImgTools is a free collection of browser-based image tools. Compress a photo to an exact size in KB, convert HEIC to JPG, remove EXIF and GPS metadata, split an image into an Instagram grid, resize and convert formats, and more. Most tools do their work in your browser, so there is nothing to install. There is also an AI Image Renamer that suggests descriptive file names using an in-browser AI model. I work on QuickImgTools.

name: BambooEmail
tagline: Free email addresses and webmail
description: Free email addresses and webmail, plus 12 productivity tools for QR codes, PDFs, signatures, images, resumes and writing.

name: Rapsona
tagline: AI Rap Video Generator from a Photo
description: Rapsona turns one photo into a 12-second vertical AI rap video with an original beat and English rap vocals. No lyrics to write, no song to upload. Templates for duo, street, dance, crowd, pet, and birthday. From $5.99 per video credit.

name: Image to Drawing
tagline: Turn any photo into a drawing with AI
description: Turn any photo into a drawing with AI — pencil, line art, charcoal, ink and more. Free, no sign-up, 3 drawings a day.

name: First10
tagline: Find Reddit posts from people who need your product
description: First10 finds Reddit posts from people asking for what you've built and emails you a list. Read-only: you reply yourself, it never posts or DMs. Free weekly plan, X support coming soon.

name: Fresh AI Game
tagline: AI-assisted browser game discovery directory with clear sources and creator links
description: Fresh AI Game is a free discovery directory for AI-assisted browser games and other small releases. Each entry credits the creator, links to the original page (often itch.io), and records platform details and any creator AI disclosure without inventing scores or compatibility claims. Browse the catalog at https://freshaigame.com/.

name: AI Rap Video Generator
tagline: Turn a photo or rap idea into a short AI rap video
description: AI Rap Video Generator (AI Rap Gen) turns a photo or a rap idea into a short AI rap performance video, generated in your browser. Pick a stage and topic, then share the clip. Paid: $6.99 per video, credit packs from $29, Basic plan $29.90/mo.

name: Tiny Desk AI Video Generator
tagline: Your "Outstanding"-inspired Tiny Desk video, from one photo
description: Upload one portrait for a solo or two for a duet and get a 15-second office-concert video with original AI soul music. Browser-based. Paid: one-time packs $6.90 (1 video) / $29.90 (5) / $99.90 (20); no subscription.

name: IHR
tagline: HR, time tracking and project management for small teams
description: IHR helps small teams manage employee records, working time, attendance and leave requests, as well as project time, recruitment and equipment. Available in English, Ukrainian and Hebrew. A free plan is available without a time limit for up to five people, with usage limits; paid plans are available for larger teams.

name: VectorCraft
tagline: Free open-source Illustrator alternative in the browser
description: VectorCraft is a free, open-source Illustrator alternative that runs right in your browser. Draw with the Pen tool, combine shapes with Pathfinder, and export clean SVG or PDF. There is nothing to install and no sign-up, so you can open it and start designing logos, icons and illustrations right away. It is a manual vector editor, not an AI image generator.

name: SMSPing
tagline: Temporary, service-specific numbers for receiving SMS online
description: SMSPing provides temporary, service-specific phone numbers for receiving SMS online. Choose a service, country and operator, check available numbers and prices, and view incoming SMS codes in the dashboard. A developer API supports integration with your workflows. Numbers are temporary and are not intended for permanent account recovery. Use the service in accordance with the rules of the platforms involved.

name: Average Calculator Online
tagline: Free online calculators — average, mortgage, BMI, GPA, tax, scientific and more, all in one place.
description: Average Calculator Online is a free collection of online calculators, including average, mortgage, BMI, GPA, tax and scientific calculators — all in one place, with no sign-up required.

name: HelloMona
tagline: AI image and video generator that shows credits before each task.
description: HelloMona generates images and video with AI, and it shows how many credits a task will use before you run it so you can choose whether to continue.

name: Histories
tagline: History timelines turned into short cards and puzzles.
description: Histories presents past events as compact cards and small puzzles, so you can place what happened in order and remember it without reading a long chapter.

name: Top AI Tools
tagline: AI products sorted by the job they help you do.
description: Top AI Tools groups AI products by the kind of work they handle, so you can compare a short set of options for one job instead of paging through a mixed catalog.

name: Codex Reset
tagline: See whether Codex reset today, plus a short history for developers.
description: Codex Reset gives a live yes-or-no on whether the Codex window reset today and keeps a brief history so developers can time their next session instead of guessing.

name: FreeCVAudit.com
tagline: Free CV audit and optional AI-powered revision
description: FreeCVAudit.com helps job seekers check CV formatting, structure, wording and ATS readability. Upload a PDF, DOC or DOCX CV for a free audit with no card required. An optional AI-powered CV revision costs $9.99 once and is delivered as a PDF by email. Built by Work Waves.

name: TheGameTake
tagline: Game news, guides, codes, and release dates in one place.
description: TheGameTake tracks PC, console, and mobile games with fresh news, practical guides, redeem codes, and upcoming release dates so players can see what just launched and what is next.

name: RelocateMath
tagline: Should I Move? State-to-State Cost Calculator (2026)
description: Is the move worth it? Compare take-home pay, taxes, rent, home prices and moving costs between any two U.S. states with 2026 rules and official data.

name: StitchFromPhoto
tagline: Turn any photo into a printable cross stitch pattern with DMC colors — free in your browser.
description: StitchFromPhoto converts a photo into a cross stitch pattern in seconds. Upload any image, choose the pattern width in stitches, fabric count (11–18 ct Aida) and how many colors you want, and the tool matches every pixel to the nearest of 454 DMC floss colors. You get a color preview, a symbol chart split into printable pages, and a floss list with stitch counts and estimated skeins. Everything runs locally in your browser — your photos never leave your device.

name: Daily Japanese
tagline: Learn Japanese with news, podcasts and videos
description: Daily Japanese is a Japanese learning library with news, podcasts, videos and JLPT-graded content. Practise listening and reading with sentence playback, subtitles, translations and word lookup. Learners can also import public YouTube and Bilibili video links for text-based Japanese practice.

name: APIMODELS
tagline: Unified AI API for developers — 150+ image, video, LLM and audio models via one key, up to 95% below official pricing.
description: APIMODELS is a multi-model AI API platform: one API key and one OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoint aggregate 150+ image, video, language, and audio models — with pay-as-you-go pricing up to 95% off official rates, automatic failover, and MCP support.

name: Modelflare
tagline: Unified OpenAI-compatible API gateway for 100+ LLM, image and video models — pay as you go from $5.
description: Modelflare is a developer-oriented AI API gateway. One OpenAI-compatible endpoint for chat, image and video models with pay-as-you-go billing, invoices, and multi-currency/crypto payments. Minimum top-up $5. Docs at https://docs.modelflare.dev. Launch ~June 2026.

name: The CS Agent Playbook: 15 Routines for Support and CS Leads
tagline: Spend Monday with customers, not spreadsheets.
description: Support and CS leads use The CS Agent Playbook to draft Monday churn-risk digests, QBRs, 1:1 prep and renewal briefs. You get a 47-page PDF and a plain-text file with 15 routines, 54 prompts and a 14-day rollout plan. Agents draft, people send. Only approved tools touch customer data. It's $29 one time, and code FIRST50 takes $10 off for the first 50 buyers. Get the free 3-page Escalation Brief for Leadership sample by email at https://draftfirstcs.com

name: Seamlessify
tagline: Seamless, tileable patterns and textures for design and AI
description: Seamlessify makes seamless, tileable patterns and textures for design and AI workflows. Turn an image into a repeating tile or generate a seamless pattern from a prompt.

name: StarBop
tagline: Original rap videos starring you or your pet, from one photo
description: StarBop turns one adult or pet photo into a 10–15-second original rap performance video. Preview and edit English lyrics free, choose Trap, Old School or Funny, then generate a clip with a fresh beat and vocals. Make birthday shout-outs, pet raps and hype videos. Download an MP4 with sound in vertical or landscape format. Video packs start at $5.99, with no subscription.

name: CartDialog
tagline: AI shopping and customer support for Magento stores
description: CartDialog is an AI shopping and support assistant designed for Magento stores. It helps shoppers find products and answers using available store information. Merchant teams can involve a person when needed; order-specific assistance depends on the store configuration and customer verification. Paid plans start at €79 per month with a 14-day Essentials trial.

name: EcomPick
tagline: EcomPick is a human-reviewed directory of AI tools & SaaS for Amazon, Shopify & TikTok Shop sellers.
description: EcomPick is an independent, human-reviewed directory of AI tools, software and MCP servers for ecommerce sellers. We focus on Amazon, Shopify and TikTok Shop, and we check every listing against the tool’s official site for pricing, platform support and features. Sellers can browse by weekly work—product research, listings, photos, video/ads, email/marketing, customer support—then compare before they pay. Sponsored placements are always labelled. Free to submit tools at ecompick.com/submit.

name: IsWeber
tagline: Agent content pipeline for creators: topic to outline, script, and titles. Coming soon, preview live.
description: IsWeber is an agent content pipeline for English creators on YouTube, TikTok, and blogs. It takes a topic through outline, script, and titles so you ship more without rebuilding the workflow. Coming soon · MVP in progress · first tool pages live.

name: IOOK
tagline: Stop refreshing careers pages. IOOK watches the job for you.
description: IOOK is an AI-powered personal productivity platform. Its free Job Watch lets you name a company and describe the role you want; IOOK finds the official careers page, keeps checking it, and alerts you when a matching opening appears.

name: AIByTask
tagline: AI exterior concepts and free home planning editors
description: AIByTask is a web-based home design and planning workspace. Upload a house photo to explore AI exterior concepts, colors and materials. Its free manual editors let you arrange room layouts, house modules and garden spaces in 2D with 3D previews. Save and compare ideas in projects and create presentation boards. First Google sign-in includes 10 one-time welcome credits. Credit purchases are not open yet. AI outputs are design concepts, not construction drawings.

name: Photo to Video AI
tagline: AI talking video from one photo
description: Upload a photo, write a script, generate a downloadable talking short video. CN/EN. Freemium — paid removes watermark.

name: Your Bank Statement Converter
tagline: Convert PDF bank statements to Excel or CSV in seconds, from any bank
description: Free online converter for PDF, scanned and image bank statements into Excel & CSV. Pulls every transaction into Date, Description, Debit, Credit and Balance columns. 500+ banks, OCR, 256-bit encryption, auto-delete in 24h. First conversion needs no account; free signup unlocks 7 pages. No credit card. Built by Ganesh Shanmugam, Chennai, India.

name: SaveFileEditor
tagline: Online Game Save Editor - Edit Game Saves in Your Browser
description: SaveFileEditor is a free online game save editor that runs in your browser. Pick a supported game, paste a save string or upload the save file, change money, items and stats with simple form fields, then copy or download the edited save. Nothing is ever uploaded to a server. Supports Cookie Clicker, PokeClicker, Balatro, Ren'Py games, OMORI and more.

name: Toollan
tagline: Free online tools: JSON, PDF, QR, images — no signup
description: Toollan is a free suite of 54+ browser-based tools for developers and everyday users — JSON formatting, QR codes, PDF merging, image compression, Base64, UUID, cron, regex and more. No signup, no paywall, and files are processed in your browser, not uploaded to a server.

name: GlyphSift - Copy-Paste Text Studio
tagline: Style, clean and inspect copy-paste Unicode text in-browser
description: GlyphSift is a copy-paste text studio: turn text into 23 Unicode styles (bold, italic, cursive, small caps), clean it up (line breaks, extra spaces, duplicates) and inspect code points and invisible characters, all in your browser.

name: DineSend
tagline: Email marketing for independent restaurants
description: DineSend is an email marketing tool in development for independent restaurants. It focuses on occasion-led campaigns—weekly specials, birthdays, and welcome-backs—so owners can stay in touch with guests without starting from a blank page. The public site is a preview; signup and campaign sending are not open yet. Pricing has not been announced.

name: Gradebook Calculator
tagline: Free online gradebook calculator for weighted grades—homework, quizzes, and exams. No account required.
description: Use this free gradebook calculator online to combine homework, quizzes, and exams by weight. Enter earned and possible points with syllabus weights to get your current course average, plan finals, save locally, or export CSV. No signup.

name: AI Rap Video Generator
tagline: Turn your photos into AI rap videos with original vocals and beats in six languages.
description: AI Rap Video Generator turns 1–2 photos into short rap, singing, duel, or roast videos with original AI vocals and music. Choose a scene, language, and style; generation usually takes 3–5 minutes. Vertical MP4 for social.

name: Every Finance Calculator
tagline: Free Online Financial Calculators for Everyday Money Decisions  4. Description  Copy
description: Every Finance Calculator offers free online tools to simplify everyday financial calculations. Explore calculators for payroll, overtime pay, sales tax, bill splitting, and more. Designed for anyone who needs quick and convenient calculations.

name: AI for Database
tagline: Ask your database questions in plain language, build dashboards and run scheduled database workflows.
description: AI for Database connects to operational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, Microsoft SQL Server, MongoDB, SQLite) so teams can ask natural-language questions against connected data, inspect query results, create dashboards, and configure scheduled workflows with authenticated webhook actions. A scoped REST API with organization-scoped keys and OpenAPI documentation is available. Free plan available, no credit card required; Pro $10/user/month, Team $30/user/month.

name: Cantian AI
tagline: Cantian AI turns Eastern metaphysics—Bazi (Four Pillars), I Ching, feng shui, and naming—into callable AI skills.
description: Cantian AI turns Eastern metaphysics—Bazi (Four Pillars), I Ching, feng shui, and naming—into callable AI skills. Personalized chart readings and scenario-based guidance. Web and App.

name: LinesDeduplicate
tagline: Remove duplicate lines. Quietly.
description: LinesDeduplicate removes duplicate lines from any list — emails, keywords, logs, CSV exports. Paste left, unique lines right. Runs in your browser; nothing uploaded. Free, no signup.

name: PSLify
tagline: Rate your face with AI and get your PSL score
description: PSLify is a free AI-powered face rating tool that scores your facial attractiveness on the PSL scale in under 60 seconds. Just upload a selfie and the AI analyzes your features to return an objective rating along with a breakdown of your results. There's no sign-up required and no complicated setup — drop a photo and get instant feedback. PSLify is built for anyone curious about where they land on the PSL scale, whether for fun, self-improvement tracking, or comparing results over time. It runs entirely online and works on any device, giving you a fast, private way to get an AI-based assessment of your appearance.

name: SleepDocs
tagline: Ad-free boring history documentaries made for sleep
description: SleepDocs is a waitlist for long, calm, ad-free history documentaries designed to fall asleep to — without mid-video ads or loud jumpscares. For people who use YouTube sleep timers but hate commercial breaks at 2am.

name: PnL Diary
tagline: Simple trading journal app to track PnL and mistakes
description: PnL Diary is a trading journal waitlist for retail traders who want a cleaner place to log trades, review PnL, and catch repeating mistakes without paying Tradezella-tier prices. Built for forex and day traders who currently bounce between Notion and spreadsheets.

name: Mapmarch
tagline: Phone-first war and history map animation maker for creators
description: Mapmarch lets mapping creators paint territories, draw moving front lines, drop attack arrows, and export 9:16 Shorts from a phone browser. Built for war-sim and history channels that currently frame-by-frame CapCut or pay for After Effects + GEOlayers. Free waitlist for early access.

name: AI Pop Video
tagline: Turn photos into AI dance videos with baby and pet templates.
description: AI Pop Video turns still photos into short AI dance videos using ready-made templates. Choose a dance style, add the required photos, generate a clip and download the result. Templates cover people, babies and pets, making it easier to create playful social clips without filming a new performance. Video generation requires an account and paid credits; photo requirements, duration and credit cost depend on the selected template.

name: Ad8.ai
tagline: See what changed. Know what to test next.
description: Ad8 brings competitor ad discovery, tracking, and source-linked creative analysis into one research workspace. Search 100M+ collected Meta ad records, follow up to 20 competitor Pages, catch offer and message changes as they appear, and turn the evidence into original creative tests — with observation, interpretation, and test hypothesis kept apart and linked to their sources. No invented ROAS. Built for DTC brands, agency strategists, creative strategists. Proposed Core plan $29/month — proposed only, not a confirmed price.

name: MakePixel
tagline: MakePixel - Free Pixel Art Converter & Bead Pattern Maker
description: Turn photos into pixel art in seconds with MakePixel, a free online pixel art converter and bead pattern maker. Perler, Hama and Artkal palettes, dithering, printable grid with bead counts, PNG export. No account required.

name: PDF Utils
tagline: Free PDF tools in your browser, no signup
description: PDF Utils is a set of free PDF tools: merge, split, compress, rotate, watermark and more. Everything runs in the browser, files are processed locally rather than uploaded, and no account is needed. The site is available in many languages. For anyone who needs a quick PDF task done without installing software or signing up.

name: JustBlogged
tagline: Free blogging platform with your own domain, SEO and an API
description: JustBlogged is a hosted blogging platform. The free plan includes unlimited posts and pages, a custom domain with HTTPS, themes, SEO settings, sitemaps, RSS and scheduled publishing, no card needed.

name: Unlimited Faxing
tagline: Online fax with e-signature included
description: Send and receive faxes online from your phone, computer or email, and collect e-signatures in the same account. Free plan available.

name: Ray 3.2 AI
tagline: Ray 3.2 AI Video Generator
description: Ray 3.2 AI is a browser‑accessible cloud AI video tool for creators. It delivers frame‑level keyframe control, covering text‑to‑video, image‑to‑video, video remastering and reframing. It tracks multiple characters stably and exports 16‑bit HDR EXR files for tools like DaVinci Resolve. It works well for storyboard previews, ad drafts and game clip production.

name: DisconfirmAI
tagline: AI investment research workspace that looks for counter-evidence before you form a thesis
description: DisconfirmAI is an AI-era investment research and reading platform. Core idea is disconfirm: seek evidence that could overturn a view before locking in conviction. Features include daily public-source reading (Reading), filings and data deep research (Research), condition-based change radar (Radar), personal investment framework, and AI 100 lists / industry maps.

name: RapGlow
tagline: Turn one photo into a viral AI rap video
description: RapGlow is an AI rap video generator: upload one photo, pick a trending rap template and get a vertical rap video starring you in minutes. No watermark. Built for creators who want shareable short-form clips for TikTok, Reels and Shorts without filming or editing anything.

name: Fooled Yet?
tagline: Real or AI? 12 pictures, 2 minutes, then challenge your mum and compare scores.
description: Free 2-minute real-or-AI picture challenge: 12 credited pictures, one simple tell after each answer, then send the same round to a parent or the family chat and compare scores. No sign-up, no ads.

name: Scale Ova
tagline: AI agent that builds and runs your Shopify store.
description: Scale Ova is an AI Shopify store builder that works like an agent: from an idea, a product link or an existing store, its AI agent Ova builds a complete, on-brand store, then runs it by chat, editing anything, creating product bundles, translating the whole site, finding suppliers and getting orders shipped. Free to build and preview; plans from €49/month (Starter).

name: SlideFarm
tagline: AI that creates and posts your TikTok carousels.
description: SlideFarm is an AI tool for e-commerce brands that turns your store into ready-to-post TikTok carousels. Import your store link, let the AI generate on-brand slides, tweak them in the editor, schedule them in the calendar and auto-post to TikTok. Works with Shopify stores, in English and French. 3 free carousels to try; plans from €29/month.

name: Quitar Fondo
tagline: Free browser AI background remover—no signup.
description: Free browser AI background remover—upload a photo, remove the background instantly, download PNG with transparency. No signup. https://quitarfondo.org

name: Aimake Videos
tagline: Viral AI video generator with trend templates
description: Aimake Videos turns your photo into trending vertical AI videos with sound. Choose a trend template, upload a photo, tap once. Export 9:16 for TikTok/Reels/Shorts — no watermark.

name: FaceShapeTryOn
tagline: Free face shape detector in your browser
description: Free face shape detector. Upload one photo and get oval, round, square, heart, diamond, oblong, or triangle. The check runs in the browser. No sign-up to check.

name: RideHop
tagline: Never plan a road trip from scratch again
description: RideHop is the place for trusted, verified road-trip recommendations. Creators and influencers publish free and paid guides with verified tips and detailed itineraries, and earn from the paid ones. Travelers turn any guide into their own editable trip, with route, stops and fuel cost planned.

name: Tiny Desk AI
tagline: Put your friends in the viral Tiny Desk AI band video
description: Tiny Desk AI turns 1 to 5 photos or one group photo into the viral 15-second "Outstanding" Tiny Desk band video with the original sound. Free 2-second preview.

name: Enzo Celebration AI
tagline: Upload one photo you have rights to use and generate a short stadium celebration video inspired by the viral Enzo Fernandez celebration.
description: Enzo Celebration AI is a photo-to-video tool for football fans. Upload a clear front-facing photo (JPG/PNG/WebP, max 10 MB), keep the Enzo Celebration effect, pick 5-15 seconds, then preview and download. Optional 1080p uses +1 credit. name: ScribistIQ
tagline: Draft, continue and revise book manuscripts with AI.
description:
ScribistIQ is a web app for independent authors and novelists. Writers can start a book from a premise or import and continue an existing manuscript, review an editable Story Bible and proposed chapter plan, then revise the prose in Write Studio. It supports PDF, EPUB and DOCX exports, cover creation and narration. Physical printed copies are purchased separately.

Paid subscriptions start at US$29/month. New accounts can try one opening chapter of approximately 500–700 words without a card. This limited preview is not an ongoing free plan or a trial of manuscript continuation. The app works in English. Authors should check generated prose for continuity, facts and voice before publication.

This submission is from the ScribistIQ product team. An inspectable example contains an original passage, saved continuation and proposed editorial revision, including continuity problems that needed attention: https://www.scribistiq.com/guides/finish-your-novel-with-ai#continuation-example . Current pricing: https://www.scribistiq.com/pricing .

name: Road Job Calculator
tagline: Know what a road job is really worth.
description: Road Job Calculator helps traveling tradespeople evaluate job pay, overtime, per diem, lodging, fuel and travel expenses to understand the true value of a road job.

name: Free IFTA Calculator
tagline: Free quarterly IFTA fuel-tax reconciliation for owner-operators, no signup.
description: Enter miles and gallons purchased per state or province. It returns taxable gallons, net taxable gallons and tax owed or credit per jurisdiction, plus fleet MPG and the quarter total, using the official IFTA matrix rates (8 fuel types, with the IN/KY/VA surcharges). Print, save as PDF or copy the summary. Estimates only, not a filed return.

name: TestLoopers
tagline: Real Android beta testing with actionable feedback
description: TestLoopers brings Android developers and genuine beta testers together. Tester profiles are free. Developers can purchase one-time coordination credits to manage beta testing campaigns and gather honest private feedback. Testers may join suitable projects after profile review, and developers can track bugs through FixLoop. Tester availability and Google Play approval are not guaranteed. No paid installs, ratings or reviews.

name: ChaseKindly

description: ChaseKindly helps freelancers and small businesses chase unpaid invoices without awkwardness. The free reminder email generator writes polite, escalating payment reminder emails (friendly nudge, firm follow-up, final notice) in seconds, no sign-up needed. The app lets you track invoices and plan reminders; automatic sending is coming soon. Free plan covers 3 active invoices; Pro is $12/month.

name: Rumpelstiltskin Dance Generator
tagline: Turn a photo into a viral Rumpelstiltskin dance video in a few clicks.
description: AI Rumpelstiltskin turns a clear portrait into a personalized 10-second, 720p Rumpelstiltskin dance video with generated audio. Pick the aspect ratio, skip the editing, and pay per video with credits.

name: FastOCR
tagline: Extract text from images and PDFs
description: FastOCR extracts text from images and PDFs and creates searchable PDFs. Use the browser workflow or API to integrate OCR into applications.

name: DraftKey
tagline: Private on-device AI autocomplete for Mac apps
description: Private on-device AI autocomplete for Mac apps. Finishes sentences with Tab and rewrites with ⌘⌥. Model runs on your Mac. $4.99 lifetime, no free trial. Apple Silicon, macOS 14+.

name: TokenBar
tagline: Mac menu bar for Claude/Codex/Cursor usage limits
description: macOS menu bar app for AI coding usage limits across Claude, Codex, Cursor and more. Built on MIT-licensed CodexBar plus a Pro dashboard and Pixel Agents (not a thin reskin). Pro $15 lifetime / Basic $5/mo.

name: Fan Vote
tagline: College fan leaderboard; $1 votes support Brady’s businesses, not universities.
description: Browse a public college fan leaderboard for free. Adults 18+ can contribute $1 per vote to their chosen school after payment verification. Contributions support Brady’s InstantBook and RepSolo businesses, not universities, clubs or scholarships. No university affiliation or endorsement. No prizes or rewards.

name: First Funnel Lab
tagline: Free funnel planner and marketing-tool fit checker
description: First Funnel Lab is a free, no-login web tool for independent creators and small businesses. Build a simple first-funnel blueprint by choosing your audience, lead magnet and distribution channel. It also offers an interactive comparison of Systeme.io, MailerLite and Kit free plan limits, plus a downloadable launch checklist and practical guides. The comparison explains trade-offs and includes non-affiliate alternatives. Some links may earn commissions from eligible paid purchases; free registrations do not pay us.

name: LaunchIntel
tagline: Curated, categorized directory playbooks and a local dashboard for your AI agent
description:
LaunchIntel helps founders launch a product to directories with an AI agent. It gives Claude Code or Codex a curated, categorized set of directory playbooks covering launch platforms, software catalogs and communities, plus a private agent workflow and a local dashboard, so the agent can choose relevant directories, prepare your listings and submit them in your own browser.

Every shipped playbook was submitted to end to end on a free route with a real product. Each guide records the form fields and limits, account and captcha requirements, costs, submission confirmation and follow-up steps for one directory.

You stay in control of the run. Your agent drafts a product kit from your site or an interview, and you approve the facts before the first submission. It then proposes a shortlist based on directory categories and requirements. You can rule out badge routes or known CAPTCHA routes and approve the queue. The agent uses free routes unless you approve a paid option, never invents facts and never votes or comments on other products.

The local dashboard keeps every product in one place. Switch between products, edit their brief and permissions, see what is awaiting review or needs your help, and track Domain Rating with optional daily checks. Your workspace stays on your computer.

LaunchIntel is a one-time purchase, delivered as access to a private GitHub repository through Polar. Solo covers unlimited products you own; Agency also covers client work. Updates land in the same repository. You need GitHub, Node 20 or newer, git and an agent with local file, terminal and browser access. Each directory decides what it accepts, so listings and links are not guaranteed.

name: Pius Bot by products.ai
tagline: Built in Amsterdam, made for shoppers everywhere
description: products.ai started from a simple frustration: product advice online is noisy and often sponsored. Founder Tim Vrij and the team at Birds B.V. in Amsterdam built Pius Bot to give one honest answer: a pick, the reasons and trade-offs, and an in-stock shop that delivers. Use it on the web, in AI apps or via API.

name: MarketingSpot
tagline: A shared canvas for independent businesses and creators
description: MarketingSpot is a shared canvas where independent businesses, creators, and ideas get discovered. Each purchased spot includes five years of visibility and supports our mission to provide free technology and hosting to disadvantaged entrepreneurs. Standard spots start at $25 for five years.

name: The Last Greenhouse
tagline: A small greenhouse, a robot companion, and plants to grow.
description: A cozy gardening and building game created by independent developer Krzysztof Radomski. Grow plants and arrange a greenhouse with Pip, a small mechanical companion. The website hosts a first-chapter browser demo and links to the complete free iOS game. Developed with generative-AI assistance; no runtime AI.

name: Zakat Calculator 2026
tagline: Free bilingual Zakat calculator for Pakistan in PKR

name: Formable
tagline: Draft, redline and e-sign contracts in one place
description: Formable helps teams review, redline, and sign contracts in one place. Generate a draft from 47 free templates by answering a few questions, negotiate in one shared editor, flag risky clauses with AI against your playbook, and send for e-signature with a tamper-evident audit trail.

name: Dimloom
tagline: Dimensional-weight and shipping cost estimates in your browser
description: Dimloom estimates dimensional (DIM) weight, billable weight and shipping cost for a package. Enter the size and weight, edit each carrier profile's divisor, thresholds and rounding, and paste your own rate card. A placeholder DEMO rate card shows how it works and is not any carrier's rates. It shows actual, dimensional and billable weight side by side. These are estimates only: carriers set the final billable weight, surcharges and price and can change their rules, so always confirm with your carrier. It runs in your browser and nothing you enter is uploaded. Free: the first 3 carrier profiles. An optional paid Pro upgrade adds unlimited profiles, multi-zone rate cards, batch CSV and a print report. Not affiliated with any carrier. How-to guides: https://quietcog.quietcog.workers.dev/guides/measuring-dimensional-weight and https://quietcog.quietcog.workers.dev/guides/compare-carrier-cost-estimate

Downloads are available for public video and photo stories. It cannot open private accounts or restore expired or deleted content. Built by independent developer Evan Mercer; not affiliated with TikTok or ByteDance.

Works on desktop and mobile with no download or sign-up.

Ask about earnings, market catalysts and technical analysis in plain language on the web or iOS. Research and educational information without personalized investment advice or guaranteed results.

The AI Detector is free with no daily limit and no signup, and highlights the sentences that read as machine-written. Around it sit an AI Humanizer (5 free modes), AI Rewriter (5 free tones) and Grammar Checker, also in a Chrome extension.

name: Spec Doctor
tagline: Walmart item workbook preflight and free Activity Feed error decoding

Compare a completed .xlsx workbook with a fresh Seller Center template before submission, or decode an Activity Feed error report in .xlsx or .csv format. Files stay in the browser; the tool does not connect to your Walmart account or send files to Walmart.

Free preflight includes template health, issue counts, and the first three full findings. Activity Feed report decoding, CSV export, and printable reports are free. Paid audit credits unlock full cell-level findings, supported selected repairs, report exports, and up to seven days of project rescans. Report decoding does not repair a workbook. Spec Doctor is not affiliated with Walmart, and a clean scan does not guarantee acceptance.

For each one you get a plain-English rewrite and a reply you can paste back to the other side. No account and no prompting. Try the free sample, then pay $9 once for up to 3 documents. Not a subscription. Not legal advice.

The tool analyzes website topics, competitors, and search queries to find relevant content opportunities. It then creates SEO-optimized articles with metadata, images, and internal links.

Articles can be published automatically or scheduled for later. The platform supports integrations with WordPress, Shopify, and Webflow.
