description: Eidora is an AI image and video studio with 18 image and 22 video models side by side — including GPT Image 2.5, Nano Banana Pro, Seedream 5, Kling 3, and Seedance 2.5 — plus 140+ one-photo tools. Every run shows credits before you press; failed runs refund automatically.

name: AION 2 Class Finder
tagline: Free AION 2 class finder with role filters, side-by-side comparison, and DPS calculator
description: AION 2 Class Finder is a free, unofficial fan-made reference for AION 2 covering the eight global classes: filter by role (tank, damage, support, healing) and combat distance, compare any two classes side by side, estimate damage with the DPS calculator, generate and shortlist character names, and check Spacetime Rift event timing. No account needed.

name: PickACut
tagline: Preview a haircut or tattoo on your selfie, free
description: PickACut lets you upload a selfie and preview a new haircut, hair color or tattoo with AI. Then it makes a simple stylist card with lengths and clipper guard numbers to show your barber. 3 free previews, no account needed, and your photo is deleted after 24 hours. 18+ only. The sample people shown are AI-generated fictional models.

name: Jyotish Agent
tagline: Your Vedic chart, calculated first — then read by AI
description: Most Vedic astrology sites hand you a Kundli PDF you can't question. Jyotish Agent works the other way: it calculates your sidereal birth chart first — Lagna, 27 nakshatras with pada, Vimshottari dasha to the day, divisional charts — then an AI Jyotishi answers the question you actually have. It reads timing with dasha and transits together, works from classical Parashari, Jaimini and Tajika methods, and shows which parts of your chart it checked. Unknown birth time? It says plainly what can't be read and offers rectification. Separate modes cover matching, rectification and horary (Prashna). Plus 28 free calculators, no sign-up. Software, not a human astrologer; interpretation, not prediction.

name: ai rap video
tagline: AI rap video generator — your photo, your rap.
description: RapSong is an AI rap video generator that turns a photo and a few details into a 15-second original rap song and a matching animated video. Edit lyrics for free, confirm name pronunciation, then pay once for the video and matching MP3. Starter pack is $6.99 for 70 credits (enough for one rap video). Supports solo and duo adult photos; no celebrities, minors, or voice cloning.

name: ReviewIQ
tagline: Learned to code? Practise spotting mistakes without hints.
description: ReviewIQ is hands-on practice after learning to code. Read unfamiliar code with planted mistakes, explain what needs fixing, and get feedback on what you caught and missed. Try one fixed Backend/Python/Mid-level exercise free before signup at https://reviewiq-ruby.vercel.app/try. An account is needed to save and continue. Free accounts include 5 credits; Pro is $8.99/month for 30 reviews per cycle. Practice and feedback, not a course, certificate or job guarantee.

name: Bamboo Player
tagline: Media player for your own M3U, M3U8 and Xtream playlists and video files. Includes no content.
description:
Bamboo Player is a media player for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV, Android and Android TV, built for the sources you already have. Add your own M3U or M3U8 playlist or your Xtream Codes login from a legitimate provider, open your video files or play from your local network, and it organizes everything into a clean library with an EPG program guide, favorites, history and "continue watching".

Its VLC-based engine plays MKV, MP4, AVI, MOV, M4V and TS, plus network streams over HTTP/HTTPS, HLS, RTMP and RTSP, with audio and subtitle track selection. On Apple devices you get AirPlay and, with Pro, iCloud sync of lists, favorites, history and settings. The Mac app can also browse SMB shares on your local network, download for offline viewing and record live streams. Android adds Google Cast and Picture-in-Picture. Parental control with a PIN is included.

Bamboo Player does not provide, host or distribute any content: you add your own sources, and you need the rights to what you play. Freemium: free download with limits; on the App Store in Spain, Pro is EUR 0.99/month or EUR 14.99 one-time (Lifetime). The store listings state it shows no ads.

name: SheetTutor
tagline: Free Excel practice in your browser, no signup required
description: SheetTutor offers free Excel learning with editable browser worksheets, original worked examples and matching workbook downloads. Practice SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, lookups, cell references and text formulas, and check the supplied exercises without creating an account or installing Excel. Worksheet calculations run locally in the browser; analytics is optional. Submitted by the maintainer.

name: TextileGen
tagline: AI textile designer for seamless fabric patterns, colorways, and mockups
description: TextileGen is an AI workspace for surface pattern and fashion designers. Create textile artwork from text, sketches, or fabric photos, build seamless repeats, develop colorways, and preview designs on products—then export high-resolution files.

name: YouTube Summarizer
tagline: Free YouTube video summarizer—paste a link, get a clear summary with key points in seconds.
description: YouTube Summarizer turns any YouTube video into a readable summary. Paste a URL, pick your language, and get key points and overview without watching the whole video. Fast, free to try, built for learners and creators.

name: Menu Fee Check
tagline: Free Illinois all-in menu price checker for Public Act 104-0472 (HB 228): enter your fees and items, get compliant prices in your browser.
description: From January 1, 2027, Illinois requires menu and advertised prices to include every mandatory fee (Public Act 104-0472, HB 228). Menu Fee Check is a free in-browser calculator: enter your service, kitchen or flat fees, card surcharge and rounding, paste your items, and get all-in prices in about a minute. Nothing is uploaded. Free guides quote the statute. Optional done-for-you repricing: $79, 5 business days. Disclosure: an AI-run service; the checker and guides were built and written by AI agents. Operated by Moe Ventures. General information, not legal advice.

name: Kitwright Schedule E Ops Kit
tagline: Excel rent roll & Schedule E–style expense kit for small landlords ($29)
description: Excel ops kit for US DIY landlords with 1–10 units: property setup, rent roll with monthly payment status, income log, expenses mapped to common Schedule E–style category labels, maintenance log, lease renewal pipeline, tax-year summary, portfolio dashboard, and printable rent receipt. Instant download. Bookkeeping aid — not tax advice.

name: Kitwright Deposit & Turnover Ops Kit
tagline: Excel deposit ledger & turnover tracker for small landlords ($19)
description: Excel ops kit for US DIY landlords with 1–10 units: security deposit ledger, move-in/out worksheets, itemized deductions, return amount tracker, unit turnover pipeline, and dashboard. Instant download. Operations aid — not legal advice. Companion to Kitwright Schedule E Ops Kit.

name: Matchshot
tagline: AI dating profile analysis and personalized dating photos
description: Matchshot is an AI tool for people improving their dating profiles. It analyzes profile photos, helps users compare and rank their pictures, and offers actionable feedback on photos and bios. Users can also generate personalized dating photos. The web app supports people preparing profiles for services such as Tinder, Hinge and Bumble.

name: Trust Me Bro
tagline: Check a claim against published research. Get a receipt.
description: Trust Me Bro checks one claim against published research and publishes a public receipt: a verdict, sources for and against, and the limits of the check.

name: MuseKiln
tagline: Agent skills and tools that make finished files, each tested
description: MuseKiln lists open-source AI agent skills that produce a finished file, such as a logo, a diagram or an explainer. Every skill is run on a real task before it is listed, with output, time and cost shown. Also: a free schema markup validator.

name: Glintmake
tagline: Turn a PNG or JPG into a printable STL, free, in the browser
description: Free image to STL converter for 3D printing. Pick relief, extruded outline or lithophane, set the width in millimetres and download a closed binary STL with a 3D preview first. It runs in your browser: no sign-up and no upload. PNG, JPG or WebP.

name: Debt Freedom Tracker
tagline: Compare snowball vs avalanche and get a month-by-month debt payoff plan
description: $17 Excel/Google Sheets planner that compares debt snowball vs avalanche, finds a realistic extra payment, and builds your payoff schedule. Instant download, no subscription.

name: Dime Dime Baby
tagline: Dime Dime Baby turns one clear adult photo into a 15s vertical dance video—pick a groove, get an MP4 with the template soundtrack merged, 1 credit per clip.
description: Dime Dime Baby (dimedimebabies.com) is a photo-to-dance AI video maker inspired by the BbY WOW / Dime Dime Baby trend: upload one clear, well-lit full-body photo of a consenting adult (JPG, PNG, or WebP, up to 10 MB), choose a move—Quince Classic, Party Groove, Camera Bounce, or Hand Groove—and get a 9:16, 15-second MP4. Generation uses a silent motion reference; the matching template soundtrack is merged into the finished file. One credit equals one video; one-time credit packs, no subscription; confirmed failed generations return the credit. Open My Videos to watch progress and download. Review music permissions before publishing. Directory listings use Free and hosting400@gmail.com per sibling-site convention (site support: support@dimedimebabies.com).

name: Fitness OS by Korey Wang Tianru
tagline: Coaching workflow workbench built from personally serving 40+ gym members, plus open-source resume-claim-guard.
description: Korey Wang Tianru's product suite at korey2028.tech: Fitness OS (a coaching and training workbench built from personally serving 40+ gym members with a live interactive demo), TEM4 study workbench (exam score improved from 53 to 69), and open-source AI agent skill resume-claim-guard (MIT).

name: Gamepad Bench
tagline: Free online gamepad tester — stick drift, buttons, triggers, polling rate.
description: Free browser-based gamepad tester. Connect USB or Bluetooth, check buttons, joysticks, triggers, and stick drift. Estimates polling rate. Works with PS5, Xbox, Switch, PC. No download; input stays on device.

name: Versebooth
tagline: Turn a photo into an AI rap video in minutes.
description: Versebooth helps creators make AI rap videos from everyday photos. Pick a scene, upload photos, get a short shareable clip in minutes. Free trial credits; paid from about $9.90.

name: CarVideoAI
tagline: AI car video generator for dealership backgrounds, edits, and promo clips
description: CarVideoAI helps car creators, tuners, and dealerships make promo clips without a full edit suite. Describe the shot or upload a reference, pick aspect ratio and length, and generate dealership aerial pans, neon drift edits, showroom turntables, and supercar features in seconds. Sound is matched by default; projects stay private. Free to start with no card required. Original car creative only—no celebrities, copyrighted characters, adult content, or deepfakes.

name: BidReady Kenya | Tender Radar
tagline: Independent tender discovery and readiness support for Kenyan SMEs, contractors and AGPO suppliers.
description: Independent tender discovery and readiness support for Kenyan SMEs, contractors and AGPO suppliers. Browse recent notices, check closing dates and open the original documents before preparing your bid.

name: FixLetter
tagline: Firm, professional dispute letters in 2 minutes
description: FixLetter turns a frustrating problem into a polished, ready-to-send letter. Pick from 22 letter types (billing errors, medical bills, credit report errors, security deposits, flight refunds, parking fines and more), answer a few questions, choose a polite or firm tone, and download it as PDF, Word or text. Preview your letter before you pay; resignation, raise and severance letters cost nothing.

name: LocalCSV Lab
tagline: Free CSV & JSON tools — private, no file uploads
description: LocalCSV Lab provides 10 free browser-based data utilities. Remove CSV duplicates, compare exports by SKU, join CSV tables by ID, convert CSV and JSON, and review Shopify product CSVs before importing. Files are processed in an isolated local browser editor, with no account or upload required. Informational pages contain labeled ads; the file editor itself is ad-free.

name: Aureon
tagline: Mac AI for selected text: rewrite, translate, summarize, or explain, then one reviewed note, page, or event.
description: Apple Intelligence Writing Tools improve selected text in place. Aureon Smart Actions starts there, then lets you add a typed or spoken instruction and optionally create one reviewed item in Apple Notes, Obsidian, Notion, Flomo, or Apple Calendar. Create-only: no send, edit, delete, or overwrite. macOS 14+, paid with free trial. Guide: https://inaureon.com/apple-intelligence-writing-tools-alternative

name: InclusiveSpeak
tagline: AAC app for nonverbal and minimally verbal children
description: InclusiveSpeak is an augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) app that helps non-verbal and minimally verbal children, including children with autism, apraxia, cerebral palsy and Down syndrome, communicate. It offers customizable visual boards, text-to-speech, word prediction and progress tracking on iPhone, iPad and the web, for families, therapists and schools.

name: Chess4D
tagline: Free 4D, 3D and 5D chess in your browser - no download, no sign-up.
description: Chess4D is a free browser chess site with three modes: 4D chess on a 4x4x2x2 hypercube board with legal-move markers, classic chess on a rotatable 3D board vs Stockfish, and an experimental 5D time-travel variant. Play vs the computer or a friend on the same device.

name: PolicyLeap
tagline: Free AI acceptable use policy generator for small and mid-sized teams
description: PolicyLeap helps small and mid-sized organizations put clear rules around ChatGPT, Copilot and other AI tools. Answer a few questions about your team, tools and data, and it drafts a starting policy covering approved tools, data rules, human review, disclosure, security and reporting. The free plan includes PDF and Word downloads. Industry Pro ($49 one-time) adds industry clauses, framework sections written with laws like HIPAA, GDPR or SOC 2 in mind, a rollout checklist and an employee acknowledgment form. Pro + Annual Refresh ($99 per year) adds a yearly refresh. Built by the Logical Leap team. It is a starting template, not legal advice, and it does not store your content.

name: SciFig
tagline: Create scientific illustrations, charts and flowcharts online
description: SciFig helps researchers turn ideas, sketches and data into scientific illustrations, charts and flowcharts for papers and presentations. Its web workspace supports refining visuals and exporting editable SVG charts and flowcharts.

name: CallEez
tagline: UK AI receptionist for trades: answers calls 24/7, books jobs, texts callers. Free 3-minute browser test, no card.
description: CallEez is a UK-built AI receptionist for trades and small businesses. When you're up a ladder, under a sink or driving, it answers your calls 24/7, answers questions about your business from your website, takes messages and books jobs into your weekly schedule. It texts the caller, emails and texts you the details, and can put a caller through to your mobile when they ask for a person. You can forward your existing line, so you keep your own number. Every call is saved with a recording, transcript and summary. Try it free first at calleez.ai/create-agent with a 3-minute test call in your browser, no account or card needed. Plans from £19/month excl. VAT, no contract. Submitted by the CallEez team.

name: Tip Toeing in My Jordans AI — Meme Video Generator
tagline: Upload one photo and become the tiptoeing imp in the viral Rumpelstiltskin barn dance — a 12-second 16:9 video with the original meme sound.
description: Tip Toeing in My Jordans AI turns a single photo into the viral AI Rumpelstiltskin barn-dance meme. The AI (Seedance 2.5 video-to-video) swaps the tiptoeing dancer for you while the barn, straw, gold coins and crying woman stay exactly as in the original clip. You get a 12-second 16:9 MP4 (480p or HD 720p) with the original meme sound plus a silent copy, ready in about 3–5 minutes. First video $4.99 for new users; credit packs from $6.99, no subscription. Photos are deleted within 24 hours and failed videos are refunded automatically.

name: AI Zombie Film — AI Zombie Video Generator
tagline: Upload two photos and get a 25-second cinematic zombie love story — one of you stays human, one turns, and it ends in a hug.
description: AI Zombie Film turns two photos into a 25-second cinematic zombie love story with sound. Photo 1 stays human; Photo 2 turns zombie. The film comes with its own cuts, camera moves and generated sound — no filming, no prompts, no editing. Pick 9:16 or 16:9, pay once ($9.99 per film, no subscription), and download your private MP4 in about 15 minutes. Failed renders are refunded automatically, and your photos and films are never published.

name: Bulin 47 AI Video Generator
tagline: Turn one photo into a 15- or 30-second vertical video of you freestyling in the viral Bulin 47 street scene — original crowd, camera and sound included.
description: Bulin 47 AI Video Generator lets anyone star in the viral Bulin 47 freestyle clip. Upload one front-facing photo and the AI (ByteDance Seedance 2.5) swaps the lead performer for you, keeping the original crowd, handheld camera, red lighting and sound exactly as filmed. You get a post-ready 9:16 MP4 (15s or 30s, 480p or HD 720p) with the original sound plus a silent copy, in about 10–20 minutes. No app, no editing, no watermark. One-time credit packs from $9.99, credits never expire, failed videos are refunded automatically.

name: Warble
tagline: AI social media manager for small businesses: writes, designs, schedules and posts for you
description:
Warble is an AI social media manager for small businesses. It writes, designs, schedules and publishes posts across up to 10 channels from your website URL.

Paste your website URL and Warble builds a brand profile and voice, then writes posts, creates the images, and schedules and publishes everything for you. Includes a content calendar, campaigns, analytics, inbox auto-replies, and an API and MCP server for Claude and ChatGPT.

name: BotSherpa
tagline: Find the right AI tool or agent for any task, with setup steps.
description: BotSherpa is a free guide to picking AI tools. Type a task in plain words and get one best pick, a cheaper or free alternative, and setup steps you can follow in about ten minutes. It covers 130 AI tools and 43 AI agents with hand-checked pricing, plus 100 task guides. Sponsored spots are always labeled.

name: Affirmism
tagline: Sound healing in your own voice. Record affirmations over healing beats.
description: Affirmism is sound healing in your own voice. Write an affirmation or start from a template, record it on your iPhone, and layer it over one of 24 binaural and isochronic beats. If you tried Calm or a manifestation app and it never stuck, this is different: you are the voice. Build playlists for mornings, sleep, calm and confidence. Your recordings never leave your phone. 14-day free trial, then $69.99/yr, or $14.99/mo after a 7-day trial. A mindfulness practice, not medical care. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6787199584

name: Bitcoin Almanack
tagline: Bitcoin research with free ETF flow tracking and mining calculators.
description: Bitcoin Almanack is an independent Bitcoin publication offering free research tools alongside news and educational guides. Its Bitcoin ETF Flow Tracker presents daily fund-flow data and historical charts, while its mining calculator helps readers explore mining economics. The site also covers wallets, exchanges, mining and energy. The homepage links to the publication and its tools.

name: MintChats
tagline: Save and reuse AI conversations through MCP
description: MintChats captures AI conversations through MCP into a searchable private library. Save the original content together with titles, tags and source context from compatible clients such as Claude Desktop, Cursor and Windsurf. Selectively publish saved assets as public share pages. A free plan is available.

name: Vitaeo
tagline: Tailor a resume to each job description
description: Vitaeo helps job seekers compare a master resume with a job description. Review the AI match analysis and targeted suggestions, then prepare a tailored version for each role. Export to PDF, Markdown or plain text. The free plan includes five optimizations per month.

name: DeepVal
tagline: AI company research that tracks what changes for U.S.-listed stocks
description: DeepVal publishes structured in-depth and moat reports on U.S.-listed companies and tracks key questions with weekly summaries. Research information only; not investment advice.

name: AI Rap Video
tagline: AI Rap Video generator: turn a photo into a lip-synced rap video
description: AI Rap Video (RapVideo.ai) turns two photos into a lip-synced rap music video in your browser. Upload one photo of each person, pick a stage and a sound, and download an MP4 with no watermark, ready for TikTok, Reels or Shorts. Includes Hotel Lobby AI trend videos, an AI rap generator, AI rap duo videos and lip-sync for your own song. Freemium: free trial credits, packs from $9.99.

name: GramPayBot
tagline: Non-custodial USDT and USDC invoices and payment links
description: GramPayBot lets merchants create USDT and USDC invoices and payment links through Telegram, a web dashboard, or an API. Customers pay directly to the merchant’s wallet. The service verifies transfers on-chain, updates payment status, and supports order reconciliation. New accounts receive $5 in processing credit; after that, pricing is per confirmed payment.

name: FlightAtom
tagline: AI-native aviation software for airlines and operators
description: FlightAtom builds AI-native software for airlines and operators. Its independent products include TRACE Ai (safety investigations), AURORA Ai (SMS/QMS), CREW Ai (crew scheduling), MENTHOR Ai (pilot training), FOLIO Ai (manual control) and more. AI drafts and analyzes; accountable people sign off.

name: HitDM
tagline: Instagram comment keyword → one private DM with a tracked link
description: HitDM automates Instagram comment-to-DM on Meta's official API. Set a keyword on a post or Reel; when someone comments, they get one private DM with your tracked link. Free: 1,000 DMs/month. Pro: $9/month unlimited DMs + optional lead capture. A ManyChat alternative for Instagram-only creators — not a multi-channel chatbot suite.

name: Footalytics
tagline: AI football prediction chat with locked pre-kickoff picks and publicly settled accuracy.
description: Footalytics is an AI football prediction chat. Predictions lock before kickoff and settle publicly on an accuracy page, with open match data on GitHub. Freemium for fans and builders who care about measurable accuracy.

name: QuizMad
tagline: Daily football quizzes and games. No sign-up; share your score.
description: QuizMad — daily football quizzes and games (Man Utd, Messi, Ronaldo, World Cup and more). No sign-up; share your score.

name: Loquendo
tagline: AI text to speech & voice cloning in English and Spanish
description: Loquendo is a browser AI text-to-speech studio for English and Spanish: pick a narrator, generate up to 500 characters free and download your audio as MP3.

name: Monolithos
tagline: The Personal Agent OS. Remembers you. Acts for you. Belongs to you.
description: Monolithos is a local-first personal agent for macOS, iOS and Windows. Its memory lives as plain Markdown in a vault on your own disk, so your agent keeps the same memory when you change models. Work you hand to the agent pauses for your approval before anything consequential, and every result is kept as a file you own. The local features, including on-device meeting transcription on Mac, iOS and Windows, are free; only the cloud AI features need a subscription.

name: Jimaku-gaeshi
tagline: Free offline SRT text-review handoff
description: Free prototype for subtitle editors and reviewers. Generate an offline review HTML from a UTF-8 SRT; reviewers edit text and notes, then return JSON. The editor checks it against the same original SRT and selects individual text corrections while retaining cue numbers and timestamps. No transcription, translation, video playback or timing edits. HTML and JSON include all original subtitles in unencrypted plain text: use only an approved sharing channel. Supports up to 2,000 cues and 500,000 characters. Desktop browser recommended; browser saving, Windows/macOS exchange and editing-software compatibility remain unverified. Japanese and English tools are linked from the homepage. Built and maintained with AI assistance; no AI API is needed to use the tool.

name: Parley Voice
tagline: Two-way live voice translation for Zoom, Meet and Teams
description: Desktop app for macOS and Windows that translates both sides of a Zoom, Teams or Meet call into live voice through virtual audio devices. The other side does not need to install anything. Pay per minute, no subscription. Live models: Qwen and Doubao; Gemini coming soon. Meeting translation: https://parleyvoice.com/meeting-translation

name: SearchBastion
tagline: Free SEO checks, audits and traffic-quality insights
description: SearchBastion helps website owners, developers and marketers find technical SEO issues and understand traffic quality. Its free browser-based tools check SEO, meta tags, speed, robots.txt, sitemaps, redirects and SSL without an account. A free account adds multi-page audits and optional Google Search Console integration. The dashboard also supports analytics connections and traffic-quality signals such as VPN, datacenter and duplicate-click detection. SearchBastion is currently in beta, with Vietnamese and English interfaces.

name: LinkToText
tagline: Free Instagram transcript generator for public Reels and videos.
description: Turns a public Instagram Reel or video URL into a clean searchable transcript. Free Instagram transcript generator with Whisper and AI cleanup.

name: StemNook
tagline: Split an MP3 or WAV into vocals and instrumental, and cut clips to WAV.
description: StemNook is an online audio tool for separating an MP3 or WAV into vocals and combined instrumental accompaniment. It also offers a browser-based audio cutter that exports selected clips as WAV files.

name: PicEdit AI
tagline: Online photo editor for focused changes to an existing image.
description: PicEdit AI is an online photo editor for existing images. Upload a photo and describe a focused change, such as replacing a background, removing an unwanted object, or adjusting a detail. Review the result against your original.

name: Sitemap.ai
tagline: Cloud XML, HTML, llms.txt & markdown generator
description: Sitemap.ai generates XML sitemaps for search engines, HTML sitemaps for visitors, llms.txt for AI, and clean markdown for LLM workflows from one crawl, with JavaScript rendering, saved projects, crawl comparison, and scheduled re-crawls. Free up to 5,000 URLs per crawl on a free account (500 as a guest), 50,000 URLs/month. Founded in Cincinnati, Ohio, in 2023 by Austin Cline.

name: Jev Model Guide
tagline: AI decision API: typed yes/no, choice and score outputs
description: Jev Model Guide is an AI decision API for routing, triage, scoring and gating inside software. Send app state plus typed questions and get back a choice, score or yes/no probability your code can branch on. Includes docs, a browser Playground and API keys. Independent guide site, not affiliated with or endorsed by TypeSafe AI.

name: GetCanvApps — Canva Apps Directory
tagline: Curated Canva apps for AI music, voice, images & design tools.
description: A curated directory of Canva apps—AI music, voice, images, mockups, and design utilities—so creators can find the right Canva tools faster.

name: Offrun
tagline: One Mac workspace for every coding agent you run
description:
Offrun is a free app for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs that manages multiple AI coding agents from one workspace. Run Claude Code, Codex, AGY, Grok Build and Muse Code side by side, and see who is working, who needs you, and how much usage each account has left.

Every agent in a project gets its own git worktree, so two agents on the same repo never touch the same files. Pick a second agent as a reviewer and its findings land in the chat while the work is still uncommitted. Nothing merges on its own.

Connect multiple logins per harness. When one hits its usage limit, Offrun moves the chat to a login with room left, or offers another agent that picks up the whole conversation. Project memory keeps repo conventions and each agent's goals and plans. Offrun runs the CLIs on your Mac, signed in as you, with no API key, and prompts go straight to your provider.

name: PC Tweaker
tagline: Review Windows settings and restore supported changes
description: PC Tweaker provides a Windows workspace for reviewing tuning, privacy and maintenance settings. Core tools are available without an account; optional Pro features add advanced workflows. Restore options cover supported recorded changes, not permanently deleted files or a full backup; results vary by device.

name: UmberLore
tagline: Visual art history, checked against the record
description: UmberLore covers visual art history checked against the record. Free educational reference for students and readers.

name: TriRank
tagline: Tracks how brands appear in AI answers and helps AI search presence.
description: TriRank is an AI visibility / SEO platform that tracks how brands appear in AI answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, etc.) and helps improve AI search presence.

name: Teraroma
tagline: Prepaid travel eSIMs for 190+ countries, from $1.12, no app
description: Teraroma sells prepaid, data-only travel eSIMs covering 190+ countries and regions, with plans from as low as $1.12. Every plan is a one-time prepaid purchase with no subscription, and no app is required: travellers buy online, install the eSIM on a compatible phone and use mobile data abroad. It suits holidaymakers, business travellers and digital nomads who want to avoid roaming bills without hunting for a local SIM. Teraroma is based in the United Kingdom. Partner code t-partner gives readers 10% off, and bespoke or group requests go to team@teraroma.io. Logo and brand assets: https://teraroma.io/press.

name: Destiny Book
tagline: AI Chinese astrology & BaZi personal destiny report generator
description: Destiny Book (个人命书 / 個人命書, https://mymingshu.com/) is an AI-powered Chinese astrology (BaZi & Zi Wei Dou Shu) life-chart and personal destiny report generator. Turn your birth date, time, and birthplace into a multi-chapter destiny reading.

name: RaumLens
tagline: AI landscape design from a yard photo, with a planting plan
description: RaumLens turns a photo of one planting bed or compact garden area into an AI landscape redesign concept and structured planting plan. Users review climate, sunlight, approximate area and features to preserve; the plan includes catalog plants, placement notes and estimated quantity ranges. A limited free trial is available, followed by paid plans. For visual planning, not construction or drainage engineering.

name: Orivox
tagline: AI website builder for small businesses (English & Hebrew)
description: Orivox is an AI website builder for small businesses. Chat about the site; the model proposes small named edits and the server validates them before apply. Free plan for one live site. Not affiliated with orivox.ai.

name: Vowise
tagline: AI voice-to-text, dictation, and voice journal app.
description: Vowise is an AI voice-to-text, dictation, and voice journal app that turns voice recordings into editable text while keeping original audio for playback and review. It includes a personal dictionary for names and custom terms, full-text search, photo captions and OCR, an Awareness Log for activities and habits, card-based note review, and AI Memory that can be viewed, edited, deleted, or paused. Available on macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android, Web, and as a Chrome extension, with cross-device sync.

name: PopNow
tagline: Create AI videos, images, music and voiceovers in your browser
description: PopNow is a browser-based creative studio for AI videos, images, music and voiceovers. Compare the generated result with the source using a before-and-after slider. Refine uses the current result as the input for another generation. Limited one-time free tries are available at 1K with a watermark; paid HD generation supports up to 4K without a watermark.

Password-protected PDFs are unlocked in your browser. 10 pages free a day without an account; paid plans add more pages.

description: iOS travel companion for international visitors — multilingual attraction guides, audio walking tours, English-friendly restaurants, private itinerary maps, and practical travel tools.

SpicyAPI is an AI API platform for developers. It provides image, video, audio and language model APIs, with documented request schemas, USD price quotes, asynchronous media jobs, polling, webhooks and OpenAI-compatible chat.

Public SDKs, a CLI, an MCP client and an agent skill support integrations. These MIT client projects are separate from the hosted service. Pricing: https://spicyapi.ai/pricing

Finished grids and a short brush-on dye trend video use one-time credit packs from $2.99 with no subscription. Only hair or lashes change. Results are a visual preview, not a guarantee of salon results.

description: Tiny Desk AI turns one authorized photo, or five people in Band mode, into a 15-second vertical desk-concert parody MP4 with sound. Solo and Band workflows, one-time credit packs, free photo checks, no watermark and consent guidance are documented.

name: Logofinch

name: Web Harmonium
tagline: Free-to-try online Indian harmonium with Sargam notation

Every key shows Western pitch and Sargam notation, with raga guides, song notes, a web tanpura and a Sargam tuner. New users receive 3 free generation credits after signup and email verification; no credit card is required.

description: DSH Hub is a bilingual directory of open-source DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins and clients. Every entry links to a public GitHub repo. name: Name A Hundred
tagline: name a hundred ideas
description: Free generator that helps you brainstorm and name a hundred creative ideas for brands, products, or projects—no signup.

name: LinkWiki

description: LinkWiki is a Korean website directory for discovering useful websites and checking addresses. Browse curated categories, search websites by name or domain, and read practical guides to finding reliable site links.

name: Square Image
tagline: square image maker
description: Free browser tool to crop and resize images into perfect squares for social posts and avatars—no signup.

name: Livnaro
tagline: Mixed-carton CBM and chargeable weight calculator
description: Livnaro is a free browser-based shipment planning worksheet for importers, exporters and small logistics teams. Add mixed carton sizes and quantities to calculate total CBM, gross weight, air and courier volumetric weight, and sea LCL W/M. Paste spreadsheet rows, export CSV or print a packing summary. Entries stay in browser local storage. Container capacity figures are estimates, not a carrier quote or approved loading plan. I am the independent developer.

name: PDF Combiner
tagline: Free Online PDF File Combiner — local processing, files never leave your device.
description: PDF Combiner (pdfcombiner.online) is a free online tool that merges multiple PDF files and images (JPG, PNG, GIF, BMP, WebP) into one PDF. Everything runs in your browser — files are not uploaded. No signup, no watermark, works on Windows, Mac, Linux and mobile.

name: Houspire
tagline: Online interior design plans for Indian homes
description: Houspire is a Hyderabad-based, design-only online interior design service founded in 2025. Homeowners get room-by-room 3D designs, layouts and itemized plans they can build with any carpenter or contractor, with no site visits. 2,500+ rooms planned.

name: Instagram Cleaner
tagline: Privacy-first Instagram tool to find who doesn’t follow you back.
description: Instagram Cleaner is a privacy-first tool for reviewing Instagram follower and following relationships. It reads your Instagram data export directly in your browser and identifies accounts that appear in your following list but not in your followers list. Upload the original Instagram export ZIP, or select relationship files in JSON or HTML. Processed locally in the browser; no Instagram password, cookies, tokens, or 2FA requested. Does not auto-unfollow. Independent project, not affiliated with Instagram/Meta.

name: FitFaat Gym Management Software
tagline: Gym management software and app for memberships, billing, attendance, CRM and WhatsApp automation.
description: FitFaat is gym management software and a mobile app built for gyms and fitness studios in India: member management and renewals, billing and invoicing, attendance tracking, trainer and staff management, CRM and lead follow-ups, and WhatsApp automation. Available on Android and iOS. Built by Dai Software, Indore, since 2019.

name: HyperFrames Online
tagline: Turn a text prompt into a 1080p MP4 motion video in 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1, then refine it with chat edits in plain English.
description:
HyperFrames Online is a web app that turns a text prompt into a motion video, without writing code. Describe the story, the audience and the words you want on screen, and it makes a 1080p MP4 for a launch, explainer or announcement.

In Agent, choose 10, 15 or 30 seconds and a landscape (16:9), portrait (9:16) or square (1:1) canvas, then pick a style: Motion for clean flat motion graphics, Sketch for hand-drawn whiteboard visuals, or Cinematic for dark cinematic visuals. The homepage Quick generator makes 15, 30 or 60 second videos in styles such as Flat Pop, Bauhaus and Cyber HUD, and accepts up to four reference images for layout, color and composition.

When it's ready, describe changes in plain English with a chat edit, or select one scene and change its title, color or pace. Undo costs no credits and version history stays available. Videos use an original music library with no voiceover.

Starter is $9.90 a month for 500 credits (USD, tax extra). There is no free tier, and failed renders refund their credits automatically. Sign in to make videos and use credits.

Built on the open-source HyperFrames project (Apache-2.0). Not affiliated with or endorsed by HeyGen.

name: HireDeveloper.sg
tagline: Hire vetted developers, designers, marketers and project managers in Singapore.
description: HireDeveloper.sg helps companies in Singapore hire pre-screened remote talent: software developers, designers, marketers and project managers. Candidates are vetted before they are introduced, and both freelance and full-time hires are supported, so teams can move straight to interviews.

name: Kibbe Body Types
tagline: Free Kibbe quiz and personal style guides
description: Kibbe Body Types is a free resource for exploring personal style through a visual quiz, a body type comparison chart, and styling guides. The quiz uses 13 questions and requires no photo uploads. Visitors can compare types and explore outfit ideas to inform their own style choices.

name: Zyloop AI
tagline: AI Tools, Artificial Intelligence, AI Technology
description:
Artificial intelligence has become an essential element of modern technology.AI tools can help individuals and businesses discover innovative ways to improve their workflows, manage information more efficiently, and solve practical problems.

Choosing the right AI solution involves considering its intended purpose, the features it provides, how easy it is to use, and whether it fits the needs of the business.

Visitors can visit the official website to learn more about the services and features available.

It is recommended to review the features of an AI tool before making a decision to ensure it meets your specific needs.

Basic generations are free and unlimited; paid tiers add higher resolution and private, watermark-free images.

name: Mobyform
tagline: Forms, surveys, exams, and response workflows
description: Mobyform helps teams build forms, surveys, and exams, collect responses, and connect follow-up workflows. It offers templates, conditional logic, sharing through links or embeds, response analytics, and webhook integrations. A free plan is available alongside paid plans.

name: CINEART

description: CINEART helps filmmakers organize productions, develop storyboards, generate shot-level video, and reuse consistent characters, scenes and visual styles. Limited free usage is available alongside subscriptions and credit packs.

name: AI Hairstyle Fit
tagline: AI haircut previews, styling advice and a barber card
description: AI Hairstyle Fit helps men prepare for a haircut using a front-facing photo and optional preferences. Compare an AI hairstyle preview with the original, get daily styling advice and create a barber card with cutting notes. Generation requires login. Eligible verified new accounts receive one preview with 10 welcome credits; extra looks use one-time credit packs. Photos and results clear after 24 hours. A barber should confirm real length, density and texture before cutting.

name: Desearch

Format and validate JSON, encode and decode Base64, and work with useful utilities directly in your browser. No complicated setup required, just fast, simple, and accessible tools for developers.

name: ProInvoice

description: ProInvoice is a web app for contractors, tradespeople and service businesses to create professional estimates and invoices, manage clients and jobs, and collect customer deposits and invoice payments through their own connected Stripe accounts. A free plan is available.

name: Meshy

description: Meshy is an AI 3D creation platform that turns text prompts and images into 3D models. It also offers AI texturing, rigging, and animation tools, helping game developers, designers, and creators build 3D assets for their projects. Meshy offers a freemium plan.

tagline: Personalized AI hypnosis and sleep audio
description: Hypnova creates personalized hypnosis audio from a short chat, with studio voices and soundscapes you choose. Explore 300+ expert-crafted sessions for sleep, stress, focus, confidence, habits, and pain. The core library is free; optional subscriptions add credits for personalized audio. Available on iOS and Android.

name: Storm Circle

description: Free 2-minute family storm plan: give each person one job (who checks on whom, meeting spots, out-of-area contact), share by text, everyone confirms with "I'm in". No app, no account.

One-time credit packs from $6.99; credits never expire. Independent fan tool; not affiliated with Mesut Özil, any club, league, or broadcaster.

description: Wonderglot is a web and iOS app for practising languages through ongoing stories with AI characters. Designed for early intermediate to advanced learners across Japanese, Spanish, French, Korean, German, Mandarin, Vietnamese, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese and English. Templates are refreshed daily, so new trend formats appear without any setup on your side.

description: PyInvesting is a no-code investment research platform for testing rule-based strategies and screening stocks. Its free Starter plan includes up to three user backtests and saved simulation results; Premium adds unlimited backtests and monitored strategies. Simulations are research tools, not forecasts or brokerage execution.

name: Knotes

description: Knotes is a browser-based chat app for adults 18 and older. Meet new people through random text or video conversations, join public lobbies, or create invite-only rooms. No profile or account is required. The interface includes camera and microphone controls, next-match and report buttons, and optional video blurring. Built by the Knotes team; feedback is welcome. Share it with adult friends who would enjoy trying it.

description: DiaTrace is Diatech's ESG-sustainability and diamond traceability and certification programme for the gems and jewelry industry. description: Diatech Make is jewelry CAD software that runs in the browser and works with AI. There is no upload API, no account, and no paid upgrade; files stay in your tab from start to finish. Built by Souren Das in Bengaluru and supported by ads.

Gallery pictures are AI style illustrations, not tested before-and-after results. Submitted by an owner-authorized AI assistant.

With barcode, RFID, PDA, and Wi-Fi support, F2 helps healthcare organisations improve asset visibility, maintenance coordination, compliance, and operational efficiency.

name: Clipper
tagline: Encrypted clipboard history across your devices
description: Clipper helps you save, search and organize copied text, links, images and files. Content is encrypted on your device before cloud sync. A macOS download and an unsigned Windows preview are available; check the website for current mobile availability. Free and paid plans are available.

name: Ayra Studio
tagline: Done-for-you AI UGC Reels starring a consistent virtual creator.

Every Reel stars a consistent virtual creator (around 17 faces to choose from), so your brand gets a recognisable on-screen presenter without casting, shipping product, or chasing influencers. Send your product photos and key message; we script, produce, and deliver scroll-ready vertical Reels for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. Your product, her spotlight. Packages: Test Drive 2 Reels $35 (₹2,499); Monthly 4 Reels $69 (₹4,999); Engine 8 Reels $119 (₹8,999).

name: Voltage Drop Calculator
tagline: Free NEC voltage drop and wire size calculator
description: VoltageDropCalculator.net is a free, browser-based voltage drop calculator for electricians, engineers and students. Enter load (amps, watts or HP), voltage (12V DC to 480V 3-phase), copper or aluminum, conduit type and one-way length to see the voltage drop, end voltage and a wire size checked against 3%/5% limits.

name: GoatRap
tagline: AI rap generator: turn one photo into a rap video.
description: GoatRap is an AI rap generator. Upload one photo, give it a topic or paste your own lyrics, and pick a flow. The AI writes the bars, makes the beat and lip-syncs your photo into a 15-second vertical rap video in about two minutes. A diss track generator makes MP3s from just a name.

name: BeatAPI
tagline: An Agent Toolkit for AI models, social data and web search
description: BeatAPI is an Agent Toolkit for accessing AI models, social data and web search through one API key. Compare current model pricing and connect the capabilities your agent needs to complete real tasks. It is built for developers adding these capabilities to agents and applications. Model requests and data actions use usage-based pricing; selected free model routes have their own limits.

name: StickersMaker
tagline: Turn your photo into animated stickers
description: StickersMaker is an AI animated sticker maker: upload one clear portrait, get a reusable cartoon character, then generate personalized animated reactions with transparent backgrounds. Export formats tailored for WhatsApp, WeChat, Telegram, and Discord. No subscription — buy credits when you need them (10 credits per sticker). Verify email for 20 free credits.

name: Property Upside
tagline: Free Singapore property research using recorded sales and comparable evidence.
description: Property Upside is an independent Singapore property research platform. Explore recorded HDB and private property sales, comparable-sale evidence and neighbourhood context. Public research reports are free and available without an account. Reports explain their methodology, sample sizes, data coverage and limitations. Historical comparisons are research signals, not forecasts, current asking prices or official bank valuations.

name: Lumen
tagline: AI that Lives On your Desktop.
description:
Lumen is an AI desktop assistant that operates directly on top of your existing workspace. By triggering a global hotkey (Ctrl+Space on Windows or Cmd+Space on macOS), users can instantly select any region of their screen—such as code blocks, math formulas, complex diagrams, or dense text—to analyze and solve without switching windows.
Rather than relying on manual copy-pasting or traditional screenshot steps, Lumen captures pixel-accurate context ephemerally to generate immediate, actionable solutions directly over your current application.

name: Seedream 5.5
tagline: Text or photos to AI images in your browser, 1K or 2K
description: Seedream 5.5 (seedream55.io) is an AI image generator that runs in your browser. Write a prompt of up to 5,000 characters for text-to-image, or upload up to 10 reference images for image-to-image. Pick 1K or 2K and one of eight aspect ratios; each image is a PNG. Free trial credits with Google sign-up.

name: AgentTaste

description: Free browser tool that generates gamertags and usernames locally (Xbox, Discord, clan tags, 4-letter tags and more). No account required to use.

description: PDFCopy lets you select and copy text from a PDF in your browser. Remove unwanted line breaks and edit before copying. Files stay on your device—no account required. Text mode needs a usable text layer; scanned pages may need OCR.

name: ScormMaker
tagline: Free online PowerPoint to SCORM converter
description: ScormMaker is a free, browser-based PowerPoint to SCORM converter. Upload a PowerPoint presentation and turn it into a SCORM 1.2 e-learning package for your LMS, with no software to install. Built by an independent developer for instructional designers, trainers and teachers.

name: Live Face Swap

description:
