description: AirapVideo1 is an AI rap video generator. Upload a portrait, pick a stage (After Hours, Rooftop, Booth, or Back & Forth duet), optionally add lyrics, and generate a short clip with original AI vocals and beat—ready for TikTok, Reels, or Shorts. One-time credit packs; no subscription required. Built for short-form creators who want a finished clip from a single portrait.

name: Pokemon Team Builder
tagline: Build teams for all Pokemon versions
description: Pokemon Team Builder is a free web tool to build Pokemon teams for 27+ games. It includes a type coverage calculator and weakness analysis so you can create competitive teams with balanced coverage in seconds.

name: Azeroth Survivors Field Guide
tagline: A multilingual game companion with class guides, equipment references and a local run notebook.
description: An independent companion website for Azeroth Survivors players. It combines illustrated beginner guides, class builds, talent and equipment references, save-backup steps and browser troubleshooting with original player-video sources. The local run notebook helps players record their own sessions. Unofficial fan resource; links to the original game point to creator Aethus.

name: Play HT
tagline: AI text to speech and voice cloning with MP3 downloads
description: Play HT is an independent AI voice generator. Paste a script, pick from 200+ public voices across 85 script languages, and download an MP3. Subscribers can clone a voice they are authorized to use, write multi-speaker dialogue, and turn manuscripts into audiobooks. Guests can try it free without an account. Freemium, based in the United States, launched February 2026.

name: UncensoredLabs
tagline: Uncensored AI models through one OpenAI-compatible API.
description: UncensoredLabs provides uncensored and abliterated AI models through one OpenAI-compatible API. Developers can build chat, coding, and AI applications using familiar clients, streaming chat completions, and prepaid token pricing. The platform includes API key spending limits, model allowlists, and per-request usage tracking. Developers can connect existing applications by changing their client base URL, choosing a model, and supplying an UncensoredLabs API key. The dashboard provides model information, token usage, billing details, and controls for managing access and spending.

name: BuyerDrill
tagline: Practice the buyer call before the buyer call.
description: BuyerDrill is AI buyer role-play for export and B2B salespeople who negotiate in English as a second language. Pick one of six export scenarios, such as a trade-show price push, an MOQ and lead-time call, or a samples and certificates request. The AI buyer speaks first, raises one objection at a time and pushes harder as you go. Answer by voice or typing; after about five minutes you get a score out of 25 on five business moves. Accent is never scored.

name: Free Audio Editor
tagline: Trim, cut, merge and convert audio in the browser. Files stay on your device.
description: Free browser audio editor. Trim, cut, merge, convert, and adjust audio locally. Files are not uploaded. No signup and no watermark.

name: Pic2Vector
tagline: Free image to SVG converter that runs in your browser
description: Pic2Vector converts PNG, JPG and WebP images into clean, color-layered SVG directly in your browser. A Rust tracing engine compiled to WebAssembly runs on your device, so images are never uploaded. Pick full color, black & white or posterize, tune with live sliders, and export a watermark-free SVG.

name: ImageSplitKit
tagline: Split images into equal tiles with a live preview and ZIP download
description: ImageSplitKit is a free browser-based image splitter for creators and designers. Select one image, choose rows and columns, preview the cut lines, and download individual tiles or a ZIP in PNG, JPEG or WebP format. A 5400 x 1350 Canva export can become five 1080 x 1350 panels using one row and five columns. Image processing happens on your device and no account is required. A built-in sample lets you try the workflow immediately. The tool supports grids up to 10 x 10 and warns before trimming a small remainder when dimensions do not divide evenly. It does not design layouts or split video.

name: FreePassportPic
tagline: Free passport photo maker — US 2×2 and more, in-browser, no upload, no watermark.
description: Free online passport photo maker. Auto-crops to official sizes (US 2×2, Canada, UK, Schengen, China, India, and more). Face detection and cropping run 100% in your browser — your photo is never uploaded. Free download, no watermark, no sign-up.

name: OumaShu
tagline: Free online navigation for ~35 browser tools — no signup.
description: Free online tool navigation site with ~35 browser-based tools across 12 categories — no registration, mostly local processing.

name: Ai Imagora
tagline: Generate and edit images with Nano Banana 2.1
description: Ai Imagora is a browser workspace for Nano Banana 2.1, Google's image generation and editing model, served through Cloudflare Workers AI. Write a prompt to create a new image, or upload a JPEG, PNG, or WebP reference and describe the edit you want. It covers text-to-image, prompt-guided photo editing, and image-to-image restyling, with output sizes of 1024×1024, 1792×1024, and 1024×1792. The site also has a prompt library with example generations, a guide, and comparison pages against Flux, Midjourney, and GPT Image. New accounts get 3 free credits, and paid credit packs are available. Ai Imagora is independent and not affiliated with Google.

name: Clip2SRT
tagline: AI subtitle generator: audio or video to SRT files
description: Clip2SRT is an AI subtitle generator that turns audio and short video clips into timed SRT subtitles. Upload MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG, WEBM, MP4, or MOV files up to 25MB, pick the spoken language or let it auto-detect, and optionally translate the subtitles into English, Chinese, Spanish, German, French, Japanese, or Korean. Speech is transcribed with Whisper large-v3-turbo on Cloudflare Workers AI, and you download an .srt file (VTT when the model provides it) ready for video editors, YouTube, and players. Guests get 2 free minutes every day; prepaid minute packs start at $5 and never expire. No watermark.

name: StickerBleed
tagline: Add a contour white border to transparent PNGs
description: StickerBleed adds a contour border that follows the shape of a transparent PNG instead of drawing a square frame around the canvas. Upload a transparent PNG (up to 4000×4000px, 10MB), choose a thickness from 2 to 20px and a color (white is the default), preview the original against the result, and download a print-ready PNG. It is built for sticker makers and Etsy/POD sellers who need white outlines, sticker bleed, or die-cut margins, and it also works as a general image outline generator. Free with no signup: 10 generations per IP per day.

name: becom
tagline: See how many people are showing up, and where you rank today
description: becom is a habit tracker with LIVE and daily rankings. LIVE shows how many people have opened LIVE recently, and the top countries they're in. Then see where you rank today. Free to download on Google Play in the US and Australia, with in-app purchases.

name: TOCA
tagline: AI workers for e-commerce that analyze, monitor and act with your approval
description:
TOCA is a Brazilian agentic management platform for retail and e-commerce. Its AI workers connect your online store, marketplaces, ads, analytics and ERP data, then deliver analyses, alerts or ready-to-approve actions.

What TOCA's agents do:
- Analyze data: cross-channel metrics such as CAC, LTV, real ROAS and best-performing channels, without spreadsheets.
- Monitor competition: track competitor prices and Buy Box on marketplaces like Mercado Livre.
- Optimize ads: watch Google, Meta, TikTok and Pinterest campaigns and flag spend that doesn't convert, e.g. pausing ads for out-of-stock products.
- Create campaigns: turn sales history into campaigns and posts ready for approval.
- Support customers: answer marketplace questions on Mercado Livre, Shopee, Magalu and Amazon based on catalog and stock.
- Catalog and stock care: find rejected products, price mismatches and zero stock before they cost sales.

Built for control: nothing changes without human approval, encrypted access keys, real-time monitoring and a full audit log of what each agent read, changed and who approved it. Teams can also talk to TOCA and receive alerts via WhatsApp.

Integrations (50+): Shopify, VTEX, Nuvemshop, Tray, WooCommerce, Mercado Livre, Shopee, Amazon, Magalu, TikTok Shop, SHEIN, Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Merchant Center, Bling, Olist Tiny, Omie, TOTVS Protheus, SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Oracle NetSuite, RD Station, Salesforce and more.

Pricing: one plan with all features and unlimited users; price scales with monthly agent credits. 7-day free trial with 500 credits, no credit card required.

Recognition: Best AI Usability – ABIACOM 2026; Startup Showcase – Web Summit Rio 2026.

name: HUALI
tagline: Chinese art for meaningful spaces.
description: HUALI connects Chinese painting with contemporary life through artwork stories, historical context and personal interpretations. Explore the collection, browse by theme and save works that speak to you. Selected digital editions are available to purchase; other editions by enquiry. Founded 2026 in Los Angeles, USA. This is a Chinese art website and digital art editions store, not an AI chatbot.

name: Taoli AI
tagline: Warm end-of-term comment generator for Chinese teachers
description: Taoli AI helps Chinese primary and secondary teachers: import student lists from Excel, pick personality/learning/discipline tags, and generate warm, rigorous, or literary personalized end-of-term comments to cut repetitive writing.

name: Creator YouTube Starter
tagline: YouTube starter guide for Chinese creators
description: A Chinese-language YouTube starter knowledge base: account setup, policy boundaries, monetization paths, and common pitfalls, with official-source preference and ongoing updates. Educational content site.

name: Geo China
tagline: Spatiotemporal geography of China on a 3D globe
description: Geo China (地理中国) overlays historical administrative geography and cultural notes on a 3D globe timeline. Educational / cultural product for Chinese-language readers — not a professional surveying suite.

name: Taste China
tagline: Encyclopedia of Chinese GI ingredients and specialty foods
description: Taste China (味探中国) catalogs Chinese geographical indication (GI) foods and ingredients. Entries combine official registry data, reference books, and nutrition tables with buying tips and cooking pairings. Content encyclopedia — not a storefront.

name: Income Claim Check
tagline: Real indie income claims, with proof
description: Income Claim Check reviews public 'I made $X' posts from indie hackers and creators. We try to verify payment trails or mark claims as unverified/debunked, and we link primary sources. Built for readers who want receipts, not hype.

name: China Travel Check
tagline: Verified field manual for independent China travel
description: English guides for independent China travel: payments, network/eSIM, visas (incl. 240-hour transit), 12306 trains, essential apps. Each page shows a last-verified date. Tools: visa-free checker, itinerary planner, packing checklist. We don't sell tours.

name: GIS Toolbox
tagline: Free GIS tools that run in your browser
description: Convert coordinates between WGS84, UTM, 100+ EPSG codes and China's GCJ-02/BD-09/CGCS2000, convert Shapefile, GeoJSON, KML and CSV, measure on a map. Files stay on your device.

name: ImgFlow
tagline: Compress and convert images locally – nothing gets uploaded
description: Compress PNG/JPG, convert HEIC to JPG, convert images to WebP or AVIF, resize, and compress to a target size such as 100KB. Runs in the browser with WebAssembly; there is no upload step. No sign-up, no watermark, no file count limit.

name: MaxH3
tagline: Free-to-start AI video workspace for MiniMax H3 with native sound
description: MaxH3 runs MiniMax H3 (Hailuo 3.0) for text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video. Combine multimodal references, generate 4–15s clips at 768P or 2K with stereo audio. Free credits at signup; paid plans remove watermark and add commercial use.

name: Grok Imagine
tagline: Free Grok Imagine AI image and video generator
description: Grok Imagine on imaginegrok.org is a free AI image and video generator: text or image to short clips with Normal, Fun, or Spicy modes — no X account or SuperGrok required.

name: VoraVid
tagline: Free AI Video Generator | Seedance 2.5 & Wan 3.0
description: VoraVid is an AI video studio for creators and marketers. Text-to-video and image-to-video with Seedance 2.5 and Wan 3.0. Multimodal inputs, up to 30s 1080p. One-time credit packs from $19.90 with commercial use on paid credits. Try free at voravid.com.

name: SynthPulse
tagline: Make songs, images, and videos in one creative studio.
description: SynthPulse is an all-in-one AI-powered creation platform that turns text prompts into original music, images, and video from one place. Creators can generate songs, artwork, short clips, and guided short films using one account and one shared credit balance.

name: PDFWrangle
tagline: Free PDF tools in your browser: no limits, no sign-up
description: Compress, merge, split, unlock, sign and convert images to PDF in your browser. Free, no sign-up, no usage limits, and your files are never uploaded.

name: InkOut PDF
tagline: Redact PDFs in your browser, then check the output
description: Redact PDFs in your browser. Covered text is deleted, not hidden, and every export is re-opened and scanned for it. Free up to 5 pages, never uploaded.

name: Avie
tagline: AI receptionist on WhatsApp for clinics in Brazil, with scheduling, CRM and human handoff.
description:
Avie is an AI receptionist for clinics and medical practices in Brazil. It answers patients in Brazilian Portuguese on the clinic's existing WhatsApp number, explains consultations and fees using the clinic's information, and books, reschedules or cancels appointments in Google Calendar or Feegow. Clinical questions, symptoms and urgent matters are handed to the clinic's team; Avie does not diagnose or give medical advice.

Avie Atende brings the AI receptionist, 13 messaging programs, appointment reminders and confirmations, a waiting list, a conversation portal/CRM, a clinic website with online booking, and monthly reporting together. Staff can review conversations and take over when needed. The Avie team configures the service around each clinic's rules and workflow.

Avie Cuida adds the electronic medical record, Avie Notes for visit transcription and draft notes for clinician review, digital prescriptions through Memed, service invoices and patient payments. Avie Cresce adds managed Google Ads and Google Business Profile services. Advertising spend is separate.

Pricing is in Brazilian reais: Avie Atende costs R$ 1,350 per month for up to 1,000 patients per month, plus a one-time R$ 2,700 setup fee, with no per-message charge or minimum term. Avie Cuida and Avie Cresce are quoted individually. See https://avie.me/precos for current pricing and https://avie.me/en for an English product overview.

Avie is operated by AVIE TECNOLOGIA LTDA in Santo Andre, Sao Paulo, Brazil. Founded in 2026, it is a technology company, not a medical service or telemedicine provider.

name: LawAsked
tagline: Legal questions answered, with the statute behind each one.
description: LawAsked answers real legal questions in plain language for 12 countries, and every answer cites and links the official statute sections it relies on.

name: Kleenest
tagline: Find restroom options nearby and share community updates.
description: Kleenest helps people find restroom options nearby. Browse as a guest, review available location details, and share community updates; a free account can save places and routes. Listing details may change, so confirm current access before relying on them.

name: Margin
tagline: Compare design screenshots, pin feedback, and export PNG review sheets.
description: Compare design screenshots, pin feedback, and export PNG review sheets. Images stay in your browser. Free during the initial launch.

name: MemeRemake
tagline: Star in a trending meme: one selfie becomes an 8-second AI video
description: MemeRemake is a web app that turns a single photo of an adult user into a short AI-generated meme or dance video. Pick a trending meme template (solo, duo with a consenting friend, or seasonal Halloween looks), upload a clear photo, and review a free watermarked preview still before spending credits. Each finished clip is an 8-second vertical 720p MP4, plus a silent copy for your own audio, a cover image and three caption ideas. All outputs are labeled as AI-generated. Pricing is one-time credit packs from $4.99, with no subscription.

name: PetAIVideo
tagline: Turn one dog or cat photo into a 10-second AI pet video
description: PetAIVideo is a browser-based AI pet video generator. Upload a single JPG, PNG or WebP photo of your dog or cat, choose a ready-made scene (lighthearted trend clips, a fridge cake heist, an angel-or-devil look, or quiet memorial tributes) and look at a free watermarked preview before spending credits. Finished clips are 10-second vertical 9:16 MP4 files. Pricing is one-time credit packs from $5.99 with no subscription. Every output is labelled AI-generated, and memorial scenes are imagined tributes, not real recordings.

name: AITrendFilter
tagline: Trending AI photo filters in one tap - no editor apps, no prompts
description: AITrendFilter packages viral AI photo trends into a simple upload flow. Couple Back Tattoo creates three AI-generated images of one partner's face as a back tattoo (purely an AI image, not a real tattoo; adults only, with consent). Symmetry Filter mirrors a straight-on selfie into left and right twins plus a 5-second switch video, just for fun with no scores. Start with a free watermarked preview; HD sets use one-time credits from $2.99.

name: LiveFaceSwapVideo
tagline: Real-time AI face swap from your webcam — in the browser, no GPU.
description: LiveFaceSwapVideo turns your webcam into a real-time AI face swap. Pick a reference portrait, turn on your camera, and the cloud AI rewrites every frame as you move — with Live Face Swap, Try-On (change outfits) and Restyle (anime or illustration looks). Try it free in the browser with 100 signup credits, or use the Windows desktop app's virtual camera to bring the live output into OBS, Zoom, Google Meet, Teams and Discord.

name: DigicamFilter
tagline: Y2K digicam and vintage camera filters for photos you already have, no app to install
description: DigicamFilter re-renders an existing photo with AI so it looks like it came from an early-2000s compact camera or a cheap film snapshot. Pick one of ten generic styles (Y2K compact, CCD night flash, disposable camera, date stamp, photobooth strip, instant film frame, black-and-white film and more) and download a labeled result, a 1080x1350 carousel, or a before/after. It runs in the browser and is not a phone camera app. Free watermarked preview; one-time credit packs for full-size results.

name: Trending AI Video Studio
tagline: Trending AI Video Studio | Create Videos from Ideas
description: Create trend-inspired AI videos from text or images. Compare video models, refine each scene, and turn a prompt into a short-form concept ready to generate.

name: Meme Video Maker
tagline: Meme Video Maker: Create Short AI Videos from Photos
description: Make AI meme videos from a photo, prompt, or trend template. Review scene requirements, model settings, and the credit estimate before creating a clip.

name: AnyFyle
tagline: ~140 free file tools — PDF, images, OCR, video, audio, archives, QR. Files never leave your device.
description:
AnyFyle is a free suite of about 140 browser-based file tools. PDF: merge, split, compress, convert, edit, sign, protect. Images: resize, crop, compress, convert, watermark, metadata removal. Video & audio: convert, trim, compress. OCR from images and scans with Arabic support. Archives: create and extract ZIP. Plus QR/barcode generation and file utilities.

Privacy first: everything runs locally in the browser — no uploads, no account, no watermark, no usage caps, free forever. English and Arabic (RTL) interfaces.

name: ContentPin Studio
tagline: Illustrated articles and Pinterest-ready Pin designs in one workspace
description: ContentPin Studio helps bloggers turn niche topics into illustrated article drafts, send reviewed drafts to self-hosted WordPress, and create downloadable Pinterest-ready Pin designs. The hosted workspace keeps the article and destination link together. Direct Pinterest publishing currently has an account-permission limitation. New users can try two illustrated articles and five template Pin credits without a card.

name: CountMyDays
tagline: Free countdowns & "days since" trackers. No ads.
description: Count down to weddings, birthdays, trips or exams, or count days since any moment. Free, no ads, no sign-up, with progress bars, share links and offline use (installable web app). Built by a solo developer in Iceland.

name: Bulin47VideoAI
tagline: Turn Your Photo into a Bulin 47 AI Freestyle Video for TikTok
description: Bulin47VideoAI turns a single clear photo into a 15-second vertical freestyle video with the original soundtrack. Upload, pick a 1/3/5 pack from $9, and download an MP4 for TikTok, Reels, or Shorts—no prompts or editing skills needed. Independent tool; not affiliated with Bulin 47.

name: Kariyan
tagline: Job matching and tailored application drafts for Germany
description: Kariyan helps job seekers in Germany find relevant roles and prepare tailored CVs and cover letters from a saved candidate profile. It explains job matches and keeps candidates in control of reviewing drafts and approving applications in the standard flow. The web app supports English and German, with a free tier and optional paid plans.

name: JustSubmit
tagline: Form handling for the websites you build
description: JustSubmit is a form backend for developers and freelancers building enquiry and quote forms for service-business websites. Keep your own HTML forms and design while receiving email notifications and reviewing submissions and uploaded files in a customer portal. It supports custom fields, optional acknowledgement emails, your own thank-you page and configurable retention for submissions and attachments. Contact lists are retained separately. Paid plans are available; no free plan or trial is advertised.

name: Soonfind
tagline: Find business opportunities before everyone else.
description: Soonfind monitors public activity such as permits and business records, filters new data to your criteria, and delivers relevant opportunity signals automatically. It is designed for businesses that want to discover projects, activity and sales opportunities earlier without manually checking multiple public sources.

name: SubRedds
tagline: Explore the largest subreddits and view them as galleries
description:
SubRedds is a map of Reddit. It keeps track of more than 100.000 subreddits, SFW and NSFW, and shows for each one how many members it has, how many posts a day it gets, how old it is and when it was last checked. The list can be searched, filtered by size, activity and content rating, and sorted by any column, so finding the biggest, busiest or newest communities on any topic takes seconds.

Every subreddit opens as a gallery of all its pictures and videos, newest first, loading as you scroll, all the way back through the public Reddit archives. Any Reddit profile can be browsed the same way, across every subreddit the person has posted in. Switches for pictures, videos, media posts only, duplicates and deleted posts, and a layout of one to eight columns with your choice of thumbnail ratio, make the gallery yours.

Browsing needs no account. A free account adds a sidebar of saved subreddits and users, sorted into sections you name, and a heart that keeps any post.

name: WingIt
tagline: Wingit AI assistant for canvas
description: Connects to your school canvas account ,organizes your assignments, sets up notifications, tells you how to do an assignment with AI assistant

name: SecuriLayer
tagline: Threat analysis, security decisions and linked evidence
description: SecuriLayer is a security platform that connects threat analysis, structured security decisions and supporting evidence. It helps teams investigate URL and content risks and review security findings in application and AI-agent workflows. Product interfaces include a web application and API. Free and paid plans are offered; external API usage and credits are separate.

name: Facilory
tagline: Free work orders for small teams. No card required.
description: Facilory helps small businesses and facilities teams manage repair requests, work orders, equipment, and recurring maintenance in one workspace. Free Forever includes unlimited basic work orders, one building, up to three team members, 25 equipment records, and two recurring maintenance schedules, with no credit card required. The optional Business plan costs $49/month per company and adds unlimited buildings, people and equipment, inspections, custom checklists, inventory, purchasing, time and cost tracking, and advanced reports. Use Facilory from desktop and mobile browsers, with free maintenance calculators and supply-planning resources on the website.

name: ServerDesk
tagline: Welcomes new members, answers repeat questions with /faq, and routes real ones to staff with /ask. Built for paid courses and cohorts.
description:
ServerDesk is a Discord support bot for paid course and cohort communities. It handles the repetitive parts so your staff have more room for people.

- Warm welcomes: greets new members in the channel you choose, in your words and your tone.
- /faq: answers members from your own FAQ. Send us your questions and answers and we load them for you, usually the same day.
- /ask: routes real questions to a private thread or staff channel. No mass DMs.
- /setup: connect your welcome channel, staff channel and staff role in under a minute.

Add ServerDesk with the invite link (no payment up front), run /setup, and email your FAQ and server ID to serverdesk.godinrules@gmail.com. 7-day free trial, then $19/mo per server. Cancel anytime; full refund within 7 days of your first payment. Hosted and kept running for you.
Support: https://discord.gg/J2VJwsP5QP
Built and supported by Carol, Godin Deploys.

name: PokerChip.live
tagline: Free digital poker chips & score keeper for home games
description: Replace physical poker chips with digital ones. Create a room, share the code or QR, and track bets, pots and stacks in real time on every phone.

name: AceFEExam
tagline: Free full-length FE Civil practice exam, real timing
description: Sit a free, full-length FE Civil mock: 110 questions, 5h20m, real Pearson VUE-style interface, pacing report and worked solutions. Free diagnostic, no signup.

name: Tinh GPA
tagline: Free GPA calculator: convert 10-point grades to 4.0
description: Free Vietnamese GPA calculator. Convert 10-point scores to the 4.0 scale under Circular 08/2021 and verified university rules. No login needed.

name: Hiintly
tagline: Real-time AI interview copilot for job candidates
description: Hiintly is an AI interview copilot for job candidates. It transcribes interview audio in real time and offers answer guidance informed by an uploaded resume, with support for coding questions. Hiintly is available on the web and as desktop apps for Mac and Windows, and its site describes pay-as-you-go credit pricing.

name: I Hate Watermarks
tagline: Strip invisible characters from AI-generated text
description:
I Hate Watermarks is an open-source AI watermark remover that reveals and strips invisible characters from text produced by ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other tools. Paste your text to see every hidden character highlighted in place with its name and code point, then copy or download a clean version.

It removes zero-width spaces and joiners, byte-order marks, soft hyphens, direction overrides, variation selectors, Unicode tag characters and exotic spaces, while keeping invisible characters your text needs, such as emoji joiners and RTL marks. Optional settings normalize lookalike spaces and letters or apply NFKC normalization.

Everything runs in your browser, so your text never leaves the page. It is upfront that it can't remove statistical watermarks like SynthID-Text. An agent skill brings the same engine to Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents, and the MIT-licensed TypeScript library has no dependencies.

name: Shop vs Shop
tagline: Find out why rival shops show up above you on Google Maps
description:
Shop vs Shop is for local business owners who wonder why other shops show up first on Google Maps and theirs doesn't.

Type in your business and get a free check: the 3 biggest gaps on your Google listing, like missing photos, wrong or missing hours, or reviews with no reply. No login needed.

If you want more, the competitor report ($195) puts your listing side by side with the 3 shops Google shows first in your area. It gives you a short list of what to fix this week and what can wait. If the report doesn't find at least 3 specific fixes, you get your money back.

After the report, you can have us rebuild the listing for you ($397). You keep full control of your Google account.

What we don't do: we don't promise rankings, and we never write fake reviews.

Made by Godin Deploys.

Who it's for: owners and managers of small local businesses (shops, nurseries, marinas, contractors, home services).
Category: Local SEO / Google Business Profile tools. Pricing: Freemium (free check; $195 report; $397 rebuild).

name: Phone Clover
tagline: Telnyx calling and texting inside HighLevel
description: Phone Clover is a private early-access HighLevel app for teams that use their own Telnyx account. It provides browser calling on approved installs, hosted SMS, call outcomes, number-health tools, and plain-English failed-text reasons. Workflow and bulk texting are not yet ready.

name: Nail the Call
tagline: AI receptionist for contractors across multiple trades
description: Nail the Call answers contractor calls, asks about the job, location, scope and timing, books site visits, and sends a call summary to the shop. The business sets its service area, calendar and approved price ranges.

name: Dial 72
tagline: AI receptionist built for HVAC contractors
description: Dial 72 answers HVAC calls around the clock, asks about heating or cooling problems, flags urgent requests, books service appointments, and sends the job details to the team. Contractors can keep their existing phone number.

name: Still Bureau
tagline: Websites, client galleries, proofing, and studio tools for working photographers.
description: Still Bureau connects a photography website, client galleries, proofing, download controls, and studio tools. New accounts start with a 14-day no-card trial of currently available Studio features, then can continue on Free with a website, unlimited galleries and visitors, proofing, configured photo downloads, and 5 GB of total photo storage.

name: Find A Doctor Canada
tagline: Free Canadian primary-care navigation
description: Find A Doctor Canada is a free, independent website that helps people explore reported family-doctor and clinic information, review contact and intake details, and find official provincial primary-care pathways.

name: Rule Audit
tagline: Audit your trading rules against real market data before you risk money.
description:
Traders shouldn't need to be expert programmers or spend hours navigating complex tools just to find out whether their strategy has potential. They need a straightforward way to define their rules, test them against historical market data, and understand where their strategies succeed or fail.

Rule Audit brings that process together in one place, from visual strategy building to backtesting and plain-English evaluation.

name: Sharpen Fit: AI Gym Coach
tagline: Your AI coach for the gym you actually have
description: Sharpen Fit is an AI personal trainer for the gym you actually have. Scan or add the equipment you have, and it builds a workout with sets, reps, weights, rest and 3D form demos for each move. Pick a goal, like building muscle, getting stronger, running a 5K, 10K or half, or hybrid training, and it lays out a multi-week plan that progresses week to week and schedules onto your calendar. As you train, it tracks your personal records and estimated 1RMs, with progress charts and a weekly muscle map. Nutrition tools include macro targets and food logging by text or photo, with estimated macros. You can add friends by username and cheer each other's workouts and PRs. It starts with a 7-day free trial, then a paid membership. Sharpen Fit is not medical advice, so check with a professional before starting a new program.

name: Home Metric Tools
tagline: Free home project calculators, starting with concrete
description: Home Metric Tools offers free calculators that turn measurements into material quantities and budgets for home improvement and construction projects. The first tool is a concrete cost calculator: enter the length, width and thickness of a slab, choose imperial or metric units, add a waste allowance, and see the volume in cubic yards along with an estimated cost. You can also include delivery, short-load and labor charges to compare a full budget. The price field starts from a sourced reference range and is clearly labeled as illustrative, so you can replace it with a quote from your local supplier. A companion concrete guide explains how volume is measured, what drives the price and what to ask a ready-mix supplier before ordering. No sign-up is required.

name: Grand Line Intel
tagline: ONE PIECE TCG stock, preorder and price tracking with linked Discord feeds.
description: Grand Line Intel is an independent ONE PIECE TCG tracking website with website-linked Discord feeds. It organizes recorded stock and preorder status, retailer prices, MSRP references, timestamps and retailer links so collectors can inspect an update before checking the retailer. Product watches and collector tools help members follow the products they care about. Website signup and Discord account linking are required to unlock eligible feeds. Free-account and paid membership access are available; see the current plans on the website. Availability and checkout totals can change at the retailer. Independent fan project, not affiliated with Bandai or retailers.

name: Dompofoto
tagline: AI home redesign from one photo, from 149 ₽
description: Dompofoto turns one photo into a renovation preview for rooms, kitchens, bedrooms, house facades and yards, keeping windows, walls and layout. Describe the task in your own words, set a budget, or choose a no-renovation option (textiles, lighting, furniture only). 149 ₽: one variant and one edit. 490 ₽: three styles, each with a shopping list linking to similar products on Wildberries, Ozon and Yandex Market and an approximate estimate of purchases and labour, up to 6 edits. One-time payment, no subscription. Paid, from 149 ₽. AI visualization to help decide, not a technical design project. Interface in Russian.

name: SEOnautik
tagline: AI visibility and SEO checks for German-speaking businesses
description: SEOnautik helps businesses and agencies in Germany, Austria and Switzerland check whether AI systems mention them. Paid reports query ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini through official APIs with web search, combine the findings with technical website checks and provide prioritized actions as a web report and PDF. A free quick check works without an account. One-time reports start at €29 for SEO or €59 including AI visibility measurements. Website and reports are in German.

name: StreamFix

description: A floating today layer for notes, to-dos and reminders on Mac. Pin above every app including fullscreen (Pro), fade opacity when unfocused, save plain Markdown locally. Free + one-time Pro. No account required. macOS 13+.

name: ReSkate Guide
tagline: Independent ReSkate guides and source-backed troubleshooting
description: A free, independent guide and interactive troubleshooting assistant for players setting up ReSkate for skate. Browse official-source downloads and guidance on installation, mods, offline play, private multiplayer, dedicated servers and Steam Deck or Proton. The symptom-based assistant links to documented checks; it does not scan your PC or diagnose it. This website is separate from the ReSkate developers, Electronic Arts and Full Circle.

name: Birthstone Meaning
tagline: Free birthstone finder and guide by birthday, month and zodiac sign.
description: Birthstone Meaning lets you enter a birthday or zodiac sign to compare your modern birthstone with its older zodiac association, plus a birthstone chart, compatibility calculator, crystal quiz and free tarot. No signup. Metaphysical meanings are labeled as traditional belief, not science or medical advice.

name: Crazy Frog AI Video Generator
tagline: Turn one photo into a Crazy Frog–style invisible motorcycle chase
description: Crazy Frog AI Video Generator is an independent photo-to-video meme studio. Upload one clear rider photo; Seedance builds a comedic invisible-motorcycle chase with a fictional helmeted officer. Choose coastal escape, neon city, or desert run; output about 15 seconds with original energetic instrumental audio at 480p or 720p (9:16 or 16:9). Generation uses credit packs — no subscription and no free video generation. Browser-based. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Crazy Frog or its rights holders.

name: Snap API
tagline: Website screenshots, PDFs and WebP in one API call. 200 free a month.
description: Snap is a simple screenshot API for developers and no-code builders. Send a URL and get back a PNG, WebP or PDF capture in one call, with X-API-Key or Bearer auth, a short free cache, and ad/cookie-banner-free captures. The free plan includes 200 screenshots a month; paid plans are Starter at $9 for 10,000 a month and Growth at $29 for 30,000 a month, plus non-expiring top-up tokens. Works great from n8n, Make, Zapier or any HTTP client for OG images, visual archives, monitoring and URL-to-PDF.

name: Ideoy
tagline: AI meme / viral video templates from one photo
description: Ideoy turns one photo or selfie into remakes of trending short-form meme and viral video templates. Creators pick a viral template, upload a face, and get a ready-to-post remake.

name: Free PDF Editor
tagline: Highlight PDF text free — no signup, no watermark
description: Free PDF Editor is a browser-based PDF highlighter and editor. Upload a PDF, highlight or underline the text you need, and download a clean file — free, with no signup and no watermark. Highlighting runs locally in your browser by default, so your document stays on your device. It works on desktop and mobile, including scanned PDFs, and accepts PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, CSV, JPG, PNG, GIF and WebP files.

name: CleanStatement
tagline: Convert PDF bank statements to Excel, CSV and QBO
description: CleanStatement converts text-based PDF bank and credit card statements into Excel, CSV, QBO and Xero CSV files for bookkeeping and accounting. Try it free: 3 pages a day with no signup. When you need more, $9 buys 100 pages that never expire, or choose Pro ($15/month, 500 pages) or Business ($30/month, 2,000 pages). Upload up to 24 PDFs in one batch. Every conversion is checked against the opening and closing balances printed on the statement, so you can see whether the result reconciles. Uploaded files are deleted within 1 hour. Extraction is rule-based, not AI. Works with text-based PDFs, not scans.

name: Planist.ai
tagline: AI content operating system for brands, marketers, and agencies worldwide.
description: Planist.ai is an AI content operating system for brands, marketers, and agencies worldwide. It scans a brand website or online store to build a reusable Brand Brain, plans monthly social content calendars, and creates on-brand captions, designs, and reel scripts; teams can share a WhatsApp link for client review, with publishing to connected channels included on paid plans. Every plan includes a 14-day free trial that requires a card; Planist does not list a permanent free tier.

name: Foilchart
tagline: Free price tracker for Pokémon and Lorcana cards
description: Foilchart is a free, independent price tracker for Pokémon and Lorcana trading cards. It follows daily prices for about 27,600 Pokémon cards and 3,500 Lorcana cards, with price history for every card, a portfolio to follow what your collection is worth, a binder per set that shows your cost to complete, wishlists and email price alerts. Prices are for raw Near Mint singles, shown in USD with a euro option. No paid tier.

name: C Dance ai
tagline: Independent Seedance 2.0 multimodal video generator.
description: C Dance ai is a separate site for short AI video. Jobs can start from text, a still, audio, or a video clip, and example prompts can be sent into the generator. Plan prices are listed publicly.

name: C Dance AI
tagline: Seedance 2.0 AI video generator for text, image, audio, and video references.
description: C Dance AI turns a prompt, a still photo, audio, or a reference clip into a short video. Seedance 2.0 is the main model, and the site also lists other video models such as Kling, Wan, and Veo. A free path and paid plans are shown on the pricing page.

name: Mou-mong
tagline: Explore 296 Hong Kong temple fortune sticks, with source notes.
description: Mou-mong is an independent cultural project from Hong Kong. It brings together 100 Man Mo Temple / Guan Di fortune sticks, 100 Wong Tai Sin fortune sticks and 96 Che Kung fortune sticks in a free web tool. Draw a stick, look up a number, or read the available verses and source notes. The interface supports Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English, Thai, Korean and Japanese; articles and source documentation are mainly in Traditional Chinese. No name, birthday or private question is required. Contemporary interpretations are AI-assisted and have not been reviewed by the temples or independent experts. This is cultural reference and self-reflection, not an official temple service or a prediction guarantee.

name: Dugout
tagline: One workspace for your team and AI agents.
description:
Dugout is a collaborative workspace where your team and AI agents work together. It combines team chat, voice and video huddles, project boards, documents, spreadsheets, slides, and shared files, keeping conversations and the work they produce connected.

Delegate research, content, coding, and recurring tasks to agents that work with your team’s context. Turn requests into board tasks, schedule routine work, and follow progress through live sessions where you can give feedback or take over when needed.

Use Dugout’s agents or connect your own supported agents, with people and AI sharing the same workspace. From a quick team discussion to a project with multiple steps, Dugout helps you plan, create, review, and deliver work in one place.

name: Nezaton
tagline: AI-powered business automation that responds to customers 24/7, captures leads, books appointments, supports orders, and hands conversations over to human agent
description: Nezaton helps businesses automate customer conversations across website, Instagram, WhatsApp, and email. Its AI responds to customer enquiries 24/7, captures leads, books appointments, supports order placement, and hands conversations over to a human when needed. Businesses can also add product images and videos to help answer customer questions with relevant information.

name: Bulin 47 AI Video Generator
tagline: Turn your photo into a Bulin 47–style street freestyle video
description: Bulin 47 AI Video Generator is an independent photo-to-video remix studio. Upload one clear portrait; Seedance 2.5 replaces the lead performer while keeping the street and crowd reference. Output is a silent ~15-second 480p clip — add your own music in TikTok or CapCut. Free to preview photos and guides; generation uses credit packs. Not affiliated with Bulin 47, Kevin Wai, or any label.

name: OutbidMap
tagline: Public world map where products claim a UN country and rank by bid
description: OutbidMap is a public world map of 193 UN member states. Claim an open country free, or outbid from $1 to climb the board. No accounts, no ads — rank is paid amount only. A listing is not a real-world title or legal right.

name: Tideris
tagline: AI Chinese astrology with a free BaZi chart
description: Tideris is an AI-powered Chinese astrology platform. Get a free BaZi (Four Pillars) chart explained in plain English, plus a daily fortune, Liu Yao and Qi Men readings and relationship compatibility. Built for curious beginners and fans of Chinese astrology.

name: PagekeepKit
tagline: Free browser-local PDF tool to extract pages, split, reorder, and download
description: Free browser-local PDF tool to extract pages, split, reorder, and download. Works in the browser; 10MB / 500-page limits. No OCR. Rejects encrypted, form, and signed PDFs. No cloud upload/storage. Not an AI product.

name: FYN
tagline: AI receipt scanner and budget app. A Monarch Money alternative with a free plan.
description: FYN is a personal finance app built around receipts and budgets. Snap a photo or forward an emailed receipt and FYN pulls out line items, prices, and return windows, then creates the transaction for you. Follow a budget built from what you actually spend, ask FYN questions about your money, and search every receipt in plain English. The free plan includes 20 receipts a month. Pro ($9.99/mo) adds bank sync via Plaid and matches receipts to bank charges. A simpler alternative to Monarch Money, Copilot Money, and Rocket Money. Works with Claude and ChatGPT through a read-only connector.

name: In-Tab Tools
tagline: Free in-browser file and text tools. No uploads, no account, no AI.
description: In-Tab Tools compresses images and PDFs to an exact file size, converts PDF to Markdown, strips image/PDF metadata and styles text — all inside your browser tab, so files never leave your device. Free, no sign-up.

name: StreamMako
tagline: Download Video from Link — free online video downloader
description: StreamMako is a free online video downloader. Paste a public page link to find available video, audio, and image download options in your browser. No account required. Built for creators and anyone who needs to save media from public pages quickly.

name: Image Aspect Ratio
tagline: Find your image aspect ratio. Calculate the dimensions you need.
description:
Image Aspect Ratio helps you find a photo's proportions and calculate the dimensions you need. Select a local image or enter its width and height to find its aspect ratio. Choose a ratio such as 1:1, 4:5 or 16:9, then calculate a matching width or height for your layout.

Preview how your image fits square, portrait and widescreen frames. Compare padding with centered cropping before making changes in your image editor. Selected images are read locally in your browser, and exact calculation values are distinguished from rounded pixel results.

The calculator is free to use, with no account required. It returns dimensions and previews, not edited image files. Separate tools also cover video dimensions and ultrawide screen ratios. Source code is available under the MIT license.

name: PinPilot
tagline: AI Pinterest scheduler that turns your site into a month of Pins
description: PinPilot scans your website, generates Pins with AI titles and vertical images, matches boards and posting times, and schedules up to 30 days in one workflow. Free forever at 3 Pins/day; paid plans from about $15/mo. No credit card to start.

name: Bright Sheets Studio Free Tools
tagline: Free browser tools for freelancers — EU invoice + VAT exemption check
description: Free browser tools for freelancers on brightsheetsstudio.com/tools/ — EU invoice maker (EN/NL/DE/FR) and small-business VAT exemption check (NL KOR, DE §19, FR franchise en base). No account; nothing leaves your device. From Bright Sheets Studio.

name: Image2Image AI
tagline: Edit reference photos with AI and text prompts
description: Image2Image AI is a browser-based image editor for changing a reference photo with a text prompt. Use it for background changes, lighting adjustments, illustrated portraits and product scenes. Compare examples and prompts for free; generating images requires an account and purchased credits. Review faces, text, logos and product details before using a result.

name: MathSprig
tagline: Create customizable printable math worksheets
description: Choose a math skill, adjust question ranges and page settings, and print practice worksheets with answer keys. Free browser tools for teachers, parents and learners; no account is required.

name: WordShapeLab
tagline: Create shaped word clouds in your browser
description: Turn words and phrases into shaped word-cloud layouts. Adjust word weights and preview a custom visual composition with free browser tools, without creating an account.

name: ColorPairLab
tagline: Check text contrast and build color palettes
description: Check text contrast, convert color values and build palettes in the browser. Free tools for designers and developers; no account is required.

name: Bobbin
tagline: Record your screen and webcam in Chrome and keep the MP4 on your computer. No account, no watermark, no time limit.
description:
Bobbin is a free screen and webcam recorder for Chrome. Record your whole screen, one window or a single tab with your microphone and the tab's sound (whole-screen system audio on Windows and ChromeOS). A round webcam bubble floats above your windows, so your face appears in screen and window recordings. There is also a camera-only mode.

Recordings are saved on your computer, not uploaded anywhere: an MP4 where your browser supports it (WebM otherwise), up to 1080p at 30 fps. There's no account, no watermark, no time limit and no limit on the number of videos. Bobbin writes to disk every second, so a crash doesn't lose your take. It has no analytics or trackers and asks only for storage, unlimitedStorage and alarms permissions.

Good for tutorials, lessons, bug reports, product demos and recording a Meet or Zoom call you're in (with everyone's agreement). It doesn't edit videos, host share links or make transcripts: it gives you the file.

Optional Pro adds 1440p/4K and 60 fps where supported, bubble styling, an auto-stop timer and custom file names: $4.99/month or $24 lifetime for the first 100 buyers (then $39 / $5.99), with a 7-day refund.

name: Vmake Labs
tagline: AI video creation and editing for creators and businesses
description: Vmake Labs is an AI video creation and editing platform for creators and businesses. Its tools include video enhancement, watermark removal and automatic captions to help prepare content for social media and marketing.

name: Klaizon
tagline: Free AI chat that cites sources and makes real files
description: Klaizon is a free AI assistant with no account required. Use it for web research with linked sources, creating and editing PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, analyzing spreadsheets, and running Python. Chat history stays in your browser.

name: STUDIO CHERIE
tagline: Styling shop and iPhone wardrobe app for adults
description: STUDIO CHERIE is a fashion shop and styling consultancy for adults, with a free iPhone app: register your clothes, shoes and accessories with photos, get outfit suggestions from your own wardrobe, save inspiration looks, and preview how a new item mixes before buying.

name: Quildra
tagline: Duelist: Idle Expedition wiki & guides
description: Practical wiki and guides for Duelist: Idle Expedition — classes, equipment, camp, map milestones, patch notes.

name: Anicca - Daily Affirmations
tagline: iPhone affirmation app whose AI learns which kind lines help
description: Anicca is an iPhone affirmation app that sends one line of kindness when your mind starts to spiral; its AI learns which lines help and when. 13 self-care themes, no streaks. Free download with optional in-app purchase. A self-care app, not medical advice.

name: Apri File P7M
tagline: Open P7M files online for free — in your browser, nothing uploaded
description: Free online P7M viewer for Italian digitally signed documents. Open PDF.P7M and FatturaPA XML.P7M e-invoices, read pages, check signature info, and extract or convert P7M to PDF. Everything runs locally in the browser — files are never uploaded. No signup, no install; works on Windows, Mac, iPhone and Android.

name: Risenote – AI Meeting Notes
tagline: On-device AI meeting notes for iPhone — no Zoom bot
description: Risenote turns your in-person and phone meetings into clear action items with on-device AI. Built for coaches, facilitators, and consultants who want private notes without a cloud meeting bot. Available on the App Store.

name: Dime Dime Baby AI Generator
tagline: Turn your photo into a Dime Dime Baby party meme video
description: Dime Dime Baby AI Generator turns one portrait (or two for a duet) into a party-inspired photo-to-video meme. Pick a version — classic party, friends dancing, garden party or character remix — and generate a 9-second 480p clip with AI-generated instrumental and party ambience. No app needed; photos stay local until you generate. Paid credit packs from $6.90. Independent tool, not affiliated with the original creators.

name: One Workflow Fixed
tagline: Browser tools for checking n8n outputs, duplicates and retry costs
description: One Workflow Fixed provides free browser-based tools for checking structured n8n and AI-workflow outputs, spotting duplicate webhook payloads, and estimating retry costs. The tools apply deterministic checks; they do not run an AI model, connect to a live workflow, or guarantee production safety. The site also offers an optional USD 19 one-time safety-gate package and separately scoped USD 49 workflow diagnostic or Launch QA reviews. Built with AI assistance; review findings before use. No customer credentials are required to try the free tools.

name: CalcifyAll
tagline: Free online calculators, no sign-up needed.
description: CalcifyAll is a free online calculator suite with GPA, loan, mortgage, BMI, standard deviation, tip and many more calculators. No sign-up needed — fast, accurate results right in the browser for students, professionals and everyday users.

name: Muse Gadgets Hub
tagline: Unofficial directory of community projects for Meta's Muse AI agent and Muse Gadget SDK.
description: Unofficial directory of community projects and skills for Meta's Muse AI agent and Muse Gadget SDK. Not affiliated with, endorsed, or sponsored by Meta. Free to browse; does not sell hardware or issue SDK tokens.

name: PDF SealBox
tagline: Browser PDF tools for stamps, page numbers, watermarks, and everyday file tasks.
description:
A while ago I noticed a routine step in our office archive: people printed every page just to stamp a document, then scanned the whole thing back in. I made PDF SealBox so we could do that part directly on the PDF. It can add a status or image stamp, spread a mark across consecutive page edges, number pages, add a watermark, split a file, turn images into a PDF, or export PDF pages as JPG or PNG. My coworkers now use it for our internal archive and have responded positively to the change.

It is for visible marks and routine document prep, not certificate-based signing. The normal browser workflow processes files in the browser and creates a new copy. Keep the original and review the exported PDF before archiving it.

name: YIX
tagline: AI image and video creation in one studio
description: YIX combines AI image and video generation, photo editing, restoration, product visuals and free prompt tools in one browser studio. Paid generation requires purchased credits; signing up does not grant free credits.

name: ZCoreAI
tagline: Multi-timeframe Z-score stock scanner with AI analysis and a public signals log.
description: ZCoreAI is a multi-timeframe Z-score stock scanner. It ranks your watchlist by how many standard deviations price sits from its regression mean, and each stock page adds an analysis checklist, DCF fair value, fundamentals, insider activity and an AI summary. Every signal goes into a public log, losses included. Free plan (watchlist up to 30); Premium $19.99/mo or $149/yr with a 7-day free trial. Not investment advice.

name: MSG.AI
tagline: AI translation & replies for WhatsApp Web
description: MSG.AI is a Chrome extension for WhatsApp Web: AI translation, AI reply drafts, a script library, contact export and controlled messaging to opted-in contacts. Data stays local. Not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta. Free tier; Pro $2.99/mo or $19.99/yr.

name: ChatAdsAI
tagline: Run paid ads inside ChatGPT conversations
description: ChatAdsAI lets brands run native ads inside ChatGPT. Target by intent, pay per result. Starter from $499/mo with Free Trial.

name: DeskWink
tagline: Let ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini work with folders on your own computer.
description: DeskWink lets web AI apps such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini work with folders on your own computer via a remote MCP connector. It can browse, read, search and propose edits to files you choose, with every change previewed for your approval. Only folders you share are visible, sensitive files such as .env and .ssh are blocked by default, and file contents are not stored in its database or logs. Free during closed beta.

name: Roxi Proxy
tagline: Free proxy subscription for v2rayN and Clash clients
description: Roxi gives every new user a free subscription with 30 minutes of full-speed access per day, importable into v2rayN, Clash Verge Rev, Hiddify and NekoBox. New users get an exclusive offer and can try it free on sign-up.

name: PDF Insight
tagline: Turn a PDF into clean Markdown, an AI summary and cited answers
description: PDF Insight is a web app that turns a PDF into clean Markdown text, a short/medium/long AI summary with key points, and (Pro) cited answers from the document. Free: 1 PDF. Pro: $15/mo billed yearly. Summaries can miss details, so check important facts against the PDF.

name: Try Crazyfrog
tagline: Make a Crazy Frog AI chase video from your photos
description: Try Crazyfrog turns one or two adult photos into a 14-second, 720p Crazy Frog AI chase video. One-time credits start at $8.99 and there is no subscription.

name: PeakYet
tagline: Plan your Japan trip around peak autumn foliage.
description: PeakYet maps Japan’s autumn foliage viewing spots with latest reports, usual peak timing, and a season calendar. It helps travelers choose where to go and when. Free to use for anyone planning a Japan trip.

name: MusicGo
tagline: Turn text ideas into AI songs in your browser
description: MusicGo is a web-based AI music studio for turning a written idea into a song. Describe a genre, mood, instruments and lyrical theme, then listen to and manage completed songs in a personal web library. Refine saved lyrics or music descriptions to create a new version while keeping the original. Google and Apple sign-in are supported. Eligible new website accounts receive a one-time 30-credit gift, with paid memberships and one-time credit packs available. Website creations and benefits are managed separately from the native app.

name: ADL Solution
tagline: Connect Salesforce with Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Zendesk, and Xurrent
description: ADL Solution helps businesses streamline workflows by connecting Salesforce with the tools their teams use every day. ADL Connect enables organizations to synchronize data between Salesforce and platforms such as Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Zendesk, and Xurrent. It supports bidirectional data synchronization, custom field mapping, and improved visibility across sales, development, and support teams. ADL Solution also provides Salesforce implementation, custom development, integration, administration, and managed services to help businesses improve productivity and operational efficiency.

name: shindan
tagline: Free Japanese personality and psychology quizzes. No sign-up, instant results.
description: shindan.co offers free personality and psychology quizzes in Japanese, including a 16-type test based on the same four indicators as MBTI (not the official MBTI), a 64-type personality test, an animal-type quiz and a mental-age test. Answer about 20-28 questions and get your result instantly, with no sign-up or email. Every quiz page publishes its axes, scoring formula and reverse-scored items. For entertainment and self-reflection only; not a medical or hiring assessment.

name: GotaOfferr
tagline: Find the jobs. Tailor the resume. Apply in one click.
description: GotaOfferr is an AI job finder and resume tailoring platform built for Indian job seekers and anyone applying abroad. Paste your resume and the job description and it rebuilds your resume for that exact role: rewritten bullets, mirrored keywords and flags for skills you are missing. It also generates a matching AI cover letter and exports ATS-safe single-column PDFs. A live job search across Indeed, LinkedIn, Glassdoor and Naukri ranks openings with match scores so you know which roles are worth applying to. Extras include a free ATS score checker, AI interview practice with Coco, a resume builder, and country-specific resume format guides for India, Dubai/UAE, Canada, the UK, Germany, Australia and Singapore. The free plan includes 3 tailored resumes a month, no card required.

name: BaZi Web
tagline: Free Ba Zi calculator for Four Pillars charts and Five Elements analysis
description: BaZi Web is a free browser-based Ba Zi calculator for people exploring Chinese Four Pillars astrology. Enter birth details to generate an eight-character chart with Five Elements balance, Ten Gods, luck pillars, symbolic stars, personality, career and health insights.

name: Lotably
tagline: Parking enforcement and daily-pass payment software for small lots
description:
Hi Ignlab Launch team, Ignlab Launch lists SaaS tools free after review, and Lotably would fit for small businesses that run a parking lot. Lotably is parking enforcement and daily-pass payment software from Cincinnati for small businesses. Lotably charges 5% or 25¢, whichever is less, plus a free plan. Anyone can sign up free on lotably.com and try every feature. Worth considering for the launch list?

Cody Blatt, Founder, Lotably, cody@lotably.com, 513-348-3049

Not a fit? Just say so and I won't follow up.

name: BeginThings
tagline: 100+ free browser tools, no login needed
description: BeginThings is a free collection of 100+ browser tools for freelancers and small businesses: PDF, image, GST and invoice tools, QR codes, a JSON formatter, OCR and on-device AI tools. No login, no signup, no email.

name: Diatech Studio
tagline: The AI workspace for jewelry teams: design, search, price, review and present in one project.
description: Diatech Studio is the AI workspace for jewelry teams. Generate a piece from text, speech, a sketch, a reference image, or a CAD file, then search your catalog, price it, review it with your team, and present it to clients without leaving the project. Built for jewelry designers, manufacturers and retailers. Free to start.

name: Ping123
tagline: Free IP lookup, DNS and WebRTC leak tests
description: Ping123 brings IP and browser network checks into one free web toolkit. Look up a public IP or domain, inspect location and ASN, review IP risk signals, and run DNS and WebRTC leak tests. It also includes WHOIS lookup, DNS lookup, browser fingerprint checks and SSL certificate checks. Available in seven languages, with no signup required. Risk results are diagnostic signals, not guarantees about security or access to third-party services.

name: No Restrictions AI
tagline: AI Image Generator No Restrictions – Free & Unrestricted
description: No Restrictions AI is a browser AI image generator for text-to-image and image-to-image. Create images from prompts or reference photos with multiple models, no watermark, free to start.

name: Image to Image
tagline: Free AI Image to Image Generator & Editor Online
description: Image to Image is a free browser-based AI image-to-image and image editor. Upload a reference photo, describe the change, and generate product shots, portraits, art, and marketing visuals with multiple AI models.

name: Photo Timestamp Pro
tagline: Add photo timestamps in your browser — privacy first
description: Privacy-first browser photo timestamp tool. Add visible timestamps and baby age stamps locally with EXIF auto-read. Supports JPG/PNG/HEIC. No upload.

name: AI Trend Clips
tagline: AI video templates for the trends you see on TikTok, Reels and Shorts — with a free photo check and a prompt for every template.
description: Put yourself in viral AI video trends with one photo. One-time payment, no subscription. Templates for Ozil Goal AI, Coldplay Kiss Cam, 24 Car Trend, Closed on Sunday, Burning Bridges.

name: VideoCatch
tagline: Free social media video downloader for public X, Instagram, Threads and RedNote posts. No sign-up, no app.
description: VideoCatch turns a public post link into a direct MP4 download. It lists every size the platform serves, picks the largest, and never re-encodes or stores the video. Works in any browser on iPhone, Android and desktop, with no sign-up.

name: Freelancer Cashflow Pack
tagline: Invoice + scope kit so freelancers stop chasing late pay
description: Freelancer Cashflow Pack is a one-time Google Sheets kit for freelancers who hate chasing overdue invoices and absorbing scope creep. It includes an overdue invoice tracker with a 3/7/14 follow-up ladder, plus a contract scope / change-order sheet so “tiny” requests get priced before work starts. Built for solo freelancers and small studios who want a boring, repeatable cashflow process — not another SaaS subscription.

name: Revision Garden
tagline: Free exam planner with daily limits and calendar export
description: Free browser study planner for one exam. Enter topics and estimates, daily limits, weekdays and blocked dates. Schedule optional reviews after 1, 3 and 7 days, see work that cannot fit, and export CSV, all-day calendar events or a JSON backup. No account or uploaded study data. Review intervals do not guarantee retention. Submitted by the developer.

name: PayDecode
tagline: Free paycheck, overtime, and tax calculators for US workers
description: PayDecode offers free paycheck, overtime, and tax calculators for US workers. Estimate take-home pay with 2026 federal, FICA, and state tax data across all 50 states. No account required.

name: DepthLogo
tagline: The AI logo maker with real depth.
description: AI logo generator and logo maker. Type a brand name, choose from 14 styles (2D/3D), edit, and download PNG/SVG/PDF with a commercial license. Built for indie makers, startups, and small businesses.

name: Alathar / الأثر المرئي
tagline: Arabic client photo albums, portfolios, and browser photo editing
description: Alathar is an Arabic-language platform for photographers to create client photo albums, build portfolios, and edit photos in the browser.

name: Ecomwith
tagline: Ecomwith offers free ecommerce tools and tutorials for Shopify DTC sellers, including ROAS calculators, GTIN checker, and guides.
description: Ecomwith helps ecommerce DTC operators turn scattered Shopify, ads, SEO, analytics, content, and profit tasks into repeatable workflows. The site combines 213+ tutorials and 16+ free tools including ROAS / break-even calculators, GTIN checker, image processor, UTM builder, QR code generator, and more.

name: BasedFrame
tagline: AI interior design that wins rooms, clients and listings
description: AI interior design studio for interior designers, real estate agents, home stagers and architects. Paste a Zillow listing or upload a room photo to get photoreal redesigns in 12 styles, virtual staging and more, keeping walls, windows and camera angle exactly as photographed.

name: PrintResize
tagline: Exact print size & DPI for any image
description: Resize any image for exact print size in centimeters or inches with correct DPI. Free DPI checks and converters; AI print resize and upscaling with credits.

name: RestoZign Free Services Hub
tagline: 155 free starter services and 74 free AI tools for business owners — no card or purchase required.
description: A free library of practical starter services and AI tools from RestoZign, a Florida website design studio. Owners pick one — a homepage mockup, a website mini audit, a local SEO checklist, an AI search visibility check, menu pricing and layout help for restaurants, email and lead templates, and dozens more — and it is produced and delivered free, within 5 business days when capacity allows. The hub also lists 74 free AI tools for websites, marketing, automation, social media, affiliates, local business and more. No card or purchase required to claim a free service.

name: MortalSpan Tools
tagline: Free online PDF & image tools that run in your browser - files never uploaded

description: Skeleton AI turns a written prompt into a ready-to-publish video. It builds the scene breakdown, generates the visuals, adds an AI voiceover and burns in captions, so creators and small teams can ship short-form video without editing software.

name: BirthdaySongWithName.online
tagline: Make a birthday song with name: their name in the chorus, your memories in the lyrics, and two full MP3 versions to download and share.
description:
BirthdaySongWithName.online is a web app for making a birthday song with name in the lyrics. Enter a first name or nickname, choose who they are to you, and pick the occasion: a regular birthday or a milestone from the 1st to the 100th. Then choose one of seven styles, from feel-good pop and warm acoustic to country celebration and smooth jazz, one of four tempos from 70 to 140 BPM, and a female, male or duet voice preference.

Add a memory, an inside joke or a favorite thing, and you get a lyric draft with their name in it. Edit every line until it sounds like you. One credit then generates two full versions of the song, each about 60 seconds long, to play and download as MP3. Every song can get its own share page, where the birthday star can listen and download without an account.

Credit packs are 5 songs for $5, 20 for $15 or 50 for $35. Credits don't expire, and a failed generation returns its credit automatically. Songs are for personal use, including posts on your own social media.

description: AIReelGenerator turns prompts or photos into vertical 9:16 AI video reels ready for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. Freemium for creators who want short-form video without a full editing suite.

name: AI Line Art
tagline: Text or photo to clean line-art outlines for logos, tattoos, and print.
description: AI Line Art turns a short prompt or a photo into crisp black-and-white line illustrations. Freemium tool for creators who need logo drafts, tattoo sketches, or print-ready outlines without redrawing by hand.

tagline: Roofing estimates, homeowner leads and preliminary roof reports

Choose $150/month or $7.95 per available preliminary report. Source and measurement limitations are disclosed before purchase; contractor review is required.

name: DropTranscribe
tagline: Audio and video to text, subtitles and translation
description: DropTranscribe turns audio and video into text and subtitles in your browser. Drop an MP3, M4A, WAV, MP4 or MOV up to 120 minutes, or paste a public Google Drive or Dropbox link. Whisper large-v3-turbo detects the language and transcribes it. Download TXT, DOCX, SRT or VTT, or translate the subtitles into 16 languages as bilingual files. The first 3 minutes are a free preview. No account, no subscription: one payment per file from $1.49. Audio is deleted within 24 hours.

tagline: AI motion control: put any move on your photo

It also animates still photos (image-to-video) and ships ready-made templates for viral AI video trends.

name: BeadDraft
tagline: Turn photos into fuse bead patterns
description: BeadDraft is a free bead pattern maker. Turn a photo or text into an editable fuse-bead pattern, then export a printable PDF chart, a bead list by color, CSV, PNG or JSON. 103 Perler-compatible colors, runs in your browser, no account.

name: DoKitly
tagline: Free online PDF, image, converter, calculator, developer and productivity tools in one place.
description:
DoKitly is a free, browser-based productivity toolkit that brings together practical online utilities for everyday digital tasks.

The platform offers tools for editing, merging, splitting, compressing and converting PDF documents; resizing, compressing, cropping and processing images; converting files; performing mathematical and financial calculations; formatting text; working with JSON and developer utilities; and analyzing websites and keyword rankings.

Designed for students, professionals, freelancers, developers, creators and everyday users, DoKitly makes it easier to complete common tasks without installing separate applications or creating an account.

Many supported file-processing operations run directly in the browser, while tools requiring external website or search information use dedicated online services.

DoKitly focuses on free access, straightforward workflows and convenient productivity tools across desktop and mobile browsers.

name: WithYouAgain
tagline: Cinematic pet memorial with your own words at the end: a 20-second Día de Muertos journey home made from 1–3 photos of your pet.
description: The last few seconds are the most personal. After your companion walks a marigold path and reaches the ofrenda, the film shows their real photo and name together with the message you wrote, so the memorial ends in your voice. WithYouAgain needs only one to three photos and any traits you'd like to describe. You can generate up to two free first-scene previews before paying.

name: Just Divvy
tagline: Simple divorce and co-parenting tools that just work.
description:
Just Divvy makes practical online tools for families going through divorce or separation, and for co-parents after it. Separating couples argue most about money, and it gets worse when nobody is looking at the same numbers. Just Divvy puts everything in one shared place, so both people see the same list and the same math.

Balance Sheet lets spouses, with their lawyers or mediator, list every asset and debt and agree who gets what, item by item. It works out the equalization payment and produces a PDF or Excel summary. No sign-up to start; free for up to 10 items.

Ledger is a free shared expense tracker for co-parents, with a split on each expense, a running balance of who owes whom, receipts, and PDF, Excel or CSV downloads.

No ads, no selling data, no AI training on what people enter. Not a law firm and not legal advice. Made by remarQable LLC in Minneapolis.

name: GalleryDock
tagline: Online client galleries for photographers and filmmakers, with photo selection, video feedback, website embedding and an integrated print shop.
description:
GalleryDock is an online client gallery platform for photographers and filmmakers who want to present their work, collect feedback and deliver finished photos and videos in one place. It supports wedding, portrait, family and commercial photography workflows, from the first client image selection to final downloads and photo sales.

PHOTO SELECTION AND CLIENT FEEDBACK
Clients can browse their online photo gallery, mark favorites and leave comments on individual images. Photographers can use this feedback to organize selections before retouching. Filmmakers can collect feedback at specific points in a video, making revision requests easier to understand.

CLIENT GALLERIES ON YOUR OWN WEBSITE
GalleryDock lets you embed client galleries in your photography website. A central gallery entrance allows clients to enter their individual password and access the corresponding gallery. This gives photographers a consistent place to send clients and keeps the gallery experience connected to their own brand.

BRANDED PHOTO DELIVERY AND SALES
Customize gallery colors and cover images, add watermarks to preview photographs and provide downloads of approved files. The integrated shop allows clients to purchase additional digital images and photo prints directly through the gallery. Galleries can be viewed on smartphones, tablets and desktop computers.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

What is the best online gallery for photographers?
The best choice depends on your workflow. GalleryDock is a strong option for photographers who want branded client galleries, photo selection, image comments, website embedding and an integrated photo shop in one platform. For professionals delivering both photography and film, its video feedback tools are an additional benefit.

How can clients choose their favorite photos after a photoshoot?
Share a GalleryDock client gallery so clients can view the images, mark favorites and leave comments. This keeps image selection and feedback together instead of spreading them across messages and emails.

Can I embed a client gallery in my WordPress website?
Yes. GalleryDock provides an embed code that can be added to a website, including WordPress pages that support the required HTML embed. A central password entrance can give different clients access to their respective galleries.

Can photographers sell digital photos and prints?
Yes. GalleryDock includes a gallery shop for digital images and photo prints, allowing clients to order within the photo viewing experience.

Does GalleryDock support video review?
Yes. Filmmakers and videographers can present videos and receive comments tied to specific moments in the film.

Can I try GalleryDock for free?
GalleryDock offers three free galleries to get started, with paid plans available for additional needs.

description: Not ready for accounting software? We build bookkeeping spreadsheets for people in that spot. description: Veriscore is an influencer risk assessment tool by Regnor. It analyses Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and X/Twitter accounts across 85-125 signals per platform and returns a plain English verdict: Legit, Monitor, Sketchy, or Run. Reports deliver in under 2 minutes as 12-page white-label documents. Pay-per-use V Credits with no subscription; credits never expire. 35 free credits on signup. Built for agencies and brands that pay creators and need to know the audience is real before the money moves.

name: CivicVane
tagline: Foundation prospect research for small US nonprofits
description:
CivicVane helps small US nonprofits find foundations with a record of funding work like theirs. A Prospect Report ($149) lists at least 20 ranked funders that give in your area, built by CivicVane's software from public records such as IRS Form 990-PF filings. It's a PDF delivered by email within 2 business days of payment and a complete order form, with sources for every figure. If we miss the 2-business-day turnaround, you get a full refund. Submitted by the CivicVane team.
