name: AI Video Download
tagline: Turn a TXT link list into a batch of MP4 downloads

Paste up to 10 individual video links, one per line, or import a UTF-8 TXT file. The server processes the list sequentially into MP4 files, shows a separate result for each item and lets users save ready files without waiting for the whole batch. A failed item does not stop the remaining valid items. Single-link mode also offers MP3 when audio is available.

No account on the website, browser extension or local software installation is required. Supported link formats include YouTube, Instagram and TikTok, but source access determines success. TikTok currently faces regional restrictions on the service.

The workflow is deliberately limited to small batches: up to 10 minutes per video and 100 MiB per output file. Ready files must be saved individually within one hour; there is no ZIP export or automatic playlist/profile expansion. Private content, login-only sources, paywalls and DRM restrictions cannot be bypassed.

Submitted by the website operator. An English walkthrough explains TXT formatting, individual results and the final saving steps: https://ai-video-download.com/en/guides/batch-download-videos/

A reference checklist and planning topics cover multi-modal input, visual consistency, motion and camera direction, video extension and editing, and audio direction. In Agent you get a guided conversation for 10, 15 or 30 second videos in landscape (16:9), portrait (9:16) or square (1:1). The homepage Quick generator makes 15, 30 or 60 second videos with styles such as Aurora Glass, Flat Pop, Bauhaus, Gold Line, Morph and Cyber HUD, and accepts up to 4 reference images for layout, color and composition.

When the video is ready, request changes in plain English with a chat edit, or select a single scene and change its title, color or pace while other scenes stay unchanged. Undo returns to the previous version at no credit cost, and your version history stays available. Videos use an original music library.

Framecast uses monthly or annual plans: Starter $9.90/month for 500 credits, Pro $39.90, Business $99.90 and Studio $199.90 (USD, tax extra). An Agent render costs 100 credits and each chat edit costs 40 credits. There is no free tier, and failed renders are refunded automatically.

tagline: Online audio converter for MP3, WAV, M4A and OGG that runs in your browser, plus AI transcription and text to speech.
description:
Audio Converter Online is an online audio converter that runs in your browser. Convert MP3, WAV, M4A and OGG files, or pull an MP3 soundtrack out of a local MP4 video. Conversion uses ffmpeg.wasm on your device, so the recording is not uploaded to a conversion server. Local format conversion is free and needs no account. For MP3 output you can choose 128, 192 or 320 kbps.

When you need the words rather than the sound, AI transcription turns local audio and video recordings into a transcript with timestamps and speaker labels, saved as TXT, SRT, VTT or HTML. It suits interviews, lectures, meetings and voice memos, and the subtitle files work in common subtitle editors and players.

AI text to speech turns written text into narration with a selected voice. Type or paste text, or upload TXT, Markdown or PDF; PDF text is extracted in the browser first. The site also includes an AI voice changer, an AI voice designer that creates a voice from a description, and AI voice cloning that requires a consent recording.

AI features need sign-in and paid credits: transcription uses 2 credits per minute, and text to speech uses 1 credit per 100 characters. Starter, Unlimited and Max plans are billed monthly or yearly. Local browser conversion stays free without sign-in.

description: LLM Memory (VRAM) Estimator is a free browser tool that estimates how much GPU memory (VRAM) a local LLM needs for a given model size, quantization and context length. It shows the weights, KV cache and overhead separately and gives a fit verdict for common GPUs and Macs, so you can check whether a model will run on your hardware before you download it or buy a card. It runs entirely in the browser, needs no signup and is free to use (MIT licensed). Made by Yunus Emre Vurgun.

name: Kling4 AI Online
tagline: kling4 ai text to video and image to video: write a prompt, add reference images, pick Kling 4.0 or Kling 3.0 Standard.
description:
Kling4 AI Online is a kling4 ai video workspace for text to video and image to video. Sign in with Google, write a prompt of up to 2,500 characters, and generate a video with Kling 4.0 or Kling 3.0 Standard.

The generator has four modes. Text mode starts from a prompt alone. Image mode uses a starting image (JPG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB), with an optional last frame. Keyframes mode accepts middle frames in selection order. Reference mode with Kling 4.0 takes multiple references: up to 10 images, 5 input videos, elements and voices, which you mention in the prompt as @image_1, @video_1 or an element name.

Choose 5, 10 or 15 seconds, or 30 seconds with Kling 4.0, at 720p or 1080p. Kling 4.0 text to video offers 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 or 21:9, and Auto keeps the first image's ratio in Image and Reference modes. Kling 3.0 Standard offers 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1. Sound is always on with Kling 4.0 and optional with Kling 3.0 Standard, so you can describe ambience, music cues or short dialogue in the prompt. The generator shows the credit cost before you generate, and your videos appear in My videos.

The site also has guides: a Kling 4.0 prompt guide, 20 copy-paste Kling 4.0 prompts, an image to video guide for product ads, a native audio guide, a multi-reference tutorial and a Kling 4.0 vs Kling 3.0 comparison.

Pricing uses one-time credit packs with no renewal, paid through Creem. Credits never expire.

name: AI Rap Video Generator

description:
AI Rap Video Generator is an online AI rap duo video generator. Add one clear photo of you and one of a friend, partner, sibling or coworker, and it renders a short video of the two of you rapping together, trading verses and lip-synced to AI-generated vocals over a hip-hop beat. The photos don't need to be taken together, and a single photo of both people also works.

Creating a video takes three steps. First, add two photos, one face per photo. Second, pick a stage: the orange Hotel Lobby booth, Luxury Lobby, Studio Booth or Street Cypher. Third, optionally say who the song is for and what it's about, such as a birthday, an anniversary, best friends or your small business. The lyrics are written around what you type, so real names and one detail make the song personal. Leave it empty for a general hype song.

Each video is a vertical 9:16 clip of about 12 seconds, at 480p or 720p, made for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. Most videos are ready in 2–3 minutes. The song is an original AI rap, not a copyrighted track. Raps can be in English, Italian, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese or French.

Beyond rap duos, the site has pages for AI rap battles, diss tracks, birthday rap songs, personalized birthday, anniversary, love and Christmas songs, pet rap videos, rap promo videos for small businesses, and photo-based AI video effects such as Earth zoom out, AI hug and AI dance.

Pricing uses one-time credit packs with no subscription. A 720p, 12-second video costs 10 credits. Failed or rejected generations return their credits automatically. Photos are used only to render your videos.

description: Stones to Castle turns a clear adult portrait into a personalised castle-building video using AI character replacement. Upload your photo, sign in with Google, buy one video and follow its progress before downloading. Each approximately 15-second, vertical 9:16, silent MP4 costs $9.90 with no subscription. A real before-and-after sample, tutorial and tested prompt are available to view for free. Facial likeness varies by photo.

name: Flow AI
tagline: Create original AI videos in the browser — free, no sign up, no limits.
description: Flow AI (flowai.studio) is a free, browser-based AI video generator. Create original videos from prompts, images, and references — including text to video, image to video, and first/last-frame generation — without signing up. Built for creators and teams who want a zero-friction video workspace.

name: influ.codes
tagline: Discount codes with the creator's name attached
description:
influ.codes is a catalog of influencer discount codes and affiliate links where every public code names the creator who owns it and the brand it applies to. It's for shoppers who know a creator has a code but don't want to scroll back through Instagram stories to find it.

Shoppers search by creator, brand or category, such as beauty, fashion, tech, fitness or food. No account is needed to browse. Copy the code, then use Go to store to reach the brand's site. After signing in, you can follow a creator and get a heads-up when they add a new deal.

Creators claim a handle and get one public profile with all their active codes: a page to put in a bio instead of a link-in-bio that goes stale. The free tier allows up to two live codes. Pro adds unlimited codes, click analytics, a verified badge and better ranking.

influ.codes is not a coupon scraper, a browser extension or a brand-run coupon portal, and the public catalog is kept small and current on purpose.

name: Scro
tagline: Approve the storyboard first — then render Reels, decks & UGC
description: Scro is an AI video studio for creators, marketers, and course teams who need finished short videos without burning credits on blind retries. You pick a visual style (whiteboard doodle, flat vector, claymation, pixel art, or realistic), review an AI storyboard with titles, hook, scenes, and narration, lock a consistent character (face, wardrobe, voice — including photo-based virtual hosts), then generate clips only after you approve. Export for 9:16 Reels, 16:9 presentation clips, and 1:1 marketing posts from the same workflow. Built for product explainers, SaaS demos, tutorials, and personal-brand talking heads. New accounts get free credits to try the approve-then-render flow.

name: PokeBonk Calculator
tagline: Plan PokeBonk Lab upgrades and Stardust costs
description: PokeBonk Calculator is a free, unofficial Lab upgrade budget tool. Enter current and target upgrade ranks to total the Stardust cost and compare it with your entered balance. The current data covers 19 permanent Lab upgrades from the v0.7.10 public game bundle. It does not connect to your game account, predict farming rewards or recommend an optimal build.

name: Friend Codes
tagline: Share and copy Pokémon GO Trainer Codes without an account
description: Friend Codes is a free, unofficial Pokémon GO Trainer Code sharing board. Players can publish their own 12-digit Trainer Code, add an optional country, browse shared codes and copy a code to use in the game. No account or password is required. A listed code does not verify player activity or guarantee a friend request is accepted.

name: TempMail.is — a Security-Minded Test Inbox
tagline: Test signups safely: disposable inboxes, zero exposure.
description:
Every untested signup form is a small security decision. TempMail.is makes the safe choice the easy one: one click gives you a free, anonymous email address — no registration, no personal details, nothing to leak. Use it to test signup flows, evaluate tools, or run QA in staging; confirmation emails and codes arrive like normal mail, so the test is faithful.

When you're done, the address is disposable, and your real inbox never appears in anyone's database — no follow-up emails, no breach-exposed addresses, no marketing lists. Honest limitation: it's receive-only and temporary by design — for signups, trials, and tests, not for banking or accounts you need to keep.

name: TeachAgent
tagline: Free AI recipes for HK & Asia primary English teachers
description: Copy-paste classroom AI workflows for NET / LET / EAL prep. Free recipes; optional HK$68 Starter Prompt Pack.

name: ElectraSim
tagline: Free browser-based electrical wiring simulator - no sign-up, works offline
description: An interactive wiring lab that behaves like the real thing. Place a breaker, run the cable, close the switch - and watch current actually flow, trip and fault. 115 components from switchgear to 3-phase, 20 guided circuits, and a 60fps off-thread solver. Free, no account, works offline as an installable PWA; data stays on your device. For students, DIYers and electricians building and testing house wiring layouts.

name: CalculateAllInOne
tagline: Free Online Calculators for Everyday Needs
description: CalculateAllInOne offers free online calculators for everyday math, finance, health and practical tasks. Explore EMI, profit and loss, discount, BMI, Zakat, percentage and unit conversion calculators in your browser.

name: Dayduties
tagline: Simplify Your Tasks, Boost Your Productivity
description: Dayduties is a productivity and task management tool designed to help users organize daily activities, manage tasks, and plan their routines efficiently. It helps users stay focused, track responsibilities, manage their time, and improve everyday productivity with a simple and convenient task management experience.

name: DropAny
tagline: Encrypted file sharing across devices, right in your browser
description: DropAny is a free browser-based tool for sending files and text between iPhone, Android, Windows, Mac and Linux. Pair two devices using a six-digit code or QR code, without installing an app or registering an account. Transfers use end-to-end encrypted WebRTC and work on the same Wi-Fi or across networks, with TURN relay when needed. Files are not stored in cloud storage. Both devices must remain online; relayed transfers are limited to 500 MB per file. Useful for photos, documents, videos, screenshots and developer logs.

name: SceneBloom
tagline: Turn two portraits into cinematic AI video stories
description: SceneBloom turns two adult portraits into short, cinematic AI video stories built around preset couple templates. Choose a zombie love story or a playful Halloween vampire reveal, then download a vertical MP4 with sound. One-time paid packs, no subscription.

name: FundingRadar
tagline: Free AU small-business grants directory — 265 open now
description: FundingRadar is a free, independent directory of open Australian small-business grants and support programs. 265 open listings across federal, state, territory and council sources. Filter by state and industry; every listing links to the official page. Free weekly email for new opens and closing dates. Live on Product Hunt: https://www.producthunt.com/products/fundingradar?launch=fundingradar — Instagram @fundingradar.au if you prefer a soft follow: https://www.instagram.com/fundingradar.au/

name: CloudGPU
tagline: GPU rental by the minute plus an OpenAI-compatible AI API, on one prepaid balance.
description: CloudGPU lets developers rent on-demand GPUs (RTX 4090, RTX 5090, A100, H100) straight from the browser. Pick a GPU, click Deploy, and the instance is ready in about 2 minutes for fine-tuning, inference, ComfyUI, Ollama, LLaMA-Factory or JupyterLab. Billing is per minute (rounded up, 1-minute minimum) and unused time is refunded when you stop. The same prepaid balance also pays for an OpenAI-compatible API (https://cloudgpu.app/v1) for open models, so one account covers both hosted inference and your own GPU. Pay as you go, no subscription.

name: Veo3o1
tagline: Independent AI workspace for short video and product concepts
description: Veo3o1 is an independent AI video workspace for creating short clips from text prompts and supported reference images. Creators can explore product concepts and review model options, input requirements and credit costs before generating. The service uses paid credits or plans and is not an official Google product.

name: LensUp Scanner
tagline: Free online document scanner and PDF tools
description: LensUp Scanner is a free, browser-based document scanner that turns phone photos into clean, printable PDFs and includes ID-card copy and PDF tools; its free tools process your files on your device. To scan, take a photo of a page with your phone, then crop it, correct the perspective and remove shadows so the page comes out flat and even. You can scan several pages in a row and save them together as one multi-page PDF. The ID-card copy tool places the front and back of a card on a single printable sheet. For documents you already have, there's a PDF editor along with tools to merge several PDFs into one and to add a signature. Everything opens in the browser, and the site is available in 20 languages.

name: Kyeo AI
tagline: A multi-model workspace for AI image and video creation
description: Kyeo AI is a browser-based workspace for AI image and video workflows. Users compare model choices, supported inputs, settings and credit costs before creating. Image workflows can support product visuals and ad concepts, with human review before publication. Kyeo offers paid credit packs and memberships.

name: Rivya AI
tagline: AI image, video, audio and chat workflows in one workspace
description: Rivya AI brings image, video, audio and chat workflows into a workspace with shared credits. Users compare model availability, inputs and credit costs, then manage saved work in Studio. Limited starter credits are available after email verification; ongoing use is supported by paid plans.

name: PDFreevert
tagline: Free online PDF tools for everyday document tasks
description:
PDFreevert is a free web toolkit for everyday PDF work. Merge separate documents, split out pages, compress a PDF, and convert supported files without installing desktop software.

Use it to combine paperwork into one document, share selected pages from a report, or prepare a smaller file for an upload. Choose the tool, add your files, and download the result. Keep your originals and check page order and formatting before sharing.

Submitted by the PDFreevert team.

name: Chinese Female Name Generator
tagline: Chinese names for girls and women, with meaning
description: AI tool that composes meaningful Chinese names for girls and women, with pinyin and a character-by-character meaning breakdown. Free to use, no sign-up.

name: Zhanle
tagline: Free Vedic birth chart, compatibility and Lenormand readings
description: Zhanle is a free online Vedic astrology site. Get your sidereal birth chart with planetary positions, nakshatras and Vimshottari dasha periods, check relationship compatibility with a 36-point Guna Milan score, ask Prashna (horary) questions, and draw Lenormand cards. Core charts are free; full written reports are optional.

name: Hit the Road Dude AI
tagline: Turn authorized photos into personalized road-trip meme videos
description: Hit the Road Dude AI creates private-property and white-pickup meme videos from an authorized person or pet photo. Choose 15- or 30-second clips and 480p, 720p or 1080p output. The product requires sign-in and uses paid credit packs.

name: A2O Lite Dance
tagline: Turn your photos into solo or duo AI dance videos
description: An independent photo-to-video tool for NEON-inspired K-pop dances. Choose solo or duo choreography, upload one or two authorized photos, and generate 480p, 720p or 1080p videos using paid one-time credit packs. Not affiliated with A2O Entertainment or A2O LITE.

name: Room to Breathe
tagline: Free storage fit checker and practical small-space organization guides
description: Room to Breathe helps small-space households plan storage before buying. Its free Will This Organizer Fit? calculator compares available dimensions with organizer outside dimensions, with optional opening and clearance inputs. Access the checker from the homepage. The site also offers room-by-room organization guides and a free measurement sheet. The checker is a dimensional planning aid; users must check obstacles and retrieval space separately. Core guides and the calculator are free; an optional printable reset kit is sold separately.

name: Vivify Realtime AI Face Swap
tagline: Real-time AI face swap for your webcam and video calls
description: Vivify's Realtime AI Face Swap regenerates your live webcam view with a reference face you pick. It follows your expressions, head turns and pose as you move. It runs in the browser, and the Vivify Live Client for Windows 10/11 and macOS 13+ (Apple Silicon) adds a "Vivify Camera" virtual camera for OBS, Zoom, Teams, Meet and Discord. Vivify also includes Live Try-On and Restyle. New users get 88 free seconds after signup, then pay per second; plans from $12/mo. Try the real-time face swap at https://vivify.video/realtime-face-swap.

name: OMOPHub
tagline: The vocabulary stack for healthcare data teams
description: Hosted API for the OHDSI OMOP vocabularies: search, map and resolve 11M+ medical concepts (SNOMED CT, ICD-10, LOINC, RxNorm). No ATHENA downloads. Includes Python/R/Node SDKs and an MCP server for AI agents (https://mcp.omophub.com). Free tier: 3,000 API calls per month. Docs: https://docs.omophub.com

name: MailboxWatch
tagline: Cold email mailbox prices, compared side by side
description: MailboxWatch is an independent price tracker for cold email infrastructure. It compares 20 mailbox and SMTP offerings from 17 providers on one apples-to-apples setup: 30 mailboxes on 10 domains, monthly billing, domain costs included. Prices come from each provider's own pricing page, are re-checked regularly, and every change is logged. Free to use, with a weekly price-change email.

name: 3PL Listing
tagline: Directory of vetted 3PL and fulfillment providers for online sellers.
description: 3PL Listing is a directory of third-party logistics (3PL) providers for ecommerce and brands. Compare warehousing, fulfillment, freight, and shipping partners in one place.

name: GiveOwl
tagline: Free giveaways and sweepstakes, checked daily, in one list
description: GiveOwl collects giveaways, sweepstakes and contests you can enter for free into one clean list. Pick your country, hide anything that needs a purchase, track your daily entries and get a reminder before favorites close. Free, no account, no tracking.

name: RivalMoose
tagline: Competitive intelligence for ecommerce teams
description: RivalMoose helps ecommerce and D2C teams monitor competitor products, pricing, promotions, launches, creatives, reviews and marketplace activity, then turns those signals into actionable competitive intelligence.

name: LB3 Trackers Free Budget Calculators
tagline: Free in-browser budget, debt payoff, savings and holiday budget calculators. No sign-up, no tracking.
description: A set of 25+ free money calculators that run entirely in your browser: 2027 budget, 50/30/20, debt payoff (snowball vs avalanche), emergency fund, sinking funds, side hustle tax set-aside, paycheck split, Christmas and Thanksgiving budgets, plus free printables. Pages include referral links, which are labelled.

tagline: Free planning tools for vertical video prompts, safe zones, and voiceover
description: 916Studio is a free browser-based toolkit for planning vertical videos. A safe-zone checker previews local images or videos against TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts overlays, while an English script timer estimates voiceover length. No account is required. It does not generate videos.

name: PDFEditor.ae
tagline: Online PDF tools for everyday document tasks
description: PDFEditor.ae is a browser-based PDF toolkit for individuals, students and businesses. Work with PDF documents online, including editing, merging, splitting and converting files.

name: Nano Image
tagline: AI image editing for product photos, cutouts, cleanup, and creative effects
description: Nano Image is an AI image editor for creators and small ecommerce teams. It supports reference-photo editing, product scene generation, transparent PNG background removal, painted-area cleanup, resizing, alternate camera-angle views, and 80 creative effects. The free plan includes 8 personal-evaluation credits per UTC month. Generative results should be reviewed before publication. Submitted by the Nano Image project representative for editorial consideration and promotion.

name: PopUGC
tagline: AI batch image and video generator for product content
description: PopUGC is a browser-based AI image and video studio for e-commerce sellers, creators, and marketing teams. Generate from text or images, run batch workflows for product visuals and short marketing videos, and use popular image and video models in one place—with new models added over time.

name: YoPro
tagline: Book paid video consultations with verified professionals.
description: YoPro is a marketplace for paid video consultations with verified professionals in legal, finance, career and health. Clients book from live availability, pay into escrow, and meet in browser video rooms or the Android app. Professionals set their own rates and pay a flat platform fee.

name: Videoify
tagline: Turn any image into video with AI, no watermark
description: Videoify is an AI image-to-video generator. Upload a JPG, PNG or WebP image, write a motion prompt, choose duration and resolution, and generate a short clip with native synchronized audio and no watermark. Add an optional end frame to control where the shot lands, or use the reference workflow to guide character, wardrobe, setting and style with multiple images, video or an MP3/WAV audio track. Runs on MiniMax H3, Seedance 2.5 and Wan 3.0 with a shared credit balance, and shows the exact cost before every generation. Uploads are never used for training and are auto-deleted in 7 days.

name: Halloween AI
tagline: Turn your selfie or pet photo into a Halloween costume
description: Halloween AI is an AI photo editor that turns a selfie or pet photo into a Halloween costume portrait in a minute or two. Upload one photo, pick one of ten looks (Forest Witch, Wedding Ghost, Gothic Vampire, Midnight Werewolf, 80s Zombie, Cracked Porcelain, Skeleton Makeup, Red Devil, plus Pumpkin Pet and Glow Dino Pet for cats and dogs), and it paints the costume, makeup and a spooky background around your own face, which stays recognizable. It can also make short Halloween videos. No costume, makeup or editing skills needed. Your first one is free.

name: Scoolin
tagline: School ERP for Indian K-12 schools. Free up to 100 students. Beta · Invite only.
description: Scoolin is a school ERP built for Indian K-12 schools: CBSE, ICSE, state boards and preschools. It keeps one record per student, so admissions, fee collection, attendance, timetable, exams and report cards stay in sync. Free up to 100 students, then Rs 5/student/month. Now in beta, request an invite: https://scoolin.com/auth/register

name: Motion Transfer
tagline: Turn your photo into viral AI video trends in one click
description: Motion Transfer turns trending AI video effects into ready-made templates. Pick a viral trend, upload your own photo or character, and get the video.

name: AirapSong
tagline: AI song maker and rap video studio
description: AirapSong is an online AI song and rap video studio. Describe your idea or write custom lyrics, choose a sound (trap, boom bap, drill, melodic rap, pop, R&B, lo-fi, rock), set vocal direction and tempo, or make an instrumental track. Create cover artwork, then turn your photos into a five-second Hotel Lobby rap video. Pay-as-you-go one-time credit packs.

name: TariffsChart
tagline: Tariff and landed-cost planning for importers
description: TariffsChart is a tariff and landed-cost planning tool for importers and cross-border sellers. It helps users keep assumptions, source evidence, and broker-ready notes together before making sourcing decisions.

name: DealsChecked
tagline: U.S. deals and promo codes with real terms checked
description: DealsChecked lists current U.S. deals and promo codes with live prices, dollar savings, code terms and exclusions, and end dates so shoppers can verify whether an offer is real before checkout. Free to use; methodology documented at dealschecked.com/methodology.

name: EditTools
tagline: Free online file editing tools - image, video, PDF, audio and JSON in your browser
description: EditTools is a free online toolkit for everyday file tasks: edit and convert images, trim and convert video and audio, merge/split/compress PDFs, and format or convert JSON. Everything runs in the browser - no signup, no software to install.

name: Concrete Calc Pilot
tagline: Free concrete volume calculator for slabs, footings, and round columns
description: Free US-English browser calculator for slab, footing, and round-column concrete volume (yd³/ft³) with editable waste and step-by-step math. No signup. Not structural sign-off, not BIM.

name: Dame Hombro AI
tagline: One photo → viral Dame Hombro freestyle video for TikTok & Reels
description: Upload one photo; get the Bulin 47 Dame Hombro lead spot — red light, crowd, shoulder moves. 10/15s, 480p–1080p, 9:16 or widescreen. From $4.99.

name: MockupOpen
tagline: Device mockups for your next wallpaper launch.
description: MockupOpen is a browser-based studio for wallpaper creators. Choose iPhone, iPad, Mac, Watch, foldable or multi-device scenes, tune framing, widgets and watermarks, then export social-ready PNGs. Wallpapers stay in your browser; sign-in is optional. Free during the launch period, no account required.

name: VPSrank
tagline: Chinese VPS review & comparison directory
description: VPSrank is a Chinese VPS review and comparison directory: VPS providers organized by region, use case, network route (CN2 GIA / CMI / backbone) and budget, with pricing data, provider comparisons, buying checklists, deployment tutorials and configuration tools.

name: Bounce Blast
tagline: Free online brick breaker game: aim, bounce and break numbered bricks in your browser.
description: Bounce Blast is a free ball-bounce brick breaker you play right in your browser. Drag to aim, release a growing volley of balls, use wall bank shots to slip behind numbered bricks, collect + pickups for more balls, break blast bricks to damage their neighbours and use Energy Blast to clear the lowest row before bricks reach the bottom line. Short rounds, mouse, touch and keyboard controls, pause and triple speed, high score saved locally. No download, no account, no purchases. Available in English, Chinese and Japanese.

name: StoryState
tagline: AI Comic Generator for Consistent Characters
description: Great AI images are easy; keeping the next panel consistent isn’t. StoryState is an AI comic generator and workspace: describe your story, auto-create characters and panels, then edit in conversation or the workspace. Styles include manga, American comic, watercolor, cinematic storyboard, ink fantasy.

name: Elmren Voice
tagline: Family read-aloud nights on a Mac. Local audiobook factory for your own books.
description:
Family companionship for read-aloud nights: open a PDF or EPUB you already own and listen together with word highlighting. Nothing uploaded for daily reading after engine and voices download.

Local audiobook factory: export M4B, read-along HTML, and captioned MP4 from your own manuscripts, offline. Not a cloud subscription reader.

Price: $39.99 one-time with a 7-day trial. Apple silicon · macOS 13+.

name: MaiBao Synthetic Inquiry Demo
tagline: Free browser-only, fictional-data sandbox for inquiry-to-quote workflows, human approval and duplicate handling.
description: MaiBao Synthetic Inquiry Demo is an interactive, browser-only sandbox for exploring how simulated customer inquiries become editable quotation drafts. Users can try fictional leads, human approval states, quotes, and duplicate handling. Data stays in the page; it does not access real inboxes, send messages, accept payments, or represent a deployed customer integration. An optional separate diagnostic service is described on the site.

name: Image to Image AI
tagline: Keep structure, change style: AI image editor online.
description: Keep structure, change style: AI image editor online. Freemium browser tool to restyle and edit photos with prompts while keeping the original composition.

name: ChantKey
tagline: Passwords you can say aloud
description: ChantKey generates passwords from made-up syllables, with pronunciation and capitalization hints. Use it when you need to say a guest Wi-Fi password aloud or type a password on another device. Choose Whisper, Chant or Ritual and one of six language sound patterns. Free, with no account required and a limit of 20 generations per network in 24 hours.

name: VideoAnt
tagline: Plan ecommerce ad hooks and storyboards before generating a concept clip.
description: VideoAnt helps ecommerce teams turn verified product details or a public product URL into an ad brief, three hook directions and an approximately 15-second storyboard plan. Planning is free. Users can review a quote before optionally generating one 5-second, 480p single-shot concept video for 30 credits, in 16:9 or 9:16. The concept clip is separate from the storyboard plan. Final editing, voiceover and subtitles are arranged separately, and product accuracy needs review. An ungated product-ad brief worksheet and a creative-testing CSV log are also available.

name: Horoscope.me
tagline: Free birth chart, daily horoscope & live 3D sky. No signup.
description: Horoscope.me is a free astrology site: enter birth date/time/place for an accurate natal chart with interactive wheel, planet signs, houses and aspects. Daily horoscopes for all 12 signs, zodiac compatibility, and a live 3D sky with real stars you explore by moving your phone. Bilingual English/Chinese, no account, no paywall.

name: HitWeave
tagline: AI Music Generator for Original Songs
description: HitWeave is an AI music generator that turns an idea, your own lyrics, or an instrumental brief into original songs. Pick a sound and compare two complete MP3 takes. Create original birthday songs, anniversary songs, and creator background music.

name: 2 Person Infrared Sauna: Spec-Based Buying Guide
tagline: Compare 2 person infrared sauna specs: size, power, price and warranty.
description: Compare 2 person infrared sauna specs from maker pages, manuals and listings: size, power, dated price bands and warranty. Spec comparison, not hands-on tested.

name: LaneCut
tagline: Cinematic AI Video Generator - Create a Controlled Shot
description: Create a cinematic AI video from text or a photo. Control the first and last frame, preview your shot in Studio, and start a focused clip today.

description: Independent electricity information for India. Source times and uncertainty are labelled; community reports do not confirm supply at every home or register an official utility complaint.

description: Song Slower is a free browser audio tool for music practice and creative edits. Slow recordings while keeping their key, change pitch separately, add reverb, or select and loop a passage. Export a full track or selected section as MP3 or WAV. No account is needed and audio processing stays on the device; browser codec and memory limits apply. It does not generate music or isolate instruments. Submitted on behalf of Song Slower.

name: ChinesePaperCut

description: ChinesePaperCut offers Chinese paper-cutting templates, illustrated cutting guides and cultural background for craft learners and educators. Physical cutting results and machine compatibility are not guaranteed; try a pattern before classroom use. Submitted on behalf of ChinesePaperCut, not as a user review.

name: Chinese Knot

description: Chinese Knot offers a free browser designer for decorative knot artwork, alongside illustrated knotting lessons and printable reference worksheets. Arrange knot elements and tassels, adjust colors and add a greeting for cards or ornament plans. The designer is not a verified physical tying-pattern generator; filmed lessons cover tying with real cord. Submitted on behalf of the website owner.

name: HoloTap
tagline: Tap a trading card with your phone to see it in 3D
description: HoloTap connects your physical trading cards to digital records. Put an NFC tag on a card, tap it with your iPhone, and its 3D record opens with front, back, and condition photos. Identify cards with Live Lens, then list, make offers, or propose card-for-card trades. Free on iOS.

name: VideoFK
tagline: Free online 4K video downloader
description: VideoFK is a free online 4K video downloader — save public videos from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X and Bilibili. Paste a link and download in the formats and quality the source provides, no signup required. It also ships free browser-based video tools to extract audio, trim, compress and mute clips without installing anything.

name: Revunda
tagline: Free review tools and one-off review reports for apps and local businesses.
description: Revunda offers free tools for app developers and local businesses: review export, reply generators, review links and complaint checks. Paid one-off reports turn customers' own reviews into a list of what to fix.

name: AI Tattoo
tagline: AI tattoo generator: describe an idea or upload a photo, pick a style, and get a design to discuss with your artist.
description: AI Tattoo helps people explore a personal tattoo idea before their appointment. Describe what you have in mind or upload a reference photo (pet, flower, keepsake), choose a style — fine line, minimalist, blackwork, black & grey, traditional or Japanese — and generate a design concept. Download it, turn it into a printable stencil, or set lettering with the tattoo font tool. The cost in credits is shown before every generation.

name: Lizely
tagline: 800+ browser-local utility tools. Files never leave your device.
description: Lizely is a free suite of 800+ browser tools (PDF merge/split/compress, image compressor, JSON formatter, QR generator, Pomodoro, and more). Processing runs locally in the browser — documents and images are not uploaded to a server. No account required to use the tools.

description: BasisPilot provides free browser-based calculators for recurring investments, average cost, position sizing and stop-loss planning. It explains formulas and assumptions, and offers educational guides. No account is needed for the calculators.

description: Kling 4.0 is a free AI video generator for text-to-video. Freemium, about $9.8/mo on the public pricing page.

Keep notes and conversations for clients, referral partners, friends and family, and get birthday and follow-up reminders. Pulse turns your notes, history and reminders into a clear next move. Free plan with room for 25 people; optional BlackBook Pro subscription. Private by design: no account required, data stays on your device and your private iCloud, no advertising SDKs, never sold. Requires iOS 17.6 or later.

name: Filefruit

description: FileFruit is a free suite of browser-based tools for converting, compressing, editing, and working with common file formats. It supports images, PDFs, audio, video, archives, and more, with no account required. It’s built for anyone who needs a quick file utility without installing software or signing up.

name: Starbucks Calorie Calculator
tagline: Free Starbucks calorie calculator for every drink and size
description: Starbucks Calorie Calculator is a free tool that shows the calories, sugar, fat, protein and caffeine in Starbucks drinks. Choose your drink, cup size, milk and number of syrup pumps, and the numbers update instantly. The site covers 160+ drinks, from lattes and cold brew to Frappuccinos, Refreshers and teas. Values are based on Starbucks' published nutrition data. Not affiliated with Starbucks.

name: Letras Bonitaas
tagline: Free Spanish fancy-text generator that keeps ñ and accents
description: Letras Bonitaas is a free fancy-text generator built for Spanish speakers in Mexico and Latin America. Type your text once and instantly see more than 3,000 Unicode styles (bold, italic, gothic, circled letters and more) ready to copy and paste into Instagram bios, WhatsApp statuses and group names, TikTok, or a Free Fire nickname. It handles ñ and accented letters correctly. No app, no account and no sign-up. The site also includes a tool to turn decorated text back into plain text, and guides explaining why some styles show up as boxes on certain phones.

name: MOV Compressor
tagline: Free browser-based MOV compression with no upload, signup or watermark
description: MOV Compressor converts MOV recordings to smaller MP4 files entirely in your browser. Choose a quality preset or target file size, optionally lower the resolution, and compress one video or a batch. It is useful for people sharing iPhone, Mac and camera videos by email or messaging, with no upload, signup or watermark. Submitted by the MOV Compressor Team.

name: QVeris
tagline: Bring real data into the work your AI does.
description:
QVeris is a platform for connecting AI to professional data services and tools. Find supported services across finance and company information, social media, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, research and patents, e-commerce, trade and everyday services. Connect them to your existing AI assistant, application or workflow, with less manual data handling and repetitive integration work. Review service coverage, access requirements and execution records, or try research tasks in QVeris Lab.

Discovery and inspection are free. Signup verification includes 1,000 one-time trial credits; capability calls are billed according to each service’s billing rules. Pricing: https://qveris.ai/pricing

name: AI Burning Bridges
tagline: One photo → viral Burning Bridges party video for TikTok & Reels.
description: Upload one photo and get your own Burning Bridges trend video: crystal chandeliers, crowd, golden light, you at the center. 10 or 15 s, widescreen or 9:16, from $4.99. Guides free; credits from $4.99.

name: TradieKit
tagline: Free quote & invoice templates and tax guides for Australian tradies
description: Free ATO-compliant quote and invoice templates plus plain-English guides on GST, BAS, ABN and chasing unpaid invoices, made for Australian tradies and sole traders.

name: Abacusify
tagline: Free Online Calculators, Converters & Everyday Tools
description: Abacusify is a free collection of online calculators, converters, generators, and reference tools for everyday life, education, personal finance, and productivity. Get quick, practical results directly in your browser, with clear formulas and explanations that help you understand how calculations work. No account is required. Explore useful tools for solving everyday problems faster and with confidence.

name: Calculators Site
tagline: Free calculators for finance, health and everyday maths
description: Calculators Site provides free browser-based calculators for finance, property, salary, health and everyday maths. Tools include mortgage repayments, compound interest, savings, BMI and running pace. Pages explain inputs, methods, assumptions and limitations. Check the country, tax year and units for calculations that depend on regional rules.

name: Chainbrief
tagline: Paste a BSC wallet/contract → pay 5 USDT → automated on-chain brief. Analysis only.
description: Chainbrief is a pay-per-use tool for BNB Smart Chain. Paste a wallet or contract address, pay 5 USDT (BEP-20), and get an automated on-chain brief covering balances, basic activity signals, and heuristic risk flags. It is analysis software only — not a trading bot, not investment advice, and it does not promise returns.

name: BioUp.me
tagline: A free link-in-bio page with QR codes, short links and email signatures.
description: BioUp.me helps independent professionals, creators and small businesses centralize links in a shareable profile page. It also offers QR codes, short links and an email signature generator.

name: Dropshipper.nl
tagline: Independent Dutch-language guide to dropshipping
description: Dropshipper.nl is an independent Dutch-language guide for people starting or growing a webshop in the Netherlands. It explains Dutch consumer law and VAT for dropshipping, compares EU and China suppliers, print-on-demand and shop platforms, and includes a free margin calculator, a step-by-step plan and tips for spotting fraudulent shops. Affiliate links are disclosed.

name: LeaseBlitz
tagline: One rental listing in, a full fair-housing-conscious leasing kit out
description: LeaseBlitz is an AI rental leasing kit for small property managers. Paste a listing and get rewritten listing copy, headlines, social posts, a video script, flyer copy, tenant FAQ answers, inquiry templates, and an automated fair-housing lint. No invented facts; gaps are marked CONFIRM. Free first kit. Free tools: listing description generator and fair-housing ad checker.

name: Vicin
tagline: See the market behind every Google Maps ranking
description:
A business can rank well in one neighborhood and struggle to appear just a few miles away. Its competitors, customer demand, and marketing results can also vary significantly by location.

Vicin is a local SEO and marketing intelligence platform built to help businesses understand those differences.

The software examines each business location through several connected perspectives: geographic Google Maps rankings, nearby competitors, customer reviews, organic search, advertising performance, and local market conditions.

Its geo-grid tracking reveals where businesses appear in Google Maps results. Competitor analysis helps identify which companies dominate nearby searches, while AI visibility monitoring examines business recommendations across ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, and Google AI Mode.

Vicin also brings Google Business Profile, Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and Google Ads measurements into a shared workspace, making it easier to investigate how visibility relates to traffic, marketing spending, and customer actions.

Business owners can explore their individual market, while agencies and multi-location teams can compare performance across locations.

The goal is to help users recognize meaningful changes, inspect the evidence behind them, and make informed decisions about what to improve.

Vicin offers a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.

name: Pocket Soundpad
tagline: A small soundboard for original cues and your own clips.
description: Keep a personal soundboard in your browser. Pocket Soundpad comes with 12 original sounds and lets you add local audio, mark favorites and trigger pads with keys 1–9. Export a board for backup or import it on another browser. No sign-up or server upload is required; playback goes to your device audio output.

name: AI Bot Cash Starter Kit
tagline: 7-day playbook + 12 prompts for selling AI-bot help
description: $47 digital kit for non-coders: 7-day playbook, 12 copy-paste prompts, first-sale checklist for selling simple AI-bot help. PayPal on landing. No income guarantee.

name: QuillBill
tagline: Send a client an invoice link. No account. No server.
description:
QuillBill is a free, open-source document generator for freelancers and small businesses. It produces six document types invoices, quotations, proposals, receipts, purchase orders and timesheets, with 15 templates and clean PDF output.

Its distinguishing feature is how sharing works. There is no backend, so a shared document is not stored anywhere: it is compressed into the link itself. The recipient opens a working document with no account and no download, and there is no server copy to leak or expire.

It handles per-line tax rates for GST and VAT documents that mix rates in one invoice, and documents the tax-invoice requirements for nine jurisdictions the UK, UAE, Nigeria, India, Canada, Australia, the Philippines, the USA and EU cross-border supply. Word and Excel versions are downloadable for people who want a file rather than an app.

name: eSIM Tayyor
tagline: Travel data plans on the web and iPhone
description: eSIM Tayyor offers travel mobile data through its website and iPhone app. Choose a destination and compare packages by data allowance and validity. Payments are available through Click in Uzbek soums and SBP in rubles. The app keeps installation details, data balance and validity together, with top-ups for eligible eSIMs. It is free to download; data plans are paid. A compatible, unlocked phone is required. iPhone app: https://apps.apple.com/ru/app/esim-tayyor/id6821702972

name: SongMesh
tagline: AI music generation API for developers
description: SongMesh is an independent third-party AI music API for developers. Generate songs and lyrics from text prompts, create covers, extend tracks and separate vocals over REST, with webhook callbacks and pay-as-you-go credits that never expire.

name: FoodAllergyCard
tagline: Make a multilingual food allergy card to show on your phone
description: Build a food allergy card in 10 languages. Pick foods, add your own, and preview free before paying.

name: Databasin
tagline: One platform for connectors, pipelines, lakehouse and AI answers, on one meter.
description:
Most companies already own a data platform, yet their people still wait weeks for an answer. The usual fix is five or six tools stitched together: ingestion, warehouse, transformation, BI, an AI layer. That stack runs $170K to $430K a year in licenses, before anyone is hired to run it.

Databasin replaces that stack with one open, governed platform on a single meter. Connectors pull from 200+ sources. Pipelines land your data in an open Iceberg lakehouse in your own storage. Your team asks in plain English and gets the answer, a chart and the SQL behind it. Agents run on a schedule and speak up when something moves. One set of permissions governs every question, and every query is logged. It also runs on top of the Databricks, Snowflake or Fabric you already own.

Start free with $50 of credit, no card and no annual commit. The first answer takes about five minutes. Or book an hour with Chris, the co-founder who runs the technical demos.

name: CaseStatusTracker
tagline: Read USCIS case JSON as a timeline
description: Independent USCIS case JSON reader: paste your own data to see a timeline, event codes and timestamp gaps. Runs in your browser, no sign-up needed.

name: Remodel AI
tagline: AI home design — redesign rooms from a photo before you remodel
description: Remodel AI is an AI home-design app. Upload a room, exterior, or garden photo and get a photorealistic redesign in about 10 seconds across 30+ styles. Tools include interior/exterior/landscape design, virtual staging, floors, paint, object removal, and furniture swap. Free tier available; Pro plans for more designs. Web + iOS + Android. For homeowners, designers, realtors, and contractors.

name: Seedance 2.5 AI Video Creator
tagline: Try Seedance 2.5 AI for free. Create cinematic videos up to 30 seconds with multimodal references, realistic motion, consistent characters, and AI editing.
description:
Seedance 2.5 AI - Cinematic Video Creation Platform

Seedance 2.5 AI Video Creator helps digital artists, filmmakers, marketers, and content creators turn creative concepts into cinematic AI-generated videos. New users can explore supported features through available free trial options before purchasing additional generation credits.

The platform brings together text prompts, images, video clips, and audio references to create visually consistent scenes.

name: NativeAdSpy
tagline: Compare native ads spy tools and plan prices side by side
description: NativeAdSpy compares five native ads spy tools - Anstrex, AdPlexity, Adbeat, SpyOver and PowerAdSpy. See native plan prices, features and which plan fits affiliates, media buyers and agencies, so you can pick the right native ad intelligence tool before you pay.

name: Retypit
tagline: Edit text in any image and keep the same font
description: Upload an image, click any line of text and retype it. Retypit's AI keeps the original font, color and style, and leaves everything else untouched.

name: Random Character Generator
tagline: Free random character generator for stories, games, anime, DnD, and art
description: Free random character generator for stories, games, anime, DnD, and art. Pick character type, gender, species, and mood to get a full character profile.

name: YourDrive
tagline: Your files. Your storage. No compromise
description:
YourDrive is a self-hosted, Google Drive-style file manager with a built-in media timeline. It runs on your own Linux server and keeps every file in the storage you already own: AWS S3, Azure Blob Storage, MinIO, Cloudflare R2 or Wasabi. There is no per-seat pricing, no monthly storage bill from us, and no telemetry.

Why YourDrive

Most cloud drives ask you to hand over your files and pay for every user. YourDrive flips that around. You deploy it on your own server, connect your own storage bucket, and keep full ownership of your data. Your storage credentials are encrypted with AES-256-GCM before they are saved.

Key features

- Nested folders with breadcrumb navigation, rename and move
- Drag-and-drop moves for files and entire folders
- Media timeline that groups photos and videos by month and year
- Smart search by filename, media type and upload date
- Starred files and a 30-day trash with restore
- Bulk actions to delete, star or restore hundreds of files at once
- Shared links, plus passwords, expiry dates and upload requests on Team plans
- Streaming uploads straight from your browser to your storage, so your server disk never fills up

Bring your own storage

Point YourDrive at your AWS S3, Azure Blob, MinIO, Cloudflare R2 or Wasabi account from the Storage Settings page, click Test Connection, and save. Any S3-compatible service works.

Installation in minutes

A single command installs Docker if needed, generates secrets and starts the whole stack. No Kubernetes and no manual configuration. The first user to register becomes the admin and can invite teammates.

Pricing

Community is free for personal, family and homelab use, with up to 3 users and all five storage backends. Team is $119 per server per year for up to 25 users and adds folder sharing, protected links, upload requests and email support. Billing is per server, never per seat.

Who it is for

Homelab users who want a private Drive and Photos replacement, freelancers and agencies sharing files with clients, and small teams that need their data to stay in their own cloud account.

Learn more at https://yourdriveapp.com. Questions? Email support@yourdriveapp.com.

name: TierProxy
tagline: Pay-per-GB residential proxies with traffic that never expires
description: TierProxy is a proxy service for scraping, data collection and marketing teams. Rotating residential traffic is billed per gigabyte and never expires, and you connect through one gateway with rotating or sticky sessions. It also sells dedicated IPv4, ISP, IPv6 and mobile proxies priced per IP. HTTP and SOCKS5 work on every plan, credentials arrive right after payment, and one wallet can be topped up by card, bKash or crypto.

name: Brabble
tagline: Find hackathons, case competitions, and coding contests in one place
description: Brabble is a live, searchable index of hackathons, case competitions, coding contests, and student opportunities. It combines listings from major platforms, removes duplicates, updates daily, and shows only opportunities with future deadlines. Students can browse by category, eligibility, location, technology, prizes, and closing date, with every listing linking to the official organiser page.

name: Printable Lined Paper
tagline: Free printable lined paper, graph paper and handwriting practice sheets as PDF or PNG.
description: Make printable lined paper and lined pages to print in Letter, A4, A5, or half Letter. Choose spacing, margins, and color, then download a free PDF or PNG. Also offers graph paper, handwriting and cursive practice sheets, notebook paper, coordinate planes and music staff paper. No sign-up, no watermark.

name: PHP2Shell Check
tagline: Free PHP version and patch-status checker for any website
description: Free checker: enter a website and it reads the public response headers to report the live PHP version, then says whether the site is patched, vulnerable or on an end-of-life branch and what to do next. Covers the PHP2Shell flaws (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619). No signup, stores nothing.

name: BayLineUp
tagline: A visual operating board for tire and auto shops
description: BayLineUp gives tire and auto shops a shared live view of vehicles, bays, technicians, assignments, and job status. Teams can assign work, see technician availability, track jobs as they move through the shop, and review operational history. A free demo with fictional shop data is available without signup.

name: MCPALL

description: MCPALL is an MCP server directory with original guides, install commands, and client setup for Claude, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf.

name: HumanPen
