description: HumanPen is an AI humanizer and document toolkit (SaaS). Rewrite AI text to sound natural, edit DOCX/PPTX while keeping formatting, and ship cleaner drafts for writers and students. Freemium at https://humanpen.net.

name: 1 in 8 Billion – Free Life Simulator
tagline: Be born somewhere you didn't choose: a free browser life simulator.
description: An independent, unofficial fan-made game inspired by "1 in 8 Billion" and not affiliated with the official 1in8b.life. You are born in a random country, weighted by real annual birth statistics from 172 countries, and live a whole life from birth to death. Compare countries, trace a family tree and run batch simulations. No signup; progress stays in your browser. Free to play, with an optional US$2.99 Keepsake card.

name: StatementHaul
tagline: Bank statement PDF to CSV/QBO, with a balance check
description: StatementHaul turns text-based bank-statement PDFs into a clean CSV or a QBO (Web Connect) file you can import into QuickBooks. Conversion runs entirely in your browser, so the PDF is never uploaded to our servers. After extracting the transactions it runs a balance check: opening balance + credits - debits must equal the closing balance. If it doesn't tie, it shows the difference and points to the row to check. 2 free statements per device, then one-time packs: 10 for $9 or 100 for $29. No subscription.

name: Plain Game
tagline: Independent daily estimation game: seven guesses to name something close to a target number or estimate a fact.
description: Plain Game is a free, independent browser estimation game. Each daily flight has seven 30-second rounds: five ask you to name something (a mountain, a film, a building) whose value is close to a target number, and two ask for a numeric estimate of an everyday fact. Closer answers earn more points and lift your illustrated plane higher; a hidden golden round doubles points. After the daily flight you can play practice flights from 20 collections, untimed Discovery mode, past flights, or send a friend a challenge link. No account, download or payment. It is an independent edition and is not affiliated with the original Plain (playplain.app).

name: MinuteHaul
tagline: Export all your tl;dv and Fireflies meeting transcripts to one ZIP of Markdown + CSV
description: MinuteHaul bulk-exports your meeting history from tl;dv and Fireflies (beta) before you cancel or downgrade. Paste your API key and it builds one ZIP in your browser: a Markdown file per meeting, an index.csv and an optional all-transcripts.txt, ready for Notion, Obsidian, Google Docs or ChatGPT/Claude. It uses each tool's official API, and your key and transcripts never pass through our servers. Your 10 most recent meetings are free; exporting everything is $19 one-time with a 14-day refund.

name: EasyPdfPlay
tagline: Free Online PDF Editor to Edit, Sign, and Annotate PDFs
description: EasyPDFPlay is a free online PDF editor that makes working with PDF documents simple and accessible. Edit text, add signatures, highlight important content, draw, and annotate PDFs directly in your browser without installing desktop software. Unlike many PDF editors that require paid subscriptions for essential features, EasyPDFPlay aims to make everyday PDF editing available to everyone for free. It is ideal for students, professionals, freelancers, and anyone who needs a quick and convenient way to work with PDF files online.

name: StatementConv
tagline: Development preview: English/USD text PDF statements to CSV/Excel, with editable review; no real-bank layouts certified yet.
description: StatementConv is a web-based development preview for converting supported text-based PDF bank statements to CSV or Excel. It provides a review view with the original PDF beside editable transaction rows, plus date, amount and balance checks before export. Guests can try two pages without signing in; Google accounts receive trial pages, and paid plans provide larger page allowances. Current support is limited to single-file, single-account, English-language USD statements with supported column-based layouts. Scanned and encrypted PDFs are not supported, and no real bank layouts have been certified yet. Users should verify every extracted row against the original statement. The public synthetic sample lets visitors explore the review workflow.

name: How to Use Apple AI
tagline: Independent source-linked Apple Intelligence use cases and user reports
description: How to Use Apple AI is an independent, free resource for exploring Apple Intelligence tasks and user opinions. It collects source-linked reports from creators, independent publications and public communities, with examples covering writing, photos, notes and Shortcuts. Visitors can search stories, filter by topic and follow links to the original reports. English, Spanish, Japanese and Chinese editions translate the site’s editorial summaries; they do not imply feature availability in a language or region. The collection summarizes other people’s experiences rather than claiming its own tests. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by Apple.

name: Easy Grade Tool
tagline: Free EZ Grader Chart & Easy Grade Calculator for Teachers
description: Free EZ grader chart and grade calculator for teachers and students. Enter number of questions to get percentage & letter grade for every score, plus weighted GPA and grade curve calculators. Printable, no signup, private - calculations run in browser.

name: SureSMM
tagline: Affordable SMM panel for followers, likes and views
description: SureSMM is a social media marketing panel for creators, businesses and resellers. Get followers, likes, views and engagement for YouTube, Instagram, Telegram, TikTok, Facebook and X, with fixed prices. Add funds from just $1 and most orders start within seconds.

name: Chatlis CRM
tagline: Future of customer relationships is now
description:
Chatlis - The Simple AI CRM for Customers & Chatbots

The lean AI CRM: Manage contacts, bundle conversations, and optionally deploy AI chatbots. Manage customers and optionally deploy AI chatbots - all in one clear, easy-to-use CRM. 

Chatlis is the lean AI CRM: Manage contacts, bundle conversations, and optionally deploy AI chatbots. Try it free for 14 days.

name: Loppee
tagline: Directory of verified, licensed local pros, built for AI agents
description: Loppee is a US-wide directory of local service pros where each Verified business has had its registration, contact details and license checked. Owners can run their page day to day through their own AI agent, and customers' AI assistants can search and check pros through Loppee's MCP server. Your agent can't verify you; only Loppee can. Listing is free.

name: OrdoGrid
tagline: Peppol invoicing, customers and projects for Belgian small businesses
description: OrdoGrid is a Belgian cloud platform for freelancers and small businesses. Create quotes, invoices and credit notes, send and receive Peppol invoices, manage customers, and organise projects, Kanban tasks and time tracking in one web app. It is available in English, French, Dutch and German, with European hosting. A free plan includes unlimited Peppol invoice reception and one outgoing invoice per month; paid plans start at EUR 9/month excluding VAT, with a 14-day trial. OrdoGrid is based in Namur, Belgium.

name: OmniHuman2
tagline: Turn one portrait and an audio track into a talking or singing video
description: OmniHuman2.net creates lifelike talking and singing avatar videos from one photo and an audio track. Upload a portrait, add speech or music, and get a 720p video with natural lip-sync, head and body motion, 4 seconds to 2 minutes per clip. Great for creators, marketers, educators and dubbing. Plans start at $9.99/month.

name: Seenivo
tagline: See how AI sees your online store
description: Seenivo helps small online stores check website readiness for AI-powered discovery. Start with a free preview without signup. Paid audits check six customer questions with saved AI answers and source links; Scan & Fix adds page-specific copy and verified competitor comparisons.

name: PorchRocket
tagline: Property data for roofers and public bids for contractors
description: PorchRocket helps roofing companies and other contractors find work through two products. Ground Control provides residential and commercial property lists filtered by roof age, material, size and location, with CSV or Excel delivery. Bid Control helps contractors find public-sector opportunities from schools, cities and counties, with bid details, deadlines and guidance. Ground Control is paid property data; Bid Control offers limited free access to three jobs alongside paid access.

name: Window Peeper AI
tagline: Turn one adult portrait into a Window Peeper AI meme video: burger, awkward stare, closing curtains.
description: Window Peeper AI is an independent browser tool for recreating the Window Peeper meme: the camera drifts toward a lit apartment window at night, a person eating a burger notices the viewer, stares, then closes the curtains. Upload one portrait of a consenting adult, choose 480p (10 credits) or 720p (20 credits), and the Wan 3.0 model generates a 14-second 9:16 MP4 you can download. Credit packs are one-time purchases from $6.90. A free guide, a free copyable prompt and a source archive on the meme's CapCut origins are readable without an account.

name: BabyPassportCheck
tagline: Baby passport photo checks, retake guidance and print-ready sheets
description: BabyPassportCheck helps parents prepare an original baby passport photo at home. Choose the passport issuing country, upload a photo, then get guided checks, retake advice, a country-sized crop and a printable photo sheet. Original-photo processing runs in the browser without changing the child’s face or background. One-time photo packs start at $7.99. Guidance supports preparation; final acceptance is decided by the issuing authority.

name: Yike AI
tagline: Describe your business; Yike AI surfaces matching public demand with sources & reasons.
description: Yike AI is an AI lead-generation workspace. Describe your business; it finds matching public demand (tenders, posts, listings) with sources and reasons, then helps organize outreach in a CRM-style workspace. Humans confirm before any outreach. For B2B founders and sales teams prospecting from public demand, replacing manual tender search.

name: PingCron
tagline: Know when your scheduled jobs miss a check-in
description:
Your app can be up while its nightly backup has stopped running. PingCron watches for check-ins from scheduled jobs so you can notice when one goes missing.

Keep your existing scheduler and send a heartbeat after the work and validation succeed. If an expected check-in is missing beyond its grace period, PingCron can alert you by email, Slack or Discord.

Start with 5 free monitors, no credit card, and 7 days of history. PingCron does not run or repair jobs, and a heartbeat alone does not prove the output is correct.

name: Moxion
tagline: Create and optimize GIFs with AI
description: Moxion is a browser-based toolkit for creating animated GIFs from text prompts, still images, or video clips. It also includes practical tools to compress, resize, crop, add text, adjust speed, and convert GIFs to MP4 for websites, social posts, ecommerce, and product demos.

name: SCENE
tagline: Keep campaign briefs, prompts, creative versions and feedback in one workspace, and stay in control of approval.
description:
SCENE helps founders and small creative teams run their marketing campaigns in one place instead of scattered chats and folders.

Start with a brief: the audience, the message and the purpose, with brand references alongside. Make the creative in your preferred tools or with your own AI agent, then import images, video or carousels into SCENE. Each version keeps its prompt and source, so a good direction is never lost.

Compare versions, collect comments and check the caption before you approve. Approval stays a human decision.

Free private beta, by invitation. No card needed. There is a public walkthrough with fictional campaigns.

name: SkinMyCar
tagline: AI Tesla Paint Shop wrap designer
description: SkinMyCar is an independent AI wrap studio for digital Tesla Paint Shop exports and photo wraps. Generate Paint Shop-ready PNGs for Model 3, Model Y, Model S, Model X, and Cybertruck, or create photo wraps for other vehicles. Free trial credits; paid credit packs.

name: ChangeFlow
tagline: Document extra work, get client approval, and keep the record for billing.
description: ChangeFlow helps small contractors manage construction change orders without a complicated project-management suite. Capture an extra-work request, specify added cost and schedule impact, prepare an approval link for the customer, and keep the response with the job for later billing. A no-login interactive demo lets anyone try a fictional project; the founding contractor plan is $19/month.

name: GreatWait
tagline: Reliable webhook scheduling for your agent, your app, and you!
description: GreatWait schedules signed HTTPS calls for apps and AI agents. Schedule a callback once, after a delay, on an interval, or with cron and time zones. It retries failed deliveries, records each attempt, and forecasts upcoming webhook activity. Use the dashboard, API, or hosted MCP service. GreatWait is a paid, usage-based hosted service with trial credit.

name: Avrenor Garage
tagline: Car rental management for fleets, rentals, payments and documents
description: Avrenor Garage is web-based car rental management software by Avrenor. Manage fleet calendars, availability, pickups and returns across fleet groups; track rental records, paid amounts and outstanding balances; and keep vehicle insurance, registrations and saved rental agreements together. Share photo quotes with date-based pricing and mileage limits, and receive rental, payment and document reminders. Use the workspace in a desktop or mobile browser, including iPhone Home Screen access. Monthly USD plans start at $49 for up to 5 active vehicles, with fleet-size tiers and custom quotes for 101+ vehicles. Request a demo on the official website.

name: DBLQR
tagline: Free, unofficial Dragon Ball Legends QR tool and friend-code exchange board.
description: DBLQR is a free, unofficial Dragon Ball Legends QR tool and friend-code exchange board. It separates friend-request QRs from the reference activity format, supports single and batch PNG downloads, and lets players bookmark codes locally. English, Spanish, Portuguese and Japanese pages are available. Saved codes do not add friends in-game. Shared codes are unverified, and activity compatibility depends on the current campaign in-game.

name: Study Shop
tagline: Free in-browser tools for hackathon teams: a README and submission checklist writer, and a deadline timer.
description: Study Shop is a small studio run by AI agents. It makes two free browser tools for hackathon teams. ShipKit takes one form about your project and writes a README plus a checklist of what judges and submission forms ask for (public repo, demo link, video), with modes for Solana and NEAR hackathons. ShipClock counts down to your submission deadline in your own time zone. No sign-up; your answers stay in your browser. Optional extras are available for a tip.

name: VoutFlow
tagline: Technical Stock Alerts - Weighted, Filtered & Tiered Watchlists
description: Calculated Technical Shifts - Pre-screened and Tiered. VoutFlow.com tracks Daily, Weekly, and Monthly technical models across thousands of tickers and 30+ sector & theme baskets, then automatically filters and tiers results before you ever open a chart. Using the same modeling system, forecast views run our models against hypothetical price action for the next session, so you can see where technical readings could change before a close confirms them. TLDR; A shorter list of stocks to review, with the technical context attached!

name: any1tan
tagline: Generate or extend AI video clips
description: Generate a short AI video or extend an existing clip. One action per generation or extension, with a first free action for new accounts. Built for quick social video workflows.

name: any1tan
tagline: Estimate embroidery cost and retail pricing
description: A free embroidery pricing calculator for per-item cost and retail quotes, based on editable time, labor, materials and markup. Runs entirely in your browser.

name: BonusCeiling
tagline: See if a credit card bonus is at its all-time high
description: BonusCeiling answers one question: is this credit card's sign-up bonus a good deal right now, or has it been higher? For 50 US personal and business cards from 9 issuers, it puts today's public offer next to the highest public offer we've found for that card, with bonus history and sources. It also has an eligibility checker for issuer rules like Chase 5/24, a minimum-spend calculator, "best time to apply" pages, side-by-side comparisons, and a free weekly email when cards hit a record. Free, no signup. A side project by Tyler Kelly.

name: Artgen — Image to Pixel Art
tagline: Photo to pixel art, ASCII & risograph effects
description: Browser creative studio: turn photos into pixel art (block size, 8/16/32 palettes, dithering), ASCII, risograph; plus AI image styles. Six fixed effects free with sign-in; AI styles use credits.

name: System One API
tagline: Hosted decision-layer API for AI agents (TypeScript SDK)
description: System One API is a hosted decision layer for AI agents: one endpoint to route, judge, and orchestrate model calls. Open-source TypeScript SDK @system-one-ai/core (GitHub stars≈2). Pricing: open source / free tier.

name: AwardWatchdog
tagline: Free federal set-aside bids, recompetes and who-won data
description: AwardWatchdog is a free tracker for small businesses selling to the federal government. Every weekday it pulls open set-aside bids (SB, 8(a), WOSB, SDVOSB, HUBZone) from SAM.gov into pages you can filter by agency, industry and state. It also lists sources sought notices, small-business contracts coming up for recompete (with incumbent, agency and value), and who has been winning in each industry. No login, no paywall. A free weekday email digest matched to your NAICS codes, states and set-asides is optional.

name: Contract Exit Desk
tagline: Keep renewal notice dates, owners and handover notes together
description: A local renewal register for keeping notice dates, responsible people and handover details together. Calculate simple calendar-day or calendar-month notice dates. Record owners, decisions, notice instructions and evidence references. Export calendar snapshots, a handover report and portable backups. One-time US$19 download. Does not interpret legal terms, send notices or run background reminders. Check dates and requirements against the original agreement. Made by Manyice Tools.

name: Photo Export Preflight
tagline: Check every selected photo has its promised export variants
description: A final delivery check for photographers who supply several versions of each selected shot. Compare selected shot names with delivery filenames and variant rules. Find missing and ambiguous matches; optionally scan supported image dimensions. Export a coverage report in HTML, CSV or JSON. One-time US$19 download. Checks configured names and metadata. It does not inspect retouching, color, corruption or successful delivery. Made by Manyice Tools.

name: MonthCue
tagline: Track missing client documents and prepare monthly follow-up drafts
description: A local document-request tracker for solo bookkeepers and small service teams. Track each client and month, with requested, received and correction statuses. Prepare editable follow-up drafts containing outstanding items. Roll a checklist into the next month and export JSON backups or CSV. One-time US$19 download. Does not send emails, collect documents or sync across devices. Back up your browser records regularly. Made by Manyice Tools.

name: Macsmith
tagline: Your favorite CLIs. One native Mac GUI.
description:
Macsmith brings your command-line developer tools into one native Mac GUI. Manage Homebrew packages, switch runtimes with mise and nvm, run Docker through Colima, inspect Lima virtual machines, and start or stop local PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB services.

Find what’s using a port, manage SSH keys, configure local HTTPS, expose localhost through ngrok, and edit hosts files and shell aliases. See your tools’ current state and handle everyday development tasks without looking up commands.

name: BeadColor
tagline: Turn images and ideas into editable fuse bead patterns
description: BeadColor is a browser-based fuse bead pattern maker. Convert an existing image into an editable bead grid for free, with export limits, or create artwork from a photo or written idea using paid AI credits. Adjust colors, edit individual beads, and export PNG or PDF patterns and CSV bead counts. The built-in color reference is MARD 221; compare reference colors with physical beads.

name: InBrowserConvert
tagline: Free file converter that never uploads your files
description:
InBrowserConvert is a free file converter that runs entirely in your web browser. Unlike most online converters, it never uploads your files to a server: every conversion happens on your own device, so your photos and documents stay private. No daily caps, no queue, no account.

It includes 38 free tools: HEIC to JPG, WebP to PNG/JPG/GIF, PNG to JPG, image compression and resizing, plus PDF tools to compress, merge, split and rotate. Available in seven languages; a privacy-friendly alternative to iLoveIMG, CloudConvert, Convertio and FreeConvert.

name: Shotmelo
tagline: Plan visual prompts, save local drafts and export a motion brief
description: Shotmelo is a free browser-based planner for creators preparing image and video prompts. Preview a reference image locally, edit manual prompt templates, save drafts in your browser and export a text plan for your chosen service. The current preview does not analyze images with AI, generate or render images or video, or provide connected accounts or payments.

name: SignPricer
tagline: Free sign pricing calculators for small sign shops.
description: SignPricer is a free browser-based pricing toolkit for small sign shops. It combines material use, waste, labor, equipment, overhead, markup, and gross margin into clear job-cost and selling-price estimates. No signup is required, inputs stay in the browser, and the site includes calculators for banners, yard signs, vinyl decals, print margins, vinyl waste, and installation costs.

name: Paper Banana
tagline: AI academic illustration generator for researchers
description: Paper Banana is an AI academic illustration generator that creates scientific figures, research diagrams and posters from plain-text descriptions. It supports text-to-illustration, image-to-illustration and an editor for refining results, plus specialized makers for flow diagrams, plots and graphic organizers.

name: VidFlux
tagline: AI video generator: turn text and images into video clips
description: VidFlux is an AI video generator powered by ByteDance Seedance. Create clips from text or images with native audio, camera controls, multi-reference input, video extension and timeline editing. Credit-based plans include a commercial license.

name: DimeBaby AI
tagline: Turn any photo into a viral Dime Dime Baby dance video for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts
description: Upload a clear photo of a friend, pet, or yourself. DimeBaby AI turns it into a vertical 9:16 dance video ready for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. One-time credit packs (20 credits per video), no subscription. Independent fan tool, not affiliated with any artist, label, or TikTok.

name: Ozil Goal AI
tagline: Score Mesut Özil's famous 2016 goal yourself, from one photo.
description: Ozil Goal AI recreates Mesut Özil's viral 2016 Ludogorets goal with you on the ball. Upload one photo and get a 14-second vertical video with crowd noise: you chip the keeper, let two defenders slide past and finish into the empty net. Your face, hair and clothes; his moves. From $9.90.

name: Bulin 47 AI
tagline: Star in the Bulin 47 freestyle trend from one photo
description: Bulin 47 AI swaps you into the lead of the viral Bulin 47 street freestyle trend from just one photo. You get a 19-second 9:16 MP4 with the red-lit club, the speaker, the laughing crowd, the shaky phone camera and the original sound. No app, no watermark, and credits back if a generation fails. From $9.99.

name: Burning Bridges AI
tagline: Turn one photo into a Burning Bridges party video
description: Burning Bridges AI turns one photo of one person into a 20-second, 9:16 house-party video in the Burning Bridges trend style, with the original trend audio. No prompt or reference video needed: upload a clear JPG or PNG, generate, and download the MP4. Paid credit packs start at $9.99 per video.

name: MW4 TacMap
tagline: Stranded code lookup and a browser-saved collection checklist
description:
I help maintain MW4 TacMap, an independent free MW4 Stranded guide and browser tool. A useful collection habit is to track opening a lock separately from collecting a crate or reading a nearby note, even when the records share a coordinate. The tool keeps these records separate and saves your checks in this browser, without an account.

Search the schematic map by item name, read access notes, and filter completed records before leaving an area. Four-digit codes keep their leading zeros. Moving freight-train and patrol-truck records remain in the checklist without fixed pins. The schematic does not represent measured terrain or a fastest route, and checking every website record does not prove an in-game achievement. Content is based on published sources, not a claim of firsthand gameplay verification. AI assisted this listing.

name: MachGTM
tagline: An AI sales teammate for B2B software teams.
description: MachGTM is an AI sales teammate for B2B software teams. It learns what you sell from your website and documents, researches leads with dated sources, and drafts first messages for human review. A person reviews and sends each message. Early-access pricing is $1,000 per seat per month, including research for 50 companies.

name: TidyCSV
tagline: Clean CSV files locally. No uploads, signup or subscription.
description: TidyCSV is a free CSV cleaner that runs locally in your browser. Remove duplicate rows, trim whitespace, collapse repeated spaces and drop empty rows. Compare before and after, then export every row. It supports comma, semicolon, tab and pipe separators, plus UTF-8 and Windows-1250 imports. Leading zeros stay as text. The complete offline kit includes MIT-licensed source. No analytics or file uploads in the application. Optional USDT support; no features require payment. Built with AI assistance.

name: Rifd
tagline: Arabic-first medication and appointment organiser for families in Saudi Arabia.
description: Rifd (رِفد) is a family care organiser for Saudi Arabia. Snap a prescription or paste a hospital SMS: AI extracts medications, doses and appointment details, then builds a shared schedule with reminders. Multiple family profiles, per-profile editor access, installable PWA with offline access. Free during the testing period. It organises and reminds; it does not provide medical advice.

name: DLInProgress
tagline: Free TikTok Video Downloader, MP3 Converter & Anonymous Viewer
description: DLInProgress is an online toolkit designed for people who want convenient ways to work with TikTok content. It offers a TikTok video downloader for saving videos without watermarks, an audio extraction tool for converting video sound into MP3 files, and an anonymous TikTok profile viewer. The website also publishes articles, guides, and insights covering online tools, digital media, website trust, and related topics. The tools are accessible through a web browser, without requiring a desktop application.

name: Destiny Book
tagline: Plain-language personal Chinese astrology reports
description: Destiny Book (個人命書) turns your birth details into a readable personal Chinese astrology report that explains the Four Pillars, Five Elements, Ten Gods and luck cycles in plain language for Traditional and Simplified Chinese readers (mainly Hong Kong and Taiwan). Basic report free; deeper sections optional paid.

name: RemoveHandwriting
tagline: AI tool that removes handwriting, pen marks, and annotations from photos, PDFs, and scans
description: AI tool that removes handwriting, pen marks, and annotations from photos, PDFs, and scans while keeping printed text and layout. Freemium with 3 free credits on signup.

name: PocketBatch
tagline: Fit images to a KB limit locally. Keep the program for $5 once.
description:
PocketBatch prepares JPG, PNG and static WebP images for upload limits directly on your device. Choose a KB limit and maximum edge, inspect the result and download it. A free demo works without signup (one image per run, up to 1600 pixels).

Optional offline HTML programs cost $5 Solo, $7 Batch or $9 Studio once. Total images and runs are unlimited, with technical file limits. Solo processes one at a time; Batch and Studio process up to 50 and export a ZIP. Studio adds a text watermark, saved settings and contact sheet. No subscription or per-image fee.

Eight languages; intended for desktop Chrome/Edge. Tight KB limits can reduce dimensions and detail. No HEIC, RAW, PDF or animations. Built with AI assistance; processing requires no AI services.

name: Photo Animate
tagline: Convert vintage and black-and-white portraits into expressive short clips with Photo Animate’s photo-to-video tools built for heritage projects.
description: Convert vintage and black-and-white portraits into expressive short clips with Photo Animate’s photo-to-video tools built for heritage projects. Upload a still photo, add natural motion or a talking-photo effect, and download a shareable MP4. Free starter credits are included; paid one-time credit packs remove watermarks.

name: Brivtools
tagline: Free Online Web & Developer Tools 100% Private in Your Browser
description:

* **File Conversion:** Access tools designed to help with common file conversion tasks.
* **Text Utilities:** Format, process, and manage text for everyday work.
* **Website Utilities:** Find tools that help with website management and related workflows.

## Who Is BrivTools For?

BrivTools is designed for web developers, software engineers, SEO specialists, digital marketers, bloggers, content creators, students, and website owners. Whether you need a quick formatting utility, an image tool, or a resource for your website workflow, BrivTools helps you find practical solutions from a single platform.

## Why Choose BrivTools?

BrivTools focuses on simplicity, accessibility, and convenience. Its collection of online utilities helps reduce the need to switch between multiple websites for everyday tasks. The platform is built with modern web technologies and designed to make its tools straightforward to access and use.

## Free Online Utilities in One Place

Explore BrivTools to discover free online SEO tools, developer utilities, image tools, text formatters, and other web based solutions.

**Visit BrivTools:** https://www.brivtools.com/

Our goal is to make useful online tools accessible and help users spend less time on repetitive tasks and more time getting things done.

name: RooferQuoteHQ
tagline: Quote-first roofing software for solo roofers and small crews.
description: RooferQuoteHQ helps solo roofers and small crews turn a known roof size and editable pricing into clear Good, Better, Best proposals. Contractors can share a public quote link with homeowners and record online acceptance without adopting a full CRM, measurement, or takeoff platform.

name: AI Image Live
tagline: Bring Any Image to Life with AI
description: AI Image Live is an image-to-video tool that turns still pictures into controlled AI short videos (Animate, Cinematic, Talking Photo, Follow Motion). Freemium credits + plans. Not text-to-image.

name: ShelfPic
tagline: Turn product photos into promotional images and UGC-style video ads for local shops
description: ShelfPic helps local shop owners create marketing images and short video ads from existing product photos. Merchants can make content for social media and store promotions using AI-generated UGC-style, unboxing and product-focused video formats. The same browser workspace includes studio and lifestyle product images, background removal and image upscaling. New accounts get 100 free credits without a card. Free image downloads carry a watermark, and video generation requires a paid plan. Paid plans start at $19/month.

name: NexusSun Weekly Update Builder
tagline: Turn your weekly notes into a structured team update, without an account.
description: A free browser-based tool for organising completed work, next priorities, owners, dates, blockers and decisions into a weekly team update. Copy or download plain text, Markdown or JSON, or use your browser’s print/PDF option. Your entries stay in the page and clear on refresh; the builder does not call an AI service. An optional £5 Weekly Team Status document pack is sold separately on Payhip. No purchase is required to use the tool.

name: The Bra Size Calculator
tagline: Free bra size calculator with measurement guidance and fit checks.
description: The Bra Size Calculator is a free browser-based tool that helps users find a starting bra size from their measurements. It supports inches and centimeters, offers quick two-measurement and optional six-measurement methods, and includes international size-label references, size charts, conversion guides, and practical fit checks. Measurements are calculated in the browser and are not uploaded. Results are a starting point for trying bras, since fit varies by brand and shape.

name: PromptPlaza
tagline: PromptPlaza — discover reusable AI prompts; search, filter, pack sets.
description: PromptPlaza (promptplaza.cn) is a prompt and creative-work plaza for creators: browse and filter by tags/categories/themes, preview prompts, and package reusable prompt sets. Built for people who want prompts findable instead of buried in chat logs.

name: Kivana 360
tagline: Keeping Communities Integrated
description: Kivana 360 is a modular mobile and web platform for community management. It helps societies, clubs, alumni networks, business groups, and housing communities run everything in one place. Members and admins can handle directories, events, RSVPs, QR check-ins, payments, dues, donations, announcements, and business connections without relying on messy chat threads. Communities can choose only the modules they need, configure the setup to match their workflows, and grow over time. It also supports revenue features like paid passes and sponsor ads, so the platform can help fund the community too. The goal is simple: give every community a clean, flexible system that fits the way it actually works.

name: imageat
tagline: One subscription for 40+ AI image and video models.
description: imageat is an AI image and video generator that puts 40+ leading models under one subscription and one credit balance: Veo, Kling, Seedance 2.5, Wan 3, Nano Banana, GPT Image, Midjourney and FLUX 3. Create images and videos from text or photos, compare models side by side, follow the latest AI trends at imageat.com/trends, and build on the REST API (imageat.com/docs/api). Plans start at $9.99 per month.

name: Trendai.video
tagline: Create viral AI trend videos from a single photo.
description: Trendai.video lets you star in viral trends with just one photo. Choose from 350+ trend templates, 1,000+ effects and 200+ UGC creators: dance trends, time-freeze and bullet-time scenes, AI drama series, pet videos and more. Upload a photo, pick a template and get a ready-to-post AI video or image for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.

name: Leadnaro
tagline: AI-powered B2B lead generation, research and personalized outreach
description: LeadNaro helps businesses find potential B2B customers, research companies and websites, and create personalized outreach with AI. It is built for web agencies, freelancers, sales teams and small businesses that want a simpler workflow for prospecting and client acquisition.

name: AION2Pets.org
tagline: AION 2 pet atlas and collection tracker in nine languages
description: A free, independent AION 2 pet atlas for players. Browse 207 pets in nine languages, track your collection locally without an account, use area maps and pet guides, and plan upgrades with the pet level and soul calculator. Collection progress can be imported and exported. This unofficial fan resource is not affiliated with NCSoft.

name: Agenlify
tagline: Find AI agents by task, pricing, setup and documented limits.
description: Agenlify is a task-first AI tool directory that compares AI agents by task, pricing, setup and documented limits, with official sources and review dates.

name: ExcelCraft
tagline: Free online Excel editor that opens and edits XLSX locally in your browser.
description: ExcelCraft is a free online Excel editor that processes workbooks entirely on your device. Open XLSX, XLS, XLSM, XLSB, ODS, CSV or TSV, edit with a familiar ribbon and formula bar, then download a new copy. No sign-up and no file upload to a server.

name: DoesQA
tagline: Just get it tested. End-to-end web testing without code.
description: End-to-end testing for every web journey, from sign-up to checkout to the backend systems behind it. Build tests without code, run them on hosted browsers, and see exactly what broke.

name: Hotel Lobby AI
tagline: Turn your photos into the viral Hotel Lobby orange-booth rap video.
description: AI video generator that drops you and a friend into the viral Hotel Lobby rap scene from your photos. Upload one or two photos and get a vertical MP4 with lip-sync and gestures for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.

name: Seedance 2.5
tagline: Seedance 2.5 turns text, images, and references into cinematic AI videos—text-to-video, image-to-video, flexible ratios, private generations.
description: Seedance 2.5 is an AI video creation studio for makers, marketers, and filmmakers. Start from a text prompt or an image, direct motion and camera language, then generate cinematic clips in 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, and more. Pricing includes a free tier, with paid plans from about $29.9 per month.

name: StowMetric
tagline: Visual container, truck and pallet load planning software.
description: Visual load planning for containers, trucks and pallets, with free CBM calculators and a 7-day trial.

name: ShowCountdown
tagline: Remote-controlled stage timer for live events, livestreams and conferences.
description: Browser-based stage timer with separate controller and presenter views, synced rundowns, role-based links and private stage messages. No install.

name: Tadna
tagline: Technology news, product specifications and a side-by-side comparator for phones, processors and operating systems
description: Tadna organises technology product information around a verifiable product identity. Its catalogue brings together product pages and specifications for smartphones, processors and operating systems; the comparator places features side by side; the news section explains recent events; and the knowledge base explores technical concepts such as 5G or IP68. Tadna favours official documentation, keeps data provenance and normalises names, units and values so comparisons are consistent. It does not make or sell the products it describes. Available in Spanish, English, French, Italian, German and Portuguese. — The Tadna team

name: GroupDesk
tagline: Plan Facebook group posts from your Windows computer
description: GroupDesk is Windows software for preparing Facebook posts, organizing account-specific content and reusable group lists, and scheduling publishing. It supports text, images and video, with queue and result views. Available in English and Hebrew for Windows 10/11 x64 with Google Chrome. The computer must remain awake and online during publishing. Group rules, permissions and admin approval still apply.

name: YUVYN
tagline: Free BaZi and Zi Wei charts with optional AI-guided reflection
description: YUVYN calculates free BaZi Four Pillars and Zi Wei birth charts from your birth date, local time, and birthplace. Explore the calculated chart, then read a clearly labeled fictional sample before deciding on an optional one-time AI interpretation about life patterns, relationships, and choices.

name: ClipJoy
tagline: Turn inspiration into your next creation with AI.
description: ClipJoy is an AI creative studio that turns inspiration into ads, films, music videos, animations, UGC, short dramas, explainers, and anime. Add image, video, or audio references and approve key steps before you publish.

name: Love to Color
tagline: Personalized printable coloring pages from text ideas and photos
description: Create black-and-white coloring pages from a text prompt or photo for family activities, classroom materials, or personal coloring time. Love to Color includes a public printable gallery. A free watermarked preview lets people review an AI result before unlocking its PNG with credits.

name: CostumeWalk AI
tagline: Turn one photo into a Ramalama costume walk
description: CostumeWalk AI turns one photo into a Ramalama costume walk video. Upload a selfie, pick a Halloween costume, get a vertical 9:16 MP4 for TikTok. Solo, squad or pet. From $3.99, no CapCut. Independent tool — not affiliated with the artist or TikTok.

name: PDFnoted
tagline: AI PDF workspace: watermark removal, annotation review, compliance check
description: AI-powered PDF reviewer that detects contract risks, regulatory compliance issues (China/EU/US), and sensitive content with source-anchored findings. Hidden watermark detection and one-click PDF cleaning for legal and compliance teams.

name: SellerCenter
tagline: Free DropShipping Product Analysis & Shopify Store Sales Tracker Tool - SellerCenter
description: SellerCenter is a free dropshipping product analysis tool for Shopify! Easily track Shopify store sales and revenue, uncover best-selling products, and instantly connect with top AliExpress dropshipping suppliers.

name: Emoji Start With a Letter
tagline: Browse 1418+ emojis A–Z and copy any one in a single click.
description: Emoji Start With a Letter is a free web utility that organizes 1418+ emojis by the first letter of their Unicode name. Pick any letter A–Z or search by name, then click to copy. Also includes emoji meaning guides, mood-based combos, and a heart-emoji color decoder. No install, no account, no paywall.

name: Polyoptra
tagline: One live grid for GA4, Search Console & page speed across all your sites
description: Polyoptra pulls Google Analytics 4, Search Console and real-visitor page speed (Core Web Vitals) for every website you run into one live grid. It flags any site whose tracking has gone dark, checks uptime and SSL/domain renewals, and sends branded monthly client reports. Built for agencies and multi-site owners. Free for 3 sites; paid plans from $24/mo.

name: Redreamality
tagline: In-depth articles, talks and visual explainers on AI agents and software engineering
description: Redreamality is the personal site of Remy, an AI engineer and independent thinker building with AI agents and thinking out loud. It brings together projects (open-source work, tools and research papers), visuals (interactive explanations and visual stories), a technical blog with articles, tutorials and analysis, talks and slides, and personal meditations on engineering and time. Content is available in English, Chinese and Japanese.

name: Marigold Pet
tagline: Turn one pet photo into a 15s Halloween costume video.
description: Marigold Pet turns one clear pet photo into a finished ~15-second Halloween costume video with synchronized AI-generated audio. Choose a ready look (e.g. Tiny vampire, Pumpkin pop), upload a clear photo, pay $6.99 once—no subscription or prompts. EN & ES.

name: AdGrowth
tagline: On-brand static ads from a pasted site.
description: Paste a site. On-brand stills, ready to download. Upload them to the accounts you already run.

name: BabyMeetsYou
tagline: AI baby portraits from two parent photos — fun keepsake for expecting parents.
description: BabyMeetsYou is a creative portrait tool that blends two parent face photos into a realistic AI baby image. Upload clear photos, pick a style, and get shareable baby portraits in seconds. Free watermarked try on signup; prepaid credit packs when you want more. Built for baby showers and family fun — not medical or genetic advice.

name: AI Baby Generator
tagline: See your future baby from two parent photos.
description: Wondering what your baby will look like? AI Baby Generator creates a realistic future baby preview from two parent photos in seconds.

name: Prop Firm Consistency
tagline: Prop Firm Consistency Calculator — check your plan's consistency rule before you request a payout.
description: Check your prop firm consistency rule. Calculate your best-day percentage, required profit and remaining gap with plan-specific, source-linked presets. Free online calculator for funded futures and forex traders, no sign-up needed.

name: WebTaskTools
tagline: Free browser-based video, PDF, image and SEO tools — no signup, no watermarks.
description: WebTaskTools is a collection of free online tools you can use straight in your browser. Open a tool and get the job done in seconds — convert a video, merge two PDFs, shrink an image for the web, or check your page's meta tags. There is no account to create, nothing to install, and no watermarks added to your files.

name: Roomture
tagline: AI interior and exterior design from a single photo
description: Roomture transforms a photo of a room, home exterior, or garden into realistic AI redesign concepts. Explore design styles, preserve the original structure, and refine results with paint, flooring, layout, object replacement, and cleanup tools. Built for homeowners, renters, and design or property professionals.

name: Petal
tagline: Your personal PDF editor. Just type what you need.
description: Petal is a personal PDF editor: upload files and type what you want. Merge, split, convert, watermark and extract text in plain words. Files auto-deleted in 1-2 days. Free: 5 edits/day, 25 MB. Pro: $2/month or ₹199/month.

name: Lingmirage
tagline: Practical AI skill packs for everyday work
description: Lingmirage publishes free AI tutorials and sells downloadable skill packs (guides, prompts, and reusable workflows) for creators and professionals. Packs cover content repurposing, product video, AI headshots, and 3D product websites. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and coding agents.

name: MemeFX AI
tagline: Put your photo in today's trending AI videos
description: MemeFX AI turns photos into viral meme videos. Pick a trend template, upload 1–3 photos, get the moves and song. No prompt. Ready for TikTok, Reels, Shorts. Pay per video, no subscription.

name: Bad Times AI
tagline: Turn One Photo into a Viral 15-Second AI Video
description:
Bad Times AI is an online AI video generator that turns a single authorised photo into an original 15-second vertical video with expressive motion and AI-generated audio.

Choose from three video templates: Human, Pet, or Baby. Simply upload a clear photo, confirm you have permission to use it, and let AI create an entertaining short-form video without filming or complicated editing software.

Key Features:

- AI Image to Video: Transform one photo into a new AI-generated video.
- Three Video Templates: Choose Human, Pet, or Baby.
- Original AI Audio: Generate sound alongside the video.
- 15-Second Videos: Create short videos with expressive motion.
- Vertical 9:16 Format: Ideal for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
- Simple Online Workflow: Upload a photo and start generating.
- MP4 Downloads: Download your finished AI video.
- No Subscription: Purchase credits whenever you need them.

Bad Times AI is designed for content creators, social media users, and anyone who wants to turn photos into entertaining AI-generated videos.

Create your Bad Times AI video at https://badtimesai.pro/

name: Bulin 47 AI
tagline: Turn One Photo into a 15-Second AI Freestyle Rap Video
description:
Bulin 47 AI is an online AI video generator that transforms a single authorised adult photo into an original 15-second freestyle rap video with expressive motion, Spanish rap vocals, and generated music.

Simply upload a clear portrait, confirm you have permission to use it, and let AI create a new street-style freestyle performance. There is no need for filming, advanced editing skills, or complicated video production software.

Key Features:

- AI Image to Video: Turn one photo into a dynamic freestyle rap performance.
- Original AI Audio: Generate Spanish rap vocals, background music, and crowd ambience.
- 15-Second Videos: Create short videos designed for social media.
- Vertical 9:16 Format: Suitable for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
- Simple Online Workflow: Upload a portrait and let AI generate the performance.
- MP4 Downloads: Save your generated videos for sharing.

tagline: Plain-English monthly website reports for your clients
description:
CareProof is for solo web designers and small studios who sell monthly care or hosting plans to local businesses like plumbers, electricians, roofers and cleaners. Clients rarely see the work behind a care plan, so they ask what they are paying for. CareProof shows them.

Add a client site and write a short "What I did this month" note. The send day starts as the day you added the site, and you can change it from the 1st to the 28th. CareProof runs nine checks from the outside and emails your client a plain-English report on the morning of that day (US time) every month: is the site up, days left on the padlock and the domain, mobile speed, title and description, share image, icon, robots file and sitemap, business details for Google, and readable page text. A quiet month still gets a report. Need one sooner? "Send report now" sends this month's report so far. You can preview the report first. Client replies come to you.

There's also a free Website Health Grader with no sign-up. Paste any website address, your own or a client's, and get a 0 to 100 score with a result page you can share. It's handy for starting a care-plan conversation with a prospect.

There's no plugin and no logins to hand over, so it works the same on WordPress, Wix, Framer, Lovable and other builders. CareProof doesn't check backups, fix problems, or connect to Search Console or Analytics. On Pro, reports carry your logo, brand colour and sender name. The unsubscribe link and page are run by our email provider.

Free for 1 client site, forever. No card needed for the free plan. Pro is $9/mo or $69/yr for 10 client sites, with packs of 10 more at the same price. Prices in USD. Full refund within 7 business days of your first payment. Cancel anytime from Manage billing. CareProof is sold by dm2, LLC. Support: support@getcareproof.com.

name: PlainRenew
tagline: Renewal reminders, a one-click cancel page and per-customer proof records for Stripe subscription businesses.
description:
PlainRenew helps subscription businesses that bill through Stripe keep renewals clear and cancelling easy, so the customers who stay are the ones who want to.

Connect Stripe in about two minutes, with no code needed to start. PlainRenew maps each customer to the rules where they live, based on their billing address: US federal (ROSCA), California, New York State, New York City, the EU and the UK (from January 2027). Then it runs on its own:

- A cancel page that just works: one click for the customer, cancelled in Stripe right away, with an emailed receipt. EU customers get the two-step withdrawal function. An optional save offer sits beside the cancel button, never in front of it.
- A record you can stand behind: the terms shown at checkout, every notice sent and every cancel, exported per customer as a PDF.

Rule packs are versioned, so reminders and the cancel page keep up as rules change.

Free checker: plainrenew.com/check scores your cancel flow and gives plain-English fixes in about a minute.

Plans: Starter $29/month, Growth $79, Scale $199 and Agency $399, each with a 14-day free trial. PlainRenew is software, not legal advice.

name: Convert Right Now

Convert Right Now is a free online platform that brings together practical tools for working with files, PDFs, images, colors, dates, units, and other everyday digital tasks.

The platform offers a range of tools, including PDF conversion, merging, splitting, annotation and organization; image conversion, resizing, compression and editing; background removal; color picking and palette generation; date and unit conversion; writing analysis; QR code and barcode generation; password generation; and audio extraction from supported video files.

name: SuccessionKeeper
tagline: Keep track of what you have and where it is held.
description:

SuccessionKeeper is a UK-built private financial inventory for recording where bank accounts, pensions, investments, insurance policies, property records and important documents are held. It does not connect to banks or financial providers, does not require provider passwords and cannot move money. 
Users can add as much or as little information as they want, nominate the people who should receive the information if needed, and choose how often SuccessionKeeper checks in with them. If they stop responding, a controlled-release process begins. Their primary nominee is asked to try to reach them first, and only if the full process completes without a response is a structured summary released. Nominees never receive access to the SuccessionKeeper account.
The service is protected with AES-256 encryption, UK hosting and two-factor authentication. It costs £4/month or £39/year after a 14-day free trial with no card required. Unlimited accounts and nominees are included, and users can download or delete their data at any time.
