tagline: 112 free image tools that run in your browser. No uploads.
description: Flipaview is a set of 112 free, single-purpose image tools: HEIC to JPG (batch), compress to KB, resize, crop, flip/mirror, collage maker, screenshot to text (OCR), remove background, PDF to image, passport/social sizes and more. Everything is processed on your device, so files are never uploaded. No sign-up, no watermark.

name: Calculator Online Pro
tagline: Free Online Calculators for Fast, Accurate Results
description: CalculatorOnlinePro offers free, fast, and easy-to-use online calculators for age, time, conversions, and everyday calculations. Get instant results without sign-ups or downloads, with a responsive experience across desktop and mobile devices.

name: The Hospitality Insider
tagline: Free restaurant, bar and hotel calculators, no signup.
description: Free, fast calculators for hospitality operators: food cost %, recipe cost, menu price, pour cost, labor %, prime cost, tip pool and tip-out, break-even, RevPAR, ADR, GOPPAR and more. Each page shows the formula and a worked example. No signup, nothing uploaded, shareable results, and every calculator embeds free on your own site.

name: DaodaoVPS
tagline: Cheap VPS price comparison and restock alerts
description: DaodaoVPS tracks low-cost VPS plans from providers such as RackNerd, BandwagonHost, BuyVM and Tencent Cloud. It monitors stock in real time, compares prices across currencies, and pushes alerts when sold-out plans come back. 409 plans tracked, from $1.50/month.

name: EmojiFinder
tagline: Search and copy 1780+ emojis in one click
description: EmojiFinder.cc is a free web tool for finding emojis fast. Search 1780+ emojis by keyword, browse categories, and copy any emoji with one click. Each emoji has a detail page showing how it renders on different platforms. ASCII symbols included, 20 interface languages, no sign-up.

name: DropLink
tagline: Share files by link or QR code, no app to receive
description: DropLink lets you share photos, videos, documents, apps or text from iPhone, Android, Mac or Windows using a simple link or QR code. Files stay on your sending device: on the same Wi-Fi, transfers go directly over the local network; across networks, a relay forwards the transfer without storing the files. Recipients only need a browser, with no app install or account.

name: FontStyler
tagline: Font Generator for All
description: FontStyler.org makes it easy to create stylish text without installing special fonts. Explore different Unicode text styles, copy your favorite result, and use it in compatible social media profiles, usernames, bios, and posts.

name: Good People Fishing
tagline: Explore overlooked skills and possible practical collaborations
description: A free, optional questionnaire for UK adults aged 18+ to explore everyday abilities, working preferences and possible practical collaboration. Choose a route, skip questions, see a map based on your own answers, and try optional fictional mini challenges. No CV is needed to explore. A human introduction is optional. This is a conversation starter, not a professional aptitude or psychological assessment. No position, project or income is guaranteed; any actual work, scope, pay, expenses and ownership would be agreed separately before work begins.

name: FreeConverto
tagline: FreeConverto is a free online toolkit for converting images and PDFs quickly and easily, with no software installation required.
description: FreeConverto is an all-in-one free online toolkit for converting images and PDFs directly in your browser. Easily convert JPG, PNG, WebP, and other image formats, manage PDF files, and simplify everyday file conversion without installing software. Fast, easy to use, and accessible from any device, FreeConverto helps students, professionals, creators, and everyday users get things done online.

name: Scritur
tagline: One AI tutor for every lecture, PDF and note
description: Scritur turns YouTube lectures, PDFs, websites and notes into one AI tutor. Ask questions with cited answers, generate flashcards and quizzes, run spaced repetition, and export everything - with a genuinely useful free tier.

name: Alphaize
tagline: AI image editor and generator that shows its plan first
description: Edit photos or generate images with an AI agent. See the plan and credit cost before it runs, keep every version, and use free in-browser color tools.

name: Materix
tagline: AI tools for game development, checked and compared
description: Independent directory of AI tools for game development, sorted by assets, code, audio, localization and release work, with pricing and terms checked. It lists 41 tools in twelve categories.

name: Plaith
tagline: More ad budget. Less ad work.
description: Plaith runs your Facebook and Instagram ads. Plaithy, our AI engine, creates image and video ads and tests the next variant. More ad budget. Less ad work.

name: Antigravity Reset
tagline: Track public Antigravity quota reset announcements and history
description: Antigravity Reset is an unofficial community web tracker for public Antigravity quota reset announcements. It presents source-linked updates, elapsed time since a recorded reset, and a calendar of reset history with local-time and UTC views. The interface supports English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean. Public announcements do not guarantee when an individual account becomes available.

name: PokeBonk
tagline: Free 3D Pokemon-inspired survivors-like fangame in your browser
description: PokeBonk is a free 3D survivors-like fangame inspired by Pokemon and Megabonk. Play instantly in your browser with no download. Pick a starter, survive waves of wild creatures, evolve your team, upgrade your lab, and plan builds with the tier list and starter quiz.

name: Money Tracker Expense & Budget
tagline: Expense tracker and budget app with AI voice and receipt entry — no bank login needed.
description: Money Tracker is a free (with ads) expense tracker and budget app for Android and iPhone. Log spending by typing, AI voice, or receipt photo — then edit the result before you save. Set budgets, use multi-currency books, split bills (AA), and share team books. Does not link bank accounts. Optional yearly Premium removes ads and unlocks extras such as unlimited AI entry and Android Smart Notification Entry (saves only after you confirm).

name: Am I Hot
tagline: AI facial analysis and photo feedback for your personal image
description: Am I Hot is a browser-based AI facial analysis tool. Users can upload a clear frontal photo, view feature-level feedback, and explore suggestions about photo presentation and personal image. The website offers paid credit packages and supports multiple languages. AI feedback is subjective and should not be treated as a scientific measure of attractiveness or personal worth.

name: Rentalot
tagline: Rentalot: the AI Agent for Leasing Agents.
description: Rentalot is the AI leasing assistant for leasing agents. Paste your listing text and AI builds the property page. Renters answer your screening questions by voice or text from one link you can drop into any listing site, and you get comparable answers side by side. Book showings, manage contacts and properties by just asking, or let your own AI (Claude, ChatGPT) drive it through MCP, the CLI or the REST API. The AI collects and organises; you approve what matters. Self-serve, month-to-month, free trial.

name: Ziji (咨记)
tagline: Practice management for Chinese-speaking counselors
description: Ziji is practice-management SaaS for Chinese-speaking counselors and counselling studios: online booking, structured client records, SOAP/DAP/custom session notes, transcript-to-notes, and AI-assisted organization reviewed by the counselor. Data is stored in mainland China on Alibaba Cloud, encrypted in transit and at rest, and de-identified before AI processing; it is never used for model training. Free trial, then subscription.

name: WARDOGS Field Guide
tagline: Independent player guides for WARDOGS
description: An independent WARDOGS fan guide with gameplay explanations, role guides, PC requirements, and release and access information in English, German and French. Not affiliated with BULKHEAD, Team17 or Valve.

name: AITeamGuide
tagline: Find the right AI agent for the job, with real pricing
description: AITeamGuide is an independent directory of 750+ AI agents, sorted by the job you need done: sales, support, coding, SEO, finance, legal and more. Full listings show public pricing with the date it was checked. Rankings are never paid. Plus credited use cases, an open-source Hub and a weekly email.

name: PaperFig
tagline: AI scientific figures with editable labels, built-in OCR, and 4K
description: PaperFig is an AI scientific figure maker for researchers. Describe an idea or upload a sketch, reference image, or PDF to generate a polished figure draft for mechanisms, workflows, and graphical abstracts. Built-in OCR helps extract and correct labels, with PNG, PDF, and high-resolution 4K PNG options.

name: 2 Minute Drill
tagline: NFL last-two-minutes comeback strategy game
description: 2 Minute Drill is a free browser NFL strategy game where you run the last two minutes of a game and try to complete the comeback. Built by indie developer Chaozi.

name: Daily Red
tagline: Daily Pokemon battle against Red's fixed team
description: Daily Red is a free daily Pokemon battle challenge against Red's fixed team, with a new lineup every day. Built by indie developer Chaozi.

name: Farflung
tagline: Daily geography puzzle game
description: Farflung is a free daily geography puzzle game that plays in the browser. A new puzzle every day. Built by indie developer Chaozi.

name: Noillirk
tagline: Multiplayer party game: predict what most people answer
description: Noillirk is a free multiplayer browser party game where you predict what most people will answer. 7 questions, 15 seconds each. Built by indie dev Chaozi.

name: Reference to Video
tagline: Turn a reference video and your photos into a new clip
description: Reference to Video turns a reference clip and your photos into a new AI video that follows the original movement. Pick a template or upload a 2-15s clip.

name: Genjutsu AI
tagline: Recast any video with your own people, pets or products
description: Genjutsu AI is an AI video generator for motion transfer and object swap. Pick a trend preset or upload a clip, add your photos, and recast the scene.

name: Mibly: Health Data for AI
tagline: Apple Health, for your AI agent.
description: Mibly shares the Apple Health metrics you choose (sleep stages, steps, heart rate, HRV, workouts, weight, cycle) with MCP-compatible AI agents. Local mode is free and pushes data to an open-source receiver you run yourself; Cloud Pro syncs through Mibly Relay so agents can reach it remotely. Per-type toggles, cycle data never leaves the device. Context for your AI, not a medical device.

name: Tucked: Gridfinity Tray Maker
tagline: Turn a photo of any object into a 3D-printable storage tray.
description: Tucked turns a photo or a few dimensions into a custom storage tray you can 3D print. Place an object on A4 or US Letter paper and snap a photo; Tucked detects the outline on-device and builds a tray with a matching pocket. Gridfinity mode auto-sizes bins to the 42 mm grid. Adjust depth, clearance and finger notches, add multiple pockets, and export STL. No CAD needed. Not affiliated with the creator of Gridfinity.

name: Migos AI Video
tagline: Turn two photos into a 15-second Hotel Lobby AI duet video in 9:16.
description: Migos AI Video is an independent two-photo Hotel Lobby AI video generator. Upload one photo per performer and it creates a vertical orange-studio duet with preset reference audio. Each video is 15 seconds at 720p in 9:16 format, no prompt needed. Sign in and buy a one-time credit pack to generate.

name: ReelCrew
tagline: Turn one photo into a 12-second AI video from templates
description: ReelCrew turns one or two photos into a 12-second vertical video (1080x1920, with music) using ready-made templates such as hug, couple, Halloween and costume reveal. No editor or filming needed. Uploads go through consent checks, photos are auto-deleted, and outputs carry C2PA AI-content labels. One free watermarked preview per day; HD downloads are $9.99 per video or $19.99 for three, with no subscription.

name: CUEGEO
tagline: Taiwan GEO agency helping brands get cited by ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity
description: CUEGEO is a Taiwan GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) agency and trust middleware platform. We help brands increase citations, mentions and recommendations in answers from ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Copilot, with evidence-chain strategy for Traditional Chinese markets.

name: EliminarPaginas
tagline: Free Spanish PDF page tools that keep documents in your browser
description: EliminarPaginas is a free Spanish-language web tool for removing, extracting, reordering and rotating PDF pages. PDF documents are processed locally in the browser without uploading the files to a server. It is designed for people who need a simple way to manage PDF pages without creating an account.

name: InvoiceTemplatePDF
tagline: Free invoices and receipts, made for each country
description: Pick your country, fill in the form and download a PDF invoice or receipt that follows local rules (US, Brazil, Indonesia, Germany, France). The preview matches the PDF you download. Your document fields stay on your device.

name: Fate & Stars
tagline: Free AI tarot readings with the full 78-card deck
description: Fate & Stars is an AI tarot reading site. Ask a question, draw from the 78-card Rider–Waite–Smith deck and get a personal AI interpretation. Yes/no, love, one-card, two-choices and daily tarot spreads plus a full card meanings library. One free reading every day; optional subscription for follow-ups and history.

name: TheFaceRating
tagline: Rate your face. Then wear it well.
description: TheFaceRating is a free AI face rating and face analyzer: a 478-landmark scan in your browser, no signup required. It also offers 12-season color analysis plus AI hairstyle and outfit virtual try-on.

name: MatchMyNumber
tagline: Explore yourself and your relationships through birthday numerology
description: MatchMyNumber brings Life Code numerology into an English-language web experience. Enter a first name and birth date to explore a free personal reading, then compare with a partner, friend or family member. Optional one-time paid report unlocks offer further detail. The initial reading requires no account. Built for entertainment, self-reflection and conversation, not scientific prediction.

name: Persona Lab
tagline: Spicy personality quizzes with shareable result cards
description: Persona Lab runs free spicy personality quizzes — Work Species, Moments Persona, Spend DNA. Finish in minutes, download a result card, copy a duel invite for friends. Fully free, no account, bilingual ZH/EN.

name: TapeMuse
tagline: Turn one memory into a personalized AI song gift
description: TapeMuse turns one memory into a personalized AI-generated song gift. Preview the original song, then send a private page anyone can open without an account. A heartfelt alternative to gift cards for weddings, birthdays and anniversaries.

name: SoldFetch
tagline: eBay listing data for apps and agents
description: SoldFetch provides eBay listing data for developers, pricing tools, and resellers. Search sold and active listings, browse categories, and look up individual items through REST or MCP. An installable eBay skill supports agent workflows. Responses preserve displayed-price context and explicit uncertainty around accepted offers and sale dates. Start with 100 free units; paid plans start at $9/month.

name: EbookNest · 书径
tagline: Find foreign nonfiction books with Chinese introductions
description: EbookNest (书径) is a Chinese-language catalog for readers exploring foreign nonfiction books, mainly English originals. Search titles and authors, browse topics such as woodworking, photography, sports and sailing, and explore Chinese introductions, selected page previews and related books. Topic guides offer starting points for reading. Browsing is currently free and does not require an EbookNest account. Available PDF links open Baidu Netdisk, which may require its own account. Books are third-party works; this is not an open-licensed textbook repository. Submitted by the maintainer. The website was developed with AI assistance.

name: Dime Dime Baby
tagline: Upload one photo → fixed ~15s 9:16 Dime Dime Baby dance AI video. No prompt.
description: Dime Dime Baby turns one photo into a fixed ~15-second vertical 9:16 dance AI video — quinceañera entrance, pan dulce bite, stare into camera — 720p preview for TikTok, Reels, Shorts. No prompt writing.

name: PageColor AI
tagline: Create your next coloring page. Color it your way
description: PageColor AI helps you create and color custom coloring pages — text-to-line-art, photo-to-line-art (Pro/Studio), name pages, and an online coloring editor. Text AI needs Google sign-in; Photo AI is paid; sample coloring works without signing in.

name: EnvTrace
tagline: Check fingerprint, IP & WebRTC before you log in
description: EnvTrace is a free online toolkit for browser, network, and account environment checks. It provides tools and practical guides for browser fingerprints, IP addresses, WebRTC, proxies, account environments, 2FA, and related online environment diagnostics.

name: yourmelody
tagline: Personalized AI song gifts, ready in minutes
description: yourmelody turns what you know about someone into an original song with their name in it. Answer a few questions in about three minutes. AI writes the lyrics, you edit them, and an AI voice sings two versions. Hear a free preview, then unlock the full song as MP3s for $6.99. Made for birthdays, anniversaries, weddings and holidays.

name: AnySport
tagline: Football live scores, fixtures, odds & match stats API for developers
description: AnySport is a football (soccer) live scores, fixtures, odds and match stats API for developers. REST + WebSocket, free tier available. Docs: https://docs.anysport.io/

name: Lecturecast
tagline: Turn course material into landscape and portrait lecture videos.
description: Lecturecast is an AI course video generator. It creates landscape and portrait course videos from a signed cloud production plan, with three human approval steps and local media rendering, so teachers stay in control of the final video.

name: Home AI Studio
tagline: AI Sketch to Render | Interior Design & Architecture Rendering
description: Home AI Studio is an AI design platform for architects, interior designers, landscape designers, and homeowners. Upload a sketch, photo, or 3D model and get photorealistic renders in ~10 seconds. Free tier: 50 credits/month.

name: Google Maps Email Extractor
tagline: Chrome extension that finds business emails on Google Maps.
description: Google Maps Email Extractor helps sales teams and agencies build local lead lists. Search Maps for a niche and city, and it collects business names, emails, phones, websites, addresses and social profiles, removes duplicates, and exports CSV, Excel or JSON. Free plan includes 200 leads.

name: Spontificant
tagline: Gentle nudges to breathe and reset — no streaks, no scores.
description: Spontificant sends gentle, randomly timed nudges through your day. Choose how many nudges you want and when they can arrive, then take a breath, name a gratitude, or write a custom nudge of your own. It includes quiet hours and a free tier for iOS and Android. Premium is $2.99/month or $24.99/year and adds more active nudges, per-nudge quiet hours, specific days, premium content, and sync across devices. No streaks, scores, or feed.

name: Screenshot Shortcuts - How to Screenshot on Any Device
tagline: Free guide to screenshot shortcuts on any device
description: Free guide to taking screenshots on Mac, Windows, iPhone, Android, Chromebook and Linux: exact keyboard shortcuts for full screen, window or area captures.

name: ChangeTextImage
tagline: Replace or Remove Text in Images
description: ChangeTextImage is an AI-assisted tool for replacing or removing text in images. Upload a JPG, PNG, or static WebP image, select the text area, and enter new wording or remove the existing text. Use it to correct typos or update prices, dates, and labels without recreating the entire image. The AI aims to match the surrounding text style and repair the background. Results vary depending on the image and edit. New users receive one free generation after signup, with additional edits available through one-time credit purchases.

name: Keptrow
tagline: Spreadsheet tools for small exporters and trade shows
description:
Keptrow makes simple spreadsheet tools for small exporters and trade show exhibitors who collect leads faster than they can follow up.

- Lead Follow-Up Tracker: grade every lead A, B or C, follow a Day 1 to Day 90 plan, and see who is due for a follow-up today. Pre-written email and WhatsApp messages you review and send yourself.
- Free Export Quotation Template: price breaks, MOQ, lead time and deposit in one clean quote.
- Works in Google Sheets and LibreOffice, built for Excel with standard formulas only. No sign-up, no app to install.

Free versions are available to try first.

name: Licitu
tagline: Follow public tenders, procurement results and market news
description: Licitu brings public tenders, procurement results and market news into one feed. Explore countries and sectors, follow organisations, and save relevant updates. Publications link to their sources so you can check the evidence.

name: Clearframe Client & Invoice Tracker (Free)
tagline: A free spreadsheet for freelancers to track clients and invoices: paid, due and overdue at a glance.
description: A free Google Sheets and Excel template for freelancers. List your clients, log the invoices you send, and add the paid date when money arrives. The sheet calculates each invoice's status (Paid, Due or Overdue), counts days overdue, and shows a one-page dashboard of what's unpaid, overdue and due in the next 7 days. Comes with a filled-in example copy. No macros, no subscriptions, no logins. Record keeping only: it doesn't create or send invoices.

name: SellerFile Studio
tagline: Browser-local CSV converter, Shopify product-file checker and duplicate SKU finder for online sellers
description: A set of free browser-based CSV tools for merchants: convert supplier columns to Shopify product files, diagnose product CSV formatting issues, and report duplicate SKUs with row numbers. Files are processed locally in your browser; no account or upload to a server. Independent, not affiliated with Shopify.

name: GearMatched
tagline: Studio monitors matched to your room
description: Answer a few quick questions about your room and get studio monitors that fit it, ranked with independent spinorama.org measurements. Free, no account needed.

name: ResetPacket
tagline: Solar detach and reset photo reports. Both visits. One PDF.
description: ResetPacket helps solar removal and reinstallation crews prepare a clear PDF handoff for roofing partners. Pair before-and-after photos by location, record panel storage and custody notes, list open items, and review the packet before printing. The free builder needs no signup and keeps job photos on the device. Pro is $49 once for a local job library, reusable templates, company logo branding and an offline edition. The tool organizes supplied records; it does not inspect or certify the work.

name: Wellness Whizz
tagline: Free supplement quiz with study references and safety notes
description: Free educational AI supplement advisor. A short quiz about goals, diet and lifestyle returns a supplement shortlist with study references, typical doses and safety notes. Includes guides, a protein calculator and a photo shelf scanner. English and Spanish, no account or paywall. Affiliate links disclosed; not diagnosis or treatment.

name: Fireply AI
tagline: AI replies on X that actually sound like you
description: Fireply is an AI reply agent for X (Twitter). It learns your voice from your posts, watches the accounts and lists you choose, and posts timely, context-aware replies for you. Start with 40 free replies, no card.

name: PhotoCraft — photo-craft.online
tagline: Free open-source Photoshop-comparable photo editor in your browser
description: PhotoCraft is a free, open-source photo editor that runs entirely in your browser — layers, masks, adjustment layers, and full PSD import/export, no account needed

name: SupperSaver
tagline: Dinner figured out, starting with your pantry.
description: Pantry-aware dinner ideas, meal planning, serving adjustments and grocery lists for busy households. Try all app features free for 7 days, then $3.99 per month or $39.99 per year until canceled. A payment method and ChatGPT sign-in are required. Cancel before the trial ends to avoid a charge. Pantry and meal-plan data stay in your browser. Grocery estimates are illustrative, not live prices or guaranteed savings.

name: Backwoods & Bluewater
tagline: Plan the trip. Check conditions. Keep your stories.
description: A browser app for hunting and fishing trip planning, with solunar estimates, weather, Florida public hunting lands, boat launches and reef reference maps, plus a personal field journal. Membership costs $4.99 per month and renews until canceled. ChatGPT sign-in required. Outdoor information is for planning; verify current access and conditions with official sources.

name: LimitDigest
tagline: AI plan prices, usage limits and resets, checked hourly
description: LimitDigest is a hub for AI plan limits, resets and models. Compare ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini and more by plan price and usage limits, track usage resets with a live countdown, compare AI API prices, find local models for your hardware, see the best model per task, and check plan vs API cost with a calculator. Official sources only, free, no signup.

name: Client Review Desk
tagline: Keep design feedback and client decisions with the version reviewed.
description: Client Review Desk is a hosted workspace for independent designers and small studios reviewing image-based work with clients. Organise project briefs and review rounds, share a revocable review link, and keep feedback and decisions attached to the version the client saw. Clients can review without creating an account. Studio costs US$12 per month for one owner and one business, with five active projects, 25 projects in total and ten review rounds per project. Each round supports up to three PNG, JPEG or WebP images, up to 2 MB each. Owners sign in with ChatGPT and activate their Gumroad licence. A public fictional example demonstrates the workflow. The service does not send automatic emails or provide verified signatures. Records can be exported as JSON, with image downloads available separately. Subscription details: https://anwarious5.gumroad.com/l/client-review-desk

name: Questora
tagline: Promote links and play Crypto Memory on Telegram
description: Questora is a Telegram Mini App where users can promote websites, bots and channels using QERIA in-app points or Telegram Stars, complete rewarded community tasks and compete in Crypto Memory weekly rankings for GRAM cryptocurrency prizes under active competition rules. QERIA are currently points, not a cashable cryptocurrency. Open at https://t.me/Questeorabot.

name: GDPRGard
tagline: AI Powered Compliance Tools
description: GDPRGard is a compliance platform and suite of practical AI privacy tools designed to help European small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) navigate GDPR Compliance Checklist requirements.

name: WatchMe.buzz
tagline: Live 1:1 and group video chat where you choose who you see.
description: Live 1:1 and group video chat where you choose who you see. All-women room, block numbers, skip anytime. $2 to start, then $1/month. Features include closest-first Randomizer, group rooms up to 5, all-women room, filters, in-call text, phone-number blocking, skip anytime, and 19 languages.

name: FerimanEdge
tagline: Rule-based crypto market-regime analytics for BTC, ETH and BNB
description: FerimanEdge is a rule-based cryptocurrency market-regime analytics service covering Bitcoin, Ethereum and BNB. It tracks predefined market conditions, publishes historical outcomes and provides a transparent methodology. Public Access is free with a 24-hour delay, while Full Access delivers real-time Edge Updates through Discord. No exchange connection, automated trade execution, copy trading or personalized financial advice.

name: Blue Engine Automations Directory
tagline: Sourced list of AI phone and chat agents for restaurants
description: A plain list of 47 AI tools that answer calls, texts, chats, and DMs for restaurants and small businesses. Every price links to its source and check date.

name: Listara.ro
tagline: Free Romanian classifieds and jobs platform, an alternative to OLX
description: Listara.ro is a free Romanian classifieds platform, an alternative to OLX, with thousands of job listings plus auto and services ads. Posting is free.

name: RadarMakers
tagline: Indie product launches scored on quality, not hype
description: RadarMakers is a launchpad and directory for products built by independent makers. Makers submit a product with a description, screenshots and links, and the community browses, upvotes and comments on new launches. Instead of ranking only by launch day votes, every product can be rated on four axes: idea, execution, design and value. Makers who want blunt feedback before launch week can request a product audit that scores the same four axes and ranks what to fix first. A community section collects guides and maker stories on pricing, onboarding and finding first customers, and a weekly newsletter rounds up new launches every Friday. RadarMakers is early stage and growing.

name: Peekly
tagline: Free Open Graph / social link-preview checker
description: Peekly is a free Open Graph and social link-preview checker. Paste any URL to see how it looks when shared on X, Facebook, LinkedIn, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp and more. Get a pass/fail meta tag checklist and copy-ready tags that fix broken previews. No signup. Made by Anthony Pan.

name: Egmatic
tagline: From first scene to published 2D game, no code
description: Egmatic is a no-code editor for 2D games, built for solo developers and small teams who want to ship, not just prototype. Game logic is assembled in a visual node editor, scenes are built with drag and drop, and real-time preview gives instant feedback without a build step. One project exports to Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS and Web, so publishing is not a separate project of its own. The editor writes clean, versioned JSON contracts and the runtime is a separate engine on .NET 9 and MonoGame, so a game never gets locked inside the tool. The roadmap follows the same goal: player accounts, cloud saves and leaderboards without writing or hosting a backend. The product is being built AI-native, with AI assistance planned inside the editor. During early access Egmatic is completely free.

name: Utiliko
tagline: CRM, help desk, projects and accounting in one business suite
description: Utiliko puts the apps a growing company runs on into one suite: CRM, support ticketing, projects, accounting with recurring invoices, a knowledge base, and estimates and proposals. It is built for US companies with 10 to 1,000 employees. Instead of paying for separate tools for sales, support, projects and billing, a team can keep customers, tickets, work and invoices in one suite. Teams can start with one app and add the others when they need them, or take the full Suite. For companies moving from another system, we clean and map your data, you click import, live the same day. Utiliko is built by Utiliko Corporation in Dallas, Texas. 14 days free. No credit card.

name: agentstock
tagline: License-clean stock images & video for AI agents — semantic search, pay-per-use.
description: agentstock.dev is a stock media marketplace built for AI agents. Semantic search over a license-clean catalog of images and video, with pay-per-use purchase via x402 on Base. Exposed as a remote MCP server (streamable HTTP) so an AI agent can find and buy the right asset programmatically — no subscription required.

name: OfferMagnet
tagline: Find matching jobs, tailor your resume and automate applications
description: OfferMagnet is a job search autopilot for people looking for work. It finds matching jobs daily, tailors resumes to each posting without adding skills the user lacks and auto-applies when the job seeker turns that on.

name: FoxPhone
tagline: Isolated cloud phones your AI agents can run at scale
description: FoxPhone gives you real Android phones in the cloud. Every cloud phone is an isolated environment with its own device fingerprint and dedicated IP. Control one or hundreds from a browser, and let AI agents batch-install apps and run tasks. Free trial available.

name: Linkedleads
tagline: Find potential clients with live LinkedIn research
description: Linkedleads helps freelancers, consultants and small agencies research potential clients using live LinkedIn people, company, job and post searches. AI Search turns a plain-language request into supported filters, while saved lists, CSV exports and signals help organize research and monitor new opportunities. One-time 30-day passes start at $15, with no automatic renewal.

name: Flowdara
tagline: Client booking and practice management software built for Reiki, breathwork, sound healing and other alternative healing practitioners.
description: Flowdara is a client booking and practice management platform built for alternative healing practitioners, including Reiki healers, breathwork facilitators, sound healers, bodyworkers, astrologers, and energy workers. Practitioners use it for bookings, events, payments, and client management in one place. Flowdara helps independent practitioners and studios replace generic scheduling tools with software designed around how healing work actually happens. It supports session types and pricing, group workshops and events, intake forms, packages, and online payments, and it offers help migrating from Calendly, Acuity, or Squarespace. Pricing: 7-day free trial, plans from $11/month.

name: Email List AI
tagline: AI-assisted US B2B contact lists prepared per order
description: Email List AI provides AI-assisted US B2B data preparation, including research, data collection, deduplication and email validation. Business contact files are prepared per order, with one-time purchases from $20 and no subscription. Files can include business emails, phone numbers, addresses and websites. The service is intended for business owners, sales teams and marketers looking for US business contacts.

name: remotify-mcp
tagline: Give AI coding assistants remote shell access through MCP, with per-command approval or automatic execution.
description:
remotify-mcp is a free, open-source MCP server for developers who want their AI coding assistant to execute shell commands on another computer. It runs locally over stdio and communicates with the remote machine through an HTTP relay.

The remote computer needs curl and bash and runs a listener without requiring SSH access or an installed agent. Users can approve commands individually or enable automatic execution. Three tools are available: remote_exec, remote_session_info and remote_session_reset.

Install with npx -y remotify-mcp@latest. Node.js 18 or later is required on the client machine. The project is licensed under Apache-2.0.

GitHub: https://github.com/onlsol/relay.remotify.run
MCP documentation: https://github.com/onlsol/relay.remotify.run/blob/main/mcp/README.md

name: Permanent QR Codes
tagline: Pay Once, Edit Anytime, Own Forever.
description: Permanent QR Codes helps businesses create customizable QR codes for website URLs, digital business cards (vCards), PDFs, restaurant menus, social media profiles, app downloads, image galleries, coupons, and more. Create QR codes with custom colors and logos, update destinations anytime, and track scan analytics. Pay $49 once per editable QR code, with no recurring subscription.

name: Lagos Life Guide
tagline: Independent English field guide for Lagos Life — Nigerian browser multiplayer life-sim
description: Free English field guide to Lagos Life: how to play, map/Ride notes, jobs, and Governor election rules — dated observations, not affiliated with Vatar.

name: wudls
tagline: Dispensary email marketing, Apple and Google Wallet loyalty cards and iMessage in one platform. $250 per store, flat.
description: wudls is a dispensary marketing platform for email, loyalty and wallet cards. It designs campaigns from your live menu and deals, sends from your own domain on dedicated IPs, and puts points and today's offer on Apple and Google Wallet cards. Flat $250 per store per month, no credits, no per-email fees.

name: same.
tagline: One thing a day - everyone gets the same thing to photograph. Post yours to see everyone else's.
description: same. gives everyone in the world the same everyday thing to photograph, one prompt per day. It takes ten seconds: see the prompt, snap it, post it. Posting your photo unlocks everyone else's - no post, no peek. Free web app, no install, Google or email sign-in. In alpha; built for honest feedback from first users.

name: GMapsScraper.AI
tagline: Google Maps scraper with API & MCP for lead generation
description: GMapsScraper.AI is a cloud Google Maps scraper for lead generation and local market research. Enter keywords and locations to bulk-extract public business data such as names, phone numbers, emails and social links, addresses, ratings, reviews and photos, then export to CSV or JSON. Developers can use the REST API, and AI agents like Cursor and Claude can search Google Maps through the built-in MCP server. No code or browser extension needed. The free plan includes 1,000 credits per month.

name: WildStory
tagline: Russian-language AI character chat and interactive stories
description: WildStory lets Russian-speaking users chat with characters from books, comics and games and take part in interactive stories. Choose a character and chapter, make decisions, and use d20 mechanics to shape a scene. Intended for ages 16+, without explicit adult scenes. Free tier: 30 turns per day and first chapters; extra turns can be purchased in RUB. Project contact: https://t.me/aeads7

name: Mentra
tagline: Mentra shows local businesses whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI recommend them. Free demo scan, or a $49 manual audit. Made by Anthony Pan.
description: Mentra is an AI search / answer-engine visibility checker for local service businesses. Run a free demo scan to see if AI assistants name your business when people ask who to hire, or buy a $49 manual audit of the real answers. Made by Anthony Pan.

name: Surprise Bhejo 🎁 – Diwali & Bhai Dooj Wish Link Maker
tagline: Free personalised surprise wish link maker
description: Create a free personalised surprise wish link with your name, a gift-box reveal and WhatsApp sharing. Hinglish Diwali, Bhai Dooj, Birthday and New Year wishes, mobile-first.

name: ClientProof
tagline: Multi-client Wall of Love for agencies
description: ClientProof lets agencies, freelancers, and studios collect, approve, and embed testimonials for every client brand from one dashboard: isolated client workspaces, shareable collection links, an approval queue, and embeddable Walls of Love. Free plan: unlimited client workspaces, 10 approved testimonials per client, embeds carry a ClientProof badge; $29/mo removes the badge and lifts the cap. Not clientproof.app (a different client-approval product).

name: My Passport Photo Maker
tagline: Free online passport photo maker. Crop any portrait to the exact size, make the background plain and download a print-ready sheet.
description: My Passport Photo Maker is a free online passport photo maker that runs in your browser. Upload a portrait, choose your country and document, and it crops to the exact size, levels the head, makes the background plain and checks head height, eye line and sharpness before you download a print-ready 4x6 sheet.

name: Tsumazuki Map
tagline: Photo math homework; AI maps weak units for JP grades 1–12
description: Japanese web tool for elementary through high school math. Photograph homework, drills, or returned tests; AI records correct/incorrect by unit and builds a daily review plan plus a pre-test tonight strategy. No signup for a one-time free trial of 30 sheets per device. Paid plan: 5800 JPY/year tax included. Operator: Beyond Culture / Dokupo Bunka.

name: Retouchia
tagline: Free online AI image editor — retouch photos in seconds.
description: Retouchia is a free AI image editor. Remove backgrounds, erase objects, upscale to 4K, restore and colorize photos online in seconds — no watermark, privacy-first, works in the browser.

name: Jobs In Perth
tagline: Find current jobs in Perth and across Western Australia
description: Jobs In Perth is a job board built specifically for Perth and Western Australia. Job seekers search current vacancies for free and filter by suburb, industry and work type, including FIFO, part-time, casual and work-from-home roles. Employers advertise jobs at a flat rate from A$29 (no variable pricing by role or location) and manage applicants from a simple dashboard. The site also publishes local career guides and Perth jobs market analysis.

name: Ganttile
tagline: Free Gantt charts for everyday project planning
description:
Plan an office move, a team workshop, or quarterly work with Ganttile, free online Gantt chart software. Create unlimited projects and tasks, drag and resize task bars, link dependencies, and automatically reschedule connected work. Highlight the critical path and view several project schedules together. Export PDF or PNG charts, Excel task tables, and Microsoft Project-compatible XML. No paid tiers or per-user fees.

Guides: https://www.ganttile.com/guides

Built by the team behind Breeze (https://www.breeze.pm/?utm_source=ganttile), a project management tool trusted by 6,000+ teams worldwide.

name: Dubai Investment Tools
tagline: Free Dubai property calculators for rental yield, mortgage payments and buying costs.
description: Dubai Investment Tools helps property buyers and landlords compare rental yield, mortgages, Dubai purchase costs, off-plan resale, holiday home versus annual rent, and rent versus buy. Six core calculators are free without registration. Optional paid reports are separate. Results are planning estimates, not valuations or guaranteed returns.

name: OfferCC
tagline: Real-time AI interview assistant for macOS and Windows
description: OfferCC is a real-time AI interview assistant for macOS and Windows, not a mock-interview platform. During live interviews, it uses spoken questions, resume and target-job context, and the ongoing conversation to suggest responses to behavioral, technical and system-design questions. For coding questions, users can capture a screenshot and click Solve for an approach, code and complexity analysis. Check the official website for desktop setup, permissions and current paid plans. Follow the interview organizer's rules on AI assistance.

name: Clipstars
tagline: AI music videos starring your own face
description: Upload three photos of yourself, pick a scene and get a lip-synced AI music video clip to promote your track. Monthly credit plans from $49.99/mo.

name: FHI Paycheck Budget Planner 2026
tagline: Excel paycheck budget planner with 6 worksheets
description: Six-sheet Excel and Google Sheets compatible workbook for biweekly paycheck planning, monthly bills, savings and debt. Secure Stripe checkout and download after payment.

name: Digital Underground
tagline: Indie digital products store with a free Developer Marketplace
description: Digital Underground is an independent store for digital products: practical apps, productivity tools, guides and fiction. Indie makers can list their apps free in our Developer Marketplace at digitalundergroundstore.com/community/, and readers can grab our free sci-fi novel at digitalundergroundstore.com/free-book/.

name: Voicestars
tagline: AI covers, voice cloning and song generation
description: Voicestars is a web app for making music with AI voices. Pick one of more than 600 voices, upload a track or paste a YouTube link to get an AI cover, train a model of your own voice, generate full songs from a text prompt, and split stems or remove noise, echo and reverb. Plans run from $8.99 to $34.99 per month.

name: KnackCity - Community App
tagline: Neighbors Helping Neighbors, Building Strong Communities
description:
Before KnackCity, finding someone nearby to help with everyday tasks could be challenging. At the same time, people with valuable skills often lacked a simple way to showcase their abilities and connect with neighbors who needed their services.

Recognizing this gap, Dr. Zeshan founded KnackCity with a vision to bring local needs and local talent together. The idea was simple: create a neighborhood community platform where people could easily find help, share their skills, and discover flexible earning opportunities.

KnackCity was built around the belief that strong communities grow when neighbors support one another. Through service requests, KnackStar profiles, direct communication, and Spotlight, the platform helps Customers discover local services while giving independent Service Providers opportunities to showcase their work and connect with nearby Customers.

Starting with California as its initial target market, KnackCity aims to make everyday help easier to find, empower local talent, and strengthen neighborhood connections.

Our mission remains simple: Connecting Neighbors, Empowering Communities.

name: Milo Kits
tagline: Outside-in security check for apps built with AI
description: Milo's Launch Check looks at your live app the way a stranger would. Built for people shipping with Lovable, Bolt, Cursor, Replit or v0, it checks for exposed secret keys, open database tables, exposed files like /.env and missing security headers. Every finding comes with a copy-paste prompt you give to your AI coder to fix it. Checks are passive and read-only, only for apps you own. Start with the free 10-second header check, no signup. Not a penetration test.

name: Recent Follows
tagline: Track recent follows on Instagram: new followers, new following and unfollows.
description: Recent Follows is an Instagram tracker that shows what changed on a public profile over time. Compare snapshots to see newly observed following connections, new followers and unfollows, each with a clear time window. No Instagram password or login needed: just enter a public username.

name: Video Extend
tagline: AI video extender that continues short clips with motion, style, and scene consistency.
description: Video Extend is an online AI video extender for creators who need a natural next beat when a clip ends too early. Upload a short video or image, choose among integrated models (Kling, Veo 3.1 Fast, Wan, Pixverse, Luma, Hailuo), and continue the shot while preserving motion, subject, and atmosphere. Adjust duration and aspect ratio for landscape, square, and vertical edits. Review estimated credit cost before generating.

name: SoftwareAdviser
tagline: Browse verified AI tools by category, industry, or business size to find solutions tailored to your needs.
description: SoftwareAdviser.ai is an AI-powered software discovery and comparison platform helping businesses find the right technology solutions faster and with confidence. We connect companies with trusted software providers across categories including AI tools, SaaS platforms, business automation, HR, CRM, finance, marketing, and more.

name: TryBestSpecs
tagline: Try on glasses virtually with AI and compare frame styles
description: TryBestSpecs is a browser-based AI glasses virtual try-on tool. Users upload a photo or use their camera to explore frame styles, receive face-shape-based recommendations, and compare virtual try-on results. Basic try-on is free after signup, with paid features available. It helps people visualize eyewear choices before shopping; it is not a substitute for professional fitting or optometry advice.

name: AION 2 Pets
tagline: Free AION 2 pet reference, upgrade planning and a portable collection checklist
description: AION 2 Pets is a free independent fan companion for planning pet collection. Browse 206 pet reference records, consult 157 mapped locations across 3 regions, and use separate calculators for Pet Insight duplicate souls, genus collection EXP and Soul Crystal/Kina estimates. Keep a manual checklist in your browser, export a JSON backup and merge a validated import. Map coverage is incomplete and locations do not guarantee drops. There is no game-account login, automatic tracking, cloud sync or AI feature. The project is not affiliated with NCSOFT.

name: NitroIndexer
tagline: Bulk URL Indexing and Google Index Checks for SEO Teams
description:
NitroIndexer is an SEO platform for website owners, SEO professionals, link builders and marketing agencies.

The platform supports bulk URL indexing submissions, backlink source page submissions and separate Google index checks. Users can import URL lists using TXT, CSV or XLSX files, organise projects, run technical URL pre-checks and track processing progress.

NitroIndexer also provides available Googlebot crawl observations and reporting tools to help teams monitor their indexing workflows.

The service operates on paid subscription plans. URL submissions do not guarantee Google indexing or search rankings.

name: AISub
tagline: Compare ChatGPT subscription prices across regions
description: AISub is a free, independent website for comparing ChatGPT web subscription prices across regions, currencies, and billing periods. Browse local prices, converted estimates, tax information, and update times together, with pricing guides and an explanation of the comparison methodology. It helps individuals and teams research subscription options. It is not an official OpenAI service or a subscription reseller; availability and final charges must be confirmed at the official checkout.

name: ConvertOP
tagline: Private file converter that runs in your browser
description: ConvertOP is a universal file converter that runs entirely in your browser. Files are processed on your own device with WebAssembly, the Canvas API, Web Audio and PDF.js, so nothing is uploaded and there's no upload or download wait. It handles images (PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF), PDFs and text extraction, audio (MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A, FLAC) and video (MP4, WebM, GIF), with batch conversion and no file-size cap beyond your device's memory. Free and unlimited with no account; installable as a PWA for offline use.

name: AIData.Broker
tagline: We find a buyer for your company's data
description: AIData.Broker finds buyers for the data a company makes as it works: tickets, email, chat, code, documents. It publishes every public price for AI training data with its source, the buyers and their terms, and free tools to value data and check what may be sold. It takes the data to every buyer that fits at once, paid from the sale or not at all.

name: Repmark
tagline: A private workout log that records one set at a time
description: Private workout log for sets (reps or seconds). Custom exercises with English and Chinese names. Daily totals and a 12-month heatmap. Interactive demo on the landing page; full use needs email signup and verification.

name: ToSong
tagline: Paste your lyrics, pick a style, get a finished song
description: ToSong is an AI song maker for people who have the words but not the studio. Paste your own lyrics and the AI builds melody, arrangement, and vocals around them, or describe a song and let the AI write the lyrics too. Choose a genre, a male or female voice, or instrumental only, then listen and download. 20 free credits on sign-up.

name: Bulin 47 AI
tagline: Turn one photo into a Bulin 47 freestyle video
description: Bulin 47 AI is an independent, fan-made photo-to-video web tool. Upload a clear photo to create a personalized 10-second freestyle video with the original soundtrack, or choose the zombie couple video effect. Generations are purchased with one-time payments: currently $4.95 for one or $9.95 for three. Unused generations stay in the account. The service is not affiliated with Bulin 47.

name: Hey Ula
tagline: Your AI travel companion for family trips
description: Hey Ula is your AI travel companion for families. Ula learns how your family travels, plans trips around your kids' ages, routines and budget, and books with your OK. Hey Ula is in early access: join the waitlist at heyula.ai.

name: Syndred
tagline: AI video templates, samples, and prompts for your next clip.
description: SyndredVideo is a visual inspiration and template library for short AI videos. Browse 80 templates across dance, couples and hugs, transformations, pets, visual effects, and seasonal celebrations. Watch playable sample videos and explore scene-inspired prompts to find a creative direction for your next clip. Visitors can browse the library without creating an account, use search and categories to narrow their ideas, and keep template favorites in the current browser. The interface is available in English and Chinese. SyndredVideo is free to browse. Video generation and paid plans are currently unavailable, so the public library is best used to discover ideas and prepare prompts for a separate video creation workflow.

name: Loyalty 360
tagline: Digital loyalty cards for cafes and restaurants
description: Loyalty 360 helps cafes, bars and restaurants run digital loyalty programs through Telegram and MAX. Guests use QR membership cards, while staff record visits and issue gifts according to the business rules. The service supports guest segments, return campaigns, ratings and feedback. Plans start at 990 RUB per month. The PRO plan costs 1990 RUB per month and includes Menu 360 for one organization. A 14-day PRO trial is available without a bank card. Designed for Russian-speaking hospitality businesses.

name: Menu 360
tagline: Digital QR menus for cafes and restaurants
description: Menu 360 helps cafes, bars and restaurants publish digital menus accessible by QR code or on Android tablets. Owners can edit dishes, photos, prices, categories and stop lists. The free plan includes up to 50 menu items. Paid plans add combos, lunch menus, recommendations and upselling. Menu 360 costs 990 RUB per month with a 14-day trial; tablet hardware is purchased separately. Designed for Russian-speaking hospitality businesses.

name: AI Agent Discoverability Checker
tagline: Can buyers and AI search find your AI product?
description: A free technical-readiness check for AI agent and AI tool websites: tests whether OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Claude-SearchBot, Googlebot and Bingbot are allowed, SoftwareApplication/Organization JSON-LD, no-JS text, llms.txt, sitemap, meta tags and visible pricing/docs/privacy links. Returns a score out of 100 and a fix list. Free, no sign-up, open source (MIT).

name: AI Crawler Access Checker
tagline: See which AI crawlers can read your website
description: Enter any domain to see which of 24 AI crawlers your robots.txt allows or blocks, grouped into training crawlers, AI search/answer crawlers and user-triggered fetchers. Also detects llms.txt, ai.txt, RSL and Cloudflare Content-Signal, and runs a live GPTBot enforcement test. Free, no sign-up, open source (MIT).

name: AudioEditDesk
tagline: Free audio editing, right in your browser.
description: AudioEditDesk is a free browser audio editor with nine tools. Trim a clip, convert OGG to MP3, adjust volume or add fades, then download MP3 or WAV. Audio is processed on your device. Your file and edits stay in place as you switch tools in the same tab.

name: FlowPick
tagline: Free, open-source browser extension to download videos, audio, and images.
description: FlowPick is a free, open-source browser extension that helps you discover, download, and process videos, audio, and images from websites, including HLS (M3U8) and DASH (MPD) streams. It also offers browser-based tools for media conversion, editing, and transcription, with local processing for better privacy. Explore FlowPick at https://flowpick.net or check out the source code on GitHub: https://github.com/ezwebtools/flowpick

name: RemixAvatar
tagline: Turn a selfie into stylized AI avatars that keep your likeness
description: RemixAvatar turns one photo of you plus an optional style reference into stylized AI avatars and profile pictures that still look like you. Great for social profiles, gaming avatars and creator branding.

name: TranscribeNest
tagline: TranscribeNest is an AI-powered audio and video transcription website. Upload media files and convert spoken content into text for easier reading, editing, and
description:
TranscribeNest is an online AI-powered transcription tool that helps users convert audio and video files into accurate, readable text quickly and easily. Whether you're transcribing interviews, meetings, lectures, podcasts, or video recordings, TranscribeNest simplifies the process and saves you time on manual transcription.

Designed for students, journalists, researchers, content creators, and professionals, TranscribeNest makes spoken content easier to access, review, organize, and reuse.

name: PictTool
tagline: Create and edit images with a collection of easy-to-use AI tools
description: PictTool is a browser-based collection of AI image tools for creating and editing visual content. Choose a tool for your task, upload an image or enter a prompt where supported, and follow the on-screen steps to create or refine your result. PictTool is designed for creators, marketers, designers, and anyone who wants a straightforward way to work with images online.

name: Phishnoo
tagline: Security awareness training in 44 European languages, for clients in all countries
description: Phishnoo is a Dutch cybersecurity company based in Rotterdam, the Netherlands, that provides a SaaS platform for security awareness training. Organisations use Phishnoo to make employees resilient against phishing, smishing and other social engineering attacks. What Phishnoo does: AI-powered phishing and smishing simulations by email and text message; snack-sized, gamified e-learning; one-click reporting of suspicious emails to IT; Phishnoo Radar, an up-to-date collection of current phishing and scam threats; the P-Shield CyberSafe Index and AI Exposure Testing to measure human cyber resilience; and a partner program for IT service providers and MSPs. Phishnoo serves clients in all countries from its base in Rotterdam, and the platform is available in 44 European languages, helping organisations worldwide build a strong human firewall.

name: Listmoth
tagline: Snap 1–8 photos of a thrift find, get a listing draft with a price estimate based on recent sold listings.
description:
Listmoth is a web app for resellers and thrifters. Snap 1 to 8 photos of an item and Listmoth writes a listing draft: a title, a description, and a low / typical / high price estimate based on recent sold listings. You edit the draft, then copy and paste it into the shops you already use, with export packs for Depop, Vinted, Poshmark and Mercari.

Listmoth is copy/paste only, never autoposts, and is not affiliated with any marketplace. Prices are an estimate, not a guaranteed sale price.

Free plan: 5 drafts a month. Pro: $12/mo.

Free beta: the first 10 resellers who sign up at https://listmoth.com/beta get Pro free for 90 days, from the day they claim a spot. All we ask is that you make a few drafts and tell us what's broken or missing (2-minute feedback form in the app).

name: Wasm Arcade
tagline: Independent catalogue of classic browser games in WebAssembly/HTML5 — no install.
description: Independent catalogue of classic browser games playable in WebAssembly/HTML5 — no install. A web catalogue for browsing and playing in the browser; the games themselves are not claimed as original works of this listing.

name: Tip Toeing in My Jordans Meme Generator
tagline: Turn any photo into the AI tip toe Rumpelstiltskin meme
description: AI meme generator that turns one photo of you, a friend or your pet into the viral "tip toeing in my Jordans" Rumpelstiltskin dance video. 12-second clips, vertical or wide, ready for TikTok and Reels.

name: InstaGet
tagline: Discover notable people, explore public profiles and understand their connections.
description: InstaGet is a web-based people discovery platform for exploring public profiles, biographies, related people and news. Users can search for notable people, explore their connections, and save profiles for later reference. It offers free access with optional premium features.

name: CrazyGames-Poki
tagline: Free browser games: action, puzzle, sports, racing and multiplayer with no download
description: CrazyGames-Poki is a free browser game portal hosting thousands of HTML5 games across action, puzzle, sports, racing and 2-player multiplayer. Every game runs instantly in the browser on desktop and mobile with no downloads, no installs and no accounts.

name: ToolNova
tagline: Free browser-based tools for images, PDFs, audio, text, calculators and CVs
description: ToolNova is a free collection of practical browser-based tools for images, PDFs, audio, text, calculators, developer tasks and CV building. Users can compress and convert images, work with PDFs, edit audio, calculate taxes and gratuity, build country-specific CVs and use many other utilities without signing up. Many supported tools process files directly in the browser for faster and more private use.

name: AI Signature Generator
tagline: Free signature images in 109 handwriting styles
description: AI Signature Generator is a free browser-based signature image maker. Enter a name, choose from 109 handwriting fonts, and customize size, color and rotation. Download a transparent PNG, white-background JPG, SVG containing the rendered PNG, or standalone PDF containing the image. No registration is required. It uses font rendering rather than model-generated handwriting. It creates images, not certificate-based digital signatures, and does not sign existing PDFs or verify identity.

name: Whisper Web Podcasts
tagline: Browse podcasts and YouTube conversations and read timestamped episode transcripts.
description: Whisper Web Podcasts is a free podcast discovery site: browse shows and episodes, read available timestamped transcripts, and explore YouTube conversation channels. When you want a transcript of your own audio, it links to Whisper Web for transcription.

name: Voice Isolator
tagline: Separate voices from music or noise in audio and video
description:
Voice Isolator is a web tool for separating a voice from music or background noise in audio and video files. It returns a voice track and a separate background track, with an option to rerun the same file in the other mode. For video, the audio is processed on servers and the browser puts the voice back into the original video. The published plans include 10 free minutes a day without an account, plus subscriptions and a one-time credit pack for longer files. Downloads are available for 24 hours after processing. Use only recordings you own or have permission to process.

I’m part of the team behind Voice Isolator. It separates voice and background tracks from audio and video, with a free rerun in the other mode. Feedback on the workflow is welcome.

name: Project 29 Market
tagline: One-time digital tools for resellers and small businesses, with public calculators to check fit.
description: Project 29 Market offers paid digital tools for small-business administration and everyday planning. The catalog includes offline sales-cost records for secondhand resellers, job-pricing and cost tools for contractors and cleaners, invoice and scope-change records, and a CSV conversion tool. Public calculators and examples help visitors check fit before buying. Paid downloads use one-time prices shown in Canadian dollars, with file contents, usage limits and delivery policies available before secure Stripe checkout. These are practical manual-entry tools, not a marketplace-sync, accounting or tax service. Individual product pages state requirements such as desktop-browser use, backup steps and included files. No profit or income result is promised.

name: SleekNav
tagline: SleekNav is a hand-reviewed web directory: about 900 useful sites and tools in 13 clear categories.
description: SleekNav is a curated, bilingual (English/Chinese) web directory. Every site is hand-reviewed and sorted into 13 categories, from AI tools to blogs. Free to browse, no sign-up required.

name: Hounds.fun
tagline: Meme signal workbench — discover, verify multiples, trade
description: Smart-money meme signal desk for Solana/BSC/Base/Arc/RBH: live signals, public multiples record, same-page trading. Free features; 1% only on executed trades. Not financial advice.

name: Mubboo Flights
tagline: Easy travel planning. Compare options. Find better value.
description:
Mubboo Flights helps travellers plan trips with less searching and fewer tabs. Its all-in-one travel comparison and tickets platform brings flights, hotels, car rentals, tours and attraction tickets together, making it easier to compare options and find better value.

Users choose their destination or route, travel details, departure market, language and currency, compare available options and booking conditions, then choose where to book. Hotel comparison options can include Booking.com, Trip.com, Expedia, Agoda and Priceline, depending on the destination, dates and market. The selected provider confirms availability and completes the booking.

Destination guides and original travel research help travellers narrow their choices. Recorded virtual drives and walks let them explore places from home before a trip. The browser-based platform is free to search and compare, with no account needed. We compare. You choose. You save.

name: NIOQUICK Attendance
tagline: RFID attendance and payroll preparation for Philippine teams
description: NIOQUICK Attendance helps Philippine businesses collect RFID clock-ins using Windows kiosks and review attendance records in a web dashboard. Teams can review records, manage branches on an appropriate plan, and prepare payroll with Excel exports. Basic is a permanent free plan for one branch, with an owner and one admin. Hardware is sold separately; compatible Windows PCs, readers and cameras should be confirmed before rollout.

name: Originle
tagline: Free daily guess-the-country game — three tries, no login.
description: Originle is a free daily guess-the-country game. Meet one mystery guest, read their story, and name their country in three tries. Same UTC puzzle for everyone — no login.

name: My Selection
tagline: Full-stack e-commerce platform helping creators build their own product lines.
description: My Selection helps influencers and creators build their own product lines end to end, from sourcing through storefront and fulfilment. Outdoor-first. Markets: Australia and the United States.

name: ListOptix
tagline: Paste once → Amazon, Etsy, eBay & Walmart listing copy
description: ListOptix is a marketplace listing optimizer for multi-channel sellers. Paste product facts once (or upload a photo) and get paste-ready listing copy tuned per channel: Amazon, Etsy, eBay, and Walmart—each with its own voice and field limits. Browse static demos free; generating your own SKU uses credits. Soft-launched and usable today.

name: Open Sora
tagline: Free AI video generator with Sora 2, Veo 3.1, Kling & more

description: QR Album collects wedding and event photos, videos and voice notes in one private album, through a single QR code. name: QR Album FR

description: QR Album FR est la version française de QR Album, un album partagé accessible par QR code pour recueillir les photos, les vidéos et les messages vocaux des invités. L'hôte crée un album et imprime un seul QR code ; chaque invité scanne, la page s'ouvre dans le navigateur de son téléphone et il y dépose une photo, une courte vidéo ou un message vocal, sans installer d'application ni créer de compte. name: CheckoutAlarm
tagline: Alerts when Stripe webhooks fail or your sales stall
description:
Your checkout page can load fine while Stripe quietly fails to deliver payment events to your app. Then people pay and get nothing, and a normal uptime check stays green.

CheckoutAlarm is for people who built a paid app with Lovable, Bolt, Cursor, Replit or v0 and take money through Stripe. It does two things:

- Page check: it loads one page you pick on a schedule and checks the status code and, if you want, an expected title or phrase. One miss isn't an alert. You get an email after 2 failures in a row, and another when it passes again.
- Stripe health: you paste a restricted Stripe key with read access to Events, Webhook Endpoints and Charges only. Full secret keys are refused. It emails you when Stripe events still haven't reached your webhook endpoint, when Stripe has disabled an endpoint, or when sales stop even though the last 14 days say they should be coming in.

You prove you own the site first with a DNS TXT record, a meta tag or a small file, so *.lovable.app and *.vercel.app addresses work too. Nothing is checked until you do.

What it doesn't do: it doesn't run a browser, fill in forms or press Pay, so it can't tell when your webhook handler answers 200 but never unlocks the purchase. It also doesn't alert when a Stripe account has no webhook endpoint at all.

Free: 1 site, checked daily, Stripe health included, no card. Pro: $19/month for up to 3 sites, checked hourly. Alerts are by email.

name: MEDIAPRONET
tagline: Where builders launch and get discovered
description: MEDIAPRONET is a launch and discovery directory where builders list what they just shipped. Visitors browse newly launched startups, SaaS tools and online products by category, and each listing gets its own page with a link to the product. Makers can submit for free or pick a paid upgrade for faster publishing. Made for indie hackers and small teams who want their launch found by early adopters and search engines.

name: DeployDoctor
tagline: Find why your app works locally but breaks on Vercel.
description: DeployDoctor scans GitHub repositories for common Vercel deployment risks without running repository code. It checks import paths, environment configuration and framework-specific build issues, and offers build-log diagnosis and reviewable import patches tied to the scanned commit. For indie developers and small teams. One public scan per day per IP is free without signup; paid passes include private-repo scans. Built by NyttoLabs.

description: SolarXlist is a global B2B directory and marketplace for the solar industry, listing solar panel manufacturers, inverter and battery suppliers, installers, and distributors. Buyers can compare verified suppliers, products and quotes in one place at https://solarxlist.org/.

name: Your Calculator Hub
tagline: A free online calculator hub for financial, health, math, country-specific, and everyday calculations.
description:
Your Calculator Hub is a free online platform offering a wide collection of practical calculators in one convenient place. It includes financial calculators, fitness and health calculators, math calculators, general utility calculators, and country-specific calculators.

Users can access relevant tools to solve everyday math problems, estimate financial values, calculate health and fitness metrics, and perform other useful calculations without installing software. name: Schriftgenerator

description: Free online font generator: type your text, pick from dozens of font styles (script, bold, fraktur & more) and copy with one click — for Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp & Discord. No sign-up, runs in your browser.

name: CoinBoss

description: CoinBoss aggregates real-time crypto derivatives and on-chain data: liquidations across major exchanges, open interest, funding rates, long-short ratios, spot and derivatives volume, ETF flows, stablecoin issuance and exchange balances. Built for traders and analysts.

name: Clarity by Brain Fog Remedy
tagline: A free 60-second quiz that pinpoints what's really causing your brain fog.
description: Brain fog has causes, not just symptoms. Sleep debt, blood-sugar swings, chronic stress, hormonal shifts, post-viral fatigue and healthy ageing all show up as trouble focusing but respond to different things. Clarity is a free 60-second assessment that narrows down your most likely cause, plus free guides on sleep, blood sugar, movement, energy pacing and nervous-system resets. description: Fusion Office is a free online toolkit with 70+ PDF, Office document and image tools that run right in your browser, no sign-up needed. Built by NextGen Fusion (https://www.nextgenfusion.in), a web and software studio in Lucknow, India.

description: ChargeHive EV is an Android app for EV drivers and charger hosts. Discover charging options, check connector and access details, and book where available. description: MailBridgeAPI turns a mailbox you already own into authenticated HTTP endpoints for sending, retrieving, searching and monitoring email. It supports standard SMTP/IMAP plus Gmail, Microsoft 365, Yahoo, Zoho and iCloud connections, with a web dashboard, mobile monitoring, WordPress integration and optional human approval for automated replies. name: WeJot
tagline: AI agent research assistant — chat to build surveys, run AI interviews, and get insight reports.
description: WeJot is an AI agent research assistant for user research and market insights. Describe your research goal in natural language to generate professional surveys with complex logic, run AI video interviews, match samples, and produce insight reports.

name: Latensy
tagline: High-signal uptime and performance monitoring.
description:
Latensy is an uptime and performance monitoring platform for lean SaaS teams, developers, and agencies that need to know when production websites and APIs are really down—and what that means for the business.
Monitor service availability and latency, verify potential outages across multiple regions to reduce alert noise, and investigate incidents with clear timelines and performance signals such as P95 latency.
Track reliability through SLA and MTTR analytics, understand revenue and customer impact, share public status pages, and communicate actionable summaries to stakeholders.

name: Aidance

The editor includes a multi-clip timeline, transitions, text and shape overlays, blur and mosaic regions, transcript-based editing, and on-device captions in 99 languages. Export MP4 or GIF. Recording, editing, captions and export run locally.

Monthly plan ₹499 (offer, regular ₹1,499) or yearly ₹4,999, GST-inclusive, 14-day free trial.
