tagline: Digital catalogs with WhatsApp orders & loyalty
description: Nice Catalogs helps small businesses put their products or menus online without building a website. Create a themed digital catalog in minutes, add photos, prices, and categories, then share a custom URL or QR code. Customers browse on their phone, no app and no account required. Every catalog includes a cart that sends itemised orders straight to WhatsApp or Telegram, with no per-order commission. Also included: a link-in-bio landing page, appointment booking, Google review collection, password-protected catalogs, and on Professional, Apple/Google Wallet loyalty cards and analytics. Plans: Basic $5/month and Professional $10/month, each with a 7-day free trial. Dashboard in English and Spanish.

name: Minute of Fame
tagline: Own one minute of the day. It airs live every day.
description: Minute of Fame splits the day into 1,440 minutes. Claim one from $5, add your name, link and message, and it airs live on the dial at that time every day.

name: PayForGPT
tagline: Buy ChatGPT Plus and Pro in China with Alipay, WeChat Pay or USDT. No foreign card.
description: PayForGPT is an independent store for buying ChatGPT Plus and Pro in China without a foreign credit card. Pay with Alipay, WeChat Pay or USDT. Plus starts at ¥160 via instant iOS gift-card top-up with a 30-day warranty. Delivery uses redeem codes, so PayForGPT never asks for your password, verification codes or session token. Not affiliated with OpenAI.

name: Sandbox0
tagline: Persistent cloud sandboxes for long-running AI agents
description: Sandbox0 gives AI agents isolated cloud computers with a durable writable root filesystem, incremental checkpoints, and on-demand resume. Preserve installed tools, system configuration, repositories and generated files across successful checkpoints. Run commands, manage files and control networking through Python, JavaScript/TypeScript and Go SDKs or the s0 CLI. Sandbox0 Cloud is managed; the current runtime is closed source. Default pause/resume preserves files and starts fresh processes. Disclosure: submitted on behalf of Sandbox0 with AI assistance using official documentation.

name: Pitch Tempo
tagline: Free audio pitch and tempo changes for music practice
description: Pitch Tempo is a free browser tool for musicians who want to practise with a recording at a different speed or key. Upload a supported audio file, find its estimated key or BPM, adjust pitch and tempo independently, preview a short section and export the result. Tempo ranges from 50% to 150%; pitch spans -12 to +12 semitones. Supports nine common audio formats, with a five-minute and 100 MB file limit. Guests receive three uploads per 24 hours; accounts receive five per hour. Audio expires after 24 hours for guests or seven days for accounts.

name: Zubware
tagline: Free browser tools for images, PDFs, text and everyday calculations
description: Zubware brings image compression and resizing, PDF utilities, QR tools, text utilities, developer helpers and calculators into one free website. No account is required to use the tools. Many tools process inputs in the browser, while optional online processing is disclosed separately. Practical guides include reproducible age-calculation examples and a photo-upload troubleshooting checklist. Submitted by the site owner.

name: Antarctica
tagline: Turn raw Steep gameplay into beat-synced Shorts
description: Antarctica turns raw Steep gameplay into finished vertical Shorts, automatically finding the best moments and cutting them to the beat of the music. Players can create 5 free Shorts every day with a small watermark and no credit card required, or choose Pro for $5 for 30 days.

name: Dere Test
tagline: Free anime personality quiz — find your Dere Type (tsundere, yandere, kuudere & 30 archetypes).
description: Dere Test is a free anime personality quiz that helps fans find their Dere Type. Take a Quick (30) or Full (70) quiz across about 30 archetypes including tsundere, yandere, kuudere, and deredere. You get a primary and secondary result. Entertainment only — not psychological advice. No account required.

name: CAZIMI
tagline: Free birth charts and plain-language astrology guides
description: CAZIMI helps astrology beginners explore a free birth chart in their browser without signing up. Enter a birth date, time and place to see a chart wheel, Sun, Moon and Rising signs, and planet placements with plain-language explanations. Dedicated calculators and guides cover rising, Moon and Venus signs. The website is available in English, Spanish, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. An optional mobile app offers additional features. Astrology is presented for reflection and entertainment.

name: WhatsMyName Apps
tagline: Free public username search for digital footprint research
description: Independent username search tool for checking public profile URLs, filtering categories and exporting results as CSV/JSON. Useful for reviewing your own digital footprint and collecting OSINT leads. Matching usernames do not prove identity; results require manual verification and can be affected by blocking or rate limits. Free ad-supported web tool. Android app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=whatsmyname.app.us . Submitted by the operator; separate from the original WhatsMyName project.

name: imgs-ai
tagline: Create AI images, edit photos, and turn stills into short videos
description: imgs-ai is a browser-based image and video creation tool for creators, designers, and people making portraits. Start an image from a text prompt, edit an uploaded photo, or build a portrait series from reference pictures. For video, describe a scene or animate an existing image. Choose a model, resolution, and aspect ratio before generating, then track results and download finished files from your account. Images and videos share one credit balance. Credit packs are available without a subscription; monthly memberships are optional. Generation requires paid credits, with no free signup balance.

name: Promptcat
tagline: Visual Claude prompts and source-linked creative coding examples
description: Promptcat is a visual gallery of Claude Opus 5.5 examples and reusable editorial prompts. Browse games, 3D scenes, animations and apps, inspect images and video previews, and follow links to original sources and creator credits. It is intended for developers and designers looking for starting points for AI-assisted creative coding. Prompt wording is labeled when it has not been verified as the creator's original.

name: Tunenoodle
tagline: AI music studio with free browser audio and MIDI utilities
description: Tunenoodle helps musicians, songwriters and content creators explore songs from ideas, lyrics, images or hummed melodies. AI generation requires an account and credits, with free starting credits and paid plans. Cloud song downloads require a paid membership or credit pack. Free local browser utilities include Audio to MIDI for a single pitched melody, a MIDI editor and Tap Tempo.

name: Tip Toeing in My Jordans
tagline: Turn one photo into the 12-second AI barn tiptoe meme clip.
description: Tip Toeing in My Jordans is an AI video maker that turns one photo into a 12-second vertical (9:16, 720p) clip of the viral barn tiptoe meme. Upload a clear photo, optionally add a second person, and download a silent clip ready to post on TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts. $9.90 per video, no subscription.

name: PeraFix Usta Destek
tagline: Fault-code references and service tracking for Turkish technicians
description: Submitted by the PeraFix team. PeraFix Usta Destek serves Turkish technicians and service companies on web, Android and iPhone. Its technical library includes boiler fault codes (kombi arıza kodları / kombi hata kodları), air-conditioning and appliance references organised by brand and model. İşletmem combines customer and device records, service tracking and parts/stock workflows. The company directory presents professional services and contact details; industry listings and spare-parts sections support sector discovery. Registration is for professionals. Paid licence and trial terms: https://perafix.tr/lisans . Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.logia.perafix . iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/tr/app/perafix-usta-destek/id6810456034

name: Aidrobe
tagline: AI virtual try-on and clothing discovery for iPhone
description: Aidrobe is an iPhone app for AI virtual try-on and clothing discovery. Preview clothing on your own photo, explore collections based on your taste and country, and visit brands’ websites to buy the items you like. Aidrobe offers free access with optional paid subscriptions and credits. Available for iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/virtual-try-on-aidrobe/id6754018376

name: Vectorizer AI
tagline: Turn raster images into editable SVG vector graphics online.
description: Vectorizer AI is a browser-based image vectorization and editing tool for designers. Convert PNG, JPG, GIF, BMP or WebP images to scalable SVG, adjust output colors with an interactive palette, edit vector paths, and export multiple formats such as SVG, PDF, EPS, AI, DXF and PNG.

name: Sonicker
tagline: Free AI voice platform for text-to-speech, voice cloning, voice design and sound effects.
description: Sonicker runs in the browser: turn text into speech with 260+ curated AI voices in 10 languages, clone a voice from a 3-second sample, design a custom voice from a written description, or generate sound effects from a text prompt. Free sign-up, no credit card required.

name: Little Log — 6–12 Month Daily Pack
tagline: Printable baby daily log for 6–12 months: feeding, sleep, solids
description: Little Log is a printable PDF and Notion pack for parents of babies aged 6–12 months. Track daily feeding, sleep, solids introductions, nanny handoffs, and pediatric visit prep. Free sample page available. One-time purchase: 9 USDC. Built by a parent for the messy middle months.

name: TimeToolsLab
tagline: Free online time tools for everyday questions.
description: TimeToolsLab helps you answer everyday time and date questions in your browser. Find what time it was hours or minutes ago, see how long remains until a chosen clock time, add or subtract days, weeks, months, or years from a date, and calculate a future time from a duration. Choose your time zone and switch between 12-hour and 24-hour formats. Live countdowns keep the remaining time up to date, and you can copy results for use in a message or plan. Popular question pages let you go straight to calculations such as 8 hours ago, how long until 3 PM, or 70 days from today. The tools are free to use, require no signup or installation, and run calculations in your browser. Use TimeToolsLab on desktop or mobile whenever you need a quick time or calendar answer.

name: Aranyix
tagline: Plantation MRV software for India's green belts
description:
Aranyix is plantation MRV software for India's mining green belts, industrial sites, CSR plantations and compensatory afforestation programmes, built by Axentis Technologies Pvt Ltd in Jaipur. The workflow is Plant → Track → Report. Field teams use an Android app with offline sync to register trees and blocks with GPS, species and photos, and survival, mortality and replanting resurveys attach to the same IDs. AI-powered tree health monitoring and satellite data and trend monitoring flag stressed blocks before a field visit. AI-powered bioacoustic monitoring adds bird-call detections that reviewers confirm. Customised predictions from a programme's own historical data help teams plan resurveys and replanting. Exports give structured evidence for EC compliance reports, BRSR Principle 6 working papers and CSR impact reviews, with observations and modelled estimates in separate columns. Aranyix provides audit-prep evidence and modelled estimates only. It does not issue, verify, register or trade carbon credits or Green Credits, and is not a certification body.

Links: https://aranyix.tech · https://axentis.tech · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/aranyix/ · https://www.linkedin.com/company/axentis-technologies

name: Intrinsic Alpha
tagline: Stock research and valuation for independent investors
description: Intrinsic Alpha helps independent investors research companies, estimate intrinsic value, and document investment decisions. Compare company fundamentals and peers, explore DCF assumptions, save research notes, and track a watchlist with price alerts. A free plan is available, with paid plans for higher research limits.

name: Celestio
tagline: Written in the stars. Read for you.
description: Celestio calculates your birth chart for any date from 1900 to 2100 and any place in the world. The birth time is optional, and you don't need an account. An AI model then writes a personal reading of that chart in plain English. You can save readings to an account and share them privately by link. For relationships, Celestio compares two charts (partner, crush, friend or family). A free preview shows the strongest connections, and the full written report is a one-time purchase. There is no subscription. Celestio also works inside AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude and Grok through its MCP server. Astrology is offered as interpretation and entertainment, not scientific fact.

name: O.Convertor
tagline: Free browser-based tools for PDFs, EPUBs, subtitles, audio, fonts and icons
description: O.Convertor is a free online toolkit for everyday document and media tasks. Its browser-based tools split and merge PDFs, convert EPUBs and subtitles, extract audio, inspect fonts and generate icons. These tools run locally without uploading files or requiring an account.

name: Axiom by Wovol
tagline: An AI tutor to get unstuck and find your next study step
description: Axiom is Wovol’s AI tutor for people who get stuck while studying. Ask a question without signing up and get help finding your next step. Plan, Vocabulary, Timer, and Diary support ongoing study. Guest access and a free account are available, with optional paid plans. Product page: https://wovol.com/lp/axiom

name: Clair Report
tagline: Turn marketing CSV data into personalized client reports
description: Clair Report is a downloadable HTML reporting kit for freelance community managers and small teams. Import marketing data from a CSV file, map columns, choose a reporting period, customize your report with a logo, colors and written observations, then print or save it as PDF through your desktop browser. Data is processed locally. French, English and Spanish interfaces are included. The kit also provides manual client and activity tracking with CSV and JSON exports. One-time purchase: EUR 19. No automatic social media connections or built-in AI generation. Free illustrative reports and a guided demo are available on the website.

name: PassCheck
tagline: Is that battle pass worth it? Payback for 14 games.
description: PassCheck answers one question: is this battle pass worth the money? For 14 live-service games it lists the premium pass price, how much premium currency you earn back by finishing it, whether that covers the next pass, the tier count, and when the season ends. Each pass gets a 0 to 100 payback score. Every number links to its official or wiki source, and anything we cannot verify is shown as Unknown instead of guessed. Free, no sign-up, no ads.

name: TooliGuide
tagline: Research Instagram tools: features, claims and limits.
description: TooliGuide is an independent directory and guide site that compares Instagram story viewers and following trackers by their published features, pricing and limits. Records separate vendor claims from what can be verified; readers can compare tools side by side.

name: ParaDocs
tagline: Collect client files, documents, and website content in one place.
description:
ParaDocs is a client content collection and project management platform designed for freelancers, web developers, digital agencies, designers, and service businesses.

Stop chasing clients through endless emails and messaging apps to collect documents, website content, logos, photos, and other essential files.

With ParaDocs, professionals can create structured content requests, share secure links with clients, track missing documents, review submitted files, request corrections, and automate reminders.

Clients can submit their content directly through a simple link without creating an account.

Key capabilities include:

- Secure client content collection
- Customizable content request checklists
- Automated email reminders
- Document review and approval
- Client submissions without registration
- Centralized project tracking
- ZIP downloads of collected files
- ChatGPT integration and MCP server support

ParaDocs helps businesses simplify client onboarding, organize their projects, and reduce time spent collecting missing information.

Start with a 14-day free trial. No credit card required.

Website: https://paradocs.fr/

name: AdRecast
tagline: Remake winning video ads with your own product
description: Remake proven e-commerce video ads: same shots, pacing and hook, your product and cast. Script you confirm, product QC in every frame, per-second pricing.

name: AdsCove
tagline: Shopify, Meta & Google Ads tools for your AI agent
description: AdsCove is a hosted remote MCP server that connects AI agents to Shopify, Meta Ads and Google Ads for diagnosis, reporting and approval-gated changes.

name: SnakeRank
tagline: Play Snake. Back your favorite app.
description: SnakeRank is a casual browser Snake game where you pick an app you like and every completed run adds to that app's leaderboards (high score, total score, games played). Makers can submit their app for free, and new accounts get 2 free ranked runs. Not a SaaS tool: it is a game.

name: MultiConverter (UniRuler)
tagline: Convert lengths, compare objects, and share a sense of scale
description: MultiConverter offers UniRuler, a free browser-based length converter. Combine measurements in different units, see multiple outputs, and compare lengths with familiar objects and animals. Explore sourced measurement references and share a comparison with a link that reopens the same inputs and outputs. The built-in Did you know? feature creates copyable conversion facts for sharing.

name: Ecomesta
tagline: Ecommerce website builder for Bangladesh
description: Create an online store for your Bangladesh business. Manage products, inventory, orders, Cash on Delivery and SSLCommerz payments, and delivery zones in one place. Pricing from BDT 99/month with a 1-month free trial.

name: NEON Dance AI
tagline: Turn two photos into a NEON-inspired duo dance video with music.
description: NEON Dance AI creates a prepared, NEON-inspired duo dance from photos of two adults or two pets, with music and an approximately 23-second landscape 480p MP4. Mixed human-and-pet pairs are not supported. Generation requires login and paid credits, with one-time packs from $9.90 for one video and no subscription. Private downloads last seven days. Independent service, not affiliated with or endorsed by A2O LITE.

name: iFollowTracker
tagline: See who a public Instagram account recently followed. No Instagram login needed.
description: Enter a public Instagram username or profile URL to review visible following and follower lists, recent-follow signals and currently available Stories, with no Instagram password or connected account. Repeat checks let you compare snapshots over time to spot follows, unfollows and following changes. A free preview is available, and membership unlocks full lookups and optional hourly Story tracking with email alerts for one public account.

name: Merch Prep Studio
tagline: Resize artwork for print-on-demand and export 300 DPI PNGs
description: Merch Prep Studio is a browser-based image preparation tool for print-on-demand sellers and designers. Upload artwork, choose canvas dimensions and a background, and download a free standard preview. A high-resolution PNG export with 300 DPI metadata costs $2.99 per export. Existing transparent PNG backgrounds can be preserved. Resizing does not recreate missing image detail.

name: SportQuanta
tagline: One API for live, in-play and historical sports data
description: SportQuanta is a sports data SaaS platform providing real-time sports data and APIs for businesses, developers and digital platforms. It delivers live scores, fixtures, match events, team and player statistics, standings and historical sports information for websites, mobile apps, media products and other digital services. MCP support on eligible plans lets AI agents access sports data. SportQuanta is a sports data API, not a standalone AI agent. Paid plans include a free trial.

name: FollowerTracker
tagline: Instagram follower changes and AI audience insights
description: FollowerTracker tracks follower changes for public Instagram accounts. Save private snapshots and compare follower, following and post counts between manual checks. Follower samples provide leads to check, not proof of unfollows. AI audience insights cover gender mix and interests. Tools also analyze Reels, comments and competitors, with CSV export. No Instagram password needed. Registration is required; signup credits cover the first check. Credit packs start at $19.99 and monthly plans at $14.99.

name: Ayillo
tagline: Ayillo Property Management  System
description: Ayillo is property management software for landlords, property managers, and real estate teams. Manage properties and units, leasing and applications, residents, rent and ledgers, maintenance, vendors, documents, reporting, and day-to-day operations from one platform. Residents can use AyiLiving for maintenance, communications, documents, payments, and package notifications, while staff manage the full property lifecycle in Ayillo.

name: Personal Color Analysis
tagline: Find practical clothing colors and outfit palettes that suit you.
description: Personal Color Analysis is a free web-based color-guidance tool for people deciding what colors to wear. The guided questionnaire helps compare practical color directions and turn them into reusable clothing palettes and outfit ideas. Treat results as practical guidance rather than a medical, scientific or diagnostic determination.

name: WorldTimely
tagline: Free time zone converter and meeting planner across time zones
description: WorldTimely is a free, browser-based time zone converter and meeting planner. Find overlap hours for teams across cities, see public holidays for each city in the meeting planner, and check current time and DST changes for any city. No sign-up. Available in English and Chinese.

name: CCRent
tagline: Your own overseas Mac mini, with Claude Code ready to go
description: CCRent rents dedicated Mac mini M4 machines hosted overseas (North America, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Malaysia or Indonesia) on residential broadband with their own IP. Claude Desktop, Claude Code and dev tools come preinstalled, with a Claude Max 5x or 20x plan active. Connect remotely and start coding.

name: KitnaJaanteHo
tagline: Free Hinglish WhatsApp quizzes — best friend, couple, family, Diwali & more. No login.
description: KitnaJaanteHo is a free static site of Hinglish "kitna jaante ho" quizzes for Indian WhatsApp groups. Packs include Best Friend, Couple/Love, Family (Bhai-Behen), College dost, Cricket fan, and a Diwali 2026 special, plus a love calculator, Bollywood naam generator, and Diwali wish card. Everything runs in the browser with no account.

name: AI Gig Scout

description: AI Gig Scout is an independent directory that helps people discover AI training, evaluation, data annotation, coding and expert opportunities in one place. Listings come from AI work platforms such as Micro1, SME Careers, Mercor, Sovrano AI, Ethos AI and AfterQuery, organized by platform, work type, category, pay and eligibility. You check the details on AI Gig Scout and apply directly on the platform, with no account needed on AI Gig Scout.

name: Video Upscaler
tagline: Online AI video upscaler — enhance resolution and quality in the browser
description: Video Upscaler is a free online AI video enhancer. Upload a clip, upscale resolution, reduce blur/noise, and download a sharper video — no install required.

name: Mingle
tagline: Live voice translator in your browser
description: Mingle translates spoken conversation between 60+ languages in real time directly in the browser, with no install. Free tier plus paid plans for heavier use.

name: AI Halloween Costume
tagline: Try on Halloween costumes with AI from one photo
description: AI Halloween Costume lets you try on Halloween costumes from a single photo. Upload a picture, pick a look, and preview festive outfits online — free to try, no download.

name: SunsetDiff
tagline: AI model shutdown dates and replacements, from official pages
description: SunsetDiff is a free tracker of AI model deprecations. Every 6 hours it checks the official OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini API, Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI and Mistral pages and records when each model shuts down and what the provider names as its replacement. Every value links to its source with a last-checked date. It includes migration pages, a shutdown calendar with iCal and RSS feeds, a free JSON API (https://sunsetdiff.com/api/) and an open CC BY 4.0 dataset on Hugging Face.

name: DopeCast
tagline: Digital TV menu boards for cannabis dispensaries
description: DopeCast is digital TV menu board and signage software for cannabis dispensaries. Menus sync from the POS. $30 per screen per month, capped at $120 per store. Built by DopeCast, Mountain Lakes, NJ.

name: Dictation Daddy
tagline: AI clinical dictation and voice typing for any app — a Dragon alternative for Mac, Windows, Chrome and Android
description:
Dictation Daddy is an AI speech-to-text and voice typing tool built as a modern alternative to Dragon Medical and Dragon NaturallySpeaking. Press one key and dictate into any app with a text cursor: email, docs, Slack, or EHRs like Epic, Cerner and athenahealth.

96–98% accuracy from your first dictation, with no voice training and no saying punctuation out loud. Built-in medical terminology and custom vocabulary, auto punctuation, templates, file transcription, and support for Philips SpeechMike and professional dictation mics. HIPAA/SOC 2 compliance options on request for Enterprise.

Pricing: Solo $15/mo or $99/yr; Team $18/mo or $149/yr per user; Enterprise custom. 7-day free trial.

name: M Card Games
tagline: Card games that start with M — play free in your browser.
description: M Card Games collects card games that start with the letter M, from classics like Mau Mau and Memory to solitaire favourites such as Montana, Monte Carlo and Miss Milligan. You can play eight of them free in your browser with no download or sign-up. A quick-reference table and FAQ cover 15 M-named games with the basics of how each one plays.

name: Tempburn
tagline: A short-lived, receive-only inbox for one-off messages.
description: Tempburn creates a temporary email inbox in the current browser for one-off, low-risk messages. No signup or password is needed. The inbox and its messages expire within 8 days. It receives plain-text email only and does not support sending, forwarding, attachments, or account recovery. Use it only where temporary email is allowed.

name: Colorbase for Developer
tagline: ColorBase the ultimate tool for web designer

description: AutosOcasion is a Spanish-language online magazine about everything with an engine: cars, motorcycles, caravans, vans, trucks, buses, boats and aviation. description: LangScribe turns videos and recordings into lessons: video to subtitles or audio to text in 99 languages, free/AI translation into 109, bilingual and AI subtitles, line-by-line A–B repeat, click-to-look-up and vocabulary cards with sentence plus audio clip. Podcast RSS, batch jobs, SRT export and print. LangScribe is a language-learning platform with a graded English and Japanese ladder.

name: YesNoMystery
tagline: AI-hosted lateral thinking mysteries — ask yes/no, crack black-story puzzles
description: Play AI-hosted lateral thinking mysteries solo. Ask yes/no questions, get smart hints, and crack classic black-story style puzzles in your browser.

description: VTuber Zukan is a free, unofficial database that maps VTubers to the illustrators and Live2D/3D modelers who created them, with official sources for each credit.

name: FabRapid 3D
tagline: Free browser-based 3D model converter, compressor and viewer. 70+ formats incl. STEP, STL, GLB, OBJ, FBX. Runs locally, no upload or signup.
description: FabRapid 3D converts, compresses and previews 3D models right in your browser. Open STEP, STL, GLB/glTF, OBJ, FBX, PLY, IGES, USD and 60+ more formats, export to 23 targets (1,600+ conversion pairs). Powered by WebAssembly and three.js, files never leave your device. Free, no signup.

name: StatementExcel
tagline: Convert PDF bank statements to editable Excel or CSV online, with a balance check on every file.
description: StatementExcel converts digital (text-based) PDF bank statements into editable Excel (XLSX) or CSV files. AI extraction separates dates, descriptions, debits, credits and balances, and a built-in balance check reconciles totals against the statement. Edit rows before you download. One conversion is free without signup; a free account includes 30 pages a month.

name: Xiaohua (小华听写)
tagline: Stroke-checked Chinese spelling practice for Singapore kids
description: Xiaohua helps Singapore kids get ready for Chinese spelling tests. Each grade from P1 to P6 is an island of five-word levels: children hear the word, write it by hand and see exactly which stroke went wrong. Missed words come back in Review Camp, and parents can print the word lists. Free to start with no account; optional Pro plan.

name: Printable Mazes for Kids
