description: PrintableMazes.org offers printable mazes for kids sorted by age, theme, and difficulty. Download PDF or PNG with separate answer keys, or build a custom maze with the free maze generator for home or classroom use.

name: Quote Floor
tagline: Free job-pricing and recurring-discount calculator for home-service professionals
description: Quote Floor is a free, no-signup pricing calculator for independent handyman, cleaning, and property maintenance businesses. Include owner pay, work and travel time, materials, overhead, payment fees, and a target profit margin. Compare recurring discounts against expected time savings, copy a pricing summary, or print it. Includes worked pricing guides. Calculator figures stay in your browser. An optional Jobber affiliate link is clearly disclosed; using the calculator never requires a purchase.

name: Jigsawable
tagline: Turn a photo into a jigsaw puzzle online — free
description: Jigsawable turns any photo into a free online jigsaw puzzle. Make and play a private jigsaw in your browser — no download or sign-up; your photo stays on your device.

name: InkPractice
tagline: Free printable name-tracing, cursive, and calligraphy worksheets
description: Free browser tool for printable name tracing, cursive, and calligraphy worksheets. Type any name, preview, and download a PDF or PNG. No signup required; the text stays on your device.

name: Business Obligations
tagline: Know which licenses, filings, and deadlines your US business faces
description: Business Obligations maps the registrations, licenses, permits, tax filings, and recurring deadlines that small businesses may need across federal, state, county, and city jurisdictions.

name: Tally Assistant
tagline: AI-powered bookkeeping for freelancers — import any bank CSV, scan receipts, AI invoicing, and auto payment reminders.
description: Tally Assistant is AI-powered bookkeeping built for independent freelancers and solopreneurs. Import any bank CSV, scan receipts, generate invoices with AI, and send automatic payment reminders. Free through September 30, 2026; Pro is $12/month after. Not affiliated with Tally Solutions or TallyPrime.

name: English1Up
tagline: Daily English lessons for learners, $3/month
description: English1Up is a paid subscription ($3/month) that delivers short daily English lessons for ESL and language learners. Learn a little every day at your own pace.

name: SlotSheet
tagline: Pick a template, share one link, and people claim a slot from their phone. No account needed to make or join a sheet. Free.
description: We're the makers of SlotSheet. Sign-up sheets without the ads. Pick a template, share one link, and people claim a slot from their phone. Potluck, volunteer shifts, class party, or blank. Change the slots to fit, like "Sides x4" or "Setup 9-10am x3". People open it and tap a slot. They don't download anything and don't make an account. Each slot shows how many spots are left and closes when it's full, so you don't end up with five pies and no turkey. If a spot opens up, the first person on the waitlist gets it automatically. See every claim, remove one if plans change, and download the list as a CSV. Add start and end times and SlotSheet adds up volunteer hours per person: end time minus start time, times the spots taken. Free sheets, up to 500 slots each. No credit card. It was built quickly by a small team using AI coding agents, as an experiment.

name: EveryBacklink
tagline: Find relevant directories and plan your website submissions
description: EveryBacklink is a free, noncommercial resource for website owners looking for relevant places to list their projects. Browse and filter directory listings, read submission requirements, and organize a submission checklist before visiting each destination. It helps makers compare opportunities without promising search rankings or guaranteed backlinks.

name: DSH Plugin Hub
tagline: Community plugin marketplace and directory for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): browse, score and install dsh plugins.
description: DSH Plugin Hub is a community directory of plugins for DeepSeek Harness, the dsh agent CLI. Every plugin gets an automatic metadata score (manifest, license, activity, popularity) before listing. Categories include Tools, Skills, Workflow & Automation, Memory, Models & Providers. Free to browse.

name: RooferForms
tagline: Create roofing contract change orders in minutes
description: RooferForms helps roofing contractors create clear contract change orders and supplemental work forms for added scope, pricing and customer approval.

name: Flying Car AI
tagline: Turn one car photo into a flying stunt video: ramp launch, mid-air flip, thruster lift-off or night city flight.
description: Flying Car AI is an online image-to-video generator for the flying car trend. Upload one clear photo of any car (whole car, every wheel in frame) and pick a stunt template: The Complete Ramp Launch, city fly-through, studio hover, lake skim at dusk or coastal flight. The AI keeps your car's shape, colour and wheels while thrusters lift it into the air. Features: one car photo in, one stunt video out, no prompt writing; 5 stunt templates with their own scene, camera and timing; vertical 9:16 clips, 8-12 seconds, with generated engine roar, thruster whoosh and wind; 480p Standard or 720p HD with the exact credit cost shown first; ready for TikTok, Reels and Shorts with MP4 download and an Assets library. Independent tool, not affiliated with Tesla, SpaceX or Elon Musk.

name: Moss Image
tagline: Run the open MOSS-Image text-to-image model free in your browser, with clean English and Chinese text inside your pictur
description: Moss Image puts MOSS-Image, the open text-to-image model from the OpenMOSS team, in a browser tab, so you can test prompts without a GPU, Docker image or local install. The model is a 5B-parameter diffusion transformer that reads prompts through a Qwen3.5 text encoder and decodes pixels with the FLUX.2 VAE, which keeps skin, fabric and small type sharp. Features: text to image from a plain-English prompt; readable English and Chinese lettering inside the image for posters, covers, banners and title cards; JSON layout prompts that place each element where you ask; Base (for LoRA / fine-tuning) and SFT checkpoints, the site runs SFT; advanced settings for steps, guidance, negative prompt, seed and HD/2K canvas. Free credits at sign-up; paid plans add commercial license, no watermark and priority queue. Independent site, not affiliated with OpenMOSS.

name: DocTree
tagline: Learn at your level with cited articles and an AI companion
description:
DocTree helps developers, independent learners, researchers, and curious minds understand a topic through structured learning articles. Start with a topic or your own sources, choose your knowledge level and available reading time, and explore explanations with citations and diagrams.

While reading, select any passage to ask the AI companion for a simpler explanation, an example, or a follow-up answer in context. Saved reading progress makes it easy to return and continue learning. A free plan is available, with paid plans for higher usage.

name: SlotSheet Volunteer Hours Report
tagline: Drop in a sign-up export (CSV or .xlsx) with names and slot times. Your file never leaves your browser. Free.
description:
We're the makers of SlotSheet.
Drop in a sign-up export (CSV or .xlsx) with names and slot times. You match the columns once, so you can use exports from tools such as SignUpGenius, SignUp.com or Google Forms.
Adds up hours per volunteer: end time minus start time for each sign-up, times the number of spots, totalled per person. End times before the start time count as overnight. Slots without times count as 0 hours, and the report tells you how many there were. Rows it can't read are listed, not silently counted. Volunteers are grouped by name and email together. If your file has a family or class column, you'll also get hours per family or class.
Download a CSV per volunteer, per family/class, or of every sign-up. A printable summary for your board meeting or a grant application.
Your file is processed in your browser and never uploaded. We never see your volunteers' names. It only remembers how you matched the columns, in this browser. No names or other values from your file are saved. No cookies. No account, no ads, no card.
Try it with example data (made-up volunteers). Coming soon: ad-free sign-up sheets. Not available yet. Built quickly by a small team using AI coding agents, as an experiment. Feedback welcome.

name: WriteChinese
tagline: Free Chinese character stroke-order practice
description: WriteChinese is a free web app for practicing Chinese character stroke order. It covers HSK 1–3 and the 3500 common Chinese characters. No signup required.

name: EuroExpo Desk
tagline: European trade fair directory and exhibitor service matching
description: EuroExpo Desk helps exhibitors find European trade fairs, verified organiser sources, dates and venues across Germany, Netherlands, France, Italy and Spain. Exhibitors can request exhibition stand building, interpreting, freight, catering and booth reception services; requests are manually reviewed and introductions to service providers are arranged. The platform is in a free testing phase.

name: SubmitMatic
tagline: We submit your SaaS to 100+ directories for you.
description: SubmitMatic is an AI-powered platform that automatically submits your SaaS to more than 100 directories, boosting visibility, Domain Rating, and organic traffic with zero effort. The service saves you over 40 hours by handling every step, from reviewing your product details to creating a dedicated submission email and distributing your startup across trusted directories. Within three days, your SaaS receives high-quality backlinks, improved SEO, and increased credibility. You can choose from simple, one-time payment plans and receive a full report with screenshots for complete transparency. SubmitMatic makes scaling your product effortless by putting your SaaS in front of thousands of potential users across the internet automatically.

name: Clear Tape
tagline: US stock research, holdout backtests and trade journal
description: Clear Tape helps traders research US stocks, define trading rules, run holdout backtests, plan trades with stops and targets, and journal decisions. It includes educational courses, stock research, an AI system checker and free tools. AI does not predict stock prices; it evaluates ideas against user-defined rules.

name: SubmitSaaS
tagline: Submit Your SaaS to 100+ Directories Effortlessly
description: SubmitSaaS uses AI automation to revolutionize SaaS visibility. We submit your product to 100+ high-quality, curated directories, streamlining the entire process. This saves you over 20 hours of valuable manual effort. Our AI-powered platform eliminates technical submission headaches, significantly boosting your SEO, expanding your reach, and attracting more targeted customers effortlessly. We handle all details, from dedicated email setup to providing a detailed submission report, ensuring maximum impact and accelerated growth for your SaaS with minimal effort from you.

name: BoxesModel
tagline: Parametric storage models for 3D printing in your browser
description: Browser-based parametric storage models for 3D printing. Browse models, adjust supported dimensions and layouts, and preview them online. Default STL and STEP files are free; customized exports are paid.

name: ToolCabana
tagline: 457 free online tools for PDF, images, text and code, right in your browser
description: ToolCabana gathers 457 free online tools in one searchable directory: PDF and documents, images and design, text and writing, developer and data, calculators, unit conversion and AI tools such as background remover, subtitle generator, OCR and transcription. Tools run client-side in the browser, no signup needed, available in about 62 languages.

name: Quitar Fondo
tagline: Free AI background remover for any image, in seconds
description: Quitar Fondo removes the background from any image in seconds, 100% automatic. Upload a photo, download a transparent PNG, or replace the background with a color, photo or blur. Free, for online sellers, designers and anyone editing photos.

name: HandymanAI
tagline: AI assistance and visual learning for DIYers and trade apprentices
description: HandymanAI provides AI assistance, trade calculators and visual learning tools for DIY projects and electrical, HVAC and plumbing training. Available on Android, web and supported smart glasses, with limited free access and optional paid access. Built by Artisan Reality.

name: BuildJams
tagline: Open AI hackathons and build jams, updated daily
description: BuildJams is a free tracker for open AI hackathons, build jams and game jams. It pulls listings from 11 public sources, including Devpost, lablab.ai, itch.io, MLH, Devfolio, TAIKAI, HackerEarth and Luma calendars, removes duplicates, and shows the prize, deadline, format and tools mentioned for each event. Topic pages group events such as online AI hackathons, AI agent hackathons, AI game jams and events closing this week. A free weekly email lists new and closing-soon events. Organizers can submit an event.

name: SunoDownloader.pro
tagline: Download public Suno music, lyrics and cover art
description: A free browser toolkit for public Suno AI songs. Save MP3, WAV or original audio, plus available lyrics, cover images and playlist ZIP archives. Works in desktop and mobile browsers with a multilingual interface. Independent from Suno; only download content you own or have permission to use.

name: DigiParser
tagline: Turn PDFs and scanned business documents into structured data
description: DigiParser helps teams extract the fields and line items they need from PDFs, scans and images. Configure a custom parser, review the results and export to Excel, CSV or JSON. API and webhook options support existing workflows. Useful examples include customer purchase-order intake for manufacturing and supplier invoice data preparation for accounting. These are separate workflows; extraction does not approve orders or invoices. Paid subscriptions with a 7-day free trial. Submitted by DigiParser’s founder.

name: SolvePilot Free Cleaning Quote Toolkit
tagline: Free cleaning quote follow-up checklist and CSV tracker
description: A free no-signup toolkit for independent cleaning businesses: a daily quote review checklist, three editable message outlines and a downloadable CSV starter with a fictional example. Helps owners manually track requested quotes, next actions and contact permission in their own spreadsheet. It does not store visitor data, send messages, find new leads or promise bookings. The optional C$19 workbook and C$69/month subscription software are NOT for sale or live.

name: StaySheet Co. Everything Bundle
tagline: Six buy-once Excel and Google Sheets trackers for landlords, Airbnb hosts, freelancers and Etsy/Shopify sellers, $79 as a bundle ($121 separately)
description: StaySheet Co. Everything Bundle is six buy-once Excel and Google Sheets trackers (landlord rent and expenses, Airbnb hosting, Etsy and Shopify bookkeeping, freelancer income and tax, moving and home buying, and wedding budget) for $79, versus $121 bought separately at https://staysheetco.gumroad.com/l/everything-bundle. Each tracker comes with a blank file, a sample file and a quick-start guide, with no subscription; the trackers organise records and are not tax, legal or accounting advice.

name: Whale Coupons
tagline: Coupon codes from thousands of independent online stores
description: Whale Coupons lists store-issued coupon codes from thousands of independent online stores. Shoppers browse by store or category without recycled expired codes. Also available as a free remote MCP server for AI assistants.

name: iModelly
tagline: Private matching for adult creators and management agencies
description: iModelly is an independent, 18+ creator-to-agency matching service for creators working on OnlyFans, Fansly and webcam platforms. Creators can apply privately and free of charge to be considered for introductions to independent management agencies. iModelly is not itself a management agency or adult-content hosting platform, and no contract is required to apply.

name: ChangeLoop 7
tagline: Seven-day planning cycles with daily actions and a weekly review
description: ChangeLoop 7 is a self-directed weekly planning and reflection tool. Answer seven fixed questions, choose one small method, work on one current daily action, and review on day seven to inform the next cycle. It offers structured analysis and sourced examples rather than open-ended chat. The first seven-day cycle is free; a subscription is required for cycle two. It does not promise guaranteed results or provide therapy or medical care.

name: RelayMe
tagline: RelayMe.ai — AI video & image workflows for marketing teams: one product photo to studio shots, 4K, 9:16, and short ads.
description: RelayMe is a no-code AI canvas for marketing teams: turn one product photo into studio images, 4K upscales, 9:16 reframes, and short videos with Veo, Grok Imagine, MiniMax and more — priced in credits before you run.

name: Zombie AI – Photo to Zombie Standoff Clip
tagline: Turn two photos into the tearful zombie standoff video
description: Zombie AI generates the zombie-apocalypse trend clip from two uploaded photos. One person becomes the survivor raising a pistol, the other becomes the loved one who has turned, and the short plays out with a hesitant standoff, a warm flashback of the two together and the gun finally lowered. Faces stay consistent, pets and cartoon versions work too, and you can export 10 or 15 seconds at 720p in vertical or landscape. Free credits on signup, one-time credit packs after that.

name: UseThisSI
tagline: Which AI tool to use for each job, with real prices
description: UseThisSI picks one AI tool per job (coding, vibe-coding apps, agents, automation, video, music, voice, writing, research, game art), plus two alternatives, with current prices taken from each vendor's own pricing page and the date we last checked. A free 30-second quiz builds your starter stack, and a free 5-minute weekday brief covers what just launched. No paid placements; affiliate links are labeled.

name: Heritage Handshake
tagline: A free Canadian site for owners who want to sell their small business themselves, with no broker or commission.
description: Heritage Handshake is a free website for Canadian small business owners who want to sell their business themselves. Owners can list a business at no cost, stay private until they choose to share details, and talk to buyers directly without paying a broker's commission. The site has a free business valuation calculator, printable checklists, and plain-language guides on preparing a business for sale, selling to an employee and succession planning. For owners who want more structure, there is an optional C$99 ReadyToSell Pack of worksheets and templates at https://sellmybusinessdirect.com/ready-to-sell. Buyers can browse Canadian businesses for sale for free.

name: Reverse Audio Online
tagline: Reverse audio online for free. Choose an audio or video file, or record your voice, then play it backwards and download a WAV—no sign-up required.
description: Reverse Audio is a free browser tool for playing sound backwards. Drop in an audio file, pull the soundtrack out of a short MP4, MOV or WebM video, or record a clip with your microphone, then listen to the original and the reversed version side by side. When it sounds right, download the result as a WAV file for an editor or a video project. A reverse singing mode plays the reversed clip while you record your own attempt, then flips your take back so you can compare. Processing happens locally in your browser: audio files are not sent to a server, and no account is required.

name: RepairGauge
tagline: Home repair cost guides and contractor quote comparison
description: RepairGauge is a free U.S.-focused home-repair research and planning website that publishes cost-range guides, checklists and educational tools to help homeowners compare contractor estimates by scope, exclusions and follow-up questions. It does not diagnose property issues, perform repairs or provide binding estimates.

name: StockElf AI
tagline: AI stock research and buy/sell signals
description: StockElf AI is an AI agent-powered web platform for researching US stock buy and sell signals. It combines a signal feed, visible reference prices and daily holding reports. Free access previews core signals; Pro adds signal details and email alerts. For independent research only; no guaranteed returns or personalized investment advice.

name: FleetSift
tagline: Independent fleet software research and comparison guides
description: FleetSift is an independent online research and comparison resource to help trucking and fleet operators evaluate fleet-management software, GPS tracking, ELD, telematics and transport management systems using vendor information and practical procurement questions. FleetSift is not itself a software vendor.

name: Transglot
tagline: Automate multilingual releases in one easy-to-use workspace
description:
Shipping a new feature should not mean rebuilding the same translation checklist. Transglot gives software and website teams a shared localization workspace: AI drafts use your glossary, brand voice and approved translation memory, while automatic checks flag placeholder, plural, terminology and length issues.

Reviewers keep control of the wording, including website editing in context. Developers can connect the CLI, GitHub Action, REST API and MCP server; repository and CMS delivery depend on the plan and configuration. Start with 10,000 translation words per month, one project, 14 target languages and three seats on the Free plan. Developer automation starts on paid plans.

name: HeroHunt
tagline: AI Recruiter that finds and reaches candidates on autopilot
description: HeroHunt.ai is an AI recruiter for sourcing and outreach. Tell it who you are looking for in plain language and it searches up to 1 billion public profiles across the web, GitHub and Stack Overflow, screens every candidate against your requirements with AI, and writes personalized outreach with automatic follow-ups. 8-day free trial; plans from $99 a month.

name: Tradee
tagline: Visual crypto strategies, backtests, and paper trading.
description: Tradee is a crypto strategy platform. You design strategies in a visual builder, backtest them on stored candles, and paper trade the result. Live API outputs and webhook delivery let you connect your own tools. Market data covers Binance, Binance US, Coinbase, and Binance USD-M futures. Tradee is not an exchange, broker, or custodian, and it does not route orders or hold funds. Free plan $0. Hobbyist $14.90 per month ($12.42 billed yearly). Pro $39.90 per month ($33.25 billed yearly).

name: BidHatch
tagline: Daily plain-English federal contract alerts for owner-operator trades: box truck, janitorial, landscaping, HVAC.
description: BidHatch reads SAM.gov's public contract file every weekday and emails small trade businesses only the open bids for their trade and states (box truck, courier, janitorial, landscaping and snow, pest control, moving, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, handyman), in plain English. Free bid pages and guides. Alerts cost $24/mo or $199/yr. There's also a $49 done-for-you capability statement.

name: FatePreview
tagline: Explore your options before a big life decision.
description:
FatePreview is a deterministic decision comparison tool using fixed planning rules for people facing a concrete life choice.

Instead of pretending to predict what will happen, FatePreview helps you compare possible paths, examine their trade-offs and constraints, identify important assumptions, and find smaller actions you can test before making a larger commitment.

Its first English decision experience focuses on a common question: whether to leave a job and start a business. Users can compare staying employed while preparing, testing the business on the side, and leaving to build full-time based on their current situation.

FatePreview is currently available as a free beta.

The English comparison uses three routes, explicit input facts and assumptions, trade-offs, and seven-day experiments. No account is required, there is no charge, and results are not saved to an account.

name: SuperCalc
tagline: Free Online Calculators for Finance, Health & Math
description: SuperCalc provides 100+ free, privacy-focused calculators for finance, tax, health, and daily utilities. No registration required, mobile-friendly, and instant results.

name: Paste a Clip
tagline: Free browser-based TikTok video downloader and video editor
description: Free browser-based TikTok video downloader and video editor. Save available MP4, HD, and MP3 formats when permitted; import supported TikTok video links into the editor to trim, crop, rotate, add text and export MP4. Core tools do not require an account or software installation.

name: RestocksAIO
tagline: Inventory and cross-listing app for resellers
description: RestocksAIO (restock.gg) helps sneaker and streetwear resellers run their business from one place. It's a Windows and macOS desktop app with a mobile companion. It covers inventory tracking, cross-listing to marketplaces such as StockX, GOAT/Alias, KLEKT, Laced, WeTheNew, eBay and Shopify, automatic repricing (Bricker Mode), a price comparator, shipping labels, invoices and a webhook API. Free tools include marketplace fee calculators for StockX, GOAT and eBay. Plans: Standard €15/month, Premium €30/month, with a free trial. Built by Reactive Systems SL, Ibiza, Spain.

name: HYPEIBIZA
tagline: Compare sneaker prices across 60+ European shops
description: HYPEIBIZA is a sneaker and streetwear price comparison site in Spanish and English, built in Ibiza by Reactive Systems SL. Search by model name or style code, or scan the barcode on the box, and see today's price and sizes in stock at 60+ European shops. Offers are always sorted by price, cheapest in-stock first. Commissions never change the order and no shop can pay for position. We sell nothing ourselves. Extras include a size converter and brand size charts, a release calendar, a deals page and price-drop alerts by email.

name: Clifzo
tagline: Save public videos, audio and images with a link
description: Clifzo resolves public links from YouTube, Bilibili, Douyin, TikTok, X and Pinterest so you can review available media formats without registration. Paste a page URL, short link or share text to see the available title, creator, thumbnail, duration and formats. The web resolver does not merge separate tracks or transcode media. An optional Chrome/Edge extension adds on-page media discovery and local downloads, including supported merging of separate audio/video streams and unencrypted HLS on-demand segments. Availability depends on the source. Use it for content you own or have permission to download.

name: Bad Quality Image Maker
tagline: Free in-browser tool that intentionally worsens images for memes — compression, blur, pixelation, deep fried. No signup, local processing.
description: Instantly make photos look worse on purpose: JPEG crush, blur, pixelate, and deep-fried meme effects. Runs fully in the browser — no account, no upload to a server. Free, no watermark.

name: ToolifyNav
tagline: Find the right AI tool for the job.
description: ToolifyNav is a curated AI tools directory for coding, marketing, design, research and productivity, with clear use cases, honest trade-offs and earned rankings.

name: StackTrim
tagline: Stop overpaying for AI. Send us your bills, we'll show you where the money's leaking.
description: StackTrim audits AI tool bills (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Copilot, Midjourney, ElevenLabs, API usage) for indie devs, vibe coders and small teams. It finds overlapping subscriptions, unused seats, cheaper plans, runaway API spend and expiring trials. A free mini-audit shows your top 3 savings, a full audit is $19, and monitoring with price and renewal alerts is $9/month. No passwords needed, files are deleted within 30 days, and we never sell your data.

name: Transfa
tagline: Clean photo files before your next social post
description: Transfa is a free, mobile-first photo cleaner for people dealing with Instagram AI info labels after editing. Choose JPEG, PNG or WebP photos, inspect supported hidden editing information, and save cleaned copies without re-encoding the image. Single and batch cleanup runs in your browser; photos are not uploaded. Includes a standard MP4/MOV beta and guidance for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook and Threads. Cleaning cannot guarantee label removal, remove invisible watermarks or change labels on existing posts.

name: RivalryRadar
tagline: Know when your competitors change pricing, features or messaging
description: RivalryRadar is online competitor monitoring software for small SaaS teams. Add the competitors you care about, and it checks their homepage, pricing page and changelog. It ignores noise like dates and counters, labels each real change (pricing, plan limits, features or messaging), and explains in plain English what it means for you. You get a digest by email, and the Team and Agency plans also post to Slack. Plans: Free (2 competitors, monthly digest), Solo $9.50/mo (5 competitors, weekly), Team $24.50/mo (15 competitors, daily plus Slack), Agency $74.50/mo (50 competitors, daily plus Slack). There's also a free one-off sample report on any competitor, no account needed.

name: Timerfly
tagline: Employee monitoring and attendance tracking for Windows and Mac teams, priced in rupees.
description:
Timerfly is employee monitoring and attendance tracking for teams at computers, built for Indian companies.

- Work day starts by itself on Windows and Mac
- Late, left-early and absent marked against each shift, night shifts included
- Live view: working, idle, on a break or off
- App and website time, sorted into productive, neutral and unproductive
- Alerts in Slack, Teams, Google Chat or Telegram

Keystrokes are never recorded. No camera or microphone recording, no GPS and no stealth mode. Screenshots are off unless you turn them on, and can be blurred.

From ₹159 per person a month, billed yearly, plus GST. 14-day free trial, no card.

name: Agent Biz Ideas Board
tagline: Free microbusiness ideas an AI agent could run day to day
description: Agent Biz Ideas Board is a free, curated board of microbusiness ideas an AI agent could run day to day: small, niche websites and services where an agent does most of the daily work and a human mostly approves. Each idea card lists the niche, the problem with a cited source, how it could make money, what the agent does each day, the suggested stack, difficulty and whether it is already claimed. It is for solo founders, side hustlers and small business owners.

name: MailTova
tagline: Professional email hosting on your own domain
description: MailTova is a business email hosting SaaS for startups, freelancers, agencies, and small businesses. It helps teams establish a professional identity with custom-domain email addresses and manage business mailboxes from one place.

name: Submi
tagline: Done-for-you SaaS directory submission with live URLs
description: Submi is a done-for-you SaaS directory submission service. Approve one product profile, and Submi handles directory submission across startup launch directories, tracking each listing's DR, status and live URL, with Badge Sync and indexing requests.

name: CodesDex
tagline: Working Roblox and mobile game redeem codes, verified daily.
description: CodesDex is a free hub of working game redeem codes for Roblox and mobile games. Lists are checked daily so players can copy codes that still work. No CD keys, no Robux scams, and no paid unlocks.

name: Free AI Song
tagline: Make a song from a text prompt, no signup to try
description: Free AI Song turns a mood or pasted lyrics into a downloadable song in a few minutes. You can try one song without creating an account.

name: Vectoree
tagline: Give your coding agent a backend — models, auth, database and storage in one cloud.
description: Vectoree gives your AI agent a backend. Everything an agent needs to ship — models, auth, database and storage — lives in one cloud, from demo to production. One project key across providers (xAI, OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, DeepSeek), email/Google auth, Postgres database and storage buckets. Works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents via a skill, CLI and OpenAI-compatible gateway. Pay for tokens, no monthly fee.

name: SeenByAI
tagline: The launchpad and directory for apps built with AI
description: SeenByAI is a launchpad and directory for apps built with AI. Makers submit their app, it launches on a set day, and the community upvotes the best ones. Every app gets its own page written so search engines and AI assistants can read it. Launching is free.

name: TokGlance
tagline: View public TikTok profiles without logging in.
description: Anonymous TikTok viewer. View public TikTok profiles, reposts, followers, and account region without logging in, and track public stats over time. Not an AI token tool. Free.

name: Weather Alerts
tagline: Personal weather alerts for your own limits, per location, days ahead
description: Most weather apps tell you what the sky will do; Weather Alerts tells you when it matters to you. This free Android app lets you save the places in your life and give each one its own warning limits. Set how many millimetres of rain is too much for your commute, which wind or gust speed should cancel the sailing trip, how hot is too hot for the dog walk, and when frost or snow is worth a heads-up. You can also track UV index, air quality (AQI and PM2.5), wildfire smoke, aurora chances via the Kp index, and thunderstorms with lightning. Notifications can come days ahead of the event, so you can plan instead of react. Official severe weather warnings are built in, a route view shows the weather along the way before a drive, and quiet hours keep nights undisturbed. Weather Alerts is free, with an optional Premium plan that starts with a 7-day free trial. Website: https://www.alerts-weather.com/ - Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=weather.alerts

name: AgentsSpot
tagline: Autonomous AI Agents & Frameworks Directory
description: AgentsSpot is the definitive directory of verified autonomous AI agents, coding copilots, and multi-agent orchestration frameworks. Listings are curated for AI engineers and builders, with verification and benchmark-focused review before indexing.

name: Change Text in Image AI
tagline: Select baked-in words and replace them with style match.
description: Upload a finished PNG or JPG, select the words already in the picture, and replace them with a best-effort same-font style match. Sign in, then buy credits. Not a source-file editor and not for ID or document fraud.

name: Plot Unfold
tagline: AI home concepts and a free 3D sketch planner
description: Plot Unfold helps people explore home, room and garden ideas before construction. Create AI visual concepts from a brief, dimensions, style preferences and reference images, then save, revise and download them. A separate free 3D sketch planner supports walls, doors, windows and PNG, GLB, editable JSON and short MP4 exports. New verified users get one free AI credit; one-time credit packs start at $9.

name: Burning Bridges AI
tagline: Upload one photo. Get a short party clip. Unofficial fan tool.
description: Unofficial fan tool. Upload a selfie or pet photo and make a short chandelier-party clip in the style of the Drake Burning Bridges party-scene trend. Silent by default. Not affiliated with Drake, OVO, or the band. Paid credit packs.

name: AI Text Watermark Checker
tagline: Paste text. See the hidden characters. Strip them in the browser.
description: Free in-browser AI text watermark detector for editors and developers. It finds zero-width spaces, homoglyphs, and odd Unicode and can strip them locally. Unofficial. It cannot score OpenAI textGrain or Google SynthID.

name: Doc2Form
tagline: Turn PDF, Word, or scanned documents into native Google Forms with AI
description: Doc2Form uses Gemini AI to read a PDF, Word document, scanned image, or plain description and creates a native Google Form directly in your Google Drive. It detects questions, answer options, field types and section breaks automatically, usually in under a minute. Documents are processed and not stored. First form free, then credit packs, no subscription. Open source and self-hostable.

name: Nova Trading App
tagline: Crypto trading app with paper mode and a kill switch
description: Nova Trading App is a crypto trading app built around risk control. Every account starts in paper mode with virtual money. No order goes through without a stop-loss, risk limits sit above every strategy and can only be tightened, and a kill switch is visible on every screen. Going live is your own choice: connect your own exchange account with trade-only API keys – Nova never gets withdrawal rights. Free plan; Pro and Premium give more keys, alerts and strategies, never different risk limits. Crypto is volatile; you can lose all your capital. Not financial advice.

name: Hashtag Web3
tagline: Web3 jobs, blockchain companies, and career resources
description: Hashtag Web3 is a job board and career resource for the Web3 and blockchain industry. Browse remote and location-based roles, explore blockchain companies, and access career tools and educational resources.

name: SiftingIO
tagline: Market data APIs for stocks, forex, crypto and commodities
description: SiftingIO gives developers live prices and historical OHLCV for US stocks, forex, crypto and commodities through consistent APIs. Use REST for snapshots and historical bars, and WebSocket for live updates. Build charts, portfolio tools, alerts and financial research workflows without maintaining a separate integration for every asset class. SDKs, documentation and an MCP server support application and AI-tool integrations. Start with a free account; coverage, access and usage limits vary by plan. Commercial display and other data uses follow the applicable plan and licensing terms.

name: Apiddy
tagline: AI API gateway. Thin homepage; terms describe subscription API access.
description: Apiddy (apiddy.com) has a thin public homepage titled as an AI API gateway. Its terms describe a developer platform for calling upstream AI model APIs through a shared pool, with subscription daily quotas and load balancing. This listing does not add features beyond that, and it is not an official provider of those upstream models.

name: VEO3
tagline: AI video technology platform for creating and enhancing video.
description: VEO3 is an AI video technology platform. The public site offers image-to-video and text-to-video generation, with model, aspect-ratio, and quality options, and shows a credit cost before generation. It presents itself as a free platform to try AI video creation and enhancement.

name: Word Reverser
tagline: Word Reverser is a free online text reverser tool.
description: Word Reverser is a free online text tool that lets you reverse text, letters, and word order instantly. Paste your text, generate the reversed result, and copy it in seconds. No software installation is required.

name: Nano Banana
tagline: Free AI image generator and editor in the browser. No sign-up to start.
description: Free AI image generator and editor. Create and edit images in the browser with no sign-up to start, and no watermark on standard images. Daily free credits are available; Nano Banana Pro is a paid upgrade. Not a video tool.

name: AI Photoshop Clone — Independent PhotoCraft Host
tagline: Browser image editing with a first-edit and save/export checklist
description:
An independent browser host for PhotoCraft v0.8.2, the editor by the ArtCraft team and contributors. We maintain the website, hosting and practical guides, rather than claiming authorship of the upstream editor.

The first-edit guide helps visitors test a copy of a small image, make one edit, save an editable project, export a PNG and reopen both files before trusting a longer session. This alpha has limited PSD compatibility, no autosave and no connected generative-AI service. PhotoCraft.design (https://photocraft.design/) is our other entry to the same engine.

Upstream editor and credit: https://github.com/storytold/photocraft

name: Ozil Goal AI
tagline: Unofficial CapCut-free desk: one photo to a short Ozil Goal AI clip.
description: Unofficial CapCut-free AI video desk. Upload one selfie, pick a style, and get a short vertical Ozil Goal clip with no editor timeline. Prompts stay optional. Not affiliated with Mesut Ozil, Arsenal, Real Madrid, Fenerbahce, UEFA, CapCut, or ByteDance. Paid one-time credit packs; sign-in required.

name: Whispek
tagline: Talk, don't type. Voice typing for Windows, Mac & Linux
description:
Whispek is an AI voice dictation desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux. Hold a key, speak, and polished text appears in Cursor, Claude Code, Slack, email, or any text box. Hold Right Alt on Windows, Right Option on Mac, or Left Ctrl + Left Alt + Space on Linux.

Auto cleanup removes filler words and fixes punctuation. Writing styles and custom cleanup rules, Dictionary, Snippets, voice translation (30 languages in, 303 out), Whispek Assistant, text rewrite, local notes, and local history with result versions are included. Speech recognition and AI run in the cloud; history stays on your device.

Free plan that resets every 7 days. Pro is US$12/month or US$99/year for unlimited use of all current features. Linux packages: .deb and AppImage.

name: Goal AI Video
tagline: Unofficial fan tool: turn a photo into a short AI clip of the iconic Ozil goal moment.
description: Unofficial fan tool that turns a photo into a short silent AI video recreating the iconic Ozil goal moment. Original AI motion, not match footage. Not affiliated with Mesut Ozil, Arsenal, UEFA, FIFA, or CapCut. Credit packs; sign-in required.

name: GameDeal
tagline: Compare PC game prices before buying
description: GameDeal helps PC players compare current game offers before buying. It shows activation platforms, shop types, offer freshness and price history, including the lowest price seen on GameDeal.

name: Fantasy Matchup Edge
tagline: Deep modeling for FPL and Sorare projections, with thousands of simmed games and proprietary model that goes further than the competition.
description: Data-driven FPL and Sorare analytics using player-level matchup modelling, projections and simulations. Includes predicted points, fixture difficulty, clean-sheet probabilities, DEFCON forecasts and historical player data. Built especially for FPL and Sorare users, so they can get deeper insights than anywhere else in the niche.

name: Brainrot Gaming
tagline: Browser games with controls, play guides and device notes
description: Brainrot Gaming is a free browser-game directory. It helps visitors choose quizzes, puzzles, escape games and clickers by gameplay rather than by similar meme names, with controls, play guides and device notes before the player opens. No Brainrot Gaming account or installation is required. Games belong to their third-party developers; ads, availability and device support vary by game.

name: Amz Operator
tagline: Amazon product research and launch planning in one AI-powered workspace
description: Amz Operator is a product research platform for Amazon private-label sellers. Product Finder helps surface product ideas, while Product Research brings together Amazon demand and competition data, Alibaba sourcing, and launch economics. It helps sellers assess opportunities before investing in inventory. Amz Operator supports research and decision-making; it does not guarantee product profitability.

name: Upbase
tagline: See how your competitors are growing.
description: Upbase.ai is a competitive intelligence platform that helps you understand how products and competitors are growing. Track ads, content, product launches, SEO, social activity, and community traction—all organized into a living GTM timeline. Monitor thousands of products, uncover growth strategies, spot emerging trends, and turn real-time market signals into actionable insights for your own go-to-market strategy.

name: SEObot
tagline: Unlock SEO Potential, Drive Success
description: SeoBOT helps businesses transform SEO from a time-consuming manual process into a more automated growth workflow. The platform uses AI to explore keyword opportunities, analyze search trends, and identify potential areas for improving organic visibility. SEO requires ongoing attention, and traditional workflows often involve multiple tools, spreadsheets, and repetitive research tasks. SeoBOT aims to simplify this process by making SEO research more accessible and efficient. It is particularly useful for founders, indie hackers, SaaS companies, and small marketing teams that need to maximize their resources. With an automation-first approach, SeoBOT helps businesses spend less time on repetitive SEO activities and more time building products, reaching customers, and growing their online presence.

name: Whatsapp API
tagline: GREEN-API
description: GREEN-API provides WhatsApp API solutions for business communication, automation, CRM integration, chatbots, and bulk messaging.

name: VidMake AI
tagline: Turn prompts and images into AI videos
description: VidMake AI creates short videos from text prompts, photos, and reference clips for social media and marketing. Users can choose styles and output formats, then generate and refine clips with AI video and audio tools.

name: ModelClock
tagline: Track AI model releases, changes and retirement deadlines
description: ModelClock helps developers follow published AI model releases, capability changes, deprecations and shutdown dates across providers. Notices include source links and affected hosting routes. Use a browser-local watchlist, Slack or Discord alerts, RSS, calendar feeds, a retirement checker, or a read-only MCP server. ModelClock tracks published notices; it does not test live API availability. Free public beta.

name: ThumbnailMake
tagline: AI YouTube thumbnail maker: four options per prompt, each with a predicted CTR score.
description: ThumbnailMake is an AI thumbnail maker for YouTube, Shorts and TikTok creators. Describe your video in a sentence, or paste a YouTube URL so the title sets the visual direction. Every generation returns four distinct thumbnail concepts, so you compare options instead of re-rolling, and each one comes with a predicted click-through score and a short reason. Refine the winner by chat, switch between 16:9 and 9:16, and export 1280×720 for YouTube or 1080×1920 for Shorts and TikTok. Style presets and niche pages cover gaming (Minecraft, Fortnite, Roblox), vlogs, tutorials, tech, podcasts, reactions, food, fitness and finance. Free to try with no credit card; paid plans start at $19.9 a month and remove the watermark.

name: YaoFlow
tagline: I Ching with a timing date and follow-up
description: Free I Ching (Liu Yao) cast with a classical Najia chart, plain-language reading, a concrete timing date, and an email check-in on that day. For reflection and cultural study — not a prediction; not medical, legal, or financial advice.

name: AI Anime Generator
tagline: Free AI anime generator that turns text prompts or photos into original anime-style art.
description: AI Anime Generator lets anyone create original anime characters, portraits, and scenes from a text prompt or a photo. Choose styles like Chibi, Waifu, Retro, Pixel, Fantasy, or Cyberpunk, pick an aspect ratio, and generate with account credits. New accounts get 30 free bonus credits.

name: Image Cosmos
tagline: Free private image tools
description: Compress, resize, crop and convert images free in your browser. Your files never leave your device.

name: GameNubi
tagline: Discover browser games, daily puzzles and word games
description: GameNubi is a browser game directory for players and game developers. Browse daily puzzles, word games and browser adventures, then visit the official place to play. Developers can submit games for free or choose optional one-time Pro ($19) and Featured ($99) directory placement. Paid plans do not guarantee traffic, approval or rankings.

name: ValuEdge
tagline: Stock valuation and portfolio research for self-directed investors
description: Estimate intrinsic value, compare market price with fair value and research stocks and portfolios in one web workspace. ValuEdge includes watchlists and a read-only MCP connection for supported AI assistants. Public MCP research is available without sign-in; private account context requires authentication and an eligible paid plan. A research tool, not a brokerage or a promise of investment returns.

name: Flying Car AI
tagline: One photo of your car becomes a short cinematic stunt video.
description: Independent creative AI that turns one photo of a car or bike into a short stunt clip: ramp flight, side-view kickflip, or head-on kickflip. Not an official Tesla product.

name: Seedance 2.5
tagline: Create up to 30-second native 4K films from conversation — text, images, video and audio in.
description: Seedance 2.5 creates up to 30-second native 4K films from conversation — describe your scene in text or feed in images, video and audio. 30 free credits, plans from $11.94/mo.

name: Relocatoria
tagline: Find places that fit your monthly living budget
description: Relocatoria helps people compare approximate monthly basic costs across destinations. Set a budget, compare places and read destination guides. Estimates are for one adult; residency eligibility is not checked.

name: Gemini Omni
tagline: Multimodal conversational AI video generator — create videos from text, images, audio and video right in chat.
description: Gemini Omni is a multimodal conversational AI video generator — create videos from text, images, audio and video right in the chat, with in-chat editing and 40-second clip extension. 30 free credits, plans from $9.95/mo.

name: Dive Krillion
tagline: The free daily trivia game where rarer answers dive deeper
description: Dive Krillion is a free daily trivia game. 7 prompts, 25 seconds each — type the rarest correct answer you can think of. Rarer answers score more (10–100 pts) and dive deeper. Features: Unlimited practice mode, Marathon mode, 8 category packs, Rarity Trainer, shareable score cards, cloud saves. No account needed, play free in your browser.

name: jpgHi
tagline: AI image upscaling with adjustable detail and similarity controls
description: jpgHi is an AI image upscaler for photographs, illustrations, portraits and product images. Choose Photo or Artwork, select an enlargement factor and adjust the available detail controls. Larger factors can add more AI-inferred detail, so results should be compared with the source. Limited free tokens are available; paid token packages provide additional processing. Submitted on behalf of the product publisher.

name: jpgRM
tagline: Brush-based AI object removal and photo cleanup in the browser
description: jpgRM is a browser-based AI photo cleanup tool. Brush over an unwanted object, person or background area, then let the service reconstruct the selected region. It supports practical edits such as tidying a product photo or removing a distraction. The free service limits download size; VIP provides higher-resolution downloads. Submitted on behalf of the product publisher.

name: jpgHD
tagline: AI restoration and enhancement for old and damaged photos
description: jpgHD is an AI photo restoration and enhancement service. Its available workflows include old-photo restoration, scratch repair, colourisation and image enlargement. The website provides before-and-after examples and web, mobile and desktop download routes. Free enhancement is limited; old-photo restoration and some options require payment. Submitted on behalf of the product publisher.

name: Bigjpg
tagline: AI enlargement for illustrations, anime artwork and photos
description: Bigjpg is an AI image enlargement tool for illustrations, anime artwork and photographs. Choose an image type, enlargement factor and noise reduction level, then compare the output with the source. A limited free tier is available; paid plans provide higher limits and additional processing options. Submitted on behalf of the product publisher.

name: PdfEditPlus
tagline: Free Online PDF Tools to Manage Your Documents
description: PdfEditPlus is a browser-based PDF toolkit that helps users perform common PDF tasks online, including merging, splitting, compressing, rotating, and converting documents and images.

name: Coloring Parade
tagline: Turn text and photos into printable coloring pages
description: Coloring Parade creates printable coloring pages from text prompts and photos. Choose from six styles and four age groups, then download A4 or US Letter PDFs or color online. The site also offers a free library of printable coloring pages. AI generation includes a limited free trial: one generation without an account or three total with an account. Paid subscriptions and credit packs are available for additional generations.

name: AutoReception
tagline: 24/7 AI receptionist for Australian businesses
description: AutoReception is a 24/7 AI receptionist built for Australian service businesses: tradies, automotive workshops, real estate, dental and medical clinics, and professional services. It answers every call in a natural Aussie voice, captures caller details, books jobs into your calendar, sends missed-call text-back, and forwards urgent calls. Setup takes under 48 hours. Based in Brisbane, serving businesses Australia-wide.

name: KeptRing
tagline: AI answering for the calls contractors miss
description: KeptRing is AI phone answering for home-service and construction contractors. When you can't pick up, it answers, says it's an automated assistant, takes the job details, and emails you the lead right after the call. 14-day free trial.

name: SARVO
tagline: The Trusted Network for Enterprise Technology
description:
SARVO is an India-built directory for enterprise technology. Businesses can find implementation partners across ERP, CRM, HRMS, cybersecurity, cloud and AI, compare them side by side, and connect with the ones that fit. Listing a company is free.

For buyers (founders, CIOs, CTOs, CFOs and business leaders):
- Search and filter partners by technology, product, city, industry, category and services
- Compare 2 to 4 companies side by side
- Company profiles show technologies, services, industries, locations, case studies and moderated reviews
- "Find my partner": describe what you need in about 2 minutes, a real person at SARVO reads it, and you pick which companies hear from you. Free for buyers, no obligation.
- A free resource library with buyer guides, checklists and comparisons

For implementation companies:
- A free company listing, reviewed before it goes live, with no time limit
- Appear in search, filters and technology and city pages
- A Verified badge is granted only after a SARVO admin review. It is never sold.

name: Mini Genius Club
tagline: Ad-free preschool learning app for kids ages 2–7.
description: Mini Genius Club is an ad-free preschool learning app for kids ages 2–7. Animated lessons, games and stories teach Math, English and General Knowledge across five age-based levels. Parents can track real progress from a parent dashboard. It runs in the browser on phone, tablet or computer. Free 7-day trial, no credit card required.

name: Ridfinder
tagline: Independent buyer-side advisory for Remote ID and RF-spectrum drone detection. Free screening, evidence-rated shortlists, disclosed supplier intros.
description: Ridfinder helps prisons, airports, event venues and critical-infrastructure teams select Remote ID and RF drone-detection receivers. Free requirements screening, fixed-price selection reports, disclosed supplier introductions.

name: I Found You in the Crowd AI
tagline: Two photos, one found-you-in-the-crowd AI moment
description: I Found You in the Crowd AI is an independent web tool that turns two portrait photos into a short AI video effect. One person watches from a nightclub balcony, a spotlight finds the other on the dance floor, and their eyes lock. Pick Fated Gaze, Funny or Romantic and AI scene synthesis creates a 10-15 second 480p vertical MP4. No account needed. Paid: from $7.99, one-time payment, no subscription. Independent, unofficial tool; not affiliated with the creators of the I found you in the crowd trend, any artist or rights holder, or TikTok.

name: CryptoIsland
tagline: CryptoIsland puts a live crypto ticker in your Mac’s notch. Free trial prices from Binance, OKX & Hyperliquid; Pro adds read-only positions and price alerts.
description: Crypto prices, alerts and read-only positions in your Mac’s notch. Follow Binance, OKX and Hyperliquid. Try 3 markets for 48 hours; a license is required afterward. US$19.90 / year. No trading. Apple silicon, macOS 14+.

name: Founden
tagline: One AI runs your whole company
description: Founden is the engine for autonomous software. Describe the first version and it goes live. Leave it running and it keeps developing itself. Builds a real company: website, app with sign-in, back office, payments, email and its own domain, built and published by an AI builder (Claude Code or Codex).

name: JyroAI
tagline: One Prompt, Videos and Songs in Minutes
description:
Jyro is a complete AI production studio that turns a single prompt into finished, publish-ready videos and songs. Instead of juggling separate tools for scripting, visuals, voiceover, music and editing, you describe your idea in one line and Jyro produces the entire result — ready to share in minutes.

Most AI tools stop at a single raw clip. Jyro runs the whole production pipeline. For video, it writes the script and screenplay, generates cinematic visuals across 18+ styles, adds professional voiceover (or your own cloned voice), composes original music and sound effects, and creates subtitles and a thumbnail — then assembles everything into one finished video, from short social clips to long-form pieces up to 30 minutes.

Jyro also makes music. From one idea it writes the lyrics, generates the vocals and an original composition, and turns the finished song into a complete music video with cover art — ready to publish.

What sets Jyro apart is the power built in beyond generation. Character DNA keeps the same character perfectly consistent across every scene and every video. Voice cloning lets you narrate or sing in your own voice. A Brand Kit applies your logo, colours and fonts to every output automatically. You can generate in 30+ languages with matching voice and subtitles, edit any scene with a single sentence, and publish straight to your social channels without leaving the app.

Jyro is built for content creators, marketing agencies, D2C brands, musicians, businesses and regional creators who want to produce videos and music faster.

With Jyro you can make product ads, social reels, YouTube videos, explainers, faceless videos, long-form stories, original songs, music videos, jingles and more — all from a single prompt. Start creating free at jyroai.com.

name: Coptic Meet
tagline: Faith-centered dating and community for Coptic Orthodox adults
description: Coptic Meet is a faith-centered dating and community app for Coptic Orthodox and other eligible Orthodox Christian adults to connect around shared values and culture.

name: musitool
tagline: Free browser tuners, vocal range test and pitch detector
description: musitool is a free browser-based collection of practice tools for musicians and singers: a chromatic tuner, ukulele tuner, vocal range test and pitch detector. No signup or app installation is required. Microphone audio is processed locally on your device and is not uploaded. Submitted by Andy on behalf of musitool.

name: The Tools Kit
tagline: Free PDF, image, dev and calculator tools, no signup
description: The Tools Kit skips the signup wall: open the tool you need, use it, and leave with your result. Combine PDFs, compress images, format JSON, build a cron schedule or run quick loan numbers. Tools are grouped into Document, Image, Conversion, Developer, Calculators, Security and Writing categories, and processing happens in the browser wherever possible.

name: Nizlo
tagline: RMM and IT management for MSPs and lean IT teams
description: Monitor Windows and macOS endpoints, review alerts and inventory, coordinate Windows patches and scripts, and open remote-support workflows from one web console. Plans start at $59 per month with unlimited RMM endpoints and a 14-day free trial.

name: Recipe Notes
tagline: Save recipes from TikTok, Instagram and any website
description: Recipe Notes is a free recipe saver and digital cookbook for iPhone, iPad, Android and the web. Save recipes from TikTok, Instagram, Pinterest or any website in one tap, scan cookbook pages, and sort everything into cookbooks. Plan your week, get a merged grocery list, and cook step by step in Cooking Mode. Unlimited recipes, cloud sync, and no ads.

name: Curveball Critiques
tagline: Baseball scouting and player-evaluation platform
description: Curveball Critiques is a New Jersey baseball scouting and player-evaluation platform for families, coaches, and clubs. Services include Reviews, Player Profiles, Club Power Index, High School Power Index, Scout's Notebook, Roster Raise, Field Ad Marketplace, Slugger AI, Diamond Legacy, Verified Free Agents, Ballpark Press Box, and the Field Scouts Affiliate Program. Contact Casey at pr@curveballcritiques.com. Based in New Jersey.

name: Taraki
tagline: AI-powered recruitment software built for Pakistan
description: Taraki is recruitment software built for growing companies in Pakistan. It combines job distribution, applicant tracking, AI screening and candidate management in one platform. Hiring teams can publish jobs, organize applicants through a hiring pipeline and search a reusable candidate database. Tara, its AI recruiter, supports applicant screening and provides candidate scores with reasons. The platform supports candidate communication through email and WhatsApp.

name: EasyAccessPDF
tagline: Automated PDF accessibility tagging & PDF/UA validation — $2.99/doc
description: EasyAccessPDF helps teams fix PDF accessibility without enterprise pricing. Upload a PDF for a free veraPDF-backed accessibility audit, then auto-tag the document for screen readers and download a tagged PDF plus validation report and checklist for a flat $2.99 per document (up to 200 pages). Processing runs in Frankfurt, Germany; files are deleted within 24 hours. Free tools include document-to-Markdown conversion and daily free PDF converters. Built for public sector, universities, legal, finance and compliance teams working toward PDF/UA, Section 508, ADA and EAA requirements.

name: Attachment Style Test
tagline: Free attachment style quiz with personalized AI report. No signup, always free.
description: Free attachment style quiz that maps you to secure, anxious, avoidant, or fearful-avoidant patterns and generates a personalized AI report. No signup, no paywall — private by design and always free.

name: PageToPromo
tagline: Turn public product-page text into a caption-first kinetic-typography launch video.
description: PageToPromo is an AI launch video maker for founders and marketers. It reads the public text on your product page, lists reviewable facts, and drafts an editable script. After you confirm the script, it composes a caption-first motion graphics video with animated typography, cards and simple shapes, so you get a product launch video without screen recording. It does not capture or recreate your website UI. Motion composition runs on Claude Opus 5.5; PageToPromo is independent and not affiliated with Anthropic. Confirming one script unlocks a free watermarked preview of about five seconds; full renders will be part of a subscription.

name: Swapotamus
tagline: Find niche referral partners without hours of outreach
description: Swapotamus helps website owners find relevant referral partners without hours of manual outreach. Add your website, install a lightweight widget once, and review partner suggestions based on topic, language, and audience. Manual approval is the default: choose recommendations, block domains, exclude categories, or pause anytime. Track referral clicks sent and received. The invitation-only pilot is free and seeks website owners to test setup and match relevance. Recommendations are nofollow; availability depends on the early network. Apply at https://swapotamus.com/pilot.

name: SeeAny
tagline: Create and compare AI images, video, music and text
description: SeeAny brings AI image, video, music, speech and text generation into one workspace. Users can compare outputs from multiple available models, refine prompts, and revisit results in private history. Tools include image upscaling, background removal and text-to-speech. New users receive 50 welcome credits valid for seven days; generation costs vary by model.

name: Afilnet
tagline: Bulk SMS, certified SMS, voice and WhatsApp Business API for companies
description: Afilnet is a business messaging platform for bulk SMS, certified SMS with legal value, voice messages, certified email and the WhatsApp Business API. Companies send from a web panel or integrate it via REST API and plugins for popular e-commerce and CRM tools, with real-time delivery reports and coverage in more than 200 countries.

name: TextLantern
tagline: Translate Discord privately or for your whole server
description: TextLantern is a Discord translator for you and your server. Translate any message privately from its Apps menu, write replies in another language with /t, or auto-translate channels between two main languages. 92 languages, no Administrator permission, one-time packs that never expire. 300 characters free.

name: Cotizaciones al Instante
tagline: Crea cotizaciones profesionales desde tu celular y compártelas por WhatsApp.
description: Herramienta web para freelancers y pequeños negocios en México: crea cotizaciones profesionales, agrega productos, descuentos e impuestos, personaliza tu marca y comparte propuestas por WhatsApp. Plan gratis con 3 cotizaciones al mes; Pro por $99 MXN al mes.

name: Crazy Frog AI
tagline: Ride the invisible moped in your own Crazy Frog trend video, from one photo
description: Crazy Frog AI puts you into the viral invisible-moped video. Upload one clear photo and the AI recasts the 14-second trend clip with you as the rider: squatting low on a moped that isn't there, fists on invisible handlebars, chased by a cop on a hover-bike, flipping in mid-air and racing off. There is no prompt to write and no timing to match, because the clip is already loaded. You can add a friend's photo to play the chasing cop and a photo of your own street, campus or skyline as the backdrop. Videos come with the trend soundtrack and render at 480p, 720p or 1080p, ready for TikTok, Reels and Shorts. It runs in the browser on phone or desktop, credits are one-time packs from $9.90 with no subscription, and failed videos are refunded automatically.

name: FreePSLScore
tagline: Free PSL score test and AI face analysis
description: FreePSLScore offers a free browser-based PSL face rating test (1–8 scale) using AI landmark detection to estimate facial harmony, symmetry, and proportions. Photo processing happens locally in the browser; no registration is required for the basic score. For entertainment and self-reflection only.

name: The Talent App
tagline: MIT-licensed open-source applicant tracking system you self-host
description: The Talent App is an MIT open-source ATS for teams that want to self-host hiring. Run it on your own infrastructure (Supabase + your host), keep candidate data under your control, and ship SSO, MFA and an append-only audit log in open code. Optional AI uses your own Gemini key. Built by SparxIT.

name: Feliz Halloween IA
tagline: AI Catrina & Halloween makeup from your selfie
description: Feliz Halloween IA turns a selfie into Catrina, skull, vampire, clown or half-face zipper makeup. Free watermarked preview; HD (3 credits) and 9:16 video (25 credits). Spanish-first, available in 10 languages.

name: Xquik
tagline: X Twitter scraper API, MCP & real-time monitoring
description: Xquik is the world's fastest and cheapest X Twitter scraper service with the most complete X data. Search tweets, export followers & replies, and retrieve profiles through REST, MCP & SDKs. Build account monitoring workflows with signed webhooks. Most other Apify Actors charge before filtering or deduplication. Xquik charges only for delivered, unique, filter-matching results and never pads rows. Xquik is an independent third-party service. Not affiliated with X Corp. "Twitter" and "X" are trademarks of X Corp.

name: base64.host
tagline: Free Base64 encoding, decoding and browser-based developer tools
description: base64.host is a free suite of 25 browser-based utilities for developers. Encode and decode Base64 text, files and images with UTF-8, emoji and URL-safe support. Other tools include JSON, SQL and YAML formatting, JWT decoding, hashing, UUID and password generation, QR codes, regular expressions, text utilities and timestamp conversion. Tool inputs are processed locally in the browser, and no account is required.

name: VideoPromptFlow
tagline: Convert GIF to MP4 locally and inspect the saved result
description: A browser-based GIF to MP4 converter with adjustable output size and frame rate. Files stay on the device during conversion. It exports silent H.264 MP4 video for one GIF cycle and provides original sample files, a timing comparison, and checklists for inspecting the saved output. No account or watermark.

name: Raindance AI Video

Yoybo is a digital loyalty card platform that helps small businesses turn first-time visitors into regular customers.

Designed for cafés, restaurants, bakeries, beauty salons, nail studios, and other local businesses, Yoybo makes customer loyalty simple and affordable.

Start free with up to 20 customer cards. No credit card required.

Paid subscription with separate usage charges; a seven-day trial is available.

name: AI Ready Check
tagline: Can ChatGPT read your business website?
description: Can ChatGPT read your business website? Paste your URL. The free scan reads your homepage, robots.txt, llms.txt and sitemap, checks your rules for 8 AI crawlers, and shows evidence and a fix for each finding. No signup, results in under a minute. name: XSaveClip
tagline: Free X (Twitter) Video, GIF & MP3 Downloader
description: XSaveClip is a free online tool for downloading supported videos, GIFs, photos, and MP3 audio from public X (Twitter) posts. Simply paste a post URL, choose an available media format, and save your media directly through your browser. No account or software installation is required.

name: Vibe Codes

Listing is free, AI writes the listing from your project URL, and sellers keep 90% of each sale. Free and open-source kits are welcome too.

name: TokenPricing
tagline: Compare LLM API token pricing across 236 providers
description: TokenPricing is a free, independent LLM API pricing comparison site. It tracks 625 models across 236 providers and shows input, output and cached token pricing in USD per 1 million tokens, so official developer prices, cloud listings and third-party API offers can be compared side by side. No signup or login is needed. Each offer links to the page where its pricing was published. The first row for each model is its base rate; other rows are additional published provider pricing. Missing pricing stays unknown instead of being shown as zero, and only active, standard base token rates are included. Batch, region-specific, VIP-group and token-tier offers are excluded, and price outliers are kept out of price summaries until verified. Each model page lists the official rate next to additional provider offers, with context window, capability tags, cache write, batch and web search charges where published, plus speed and uptime when a source reports them. A chart plots input against output price so the cheapest providers are easy to spot, and the homepage table can be filtered by 30 days, 90 days or all time. The pricing calculator turns input tokens, output tokens, requests per month and cache hit rate into an estimated monthly bill and cost per request, using published model pricing or your own custom rates. It splits the bill into uncached input, cached input and output, offers Chat app, AI agent and High volume presets, and compares the same workload across other offers. A pricing guide explains tokens, per-million conversion and prompt-cache pricing. The catalog is checked daily. Use TokenPricing to find the cheapest provider for a model, see how prompt caching changes the bill, or budget an AI app or agent before launch. The site is free, with no paid plans, and no signup is required.

Reviews: save review photos and review videos, and export reviews to Excel and CSV with an AI sentiment label per review (positive, neutral, negative). 200 reviews by default, up to 500, or only the 1 to 3 star ones, which is where the complaint that keeps coming back shows up.

Pro ($7.99/month or $79.99 lifetime, 7-day refund) adds videos, review media, review export and one-click download of everything. ShopEDown reads what the page has already loaded and sends Shopee nothing extra while you browse; files go from Shopee straight to your disk, never through ShopEDown's servers. It does not download Shopee Live or the Shopee Video feed, and it is an independent tool, not affiliated with Shopee.

name: AskAgentsAI
tagline: An AI Interview Assistant
description: Ask Agents is an AI-powered interview assistant that helps job seekers prepare for interviews with personalized questions, resume-based practice, and AI feedback. It supports technical and HR interview preparation, helping candidates improve their answers, build confidence, and get ready for real interviews.

name: MyCaseStatus.in
tagline: Free Indian court case status search
description: MyCaseStatus.in lets anyone check Indian court case status for free. Search by CNR number, party name or advocate name across 36 states/UTs and 700+ district courts, and see hearing dates and case details in one place. No registration, no paywall and no hidden charges.

name: Pricify
tagline: Live NSE/BSE, crypto and mutual fund tracker
description: Pricify (pricify.in) is a free market dashboard for Indian users. It tracks 1,700+ stocks across NSE, BSE and global exchanges, 1,250+ cryptocurrencies, ETFs, mutual funds, sectors and IPOs, and includes a SIP calculator and stock screener. Information only, not investment advice.

name: Tools of India
tagline: 213+ free Indian calculators and online tools
description: Tools of India (toolsofindia.com) is a free collection of 213+ browser-based tools for Indian users: GST, TDS, income tax, SIP and EMI calculators, plus PDF tools, text utilities and CSS generators. Everything runs in the browser, with no sign-up and no paywall.

name: EstateAI by Pixel Perfects Solutions
tagline: AI real estate photo editing, virtual staging and HDR merge
description: EstateAI helps real estate photographers, agents, brokerages and property teams prepare listing media. Organize photos by property, apply virtual staging, image enhancement, day-to-dusk editing and decluttering, compare results with originals, and deliver selected media. A separate HDR workflow merges bracketed exposures. Free and paid plans are available. Review AI outputs before publication.

name: SEOENV
tagline: Backlink manager for link exchanges and paid links
description: SEOENV keeps link exchanges, paid placements, guest posts and directory links in one place, and rechecks every link status with one click. Built for SEO freelancers, in-house teams and agencies. Free plan available.

name: Steam Page Auditor
tagline: Paste a Steam URL → 60s AI audit with score and ready-to-paste rewrites
description: Steam Page Auditor runs a 12-point conversion audit on any Steam store page (Coming Soon or released). You get a score/100, top issues, capsule/screenshot notes, short-description + hook rewrites, tag suggestions, and 5 high-review comparable games. Built for indie game developers preparing Next Fest, demos, or launch. Free preview on the website; full audits also on Apify at $0.99/page. Uses public Steam data only — no Steam login required.

name: XCrawl
tagline: Web scraping, crawling and SERP data in one API
description: XCrawl is a web data API for teams building AI apps. Turn a URL into Markdown, JSON, HTML or a screenshot, crawl a full site with scope and depth rules, list every URL on a domain, or get structured search results from Google, Bing and other engines. Rendering, proxies and retries are handled on the server. Python and Node.js SDKs, a CLI, an MCP server and an n8n node are available; new accounts get 1,000 free credits.

name: Craic Hub
tagline: Free community hub for Solana tokens
description: Craic Hub is a free community hub for Solana tokens. Projects can list their token at no cost, and members can browse listed tokens, post in the community feed, join a clan and climb the ranks by taking part. Listing also works straight from Telegram with Craic Bot (t.me/CraicHubBot), so a project can add its token without leaving chat. Craic Hub is built by the Craic Coin community. It is a discovery and community tool only and gives no financial advice.

name: TermiGram
tagline: SSH terminal and SFTP file manager inside Telegram
description: TermiGram is an SSH terminal and SFTP file manager inside Telegram, with built-in AI help for TermiGram, SSH and Linux. Developers and VPS owners can work with externally reachable servers. The Free plan includes one server profile, one terminal session and one SFTP workspace. Cloud Terminal and additional capacity are available on eligible paid plans.

name: RAI Builder
tagline: No-code AI assistants with company knowledge, CRM and a virtual office
description: RAI Builder is RAI's no-code platform for business AI assistants. It connects customer communication, company knowledge and CRM workflows, with a virtual office for viewing agent activity and handoffs to people. Businesses can start with a defined task such as collecting a customer brief or qualifying an inquiry; available integrations and limits depend on the selected plan. RAI also provides custom AI development for requirements outside the standard product. RAI Builder is a paid subscription product; current plans and trial conditions are on its official website. Submitted by an AI assistant acting as RAI's press representative. This description is based on RAI's public product information, not an independent review.

name: TravelWhiteLabel
tagline: White-label travel booking websites for UK travel agencies and tour operators.
description: TravelWhiteLabel is a UK white-label travel booking platform for travel agencies, tour operators, OTAs and consolidators. Agencies get a branded booking website for flights, hotels and holiday packages, plus an optional B2B portal for sub-agents with markups and credit controls.
