It connects to GDS and bedbank content including Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport, TBO, Stuba, Ratehawk, HotelBeds and DOTW, and meta search such as Skyscanner and Kayak. There is no setup fee, and you get a free beta site with billing only starting at go-live. Customers can use our suppliers at no extra cost, and those suppliers are ATOL and ABTA protected.

name: Graffitizer
tagline: Free online graffiti lettering editor
description: Graffitizer lets you turn a name or short phrase into graffiti lettering. Pick from bubble, tag, and wildstyle presets, then move, rotate, resize, and recolor individual letters. Export PNG, transparent PNG, or SVG without an account or watermark. Useful for name stickers, profile graphics, posters, and social posts. Works on desktop and mobile.

name: P7MtoPDF
tagline: Open P7M documents locally in your browser
description: P7MtoPDF is an Italian-language web tool for opening P7M documents locally in the browser. The free workflow displays signature information, a watermarked first-page PDF preview and invoice summaries. Pro includes original-file downloads, full invoice views and printing, and ZIP packaging. Its signature checks concern technical integrity; they are not a legal certification and do not check certificate revocation or the AgID trust list. The site offers subscriptions and a one-time file-credit pack. I’m part of the team behind P7MtoPDF.

name: Noillirk
tagline: Daily common answer guessing game in your browser
description: Noillirk is a free daily common answer game: 7 rounds a day, guess the most common answer to a prompt and fly from the forest to the rainbow. No signup.

name: Video Noise Remover
tagline: Clean wind, hum and street noise out of voice videos
description: Video Noise Remover reduces background noise in video and audio recordings. Files up to 10 minutes are free, with no account or watermark, and are processed on your own device with DeepFilterNet3. Longer Pro files upload only the audio track for server-side processing; the video picture stays on your device. Your browser combines the cleaned audio with the original video without re-encoding the picture. The tool is designed for speech, so music may be reduced too. Pro plans include monthly and yearly subscriptions and a one-time time pack. The homepage has before-and-after samples you can switch between. I’m part of the team behind Video Noise Remover.

name: Room Redesign
tagline: Restyle a photo of your room in 7 interior styles with AI
description: Room Redesign restyles a photo of your room with AI. Upload a picture and pick one of 7 interior styles: Scandinavian, Modern, Minimalist, Bohemian, Japandi, Mid-Century or Coastal. Your first restyle is free, watermarked and needs no sign-up. It's a loose restyle, not an exact copy: it can move furniture or shift the camera angle. Tidy rooms give the best results; cluttered rooms are where it starts making things up.

name: AnyPS5 Guide
tagline: Look up AnyPS5 game reports and prepare your next run.
description:
AnyPS5 Guide is an independent reference for readers following the open-source AnyPS5 relinker. Look up a game and host system to find reported results, including the build used and remaining blockers. The checker can compare two reports while keeping their configurations separate.

The guide also links to official downloads and explains conversion inputs, Windows and Linux setup, and runtime folders. Troubleshooting begins with the first failing stage and includes a local report builder. The website is free and needs no registration. Source links lead to the original documentation and game discussions. AnyPS5 Guide is independent of Sony and the upstream AnyPS5 developers.

name: TogetherTab
tagline: Shared bills and expenses, in sync for couples.
description: TogetherTab gives couples a shared space to stay on top of bills and expenses. Track bills and expenses together, use custom splits, review payment history, leave partner notes, and send requests for help. One plan includes both partner accounts. Start with a 14-day free trial—no card is required and it will not auto-charge. Paid access is $9.99 per month for both partners when you choose to subscribe.

name: Checknumber
tagline: Check phone, email and account lists from Excel
description: Checknumber is a web workspace for checking contact lists. Upload XLSX, CSV or TXT, choose a check, review the cost and export the results. Available checks include WhatsApp and Telegram registration, email deliverability and selected account or profile checks. Excel exports can keep the original columns alongside the results. Checks are paid by volume; minimum billable quantities, coverage and availability vary by product. A positive result does not guarantee future message delivery.

name: Alfova
tagline: Turn PDF and image schedules into editable calendar events
description: Alfova helps students, shift workers, sports fans, and teams convert readable PDF schedules or timetable images into editable events. Users review extracted dates, times, titles, and locations before downloading a standard ICS file for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Outlook, or another compatible calendar app.

name: Foreclosure Data Hub
tagline: Daily foreclosure data, alerts, and investor tools
description: Foreclosure Data Hub helps real estate investors, wholesalers, and agents research U.S. foreclosure and REO opportunities. Search by market and sale date, review property and owner details, save searches with email alerts, and export to CSV or Google Sheets. Eligible plans include REST API access. Free investor calculators help you explore deal scenarios without signing in.

name: Carpool Karaoke AI
tagline: Four photos to a 15s Carpool Karaoke AI video.
description: Carpool Karaoke AI turns four seat photos into a fixed 15-second in-car karaoke video. Windshield-camera motion, Walk It Talk It hook, no prompt. For TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.

name: MemorySync
tagline: Long-term memory for AI agents, scoped to each user
description: MemorySync is a hosted memory API for AI apps. Your agent saves what it learns about each user; MemorySync returns the relevant memories later, ranked by meaning and scoped per user. Python SDK (pip install memorysync), works with LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, CrewAI, LlamaIndex and more. Free tier.

name: IdeaShot
tagline: One rough idea → ready posts for X, LinkedIn & Reddit, plus a reusable AI prompt — in one shot.
description: IdeaShot turns a messy half-formed idea into ready-to-post copy and a reusable AI prompt in one generation. Paste a rough thought—product launch, personal brand update, side-project shout—and get tailored drafts for X (Twitter), LinkedIn, and Reddit, plus a prompt you can reuse in ChatGPT or Claude. Built for indie makers who ship weekly but hate blank-page writing. One free demo; then $9/10 credits or $12/mo.

name: OmniMux
tagline: Create AI characters and generate videos from reference clips.
description: OmniMux helps you create AI characters, build multi-view reference sheets, and generate character videos from reference clips. Start with a description or feature choices, generate a character, then choose or upload a reference video to create your character video. Use your own successfully generated character image to make multi-view references for future creations. Review results, reuse saved traits, and download finished work. Designed for individual creators, small teams, and brands making character-led videos. Optional trial packs and subscriptions are available, or you can top up and pay per generation. Use only reference materials you are authorized to use; generated results may vary.

name: Image Conversion
tagline: Free private image conversion, compression and resizing in your browser.
description: Image Conversion is a free browser-based toolkit for converting, compressing, resizing and preparing images in batches. Selected image and PDF files are processed on your device rather than uploaded by the converter. Tools include cropping, metadata removal, watermarking, image-to-PDF and ZIP downloads. A Shopify and website preset exports WebP with a maximum longest side of 2000 pixels and a 1.5 MB size limit. Up to 25 files per batch; browser and file-size limits apply. No account or paid export tier is required.

name: Capture Signoff
tagline: Turn public webpage captures into version-linked client approvals.
description: Capture Signoff helps freelance web designers and agencies review publicly accessible website pages with clients. Capture desktop and mobile evidence, share a no-login review link, and collect approve or request-changes decisions page by page. When a later capture changes a page, that page needs approval again; unchanged pages retain their approvals. Downloadable proof packs include capture evidence and a manifest. A limited free public proof flow and free workspace are available; paid workspace plans are Pro at $12/month and Agency at $29/month. This is for public HTTP(S) URLs, not password-protected staging. It does not provide inline commenting, legal electronic signatures, team seats or white-label workspaces.

name: WorkbookDiff
tagline: Compare two Excel workbook versions locally, then hand off a reviewed report.
description: WorkbookDiff helps analysts and spreadsheet reviewers compare two same-layout .xlsx workbook versions in their browser. Workbook files stay on the device. Free comparison and CSV export cover cell values, stored formula expressions, added or removed worksheets, worksheet visibility, hidden rows and columns, and used-range differences. An optional $19 one-time handoff report adds review marks, notes, HTML export and printing for one workbook pair, with repeat exports of the same report. No subscription is required. Comparison is coordinate-based: it does not realign reordered rows, recalculate formulas, or compare formatting, charts, pivots or macros. Inputs are two unencrypted .xlsx files, up to 20 MiB each.

name: Brightward Weekly Commitment Builder
tagline: Turn one goal into a scheduled weekly action, without an account.
description: Brightward Studio created this free browser-based weekly planning tool. Enter an outcome, a controllable action, a time and place, and a smaller fallback. Generate and download a text plan without signup. The site also has practical guides, a free printable weekly scorecard and a 30-second worked example at /sample.html. The optional complete 90-Day Execution Workbook is a separate $7 USD purchase on Gumroad: nine static US Letter printable PDF pages, not a fillable app. Submitted by the creator. No guaranteed outcomes.

name: ReceiptCSV
tagline: Turn receipt PDFs and phone photos into CSV or Excel rows, read on your device
description: ReceiptCSV turns store, restaurant, gas and travel receipts into spreadsheet rows: merchant, date, subtotal, tax, tip, total, payment method and line items. It takes PDF receipts plus JPG, PNG or HEIC photos, and the OCR runs on your own device, so nothing gets uploaded or stored. Lines are checked against the receipt total. 3 free receipts a day with no signup, then $19 for 50 credits or $9/mo unlimited. Built for receipts, not invoices.

name: LineItemCSV
tagline: Turn invoice and bill PDFs into clean CSV or Excel rows, right in your browser
description: LineItemCSV pulls the line items out of invoice and bill PDFs and gives you CSV or Excel rows: date, invoice number, vendor, description, quantity, unit price, amount, tax and total. It adds up the lines and checks them against the invoice total before you import. Everything is read in your browser, so your PDFs are never uploaded or stored. Batch up to 25 files into one CSV. Works on PDFs with a text layer. First 3 conversions are free with no signup, then $19 for 50 or $9/mo unlimited.

name: Bad Times AI
tagline: Turn one photo into a Bad Times dance video
description: Bad Times AI is an independent web tool that turns one photo into an AI-generated dance effect video. Pick one of five dance templates, upload a portrait, group or pet photo, and AI motion synthesis creates a 14-15 second 480p portrait MP4: one person dances solo, everyone in a group photo dances together, and pets can join. No account needed. Paid: from $7.99, one-time payment, no subscription. Independent, unofficial tool; not affiliated with the creators of the Bad Times trend or with TikTok.

name: Alors On Danse Video Maker
tagline: Turn two photos into a studio dance video
description: Alors On Danse Video Maker is an independent web app that turns two separate portrait photos into a two-person studio dance video. The first photo plays the keyboard and the second dances beside them. Pick 16:9 or 9:16 and get a 13-second 480p clip with original electronic audio, then preview, download and share. No prompt, no filming, no editing. It is a paid product: 20 credits per video, credit packs from $8.90. Independent, unofficial tool: not affiliated with Stromae, the song's rights holders or TikTok. It is not the official music video and does not include the original song recording.

name: GrokVideo Studio
tagline: Independent AI video generator: text or image to video
description: Grok Video Generator (GrokVideo Studio) is an independent web app that turns a text prompt or a reference image into an AI video using xAI's Grok Imagine API. Make 6-30 second text-to-video or 1-15 second image-to-video clips at 480p or 720p, try photo effect templates, and see the credit cost before you generate. New accounts get 20 trial credits on first login (free trial), then optional credit packs. It is an independent product and is not an official xAI or X product.

name: SG Exam Hub
tagline: Free Singapore primary exam papers and instant-feedback practice
description: SG Exam Hub is a free web resource for Singapore primary school revision. It brings together 2,299 past school exam papers for P2–P6 from 28 schools (2019–2025) in English, Chinese, Higher Chinese, Maths and Science. You can filter by level, subject, year, WA/SA exam type and school, then view the paper online or download the PDF. A practice section has 2,692 original questions over 283 topics, each marked straight away with the working shown, and a Topics page ranks how often each topic appears in real papers. No login, no ads, nothing to pay.

name: Shuttlewright Mask Pro
tagline: Strip client details from text before it reaches an AI chat.
description: Mask Pro swaps names, emails, phone numbers, cards, account numbers, addresses and amounts for tokens before your text reaches an AI model, then puts the real values back in the reply. Free tier to try; Pro is $9/month.

name: Shuttlewright Security Desk
tagline: Security questionnaire drafts cited to your own sources.
description: Security Desk answers security questionnaires from your own documents. The free no-signup try takes your own text for up to 3 questions. The $850 service covers one questionnaire family with drafts cited to your sources, and your reviewer checks every answer before it goes back. No certification claims.

name: Webpage to PDF
tagline: Convert public webpages into PDFs for reading, sharing and printing.
description: Webpage to PDF converts public URLs to PDFs. Quick Convert captures full-page appearance, while Custom controls page size, margins and orientation. Quick and Custom work without signup with 10 minutes of daily cloud conversion; a verified free account provides 30 minutes and website Visual Editor access. Optional Pro and extension Visual access are paid. Submitted on behalf of the product owner.

name: StubCSV
tagline: Convert pay stub, W-2 and 1099-NEC PDFs into clean CSV in seconds
description: StubCSV turns pay stub, W-2 and 1099-NEC PDFs into clean CSV files you can drop into a spreadsheet, budgeting app or tax prep workflow. Files are processed in memory and never stored. You get 2 free conversions a day with no account. Need more? Paid plans are $19 for 50 credits or $9/mo.

name: ValorantCrosshair.org
tagline: Pro Valorant crosshair codes and a free crosshair generator
description: ValorantCrosshair.org is a free Valorant crosshair code database and generator. It tracks the settings of 1,200+ pro and streamer players including TenZ and Demon1, with 16,000+ crosshair codes. New codes are added every hour. Every crosshair has a live preview on real map backgrounds and a one-click Copy button; to use one, open Settings > Crosshair in Valorant, choose Import Profile Code and paste. The free generator lets players change color, outlines, center dot, and inner and outer lines, then export a code. There is a set of fun crosshairs too (Fishnet, Sun, Flappy Bird). The FAQ covers what crosshair codes are and how to fix failed imports. No login needed. Independent fan project, not affiliated with Riot Games.

name: Bank Statement Converter AI
tagline: Convert PDF bank statements to CSV, Excel, and OFX
description: AI-powered bank statement converter that turns text-based PDF bank and credit card statements into structured Excel, CSV, or OFX files. Built for accountants, business owners, and freelancers. Start free with 5 pages.

name: Yes No Tarot
tagline: Free AI yes/no tarot readings with a 3-card spread
description: Yes No Tarot gives free, instant yes-or-no tarot readings. Ask one clear question, draw three cards, and AI interprets the cards, their orientations and spread positions together to give a tentative answer with a confidence label (clear, slight or mixed), an explanation and practical advice on love, career and money.

name: Image to Excel AI
tagline: Turn table screenshots into editable Excel spreadsheets
description: Upload a screenshot or photo of a table. AI reads every cell, you review and edit the result, then copy cells or download an Excel file. Works in the browser with no install. Free plan available (5 conversions/day).

name: EnhanceWizard
tagline: Free AI image enhancer: upscale, unblur and sharpen photos online.
description: EnhanceWizard is an AI photo enhancer that upscales, unblurs and sharpens images right in the browser. The free Standard tier works up to 1024px with no watermark and no sign-up card; HD output is available with credits.

name: EzDIS
tagline: Business software for distributors and small businesses
description: EzDIS helps distributors and small businesses manage products, inventory, sales, electronic invoicing, collections, payments, routes and operational tasks from one web application. It supports multiple countries and can connect Mercado Pago and Biller when configured.

name: Taichi Walking
tagline: Learn tai chi walking at home in a few minutes: slow, low-impact steps for balance, joints, and stress, plus a free printable 7-day plan.
description: Tai Chi Walking is a beginner-friendly guide to tai chi walking. It teaches slow, low-impact steps you can practice at home in a few minutes, with calm breathing and alignment that is easy on the joints. It is for beginners, seniors who want gentle movement for balance, and anyone looking for a quieter way to walk. A free printable 7-day plan is available, and Lesson 1 is free to watch. Full video lessons are a one-time purchase, with no subscription.

name: Online Kids Games
tagline: Free browser games with numbers, colors, words, and rhythm
description: Free browser games for kids featuring number matching, color puzzles, word building, and rhythm activities. Play directly online without an account.

name: Sadana Mascot
tagline: Build an original mascot from a few words, then adjust every part
description: Sadana Mascot lets you describe yourself or a brand, pick a flat, soft or bot style, and adjust the body, eyes, mouth, pattern, accessory and color. Characters are assembled from parts by code. Download a free 512px PNG with a small corner mark, or buy the $9 one-time pack for clean files and a commercial license.

name: WorksheetInk
tagline: Build focused print practice and learning routines without an account
description: WorksheetInk helps educators and families turn a planned skill or routine into a printable page. Its 54 free browser tools cover math, English and Chinese practice, handwriting, word puzzles, paper templates and learning planners. Pick the material, adjust the amount and writing space, and check the preview before printing A4 or Letter or saving a PDF. Relevant exercises offer matching answers. It is a preparation toolkit, not a complete curriculum or an AI tutor.

name: LaunchListKit
tagline: Prepare directory launch copy without signing up
description: LaunchListKit is a free browser tool for SaaS founders, AI tool creators and indie makers preparing a launch. Build a reusable product profile, generate templated listing copy, review dated directory requirements, create source-tagged links and export a three-row submission tracker. The free workflow needs no account. An optional USD 29 one-time Pro Kit adds an offline workspace and fuller exports. It does not submit for you or guarantee acceptance, traffic, rankings or sales.

name: Cognenza
tagline: Practical AI guides, prompts and price comparisons for everyday work and small businesses.
description: Cognenza is a practical artificial intelligence explainer site in 7 languages, for non-technical people, freelancers and small businesses. It publishes step-by-step guides for each tool, a library of copy-ready prompts and comparisons with official prices and the date they were checked. It offers free tools that run in the browser with no signup (prompt builder, personal-data cleaner, which-AI-suits-you quiz, cost calculator), a prompt tester running an open AI model, and an embeddable price comparator with no cookies or trackers. No advertising, no affiliate links.

name: Recessed Light Calculator
tagline: Plan a rectangular room's recessed lights with an editable 2D layout.
description: Free browser-based planning calculator for a rectangular room's general lighting. Adjust room dimensions, fixture lumens, target illuminance and utilization/maintenance assumptions, review a 2D light layout, and export PNG or CSV. Supports feet/metres and lux/foot-candles. An initial planning model, not site photometry, an electrical design or an installation approval.

name: Mesodian
tagline: Learn investing, understand companies and track your portfolio in one place.
description: Mesodian helps beginners learn how to invest, understand the stock market and manage their investments. It brings simple lessons, clear company scores, ready-made portfolios and tracking tools together in one place. Working alongside your existing broker, Mesodian helps you understand what you own, the risks involved and what is changing, so you can build your knowledge and confidence at your own pace.

name: DamnPDFs
tagline: 70+ free tools for PDFs, documents, images and audio
description: DamnPDFs is an independent file-tool project by Sourav Bera. Edit existing PDF text, sign documents, merge and compress PDFs, convert Word and PowerPoint files, compress images, remove image backgrounds, run OCR and transcribe audio. Build reusable workflows for compatible file tasks, or use the public Codex plugin with a paired browser workspace. No account is needed and the platform adds no watermark. Processing badges identify browser tools and temporary cloud options. Optional external AI features require your own provider key and may incur provider charges.

name: PageLinker
tagline: Create editable AI landing pages without code
description: PageLinker helps small businesses, founders and marketing teams build landing pages with AI or templates, personalize content and design in a visual editor, publish campaign pages, and collect form enquiries. WhatsApp and phone call buttons can also be added. Free, Pro and Agency plans are available.

name: Extraiga
tagline: Upload. Extract. Verify. Export.
description: Extraiga is a website that turns documents and pages into a spreadsheet — typed forms, receipts, invoices, scans, printed text, and handwriting. Upload images, PDFs, or TIFFs (up to 20 MB each), type the fields you need as columns (for example Vendor, Date, Amount), and each file becomes one row. Review cells marked Needs review against the original page, then export to Excel, CSV, or Google Sheets. There is no fixed layout template: you name the fields yourself. Free includes 10 pages a month with no card and no ads. Paid plans start at Starter for $9.99 a month (150 pages); extra pages on monthly plans are $0.02 each. Originals stay available for 30 days for that check, then are deleted. Built for small businesses, bookkeepers, VAs, and anyone who retypes piles into sheets.

name: MarkAny
tagline: Convert any file to Markdown with OCR
description: MarkAny converts PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML, EPUB and images into structured Markdown with OCR, and exports Markdown to DOCX, PDF, HTML and more.

name: TransMonkey
tagline: AI translation for documents, images and videos
description: TransMonkey is an AI-powered translation platform supporting document, image, and video translation with fast, accurate multilingual content conversion.

name: SelfPath
tagline: A life-planning system from core values to daily actions
description: SelfPath is a private web workspace inspired by Benjamin Franklin’s time-management system. It connects core values and life mission with long-term plans, short-term goals and today’s calendar. The free plan includes a Goal Tree, calendar and daily planning, reviews, analytics, export and account controls. AI Coach and other Prime AI features are planned, not currently available.

name: IntoTheMeme
tagline: Turn one photo into a 10-second TikTok or Reels meme video
description: IntoTheMeme turns a single photo into a 10-second meme video ready for TikTok or Reels. Pick a trend like Tiptoeing In My Jordans, Burning Bridges, Bulin 47, AI Halloween Costume (six classic costumes) or the AI Zombie Trend (a two-photo zombie love story), upload your photo, and preview it for free. You only pay for the clips you keep, starting at $4.99, and credits never expire. Made for anyone who wants to jump on a meme trend without editing skills.

name: Context Board
tagline: Your business on one live board. Your agent builds the widgets.
description:
Context Board puts your business on one live board. Connect your MCP servers, JSON APIs, feeds and calendars to keep your numbers together. Ask Claude or Codex to build a widget, change its design or explain what the numbers mean.

Move and resize widgets, switch themes, keep shared tasks and notes, and create separate boards for different projects. Share a read-only link that stays live or embed a board on a page.

Free for 3 days, then $6 a month at the launch price. Card required. Cancel anytime. If you join at $6, you keep $6.

Product details and trial: https://contextbolt.com/board/

name: Cocina Semanal
tagline: Free bilingual weekly meal planner for Latino families
description: Cocina Semanal plans a week of Latin family dinners (tinga, pozole, arroz con pollo and more) and builds one grocery list priced for your store, from Walmart and H-E-B to your local mercado, kept under your budget. Swap a meal and the list updates; cross off pantry items to lower the total. Spanish and English, works on any phone, free.

name: AIGoCode
tagline: One API key to access multiple AI models.
description: AIGoCode is an AI API gateway that provides access to multiple models with one API key, unified usage tracking, and flexible billing.

name: Exhibitor Toolkit
tagline: Free trade show break-even calculator: budget, profit and qualified leads
description: Work out the sales and qualified leads needed to cover your trade show budget before you book. Enter your costs, gross profit per customer, lead-to-customer win rate and expected qualified leads to see estimated profit or loss after booth costs. The break-even target rounds up to whole customers, then works out how many qualified leads you need. Download your numbers as CSV or manually save and restore them in the same browser. You supply your own budget assumptions; results are estimates, not sales forecasts. Free to use without signup. Optional, sourced CES 2027 LVCC fee references distinguish verified figures from unverified prices and conditions. Independent pilot, not affiliated with CES or CTA.

name: ChambaNOW
tagline: Bilingual EN/ES marketplace for day laborers and trade workers
description: ChambaNOW is a bilingual job marketplace connecting day laborers and skilled trade workers with hirers across the US and Mexico. Job posts auto-translate between English and Spanish so they reach Spanish-speaking workers. Free for workers; hirers get a free month with unlimited job postings. Launched June 2026 in Sacramento with 80,000+ monthly visits and thousands of workers.

name: Yuitility
tagline: Free browser tools for JSON, text, images and PDFs
description: Yuitility provides 167 free browser tools for developers and everyday tasks. Format and validate JSON, compare text, encode Base64, generate hashes, and work with images and PDFs without creating an account. File processing and calculations run on the device. Optional AI chat and contact messages use servers. Source code is publicly inspectable under a source-available license.

name: Online Mini Tools
tagline: 2,100+ free in-browser utilities, no signup
description: Online Mini Tools is a free library of focused web utilities for developers, designers, and everyday work. Format JSON, encode data, convert files, run calculators, and use SEO helpers in the browser without an account. Most tools run client-side for privacy. Chrome and Firefox extensions help you open any tool from the toolbar. New tools ship from community requests.

name: ShortDramaFix
tagline: Discover short dramas and find where to watch
description: ShortDramaFix is an independent short-drama discovery website. Browse drama summaries, genre collections and viewing guides, save titles to a watchlist, and find the relevant viewing platforms. It helps viewers choose what to watch next.

name: AITraining.jobs
tagline: AI training jobs with real pay, from every platform
description: AITraining.jobs lists the open AI training jobs from the platforms that pay people to train, evaluate and label data for AI (Mercor, micro1, Outlier, DataAnnotation, Alignerr, Prolific and more). About 3,700 open roles, refreshed daily, each with the hourly pay it advertises. Free, no signup needed.

name: ScamsShield
tagline: Understand scam and phishing warning signs in suspicious links, messages, emails and QR codes.
description: ScamsShield by AWARAN helps people understand possible scam and phishing warning signs before clicking, replying or paying. Paste a suspicious link, message or email to see an automated assessment and explanations of what to verify independently. The website includes free checks with daily limits and optional paid plans. The desktop browser extension also offers free local website checks and ad and tracker blocking; optional paid AI analysis is separate. Assessments can be wrong, and online checks process submitted content. Do not submit passwords, verification codes or payment details.

name: Unstuck
tagline: Fix your broken AI-built app. Flat price, PR in 48h.
description: Unstuck fixes apps built with AI coding tools. Paste an error into the free explainer, follow a fix guide, or get the bug fixed as a pull request from $199.

name: Crypto Freelancer Starter Kit
tagline: Invoices, contract, tax tracker and rate calculator for freelancers paid in crypto
description: The Crypto Freelancer Starter Kit is a bundle of 10 practical templates for freelancers who get paid in crypto. It includes a crypto invoice (DOCX, PDF and auto-calculating XLSX) that names the network and locks the rate, a freelance services agreement with crypto-specific payment, deposit and IP clauses, a statement of work, a client onboarding and scam red-flag checklist, six payment request and reminder email scripts, a wallet security checklist, record-keeping notes for crypto income, an income and tax tracker (XLSX and CSV), a freelance rate calculator, and a client pipeline tracker. Files work in Excel, Google Docs/Sheets, LibreOffice and Notion via CSV. It costs $12, paid in USDC on Base, and a free invoice template and security checklist are available on the site. The kit was built and is run by an AI agent. Templates are general-purpose and not legal or tax advice.

name: 10XLinks
tagline: The Wholesale Guest Post Marketplace
description: 10XLinks is the wholesale guest post marketplace with 10,000+ websites, including guest posts, backlinks, PR and digital PR at wholesale prices.

name: Image2Image AI
tagline: Restyle photos, develop sketches and explore materials with image to image AI.
description: Image2Image AI turns existing photos, artwork and sketches into new visual concepts. Describe an edit, choose an image-editing model, explore styles or materials, and compare the result with your original.

name: WeMotion
tagline: Free Mac app: describe a film and an AI designer builds it live, layer by layer. Click any frame to change it. Use an Anthropic API key or Claude Pro/Max.
description: WeMotion is a free AI motion studio for Mac. Describe a launch film, product video, social clip or title sequence, and Motion, an AI motion designer built on Claude, builds it layer by layer while it plays. Pause, click anything and leave a note; Motion makes the change. Switch to Pro for every layer, keyframe and easing curve. Up to 4K 60 fps export on your Mac, 120+ free typefaces, original music. Apple silicon, macOS 13+. Use an Anthropic API key, or Claude Pro or Max via Claude Code.

name: Shuttlewright UGC
tagline: UGC-style ad scripts built from your product real proof.
description: UGC turns your product details into UGC-style ad scripts and videos. The free sample gives a hook and script outline. The $29 Script Pack is three script variants with different hook types, a beat-by-beat board, a phone shot list, captions, hashtags and the disclosure line. The $99 Video Pack is a product-only video emailed within 48 hours. No fake testimonials: scripts come only from the proof you can stand behind.

name: Shuttlewright Social Agent
tagline: AI agent that runs your business socials, consent and labels built in.
description: Social Agent runs social posting for a business or an AI-run account. Every account carries a built-in label, managed mode needs client consent with a one-tap opt-out, and every draft is approved by a human before it posts. Managed plan $29/month; Agent Account $99/month. X posting is currently off.

name: Shuttlewright Signal Check
tagline: Can AI crawlers read your site? Free scan in seconds.
description: Signal Check scans your homepage, robots.txt, llms.txt and sitemap and reports whether AI crawlers can read your site. Free scan on the page; $19/month keeps saved history and comparisons. For site owners and marketers who want to know if AI assistants can actually read their site.

name: Syntax Highlighter
tagline: Create readable code examples with browser-local highlighting and HTML or PNG exports
description: Syntax Highlighter helps developers, technical writers and educators prepare code examples. Choose from 242 languages and formats, compare light and dark themes, add line emphasis, diff markers, numbering or folding, then copy HTML or export HTML/CSS/Tailwind files and PNG images. Highlighting and export run in the browser, and the homepage tool works without an account.

name: Roundtable
tagline: Shared context and coordination for your AI agents
description: Roundtable helps anyone using multiple AI agents share context and coordinate work, reducing manual relay between agents. It connects Muse and Instinct with supported Codex and Claude Code sessions on Mac and Linux. Shared project records, progress inspection, and scoped controls help people coordinate agent work. Free during invite-only early access; future pricing is not yet established.

name: Reach QR CODE
tagline: Free custom QR codes with logos, colors and unlimited downloads
description: Reach QR CODE is a completely free browser-based QR code generator for URLs, Wi-Fi, contacts, UPI, WhatsApp, social profiles and more. Customize colors, gradients, shapes and logos, then download high-resolution PNG, SVG, PDF or EPS files. No signup, expiry or scan limits, and QR data stays in the user's browser.

name: Yamal Rabona AI
tagline: Turn one photo into a personalized football rabona video.
description: Yamal Rabona AI turns one photo into a personalized 10-second vertical football video in 720p with audio, inspired by the fake rabona sequence. It costs $6.99 per video as a one-time payment, with no account, prompts or manual editing required.

name: ToolDeck
tagline: Free Online Image & PDF Tools
description: ToolDeck is a free collection of web utilities designed for developers, designers, and daily web users. It provides fast tools for image compression, format conversion, cropping, and PDF manipulation with no registration required.

name: Riff
tagline: Fresh replies for every post, written on your computer
description: Riff is a free Chrome extension that helps you reply on X, LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram. Paste your rough point and Gemini Nano, the AI built into Chrome, writes a fresh reply for that post. It also answers DMs and drafts your own posts. It runs on your computer with no account and no API key, and no text is sent to servers. It never posts or sends for you.

name: CatchFolder
tagline: A no-sign-in upload link that saves files to your own Google Drive
description: Google Forms' File upload question requires every respondent to sign in to a Google Account. CatchFolder gives you one upload link anyone can use without signing in; files go straight into a folder in your own Google Drive, with a Google Sheet log of every upload. It runs as a small Google Apps Script app inside your own Google account (about 5-minute copy-paste setup), so uploaded files never pass through our servers. Early access: Event Pass $12 for 30 days, Annual $59 one-time. Free tools: Google Form sign-in checker and Google Forms upload limits calculator.

name: Admix
tagline: Compare 100+ AI models side by side in one app
description:
Admix is an AI aggregator for people who use more than one AI model. Instead of paying for separate ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini subscriptions and switching between tabs, you get ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, Kimi and 100+ other frontier models in a single app. It supports GPT-5, Claude Opus 4.7, Gemini 3 Pro, Grok 4 and more.

Run the same prompt across the models you choose and see the answers side by side. Where the models agree, you get a consensus answer. Where they disagree, you have a reason to check the claim, which makes it easier to catch hallucinations. You can also switch models in the middle of a conversation instead of starting over.

Admix starts at $8.99 a month and has a free plan, so you can try it before you pay. It is meant for anyone who wants to compare models and verify answers across providers.

name: Pember
tagline: Match Stripe payouts to bank transactions. Find discrepancies in minutes.
description:
Pember is a browser-based reconciliation tool that helps businesses match Stripe payouts against bank transactions.

Import your Stripe payout report and bank statement, automatically identify matches and discrepancies, review unresolved transactions, and export a structured Excel reconciliation report.

Pember supports common bank file formats, keeps your reconciliation work available in your browser, and processes financial data locally without uploading your statements to a server.

No account required. $49 one-time payment, with no subscription.

name: dcmage
tagline: Free DICOM editor, anonymizer and 3D MPR viewer for web and Mac
description: dcmage is a free DICOM workbench for researchers and imaging data teams. Edit nested metadata, apply PS3.15 de-identification profiles, review burned-in text redactions and inspect 3D MPR views. Core imaging processing runs on your device. The browser app at https://app.dcmage.com needs no account; a Mac App Store version is also available. Native Windows is in development. For research, data management and technical review, not diagnosis.

name: VMESTA
tagline: Free service marketplace connecting clients and specialists for online and local projects
description: VMESTA is an online marketplace connecting customers with freelance professionals and local service providers. Customers can post tasks, specify a budget and preferred location, compare proposals, and invite the right specialist. Providers can create a profile, showcase a portfolio, publish services, find suitable projects, and respond to orders. The platform supports digital and in-person work, including web development, design, marketing, repairs, transportation, and education. A single account can be used as both a customer and a provider. Core tools such as profiles, job listings, service offers, project messaging, and reviews are currently free. Paid plans are planned for the future but are not active yet. VMESTA does not currently process payments between customers and providers; they agree on payment terms directly. The service is primarily designed for Russian-speaking users.

name: Learn to Play Pitch
tagline: Free browser trainer for 4-point Pitch (High-Low-Jack)
description: I vibe-coded Learn to Play Pitch so my fiancée could learn 4-point Pitch, the card game all our friends play. It deals real hands against computer opponents and explains bidding, trump, and scoring for High, Low, Jack, and Game as you go. No download or signup. Play free at https://www.learntoplaypitch.com

name: South Park Character Creator
tagline: AI South Park-style avatars from a photo or text prompt
description: South Park Character Creator is an unofficial, fan-made AI tool that turns a selfie, pet photo or text prompt into a South Park-style cartoon avatar you can download as a high-resolution PNG. A free plan lets you try it; paid plans add more credits. Not affiliated with South Park or Comedy Central.

name: Hookquill
tagline: YouTube scripts that sound like you
description: Hookquill writes YouTube scripts in your own voice. Give it a topic: it researches the web and keeps every fact with its source, offers three hooks, writes the full script and checks any claim it could not source. Edits arrive line by line for you to accept or reject. Then it records a studio voiceover and drafts titles, a description with chapters, and tags. Works for on-camera and faceless channels, in 9 languages including Urdu, Hindi and Arabic. Your first video is free with Google sign-in, no card.

name: Sprunki Video Game
tagline: Play every Sprunki game and community mod free in your browser
description: Play Sprunki and 39 community mods free online. Drag characters onto the stage to layer beats, bass, melodies and voices. No download, no account.

name: inktype
tagline: Turn your handwriting into a font, free in your browser.
description: Download a capture sheet, write the characters, and open a photo or scan. inktype extracts the letters, lets you adjust them with a live preview, and exports OTF, TTF, WOFF or WOFF2. No account is required, and scans stay on your device. Supports multiple languages, alternate letter drawings, ligatures and automatic kerning. Requires a desktop browser.

name: AutoAgents Home Hub
tagline: AAHH, this is easy! Free AI guides for buying, selling, renting and closing a home.
description: AutoAgents Home Hub is a free website with six AI guides that answer everyday questions about buying, selling, renting, financing, neighborhoods and closing in plain English. Enter a ZIP code and the guides add state rules and local links. It also has mortgage and affordability calculators and a daily housing newsletter. AutoAgents Home Hub is an information site, not a licensed real estate brokerage, lender or law firm. Free to use, no account needed.

name: 8ake
tagline: 8ake is bake
description: 8ake lists new apps on startup, SaaS and AI directories. You bring an app and agents submit it to verified directories that publish, so it gets seen. Rejections are replaced until the live-listing target is met, and you keep the login for every listing. One payment from $79, no subscription: up to 60 live listings, targeting within 30 days.

name: Cove
tagline: Support desk with branded website chat, a shared inbox, help articles, and workflows, priced per workspace.
description: Cove is a support desk for small teams that pay for a separate chat widget, shared inbox, help center, and workflow tool. It puts branded website chat, a shared inbox, help articles, and workflows in one product. Visitors write from the chat window on the website, and the team replies from one shared inbox. Email arrives in the same inbox by forwarding. When a customer writes in another language, the translation is shown under the original message. Shopify stores see the customer's recent orders beside the conversation. Cove connects to Slack, Shopify, Stripe, Meta, WhatsApp, Discord, Telegram, and Linear, and offers a signed webhook. Pricing is per workspace with unlimited conversations: Free for 2 seats, Mini $39/mo for 10 seats, Essentials $89/mo for 25 seats, Plus $219/mo for 50 seats. Paid plans include a 14-day trial.

name: FanDesk
tagline: Helpdesk and ticketing with SLAs that respect business hours
description: FanDesk is helpdesk and ticketing software by Fanpino (Dubai, UAE) for support and IT teams. Tickets move through open, in-progress, on-hold and closed states with priorities and assignment. SLA timers count only your business hours and skip holidays, so a ticket opened late on a Friday is not marked overdue over the weekend. It also includes a searchable knowledge base, canned responses and reporting dashboards. Cloud plans start at $29/month for up to 3 agents; an on-premise licence is available. Product page: https://fanpino.com/en/showcase/fandesk/

name: QunSou
tagline: Telegram Community Directory & Online Tools
description: QunSou helps users discover Chinese-language Telegram groups and channels through keyword search and category browsing, and provides practical Telegram online tools and tutorials.

name: HireDeveloperUSA
tagline: Hire pre-vetted US developers, designers and marketers.
description: HireDeveloperUSA helps companies hire pre-vetted developers, designers, marketers and project managers based in the United States. Screened freelance and full-time talent is ready for interviews, with no fee until you hire.

name: Lazy Trader AI
tagline: AI market research, options activity, and portfolio insights
description: Lazy Trader AI combines AI market research with options activity, institutional holdings, politician disclosures, watchlists, and portfolio tracking. Available on web, iOS, and Android, it helps users explore market information in context. Free accounts include public previews and five lifetime AI answers; paid plans unlock additional research tools and feeds. Lazy Trader AI is an informational research tool. It does not execute trades, provide personalized investment advice, or guarantee results.

name: DigMyName
tagline: Fastest domain search? Run the timer.
description: DigMyName puts its fastest-domain-search challenge on a live stopwatch. Published first-result p95: 386 ms and 485 ms across two 150-visit runs. Search 50+ TLDs, compare six registrars, and use the free JSON API or MCP server.

name: MiVid AI
tagline: Faceless video generator for Shorts, Reels, and TikTok
description: Create AI faceless videos from scripts and ideas with scene-by-scene storyboards, consistent characters, voiceovers, subtitles, and video generation for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Reels.

name: Adspread
tagline: Advertising campaign management and managed placements
description: Adspread helps businesses, marketers and agencies plan and manage advertising campaigns. The platform brings together campaign coordination, Telegram channel placements and managed advertising services, with reporting to track results.

name: Reno√Verify
tagline: Renovation budget planning and expense tracking for homeowners
description: Renovation budget planning and project expense tracking web app for homeowners, helps assess contractor quotes.

name: InstaVeil
tagline: Public Instagram viewing, monitoring and reports
description: InstaVeil helps creators, marketers and agency teams research available public Instagram content without an Instagram login. The viewer is free. Optional VeilWatch workspaces add saved-profile change review, comparisons and CSV exports. A one-time 24h Pro pass costs €1.99 through PayPal, with no auto-renewal. Monthly plans start at €4.99; Pro is €12.99 and Studio is €29.99 for up to 60 public profiles, client-ready reports and device-local history. Public content availability varies; private and expired Stories cannot be retrieved. Submitted by the operator for independent free editorial review.

name: MiniMax H3 AI
tagline: AI video generation studio
description: MiniMax H3 AI turns text prompts into AI videos for product demos, ads, and short-form content.

name: Saavo Starter
tagline: Cloudflare-native TypeScript SaaS starter kit
description: Saavo Starter is a TypeScript SaaS starter kit for developers and small teams building on Cloudflare Workers. It connects authentication, billing, access control, OAuth2, admin operations, support, and documentation in an extensible codebase. The stack uses React, Hono, and Tailwind with Cloudflare services including D1, KV, R2, Queues, and Durable Objects. The full starter codebase is available as a one-time purchase.

name: Seedance 2.5
tagline: Multi-scene AI video generator
description: Seedance 2.5 creates multi-scene AI videos from text prompts for storyboards, demos, and social clips.

name: PHP Decode
tagline: PHP source recovery for files you own or are authorized to process
description: PHP Decode is an online service for recovering PHP source from files you own or are authorized to process. It provides product-specific workflows for SourceGuardian, ionCube, Swoole Compiler and Xload. Choose the matching decoder, upload an authorized PHP file, preview the first 10 lines and unlock the complete result using credits. A console provides access to decoding tasks and results. Output and compatibility depend on the selected decoder and file.

name: Hello Keyboard
tagline: Free browser tools, curated games and keyboard learning in six languages
description: Hello Keyboard brings together free browser tools, a curated browser-game collection and keyboard-learning resources. It includes image and PDF tools designed for local processing, alongside text, structured-data and developer utilities. The education site offers step-by-step keyboard lessons and typing practice. The site supports English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Filipino and Hindi. Game pages include instructions, source links and license details.

name: 12 Axes Test
tagline: Explore your political values across twelve separate axes
description: 12 Axes Test is a free political-values quiz with 36, 60 or 288 statements. It presents twelve axes across government, diplomacy, economy and society, with scoring calculated in your browser and no account required. Available in English, Portuguese and Spanish. Methodology pages explain scoring and limitations. Editorial comparisons with ideologies, countries and historical figures are intended for reflection and conversation, not scientific validation or voting advice. Submitted by the team that operates the project.

name: HoopFile
tagline: Free embroidery file converter with stitch preview
description: Free embroidery file converter between PES, DST, JEF, EXP, VP3 and more. Free stitch preview in the browser, with no signup.

name: BendTab
tagline: Free sheet metal bend allowance and flat pattern calculators
description: Free sheet metal calculators for bend allowance, bend deduction, K-factor and flat patterns. Use them in the browser with no signup.

name: AIArtFlow
tagline: Free AI art generator and creative workflow tools
description: Free AI art generator and creative workflow tools. Create AI images and streamline your creative process online.

name: JustCV
tagline: Free resume exports, with a $7.99 one-time template upgrade
description: JustCV helps job seekers create and adapt resumes in a web browser. Start with two free templates, save up to five resumes, and export PDF or PNG after signing in. AI job tailoring is available with daily usage limits. A $7.99 one-time payment unlocks 150+ professional templates and ongoing template updates, without recurring charges.

name: Wan 3 AI
tagline: AI video generation from text or image
description: Generate AI videos from text prompts or images with Wan 3 AI — cinematic clips, motion, and creative video for creators and marketers.

name: Gemini Music
tagline: AI music generator from text prompts
description: Create original tracks with Gemini Music, an AI music generator for songs, instrumentals, and soundscapes from text prompts.

name: PaperBanana
tagline: AI Academic Illustrations
description: PaperBanana generates publication-ready academic diagrams and illustrations from paper text.

name: Rock Identify
tagline: Rock Identify is a free browser-based tool that identifies rocks and minerals from photos—no signup or app download required for basic use.
description: Rock Identify is a free online rock and mineral identifier for students, hobbyists, and STEM educators. Upload one to three photos of the same specimen in your browser to explore possible matches, visible clues, limitations, and lookalikes. Basic use needs no account; results explain the evidence behind each suggestion and link to educational references. Photo-based ID is tentative—not a lab confirmation.

name: Videnly
tagline: AI video creation and auto-publishing in one place
description: Turn an idea into a finished video without spending hours editing. Create faceless videos, ads, and more with script, visuals, voiceover, and captions in one place, then publish everywhere.

name: EduNinja
tagline: IB Biology practice organised by course and topic
description: EduNinja provides a structured starting point for IB Biology revision. Students choose Biology SL or HL, follow the course syllabus and open available topic questions with supplied answer and mark guidance. The current eduninja.pro release focuses on Biology; resources are shown as available within each course. Biology HL Question Bank: https://eduninja.pro/ib/biology/hl/question-bank

name: Mayavoo
tagline: A home for browser games
description: Mayavoo is a home for browser games made by independent creators. Every game plays free in your browser, with nothing to download or install. Browse by category and play without an account; sign in with Google or GitHub to like games and comment.

name: Sadana Baby
tagline: Upload two face photos and see six AI portraits of what your baby might look like
description: Sadana Baby turns two face photos into six fictional AI portraits of a girl and a boy at ages 1, 4 and 8. Made for fun as a gift for couples and parents-to-be, not a genetic prediction. Photos are not stored. One free low-res preview, paid packs are one-time with no subscription.

name: TickTock Age
tagline: Free chronological age calculator for exact years, months and days
description: TickTock Age calculates chronological age from a birth date to a selected date, showing exact years, months and days. It also offers age difference, birthday countdown and related date calculators.

name: Unslop Search
tagline: Free search launcher that opens your query on Google, DuckDuckGo, Brave and more in modes that skip AI overviews.
description: Unslop Search is a free search launcher for people who want plain web results without AI overviews. Type a query once and open it on Google, DuckDuckGo, Brave, Startpage, Qwant, Mojeek or Presearch using the URL modes that skip AI summaries. No account, no tracking, and no redirect through our servers: the query goes straight to the search engine you pick.

name: PriceSnap
tagline: Free photo value scanner: snap an item and see what it's worth, with the comparable listings behind the number.
description: PriceSnap estimates what an item is worth from a single photo. Upload a picture of a collectible, gadget, furniture piece or thrift find and it identifies the item and shows a value range together with the comparable listings used, so you can check the estimate yourself. Free to use in the browser with no account needed. Useful for resellers, thrift and garage-sale shoppers, and anyone decluttering.

name: PhotoToTattoo
tagline: Turn photos or text ideas into tattoo concepts for your artist
description: PhotoToTattoo is a web-based AI tool for exploring tattoo concepts from photos you have permission to use or from written ideas. Choose from nine styles, revise a concept, and download a PNG or artist discussion PDF. Google sign-in is required. One-time credit packs start at US$9.99 for 60 credits, with no subscription. Generated images are creative references for consultation with a tattoo artist, not transfer stencils or ready-to-tattoo instructions.

name: Whatsable
tagline: WhatsApp from your own number with Meta coexistence and automation.
description: Whatsable lets you send WhatsApp from your own WhatsApp Business number while keeping the WhatsApp Business app on your phone (Meta coexistence). Automate with Zapier, Make, n8n, webhooks, or the REST API. Official Meta Tech Provider.

name: Niche Pickers
tagline: Find niches that already make money
description: Choosing a website niche based on guesswork can lead to wasted time and resources. Entrepreneurs, bloggers, and affiliate marketers often struggle to identify niches with existing websites, measurable traffic, and potential monetization opportunities. Niche Pickers helps users research 386,000+ websites using estimated traffic, Domain Rating, domain age, niche, language, site type, and advertising network data to make more informed decisions before building a website.

name: ImageSVG
tagline: High-quality image to SVG conversion with a daily free allowance
description: ImageSVG turns logos, icons and illustrations into high-quality SVG vector artwork. Compare the original image and vector result before downloading scalable files. Registered users receive a daily free conversion allowance, subject to daily and monthly limits. Paid passes add batch conversion and PDF, EPS and DXF exports.

name: AI Ozil Goal
tagline: Turn one photo into a personalized AI football goal video
description: AI Ozil Goal turns one photo into a personalized football video inspired by the Ozil Goal AI trend. A prepared scene and motion reference guide the chip, dribble and finish. Generate a 15-second vertical video with AI-generated audio without CapCut, prompt writing, manual editing or an account. One-time pricing is $4.99 for 480p or $6.99 for 720p. Results may vary. Independent service, not affiliated with Mesut Ozil or any club.

name: Te He Perdido IA
tagline: Turn two photos into an AI balcony and crowd reveal video.
description: Te He Perdido IA turns two photos into a personalized AI balcony and crowd reveal video. Assign the two roles in a guided Spanish-language workflow. Generate a 15-second vertical 720p video without writing prompts or editing a sequence, then download it without music. Paid service: $6.99 USD per video, one-time payment.

name: Astrology Geeks
tagline: Free online astrology calculators with clear explanations of your results.
description: Astrology Geeks is a free collection of online astrology calculators. Enter your birth date, time and place to generate a natal birth chart, find your sun, moon and rising signs, compare charts with a partner using synastry and composite charts, check current transits, and explore placements like Venus, Mars, Saturn return, North Node and Midheaven. Each calculator explains what the results mean in plain language, so beginners and experienced astrology fans can read their charts with confidence.

name: HostingCompass
tagline: Compare hosting, VPS and domain prices and renewal costs
description: HostingCompass helps users compare web hosting, VPS, cloud and domain prices. Filter plans by specifications and location, compare billing terms, and check domain registration and renewal costs. Provider sources and affiliate relationships are disclosed on the website.

name: ZeroKB
tagline: Free Online Tools to Compress and Convert PDFs, Images, and Documents
description: ZeroKB offers free online PDF tools, image compression, document conversion, and useful file management utilities in one convenient platform.

name: DocReq
tagline: Collect client documents through one simple link.
description: DocReq is an early-stage document collection tool for CA firms, tax consultants, and accounting practices. Create document requests, share an upload link with clients, track submissions, review documents, and request replacements when corrections are needed. Clients can upload documents without creating an account.

name: Uniqly
tagline: Get more from the Instagram videos you already filmed
description: Uniqly helps Instagram creators reuse their own footage for trial reels, repeat posts and other accounts they manage. Send a video to the Telegram bot, choose the number of copies, and download separate video files with small framing and encoding changes. Audio pitch can also be adjusted, so music may sound slightly different. You publish the files yourself, without connecting an Instagram account. The first 3 copies are free; paid packs and plans are available after the trial.

name: PrepVidya
tagline: Branded coaching academy platform for courses, live classes and mock tests
description: Online learning software for coaching institutes and educators with branded websites, learner apps, courses, live classes, mock tests, payments and analytics.

name: OneShot Interview
tagline: Practice one-way video interviews with instant AI feedback
description: OneShot Interview helps job seekers get ready for one-way video interviews like HireVue and Spark Hire, where you face a camera, a countdown and usually just one take. Pick a role, get realistic questions, and answer under real timing rules. Video is recorded in your browser and never leaves it. After each answer you get AI feedback on STAR structure, filler words, relevance and clarity. First session free, then pay as you go, no subscription.

name: type.
tagline: Quizzes, moodboards and a little chemistry. Better with a friend.
description: type. is a free, mobile-friendly playground for adults 18+ who enjoy personality quizzes and playful connection. Explore six quiz themes, compare independent answers with a friend, try rotating daily vibe cards and weekly editions, create personal moodboards, and download shareable result cards. Crush Lab offers lighthearted compatibility prompts based on initials, birthdays, music taste and campus. Anonymous notes add a way to exchange messages through a shared inbox link. Built as an early-stage student project with AI coding assistance. Quiz and compatibility results are entertainment, not scientific assessments.

name: LaunchCut
tagline: Make an app launch video from the screens you already have.
description: LaunchCut is a browser-based promo video maker for indie developers. Start with a screen recording or up to 15 app screenshots, choose TikTok, Instagram, Reddit or X, and review the frames before AI builds the story. Edit the scenes, export an MP4 and copy matching post text. Videos are up to 20 seconds; Standard costs 30 credits and Enhanced costs 60. Credit packs start at $10 with no subscription.

name: RowTune
tagline: Review supplier price changes before updating your catalog
description: RowTune helps wholesale distributors review supplier price updates before changing their catalog or price sheet. Upload a supplier PDF, CSV, or Excel file alongside your item catalog. It matches items, highlights price and product changes, and flags uncertain matches for human review. Approve the changes you want, then export the results to Excel or Google Sheets. Explore a fictional sample without an account; a single real supplier file is $19 and monthly plans start at $99.

name: UseFreeTools
tagline: Free PDF, image, video and audio tools that run entirely in your browser
description: UseFreeTools is a collection of free tools that run entirely in your browser. Merge, compress, split and convert PDFs. Compress, resize, crop and convert images. Trim, join, convert and compress video. Cut and join audio. Files are processed locally on your device, so nothing is uploaded to a server. No sign-up, no watermarks, no usage limits.

name: TKLive
tagline: TikTok LIVE workspace for OBS, accounts and stream interactions
description: TKLive is a Windows and macOS desktop workspace for TikTok LIVE creators and teams. It brings together OBS instance management, account and media organization, stream-key workflows, gift-wall displays, keyword-based auto-replies and OpenAPI integration. A compatible OBS installation is required for OBS instance management. Available features depend on the plan, app version and account permissions. TKLive supports operator-supervised workflows; stream keys do not bypass TikTok LIVE eligibility. It is an independent third-party product, not affiliated with TikTok or ByteDance.

name: CrazyFrogAI
tagline: Photo-to-video chase memes and invisible motorcycle rides with BGM.
description: CrazyFrogAI helps social creators turn one or two photos into short AI chase videos or invisible motorcycle rides. Select a template, assign each photo a role, choose 720p or 1080p, then download a generated MP4 with cheerful background music. Public examples and guides show the workflow, and a credit calculator estimates the credits required. Generation is paid through one-time packs starting at $4.99 for 400 credits; no subscription. An eight-second 720p generation uses 200 credits and 1080p uses 400. AI faces, poses and vehicle details may vary. Independent tool, not affiliated with Crazy Frog or its rights holders.

name: Inpiko
tagline: Count customers, not comments
description: Inpiko is a lightweight customer feedback tool for small founders and teams. Add one script tag to your site and customers can send feedback with just their email, no account needed. AI groups similar submissions into one request and shows how many different customers asked for it, so a single loud voice doesn't look like demand. Move requests through New, Planned, In Progress and Shipped and your public roadmap updates automatically.

name: Whisper Web
tagline: Browser Whisper transcription for audio and video
description: Whisper Web runs OpenAI Whisper in your browser to transcribe audio and video files. Local use stays on your device and is free. Export TXT, JSON, SRT, and VTT in 99 languages.

name: Mantafin
tagline: Equity research, portfolio backtesting, and AI-connected financial data
description: Mantafin helps self-directed investors research U.S. securities, review historical financials and prices, screen stocks and ETFs, and backtest custom portfolios. ChatGPT and Claude integrations through MCP connect supported AI research workflows to Mantafin tools. Paid plans start at $39/month with a seven-day trial.

name: AstroDir
tagline: Discover astrology, tarot, and Bazi tools
description: AstroDir is an English and Chinese directory of astrology apps, tarot websites, Bazi calculators, I Ching tools and other divination resources. Visitors can browse by practice, explore themed collections, and read practical product notes before visiting the original websites. Browsing and basic maker submissions are free, with optional paid listing features.

name: TextRaze
tagline: Update text in existing photos, menus, and posters
description: TextRaze is a browser-based AI photo editor for practical changes to existing images. Select one text area, type the original wording and its replacement, and compare the generated result before downloading. It is designed for tasks such as changing a menu price or poster date when the editable design file is unavailable. Separate tools reduce photo shadows and glasses reflections. Generation uses paid credits; one-time packs start at $4.99. Results should be checked before publishing.

name: Sesshu (sesshu.app)
tagline: Japanese-first AI video generator with top models in one place
description: Sesshu is an AI video generator built for Japanese speakers, with an English version too. Describe a scene in plain language, or upload a photo or illustration, and Sesshu turns it into a short video with models such as Seedance, Kling and Veo in one interface. It supports 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1, 4-8 second clips, with optional audio - good for social shorts, product clips and anime-style shots. New accounts get 48 free credits; no credit card is needed.

name: Optio (jevai.website)
tagline: Typed decisions with probabilities, via one API call
description: Optio is a pay-as-you-go API for typed decisions: send text or JSON with up to 8 questions and get choice, score or yes/no answers with probabilities. Typical uses: support-ticket triage, model routing, content moderation, lead scoring, and a risk gate in front of agent tool calls. Free browser playground with no signup; new accounts get 5 free credits; one-time credit packs never expire.

name: WhisperWeb
tagline: Whisper transcription right in your browser - free, no upload.
description: WhisperWeb is a free transcription tool that runs in the browser: it executes OpenAI's open-source Whisper speech recognition model on your own device, so recordings are not uploaded. It accepts MP3, WAV, M4A, MP4, MOV, WebM and more, or a microphone recording. You can check and correct the text and timestamps before exporting, then download TXT, SRT or VTT. No sign-up; up to 200 MB or 20 minutes per file.

name: Massvai
tagline: AI app builder for full-stack Next.js, Supabase and Vercel
description: Massvai is an AI app builder. Describe your product in a prompt and an AI coding agent builds a production-ready full-stack Next.js + TypeScript + Tailwind app with live preview, Supabase auth and database, Stripe, GitHub sync and one-click Vercel deploy. You own and can export the code.

name: Sora2 Hub
tagline: AI image and video generator with many leading models in one place
description: Sora2 Hub is an AI image and video generation platform. Turn text prompts or a single photo into short videos and images, compare results from several leading generation models side by side, and download what you like. Built for creators, marketers and small teams who want fast visual content without editing software.

name: DogPay
tagline: Crypto cards, global accounts, acquiring, and cross-border payouts.
description: Crypto-to-fiat payments platform: Dog Card virtual and physical cards (issuing regions Hong Kong, Singapore, UK, and US), global accounts, acquiring, and cross-border payouts, with KYC/KYB/KYT and an API/SDK.

name: SonicGames
tagline: Play classic Sonic games free in your browser
description: SonicGames is a free browser gaming site dedicated to the Sonic the Hedgehog series. Dozens of Sonic games -- from the 1991 original to fan-made ROM hacks -- playable instantly online with no downloads or emulator setup. New titles added regularly.

name: GMB Scraper
tagline: Extract public Google Business Profile and Maps listing data to CSV or XLSX in seconds.
description: GMB Scraper is a Chrome extension that pulls public Google Business Profile and Maps data for local research. Search a category and location, scan the result pages, and collect details such as business name, phone, email, website, social links, hours, ratings, Place ID or CID, and coordinates. Emails found on linked sites are included when available. Results are de-duplicated and exported as a clean CSV or XLSX for sales, marketing, and local SEO teams. No code is required. A free plan is available, and Pro starts at $39.90 per month.

name: Reverse Image Location (GeoSolver)
tagline: Find possible photo locations from visible geographic clues
description: GeoSolver is an AI-assisted photo geolocation tool. It analyzes signs, roads, buildings, vegetation and terrain to explain possible locations. It supports geography learning, GeoGuessr-style practice, travel research and public-scene OSINT workflows. AI analysis is paid; separate EXIF tools are free. Location predictions must be verified independently with maps and other evidence.

name: NetFee Tools
tagline: Free payment fee calculators for Stripe, PayPal, Square, and credit card processing.
description:
NetFee Tools is a collection of free online payment fee calculators designed for freelancers, small businesses, online sellers, and independent developers.

Calculate payment processing fees, estimate your net earnings, and work backward from a target payout to determine how much you need to charge.

Our tools cover Stripe, PayPal, Square, and general credit card processing. Each calculator provides transparent fee breakdowns, customizable inputs where supported, and clear explanations of applicable rates and limitations.

No registration required. Just enter your transaction details and calculate your fees in seconds.

name: SwiftTools
tagline: Free browser tools for everyday tasks and developers - no sign-up
description: SwiftTools is a free, no-sign-up collection of 50 online tools that run entirely in your browser. It covers text writing, calculators, unit converters, date and time tools, developer utilities (JSON formatter, Base64, UUID, URL encoder) and ten PDF tools (compress, merge, split, watermark, protect). Because everything runs client-side, your files and text never leave your device.

name: CalcPilot
tagline: Free online calculators & converters — no sign-up, instant results
description: CalcPilot is a free collection of online calculators and unit converters that run entirely in your browser. Convert kg to lbs, estimate USD monthly take-home, run mortgage and auto-loan math, compound interest, date differences, percentages, BMR calories, and more. No account, no download.

name: AsiaTender Watch
tagline: Daily World Bank tender alerts for South & Southeast Asia energy and water projects.
description: AsiaTender Watch sends a daily digest of open World Bank tenders and recent contract awards across South and Southeast Asia, filtered by country and sector (energy/power, water/sanitation), with deadlines, procurement methods and winning prices. Free weekly sample, 7-day free Pro trial; paid plans from $19/month.

name: DREAMMMER
tagline: AI image and video editor where an agent writes the prompt, picks the model and refines the result with you
description: DREAMMMER is an AI creative workspace for images and video. Describe your idea in plain language, and an agent turns it into a prompt, picks a suitable model and refines the result with you in conversation. Create product visuals, posters, portraits and social content, or edit and restyle photos. Get 50 free credits.

name: CareerMatch
tagline: AI career matching for students, young adults and parents
description: CareerMatch is an AI career assessment for students and young adults aged seventeen to twenty-four, and for their parents, that matches each person to careers from a library of more than 4,000 researched roles.

name: NEPSE Tracker: Portfolio & IPO
tagline: Track NEPSE portfolios, IPOs and live market activity
description: Track Nepal Stock Exchange (NEPSE) prices and market activity, manage multiple stock portfolios and transactions, review profit and loss, check IPO results, and set stock alerts in one app for Android and iOS.

name: OpenWish
tagline: One practical wish. A clearer request. A private conversation.
description:
A bicycle to reach a new job. A laptop for classes. An hour of interview practice. A practical need is easier to act on when the person who could help can understand it and start a conversation.

OpenWish is a free community for adults aged 18+ to share practical wishes and discover ways to help. Type or speak your wish, then use Prepare Wish to turn it into a clearer request. The AI can suggest wording, a category or a clarification question; you review and approve the result before publication. A generated public alias is the default unless you choose otherwise.

Helpers can browse before signing up. When a wish fits the time, skill, mentorship or item they can offer, they tap I can help, review the wish preview and sign in to start a private, moderated chat. A suggested opening message is editable and never sent automatically. Report and block controls are available inside the conversation.

After the help has happened, the helper marks the wish granted and the wisher can confirm or report that it did not arrive. The confirmation flow includes automatic confirmation after 24 hours without a response. Help is voluntary and never guaranteed. The interface is in English.

OpenWish is free and does not process payments or hold money. Where a wisher turns it on, members can optionally send NHBCoin through the Send NHBCoin button, wallet to wallet.

From Nwudu Inc., the team behind OpenWish.

Make your first practical wish: https://openwish.org/?compose=1&utm_source=ignlab&utm_medium=directory&utm_campaign=openwish_practical_wishes&utm_content=claude_20261017

name: SlashFlow
tagline: Reusable reply templates and profile variables for Chrome
description:
SlashFlow is a desktop Chrome extension for reusable text templates and browser workflows. Save a reply, give it a slash shortcut, and expand it in a supported editable field. Profile variables help reuse your saved details in templates.

You review the result and send messages or submit forms yourself; SlashFlow does not do that automatically. Support varies by site and editable field.

First-time eligible accounts can start a 14-day trial with a payment card. New subscriptions renew automatically at US$3.49 per month unless canceled before the trial ends. Current terms: https://getslashflow.com/pricing/

Watch the real product demonstration: https://getslashflow.com/demos/

name: Upswello
tagline: Less Chaos. More Profit.
description: Shop management software built for phone and computer repair shops. Web + iOS app included on every plan.

name: Revision Boundary Lab
tagline: Estimate extra project work and draft a professional scope-change response.
description: A free browser-based prototype for freelance web designers to calculate an estimated additional fee for extra pages or revisions and draft a polite client response. The draft is template-based, not generative AI analysis. No account or paid plan. Entered details are processed in the browser. Created by Indie | Independent AI Lab, an AI-led, human-owned $100 business experiment seeking candid feedback.

name: Cleaning Quote Kit
tagline: Cost and margin calculator plus a $19 offline quote desk for cleaners
description: Cleaning Quote Kit helps independent cleaning businesses calculate a visit price from their own labor, travel, supplies, overhead and target margin. The website offers a free no-sign-up calculator. A $19 one-time download adds a desktop-browser quote desk with price testing, a customer-only quote preview, print/PDF output, text export, local saved quotes and backup/restore. No subscription, Excel or AI credits are required. It calculates from the costs entered; it does not estimate local market rates or guarantee profit.

name: ShopQuote Flow
