tagline: Free quoting tools for machine shops and CNC estimators
description: ShopQuote Flow provides free quoting calculators and an Excel quote template for machine shops, CNC job shops, and estimators. It helps calculate shop rates, setup and run time, quantity breaks, and quote-versus-actual results.

name: Parts & Quotes
tagline: Compare BOM revisions and supplier quote coverage
description: Parts & Quotes helps small hardware teams, manufacturers and buyers compare two flat bills of materials or check one supplier quote against a required-parts list. It accepts CSV, TSV, ordinary XLSX files and pasted tables. Files are processed locally in the browser. Try up to 25 rows per input free, without an account or card; the $29 one-time offline edition supports 20,000 rows and Excel, CSV and readable-report exports for use within one business. It flags changes, missing or short lines and ambiguous data for review. It does not read PDFs, convert units or currencies, select suppliers or place orders.

name: Which AI Sent
tagline: See which customers and revenue AI assistants send your business
description: Which AI Sent connects visits from ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and other AI assistants to leads, bookings and recorded revenue. Businesses can also capture customers who say an AI recommended them, then inspect the evidence behind each attributed lead. It is designed for service businesses and agencies that need to measure AI search beyond traffic counts.

name: BytePane
tagline: Free Developer Tools: 60+ utilities in your browser
description: JSON formatter, regex tester, base64, JWT decoder, SQL formatter, hash generators, YAML/XML converters. Privacy-first: all tools run client-side, no data uploaded.

name: Bot Lodge
tagline: Free plain-English hub of real Grok Bot use cases, templates and routines
description: Bot Lodge is a free, independent guide to everyday AI agents. It collects 150+ real Grok Bot use cases with plain step-by-step setup for small business owners, parents, teachers, retirees, freelancers and job seekers, plus a curated Marketplace of templates, routines, skills and plugins people have built, a top-posts list, AI tool reviews and a daily Today in AI feed. Every entry credits its original creator. No signup needed; RSS and a free newsletter are available.

name: Billmates
tagline: Free roommate rent and bill splitters.
description: Billmates offers two free calculators that need no signup: a rent splitter that divides rent by room size, private bathroom or income, and a utility bill splitter that divides electricity, water, gas and internet by days at home. There are also short guides for common roommate situations. A waitlist is open for an upcoming bill-tracking web app.

name: AI-Payer
tagline: I got paid. What should I pay first?
description: AI-Payer is a free paycheck bill triage tool for people whose bills and everyday needs compete for the same paycheck. Enter available money, your next income date, groceries, gas, necessities, bills and minimum debt payments. The planner protects the living amount you enter, then organizes required payments and flags shortfalls. For example, $2,000 available minus $500 for living leaves $1,500 for $1,800 in bills: a $300 gap to review. No bank connection or account is required. Saved bills stay in the browser. AI-Payer does not pay bills automatically, guarantee outcomes or replace individualized financial advice.

name: Desknotes
tagline: A free, distraction-free online notepad. No account required.
description: Desknotes is a free online notepad for quick notes, to-do lists and writing. Start without signing up. Notes autosave locally in the current browser via IndexedDB; work offline after the first load, search and pin notes, restore from trash or version history, and export JSON backups or individual TXT files. The interface supports 14 languages. Notes do not automatically sync between devices, so regular backups are recommended. The public beta is free.

name: medicalGFE
tagline: B2B telehealth compliance and pre-treatment Good Faith Exam software.
description: medicalGFE connects med spas, IV therapy and wellness clinics with California-licensed clinicians for pre-treatment Good Faith Exams.

name: CodeTrendy
tagline: A curated directory of new startups, SaaS and indie products
description: CodeTrendy is a curated directory of newly launched startups, SaaS tools and indie products. Every submission passes a content check before it is published, and each approved product gets a permanent public profile with its category, tech stack, screenshots, reviews and a link to the site.

name: Cornel VPN
tagline: VPN for travel Wi-Fi, remote work and every device, with a 3-day free trial and crypto payment
description: Cornel VPN 2.0 (build 2.0.110) runs on its own Tenzor Core protocol, as described on our site, and encrypts your traffic so hotel, train, café and coworking Wi-Fi operators can't see what you do. Choose Global mode, Selective mode (only the domains you pick go through the VPN) or Exclusion mode (everything except the domains you bypass). Apps for Windows, macOS, Linux (deb/rpm/AppImage), Android and Android TV with QR-code sign-in; iPhone, iPad and Apple TV via TestFlight. Personal plans from $2.35/month (1, 3, 5 or 10 devices), Family plans for 3 or 5 people and Corporate plans for teams of 10 or 25. 3-day free trial. Payment is crypto: USDT, BTC, ETH or SOL. I'm on the Cornel team.

name: Cursor Agent Starter (lite) — Northpaw Labs
tagline: Free plain-file Cursor agent starter: AGENTS.md, 2 rules, 2 skills (plan + review). By Northpaw Labs.
description:
Free drop-in starter for Cursor from Northpaw Labs: one AGENTS.md, two rules (core, communication) and two skills (plan, review), with instructions for the agent to plan before coding and review its own diff before finishing. Plain files: copy AGENTS.md and .cursor/ into your project root, then type "Plan: <what you want>" → "Build it" → "Review my changes" in Cursor Agent chat.

Made with AI tools and reviewed by Northpaw Labs before release. MIT license. Not affiliated with Cursor. No income or productivity guarantees — just the files and the prompts.

Free download ($0; Gumroad shows an optional pay-what-you-want field): https://northpawlabs.gumroad.com/l/brifhl

name: QuickImageFix
tagline: Free online image tools to compress, resize, crop and convert photos
description:
QuickImageFix is a free set of online image tools for everyday jobs. It solves the problem of large or wrongly sized images that fail upload limits, slow down pages or don't fit a form. You can reduce image size, resize photos for passport applications and Instagram, convert between JPG, PNG and WebP, crop photos into a circle or fixed ratio, and remove backgrounds, including from animated GIFs, to get a transparent result.

It runs in any modern browser on phone or desktop and needs no account. The site is available in 10 languages (English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Swedish and Vietnamese), with pages written for how people in each country search. It's built for bloggers, store owners, designers, developers and students.

name: Ampsu
tagline: Food diary for European shelves that learns your real calorie needs
description: Ampsu is a food and nutrition tracker made in Estonia. Scan European supermarket barcodes, log meals quickly, and see a calorie target that adjusts from your food log and weight trend. Free public calculators cover TDEE, recipe calories, nutrition labels, macros, and body measurements.

name: AppTrendKit
tagline: iOS app market research and ASO tools
description: AppTrendKit helps indie developers and small app teams research the Apple App Store. Explore iOS apps, estimated monthly downloads and revenue, chart history, keyword research and competitor keyword gaps. Public charts, selected app pages, free ASO tools and weekly reports are available free. Pro expands research access. Downloads and revenue are estimates with confidence labels. Currently covers iOS.

name: Bulk Material Calc
tagline: Free material quantity and cost calculators for landscaping and DIY projects
description: Work out how much loose material a project needs before ordering. Bulk Material Calc offers ten free calculators covering gravel, topsoil, crushed stone, mulch, sand, paving layers, joint sand and sandbox fills, with a mass–volume converter. Use US or metric measurements, enter supplier density when known, round up whole packages and compare entered costs. Eight language versions are available; calculations need no account.

name: InsertKit
tagline: Type Less, Insert More
description: Most tools do only dictation or only saved phrases. InsertKit brings AI voice typing that works in 100+ languages, snippets you trigger with a short command like /reply, dynamic snippets with variations, clipboard history and cross-device sync together in one workflow. It runs quietly in the system tray on desktop and works in any app, so emails, support replies, notes and messages take less repetitive typing. Free tier available.

name: VideoBGRemover
tagline: Remove video backgrounds and export transparent clips
description: Remove backgrounds from recorded video clips with AI. Preview the cutout, keep a transparent background, or replace it with a color or static image. VideoBGRemover preserves motion and audio and exports transparent WebM or composited MP4 files. Try the tool with free trial credits, then buy credit packs or subscribe for more processing.

name: Herramientas Productivas
tagline: Herramientas online gratuitas para productividad y tareas cotidianas
description: Colección en español de herramientas web para Pomodoro, matriz Eisenhower, compresión de imágenes, archivos, PDF, multimedia, planificación, QR y cálculos. Funciona desde el navegador y ofrece un nivel gratuito con opciones Pro.

name: TrackYourQR
tagline: Dynamic QR Codes with Scan Analytics and Smart Routing
description: TrackYourQR is a dynamic QR code management platform that helps businesses create customized QR codes, update destination URLs after printing, monitor scan analytics, and route users based on supported campaign rules. It is useful for marketers, retailers, restaurants, product packaging, and businesses connecting offline campaigns with digital experiences.

name: inkSTR
tagline: AI SEO & GEO Content Automation for Vacation Rentals
description: inkSTR is an AI-powered SEO and GEO content automation platform designed for vacation rental hosts, property managers, and boutique hotels. It automates keyword research, SEO article creation, and scheduled publishing to Wix, WordPress, and custom websites. With Google Search Console insights, structured data, and property management integrations, inkSTR helps businesses improve search visibility and attract more direct booking opportunities.

name: Bookkeeping Prompts
tagline: Free AI prompts and workflows for small-business bookkeeping
description: A free directory of tested AI prompts and step-by-step workflows for bookkeepers and small-business owners, covering ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok for bank reconciliation, month-end close, AR follow-up, expense categorization and more. Each entry links its sources. Record-keeping help only, not tax or legal advice.

name: EvoLuxe
tagline: AI photos & video that look like you — apply to the modeling team
description: EvoLuxe builds a consented likeness model from your reference photos and makes photos and short clips that look like you. You keep the files and post on your own accounts. Application is an audition to join the EvoLuxe modeling team — use the form on the site: https://evoluxe-for-creators.netlify.app/apply.html?utm_source=ignlab&utm_medium=directory&utm_campaign=listing . 18+ for social posts, 21+ for adult work. Own likeness only.

name: Free Invoice Generator
tagline: Create a free professional invoice online.
description:
**InvoiceTemplateMaker** is a free online invoice generator designed to help freelancers, entrepreneurs, and small businesses create professional invoices quickly and easily.

Users can choose from customizable invoice templates, add their business information and logo, manage items and taxes, and download their invoices as professional PDF documents.

**Key features:**
- 100% free invoice generation
- No registration or subscription required
- Multiple customizable invoice templates
- Instant PDF downloads without watermarks
- Support for multiple currencies and taxes
- Business logo and company information customization
- Available in English and French
- Privacy-focused, browser-based invoice creation

Unlike complex accounting platforms, InvoiceTemplateMaker focuses on simplicity. Users can create a professional invoice in minutes without learning complicated software or creating an account.

The tool is ideal for freelancers, consultants, independent professionals, and small businesses looking for a fast, accessible, and completely free invoicing solution.

name: EA LAB
tagline: Configurable MT5 trading robots with documented strategy rules
description: EA LAB (MT5 Robot Lab) develops configurable Expert Advisors for MetaTrader 5. Explore documented entry rules, exits, filters and limitations before purchase. Adjust the inputs, backtest configurations in MT5 and evaluate historical evidence. The site also publishes educational guides on strategies, optimization and risk. Features vary by robot. Trading involves risk, including loss of capital. Historical results do not guarantee future performance. Software only, not financial advice or account management.

name: Best Physical Therapy Near Me
tagline: Free national directory of physical therapists and PT clinics. Find care near you or claim your free listing.
description: Best Physical Therapy Near Me is a free nationwide directory of physical therapists and PT clinics. Patients search by city and specialty to find local providers. Clinics and therapists claim a free listing to update their profile and connect with people looking for physical therapy care. Claiming a basic listing is free.

name: Sabbaq
tagline: Every Property Finder and Bayut lead answered in seconds, in Arabic or English, on your existing WhatsApp number.
description: Sabbaq is an AI lead desk for Dubai real-estate brokerages. It replies to Property Finder and Bayut leads on WhatsApp within seconds, in Arabic or English, asks about budget, area and property type, and hands qualified leads to a named agent, alerting the manager if nobody responds. It runs on the brokerage's existing WhatsApp number. Plans start at AED 790/month with a 7-day trial (card required).

name: DocZap
tagline: Free Online PDF and Image Tools, Made Simple
description:
DocZap is a free online document toolkit that makes working with PDFs and images easier, faster, and more convenient. It offers a collection of browser based tools that help users merge PDF files, split documents, compress large files, convert formats, edit PDFs, and handle everyday document tasks without installing additional software.

Designed for students, professionals, freelancers, businesses, and everyday users, DocZap simplifies common file management tasks through an easy to use interface. Users can access supported tools directly from their browser, without creating an account or going through a complicated setup process.

DocZap aims to make essential document utilities accessible to everyone by providing practical tools for managing files, preparing documents for sharing, reducing file sizes, and converting content between formats. Supported tools process files locally on the user's device, helping protect document privacy.

Whether you're organizing paperwork, preparing files for work or study, or managing documents for your business, DocZap provides a convenient place to get everyday PDF and image tasks done.

name: LTX 2.5 AI
tagline: Turn text, images and audio into 4K video with sound using LTX 2.5
description: Browser AI video generator on Lightricks' LTX 2.5 open-weights model: text, image or audio to video, up to 4K at 50 fps with synced sound, clips up to 20 s.

name: Square Image
tagline: Make any image a perfect 1:1 square online, by crop or pad
description: Free online tool that crops or pads any photo into a perfect 1:1 square right in your browser. No signup, no watermark, and your image is never uploaded.

name: free online image cropper
tagline: Free private image cropping in your browser
description: Free Online Image Cropper is a simple and convenient tool for anyone who wants to crop images quickly. Adjust image dimensions, remove unwanted areas, and create clean crops directly in your browser without installing software.

name: AI Spend Doctor
tagline: Private API cost checks for Claude, OpenAI and OpenRouter
description: AI Spend Doctor is a free browser-local tool for developers and teams investigating AI API costs. Open a supported Claude, OpenAI or OpenRouter usage/cost CSV to spot daily spend spikes and inspect cache, batch and top-tier model shares when the data allows. Model-price scenarios are estimates, not guaranteed savings; unavailable checks are labelled. No signup, API key, file upload, analytics or stored usage data. A synthetic demo is available. The source can be inspected on GitHub. Real dashboard exports have not been independently verified.

name: App Screenshot Creator
tagline: Create stunning, conversion-boosting screenshots for App Store & Google Play — templates, custom typography, one-click PNG/JPG export.

description: OpenCraftTools is the home of the ArtCraft open-source suite: 13 Craft Apps and 12 verified browser-based editors, including PhotoCraft (photo editor) and VectorCraft (vector editor). Every tool runs in the browser with honest workflow limits, free to use, no sign-up required.

name: Maze Generator
tagline: Make custom printable mazes in seconds with answer keys.
description: Make custom printable mazes in seconds with answer keys. Export PDF, SVG or PNG free.

name: TextCompare
tagline: Compare two texts online and see every difference highlighted.
description: Compare two texts online and see every difference highlighted. Line, word and character diff, 100% in your browser.

name: PixSip
tagline: Compress images in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
description: PixSip is a free image compressor that runs entirely in your browser. Drop JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or HEIC files and get smaller versions back without uploading anything: compression happens locally with WebAssembly builds of the open-source MozJPEG, OxiPNG, libwebp, libavif and libjxl encoders, and the tool keeps working offline once the page has loaded. There is no quality slider to guess at; PixSip ships one quality setting calibrated against TinyPNG on a 20-image benchmark. Flip one switch to also convert your images to AVIF, JPEG XL, WebP, JPG or PNG, each output shown with its own size and download button. The free plan handles batches of up to 20 images (10 MB each), strips metadata automatically, offers a before/after Compare view at 1:1, and downloads the whole batch as a ZIP. No signup, no watermark, no ads.

name: TidyCode
tagline: Free online code formatter, validator & beautifier
description: TidyCode is a free online code formatter, validator and beautifier. Format, validate, convert and beautify JSON, HTML, CSS, XML, YAML, Python and SQL directly in the browser. No signup required.

name: ResizeOn
tagline: Free online image resizer — pixels, ratios & more
description: Resize JPG, PNG, and WEBP images by pixels, percentage, or aspect ratio. Free online image resizer and crop tool with no signup and no watermark.

name: State Property Meme AI
tagline: Turn one photo into your own State Property meme video
description: Make the viral “State? This?” / Hit the Road Dude private property meme video from one photo. Pick a scene, generate, preview and download. Paid, credit-based pricing.

name: Remorphy
tagline: AI image morph and edit tool with a free plan
description: Remorphy morphs and edits photos: restyle an image, change the background, or remove an object. A free plan includes Fast edits. Useful for product photos and portraits.

name: SkillManual
tagline: Curated directory of agent skills — discover verified skills, prompts, and workflows for AI coding assistants.
description: SkillManual curates agent skills, guides, and workflows for developers working with AI assistants. Browse by category — from meeting-minutes workflows and time-boxed technical decisions to verified-facts README writing. Each skill links its source and documents its cost and evidence, helping you choose skills you can actually trust in your agent workflow.

name: Earnings Insight Lab
tagline: Public company earnings research with a report assistant
description: Earnings Insight Lab helps readers research public company earnings through searchable company and report pages, financial trends and available filing sources. After signing in, readers can ask report-specific questions through the report assistant. Public pages are free to browse and a free account is needed for the assistant; coverage, features and limits vary by company and period. The material provides research information rather than personalized investment advice.

name: CYBERMAPS
tagline: Help search and AI understand your WordPress site.
description: CYBERMAPS is a free, open-source (GPL-2.0-or-later) WordPress plugin that gives search engines a clear map of your pages, gives AI tools readable information about your site, and finds pages that need work. One free plugin, no AI subscription required. Made by CYBER BRAND (https://cyberbrand.net).

name: Scientific Figure Generator
tagline: Chat to create publication-ready scientific figures
description: AI scientific illustration tool: turn text, sketches or abstracts into publication-ready diagrams and graphical abstracts, then edit any part by chat. Freemium from $9.90/mo with 50 free credits to start. Alternative to BioRender for researchers and students.

name: Decisión — Business Calculators in Spanish
tagline: Free Spanish calculators for online course pricing, memberships and business costs
description: Decisión offers 20 free economic planning calculators in Spanish. Course creators can estimate prices, launch costs, sales targets and membership scenarios; other tools cover hiring and software costs. Assumptions are editable and calculations run in the browser. No account is needed. Optional analytics require consent, and disclosed affiliate links to Systeme.io appear where relevant. These tools support scenario planning and do not predict sales or guarantee profits.

name: CryptoTax converter
tagline: Free browser-only wallet history → Koinly/KoinX/CoinTracker CSV
description: Free client-side converter that turns Etherscan-family CSV exports or a Tron address into import files for Koinly, KoinX, CoinTracker, CoinLedger, Summ, Blockpit, CoinTracking, Recap, Cryptact, Coinpanda, TaxBit, Divly and Awaken. Runs locally in the browser — no upload, no keys, no signup. MIT core. Not tax advice; not affiliated with those tax tools.

name: rea-captcha
tagline: Keep Browser Use tasks in the same session when CAPTCHA interrupts them.
description: Browser Use jobs can get ten steps in and stop at CAPTCHA. rea-captcha keeps the same Playwright/CDP page, pauses the task for an authorized test action or human handoff, then checks fresh page or server evidence before handing control back. It is an open-source local MCP server and SDK, not a hosted solver.

name: Clear HVAC Costs
tagline: Free HVAC cost and quote-checking tools for U.S. homeowners
description: Clear HVAC Costs helps U.S. homeowners estimate HVAC replacement costs and review contractor quotes for missing scope, equipment, labor, permits, warranties, and other common cost drivers.

name: RoomFlip
tagline: AI room design & virtual staging from real photos—before/after previews for listings, Airbnb, and home redesign.
description: RoomFlip is an AI room design and virtual staging tool for real room photos. Upload up to 6 photos, choose a direction (redesign, new layout, or furnish an empty room), and compare photoreal before-and-after concepts that keep the original architecture. Built for real estate agents, Airbnb hosts, and homeowners who need listing-ready staging or redesign previews before buying furniture or committing to a renovation. Free starter credits; Pro and Max plans for higher volume. Web plus iOS and Android.

name: Pixolm
tagline: Pixolm — chat with an AI Agent to create images, with modes for logo, icon, portrait, hand-drawn, and more.
description: Pixolm is an AI image workspace with a chat Agent. Describe your idea in conversation, generate and keep refining, or jump into modes for logo, icon, portrait photography, hand-drawn styles, and more. Edit with prompts and masks, and keep assets and task history in one place.

name: CuteFontGen
tagline: Free cute font & Unicode fancy text generator for Instagram bios
description: CuteFontGen is a free online cute font generator. Create kawaii fonts, bubble text, bold/italic Unicode styles, Instagram bio fonts, and fancy text without signup.

name: setaside
tagline: Freelance tax set-aside kit: invoices + country tax buffers
description: Track paid and unpaid freelancing invoices, then see how much to move to a tax account using country profiles (KR 3.3% withholding plus optional year-end buffer, US quarterly planner, UK rough). Google Sheets CSV plus Notion pack. One-time $29 download. Estimates for planning only — not tax advice.

name: calorie
tagline: Free BMR, TDEE and diet calorie calculator (Mifflin–St Jeor)
description: Enter sex, age, height, weight and activity level to get basal metabolic rate, total daily energy expenditure, and target calories for cut/maintain/bulk plus macros. Uses the Mifflin–St Jeor formula. Free, no signup.

name: pdf
tagline: Free merge/split PDF and image-to-PDF in your browser
description: Merge multiple PDFs, split by page range, and turn JPG/PNG/WebP into a PDF. Everything runs in your browser on this device — files are never uploaded. Free, no signup. Korean and English UI.

name: WeChat to Markdown (wx2md)
tagline: Save WeChat articles as local Markdown — no upload
description: Local-first Chrome extension that turns WeChat Official Account articles into clean Markdown. Articles are parsed in the browser and article bodies are never uploaded. Keeps headings, lists, code blocks and image links, optional image ZIP for offline use, and works with Obsidian, SiYuan, Typora and VS Code. Freemium: 10 free single-article exports per month.

name: Img
tagline: Compress, resize and convert images in your browser
description: img.sadana.app compresses photos, resizes images and converts between PNG, JPG and WebP directly in your browser. Files are never uploaded to a server. Target a size such as under 500 KB, see before and after sizes, and download instantly. No signup, free, Korean and English.

name: gen.sadana.app
tagline: QR code, password and UUID generator that runs in your browser
description: Generate static QR codes (PNG download), strong passwords with entropy display, UUIDs and vCards. Everything runs locally, nothing sent to a server.

name: unit.sadana.app
tagline: Clean unit converter: weight, length, temperature, volume, area, speed
description: Instant unit conversion with popular-value pages, tables and formulas (kg to lb, C to F, pyeong to m2, km/h to mph). Korean and English, no signup.

name: format.sadana.app
tagline: Free JSON/CSV/YAML formatter, validator and converter
description: format.sadana.app formats, validates and minifies JSON, converts CSV<->JSON and YAML<->JSON, and shows a line-by-line diff, all locally in your browser. No signup, no upload. Korean and English.

name: New-website.bg
tagline: Custom websites and online stores from Plovdiv, Bulgaria
description: New-website.bg builds custom websites and online stores with responsive design for start-ups and SMEs, plus SEO optimisation, website maintenance, custom programming, branding and online marketing. Pricing is per project.

name: Generator Budget
tagline: Free standby-generator cost planning calculator.
description: Generator Budget helps U.S. homeowners plan a residential standby-generator project before requesting contractor proposals. The calculator presents itemized low, typical, and high installed-cost ranges rather than a single unexplained number. Homeowners can compare generator size, fuel, location, coverage, and installation-scope assumptions, then review the line items that drive the result. Supporting planning tools cover generator sizing, transfer-switch installation cost, written-quote comparison, scheduled maintenance, outage fuel running cost, financing payment sensitivity, and placement questions. The site explains its boundaries and source-backed assumptions. Results are planning estimates for early comparison, not contractor quotes, electrical designs, code-compliance decisions, tax advice, or an installation recommendation.

name: Playable Notes
tagline: Any piece, at your student's level. Just ask.
description: Playable Notes helps piano teachers turn any piece into a version their student can play. Snap a photo or upload a PDF of sheet music, and it reads it into a real score; then ask in plain English, like "easier left hand" or "put it in C", and it arranges it in about a minute. Hear it, fix any note, and print a clean PDF. New accounts get 50 free credits.

name: Diffio
tagline: AI audio enhancer that restores noisy recorded speech.
description: Diffio is an AI audio enhancer that restores recorded speech. Upload a noisy podcast, interview, lecture, or video and Diffio removes background noise and cleans up the voice, with before/after preview in the browser. Free trial includes 3 uploads; paid plans start at $8/month, and there's a developer API with JavaScript and Python SDKs.

name: Trim Checkout
tagline: A Shopify-like checkout plugin for WooCommerce
description: Trim Checkout is a WordPress plugin that gives classic WooCommerce checkout a Shopify-like layout. Customize checkout branding, fields and delivery options while keeping products, shipping rules, taxes, coupons and orders in WooCommerce. Features include a mobile order summary, opt-in abandoned-cart reminders after email verification, and analytics for captured carts. Express payment availability depends on supported gateway setup. One-time launch pricing is $49 USD for one website or $295 USD for 100 websites, including lifetime updates. Independent of Shopify; test compatibility on staging.

name: Fish Tank Plus
tagline: A free living 3D fish tank for Windows: screensaver or live wallpaper, one tank across all your monitors. Now on the Microsoft Store.
description:
Fish Tank Plus (formerly Ultra Aquarium) is a living 3D fish tank for Windows 10/11. Use it as a screensaver, as live wallpaper behind your desktop icons, or full screen. With more than one monitor it becomes one big tank: the fish swim from screen to screen, and bezel correction lines the picture up across the gaps.

Now on the Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/xp8c5d95n4q26p (Microsoft-signed, one-click trusted install, automatic updates).

Pick your scene: the Glass Tank, a huge public-aquarium tank in a grand hall with a resident shark doing laps past the glass, or the open sea, a coral reef with Octopus Boy, manta rays, turtles and whales passing through. Real 3D is the showpiece: with your webcam on, it's like looking into a real aquarium. Lean, stand up or get close and the tank moves with you.

New in 8.0: fish sticks. Earn one for every minute your tank fills the screen and unlock new fish and ornaments, from a seahorse and a treasure chest to a sunken lighthouse and a golden Octopus Boy, plus 34 achievements.

Free, no ads. Not on Windows? Play it in your browser at https://fishtankplus.com.

Good to know: built with a lot of AI help (Claude, ChatGPT, Grok); the code is on GitHub for anyone to read but it isn't open source; anonymous usage sharing is on by default and can be switched off on the About page. Download: https://windows.fishtankplus.com/download · GitHub: https://github.com/leksicon1/aquarium

name: GeometryDash.si
tagline: Independent browser arcade with dash and jump games
description: GeometryDash.si is an independent browser arcade featuring Geometry Dash Lite and related dash, jump and platform games. Players can find practical guides to controls, timing, loading and audio. No website account is required, and third-party games may display ads. Submitted by the website owner; the site is not affiliated with the original game creators.

name: RobotTraining.jobs
tagline: Paid robot training, teleoperation and AV test-driver jobs, checked daily
description: Free job board for paid robot-training work: teleoperation, demonstration recording, at-home video capture, AV and drone test operation, with posted pay where the employer states it.

name: HustleCrewAI
tagline: Plain-English AI tool directory for trades & small biz
description: HustleCrewAI is a free directory of 65+ AI tools picked for trades and small service businesses: plumbers, HVAC, roofers, cleaners, landscapers and solo operators. Tools are sorted by the job they actually do (answering phones, scheduling, estimates, reviews, bookkeeping), with checked starting prices and honest, plain-English comparisons. No hype, no jargon, and no developer tools you'll never use.

name: 글자수 세기 / Character Counter
tagline: Free character counter for Korean and English text
description: Free 글자수 세기 / character counter that shows graphemes, code points, UTF-16 units and UTF-8 bytes side by side, with X weighted counts, SMS byte limits (90B/LMS), 자소서 공백 포함/제외 and 원고지 pages. Runs in your browser; text is never sent to a server. Bilingual: https://count.sadana.app/en/

name: ShellWire
tagline: Good software deserves a front page.
description:
Someone is looking for a better way to do the thing your software does.

ShellWire gives useful applications a place to be understood and discovered. Explore AI assistants, chatbots, developer tools and everyday software by the problems they help solve. Compare documented capabilities, follow official sources and see how each application's utility score is calculated.

Built with AI, by hand or through both approaches, an application belongs here because of what it helps someone do. Builders can submit their software for a free, reviewed listing. Each published application has its own page, and the public catalog is available to AI assistants through MCP.

Find an application for the job in front of you, or introduce the one you built.

Free submissions require email verification and a ShellWire link on the application's homepage. Listings are reviewed before publication.

name: VideoAny
tagline: One-click AI video and image generator
description: VideoAny turns text prompts or reference photos into cinematic videos and images. Text-to-video, image-to-video, text-to-image, photo remix, AI kiss/dance, cloth change, and video extend — with many models in one workspace.

name: Koinsify
tagline: Cryptocurrency markets, news, and token discovery
description: Koinsify is a free web platform for people exploring cryptocurrency markets and researching digital assets. It combines crypto news, market information, and emerging-token discovery in a recognizable dark interface. Readers can use Koinsify as a starting point for following the crypto landscape and choosing projects to investigate further.

name: Dollar Cost Averaging Calculator
tagline: Explore recurring investment and compound growth scenarios
description: A free browser-based calculator for exploring regular investment scenarios. Users can adjust the starting amount, monthly contribution, investment period, assumed annual return and annual costs, then compare total contributions with an estimated future value and growth chart. The site also provides compound-interest, Bitcoin savings-plan and lump-sum versus recurring-investment calculators. Multiple languages and currencies are available. Results depend on the selected assumptions and are for education, not investment advice.

name: Shot
tagline: Mac screenshot annotation, quick and quiet.
description: Coming-soon Mac screenshot annotation app (not released yet) for quick arrows, boxes and blur on captures. Join the free waitlist on the site.

name: Snap
tagline: Mac window snapping: halves, quarters, next display. Instant.
description: Coming-soon Mac window tiling app (not released yet): halves, quarters, saved layouts and next-display moves, with a quiet gray UI. Join the free waitlist on the site.

name: AppClean
tagline: See every Mac app leftover. Delete nothing until you say so.
description: Coming-soon Mac app (not released yet) that finds the prefs, caches and support files a removed app leaves behind. Dry-run by default; deletes go to Trash. Join the free waitlist on the site.

name: AirBasing
tagline: Compare aircraft and explore US airport basing options.
description: AirBasing is an aircraft research website covering 36 aircraft models and 34 US airports. Compare 2–5 models, explore aircraft profiles and the Bases map, and download free model specification PDFs. Source-linked research supports initial exploration; operational decisions require current authoritative data.

name: devdisk
tagline: Find the gigabytes your dev tools hide.
description: Free, read-only disk scanner for developers. Finds npm/pnpm/yarn caches, node_modules, Xcode DerivedData, Gradle, Rust target and model caches. Never deletes.

name: receipt-to-csv
tagline: Turn receipt photos into CSV, privately in-browser
description: Drop receipt photos and get a clean CSV of merchant, date, total and tax. OCR runs in your browser, so nothing is uploaded. Free for 5 per batch.

name: og-api
tagline: Open Graph images from a URL. Free API
description: Generate 1200x630 Open Graph and social preview images with a single URL. No signup and free with a small watermark. $29 lifetime Pro removes it.

name: agent-failure-modes
tagline: 22 real ways coding agents break repos, plus fixes
description: A sourced catalog of real AI coding agent incidents (deleted DBs, leaked .env, deleted tests, runaway bills), each with a copy-paste fix. Free.

name: agent-tools-directory
tagline: 429 link-checked MCP servers, skills & hooks
description: Most awesome lists are full of dead links and abandoned repos. Agent Tools Directory lists 429 MCP servers, agent skills and hooks for AI coding agents, and every link is checked. Search or filter by category and agent, then open setup in one click. Submit your own tool for free.

name: agentsmd-gen
tagline: Generate AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md & Cursor rules free
description: Coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot) follow whatever instructions file sits in your repo, and each one wants a different file. agentsmd-gen writes all three from one form: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and .cursor/rules. Pick your stack (15+ presets: Next.js, Django, Rails, Go, Rust…) and you get build/test commands, code conventions and safety guardrails: no reading .env, no deleting tests to make CI pass, no force-pushing. Copy or download. No signup, runs in the browser.

name: GHOST CHAT
tagline: Private one-to-one and group chats without accounts or phone numbers
description: GHOST CHAT is a free web-based private messaging tool for adults. Start a one-to-one conversation or create a group of 2–20 people. Invite participants using a private link without sharing your phone number or creating an account. It runs directly in a browser, and it is designed for conversations with people you choose to invite.

name: Astrojelly
tagline: Free birth charts, Moon signs and local-time lunar calendars
description: Astrojelly offers free browser-based astrology calculators and beginner-friendly guides. Create a birth chart using a date, birth time and worldwide birthplace search, then explore Sun, Moon and rising signs, planetary placements and chart graphics. Check the current Moon phase and full moon calendars with local times for the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia and India. Tools work on mobile and desktop without an account. Astrology interpretations are for reflection and entertainment.

name: ReWords.AI (rewords.ai)
tagline: Replace image text while matching its original font and background
description: ReWords.AI is a browser-based AI tool for replacing existing text in images while matching the original font style, color and background. It helps designers, marketers and online sellers correct typos or adapt finished visuals without the original design file. Multiple text changes in one image use one credit. New users receive one free watermarked credit; further use is paid, with plans starting at $5.99. Maker submission by Shawn Shi. Official website: https://rewords.ai.

name: The AI Till
tagline: Free AI guides, prompts and calculators for UK trades
description: The AI Till is a free UK site for tradespeople and sole traders. It reviews AI tools with prices checked on each provider's own page, has ready-to-copy ChatGPT prompts for each trade, and offers 30+ free calculators and templates, from CIS and VAT to day rates. There's a free daily email too.

name: musics.name
tagline: Music theory you can hear: articles, scale and chord pages, free browser piano and tuner
description: musics.name is a music theory site with articles, scale and chord pages and free browser tools such as a piano and a tuner, plus the catalogue of the maker's fully human-made independent music. Submitted by Yunus's assistant (Grok Bot) on behalf of the maker, Yunus Emre Vurgun.

name: Crazy Frog AI
tagline: Turn your photo into the Crazy Frog AI trend video
description: Upload 1–2 photos and generate a 12s Crazy Frog AI trend clip: invisible moped, chasing car, wipeout. Free preview, no prompt writing. Free daily previews; one-time credit packs from $4.99, no subscription.

name: TradeAI Index
tagline: Free price directory of AI tools for trades
description: TradeAI Index is a free, independent directory of AI and software tools for home-service trades businesses, including plumbing, HVAC, electrical, roofing, landscaping, cleaning, pest control and garage door companies. It covers 68 tools across AI receptionists, missed-call text back, review management, dispatch and CRM, estimating and marketing. Every listing shows the lowest published starting price copied from the vendor's own pricing page, the date it was checked and a link to the source, so owners can verify it in one click. If a vendor does not publish a price, the listing says so instead of guessing. The site is built for busy contractors, not tech experts: plain language, no sign-up, and side-by-side comparisons such as Jobber vs Housecall Pro. It also includes an AI receptionist price index and a missed-call cost calculator. The full dataset is free to download as CSV or JSON. Vendors can submit tools and corrections for free.

name: OpenSparta
tagline: Telegram account management and AI engagement
description: OpenSparta is a web workspace for Telegram account and proxy management, account warm-up, AI-assisted contextual commenting, reactions, masslooking, and audience discovery. It brings Telegram growth workflows into one dashboard. New access requests are currently paused while the service is being prepared.

name: Nah Crypto Tax Tracker
tagline: FIFO crypto gains spreadsheet with PDF guide
description: Nah Crypto Tax Tracker is a spreadsheet template (.xlsx; works in Google Sheets and LibreOffice) plus a step-by-step PDF guide. Log buys and sells (swaps as a sell plus a buy) and get FIFO cost basis, realized gain/loss per year, and current holdings by token. Airdrops, staking and transfers are explained in the guide but not calculated. FIFO only; guide covers US, Switzerland and Germany. No sign-up and no wallet connection: your data stays in your own file. Price: 29 USDC one-time, paid on Solana. Not tax advice: it organises records and does not determine what you owe; consult a qualified tax professional.

name: PS2 Web Recomp
tagline: Independent PS2 recompilation guides, setup and compatibility notes
description: PS2 Web Recomp is an independent English-language community guide to the experimental open-source PS2 static recompilation project. It brings together upstream source links, local build and setup instructions, Chrome and Edge WebGPU requirements, and compatibility notes for showcased games such as Gran Turismo 4 and God of War II. It helps retro-gaming enthusiasts and developers understand how the project works and prepare their own game-specific browser build. The site is free to read, requires no account, and does not host game images or ready-to-play game builds. It is not affiliated with Sony or presented as the upstream project's official website.

name: Kling 4.0 AI Video Generator
tagline: Create cinematic AI videos from text and images with multiple AI models.
description:
Kling 4.0 AI Video Generator is an online multi-model AI video creation platform that helps users turn text prompts and images into engaging videos. It supports text-to-video and image-to-video generation, allowing creators to produce cinematic scenes, product advertisements, social media videos, and marketing content.

The platform brings together multiple AI video models, giving users the flexibility to choose the right model for different creative needs. It also offers ready-to-use video prompts, daily free credits, and a simple online workflow, making AI video creation accessible to beginners, content creators, marketers, and businesses.

Visit https://kling40.app/ to explore AI video generation.

name: ChatDecitas
tagline: Chat gratuito en español con salas por ciudades y temáticas
description: Free Spanish-language community chat with city and topic rooms, no mandatory registration, and multi-room chat in one tab. Real human conversations without fake members or bots, responsive mobile UI.

name: Rolodai
tagline: Voice-first personal CRM. Never forget anyone you meet.
description: Rolodai is a personal CRM for you, not your company. After a meeting or coffee chat, just talk. Rolodai pulls out the people, matches them to LinkedIn, researches them, tracks how warm each relationship is, and reminds you to follow up. Native iOS plus web. $10/month or $100/year, 14-day free trial, no credit card.

name: MegaFaucet
tagline: Free crypto faucet, PTC, offerwall and shortlink rewards platform
description: MegaFaucet lets users claim small crypto rewards via a faucet, PTC ads, offerwalls, shortlinks and tasks. Daily bonuses, referral rewards and optional crypto games are available. Withdrawals supported through FaucetPay or other displayed payout methods after reaching the minimum.

name: JobbyRecruit
tagline: Map-based job search and ATS for small employers
description: JobbyRecruit is a map-based job search (like Zillow for jobs) that pulls openings from company career pages, plus an applicant tracking system for small employers. Includes AI recruiting agent Zeus. Founded 2025 by Travis Hall in Lake Oswego, OR. Free plan for 1 job; Basic $95/mo; Premium $190/mo. Android app: Jobby.

name: Derive
tagline: The intelligent notebook for STEM with a real-time tutor
description: A handwriting notebook for maths, science and engineering students. It reads your working, checks each line, and has a tutor beside the page. Paid, 7-day free trial. Available on iPad, iPhone, Mac, Windows and Web.

name: Standout
tagline: Free 0-100 LinkedIn recruiter-visibility score plus a rewritten headline. No signup. $1 unlocks the full rewrite.
description: Recruiters run keyword searches rather than reading profiles. Standout scores your LinkedIn profile 0-100 on how that search reads it, shows the four components behind the number, and returns a rewritten paste-ready headline — instantly, free, with no signup, no account and no card. Four free single-purpose tools (headline generator, profile checker, About generator, keyword finder) and 40 role example pages are free and unlimited. One optional paid product: $1 one-time unlocks the rewritten About section, your top three experience bullets reworded for recruiter search, and a ranked keyword list, with a 14-day money-back guarantee. No subscription and nothing recurring. It does not edit resumes or PDF files, never asks for your LinkedIn password or account access, never posts on your behalf, and uses no human reviewers. Not affiliated with or endorsed by LinkedIn.

name: TiniDrop
tagline: Secure document intelligence for modern teams.
description: TiniDrop is a secure document intelligence platform. Share pitch decks, proposals, contracts, and files as a tracked link — see who opened it, which pages they read, collect eSignatures, and control access with passwords and expiry. Founded 2025 in Würzburg, Germany. Freemium.

name: VideoText
tagline: Video to text: transcripts, SRT/VTT subtitles and subtitle translation in 69 languages
description: VideoText turns video and audio into clean transcripts and SRT/VTT subtitles. Speech to text in 50+ languages, subtitle translation into 69 languages, and Fix Subtitles for timing and overlaps (free). Free plan available; Pro $14.99/mo or $120/yr.

name: Socify social media scraper api
tagline: Unified Social Media Scraper API
description: Socify is a unified social media scraping API that gives developers and AI agents access to public data from major social platforms through a single API key and a single, consistent JSON schema. The supported platforms are Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X (Twitter), Reddit, LinkedIn, Threads, Twitch, and Snapchat.

name: Image Convert
tagline: Prepare images on your device
description: Image Convert provides seven free browser-local tools for everyday image work: HEIC or HEIF to JPG, HEIC to an ordered PDF, JPEG/PNG/WebP conversion, target-size compression, resizing, cropping, and batch text watermarking. It is useful when you need a compatible format, smaller file, specific dimensions, or one PDF from several HEIC photos. Supported file processing happens on your device, and selected files and generated results are not uploaded for processing. Public tools require no sign-in.

name: RE Underwrite Lab
tagline: Real estate flip and rental deal calculators

name: Save Gmail Emails as PDF in Bulk
tagline: Bulk export Gmail to PDF and print, 100% in your browser
description:
Save Gmail Emails as PDF in Bulk is a Chrome and Edge extension that adds PDF and Print buttons to Gmail's own toolbar. Select emails, a whole label or a search result and save every conversation as its own PDF with attachments zipped alongside, or merge up to 50 conversations into one PDF to save or print. PDFs are generated locally in your browser, so no email is ever uploaded.

Bulk export: tick the emails you want, or select a label, a sender or any Gmail search result, then click PDF. Each conversation becomes a separate PDF, named by a filename template you build from date, sender and subject (the default gives names like 2026-01-15_Acme_Invoice.pdf), and attachments are saved next to each PDF in a zip with the original files intact. A progress panel shows which emails are saved, converting or waiting, and a run can be cancelled midway without losing the files already written.

Merge and print: click Print instead and the selection is merged into a single PDF, one email per page, in the order you picked them. A short summary lists what went in, then Save PDF downloads the merged file or Print now sends it to the printer as one job. Gmail itself can only print one conversation at a time. A whole thread can also be saved as one PDF with every reply in order.

Page setup: portrait or landscape, and eight paper sizes (A3, A4, A5, B4, B5, Letter, Legal and Tabloid), set once and applied to every export. Layout, fonts, inline images, headers and timestamps come through as Gmail shows them.

Privacy: the PDF is built inside the Gmail tab that is already open, on your own device. Emails and attachments never pass through our servers or anyone else's.

It works with personal Gmail and Google Workspace accounts, in Chrome (Chrome Web Store) and Microsoft Edge (Edge Add-ons) with identical features. There is no setup: after installing, the PDF and Print buttons appear the next time Gmail is opened. It is used for client files, discovery and evidence in legal work, invoices and receipts for accounting and audits, offer letters and candidate threads in HR, project sign-offs for freelancers and agencies, transaction files in real estate, claims records in healthcare and insurance, and backing up a mailbox before an account closes.

Pricing: the free trial includes every feature and 20 Gmail to PDF conversions. Pro is $4.99/month or $49.9/year for unlimited conversions with priority ticket support, cancel anytime, and every payment has a 7-day money-back guarantee.

name: HSKWin
tagline: HSK 3.0 mock tests, timed and scored instantly
description:
HSKWin is an HSK exam preparation site built to the 2026 HSK 3.0 syllabus. Sit a full mock test for any level from HSK 1 to HSK 7-9 on the real section clock, get your score the moment you hand in, with an explanation for every answer and a pass probability, and have your Chinese writing marked by AI. Every paper can be previewed free and every account gets one full timed mock free.

The mock tests follow the official structure of each level: listening, reading and writing in exam order, at the official question counts, with each section on its own countdown that closes when time is up. Listening is recorded to the official pattern, at exam speed with three voices, and plays the number of times your level plays it. The clock runs on the server, so a paper can be paused and resumed without gaining time. There are ten papers at each of HSK 1-6 and fifteen at HSK 7-9, all written against the published HSK 3.0 syllabus rather than copied from past papers. Questions you miss go into a mistake book with their explanations, grouped by section and question type, so you can see which part of the paper is costing you marks.

AI writing marking scores answers on the three dimensions exam raters use (content, language and structure), quotes the sentence behind every deduction and gives a model answer. HSKK speaking practice has fifteen full sets, five each for Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced, with recordings, pictures and model answers; you record your answers in the browser and each one is scored.

Free tools: a 15-question placement test that estimates your HSK level in about three minutes, a score calculator with the pass marks for every level, the 2026 exam calendar with email reminders before registration closes, an HSK 3.0 status tracker that says which levels have switched from HSK 2.0, graded Chinese stories for each level, and the HSK 3.0 word lists (11,000 words across nine levels) with pinyin, English meanings and audio, free to browse with no account.

HSKWin is for adults preparing for an HSK or HSKK sitting. The site is available in English, Chinese, Vietnamese and Thai and has no ads. The free plan includes paper previews, one full timed mock, and one AI essay mark and one HSKK speaking score a day. Monthly ($5.99/month) and Lifetime (one payment) add three timed mocks a month, full answer reviews and unlimited AI marking. HSKWin is an independent study tool and is not affiliated with the HSK exam's owner.

name: AmzDL
tagline: Download Amazon product videos, images and reviews
description:

Works on 20+ Amazon marketplaces. Image downloads are free; Pro adds videos, reviews and AI analysis.

Amazon serves product videos as HLS streams, so most people end up screen-recording them. AmzDL takes the highest-quality stream Amazon serves and joins it into an MP4 without re-encoding: no cursor, no player controls, no watermark. It finds the main product and brand videos, creator and review videos from the video carousel, and videos inside A+ modules, which most tools miss.

The image downloader grabs the real files instead of the 500px preview: the main gallery, every colour and size variant and the A+ / EBC modules, as HD originals up to 3000px. Image downloads are free and unlimited on every marketplace.

The review exporter pages through a listing's reviews and writes one row per review to .xlsx and .csv, with rating, title, full text, author, date, verified purchase, variation and helpful votes, plus an AI sentiment label computed locally. AI review analysis clusters complaints, ranks them by star impact and separates product problems from listing problems.

One-click bulk download files a whole listing into a folder named after the ASIN and title (01_main-images, 02_variants, 03_aplus, 04_customer-photos, 05_videos, 06_360-spin and a manifest.xlsx). Everything runs locally in the browser and works on 20+ Amazon marketplaces including amazon.com, .co.uk, .de, .co.jp, .fr and .ca. No sign-up is needed to start; Pro is $7.99/month or $79.99 once.
