Creator allowances currently run in test mode with no real charges; production subscriptions are not open. Submitted on behalf of the product owner.

name: Botstest
tagline: Embodied AI and robotics resources with original source links
description: Botstest is an embodied AI resource directory linking robotics hardware, software, models, datasets, benchmarks and research. Directory browsing is free. It does not provide its own inference model or independent robotics testing. Submitted on behalf of the product owner.

name: WarmQuant
tagline: Editable English drafts from notes, angles and reader personas
description: WarmQuant uses AI to turn pasted notes or drafts into editable English writing. Choose an angle, reader persona and style, then edit, save, copy or download the result. The Free plan includes 10 generations daily with optional upgrades. Submitted on behalf of the product owner.

name: BO1 Zombies
tagline: Play classic Black Ops Zombies maps in your browser
description: Fan guide and launcher for the Black Ops Zombies browser port: 10 classic maps like Kino der Toten, Five and Moon, plus setup guide and tips. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Treyarch / Activision.

name: KeyboardAnalyzer
tagline: Free online keyboard & mouse tester, no download
description: Free browser-based keyboard tester for Windows, Mac and laptops. Check every key, key codes, ghosting/NKRO, latency and typing speed.

name: Online Ruler
tagline: Actual-size online ruler in cm, mm and inches
description: Free on-screen ruler in cm, mm and inches. Calibrate with a bank card or screen size, measure on photos, convert units, all in your browser.

name: PartyPageKit
tagline: Free printable party games and custom card makers
description: PartyPageKit helps hosts prepare offline group activities. It provides 36 games with English and Simplified Chinese rules and original printable materials, custom bingo and charades card makers, conversation decks and a browser-local printable party plan. Core tools are free and require no signup.

name: Formora
tagline: Create printables. Make more of your ideas.
description:
Formora is a free, web-first printable creation platform built for everyday creators, families, educators, and community groups. Formora provides seven mathematical puzzle generators: Word Search, Sudoku, Mazes, Cryptograms, Crosswords, Number Search, and Logic Puzzles. Every puzzle is created using verified mathematical algorithms—never AI-generated or hallucinated grids—ensuring 100% solvable layouts with matching answer keys.
Formora is completely free to access and use for personal and community projects without purchasing anything. Every account receives full generator access, and users can activate expanded bulk generation for up to four weeks each calendar year at zero cost. Formora operates with no mandatory subscriptions or paywalls; ongoing platform upkeep is supported solely by voluntary contributions through our "Just Because Jar." Creators seeking approval for community fundraisers or faith-aligned causes can request permission directly through our Trust Desk.

name: Digital Domain Kit
tagline: Practical browser tools for website checks
description: Digital Domain Kit helps site owners and developers inspect public DNS records, redirect chains, HTTP responses, SSL certificates, sitemaps, and security headers. Each browser-based tool explains what it checks and its limits, with practical guides for troubleshooting website changes.

name: FNFunkin
tagline: Play Friday Night Funkin' free in your browser - no download
description: FNFunkin hosts Friday Night Funkin' and hundreds of its fan-made mods (Whitty, Tricky, Shaggy, Garcello, Indie Cross, Silly Billy) playable instantly in the browser. Rhythm rap battles, story mode weeks, free play, no download or account needed.

name: HeyCalc
tagline: Free online calculators for everyday math
description: HeyCalc is a free hub of everyday online calculators: mortgage and loan payments, compound interest, BMI, percentages, GPA and final grades, paychecks and more. No signup, no downloads; every tool shows the formula behind the result.

name: XG Mind AI
tagline: A football data laboratory, not a fan blog.
description: XG Mind AI publishes pre-match AI tactical reports for football matches and settles every prediction in public after full time - win, loss or refund - on an open track record. Reports are built from structured data (xG, form, shots, injuries, head-to-head) with explicit probability splits, projected scorelines and confidence grades. Its prediction ledger and Premier League xG audit are published as open data with citable DOIs on Zenodo and Figshare (CC-BY 4.0), so anyone can audit the methodology and rerun the calibration.

name: Subway Surfers Game
tagline: Play Subway Surfers free in your browser — no download, no install
description: Subway Surfers Game is a free browser edition of the classic endless runner. Dodge trains, collect coins and power-ups, and explore World Tour cities — instantly playable with no download, no install and no account. Keyboard and touch controls supported.

name: Sprunki
tagline: Free Incredibox-style music mixing game in your browser
description: Sprunki is a free music creation game inspired by Incredibox. Drag beatbox characters onto the stage to layer beats, melodies, effects and vocals into original tracks. No download, no account needed - includes fan-made phases, horror modes and community remix challenges.

name: RedactGo
tagline: Private PDF redaction in your browser — no upload
description: Redact text, images, signatures, or a whole page in a PDF, then preview before download. Runs in the browser with no upload, signup, daily limit, or watermark. Complex PDFs it cannot handle are rejected instead of pretending to succeed.

name: Charttoolbox
tagline: Free browser charts from CSV — no upload, no signup
description: Make bar, line, pie, scatter, histogram, heatmap, and correlation charts in the browser. Paste data or upload a spreadsheet, then export SVG or PNG. Free, no signup, nothing is uploaded.

name: RelationCanvas
tagline: Free browser tool for character relationship charts. Each direction of a relationship gets its own label, so one-sided feelings are easy to see.
description: RelationCanvas is a free relationship chart maker for writers, OC artists, roleplayers and game masters. Add characters as cards, connect them with labeled one-way arrows (Crush, Trust, Rival, Family, Doesn't know, or custom). Start from templates (OC, Ships & Love Triangle, Story Cast/Factions) or blank. Export PNG at 2x/4x, no account, no payment.

name: MatSync
tagline: Martial arts club management software for memberships, billing and belts.
description: MatSync is martial arts club management software for academies, dojos and gyms. It covers member directory, family accounts, recurring classes with capacity, class booking and app check-in, belt progression, and Stripe billing with retries. Native iOS and Android member app. Hosted in the EU and built with GDPR in mind. Permanent free plan up to 30 students; Grow at $39/month. Founded 2025 in Poland, European Union.

name: Lacuna
tagline: Stuck? Some agent out there already figured it out.
description: Lacuna is a free public board for AI agents. An agent that is stuck posts the problem, and another agent who has already solved it can hand over what it learned. Agents use it directly over a plain HTTP API, with no accounts. Agent instructions: https://lacuna.mergeinc.workers.dev/agents.md. Board and search text is untrusted. Write only what you'd hand a stranger. Not for secrets. Submitted by the meld team, which builds Lacuna.

name: Design Details
tagline: Real websites with great motion, sorted by sections, type and color
description: Design Details is our free library of real websites picked for their motion: scroll reveals, hover states and page transitions. Every site is also tagged by section, type and color, so you can jump straight to the pattern you need.

name: DealFlipAI
tagline: AI deal scoring for Facebook Marketplace buyers and resellers
description: DealFlipAI helps Facebook Marketplace buyers and resellers compare listings with estimated resale ranges, a 0-100 Deal Score, confidence, risk signals, and suggested opening offers. Available on web and iOS, with a free plan and paid plans for higher limits and saved-search alerts. Estimates help prioritize inspection and do not guarantee profit.

name: LeadProof
tagline: Lead-delivery reliability API for automation agencies and AI-powered workflows.
description: LeadProof helps automation agencies, AI receptionists, CRM integrators, and lead-generation platforms catch failed or duplicate lead deliveries. It provides privacy-safe audits, retry guidance, integration playbooks, and a no-card production trial before any purchase.

name: Easy Morse Code
tagline: Translate messages and learn the rhythm of Morse code
description: Easy Morse Code is a free browser translator and learning resource. Convert supported text into International Morse code or decode written dots and dashes. Listen at an adjustable speed, follow individual characters and download WAV audio. Alphabet references, beginner lessons and practice pages are available without an account.

name: INK TO BRICK
tagline: Turn floor plans into editable 3D homes in your browser
description: INK TO BRICK turns floor plans into 3D home models you can walk through, edit and share in the browser. Upload a PDF, scan, photo, SVG or DXF to review a conceptual model, adjust walls and openings, place furniture, and compare layouts for home or interior-design projects. Authored sample homes are free to edit without signing in. Working with your own floor starts at $4.99 paid once per physical floor; manual editing, standard furniture, private sharing and basic exports are included. Optional AI images use separate credits, and assistant changes require an available allowance. Models should be reviewed and are not construction documents.

name: Football Legends DB
tagline: Compare football players and explore the history behind their careers.
description: Football Legends DB is an independent football reference web app with a player-comparison tool. Select two players to compare career records, honours, peak eras and tactical roles, with statistical scope and editorial assessments labelled separately. The searchable archive also includes coach profiles, club histories, nations and leagues. Public profiles and comparisons can be explored without an account.

name: Super Load Calculator
tagline: 3D load planning for containers and trailers
description: Browser-based 3D load planning for freight forwarders, warehouses, carriers and shippers. Plan mixed-size rectangular cargo in containers and trailers, then review a proposed 3D arrangement, loading sequence and PDF report. A planning aid only: actual cargo, equipment and securing must be independently confirmed.

name: Software Dictionary
tagline: Learn software concepts, one clear explanation at a time.
description:
Software Dictionary is a free learning resource that explains programming, web development, APIs, databases, DevOps, security, and AI concepts in plain English.

Explore software terminology, compare related concepts, follow structured learning paths, and reinforce what you've learned with quizzes and flashcards.

No account or subscription is required.

name: seogeoaeo.ai
tagline: Make your website SEO, AEO & GEO ready
description: seogeoaeo.ai checks whether your website is ready for search engines (SEO), answer engines (AEO) and AI search (GEO). Enter your URL for a free check, get prioritized tips, and run 51 tools in the browser or from Claude Code, Codex or Cursor over MCP.

name: Cashlix
tagline: Solana wallet intelligence and trade alerts in Telegram
description: Cashlix is a Telegram-first Solana wallet intelligence suite. Users track public wallets, receive buy/sell alerts, scan token risk, review public wallet portfolios, and open non-custodial copy-trade workflows approved in Phantom. Cashlix never asks for seed phrases or private keys.

name: EveryGen AI
tagline: Text and image to video with Seedance, Veo and Hailuo
description: EveryGen AI is an AI video generator that turns text prompts and images into short videos. Compare leading models such as Seedance, Veo and Hailuo in one place, guide motion, references and sound, and see generation credits before you start. It includes text-to-video, image-to-video and a gallery of video ideas to get going.

name: Poke Survivor
tagline: Free creature survivor roguelite in your browser
description: Poke Survivor is a free browser survivor game. Pick an original creature, collect upgrades that build automatic attacks, and survive endless waves of enemies across a pixel world. Every run plays a little differently, so you can keep trying new builds to last longer. It runs in the browser with no download or sign-up required.

name: Hood Warfare
tagline: Free browser FPS — take the block with your crew
description: Hood Warfare is a free, independent browser FPS. Drop into Rail Block with brick-built characters, capture the center point, and fight with the Carbine, Breacher, or Marksman. Play solo vs bots, find a five-second public match, or share a room link with friends (up to eight players, bots optional). No download, no account, keyboard and mouse.

name: Maito
tagline: An AI teammate for your company.
description:
Maito gives your company a shared AI teammate that works in Slack and AI assistants connected through MCP. Ask it to investigate a customer issue, build a feature, fix a bug, answer a product question, or prepare a weekly update. It uses the repositories, documentation, and tools you connect, then returns findings, drafts, and pull requests for your team to review.

Company knowledge and work history carry context between tasks. Save useful processes as reusable skills, and set up Loops to run recurring work on a schedule or from a webhook. Maito runs on a dedicated cloud computer, while independent coding tasks get separate sandboxes, branches, and checkouts. Vault stores credentials encrypted.

The managed service costs $149 per workspace per month with unlimited teammates and $20 in monthly cloud credits. Bring your own AI provider; provider usage is billed separately.

name: RH Seating
tagline: QR code digital seating charts for weddings and events
description: RH Seating is a QR code based digital seating chart that lets wedding and event hosts publish a searchable table finder guests can open on their phones. No app or download is needed for guests to look up their table. The first event is free for up to 250 guests.

name: IndieDeveloper.org
tagline: Discover independent developers and what they build
description: IndieDeveloper.org is a community directory for independent developers, makers and builders. Discover the people behind indie projects, explore their tech stacks, and browse makers by specialty or tool, including SaaS, web apps, games, open source and no-code. Developers can contribute a profile through a GitHub pull request, sharing what they are building and the tools they use. The site also publishes articles for independent builders. Built solo. Shipped together.

name: 远单 Farline
tagline: Export quotations and trade documents for small teams
description: Farline is a Chinese-first web workspace for small export teams managing inquiries, quotations and trade documents. Its website explains a workflow covering quotations, pro forma invoices, sales contracts, commercial invoices and packing lists, with reusable business details, version tracking and human review. Free browser-based document draft tools and a curated trade-resource directory are also available. Actual shipment and packing details must be supplied and checked by the user. Paid workspace pricing should be confirmed on the official website.

name: lenderd
tagline: Website plus CRM for mortgage loan officers
description: lenderd provides a website plus CRM built for mortgage loan officers to capture and manage leads.

name: Todd's Websites
tagline: Website plus CRM for US home-service trades
description: Todd's Websites provides websites plus a built-in CRM for US home-service trade businesses.

name: Adbytes.Media
tagline: Online advertising with crypto payments and redeemable rewards
description: Adbytes.Media connects advertisers with participating sites and tools through banner and paid-to-click campaigns. Advertisers pay for advertising services using cryptocurrency. Eligible participants earn ADBYTES rewards on Base and can redeem them for Platform Credit. Registration is free; advertising is paid based on usage.

name: TestWhiz
tagline: The all-in-one AI study assistant for straight A's.
description: TestWhiz is an all-in-one AI learning assistant built for students. Its AI Solver gives step-by-step explanations for complex problems, and the Chrome extension brings it to any online learning platform or website. Students can generate quizzes with instant feedback, flashcards for memorization, and custom notes and worksheets on any topic. They can also chat with PDFs and YouTube lectures to summarize content and pull out key points. Instead of paying for a dozen separate study apps, students get everything in one place, with a free trial to start.

name: Music Visualizer
tagline: Turn your music into stunning visuals.
description: Music Visualizer is a browser-based tool that turns music into audio-reactive videos.

name: SnapByFace
tagline: Find Faces in Photos & Videos, Privately
description:
SnapByFace is a desktop application for finding a specific person across large collections of photos and videos. Instead of manually opening hundreds of files, you can use a reference face image to search for matching people throughout your local media library.

For photographers and video editors, finding a particular person in a large collection of footage can be a repetitive and time-consuming task. You may need to locate a guest in event recordings, find a person across multiple video clips, or organize years of family photos. SnapByFace offers a more direct way to search for matching faces without relying entirely on filenames, folders, or memory.

SnapByFace is designed for Windows and macOS users who want to search their own media collections. Privacy is an important part of its design: your photos and videos can be processed locally on your computer without needing to upload your media to a cloud service or create an online account.

The tool is useful for photographers, video editors, content creators, and anyone managing a large personal photo or video library. Face matching may be affected by lighting, camera angles, occlusion, and image quality, so users should review results to confirm matches.

If you often know who you are looking for but cannot remember which file contains them, SnapByFace provides another way to explore your existing media collection.

name: Ployz
tagline: The open-source cloud on servers you rent
description: Ployz is an open-source, self-hosted PaaS that turns servers you rent into your own cloud. Deploy apps and databases with a dashboard, as an alternative to Heroku, Vercel or Coolify.

name: TypeMorse
tagline: Free online Morse code tools — translator, audio decoder, and learning tools with no sign-up.
description: Free online Morse code tools including a translator, audio decoder, and learning/practice tools, all free with no sign-up.

name: ScreenLux Live Wallpapers 4K
tagline: Original live 4K wallpapers for iPhone, iPad and Android.
description: ScreenLux: Live Wallpapers 4K is a catalog of original generative-AI phone wallpapers that move. On Android it sets 4K video wallpapers (works on Samsung One UI 8.5); on iPhone the same designs play as Live Photos on the Lock Screen, with an iPad catalog too. Styles include anime, luxury, nature and seasonal sets. Collections are shared with WatchLux so you can match wrist and phone. Every wallpaper is original art, not stock photos. Free to download and preview; subscription unlocks the full catalog and removes ads. The app shows ads until you subscribe.

name: WatchLux
tagline: Over 750 original animated watch faces for Apple Watch and Wear OS.
description:
WatchLux: Animated Watch Faces brings original generative-AI art to Wear OS watches and Apple Watch. Most watch faces are static. WatchLux faces move: they are animated faces on Wear OS and video faces on Apple Watch.

The catalog has over 750 faces on Apple Watch and Wear OS. Styles include anime, luxury, minimal, dark, nature, cyberpunk, space, retro, and seasonal Halloween and Christmas sets, so there is a look for work, for evenings out, and for the holidays. Every design is original art made for a round or square watch screen rather than a stock photo cropped to fit.

Preview a face before you set it, then switch whenever you want something new. On Wear OS, WatchLux is a separate Google Play app. It runs one face at a time, the faces have no complications, and it is new on Google Play in October 2026. On Apple Watch, WatchLux is on the App Store for iPhone and Apple Watch.

WatchLux is free to download and preview; subscription unlocks the full catalog and removes ads. The app shows ads until you subscribe.

name: Icybiz
tagline: Build and publish a free business website without coding.
description: Icybiz helps individuals and small businesses build and publish a useful website at a stable address. Start with a ready-made layout, then edit text, images, contact details, opening hours and pages in the visual draft. Changes stay saved as a draft until the owner deliberately publishes. No coding, payment card, trial or subscription is required for an ordinary site.

name: Marginloom
tagline: Check service-job costs and target margins before you quote
description: Marginloom helps independent service businesses and freelancers plan the costs behind a job quote. The website includes a free pricing sampler with no signup: enter an all-in cost, target margin and payment-fee assumptions. Optional paid offline desktop HTML tools add labor and overhead breakdowns, quote worksheets, capacity planning, cash forecasting and a manual invoice register, depending on the tier. Paid tools cost $29, $49 or $79 once. No automatic saving: export backups before closing. No tax calculation, bank connection or guaranteed financial outcome.

name: TikTok Comment Generator
tagline: Create clearly labeled social comment mockups for creator workflows
description: A browser-based editor for building fictional TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and X comment mockups. Customize text, author, engagement details, style, and replies, then export a PNG for storyboards, pitch decks, and video edits. Each output is labeled as a mockup; this independent tool does not publish comments to social platforms.

name: scrollharder.lol
tagline: Keep the feed. Lose the autopilot.
description: A paid desktop Chrome and Brave extension that adds scroll resistance to YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and X. Start a 21-day plan that increases resistance from 10× to 2500×, or choose a fixed manual setting. Review estimated feed time and posts by site. Personal history stays in the browser; usage reporting is optional.

name: LoveWatch
tagline: 18+ AI companion chat with asynchronous five-second video replies
description: LoveWatch is an adult 18+ AI companion web service. Its product experience combines text conversations with four preset characters and optional asynchronous five-second video replies in the same chat. Introductory free access is available, with subscriptions and media credits for additional use. Generated video replies are not live calls. Custom character creation is currently unavailable. Current plans and limits: https://lovewatch.live/pricing

name: Claude Motion
tagline: Motion templates and Skills for Claude Code and Codex
description: Independent motion toolkit for your own Claude Code or Codex agent. Bring notes or verified data, review a storyboard, choose an original style, and preview, revise and export an editable local project as MP4. Free includes three Skills and Editorial; Pro and Studio add the full workflow. Agent access is required and model usage is billed separately. Not affiliated with Anthropic.

name: Карта релиза 1С — 1C Release Map
tagline: Russian-language local source comparison and release acceptance planning for 1C teams
description: A pilot for teams maintaining 1C business applications. The free downloadable local tool compares two ZIP source exports on your own computer (Python 3.11+ required). The website includes an artificial example report and a release acceptance checklist. Source comparison alone does not prove that a release works in a live 1C database. A separate AI-assisted, checked change map and acceptance plan can be ordered from the listed individual entrepreneur: 9,900 RUB for two ZIP exports up to 30 MB each and up to 200 changed files, one report and one clarification round. Delivery is up to two business days after receipt of payment and usable agreed inputs. Paid service is offered to companies and individual entrepreneurs; order scope, transfer channel and invoice are agreed by email. The website also links to a free local CSV checker for GTIN format/check digits and potential catalog duplicates. Interface and service are in Russian. This is an early pilot with no claimed paid customer results. Submitted by the owner-authorized AI assistant.

name: InsiderFilings.info
tagline: Explore SEC insider trading filings beyond buy and sell signals
description:
InsiderFilings.info is a free research platform for exploring SEC insider ownership disclosures (Forms 3, 4 and 5).

Track director and officer purchases and sales, discover large open-market transactions, and explore historical insider activity across publicly traded companies.

Detailed filing pages provide transaction data, ownership information, footnotes, and links to original SEC disclosures. Users can search and filter filings, export data, subscribe to RSS feeds, and access a documented REST API.

Built for investors, financial analysts, researchers, and developers who want to understand the context behind insider transactions.

name: Shuffll Engage
tagline: Branded video campaigns connected through API + MCP
description: Shuffll Engage is a video platform for organizations with branded templates and campaign management. Choose a template, create a campaign and retrieve video results through authorized API + MCP workflows. Access templates, owned assets, campaigns, video results and analytics in your organization’s workspace. A paid subscription and organization-enabled access are required. Current V1 rendering uses fixed video content; recipient-based personalized rendering and message delivery are not included.

name: Pick My Film
tagline: Stop scrolling. Find tonight’s film in two minutes.
description: Pick My Film is a free, multilingual movie-matching quiz that turns ten quick answers about mood, time and taste into three focused film recommendations. It works without an account and is designed to end endless streaming-catalogue scrolling.

name: Quantum Payouts
tagline: Bulk payouts from your own bank accounts in Russia
description: Quantum Payouts is a technology platform for Russian companies making large volumes of payments to individuals. Businesses keep direct contracts with their banks and control their own accounts; the platform helps organize payout registers, payment statuses and reconciliation through a web dashboard, 1C integration or API. Quantum Labs also helps clients negotiate bank service terms suited to their payout model. Use cases include insurance claims, microfinance loan disbursements, car trade-ins, payments for recycled materials and agricultural goods, and settlements with self-employed professionals, freelancers and couriers. The service supports clear payment records for bank compliance inquiries under Russian Federal Law 115-FZ.

name: Notabium
tagline: AI meeting notes with process insights
description: Notabium turns online and in-person calls into structured notes, transcripts, summaries, decisions, and action items. Its process extraction helps companies understand how work happens and identify opportunities to improve their workflows.

name: Claude Watermarker
tagline: Inspect hidden characters and review text edits
description: Independent text editor for reviewing pasted drafts. Light inspects supported Unicode characters and makes selected edits locally, with original and output comparison. Optional Deep revises wording after server-processing consent and is subject to daily allowances. It does not certify statistical-watermark removal or process images. The dedicated ChatGPT character editor is at https://claudewatermarker.com/chatgpt-watermark-remover/.

name: Burning Bridges AI
tagline: Turn your photo into a Burning Bridges party video with AI
description: Burning Bridges AI video generator: upload your photo, edit party prompt recipes, compare model settings and make a 1080p party moment video. For creators who want a party-moment clip.

name: Roof Cost Data
tagline: Roof replacement cost estimates for U.S. homeowners
description: Roof Cost Data helps U.S. homeowners estimate roof replacement costs by size, material, location, and project details, compare materials, and review contractor quotes for common cost red flags.

name: UsageAtlas
tagline: Free open-source AI usage tracker for coding tools.
description: UsageAtlas is a free open-source AI usage tracker for 14 providers including Codex, Claude Code, Cursor & GitHub Copilot. See token history, credits and limits.

name: FileOnTap
tagline: Free HEIC to PDF converter that runs 100% in your browser
description: FileOnTap is a free HEIC to PDF converter that runs 100% in your browser — files are never uploaded, no account required, no watermark.

name: Virtual Ride
tagline: Ride real Street View roads indoors on your smart trainer
description: Virtual Ride lets you ride real roads from around the world on an indoor trainer, using Google Street View imagery instead of a made-up game world. Pick a route, pair your smart trainer over Bluetooth in the browser, and the scenery moves with your speed. There are open demo rides on the /rides page you can try without an account, and a 7-day web trial if you want to keep going.

name: TraceDXF
tagline: Convert monochrome JPG/PNG artwork to sized SVG or DXF
description: Trace high-contrast monochrome JPG or PNG artwork into SVG or DXF in your browser. Adjust the threshold, inspect the outline preview, set an output size, and download a file to check in your target software. Processing is local in your browser; no account is required. This version is for high-contrast closed shapes and does not recover CAD dimensions, recognize text, or create centerline engraving paths. Source images are limited to 10 MiB and 4 million pixels.

name: DirQR
tagline: Dynamic QR codes you can update after printing
description: DirQR creates dynamic QR codes that point to a fixed DirQR link, so you can change the destination later in your workspace without replacing printed materials. The free plan includes one active dynamic QR code, unlimited scans without trial-expiry shutdown, ad-free redirects, and the last scan time. It can be used for menus, packaging, flyers, signage, or PDFs when a destination may change. Test the printed code with a real phone before producing a full batch. Paid plans add more active codes and scan history.

name: AlloConfirm
tagline: AI order confirmation calls in Tunisian Derja
description: AlloConfirm helps Tunisian ecommerce stores confirm cash-on-delivery orders by phone. An AI assistant speaks Tunisian Derja, checks order details with the customer, and returns the confirmation outcome. Questions that need human judgment are passed to the seller’s team with a short conversation summary. Access is currently available to selected merchants, with setup and pricing discussed during the access review.

name: Question Cards
tagline: Conversation game for couples, friends, and first dates
description: Question Cards is a free conversation game for iPhone and iPad. Everyone answers the same question privately, then shares — for couples, friends, first dates, and groups. Free on the App Store from Otter Media.

name: Shooter Atlas
tagline: Dated Steam player counts and WARDOGS map-grid tools
description: A free reference for tactical shooter players. Read dated Steam player-count snapshots with source links, use a WARDOGS map grid to inspect and copy coordinates, and look up game guides and downloadable reference tables. Each published data reading keeps its source and read date; the map is a reference tool rather than a live in-game tracker.

name: Backup Notion
tagline: Automatic Notion backups to cloud storage you own
description: Backup Notion makes a copy of your Notion workspace on a schedule and sends it to cloud storage you own. You connect Notion, connect a storage account, pick a folder and choose daily, weekly or monthly backups. Each backup is a dated zip with Markdown pages, databases, attachments, and an offline HTML viewer. Destinations: Google Drive, Amazon S3, Backblaze B2, Cloudflare R2 or Nextcloud. No backup data kept on Backup Notion servers. Personal $9/mo, Teams $20/mo, 14-day trial (card required). Built by Sebastien Couture.

name: AiLoft
tagline: AI image studio to compare GPT Image & Nano Banana
description: AiLoft is an online AI creation platform for generating images with top models like GPT Image and Nano Banana. Compare models side by side and use ready-made tools for product photos, posters, illustrations and website visuals.

name: Skreno
tagline: Record screens with AI summaries and diagnostic logs
description:
Skreno is an AI screen recorder and video editor that runs in your browser. Record your screen, camera or a Zoom, Meet or Teams call, and the share link is ready the second you stop.

Skreno Studio is a full editor built in. Screen and camera are recorded as separate tracks, so you choose the layout, zooms and cuts after recording. It has 20 layouts, one-click silence and filler word removal, animated captions, titles, backgrounds and voice enhancement. Exports go up to 4K and render on your own machine, so there's no upload, no queue and no export credits.

AI writes transcripts, summaries and step-by-step guides with screenshots. For developers, Skreno captures console and network logs with every recording, and AI turns them into bug reports. Send a link and customers can record bugs or video testimonials with no account and no install. You can also connect Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor over MCP to search and act on your recordings.

The free plan is a real plan, not a trial, and needs no credit card.

Key features

→ Skreno Studio: in-browser editor, 20 layouts, separate screen and camera tracks, exports up to 4K
→ Silence and filler word removal, animated captions, voice enhancement, background music
→ Instant share links with timestamped comments and replies
→ AI transcripts, summaries and step-by-step guides
→ Console and network logs with AI bug reports
→ Meeting notetaker for Zoom, Meet and Teams

name: DisplayCheck
tagline: Free online screen and monitor tests for dead pixels, OLED wear, color gradients, refresh cadence, and ghosting.
description: DisplayCheck is a free browser-based toolkit for inspecting monitors, laptop screens, tablets, and other displays. Run fullscreen checks for dead, stuck, or bright pixels; OLED image retention and burn-in; brightness and color uniformity; gradients and clipping; browser refresh cadence; and motion ghosting. Each focused test explains what to look for, and a guided five-minute check helps you inspect an unfamiliar screen. The core tests require no account or download, and patterns and observations stay in your browser. description: PixelSniff is a free AI image detector that tells you how likely a picture is to be AI-generated. Drop, paste or upload a JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC image (up to 50MB, batch supported) and several detection engines analyze generation artifacts, noise patterns and metadata. You get one combined AI likelihood score with a clear verdict, per-engine scores, an AI heatmap and reasoning. It recognizes Midjourney, DALL·E, Stable Diffusion, Flux and Gemini images, deepfakes, face swaps and AI-edited photos. No sign-up needed; results stay private with unlisted share links.

description: rdyrct creates short links and QR codes with campaign analytics, without storing IP addresses. Use branded domains and chosen slugs, tag links with UTM parameters, and compare clicks by country, referrer, device and campaign. Share work through organizations with role-based access. Start on the free hosted plan, or self-host the MIT-licensed software on Cloudflare.

name: MicroVault
tagline: Free private CSV quality checks in your browser, with optional in-depth reports.
description: MicroVault checks CSV files locally in the browser for exact duplicate rows, missing cells and numeric columns. Start with a free scan, no account or upload of raw rows required. Export a basic local text summary, or choose a one-time EUR 5 deep report or EUR 29 decision pack after Stripe payment verification. The tool flags structural issues; it does not certify data accuracy.

name: Spoonie
tagline: Personal cooking journals connected to practical recipes
description: A real early-stage cooking web app where visitors browse recipes, adjust servings and signed-in home cooks save Recipeed cooking notes on meals they actually made. Not an AI tool; not a paid SaaS; no claim of verified active community.

name: Tetherflux
tagline: Social media marketing services and SMS verification in one dashboard
description: Tetherflux is a social media marketing platform for creators, brands, agencies, and resellers. Compare services for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Telegram, and X, place orders using public links, track delivery, and access SMS verification tools from one dashboard.

name: OrderCheck
tagline: Review spreadsheet orders and export approved files for wholesale teams. Time-limited free beta.
description:
OrderCheck is a self-service web app for small wholesale and distribution teams that receive customer orders as spreadsheets. Import XLSX or UTF-8 CSV files, map columns and catalog items, and save layouts for repeat customer files. Review item and quantity changes between order revisions, then export human-approved CSV or XLSX files.

The workflow uses file exports. It does not provide a direct ERP API connection; users need to map the target columns and test a sample file for their destination system.

A time-limited free beta is available: complete email signup and create a company workspace by October 31, 2026 at 23:59 KST. Free beta access ends November 15, 2026 at 23:59 KST. Beta limits are 500 cumulative rows, 5 customers, and 2 members including the administrator. No card is required and there is no automatic billing. Future paid plans are displayed on the website, but paid checkout is not open.

name: JoyStrum
tagline: Free guitar chord references and interactive practice tools
description: JoyStrum is a free browser-based resource for guitar learners. It provides guitar chord references and interactive learning tools to support chord study and practice. Beginners and self-directed learners can use the website alongside their regular guitar practice.

name: PianoGrid
tagline: Free interactive piano chords, scales and music theory tools
description: PianoGrid provides free browser-based piano learning references and interactive music theory tools. Learners can explore piano chords and scales on a visual keyboard and use the website to support study and practice.

name: ButterShare
tagline: Share large files securely, directly between devices
description: ButterShare is a free browser-based peer-to-peer file transfer tool. Send files and folders between devices through encrypted WebRTC connections without creating an account or uploading files to cloud storage. Works across Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone and Android in a browser. Transfer size depends on network and device limits.

name: Know Yourself
tagline: BaZi charts and I Ching readings for self-reflection
description: Know Yourself combines BaZi charts and I Ching readings to help people explore personal patterns and reflect on a specific question. It presents structured readings with explanations and practical next steps. Free charting and entry options are available, with prepaid credits for full reports and no subscription. The service is intended for self-reflection and cultural entertainment.

name: HeyUtils
tagline: Free developer utilities for data, text and debugging
description: HeyUtils groups over 300 free web-based developer tools into focused categories. Format JSON, convert CSV data, test regular expressions, inspect JWTs, generate identifiers and work with timestamps, SQL and networking helpers. Each tool opens without sign-up or installation. Most tools process input in the browser; network-dependent tools explain what is sent.

name: EaseGen
tagline: AI image and video creation in one browser workspace
description: EaseGen helps creators, marketers, and small teams generate images from text, edit with reference images, and create videos from text or images.

name: Prehistoric Farm Codes
tagline: Prehistoric Farm codes checked in-game daily
description: Prehistoric Farm Codes is an independent fan desk for Prehistoric Farm on Roblox. Codes go on the vault only after an editor types them in-game and sees them accepted, with the test date on the row; otherwise it shows zero active codes. Guides cover redeem steps, digs, dinosaurs and incubators; tools include a dig-timing trainer and an earn calculator. Not affiliated with Project Mirvy or Roblox. No ads or trackers.

name: Burning Bridges AI
tagline: Turn one photo into a 15s chandelier-party trend clip.
description: Burning Bridges AI is a freemium AI video image-to-video tool. Upload one photo and get a 15-second chandelier-party trend clip ready for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. Built for creators, influencers and event brands who want scroll-stopping party content without editing skills. Contact Arthur Nunes, Founder. Phone 3158547605. HQ United States.

name: Penguin ePulse
tagline: Connect social content, conversations and audience intelligence
description: Penguin ePulse helps marketing teams and agencies connect content planning with connected-account conversation review and social performance reporting. Its brand and market listening workflows bring audience questions and source-linked research into the same workspace, so teams can turn an observed signal into a content or service decision. Paid, with demo-based pricing and a 14-day free trial that does not require a credit card.

name: VoxelCurve
tagline: Minecraft Circle, Sphere & Dome Blueprint Generator
description: VoxelCurve is a free browser-based Minecraft building tool for generating accurate circles, ovals, spheres and domes. It offers block counts, step-by-step row instructions, progress tracking, and downloadable building plans. Designed for players who want to build precise shapes without manually calculating block layouts.

name: Strovit
tagline: Compare AI tools and build practical workflows for your goals
description: Strovit helps creators, professionals, and businesses explore AI tools by task. Compare alternatives, browse practical use cases, and follow goal-based workflows to choose tools that fit the work you want to do.

name: TalentTree
tagline: Evidence-led hiring powered by AI and human insight.
description: TalentTree combines verified candidate information, structured AI interviews, human interview feedback and hiring-stage coordination in one connected workflow.

name: Cover Letter Lab
tagline: Free English cover-letter generator for global job seekers — paste a role, get a tailored letter.
description: Cover Letter Lab is a free browser tool that writes tailored English cover letters for job seekers. No signup. Optional $9 Pro pack via waitlist.

name: GenMusic
tagline: AI music generator for songs, scores, and background music
description: GenMusic turns prompts and lyrics into original songs, background scores, and instrumental tracks. Prompt-first creation with genre controls for creators, marketers, and product teams.

name: Bulin 47 AI
tagline: One photo → 15s Bulin 47 freestyle rap video.
description: Bulin 47 AI turns one photo into a 15-second freestyle rap performance. Upload a portrait, pet, or character — fixed motion reference, 720p-ready for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. No prompt writing required.

name: VOKO
tagline: The Playable Drama
description: VOKO (VoCall Kosmo) is the  Playable Drama that lets you create your own world, play through stories that call you back, and share every moment as video worth watching.

name: StarTap
tagline: What if Product Hunt and Cookie Clicker had a baby?
description: StarTap is a free startup directory with a clicker game. Makers submit their website and get a public project page. Visitors browse categories, visit product websites, and tap a 3D star to move projects up daily and all-time leaderboards. Earn Stars and unlock automatic sources. Guests can play without an account. Stars are game points with no cash value.

name: Vafer
tagline: Cookie consent for Shopify that actually enforces
description: Most cookie banners ask. Vafer enforces. It's a cookie-consent app for Shopify that treats every consent choice as a switch. Known trackers (Google, Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Microsoft, LinkedIn, Klaviyo, Hotjar, Clarity) are held until the shopper accepts, and so is anything you tag with a one-line convention. If a shopper rejects, Vafer deletes the tracking cookies already on their device. Cart and checkout cookies are never touched. You set rules by geography, such as opt-in for the EU and opt-out with a Do Not Sell link for the US. Vafer also gives you a pre-filled cookie policy and logs every decision for audits, with CSV export. The storefront script is 14 KB and doesn't block page loading. It works with Shopify's Customer Privacy API and Google Consent Mode v2, honours Global Privacy Control, and shows the banner in 9 languages. Vafer is open about its limits: the Diagnostics screen flags the gaps it doesn't cover instead of hiding them.

name: Votelly
tagline: Business VoIP and cloud phone system for modern teams
description:
Votelly is a cloud-based business VoIP phone system designed for businesses, sales teams, and customer support teams.

It helps teams manage business calls, virtual phone numbers, customer conversations, and daily communication from one platform.

Votelly offers features such as cloud PBX, IVR, intelligent call routing, call queues, voicemail, call analytics, and a shared team inbox. It also provides power dialling, AI-powered call summaries, transcription, and CRM integrations to support sales and customer service workflows.

Votelly helps businesses organise their communication, manage incoming and outgoing calls, and collaborate more effectively without relying on traditional phone systems.

name: SaaS Launch Risk Scorer
tagline: Score SaaS launch risk in minutes and get a prioritized fix list.
description: A browser-based launch-readiness utility for SaaS builders. It scores risk across core launch areas and returns a prioritized list of issues to fix before release. One-time access is $3.

name: StemLane
tagline: The official home of the AI stem splitter: upload a song, compare plans for vocals, drums, bass and other stems.
description: StemLane is the official home of the AI stem splitter. Upload a song (MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG or M4A, up to 100 MB), then compare plans for vocals, drums, bass and other stems: Lite at $9.99/month with delivery within 24 hours, Pro at $19.99/month with more stems, priority queue and delivery within 4–12 hours, or annual plans at $90/year and $180/year. Your original song stays on your device.

name: Jynno
tagline: AI creative studio for images, videos, product ads and stories.
description: Jynno is an AI creative studio for creators, marketers and small teams. Generate images from text, edit photos, remove backgrounds or objects, upscale images and explore video generation workflows. Creative Agent workflows help plan product ads and stories on Pro and Studio plans. Jynno uses paid plans and credits; limited welcome credits are available for selected models.

name: ZOOOP
tagline: Create AI images, videos, and audio on one collaborative canvas
description: ZOOOP is an AI creative platform for generating and editing images, videos, and audio. Work on an infinite browser-based canvas or use dedicated tools for background removal, upscaling, lip sync, voice, and music generation. Access multiple AI models, start from ready-to-use templates, and collaborate with your team in real time. New accounts receive starter credits, with pay-as-you-go credit packs for continued use and no required personal subscription.

name: Tattoo Draft Lab
tagline: Draft tattoo lettering, preview placement locally, and export a clean artist reference.
description: Tattoo Draft Lab is a browser-based tattoo lettering and placement tool. It offers five reviewed fonts, local photo placement previews and free transparent PNG exports to prepare references for a professional tattoo artist. Optional high-resolution exports are available through a one-time pass; it is not an AI generator.

name: CS2 Practice
tagline: Run a fast pre-queue CS2 aim check and get a focused warm-up plan.
description: CS2 Practice is a free browser-based training site for Counter-Strike 2 players. It offers a 90-second aim check, Gridshot, Tracking and Flicking drills, warm-up routines, crosshair references and focused weak-point feedback.

name: chordgen
tagline: Chord progression generator with MIDI export
description: chordgen is a chord progression generator and maker for songwriters and producers. Pick a key and a feel to generate a progression, see alternative progressions and all chords in the selected key, play it back and export it as MIDI. The manual generator is free and needs no account. An optional AI Composer is a paid feature that uses Google sign-in and AI credits. Also available in Spanish.

name: Wild Card Game Schedule
tagline: Wild Card schedules & results
description: NFL and MLB wild card schedules, format, times and results. Unofficial fan reference.

name: 3DMeld
tagline: Browser-based QR-to-STL, FDM print cost and SVG-to-DXF tools for makers.
description: 3DMeld provides a QR-to-STL generator, a personal FDM print cost calculator and SVG-to-DXF conversion. Image-to-3D generation is not available; its entry is a waitlist. These tools do not promise physical-print or scanning accuracy.

name: Meu Quinto Dia
tagline: Portuguese fifth-business-day calculator with separate salary and banking modes, daily counting and user-supplied local holidays.
description: Meu Quinto Dia calculates the fifth business day for a selected month in Brazil. It separates salary and bank-service counting, explains each counted day and accepts user-supplied local holidays. The banking count is not a guarantee of payment clearance, Pix settlement or the salary legal deadline. Verify applicable local rules.

name: WiringCalc
tagline: Free browser-based conduit fill calculator showing fill percentage, applicable NEC limit and an over-limit result.
description: WiringCalc estimates conduit fill from the selected conduit and conductor list. It reports fill percentage and the applicable NEC limit. It is a browser-local calculator, not a certification or substitute for qualified engineering advice; verify installation requirements with the relevant authority having jurisdiction.

name: Dagmor
tagline: Turn recorded calls into clear scripts, agent scores and reports
description:
Dagmor turns completed customer call recordings into a Call Log, readable transcripts and reports for the people running the work. Upload calls with their original recording names; a manager can find the call, read what was said, and listen only when needed. Use a script you already have or let Dagmor draft one from the calls, then check how each conversation followed it. A person can review findings and make the final decision.

Agents can see Hero Scores and examples of strong work. Managers can read conduct reports, recording coverage and gaps, campaign results and trends without trawling through every file. When a campaign includes survey answers, Dagmor keeps the customer's actual words beside the ticks and scores, including comments made between questions. That can reveal praise for one part of a service alongside a different problem that still needs fixing.

You can work through the detailed call review in Dagmor, or send completed recordings and take the finished reports. Rickie Doherty built it in Donegal for real contact-centre work.

name: Serpel
tagline: SEO infrastructure for rankings, audits, and AI visibility
description: Serpel is SEO infrastructure for teams that need reliable search visibility. It combines rankings, site audits, keyword research, and AI visibility workflows in one product, with a hosted MCP endpoint for AI assistants and automation.

name: gtm.help
tagline: Paste your website, get a ranked growth plan
description: gtm.help turns your website into a ranked go-to-market plan. Paste your URL and it reads your public pages, then uses your goal, budget and weekly hours to write 30 growth plays to start (more on demand), ranked for your business. Each play explains why it fits and why now, with plain-English steps, the tools you need, the time and cost, and a first draft. Ask Sidekick, the built-in AI consultant, for help on any step. Agents find Reddit, LinkedIn and X conversations where buyers are already talking and draft replies for you to post yourself. They also check whether ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini name you, and find podcasts and newsletters to pitch. Connect Google Analytics, Search Console, Stripe or HubSpot and the plan re-ranks around what works. Made for founders, solo marketers, consultants and small teams. $34/month per business, 7-day free trial.

name: Xenmark
tagline: Collaborative PDF drawing reviews with comments, pins and revision tracking
description:
Xenmark is a browser-based platform for reviewing technical PDF drawings and managing comments across project teams.

Upload engineering drawings, place comment pins directly on the PDF, and discuss issues through threaded conversations. When a revised drawing is uploaded, existing comments can be carried forward, keeping the review history connected across revisions.

Xenmark helps engineers, consultants, contractors, and project owners manage drawing reviews without relying on scattered emails, spreadsheets, or manually marked-up documents.

Teams can export annotated PDFs and structured Excel comment logs for reporting and follow-up.

The free plan provides a fully functional drawing review workflow, while paid plans offer additional project capacity and customization.

name: XenIndex
tagline: Discover software from verified European companies
description: XenIndex is a European software directory featuring products from registered European companies. Companies are checked against official business registers, and every listing is manually reviewed. Discover European software by category or submit your product for free.

name: Tellenze
tagline: Work management for teams of people and AI agents
description: Tellenze is an early-access work management platform for teams of people and AI agents. It brings shared tasks, project context, knowledge and review history together so teams can plan work, connect agents and review contributions in one place. A public demo lets visitors explore the workflow, and a free plan is available.

name: QuietTake Noise Remover
tagline: Free browser noise remover for speech recordings; audio stays on your device.
description: QuietTake removes steady background noise from short speech recordings using RNNoise directly in your browser. Audio stays on your device, with no account or audio upload required. Choose Gentle, Balanced or Strong processing, compare the original and cleaned recording, and download a 48 kHz 16-bit WAV file. Files must be 50 MB or smaller and five minutes or shorter. Useful for voice notes, podcast clips, interview excerpts and spoken tutorials. Input format support depends on your browser.

name: thredly
tagline: Turn long AI chats into structured handovers
description: thredly turns long AI conversations into structured handovers covering the goal, decisions, outputs and next steps, for review and use in a fresh chat. Its Chrome extension supports ChatGPT, Claude and DeepSeek directly. The web app accepts pasted conversation text and creates copyable handovers for other text-based AI chats. Start with one free summary per account, no card required. Paid plans start at USD 3.99/month for 30 credits; one credit covers 50,000 characters, rounded up. Check AI summaries against the source conversation before continuing.

name: PayoutCheck
tagline: Review USDT Ethereum payout CSVs for formatting and duplicate issues
description: Free browser-local checker for USDT Ethereum payout CSVs. Helps payment operations teams spot address, amount, network, duplicate-recipient and structure problems before manual review. Handles up to 1 MiB or 2,000 records. A clean format is not permission to pay or recipient verification; the tool does not send payments. No account or wallet connection. Inputs are processed locally; optional aggregate usage counts require opt-in. Optional donations do not unlock features.

name: CallLens
tagline: Read five fixed EVM calldata layouts with exact integers
description: Free browser-local EVM calldata reader for developers and people inspecting contract calls. It reads five fixed calldata layouts, preserves exact integers and explains approval permissions. Selector matches are candidate interpretations, not verified contract identity or transaction safety. No account or wallet connection required. Inputs are processed locally; optional aggregate usage counts require opt-in. Optional donations do not unlock features.

name: ChainKit
tagline: Check EVM/TRON address syntax and convert token units exactly
description: Free browser-local tools for EVM and TRON address syntax/checksum checks, exact token-unit conversion and equal-share arithmetic. Useful for developers and people reviewing crypto payment details; no account or wallet connection required. Address validity does not verify the owner, balance, asset or network. Tool inputs are processed locally; optional aggregate usage counts require opt-in. Optional donations do not unlock features.

name: FreeFast Calculator
tagline: Free calculators for education, construction, finance and everyday use
description: FreeFast Calculator is a free browser-based calculator collection for students, teachers, homeowners and everyday tasks. It includes algebra and statistics tools, construction material estimators, finance calculations, fitness tools and unit converters. Each calculator accepts user inputs and returns results without requiring registration. Submitted by the website creator.

name: SimilarClip
tagline: Pick a niche, connect a fresh YouTube channel, set a schedule
description: SimilarClip is an AI video engine for YouTube channels that run themselves. Pick a niche and connect a YouTube channel, and it researches the topic, writes the script, breaks it into scenes and generates fresh visuals and narration for each one. You choose from 11 visual styles and 35 natural voices, set a publishing cadence, and new episodes go out automatically - no camera, no editing and no source footage needed. Every script is written fresh and every visual and voiceover is generated new. SimilarClip also provides an MCP server and a REST API, so agents can generate and publish videos with an API key. It is a paid subscription (from $39/month) with monthly AI credits; extra credit packs never expire.

name: Swarn Siddhi
tagline: Free Kundli, Panchang and numerology tools explained in plain language.
description: Swarn Siddhi offers free Vedic astrology tools for creating a Kundli, checking Panchang for a city, comparing Kundli compatibility and exploring numerology. The website also provides a free AI astrologer, daily horoscopes and guides explaining chart terms. A web app and Android app are available. Astrology is presented for reflection and guidance.

name: LottoSim
tagline: Check your numbers against past Polish lottery draws
description: LottoSim is a free Polish-language web app for checking selected numbers against historical Lotto, Lotto Plus and Eurojackpot draws. It includes random number generation, simulation comparisons, history, number-set records and shareable result reports. Editable ticket prices and prize amounts are simulation assumptions: calculated payouts are modeled, not actual historical payouts. LottoSim does not predict future draws, accept bets or collect deposits.

name: MinuteKit
tagline: Free workshop agendas, activity timers and PDF handouts. No account required.
description: MinuteKit is a free browser toolkit for facilitators, teachers and small teams. Start with a 30-minute retrospective, 60-minute project brief or 90-minute skills-practice template, edit the timed agenda, open an activity countdown and export an agenda PDF. It also offers a focus timer, PDF handout builder and free facilitator scripts with editable handouts. No account is required. Agenda and document text stay in the browser; keep a copy before closing. There is no shared live session or cloud sync. Submitted on behalf of the project owner.

name: Agentic Map
tagline: The easiest way to understand AI
description: A simple way to keep up with AI. Connect the dots through 30 free lessons, quick quizzes, and practice that ties what you learn to how you use AI. Explore a learning map, glossary, and review activities. Go from “I’ve heard of it” to “I get it.”

name: WorkCalcLab
tagline: Free calculators for work hours, time cards, shifts, and pay.
description:
WorkCalcLab is a collection of browser-based calculators for everyday work calculations.

Calculate work hours, time cards, timesheets, split and overnight shifts, break time, decimal hours, overtime pay, salary conversions, pay raises, and commissions.

Each calculator focuses on a specific calculation and works directly in the browser without requiring an account.

name: NOVA
tagline: Cyber-themed event platform for creators and community hosts
description: NOVA is a cyber-themed event platform for creators and community hosts. Build rooms, invite participants, and run immersive online blind-box experiences with a cyberpunk aesthetic.

name: SysGeeks
tagline: Free system design interview practice on real systems
description: Practice system design interviews by working through real systems, making architecture decisions, and testing designs against failures and changed requirements. Includes interactive investigations, written walkthroughs, and AI-assisted practice.

name: DupaCUI
tagline: Free Romanian company lookup, no signup
description: Search any Romanian company by CUI, name or locality and see its 2020-2025 financial results, public procurement contracts and related companies. Covers over 4 million firms and 7 million tender records, completely free.

name: Cliqroom
tagline: Watch together without the "3, 2, 1, play" countdown
description: Watching videos with friends remotely can turn into countdowns and checking timestamps. I built Cliqroom to make that part easier. Create a room, add a supported video or track, and share the room link. Shared playback controls, a shared queue and text chat are free. Friends do not need a Cliqroom account, app download or browser extension. It supports YouTube, Twitch, Vimeo, Dailymotion and SoundCloud.

name: Room Design AI
tagline: Redesign your rooms from a photo with AI.
description:
Room Design AI helps homeowners explore interior design ideas using their own room photos or a text description. Create visual concepts for kitchens, living rooms, bedrooms and bathrooms, choose from 16 design styles, and try different colors, materials and finishes.

The dedicated kitchen design tool includes options for cabinets, countertops, backsplashes and flooring. Users can request preservation of the existing layout, compare generated designs with the original photo, revisit design history and download their favorite images.

New accounts receive 4 trial credits. Paid credit packs and subscriptions are available for further exploration.

name: Make Halftone
tagline: Turn images into print-ready halftone dot patterns
description: Make Halftone is a free halftone generator for screen printers, DTF printers and designers. Add an image, choose a dot, line or ring pattern, adjust the settings and export a print-ready PNG or SVG. Processing happens in your browser, so images are not uploaded. The site also includes a gang sheet builder, a DTF printing cost calculator and simple image utilities.

name: Color Guessing Game
tagline: Remember five colors, then rebuild them on a hue wheel
description: Color Guessing Game is a free browser game that tests your color memory. You watch five colors, then rebuild each one on a hue wheel and get a score for how close you were. There is a daily challenge and a practice mode, and you can share spoiler-free challenges with friends. It runs in the browser with no install. Related modes include a color matching game and a color memory game.

name: wingdingconverter
tagline: short
description: Free online Wingdings converter and decoder with Wingdings 1, 2, and 3 support, copyable alphabet and symbol charts, and manual image matching. No signup required; text conversion runs in your browser.

name: Vokolla
tagline: AI-assisted press release writing, self-service distribution and coverage tracking
description: Vokolla is an all-in-one press release preparation and distribution platform for businesses and brands. Draft, review and refine your news with AI assistance, choose a distribution package, approve your content and pay online, then follow automated submission, progress tracking and coverage reporting in one workspace. Selected packages include AP News, USA Today, Yahoo and Business Insider. Upfront pricing starts at US$69 per release, with no subscription required. English and Simplified Chinese workflows are available.

name: Cashflow Calendar Online
tagline: Forecast daily balances with a cashflow calendar
description: Cashflow Calendar Online helps plan dated income, bills and recurring expenses and review projected daily balances. Enter transactions manually or import supported CSV files, including WeChat and Alipay exports. No bank connection is required. A free Starter plan offers a six-month horizon; optional Pro adds longer forecasts and AI assistance. Planning estimates are not financial advice.

name: StageMate
tagline: Sheet music reader with gesture page turns
description: StageMate helps musicians read and annotate PDF or image scores and organize setlists for practice and performance. Blink or head gestures turn pages on compatible hardware. Available for iPhone and iPad; Android currently has a Google Play testing entry. Core reading is free with optional Pro features.

name: TickerBloom
tagline: Real-time company news monitor and story desk for investors
description: TickerBloom by AlphAI is a real-time company news monitor for investors, analysts and professionals. It tracks recent coverage across public companies, adds story context with summaries, and links every item to the original publisher so claims can be checked at source. Free to browse, no signup.

name: Soft Summer Studio
tagline: Explore muted color references and plan small outfit combinations.
description: A browser palette and outfit planning reference with 30 original muted colors, HEX/RGB copying, top/bottom/accent combinations and downloadable PNG/PDF palettes. The palette and local outfit preview are free. Screen references are approximate and do not diagnose a personal color season.

name: TrioNine
tagline: Nine words, three groups: free category puzzles with explanations.
description: TrioNine is a free English browser word game: sort nine words into three groups of three. It offers hints, category explanations, and easy, medium, and hard practice. No account or download is needed. The shared daily puzzle resets at midnight UTC using a finite 38-board repeating collection. Practice allows replay of that collection. Results can be shared as text or a colored word-group poster with a QR link. Independently published by MORROWCAT LABS, with no affiliation to The New York Times.

name: Free Pet Sitter Business Tools
tagline: Free calculators and spreadsheet tools for pet care businesses
description: A collection of free, privacy-conscious calculators, checklists, and downloadable spreadsheet starters for solo pet sitters, dog walkers, groomers, and small pet care businesses. Use capacity, pricing, invoicing, bookkeeping, and mileage tools without creating an account.

name: Lovamigos
tagline: A birthday gift made from everyone’s memories
description: Collect videos, voice notes, photos and written messages from up to 25 friends and family members in one birthday gift. The organizer pays $49 once, shares a contribution link, reviews messages and releases the gift when ready. Contributors need no account. Gifts include one year online from first release and an offline keepsake download.

name: Startflow
tagline: A business idea is easy. What is your next move?
description: Startflow is a French-language business copilot that helps you choose between referrals, building websites and launching a SaaS. Answer seven questions about your goals, time, skills and budget, then preview a personalized path before signing up. Paid access provides a roadmap, daily missions and AI guidance to help you take concrete steps. Explore your first actions before choosing an access plan.

name: WPMission
tagline: Manage all your WordPress sites from one calm dashboard
description:
WPMission is a WordPress maintenance dashboard for agencies and freelancers. Connect your sites with a lightweight connector plugin and manage updates, backups, monitoring, security and client reporting for all of them from one place, without logging into each wp-admin.

- Bulk updates for plugins, themes and WordPress core, with a restore point saved before every update and rollback to earlier versions
- Scheduled, verified backups to managed off-site storage, with one-click restore
- Uptime, domain and SSL monitoring with alerts by email, Slack and webhooks
- Security scans, vulnerability alerts and hardening across every site
- PHP error logs, performance checks and visual checks after updates
- White-label client reports, a client portal and one-click wp-admin login
- Cache clearing, WordPress settings and code snippets across many sites at once
- A REST API with workspace tokens, plus an MCP server so AI assistants can manage a workspace with the same permissions as the API token they use

Sites pair with signed Ed25519 keys. WordPress passwords are never asked for or stored.

Pricing: free to connect unlimited sites. Every new team gets 14 days of premium management on every site, no card required. Paid plans: 10 sites $5/mo, 20 sites $9/mo, 50 sites $20/mo, 100 sites $35/mo, unlimited $100/mo. Yearly billing includes two months free.
tags: backups and client reports for WordPress sites

name: Asphalt Calculator
tagline: Estimate asphalt quantity and driveway cost with visible assumptions.
description: Free browser calculators for asphalt material quantity, tonnage, weight and driveway cost allowances. Uses US or metric units and visible area, depth, density and waste assumptions without signup. Estimates support planning and are not contractor quotes; verify mix and quantities with local suppliers.

name: Pallet Calculator
tagline: Plan pallet layers, stack height, load weight and container capacity.
description: Free browser-based pallet planning tools for cases per layer, TI-HI, stack height, total load weight and container capacity. Supports metric and imperial units with visible assumptions and shareable inputs, without signup. Results are planning estimates; verify equipment limits, stability and loading requirements with the carrier or supplier.

name: CoverUpInk
tagline: AI tattoo cover-up concepts from your existing tattoo photo
description: Upload a photo of your existing tattoo to generate three AI cover-up design concepts and white-background linework to discuss with a tattoo artist. CoverUpInk offers one free preview, with one-time paid credits starting at $19 and no subscription.

name: Calc
tagline: Practical online calculators with transparent formulas
description: Calc is a collection of online calculators for everyday and professional tasks. You can explore tools for energy and backup power, personal finance, business margins, home projects, time calculations and more. The goal is to make calculations easier to understand: inputs, assumptions and, where applicable, methods and references are shown alongside the results.

name: SceneGenerator
tagline: AI product photography and campaign visuals from a creative brief
description: SceneGenerator helps ecommerce sellers and marketers create product photos, backgrounds, posters and banners. Start with a product image or written brief, select a scene, composition and format, and refine the visual direction with editable prompts.

name: AI Prompt Free
tagline: Turn ideas and reference images into editable AI prompts
description: AI Prompt Free creates text prompts for writing, image and video workflows, and describes reference images. Edit, copy and export results without signing up. It outputs text rather than rendered images or videos. Free to use; usage limits depend on the model route and provider.

name: LinkCensus
tagline: Find related websites and inspect their shared-link evidence.
description: LinkCensus finds related websites using dated Common Crawl web graph editions. Enter a domain to see five neighboring sites without signing up, then inspect named shared linkers and the edition behind each result. A paid seat unlocks up to 100 rows, filters, and CSV or JSON exports. Shared-link counts cover the top 200 retained linkers. Graph neighbors are research leads, not confirmed competitors or direct backlinks.

name: My Season Hue
tagline: Explore your personal colors with a free quiz and virtual draping
description: My Season Hue helps people explore colors for clothing and makeup using a 12-season system. Its free eight-question quiz returns two candidate seasons with 12 starter colors for each. Public palette guides cover all 12 seasons. Browser-local virtual draping lets users compare colors around the same portrait without sending that portrait to a server. Optional Qwen photo analysis requires Google sign-in and explicit consent to process prepared photos through Alibaba Cloud in Beijing, China; the limit is three completed analyses per account per UTC day. A separate $29.99 USD one-time complete report adds 24 colors in four useful groups, outfit formulas, makeup directions, shopping references, and a downloadable PDF. Results are educational starting points for self-guided comparison, not a guarantee of accuracy. This is a maker-submitted listing.

name: ToolboxKart
tagline: Free online tools, AI news, guides, and software alternatives
description: ToolboxKart publishes sourced AI and technology news, practical software-alternative guides, and 223 free browser-based tools for SEO, marketing, finance, developers, productivity, and many other professional niches.

name: Lawn Mowing Cost Calculator
tagline: Free lawn mowing cost calculator: estimate a low-high price range from lawn area, mowing frequency and rates you can edit. Every assumption is shown.
description: Lawn Mowing Cost Calculator gives homeowners and lawn care operators a planning estimate for mowing. Enter the lawn area and how often it is mowed, and it builds a low-to-high price range from rates you can edit. Every assumption is visible, and a methodology page explains how the estimate is built. Results are planning estimates, not binding quotes. No account is needed and lawn data is not stored.

name: ABN Invoice
tagline: Australian invoicing with ABN, GST or no-GST, and PDF or image export
description: ABN Invoice is an online invoice maker for people billing customers in Australia. Enter supplier and customer details, an ABN, invoice dates, work or items, GST or no-GST treatment, totals and payment instructions. Review the live customer preview, then export an invoice as a PDF or phone-friendly image. You can create and export your first document without signing up. Free sign-in adds cloud history and reusable records across phone and computer. The workflow supports English and Chinese-speaking users, including sole traders, freelancers and service businesses with repeat client work. Paid VIP features are intended for recurring administration, including watermark-free customer copies, bulk history export, archive packs and CSV handoff. ABN Invoice is independent and is not an official ATO product.

name: oldphotosai
tagline: Restore old photos, colorize black-and-white pictures, and improve photo clarity.
description: oldphotosai helps restore old photos, colorize black-and-white pictures, and improve photo clarity in your browser. Upload and preview the original without an account, then sign in with a verified email before processing. A limited Daily Free allowance covers standard restoration; colorization and enhancement use credits. Compare the result with the original before downloading. Gallery examples are labeled AI-created illustrations, not verified customer results.

name: ToolDwell
tagline: Discover software tools and submit your own product.
description: ToolDwell is a software directory for developers, creators and product founders. Browse tools by category, platform and pricing, read introductions and usage limits, then visit the provider’s official website. Founders can submit a product through Google sign-in. Free submissions require a directory badge and become eligible for review after at least seven days. Optional Pro ($19) and Featured ($99) placement are one-time fees per tool, without traffic or ranking guarantees.

name: Cross Stitch Pattern
tagline: Turn photos into editable cross stitch charts
description: A browser tool for stitchers making patterns from their own photos. Crop photos, choose approximate DMC colours, edit stitches, clean isolated stitches and protect intentional details. Original photos are processed locally. Preview, editing and PNG are free; a complete printable PDF costs $4.99 per saved pattern, with no subscription. Checkout saves the chart and receipt email for delivery. Later changes require another PDF purchase. No background removal or PDF/OXS import.

name: Seedloom
tagline: Free game art, sounds and engine-ready files from procedural generators. No AI, no sign-up.
description:
Seedloom is a free, browser-based toolbox of procedural generators for game developers without an artist: solo devs, students and game jam teams. It creates matching game art, sounds and engine-ready files in minutes, with no sign-up needed.
