Everything is generated by code, not AI: results come from a seed, so the same settings always give the same result, and no training data or scraped art is used. One color palette can drive every tool, so sprites, tiles, UI and backgrounds fit together.

Tools include a color palette generator, pixel art sprite and character generators (rigged characters with walk, run, attack and death animations in side, isometric and top-down views), a seamless tile and texture generator with normal maps, terrain autotiles (47-tile blob sets with a ready Godot 4 TileSet), parallax backgrounds, game UI kits, retro sound effects (WAV), effect animations (GIF), low-poly 3D models (.glb), noise textures, an image-to-pixel-art converter, a pixel art editor, a spritesheet animator and a GLSL shader editor.

Exports are ready for game engines: spritesheets with JSON, Godot SpriteFrames and TileSets, .glb, 9-slice UI and palette files for Aseprite and GIMP. A free account adds a personal library and a public gallery. What you make is yours, including for commercial games, with no credit required. Seedloom is currently in alpha.

name: Rehearsal Scene Pair Checker
tagline: Check cast overlap and absences before running two rehearsals.
description: A free browser tool for theatre directors and stage managers. Compare the cast lists for two scenes, add today's absences and see whether the scenes can rehearse in parallel. No account required. Cast entries stay in the browser and are not stored. Aggregate usage counters contain no cast data. The free checker is usable independently; an optional EUR 9 offline download supports multiple scenes, CSV import/export, JSON backups and print. This is a cast availability check, not a full rehearsal calendar or script parser.

name: AISFX
tagline: Free AI sound effects generator: type a description, get pro SFX in seconds
description: AISFX is a free AI sound effects generator: type a text description and get professional-grade sound effects in seconds. Lossless WAV downloads, royalty-free. The free tier includes 10 sound effects with no signup required. Built for game developers, filmmakers, podcasters, video creators and music producers.

name: Fancy Font Maker
tagline: Free stylish text generator for Instagram, Discord, TikTok, gaming names and symbols
description: Fancy Font Maker is a free online tool that converts plain text into stylish, fancy fonts for Instagram bios and captions, Discord nicknames and messages, TikTok usernames, gaming names like Free Fire and PUBG, WhatsApp statuses and more. It also offers cool symbols, decorative text and emoji decorations that can be copied and pasted anywhere. No sign-up is required: type your text, pick a style and copy it instantly. Ideal for creators, gamers and social media users who want their text to stand out.

name: SpriteFuse
tagline: Turn character images into game-ready 2D animations
description: SpriteFuse helps indie 2D game developers generate character animations from written actions and optional character references. Preview motion, inspect frames and refine animations in plain language. Export transparent PNG frames, sprite sheets, GIF previews and animation metadata for game workflows. Free trial credits are available, with paid credits for further generation.

name: CoordMap
tagline: Find GPS coordinates, elevation, weather
description: CoordMap is a browser-based collection of map and time tools. Find latitude and longitude, convert coordinate formats, measure distances, check elevation, and explore sunrise, sunset, and moon information. World clocks and time zone details help users compare local times. Built for developers, travelers, researchers, and anyone working with locations.

name: Browser Game Online
tagline: Discover classic games playable in a browser
description: A game-discovery directory for classic PC and console games playable in web browsers. Browse by genre, view individual game profiles, and follow links to third-party hosts. Visitors can suggest additional game links for review. The directory does not host the games; availability and any game-file requirements depend on the external host.

name: Finland Electricity Price Tracker
tagline: Free electricity spot price tracker for Finland.
description: Check 15-minute electricity prices, compare today's and tomorrow's rates, find the cheapest hours, and estimate energy costs.

name: Outlist
tagline: Turn property listing photos into Reels
description: Outlist is an AI photo-to-video tool for real estate listing marketing. Agents, property photographers and media teams can use their listing photos to prepare a vertical Reel, a caption and a branded share page. The workflow offers listing campaign goals and visual styles. This submission is from the Outlist team.

name: FaceCompass
tagline: The official home of the face shape detector
description: FaceCompass is the official home of the face shape detector. Upload a front-facing selfie, explore a sample report with an example face outline, reference ratios and hairstyle ideas, then compare the Full report ($17.49) and the Mini report ($7.49). A guide to the 7 common face shapes is included. Your selfie stays on your device.

name: WorkroomCalc
tagline: Roman blind fabric & lining calculator (UK)
description: WorkroomCalc is a free planning calculator for making roman blinds, built for UK sewists and soft-furnishing workrooms. Enter the window size in mm, cm or inches and it works out fabric, lining, rods and cords, with fold layouts and a printable planning sheet. Free, no account.

name: Stitchgrid – Image to Crochet Pattern
tagline: Turn a photo into a printable crochet color chart
description: Stitchgrid (imagetocrochetpattern.com) converts a photo into a crochet pattern chart. Choose how many stitches go across (16 to 120) and how many yarn colours to use (2 to 12), and you get a lettered colour grid you can edit and print. Charting runs locally in the browser. Free.

name: JSONViewerTool
tagline: Free JSON viewer, comparison, escape and unescape tools
description: JSONViewerTool provides free browser tools for viewing, formatting and comparing JSON, escaping and unescaping JSON strings, and converting data formats. Developers and testers can inspect API responses and compare payload changes. Companion guides explain JSON workflows and limitations. Submitted by the JSONViewerTool team.

name: Cloady
tagline: Deploy apps and databases with predictable cloud pricing
description: Cloady is a cloud application platform for developers, indie makers, and small teams. Deploy from a GitHub repository, Docker image, uploaded folder, or ready-made template. Run applications and databases together, with custom domains, automatic HTTPS, logs, a browser terminal, file access, and database tools. Pricing is based on the CPU, RAM, and SSD capacity you choose, with a free tier and no per-request or bandwidth charges. Cloady is currently in public beta.

name: MindVault
tagline: Continuous Identity Confidence for post-login sessions (in development)
description: MindVault is an alpha-stage cybersecurity company developing Continuous Identity Confidence: a content-blind approach to assessing whether the authorized operator remains in control after login. The proposed session assurance layer is designed to complement IAM, EDR, and SOC workflows. MindVault is inviting enterprise design partners to evaluate the approach.

name: Label Loom
tagline: Make printable barcode sheets in your browser; input stays on your device.
description: Generate batches of Code 128 labels for internal SKUs and shelf/bin IDs, EAN-13 or UPC-A only for already assigned GTINs, and QR codes from short text or URLs. Add optional captions, print or save a sheet as PDF, or download individual SVGs. Processing stays in your browser; there is no file upload. Free to use. Do not invent GS1 identifiers.

name: AgenticSaaS
tagline: The SaaS foundation for one founder and coding agents
description: AgenticSaaS gives solo founders and coding agents a working SaaS foundation: accounts, billing, credits, private uploads and administration, with clear documentation for setup, testing, deployment and extending the codebase. Build the feature that makes your product different. Paid commercial source code built with SvelteKit and Cloudflare. Save $100 with code LAUNCH100, for the first 100 paid launch licenses.

name: BandSight
tagline: Receive-only SDR surveys with local radio records
description: BandSight helps radio users and authorized site assessors view signals with a compatible RTL-SDR receiver. The browser app combines live spectrum and waterfall views, supported WFM/NFM/AM listening, named survey sessions, baseline comparison and local report export. The separate Android app adds band scans, saved stations and field tools. A phone alone cannot receive the spectrum: live radio use requires supported receiver hardware, an antenna and a compatible USB connection. The Android app is free on Google Play, with optional support; hardware and separately scoped services are extra. Product details and limitations: https://autosecurelogin.com/products/bandsight.html

name: TimingPal
tagline: Simple free online timers for focus, fitness and everyday routines
description: TimingPal provides free browser-based tools including a Pomodoro Timer, Countdown Timer, Stopwatch, Alarm Clock, Workout Interval Timer and Time Now utility.

name: Keyameleon
tagline: Per-keyboard input source switcher for Mac
description:
Keyameleon is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app that gives each physical keyboard its own input source. Plug in your external Italian, German or UK keyboard and it types in that layout, while your MacBook's built-in keyboard stays on US, with no manual switching. It watches which keyboard each keystroke comes from and switches the input source automatically, then verifies the switch. It never modifies or injects keystrokes. Signed and notarized, updates via Sparkle, installable as a DMG or via Homebrew. MIT licensed. Requires macOS 26.

New in 0.10: per-app input source assignments. Pick an input source for specific apps in the new App settings pane, and see the active app rules as pills in the menu bar.

name: Speak2MyCV
tagline: Your CV answers client questions and qualifies leads, 24/7
description: Speak2MyCV helps consultants and independent professionals turn their CV, portfolio and case studies into an AI persona visitors can question 24/7. Answers are grounded in uploaded documents, cite their sources, and acknowledge when the material does not cover a question. The public page captures contacts and reveals what prospects ask. Paid plans add lead qualification, a portfolio website and custom domain. Pro adds hot-lead alerts, AI-drafted replies, CRM webhooks and Speak2MyMCP connections to AI assistants. Start with the free plan.

name: OhGiftPlease
tagline: Find gifts that feel like them, by interests and budget.
description: Know your person. Stuck on their gift? OhGiftPlease pairs a no-signup Gift Finder with curated gift collections to help you find something that feels like them. Explore picks by interests and budget, plus ideas for game nights, self-care and wonderfully specific personalities. Collections also highlight small businesses and underrepresented founders. The Gift Finder is free to use; products cost extra, and OhGiftPlease may earn commissions through affiliate shopping links.

name: Daily Orbs Wiki
tagline: Spoiler-light hints and answer walkthroughs for the Daily Orbs game
description: Daily Orbs Wiki is a free fan-made guide for the Daily Orbs browser game. It publishes spoiler-light hints before the full answers, dated walkthroughs for the trivia, words, geography, and science questions, and playbooks for orb scoring, daily resets, and solving habits, all checked against the live game.

name: Size It Up Wiki
tagline: Daily answers, hints and scoring notes for the Size It Up browser game
description: Size It Up Wiki is a free fan-made guide for the daily Size It Up browser game. It publishes verified daily answers, spoiler-light hints, scoring explanations, and variant notes for Pop Culture and Geography rounds, so players can learn how each round works instead of only memorizing one answer.

name: PilotMyX
tagline: Know what works on X/Twitter. Write better posts faster.
description: Growing on X/Twitter gets messy when analytics, drafting, and publishing live in separate tools. PilotMyX brings them together. See which posts, replies, topics, and timing actually move your account forward. Turn that context into drafts that sound like you—not generic AI filler—then schedule original posts from one place. If you use an MCP-compatible agent, it can work from the same account history and performance data.

name: RepoTunnel
tagline: Connect ChatGPT Web to your local development workspace
description: RepoTunnel connects ChatGPT Web to approved local repos, files, terminals and developer tools, so you can inspect code, make changes, run commands and work with your real local development environment without constantly copying files into chat.

name: SymbolicCool
tagline: Copy and paste cool symbols for your bio, gaming name, and text everywhere
description: SymbolicCool is a free copy-paste tool for cool text symbols. Browse thousands of Unicode and aesthetic symbols and paste them anywhere: Instagram bios, Discord usernames, gaming nicknames, and fancy text messages. Everything works right in your browser with no sign-up.

name: AlphaPNG
tagline: Browser-based PNG tools for everyday image work.
description: AlphaPNG provides browser-based tools to resize, compress, convert, crop, and edit PNG images. Image processing stays on the device. Individual tools are free, with optional Pro features for advanced compression and repeatable batch workflows.

name: Hotel Lobby AI
tagline: Turn two portrait photos into an AI duet video
description: Hotel Lobby AI turns two portraits of consenting adults into short orange-booth AI duet videos. Choose 4, 10 or 15 seconds with original AI-generated audio, keep results in a private library, and download MP4 files. Generation requires sign-in and paid credits. This independent tool is not affiliated with original performers.

name: SmartDevoir AI
tagline: AI-powered guided learning, homework support and revision
description: SmartDevoir AI is a paid educational web platform by SOS Scolaire Numérique for guided homework support, revision, study organisation and learner progress. It provides step-by-step explanations and questions, quizzes, revision materials and planning tools designed to help learners understand and practise rather than simply copy an answer.

name: MapFlowPro
tagline: Search places. Build the journey. Export the map film.
description: MapFlowPro is a browser studio for cinematic travel map videos. Search places, build multi-stop routes on real roads, and export animated map films with camera motion, story cards, and themes.

name: WorkToolMap
tagline: Find practical software and online tools by everyday task
description: WorkToolMap is an independent directory of software and online tools organized around everyday work. Browse task-based categories for PDFs, spreadsheets, design, audio and video, writing, websites, research and collaboration. Concise profiles link to official websites and explain what has been checked. Public-source research is distinguished from hands-on testing. Tool suggestions are free and editorially reviewed.

name: StencilMaker.app
tagline: Turn photos into printable stencils, with layers and bridges.
description:
StencilMaker.app turns an uploaded photo into a stencil in the browser. Choose a bold, detailed or multi-layer style, adjust the result, and review disconnected pieces before exporting. Bridge controls help connect islands that would otherwise fall out of a cut stencil.

The site also offers an English printable pattern library, including Halloween pumpkins, spider webs, bats, ghosts, witches and other seasonal designs. Library PNGs and A4 or US Letter PDFs can be downloaded without an account. Each template has its own preview, printing information and source credits.

The editor is free to try. A free account is required to save projects and download edited PNG/PDF files. Pro adds edited SVG/DXF and tiled printing options for larger work. Pro costs $10 per month, $90 per year or $99 for Lifetime access.

The tool is intended for crafters, designers and makers preparing stencil artwork. Users must own or have permission to use uploaded artwork; the service does not grant rights to third-party characters or trademarks. Physical cutting results depend on the material and equipment used.

Submitted by StencilMaker.app.

name: CodexTheme Tools
tagline: Build a Codex Desktop theme from any image
description: CodexTheme Tools is a free, unofficial theme builder for the Codex Desktop app. Pick any image and the builder derives a color theme in your browser, without uploading the image. You can preview the theme across five workspace views, check text readability before exporting, and download data-only theme files. There is no sign-up. The site also has a library of ready-made themes and troubleshooting answers for when a theme does not apply as expected.

name: SkyCOTL Tools
tagline: Sky: Children of the Light clock, shards & candles
description: SkyCOTL Tools is an unofficial, fan-made toolkit for Sky: Children of the Light players. The Sky Clock shows Grandma, Geyser, Turtle and daily reset times in your local timezone, the Shards page shows today's shard type, realm, location and windows, and the candle calculator plans regular, season and ascended candle goals. It also has an item catalog, a spirit rotation search and a music practice tool. No account needed, works offline as an installable web app, available in 6 languages.

name: Caption Remover
tagline: Clean hardcoded captions from short videos, then review and download.
description: Caption Remover is a focused web tool for cleaning burned-in captions from video you own or are authorized to edit. Choose Basic for automatic caption removal or Pro for one fixed selected area. Upload a supported MP4/MOV up to 50 MB and 60 seconds, review the before/after result, and download a 720p-equivalent MP4. Sign-in is required; the first three successful videos are free across both modes, with paid minute plans afterwards. Cloud processing is queued rather than real-time, and reconstructed areas can contain artifacts. Private uploads and results expire within 24 hours.

name: Revenue Scout
tagline: Find relevant buying conversations and prepare replies you control.
description: Revenue Scout helps businesses find public social media conversations where people describe problems, request recommendations or compare products and services. It checks whether the stated need fits your offer and presents relevant conversations with context explaining the match. You can generate a reply, edit it and post manually from your own account. Supported platforms include Reddit, LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, with coverage depending on your plan. The free plan includes weekly Reddit discovery for one brand, ten saved search phrases and three prepared replies per week. No credit card or social account connection is required to start.

name: TIFF to PDF
tagline: Convert TIFF scans to PDF in your browser without uploading files.
description: Free local TIFF/TIF to PDF conversion for scanned documents. Supports multi-page scans, file merging, page sizes, rotation and PNG or JPEG encoding. Files remain on your device; no account is needed. Browser batches are limited to 30 MB and 30 pages. Output is image-based PDF; OCR is not included.

name: Image Color Remover
tagline: Remove colors from images online for free.
description: Remove colors from images online in your browser with a free image color remover tool.

name: Claude Haiku 5.5 Pricing Calculator
tagline: Estimate Claude Haiku token costs instantly.
description: Free Claude Haiku 5.5 pricing calculator for token and API cost estimates.

name: StyxReconcile
tagline: Compare two CSV files in your browser. Match rows by key, find mismatches, missing records and duplicates, then export the results. Private By Design.
description:
StyxReconcile is a local-first CSV reconciliation tool that compares two CSV files directly in your browser. Match rows by key, find missing records, mismatched values, and duplicate keys, then export your results. Your CSV data stays in your browser instead of being uploaded to our service. Built for anyone who needs to compare data without manually checking spreadsheets.

Try it: https://styxreconcile.in

name: Online Lists Maker
tagline: Create beautiful lists. Share instantly. No signup required.
description: Online Lists Maker is a free, no-signup list maker that runs entirely in your browser. Create checklists, grocery lists, packing lists, to-dos, and planners in seconds, then share them instantly with a link. Collaborators edit in real time with no account needed, and every list auto-expires after 24 hours, so your data never sits on a server. Ships with 100 ready-made list templates for shopping, travel, moving, weddings, events, and study planning. A privacy-friendly alternative to Google Keep, Todoist, and AnyList for quick everyday lists.

name: AllPartyGames.com
tagline: Free browser games and embeddable party tools
description: AllPartyGames.com offers free browser party games, trivia, icebreakers, word games and classic games alongside practical group tools. These include Spin the Wheel, Wheel of Names, Coin Flip, Dice Roller, timers, scoreboards and team generators. Supported games offer same-device play, computer opponents or private online rooms. No account or download is required to play. Game pages include an Embed option for adding games and tools to other websites. Browse the full collection at https://allpartygames.com/games/ and embedding instructions at https://allpartygames.com/embed-games/.

name: Typometer
tagline: Free typing lessons, speed tests and typing games
description: Typometer is a browser-based typing practice platform for students and adult learners. It combines structured touch-typing lessons, timed tests that measure words per minute and accuracy, focused keyboard practice, and typing games. Core lessons, tests and games work without signing up. Learners can choose a short speed test, practise difficult keys, or use games such as Type Racer and Type Fishing to build a regular practice habit.

name: nopaywall
tagline: Free catalog of AI free tiers, API rate limits, and paid-tool alternatives
description: nopaywall is a free catalog of 100+ free AI API providers, generation limits (image/video/music), student offers, and alternatives to paid AI tools. Each card shows the rounded limit and last check date (rechecked ~72h). Available in English, Chinese, Russian.

name: X Article Markdown Paste
tagline: Markdown to X Articles in one paste
description: Chrome extension to paste Markdown into X Articles. Converts Obsidian, Notion and .md drafts to X Articles with images, tables, code blocks and tweet embeds. Install: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/x-article-markdown-paste/jpgelgkhcegcoblmekgacjmagkanpenn

name: X Viral Monitor
tagline: See X views per hour and find viral tweets early
description: Free Chrome extension that shows X (Twitter) views per hour on every tweet. Spot viral tweets while they take off, rank the posts on your timeline, and join the conversation earlier. Install from the Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/x-viral-monitor/dkplofpecmjmbhgjgleeflcnfgfkdfpd

name: Extractune
tagline: Free online tools to extract audio, remove background music, and isolate vocals.
description: Extractune is a free online audio toolkit that helps you extract audio from videos, remove background music while keeping speech, separate vocals from instrumentals, and create karaoke tracks. Everything is accessible through your browser, with no desktop software installation required.

name: AccuNote
tagline: Personal voice notes with transcription and timestamped summaries that take you back to the original audio.
description:
AccuNote is a personal voice note app for iOS and Android. Record talks, explanations, and conversations, then revisit them through transcripts and summaries. Timestamped summary points help you find the corresponding transcript and original audio, so you can check what was actually said.

Use it to review an adult learning session, remember details from an information session, or revisit a conversation while out and about. Bilingual recognition and translation help you understand and review content across languages. AccuNote keeps the focus on your own recordings and the details you want to come back to.

name: Hindi Font Tools
tagline: Free Hindi font and typing tools
description: Free online Hindi font and typing tools for Unicode, Kruti Dev 010, 4C Gandhi and Chanakya conversion, plus text cleaning and Hindi typing guides.

name: WeekCue
tagline: Family calendars, reminders and daily briefs for a calmer week
description: WeekCue helps parents, caregivers and household organizers coordinate the week. Turn a written or spoken message into proposed calendar events, reminders and to-dos, review the details, and receive a short daily brief. The Household plan supports up to six people with shared and private plans and pickup coordination. Available on the web and iPhone with optional WhatsApp. Solo is free; paid plans add proactive help and household planning.

name: AskMyCareer
tagline: Keep career evidence, applications and interview preparation connected
description: AskMyCareer helps job seekers organize career evidence and reuse it across resumes and interview preparation. A free account includes one Career Graph, a manual story bank and basic job-application tracking. Role-specific preparation and higher limits are paid features. AI-generated suggestions should be checked against your actual experience. Submitted in response to your public tool-submission invitation by Joel | AskMyCareer, an authorized representative. Please feel free to decline this submission; no follow-up is needed.

name: Image Translator Unlimited
tagline: Unlimited image translation with editable translate results.
description: Imagoo Image Translator Unlimited is a desktop app for Windows and macOS that lets you translate images with no daily limits and no paywall. Translate screenshots, product images, comics, and other image-based text, then edit the translated text directly inside the app. It supports 20+ languages and is built for people who need image translation regularly, especially e-commerce sellers, cross-border teams, students, and multilingual users.

name: PilotCalcs
tagline: Free aviation calculators with transparent formulas and worked examples
description: PilotCalcs provides free browser-based aviation calculators for pilots and student pilots. It covers crosswind, wind correction angle, ground speed, true airspeed, fuel burn, point of no return, point of equal time, pressure altitude and density altitude. Each calculator includes editable inputs, transparent formulas, worked examples, source notes, shareable results and clear operational limitations. No account is required.

name: Prep to Build
tagline: Free visual planners for stairs, decks and tile layouts
description: Prep to Build helps DIY renovators and contractors plan home projects before buying materials. Use its free staircase, decking and tile planners to enter measurements, compare layouts, see live visual previews and estimate stock requirements. Deck and tile plans can be drawn on a grid or started from an uploaded plan. Results are planning estimates and should be checked before construction.

name: R2Client
tagline: Native desktop client for Cloudflare R2 object storage
description: R2Client is a native desktop client for Cloudflare R2 object storage. Browse buckets like folders, drag-and-drop upload and download, generate share links — no CLI needed. Free to try. Available for Windows, macOS and Linux.

name: HyperGSC
tagline: Google Search Console for your AI.
description: HyperGSC connects Google Search Console to ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and other compatible AI clients through MCP. Analyze traffic, rankings, queries and indexing using your own website data. Search Console access is read-only, with a free plan and paid upgrades.

name: Peptide Dose
tagline: Peptide reconstitution calculator with cited reference pages for 50+ peptides
description: Peptide Dose is an educational reference site for over 50 research peptides. Its reconstitution and dose calculator turns a vial size in mg, a BAC water volume in mL and a target dose in mg into the number of insulin-syringe units to draw. Every peptide has its own page with default vial sizes, suggested reconstitution volumes, FAQ entries and citations to FDA labels or PubMed protocols. Stacks such as Wolverine, KLOW and GHK-Cu+BPC include combined dosing tables. Informational resource only. Not medical advice.

name: Jet Browser
tagline: A portable WPE WebKit runtime for AI agents
description: Jet Browser is a portable WPE WebKit runtime for AI agents and deterministic browser tests. One Docker container owns one isolated session; clients send ordered JSONL and receive native-input, DOM, and screenshot evidence from the same run. It is model-agnostic, Apache-2.0, and requires no account, API key, database, or hosted control plane.

name: Repairius
tagline: Repairius – All-in-One Repair Shop & Service Management Software
description: Repairius helps repair shops manage jobs, customers, scheduling, estimates, invoices, inventory, payments, and service requests in one platform.

name: Study4Pass
tagline: Verified practice questions for IT certification exams
description: Study4Pass is an online IT certification exam prep platform with 3,000+ certifications — verified practice questions, PDF study guides, and a downloadable test engine for Cisco, CompTIA, AWS, Microsoft, SAP and more.

name: EntiScan
tagline: SEO, entity and semantic audits in your browser
description: EntiScan is a free Chrome extension for SEO professionals, marketers, and web developers. It audits the page you are viewing and organizes technical and on-page SEO signals, headings, links, images, structured data, social metadata, entities, and semantic consistency. The initial analysis runs locally and does not require an account. It shows observable signals and context instead of reducing the audit to a single SEO score. You can export audits locally or optionally save reviewed snapshots to EntiScan Web after confirmation.

name: Common Room
tagline: A public message board for AI agents
description: Common Room is a public message board where AI agents can exchange notes, questions, discoveries, and points of view. Anyone can read freely; agents can register and post through an HTTP API using an agent token. The board also offers a weekly prompt and public feeds.

name: Tesla Wrap Generator
tagline: AI Tesla Paint Shop wrap designer with 3D preview and USB-ready PNG exports
description: Tesla Wrap Generator creates digital wraps for Tesla Paint Shop. Start with a prompt or photo, select your Tesla model and year, and preview the result in 3D before exporting a USB-ready PNG. The site provides 12 official templates for Model 3, Model Y, Model S, Model X and Cybertruck, including newer Model Y and YL layouts. Per-panel direction maps help place artwork correctly. Free templates, 3D preview and a PNG Fixer can be used without an account. New accounts receive one free AI wrap; additional generation credits are available in packs. This is a digital in-car customization tool, independent of Tesla Inc.

name: AI Rumpelstiltskin
tagline: Turn your photo into the viral AI Rumpelstiltskin tiptoe meme.
description: AI Rumpelstiltskin is an AI video generator for creating the viral fairy-tale tiptoe meme from personal photos. Users can choose a two-person fairy tale, a solo version, or a pet version. The tool automatically creates the barn scene, velvet costume, tiptoe, shush, dance, straw-to-gold transformation, kiss, and royal reveal without prompting or manual video editing. Each finished video is 15 seconds with sound and can be generated in vertical 9:16 or widescreen 16:9 format for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Standard videos start at $4.99 with one-time credits and no subscription.

name: Hasta
tagline: One photo of your palm. A reading of the lines that are actually there.
description: One photo of your open palm. Hasta reads the lines that are actually there and writes you a reading in your own hand's terms, and every claim points back to the sign it came from. A mirror, not a verdict. Free reading; the full manuscript is a paid upgrade.

name: Random Topic Generators
tagline: Free topics for conversations, writing and timed speech practice
description: A free browser-based toolkit for students, teachers, writers and speaking clubs. Browse 1,000 curated topics, choose conversation or debate prompts, spin a topic wheel, and practice a short timed speech or writing draft. No account required.

name: Margo
tagline: Character headcanons and scene prompts for fandom writers
description: Margo helps fandom writers and original-character creators brainstorm character headcanons, missing scenes, what-if ideas and character pressure. These are creative possibilities, not official canon. New users receive limited welcome Sparks to try generation; extra credit packs and monthly plans are paid. Submitted by the maker.

name: localiPDF
tagline: Free PDF tools that keep your files on your device
description: localiPDF offers 59 free PDF tools for everyday paperwork. Merge, split, compress, sign, annotate, convert and protect PDFs in your browser. Files stay on your device; no account or watermark is required. Tools work offline once loaded.

name: SumHours
tagline: Free work-hours calculators and printable timesheets with CSV export.
description: SumHours provides free online calculators for work hours, shifts, unpaid breaks, overnight work and decimal time. Employees, freelancers and contractors can total weekly hours, create one- and two-week timesheets or custom pay-period records, and use user-defined overtime settings. The Work Hours & Timesheet tool supports printing and CSV export. Normal calculations do not require an account. The site also publishes calculation formulas and worked examples.

name: Life Hub
tagline: A simple planner for tasks, bills, dates, notes, and grocery lists
description: Life Hub is a browser-based personal organizer for adults who want everyday responsibilities in one place. Track tasks, bill due dates, appointments, notes, grocery lists, and daily plans. The free plan includes unlimited tasks, notes, and grocery lists; Premium adds the full calendar and reminders.

name: Hikari
tagline: Free Next.js starter for subscription applications
description: Hikari is a free Next.js starter, released under MIT, for developers building subscription applications with individual accounts. It includes Supabase authentication, Stripe recurring billing, a protected dashboard, and MDX docs and blog pages. Clone the public repository, run it locally, and customize the code for your product.

name: SongBijou
tagline: The official home of anniversary song for wife
description: SongBijou is the official home of anniversary song for wife. Share her name, a memory you both love and the words you want her to hear, then compare plans and choose a custom love song: Keepsake ($34.99, one song), Love Notes ($46.99/month) or Our Year ($219.99/year). No sign up needed. Also in French.

name: WattsCalc Conduit Bending Calculator
tagline: EMT conduit bending calculator for offsets & saddles
description: WattsCalc is a free conduit bending calculator for electricians and apprentices. Enter the size and height and it works out offsets, 90° stub-ups and 3- or 4-point saddles, including shrink and take-up for 1/2-inch, 3/4-inch and 1-inch EMT. The site also has an offset reference table, a conduit bending cheat sheet, a conduit shrink chart and a conduit fill calculator. Free to use in the browser.

name: Pressure Washer Fix
tagline: Pressure washer not building pressure? 2-minute check
description: Pressure Washer Fix is a free troubleshooting tool for pressure washers that are not building pressure. You pick the symptom (weak, pulsing or no working pressure) and answer a short series of questions that need no disassembly. It explains the likely causes, what is safe to observe yourself and when to stop and get the machine serviced, with a methodology and safety limitations section. No account is needed and your answers stay in your browser.

name: SizeCompare
tagline: Compare Sizes & Dimensions at True Scale
description: SizeCompare is a free online visual size comparison tool for understanding the real-world dimensions of phones, tablets, laptops, monitors, smartwatches, cameras, headphones, tires, animals, and everyday reference objects. Comparisons share one scale so proportions remain accurate. It includes verified specification data, custom compare, height comparison, tire and screen calculators, and unit conversion.

name: 3dlogoai
tagline: AI 3D and 2D logo generator: pro logos in seconds
description: Generate 3D or 2D logos from your company name or slogan. Pick from 11 styles and download transparent PNGs up to 4K, with full commercial rights. Paid, 30-day passes from $19; no credit card needed to start.

name: 1Que AI Business OS
tagline: Run CRM, sales, finance, operations, and workflows with AI
description: 1Que AI Business OS is an integrated platform for UAE companies that combines CRM, sales pipelines, VAT-ready quotations and invoices, tasks, operations, workflow automation, analytics, WhatsApp, email, and AI agents in one workspace. It supports Arabic and English and keeps people in control through approval steps.

name: Calc Zest
tagline: Free Online Calculators for Finance, Tax & Healthcare | Calc Zest
description: Use free online calculators for finance, taxes, healthcare, and everyday decisions. Get quick, clear results with Calc Zest—no signup required.

name: CashFlow Guard
tagline: Know what should come in this week — and who needs a follow-up
description: CashFlow Guard helps small B2B teams track customer receivables, due dates, cheques and payment follow-ups from their existing Excel files, without replacing accounting software. Free 7-day trial, no card required.

name: TrainTeam
tagline: Football team and club management: schedules, attendance, squads, communication and fees
description: TrainTeam helps grassroots football coaches, academies and clubs organise daily team operations. Plan training sessions and matches, collect player availability, track attendance, prepare match squads and communicate with parents and players in one workspace. Clubs can manage several teams and collect membership fees online with automatic monthly billing and sibling discounts. The web app supports Polish, English, German, Spanish, Italian and French. A free plan is available for one team and up to 40 people.

name: Vennivo
tagline: Free early-access people discovery with voluntary profiles
description: Vennivo is a free early-access people-discovery website hosted on ChatGPT Sites. Members can publish voluntary profiles, explore available source evidence and save discoveries. There are no seeded member profiles. ChatGPT sign-in is required for member features; external source availability varies.

name: Forge EPM
tagline: On-premise shop management for steel fabricators
description: Forge EPM connects estimating, production status, material heat and MTR traceability, QC records, shipping, and live job cost in one system of record on a PC in your shop. Built for steel fabrication workflows and designed to work offline. We are selecting three fabrication shops for a live beta. Beta includes implementation and training, the first month free, and a permanent 25% subscription discount while the shop remains a customer. Beta participants run it on live work, share feedback, and join a short call every two weeks. Contact Jarrett Yount at jarrettyount@forgeepm.com to discuss fit.

name: B2B-Saas-OS
tagline: A multi-tenant SaaS starter with adversarial tests
description: B2B SaaS OS is a Next.js 16, Supabase/PostgreSQL and Stripe foundation for developers building multi-tenant B2B SaaS applications. It includes authentication, organizations, role-based access control, team invitations, API keys, billing, usage limits and audit logs. Its adversarial hardening suite tests tenant isolation, privilege boundaries and Stripe webhook failure modes—and caught three real bugs in our own application that we fixed.

name: iEditPDF
tagline: Free Private PDF & Image Tools in Your Browser
description: iEditPDF is a privacy-first online PDF and image toolkit that processes files directly in your browser. Compress, merge, split, rotate, watermark, protect, and convert PDF documents, along with useful image editing and conversion tools. Core tools require no signup or watermarks, and browser-based processing is designed to keep files on your device without routine server uploads.

name: WaveMotion
tagline: Free stem-reactive music visualizer
description: WaveMotion is a free browser music visualizer that turns a song or separate stems into an audio-reactive MP4 with no watermark and no account. Unlike visualizers that react to the full mix at once, it can link any setting to drums, bass, vocals, or synths. Build from templates or a blank canvas with 2D and 3D visualizers, GPU effects, text, images, and a real timeline. Paste lyrics or an LRC file for karaoke-style lyric videos. Export up to 4K in 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, or 4:5 for YouTube, Reels, TikTok, and Shorts. Rendering stays on your computer, so audio never leaves the browser.

name: Folio
tagline: Keep chapters, story notes and revisions together
description:
Folio keeps your novel's chapters, story notes and saved drafts in one browser workspace. Write with your notes nearby, revisit earlier versions and export your manuscript.

Optional passage suggestions can be compared with your original before you decide whether to apply them.

The writing workspace is free. Optional passage suggestions use paid credits, with no subscription. Submitted by Folio's maker.

name: PetMorph
tagline: Turn your pet photos into studio-quality AI portraits in seconds.
description: PetMorph turns everyday photos of dogs, cats and other pets into studio-quality AI portraits. Pick a style, upload a picture and get a set of polished images in seconds, ready to download and share. No design skills, no prompts and no app install required, just your own pet photos.

name: JointTex
tagline: Collaborative LaTeX editing with AI assistance
description: JointTex is a collaborative LaTeX editor for research papers and technical documents. Teams can edit together, review comments in the source and PDF, and use AI assistance for edits and compilation-error repair. Reference metadata lookup supports Crossref and arXiv. The free tier allows two invited editors per project, with Git integrations available on paid plans.

name: Lesson Worlds
tagline: Personal planet learning worlds and free educational resources for Grades 1–8
description: Lesson Worlds is a Toronto-based browser learning platform from Shabe Ai Corp., serving Canadian and US school and homeschool families. Grades 1–8 learners explore and change personal planet worlds while practising math, science, English, social studies and geography. Free reading resources, interactive science labs and educator-led virtual field trips are available. Optional household membership costs US$4.99/month for up to three children, with saved worlds and a parent dashboard. Live free Grade 6+ geography experiences with Frank Romo: https://romogis.lessonworlds.com/. No app download or child email is needed.

name: FirstPass Memo
tagline: Free red-flag checker for business-for-sale listings
description: FirstPass Memo is a free red-flag checker for people buying a small online business: SaaS, content sites, ecommerce, apps. Paste the listing text and it shows payback in months, the asking multiple against a range of comparable listings, and the top three red flags, each with a question to send the seller. It runs entirely in your browser; nothing you paste is sent.

name: DRIVNETT
tagline: Oslo digital agency building websites, integrations, dashboards, AI chatbots and automation.
description: DRIVNETT delivers digital solutions for Norwegian businesses: websites and web portals, custom development and integrations, business analytics and dashboards, and AI chatbots and automation. Fixed-price websites from 14 900 NOK. Serving Oslo, Bergen, Trondheim, Stavanger and the rest of Norway.

name: Ramsa Speech
tagline: Emirati Arabic text-to-speech for AI assistants, customer conversations and voiceovers.
description:
Ramsa is an AI speech platform built specifically for Emirati Arabic. It turns text into spoken audio with the local pronunciation, rhythm, and everyday expressions that make a voice feel familiar.

The idea grew out of conversations with Emirati officials who wanted speech technology that stayed true to their dialect. That focus shapes Ramsa’s work, from the way words are pronounced to how a sentence flows.

Organizations can use Ramsa to give their AI assistants, virtual receptionists, and customer service applications an Emirati voice. It also produces voiceovers for advertising, videos, training materials, podcasts, and other recorded content.

For organizations that want their own distinctive voice, Ramsa offers custom voice cloning with the speaker’s consent. The voice can be reserved exclusively for the organization and used across its services and content, helping it sound consistent wherever people hear it.

Developed by NextGen Speech AI, Ramsa is available through a shared cloud service or can be deployed within an organization’s own cloud or premises.

Contact Ramsa Speech for pricing.

name: Limaz
tagline: Fraud, AML and cybersecurity compliance for regulated organizations in Saudi Arabia
description: Limaz provides fraud detection and AML technology, plus cybersecurity and regulatory compliance services (PDPL, NCA, SAMA, IAM/PAM) for banks, fintechs and other regulated organizations in Saudi Arabia.

name: Voxily
tagline: Draft social replies in your own voice, then review and send
description: Voxily is a desktop Chrome extension for founders, freelancers and creators who regularly reply on X, LinkedIn and Reddit. It drafts inside the comment box using visible conversation context, saved personas, writing examples, knowledge and moods. You review, edit and send yourself. Free includes 10 reply generations per day; sign-in is required, with no credit card or separate AI API key. Pro adds optional variations, Brand Mode, Custom Mood and DM drafts for $12.99/month or $120/year.

name: Property Promo Kit
tagline: Contractor project tools for estimates, invoices and job costs
description: Property Promo Kit helps contractors and remodelers manage project estimates, client approvals, invoices, job photos and field notes. Its job-cost view compares revenue with entered materials, labor and other costs, so a busy schedule can be evaluated alongside gross profit before overhead and taxes. Explore the public demo at https://propertypromokit.com/demo. Today's walkthrough: https://www.facebook.com/reel/1557912962806848

name: CPFHub.io
tagline: Brazilian CPF lookup API with an MCP server for AI agents
description: CPFHub.io is a REST API for Brazilian CPF data. Simple lookup returns name, gender and birth date in about 150 ms, and real-time lookup (CPF plus birth date) checks registration status directly at Receita Federal in about one second. It also offers bulk lookups, public OpenAPI docs and a remote MCP server (https://api.cpfhub.io/mcp) so AI agents can use it as a tool. Free plan with 50 credits per month, no card required.

name: Brivoy
tagline: Where new products take off
description: Brivoy is a product discovery platform that helps makers and founders showcase their products and get discovered by a wider audience. Explore new launches, discover useful tools, support independent makers, and share your own creations with the community. Track your MRR and ARR milestones, celebrate progress, and give your products the visibility they deserve.

name: CRCKBL
tagline: Live available .com discovery with evidence-based 360° name grades
description: CRCKBL helps domain investors and founders discover registry-checked available .com names through a live Wire, then screen candidates with one overall 1–360° grade supported by five evidence areas. It is a screening and discovery tool, not a dollar appraisal or sale-price forecast.

name: EasyPick
tagline: Split posters and screenshots into separate PNG assets
description: EasyPick is a Chinese-language web tool that separates products, icons and illustrations from a complete image into individual PNG assets, delivered in a ZIP file for reuse in layouts. Upload a PNG, JPG or WebP image, preview the extracted assets, then purchase a download. New users get one watermarked preview. Paid image packs start at CNY 9.9 for 5 source images, with one-time payment and no subscription. Source images are retained for 7 days and results for 30 days.

name: Watt Garden
tagline: Plan daily electricity use and compare outage loads with your battery.
description: Estimate daily energy use and cost from device wattage and hours, then compare a planned outage window with battery capacity you enter. Add or edit devices, try a flexible-load scenario, and export CSV or a printable PDF. This standalone tool makes no network requests; values are user-entered rough estimates, not electrical safety advice.

name: Zombie Trend
tagline: Turn two photos into a 15-second AI zombie love story
description: Zombie Trend is an AI video generator that turns two photos into a personalized 15-second zombie love story. Choose a partner, family member, best friend, or pet, then create a cinematic standoff, emotional embrace, and warm-memory transition for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. The story and prompts are built in, with recognizable faces, 9:16 or 16:9 formats, and no blood or gore.

name: ココロタイプ (Kokoro Type)
tagline: Explore your personality in Japanese, without signing up
description: Kokoro Type helps Japanese-speaking users reflect on personality and communication through a 60-question test taking about 5–7 minutes. Basic results are free and require no account. Five indicators are presented with uncertainty, alongside 16-type explanations and repeat-test comparisons on the same device. Optional detailed reports are paid. It is independently developed and is not the official MBTI assessment or a clinical diagnosis.

name: EZGradeHub
tagline: Free Online Grade, Final Grade, GPA & CGPA Calculators for Students
description: EzGradeHub offers four free online academic calculators: Easy Grade Calculator, Final Grade Calculator, GPA Calculator, and CGPA Calculator. Students can calculate grades, estimate the exam scores they need, and track their semester and cumulative academic performance with simple, easy-to-use tools.

name: FilePresto
tagline: Free single-file converters that run on your device. No account needed.
description: FilePresto is a set of file converters that run in your web browser. No account needed. Converting a single file is free. On tools that support batches, free use is up to 5 files at a time and up to 10 free files a day in this browser. A Day Pass costs £3.99 and removes both free limits for 24 hours. Your files are processed on your device and are not uploaded to FilePresto. Tools include batch HEIC to JPG, HEIC to PNG, MOV to MP4, MP3 to WAV and AVI to MP4.

name: Warning Vector
tagline: Weather and Emergency Alerts: US and Canada
description: Live weather and emergency alerts for the United States and Canada. Read recent warnings, search the archive, or get device notifications for your area.

name: Imagefake
tagline: An AI-image screening signal with private reports
description: Imagefake is an online AI-image screening tool powered by IsItAI classification. Sign in with Google to check one supported image and review an AI/Human classification with model confidence. One successful free check is available per Google identity, subject to trial capacity; paid plans provide a limited monthly allowance. Private reports can be downloaded, printed or shared through a revocable score-only link. Model confidence is a screening signal, not proof of authenticity, authorship or editing history.

name: SmartToolNexa
tagline: Free Online Tools for Everyday Digital Tasks
description: SmartToolNexa is an online tools platform designed to help students, creators, professionals, and businesses complete everyday digital tasks quickly and easily. Explore practical tools for QR code generation, text processing, productivity, and other online workflows, all in one convenient place. SmartToolNexa focuses on simplicity, accessibility, and useful solutions that save users time without complicated software installations.

name: PriceRight
tagline: Etsy/eBay profit calculator
description:
A seller on Etsy/eBay? The price you bought/ sold it for isnt the same as your profit. Learn how marketplace fees, asvertisement fees, and shipping effect what you actually take home.
PriceRight is a free Etsy and eBay profit calculator with the sole purpose of helping you estimate your profit and determining what price you should sell it for based on the dollar amount of profit you seek or the desired profit margin %. Try it free🙌🏾

name: Bulk MES
tagline: Manufacturing orders and shop-floor work in one system
description: Bulk MES connects manufacturing orders with production jobs and shop-floor records. Operators capture time, output, materials and checks at the workstation. Planners manage schedules, while supervisors follow progress and job-linked quality issues. SQDCP teamboards bring daily performance and owned actions into shift meetings. Consumable inventory, training, safety and audits support the surrounding operations. Eligible job records provide the basis for invoicing. Paid software with quote-based pricing and a free trial.

name: Canopio
tagline: See what your Etsy listings keep after every fee
description: Canopio is an Etsy fee and profit tool. The free calculator shows what one order keeps after Etsy's 6.5% transaction fee (which also applies to shipping), payment processing, the $0.20 listing fee, and Etsy Ads or Offsite Ads (12% or 15%, capped at $100), and it can work backwards from a target margin to a price. A free listing score rates titles, tags and descriptions, with optional AI rewrites. The $9.90 one-time Shop Audit connects to Etsy with read-only OAuth and ranks every live listing worst-first, with suggested prices and a sold-order backtest. No subscription. Not affiliated with Etsy.

name: KitForma
tagline: Browser tools for PDFs, images, text and data
description: KitForma brings PDF, image, text and developer tools together with practical guides and community answers. It helps students, creators and small teams complete everyday file and data tasks. Core tools are free to try; optional Pro and connected cloud features have their own limits and permissions.

name: WeddingSpeech
tagline: AI wedding speech generator — answer a few questions, get three personalized, fully editable drafts in minutes. Free to start.
description: WeddingSpeech helps anyone deliver a memorable wedding speech without the blank-page anxiety. Choose your role — best man, maid of honor, parent of the couple, or officiant — answer a few guided questions about your favorite stories and memories, and the AI crafts three distinct speech drafts in minutes. Every word stays fully editable, so the final speech sounds like you, not a template. It also covers wedding vows, rehearsal dinner speeches, and reception welcome speeches. The first speech is completely free.

name: MotRadar
tagline: Free UK MOT history checks using DVSA data.
description: MotRadar is a free UK MOT checker. Enter a vehicle registration to see its current MOT status, expiry date, full MOT test history, failures, advisories and mileage trend — all based on official DVSA data. It highlights dangerous and major defects, recurring issues and mileage anomalies, helping used-car buyers, owners and sellers check a vehicle in seconds. No sign-up required.

name: Final Grade Calcs
tagline: Find the grade you need on your final exam to reach your target course grade.
description: Final Grade Calcs provides free grade calculators for students. Its final grade calculator uses a student’s current grade, target course grade, and final exam weight to calculate the minimum score needed on the final exam. The site also includes weighted grade and GPA calculators, requires no sign-up, and performs calculations directly in the browser.

name: Agent Service Market
tagline: Bounded operation contracts and pilot documentation for AI agent developers
description: Agent Service Market publishes operation contracts and documentation for developers building AI agents. Its three-tool pilot covers text hashing, timestamp conversion and conservative JSON repair. Paid execution is currently paused. The remaining operation definitions are planned reference material, not live APIs.

name: LineRecon
tagline: Compare orders, confirmations and invoices with source evidence
description: LineRecon helps procurement, operations and finance teams compare line items across purchase orders, order confirmations and invoices. Upload PDFs or document photos, confirm the proposed comparison plan and review differences against the original document pages. Record review decisions, reuse saved comparison plans and export findings to Excel or PDF. Eligible accounts can start with 100 one-time trial credits, valid for 30 days after claim.

name: LingoBound
tagline: Whole-book translation with a shared glossary
description: LingoBound is an AI translator for books, manuscripts and long documents. Its chapter-aware workflow uses a shared glossary to help carry names and recurring terms across a book. Upload EPUB, DOCX, TXT or a supported PDF, then compare the source and translation in a bilingual reader. An eligible free chapter sample is available after sign-in, with limits; paid access unlocks the complete book. Download the translation as a rebuilt EPUB, PDF or TXT. Exports contain translated text only and do not preserve original layouts, images or tables. Review AI output before publication or other important uses.

name: Meranti
tagline: Invoices, routes and TMS in one platform for transport companies
description: Meranti brings together invoicing, route planning and transport management modules. Explore the current features and plans on the official website.

name: VerdictKit
tagline: Explore typed AI decisions with the Jev playground
description: VerdictKit helps developers explore decision models for agent workflows. Its independent Jev playground accepts text or JSON and supports Choice classification, ordered Score questions and Noul yes/no probabilities. Inspect request and response JSON, try support-ticket and tool-selection examples, and read practical guides to API integration, limitations and System One models. Demo previews are free; live evaluations have trial limits and paid plans. VerdictKit is not affiliated with TypeSafe AI.

name: Login Broker
tagline: Social login in five minutes. One key, six providers.
description: Hosted social-login utility for developers. One script tag and one API key cover Google, Facebook, Microsoft, Apple, GitHub, and LinkedIn. Answers “is this person really this email?” and leaves sessions/permissions to the app.

name: Nano Banana 2.1 Tools
tagline: Adaptable image prompts and a simple creative workspace
description: Nano Banana Tools is an independent AI image workspace for developing visual ideas with prompts and reference images. Explore adaptable briefs for product photography, campaign concepts and editorial still life. The interface provides text-to-image and image-editing controls, five aspect ratios, 1K/2K/4K settings and visible credit costs. Generation depends on service availability. Example artwork is illustrative preview material rather than verified model output. Paid plans are coming soon. The service is not affiliated with Google.

name: Tử Vi Phương Đông
tagline: Vietnamese Tu Vi, feng shui and I Ching tools with AI chat
description: Tử Vi Phương Đông offers Vietnamese tools for traditional Tu Vi chart lookup, feng shui home directions and I Ching cultural learning. A free Vietnamese AI chat helps explain terminology. AI answers should be checked.

name: Güncel Hesaplar
tagline: Free Turkish calculators and file converters
description: Güncel Hesaplar offers free calculators for Turkish tax, salary, property, finance and daily needs. It also has browser-based PDF, image and data converters. Tools work without registration.

name: Fileful
tagline: Collect month-end documents with one clear client request.
description:
Fileful helps small bookkeeping practices collect the documents needed to close the month. Build a request checklist, send a private client link, and review what is still missing or ready to use.

The free month-end checklist can be edited, copied and printed without an account. The optional USD 29/month workspace adds private client uploads, item-level review, recurring requests and optional reminders for up to 500 active requests. Clients upload without creating an account. Files are limited to 5 MB each.

The 14-day workspace trial needs no card and ends without a charge.

name: Remeto
tagline: Keep overdue invoices, payment promises and next actions together.
description:
Remeto helps bookkeepers keep invoice follow-up organised across client businesses. See outstanding balances, record partial payments and promises, and keep the next action beside each invoice.

Use the free invoice CSV preview without an account. The file stays in your browser until you choose to save it. The optional GBP 29/month workspace saves up to 500 active invoices with follow-up history and CSV import and export. A 14-day trial needs no card and ends without a charge.

Remeto tracks follow-through; it does not send debt demands or replace your accounting ledger.

name: Keptick
tagline: Know when an automation ran but produced too little.
description:
Keptick helps automation consultants check the work a workflow produced, as well as whether it ran. Set an expected interval and minimum output count, send an outcome receipt, and inspect missed runs or low output. Private client status links show recent results.

Try the local outcome simulator without an account. One live monitor remains free after the 14-day no-card trial; the optional USD 19/month plan supports up to 50 monitors. The trial ends without a charge.

Your workflow must send receipts. Missing-run checks run about every five minutes, and email delivery can add delay.

name: Jinli Job (锦鲤求职)
tagline: AI career assistant for Chinese-speaking job seekers
description: Jinli Job helps Chinese-speaking job seekers prepare and manage their applications. Users can browse employer-site jobs, organize resume information, use cloud-browser assistance for application forms, track progress and prepare for interviews. It offers free starting quota and paid additional usage. Users complete authentication and verification, review their information and check results on employer websites.

name: InviteRelays
tagline: A community exchange for sharing Muse AI invite codes
description: InviteRelays helps Muse AI users find, copy, share, and mark invite codes in one community exchange. It is an independent project and is not affiliated with Muse AI.

name: Produsa
tagline: AI website builder for India: from one sentence to a live website.
description: Type a sentence and Produsa's 35 AI agents research your niche, then design, write and build a live website. No code, no agency. Built for India with nine local languages and pricing in rupees. Real working software on yourbrand.produsa.app or your own custom domain on the Founder plan. Refine by chat. Export the code if you want. First website free to build and publish, live free for 10 days; plans from 999 rupees a month.

name: Room Cherry
tagline: Google Calendar meeting room display in any browser
description: Room Cherry turns any iPad, Android tablet, Fire tablet, or desktop browser into a live Google Calendar meeting room display. Pair with a secret link, QR, or 6-character code. When the room is free, tap Book on the wall for walk-up booking. Browser only — no App Store app. Built for Google Workspace resource calendars. $10 per resource calendar per month after a 30-day free trial (no card). Listed on the Google Workspace Marketplace.

name: FirstPass
tagline: Evidence-first release checks and small browser tools
description: FirstPass gives developers and small product teams evidence-first checks before release. Its free browser tools validate cross-platform release assets and create structured launch briefs without an account. Fixed-scope CI integration and browser-tool implementation are also available.

name: ImageWise
tagline: AI image translator that keeps your layout
description: ImageWise is an AI image workspace for translating text inside images without rebuilding the design. It detects text regions, uses surrounding visual context, and places translated copy back into the image - built for screenshots, menus, manga, posters, labels, and product graphics. Also includes AI image generation, image-to-image, image-to-prompt, and free local edits (flip, merge, compress, resize, crop).

name: We0 AI
tagline: An AI website creation and business growth workspace
description: We0 AI helps founders, small businesses and growth teams plan, design, build and publish websites. Its multi-agent workflow combines code generation, CMS and deployment with ongoing SEO, GEO, marketing content and lead generation tools.

name: Sticker Printer Hub
tagline: Independent sticker printer guides, cost calculator and free 4x7 sheet maker
description: Sticker Printer Hub compares home colour sticker printers such as the Liene PixCut S1, Cricut StickerPix and Canon SELPHY using the makers published specs and supply prices. It includes a cost-per-sheet calculator, troubleshooting guide and a free browser tool for laying out 4x7 sticker sheets. Not affiliated with Cricut, Liene or Canon.

name: Tarotop
tagline: An AI familiar with skills — tarot first, more to unlock
description: Tarotop is a private space with Maevera, an AI familiar (灵宠). She stays with you in chat, keeps memory you control, and uses skills when they help — tarot is the first one. Free card of the day, 150 credits on signup, 10 languages.

name: UI Discovery
tagline: Discover real-world UI references and design resources
description: UI Discovery is a UI and design discovery platform for product designers and engineers. It is a curated library of real production interfaces — marketing sites, web apps, dashboards, iOS screens, and page sections — so you can find a reference, inspect layout, color, and type, and copy an original build prompt into Cursor, Claude, or a similar tool. Captured designs stay with their owners and are for inspiration. The prompts describe structure, palette, and typography and ask for original copy. Who it's for: product designers, UI/UX designers, frontend engineers, and indie founders who need real production interface references instead of generic mockups. How it works: browse curated galleries by category, inspect layout color and typography on live captures, then copy an original build prompt into Cursor, Claude, or a similar tool to recreate structure and style with your own copy. Why it helps: speeds up design research and prototyping by grounding decisions in real shipped UIs rather than abstract inspiration boards. Pricing: Freemium.

name: EUParcelFee
tagline: Estimate EU import duty, VAT and parcel costs
description: EUParcelFee is a free web calculator for estimating customs duty, import VAT and checkout costs on low-value orders from non-EU sellers. Choose from 27 EU destinations, enter the declared value and number of tariff categories, and view an itemized estimate. It includes country and shopping-platform guides and works without signup. Results are estimates only, not customs or tax advice; verify the actual checkout and destination customs guidance.

name: CutDone
tagline: Turn your goals into printable tear-off checklists.
description:
CutDone is a web-based productivity tool that turns goals, to-do lists, and personal challenges into printable tear-off checklists.

Create customized lists, explore ready-made templates, or use AI to break big goals into smaller actionable steps.

Print your checklist, complete a task, and physically cut it off to make progress visible and satisfying.

Free printable options require no signup. Optional Pro features are available for a one-time payment.

name: Energy Radar
tagline: Free backup power sizing calculator for Ukrainian homes and small businesses.
description: Energy Radar helps users estimate appliance energy demand, battery capacity, inverter power and approximate runtime for planned or emergency outages. The calculator explains its methodology and limitations. It is free to use, with disclosed affiliate links on the site.

name: Split Forms
tagline: Free contact form backend for any website
description: splitforms is a hosted form backend: point any HTML, React, Next.js, WordPress or AI-built form at https://splitforms.com/api/submit and submissions are spam-filtered, saved to a dashboard and emailed to you. Free includes 500 submissions with no card and no time limit.

name: Wirewoman
tagline: AI receptionist built for electricians
description: Wirewoman answers electricians’ calls 24/7, captures job details, books work on the calendar, and flags urgent electrical safety issues for escalation. It sends clean call summaries by text and remembers customer and job details.

name: Plumber Secretary
tagline: 24/7 AI receptionist that books plumbing jobs
description: Plumber Secretary is an AI receptionist for plumbing businesses. It answers calls around the clock, handles common plumbing questions, triages emergencies, books jobs on the calendar, and sends the owner call summaries by text or email.

name: Archivar
tagline: AI receptionist and intake system for law firms
description: Archivar answers law firm calls 24/7, captures prospective client intake, and helps schedule consultations. Its connected workspace also includes case management, meeting notes, and firm-wide knowledge and memory.

name: Demo My Product
tagline: Turn screenshots into clickable product tours
description: Demo My Product is a tool for building interactive product demos. Capture screens with the Chrome extension or upload screenshots, then add hotspots, tooltips and branching steps, and blur anything private before anyone sees it. Publish to get a link, or paste one iframe into your site, docs or help centre. Protect a demo with a password or ask for an email first, and see views, completion and drop-off step by step. Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT can build and publish demos over MCP. Pro adds editable HTML capture for redacting the real page. One published demo is free.

name: FicWeave
tagline: AI fanfiction generator with Story Memory for consistent multi-chapter stories
description: FicWeave is an AI fanfiction generator that helps you create Chapter 1 without an account, then save and continue with Story Memory so characters, relationships, facts, and open threads stay consistent as the story grows.

name: ProductLair
tagline: Curated dropshipping product research and launch plans for Shopify sellers
description: ProductLair helps Shopify sellers evaluate dropshipping products using curated research, supplier costs, estimated margins, competitor stores and TikTok ad insights. Higher tiers include Shopify product copy, ad copy and four-week launch plans with budgets. Research $49, Launch $99 and Sell $199 are one-time purchases with lifetime access. Separate public Profit and ROAS Calculators work without an account.

name: AXQIR
tagline: AI visibility measurement SaaS
description: PAID AI visibility measurement SaaS, monitors brand mentions and recommendations in AI answers across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and Perplexity.

name: SYNDIC HQ
tagline: AI-powered end-to-end content operations
description: PAID AI-powered end-to-end content operations for agencies and multi-location teams, planning, creating, QA, scheduling and publishing branded social content.

name: BuildQuantities
tagline: 41 free construction calculators with visible formulas
description: BuildQuantities offers 41 free construction quantity calculators — concrete, gravel, sand, rebar, drywall, paint, brick, roofing, flooring, asphalt and more. Every calculator shows its formulas and a worked example so you can verify the math, and everything runs in the browser with no signup required.

name: DramaGenerator
tagline: AI photo transformations for posters, costumes and seasonal avatars
description: Submitted by the site operator. DramaGenerator offers AI photo transformations for movie posters, superhero looks, costume previews, Halloween images and 1980s-style portraits. Google sign-in is required. Tools have a limited daily free allowance and watermark-free outputs; they are not unlimited.

name: VideoCreate
tagline: Turn video references into prompts tailored to AI video models
description: Submitted by the site operator. VideoCreate analyzes MP4 or MOV video references shot by shot and writes model-specific prompts covering subject, camera, motion, lighting and style. Explore its demo or analyze a clip you have permission to use. Limited free analysis is available alongside optional pay-as-you-go short video generation.

name: Jev Pricing
tagline: Independent cost calculator and benchmarks for the Jev API
description: Submitted by the site operator. Jev Pricing offers a token estimator, cost calculator and independent benchmark research for TypeSafe’s Jev API. Methodology and benchmark code help developers assess representative workloads. It is unofficial and not affiliated with TypeSafe; estimates should be checked against actual usage and current vendor documentation.

name: SeasonKeep
tagline: Personalized home-maintenance schedules with reminders and cost ranges
description: Personalized home-maintenance schedule app that builds dated tasks from home age, systems, and climate zone, with reminders, cost ranges, and DIY-or-pro guidance. Free for one home.

name: Web Tool Bench
tagline: 33 free web tools for DNS, email, SEO and developers, with every result explained
description:
Web Tool Bench is a collection of 33 free web tools for people who run their own sites and email. The DNS and domain tools cover lookups, WHOIS, SSL certificates and HTTP headers, and the email deliverability checker tests SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MX records and gives an overall score. The SEO tools include an on-page checker, redirect checker, robots.txt tester, sitemap checker, broken link checker and a search snippet preview. Developers get generators and utilities such as .htaccess, robots.txt and meta tag builders, a JSON formatter, and password, hash and UUID tools. For business owners there are calculators for margin, break-even, sales tax, ROI and freelance hourly rates.

Every result comes with an explanation of what it means and what to do next, so the output is useful even if you are not an expert in the subject. There is no sign-up and no query limit.

name: SponsorBoard
tagline: Find podcast sponsors in your niche
description: SponsorBoard helps niche podcast hosts find companies already advertising in their trade. Browse sponsorship activity by industry, relationship duration and last-seen date, with evidence linked to specific episodes in public show notes or video descriptions. Brands and agencies can also research observed sponsorship activity. Free boards show sample advertiser names; USD 15.99/month or USD 158/year unlocks all names. No advertiser contacts, audience estimates, ad rates or spend figures.

name: appkeepr
tagline: Your app alerts in one inbox, on web and phone
description:
You built the app. You shouldn’t have to build a notification system too.

Appkeepr brings sales, errors, deploys, and downtime into one inbox on web and phone. Connect Sentry, RevenueCat, Vercel, and Dokploy, receive App Store release alerts, or send your own events through the HTTP API or Node.js SDK.

Keep related updates in channels and organize them by project. Each teammate chooses which channels to follow and gets mobile push notifications for those updates. Set up an integration once, and your teammates can subscribe without configuring it again.

Uptime monitoring is built in. When your service goes down or comes back online, the alert arrives in the same inbox. Domain and TLS expiry reminders go there too, so there’s less to keep checking.

Appkeepr is a hosted service with a free plan and paid plans for higher usage. No notification backend or Telegram bot to build.

name: Tjekbanker.dk
tagline: Free Danish loan comparison: rates and APR (ÅOP) from 17 lenders
description: Tjekbanker.dk is a free Danish comparison site that helps people in Denmark compare loans before they borrow. Users can compare interest rates and APR (ÅOP) from 17 lenders across loan types such as consumer loans, debt consolidation loans, car loans, mortgages and cooperative housing loans. The site includes a loan calculator, an APR guide, profiles of Danish banks and a knowledge centre with guides. The service is free for users; the site discloses that it may receive commission from partners.

name: Moonlit Bonds
tagline: Free interactive romance stories you play in your browser
description: Moonlit Bonds is a free library of interactive, closed-door romance novellas you read and play in the browser: no download, no account. Your choices shape each story. Three books so far: The Glasshouse at Dusk (a cozy-gothic monster romance), The Last Lanternkeeper (a lighthouse romance with a sea-born keeper) and Sunfire After Hours (a forbidden workplace monster romance). Each book has a free first scene, chapter checkpoints and saves in your browser.

name: PrintMigo
tagline: Create printable learning pages, gift tags and planners in your browser.
description: PrintMigo is a collection of free browser-based printable generators for teachers, parents and everyday planning. Create gift tags, flashcards, worksheets, reward charts and weekly planners using your own content. Choose print settings, review the preview and print or export PDF/PNG without creating an account.

name: BulkQRCode
tagline: Create multiple QR codes quickly from Excel and CSV files
description: BulkQRCode is an easy-to-use online bulk QR code generator that helps users create multiple QR codes quickly from Excel and CSV files. Users can customize QR code colors and download multiple QR codes in convenient formats. It is useful for businesses, marketers, event organizers, and anyone who needs to generate QR codes in bulk.
tags: Create multiple QR codes quickly from Excel and CSV files

name: XmasApplication
tagline: Christmas wishes, cards, photos and festive tools in one place
