description: XmasApplication is a free Christmas web app for families and friends. Explore Christmas wishes, greeting cards, photo tools, countdowns, wallpapers, games, and festive activities to celebrate and share the holiday season.

name: ClapSnap
tagline: Launch your Mac workspace with a clap or snap
description: ClapSnap is a native macOS menu bar app that launches a chosen set of apps with a double clap or double snap. It also includes Air Mouse: use your webcam to move the cursor with your hand, pinch to click or drag, and use gestures to right-click and scroll. Audio detection and hand tracking run on your Mac; no audio or video is recorded or uploaded. Settings include trigger sensitivity, cursor smoothing, gesture toggles, and an optional welcome overlay and sound. Runs on macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon and Intel. Air Mouse requires camera access. One-time pay-what-you-want purchase, minimum EUR 8, with a 14-day refund policy. First launch requires macOS approval; instructions are on the website.

name: MacUno
tagline: Desktop transitions that follow your MacBook's lid angle
description: MacUno is a native macOS menu bar app that reads your MacBook's lid angle. As you close the lid, your desktop gradually blurs, narrows in perspective, and dims; reopening the lid reverses the effect. Settings include a custom trigger angle, transition styles, animation variants, per-app strength profiles, and external-display support. Desktop images are processed in local memory, not saved or uploaded. It costs $4.50 once. Requires an Apple Silicon MacBook on macOS 15.2+ with a readable lid-angle sensor; physical-device testing has been on a MacBook Pro M3 Pro, so sensor support is not guaranteed on every model. Screen recording permission is required. The app is ad-hoc signed, not notarized, and the website explains the first-launch approval steps.

name: Print Calendar Lab
tagline: Create and print customizable calendars as PDFs
description: Create free printable monthly and yearly calendars in your browser. Customize layouts, paper size, week starts, holidays and notes, then print or download a PDF without signing up. Useful for home, school and work planning.

name: DROPS.ST
tagline: Cannabis commerce software for dispensaries, coffeeshops and delivery operators
description: DROPS.ST helps dispensaries, coffeeshops, mail-order and delivery operators run their online shop. It brings menus, customer accounts, orders and shop management into one platform. Operators can explore public demos and practical resources before choosing a setup for their business.

name: Agenvas
tagline: Self-hosted AI creation canvas for text, images, video, audio and agents
description: Agenvas is an MIT-licensed, self-hosted visual creation workspace. Connect cards, reuse prompts and assets, and work with configured models and media adapters across text, images, video, audio and agents. Agent-proposed media jobs require approval. The current development build is designed for a single administrator. The software is free; hosting and external model-provider costs may apply. Source and setup: https://github.com/grayrepo-byte/Agenvas

name: CheckMyRaise
tagline: Free pay raise and salary calculators to check if your raise is fair
description: CheckMyRaise is a free finance toolkit for employees who want to understand their pay before a review or negotiation. Use the Pay Raise Calculator and Raise Percentage Calculator to see exactly how a raise changes your salary, and convert between salary and hourly pay in seconds. It also includes a Cost of Living Raise Calculator and data on average raise percentages for 2026, so you can compare your offer against real benchmarks.

name: Code Mods Hub
tagline: Discover Claude Code mods, skills, plugins and MCP servers
description: Code Mods Hub is an independent directory of Claude Code extensions. Developers can browse mods, skills, agents, plugins, hooks, MCP servers, subagents and commands, with source links and setup instructions.

name: L1 Reward
tagline: India’s Leading B2B Loyalty Program Software – Trusted Worldwide
description: Loyltworks is a cloud-based loyalty program software for B2B, channel partners, trade influencers & sales teams. Boost engagement and retention.

name: Freeboard
tagline: Public conversation nearby and around shared interests
description:
Freeboard is a public place for anonymous conversation, locally and globally. Guests can participate without creating an account or profile.

Use Nearby for location-tagged public conversation, or create a Board around a shared interest. Each Board has a feed and a live chat. Share its link with your club, audience or customers so they can join.

Boards and chats are public. Live messages are temporary. Bring people you want to talk with; an existing audience or immediate response is not guaranteed.

name: Printable Toolkit
tagline: Free customizable worksheets, planners, calendars and printable PDFs
description: Printable Toolkit offers free browser-based generators for customizable worksheets, planners, calendars, puzzles and printable paper, with live previews and PDF downloads. No account or watermark.

name: MyPhotoAI
tagline: AI headshots from US$5. No subscription.
description:
Create a new look for your LinkedIn profile, dating profile or social feed from your own selfies. MyPhotoAI turns your photos into professional headshots and creative portraits using state-of-the-art image generation models. Choose from 142 looks across 7 categories, with up to 5 looks per shoot.

Start with 3 photos for US$5, or keep every photo from one shoot for US$10. Each purchase covers one shoot, with no subscription. Choose a style, upload your selfies and create your photos online.

name: SpriteGen
tagline: Generate animated sprite sheets from text or reference images
description: SpriteGen is a browser-based AI sprite sheet generator for game developers and artists. Generate from text or reference images, preview animations, and download transparent PNG sprite sheets. Free generation attempts are available, with paid credits for additional use.

name: Sitelemetry
tagline: Evidence-backed website audits with fixes for AI coding agents
description: Sitelemetry checks authorized websites across security, technical SEO, AI visibility, accessibility, performance and integrations. Findings include evidence, prioritized fixes and re-audit guidance. Connect through compatible MCP clients such as Codex, Claude Code and Cursor. Free accounts include 10 security scans per month; paid plans unlock all six audit areas.

name: subtitle.im
tagline: Your all-in-one YouTube extension
description:
subtitle.im is an all-in-one YouTube extension for getting, searching, copying and downloading transcripts, automatically turning captions on or off, and handling duplicate subtitles.

Transcript tools are part of the upcoming 1.6 release, currently a Chrome Web Store draft as of October 31, 2026. They use a video’s available captions: read and search the transcript, jump to matching moments, copy the full text or selected passages, and download TXT for free. Pro adds SRT, VTT, Markdown and PDF through the browser’s print/save-as-PDF flow. Videos without available captions are not transcribed.

Let captions follow YouTube or turn them on or off automatically. Handle overlapping YouTube captions according to your settings and restore them when needed. Subtitle detection and OCR run locally without uploading video frames. The extension does not generate or translate subtitles, or remove burned-in text.

Try duplicate-caption handling on 10 successfully processed videos without signup; this cumulative allowance does not reset monthly. Optional Pro provides continued handling, video and channel rules, and memory of confirmed decisions to turn captions off. Manual caption changes apply to the current viewing. See subtitle.im for current plans and availability.

name: Prism Post
tagline: Turn mirrors, guide the beam, wake the blooms.
description: A free browser puzzle with three hand-made levels: tap mirrors to guide one light beam through every paper flower. Touch-friendly, no account or uploads; progress stays in the browser. An optional $1 Base USDC thank-you link is user-reviewed and never charges automatically.

name: CoinPriceAlert
tagline: Price alerts across crypto, stocks, metals and forex
description: CoinPriceAlert provides price and percentage alerts across crypto, stocks, metals and forex. Server-side monitoring delivers push notifications and Telegram messages, with quiet hours and alert history. A free crypto threshold calculator explores historical observations for market monitoring.

name: Douze Salles
tagline: Free seeded 12-room dungeon maps for tabletop RPG preparation
description: Free browser-based tabletop RPG dungeon generator. Each seed creates a connected 12-room map that can be regenerated, shared by URL, printed, or exported as SVG. The site includes a free four-page, system-agnostic adventure sample. The generator and adventure text were produced with AI assistance and validated structurally; no human playtest is claimed.

name: FaceRater
tagline: Free face rating with 478 landmarks and measurements you can inspect
description: FaceRater is a free face rating tool: upload one clear photo, get a score out of 10, ten labeled measurements, and a map from 478 facial landmarks. Free analysis runs on your device — no account or card. Optional one-time reports go deeper with 44 measurements across 7 regions, styling ideas, and a practical plan.

name: AI Context Bridge
tagline: Bring open browser tabs directly into AI chats — no copy-paste needed
description: AI Context Bridge is a Chromium browser extension that brings open browser tabs directly into AI chats. Type @ in your chat input, select one or more tabs, and their content is inserted as context — no copy-paste, no window switching. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Doubao, Kimi, Qwen, Grok and Muse. Free core features, no account required.

name: VoiceWarp
tagline: Free browser-based real-time voice changer
description: VoiceWarp is a free, browser-based voice changer. Open voicewarp.ai, allow microphone access, and change your voice in real time, or upload an audio file and apply effects such as robot, 8-bit, vocoder, anime, deep voice and reverse audio. No download and no account needed. It is made for gamers, streamers, online calls and content creators, and audio stays private in the browser session.

name: AION2 Forge
tagline: Free AION 2 Sorcerer skill and Stigma planner for Global level 45
description: AION2 Forge is an independent fan-made build planner for AION 2 Global Sorcerers at level 45. Check shared active/passive skill points and separate Stigma costs, account for owned bonus ranks, and compare two starter templates for solo play and fresh-level-45 group PvE. Drafts and named builds stay on your device; build links can be shared without signing in. Includes leveling guidance and transparent source notes. Free to use, unofficial, and not a DPS optimizer.

name: EasePaint
tagline: Browser image editor with AI cleanup and free everyday image utilities
description: EasePaint by EaseSoft Limited brings image editing into the browser for product photos, social content and everyday tasks. AI features include object removal, background removal, ID photos, upscaling and restoration of old photos. Compression, cropping, conversion, adding watermarks, GIF creation and filters are free without an account. AI features use credits or Pro at $9.99/month or $79/year, with 300 monthly credits that expire each month.

name: DeepSwapAI
tagline: Online AI face-swap studio for photo, batch, group-photo, video, and GIF.
description: DeepSwapAI is an online AI face-swap studio for photo, batch, group-photo, video, and GIF. Preview free without signing up; earn trial credits after verification; buy one-time credits for watermark-free future image exports—no subscription.

name: UrbanBytez Email and DNS Security Check
tagline: Check public email and DNS security records for your business domain
description: A free browser-based check of public DNS and email-security records such as SPF, DKIM, DMARC and related configuration signals for small businesses. Results are informational and point to a bounded professional assessment when expert review is needed.

name: Collatavo Print-Ready PDF Checker
tagline: Check trim size, bleed, embedded fonts and page count in your browser
description: A free on-device PDF readiness checker for event programs, signage and production files. It reports page count, trim size, bleed indicators and embedded-font readiness without uploading files. Collatavo also offers a clearly scoped paid production package. The checker is informational and does not guarantee printer acceptance.

name: CrewCentral
tagline: Scheduling, hiring, onboarding and training for shift-based teams
description: CrewCentral connects scheduling, hiring, onboarding and training for shift-based teams, including restaurants, cafes and bars. Managers can plan shifts around roles and availability, review AI-assisted schedule drafts before publishing, and track onboarding and training progress. A free browser-based schedule maker lets teams build a manual roster without an account, print it, export CSV and reuse the week.

name: HustleFin
tagline: Free small business calculators for pricing, quotes, invoices and cash flow
description: HustleFin offers free browser-based finance tools for small businesses and freelancers. Calculate profit margin, markup, selling prices and break-even points, set freelance rates, generate quotes, invoices and receipts, and plan cash flow or runway. No signup is required.

name: QuizQuip
tagline: Quick personality, friend and pop culture quizzes with shareable result cards
description: QuizQuip is a free quiz site with short personality, friendship, pop culture and challenge quizzes. Finish a quiz in a couple of minutes, get a result card and share it with friends to compare answers. Works in any browser on phone or desktop.

name: StatOrigin
tagline: Free, sourced industry statistics with publisher, report and quote for every number
description: StatOrigin collects verified statistics for 32 industries, from healthcare to insurance. Every number carries its publisher, the report it came from and the exact quote, so writers, analysts and students can check and cite it. Free to browse and cite, with a free JSON API.

name: KENSHIN WORKS Free Tools
tagline: 43 free browser tools for practical work
description: A Japanese collection of 43 free practical browser tools, including CSV checking and estimate preparation. Try them without registration. The site separately labels 7 fictional demos and offers business improvement and web production services.

name: VOVE ID
tagline: AI-powered identity verification and KYB solutions for secure digital onboarding and compliance.
description: VOVE ID provides AI-driven identity verification and KYC/KYB solutions for businesses across Africa and the Middle East. The platform supports secure digital onboarding through identity document verification, OCR, data matching, biometric verification, and business verification workflows, including UBO checks. With API and SDK integrations, VOVE ID helps fintechs, digital banks, payment providers, and other businesses streamline customer and business verification.

name: Figuro
tagline: Free online calculators and useful tools for everyday calculations
description: Figuro is a free online calculator website offering simple and easy-to-use tools for everyday calculations, including math, finance, conversions, percentages, and more.

name: tta1
tagline: Listen to any article, in your language
description: tta1 turns web articles, X threads, PDFs, Word docs and screenshots into natural speech. Menus and ads are stripped out, and content in another language is translated first. 30 voices, 25 languages. Free tier, Plus from $6/mo.

name: UNLISPACE
tagline: A social home for creators and communities
description: UNLISPACE is a social publishing platform for creators and communities. Bring your story, selected work and updates into a public space, invite conversation, and enable appointment bookings when needed. Spacey can help prepare editable page content, while Studio gives owners manual control. Use the space alongside your existing social channels to give visitors context and a clear next step.

name: Decibel Meter Lab
tagline: Free online decibel meter in your browser
description:
Decibel Meter Lab is a free browser-based audio testing platform for measuring sound, analyzing frequencies, and troubleshooting audio equipment without installing software.

It includes a real-time decibel meter, spectrum analyzer, tone generator, microphone test, speaker test, headphone test, bass and subwoofer test, stereo checks, phase testing, frequency sweeps, and noise generators.

Everything runs directly in a modern web browser, making it useful for everyday users, musicians, creators, students, home-studio users, audio enthusiasts, and technicians who need quick and accessible sound-testing tools.

No account, download, or complicated setup is required.

name: FormCourier CRM Pro
tagline: Connect WordPress forms to CRM without Zapier
description: FormCourier CRM Pro connects Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms and Forminator to HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho CRM, Bitrix24 and other CRMs. Map fields, track lead sources, queue submissions, retry delivery and review logs without custom code.

name: WorkplaceReady
tagline: Business evidence and readiness for small businesses
description: WorkplaceReady helps small businesses turn published guidance and real operating facts into clearer readiness evidence. It covers AI use, cybersecurity, heat, power outages and flooding with practical tools, plain-language resources and paid business-specific assessments and Operating Packs. It is not legal advice and does not provide certification or compliance guarantees.

name: Shirt Lab
tagline: Turn a personal idea into an editable custom-shirt design.
description: Shirt Lab is an online custom T-shirt design studio for personal ideas, gifts and community merch. Users can create AI-assisted artwork or bring original artwork, refine typography and placement, preview their design on a garment and review product choices before ordering printed shirts. Paid AI usage, memberships and shirt purchases are available; customers review the applicable prices before checkout.

name: GenHealth
tagline: AI agents for healthcare operations and revenue cycle workflows
description: GenHealth uses AI agents to automate administrative work across healthcare operations, including patient intake, eligibility verification, prior authorization, billing, resupply, stock and bill, and denials. Agents work across existing EHRs, payer portals, fax, and phone workflows, helping healthcare teams coordinate and review work in one place.

name: Veemo AI
tagline: AI video and image creation in one workspace
description: Veemo AI brings text-to-video, image-to-video, text-to-image, and AI image editing into one online workspace for creators and marketing teams.

name: AskLex
tagline: Legal research and document tools for Sri Lankan practice.
description: AskLex is a Sri Lankan legal intelligence platform for researching judgments and legislation and working with legal documents. It brings research and document tools into one workspace, with sources users can open and check. Legal professionals remain responsible for evaluating the material and its application to their work.

name: Currawong
tagline: China supplier name, company-code and business-scope checks
description: Currawong provides web tools for small importers, procurement teams and researchers checking a China supplier. Free tools help find candidate Chinese company names, check an 18-character Unified Social Credit Code, and screen registered business-scope wording. Names and shop links are sent for a candidate search; code and wording checks run in the browser. A match or passing code does not confirm registration, factory capability or supplier reliability. Separate paid reports use a licensed business-information source when available, with dated findings and stated gaps; a manual official-source recheck is available by arrangement. The site uses basic analytics. Submitted by Bao L. Zhou (Derrick Zhou), Currawong.

name: Kaboomly
tagline: Explore nuclear effects on an interactive city map
description: Kaboomly is a browser-based educational map that visualizes approximate nuclear blast, heat and initial radiation effects over real cities. Choose a location and historical yield, compare effect rings and share a scenario. Calculations use published sources and include limitations; it is not a targeting or civil-defense tool. The core simulator is free without an account, with optional one-time Pro features.

name: DIRI AI
tagline: Practise a clearer response before your next sales call.
description: DIRI AI is an AI call-practice tool for individual salespeople preparing difficult customer conversations. Rehearse sales objections and practise one improvement goal before a real call. Free written guides offer short, practical exercises; the product has paid subscription plans.

name: Monytra
tagline: Free uptime monitoring for agencies
description: Free uptime monitoring for websites and APIs. Checks every 5 to 60 minutes, downtime alerts, SSL expiry warnings, and public status pages. Free to start, no credit card.

name: Zombie AI
tagline: Early-access zombie love-story video project for people and pets
description: Zombie AI is an early-access web project for creating zombie-themed love-story videos from two reference photos of people or pets. Its public site includes reference videos, scene templates and prompt guides. Planned video packs are one-time purchases. Generation and payments are not open yet.

name: Omegatools
tagline: Work Smarter with OmegaTools.
description: OmegaTools is a free collection of fast, privacy-focused online tools for PDF, images, developers, calculators, and everyday tasks. Many tools run directly in your browser, helping you resize, compress, convert, edit, and manage files without unnecessary uploads.

name: CheapGamesFinder
tagline: every store, one chart
description: Free game price comparison across official PC and console stores — best price first, never commission. Compare live prices across 12 official storefronts, view price history, and get deal alerts — we are not a retailer.

name: ReportForge
tagline: Productized GA4 / Ads / Meta client reporting packs for boutique agencies.
description: ReportForge is a productized reporting service for boutique marketing agencies: weekly or monthly client packs covering GA4, Google Ads, and Meta, with human QA and a reusable setup pack. Built for agency AMs who hate Sunday-night slide decks. Fit call via Upwork; payment via Gumroad/PayPal — no Stripe.

name: StayLedger
tagline: Airbnb & Vrbo host profit tracker for Google Sheets and Excel — $19 one-time.
description: StayLedger helps Airbnb and Vrbo hosts see what each stay actually leaves them after platform fees, cleaning collected vs cleaner paid, and operating expenses. Includes monthly/YTD P&L, per-property rollup, and an editable quarterly tax set-aside estimate. Works in Google Sheets and Excel — no macros, no subscription. Bookkeeping aid, not tax advice.

name: BookCoverAI
tagline: Create Kindle, paperback, and hardcover cover concepts for Amazon KDP with AI.
description: BookCoverAI free Amazon KDP book cover generator helps self-published authors create Kindle, paperback, and hardcover cover concepts with AI. It supports KDP-oriented details such as trim size, page count, spine width, bleed, safe zones, back-cover text, and export preparation.

name: Inbox Tally
tagline: Compare email platform costs for your list size and sending frequency.
description: Free email marketing cost calculator comparing published plans by subscriber count and emails sent per subscriber each month. Compare monthly or annual billing across platforms including Mailchimp, Kit, MailerLite, beehiiv and Brevo, with send limits included. No account required.

name: Workflow Math
tagline: Compare automation costs using your actual workflow runs and steps.
description: Free calculator comparing automation costs on Zapier, Make, n8n Cloud, Activepieces, Pabbly Connect and Integrately. Enter monthly workflow runs, action steps and trigger frequency to compare plans using each platform’s task, credit or execution counting rules. No account required.

name: Carnage Commander
tagline: A fast-paced browser arena FPS — fight through three arenas, free to play.
description: Carnage Commander is a fast-paced arena shooter that runs right in your browser. Fight through three operations — Sunfall, the Cistern and Iron Furnace — clear the waves, take down each arena's boss and reach the way out. Switch between three weapons (Breaker, Ripper and Hellfire), sprint, jump and keep moving. Play with WASD and the mouse; no download needed.

name: PullBull
tagline: Live auctions marketplace for trading card collectors
description: PullBull is a marketplace for buying and selling trading cards (Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh!, sports cards and more) through timed auctions. Collectors list cards, bid, and contact sellers directly. Early pre-launch.

name: EasyHEIC
tagline: Free and fast online HEIC to PNG converter
description: EasyHEIC is a free online HEIC to PNG converter that makes it easy to convert HEIC and HEIF images into PNG files. It works directly in the browser and requires no software installation or account.

name: Folksoft
tagline: Your compliance co-founder
description:
### Company Description — Folksoft

> Folksoft is a managed GRC and compliance platform helping startups and growing SaaS companies simplify security and compliance. Folksoft combines automation, autonomous remediation, and dedicated GRC guidance to support frameworks including SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR. From compliance readiness and evidence collection to audit preparation and continuous compliance, Folksoft helps teams reduce manual work, strengthen security practices, and stay audit-ready as they grow.

name: AcreSketch
tagline: Free property measurement and outdoor project planning tools
description: AcreSketch helps homeowners, land buyers, DIYers and contractors measure property and lot area, calculate acreage and perimeter, test project footprints, and estimate fencing, sod and gravel requirements directly in the browser.

name: NovaReach
tagline: AI- powered marketing automation & Lead generation platform
description: `NovaReach is an AI-powered marketing automation platform for lead generation, customer engagement, social media, CRM, SEO, and automated marketing workflows.`

name: LinoRoute
tagline: One gateway for multi-model AI API access
description: LinoRoute gives developers and businesses a unified AI API gateway for DeepSeek, Claude, GPT and Gemini. It helps manage model access, API keys and usage when building AI applications, with usage-based paid billing.

name: MacClean
tagline: Review Mac disk usage, WeChat media and Xcode caches before cleaning
description: I’m the developer of MacClean, a macOS 14+ desktop app for finding what takes up disk space. It lets you review WeChat photos and videos or Xcode build caches before selecting items to clean. Scanning remains free, with a 7-day trial of the full cleanup features; cleaning after the trial needs a one-time paid license.

name: CreatorScout HQ
tagline: Find the right UGC creators for SaaS, mobile apps and ecommerce
description: CreatorScout HQ helps brands shortlist UGC creators by campaign goal, video format, budget and creative style. It also includes a free Creator Matcher to quickly find suitable creators without signup.

name: CarProbs
tagline: Compare used-car model years with public NHTSA complaint and recall records
description: CarProbs organizes public NHTSA complaint and recall records for used-car research. Search by make, model and year to compare reported problems, component breakdowns, safety severity, failure mileage and recall campaigns. The site includes model-year reports, rankings, years-to-avoid guides, source links and a documented methodology. Its free recall tool supports model-year research and links to the official NHTSA lookup for VIN-specific status. CarProbs is independent of NHTSA; the reports describe recorded patterns and do not predict an individual vehicle's condition or replace a pre-purchase inspection.

name: CiteFormat
tagline: ABNT references, document formatting and academic rewriting in your browser
description: CiteFormat helps students and researchers prepare Brazilian academic work in ABNT style. Generate references from source details, DOI, ISBN or a link, format text into a downloadable DOCX document, and revise paragraphs into a more formal academic register. Reference generation is free and unlimited. An account includes 10 free document-formatting uses per month and an initial 1,000-word rewriting allowance; paid packages and plans expand usage. Designed for thesis and TCC workflows, with browser-based tools and guides for checking references and formatting.

name: Bidquin
tagline: Discover great projects. Rank higher. Get noticed.
description: Bidquin is a project ranking and discovery platform for founders, SaaS makers and AI builders. List your project for free, discover useful tools, and optionally compete for greater visibility on the public leaderboard.

name: WARDOGS Fieldguide
tagline: Fan-made WARDOGS guides and free loadout budgeting tools
description: WARDOGS Fieldguide is an unofficial companion for WARDOGS players. Its free browser tools include a loadout planner, a Cost of a Death equipment-budget calculator and a field test log. Source-labelled guides explain the Control Zone, ammunition, cash economy and equipment, alongside dated game updates. The site is fan-made and is not affiliated with BULKHEAD or Team17.

name: Only the Overs
tagline: Affordable NFL/NHL DFS builders, projections & PrizePicks research
description: Only the Overs helps DFS and pick'em players research NFL (and NHL) slates with lineup builders, inspectable projections, PrizePicks research workflows, and educational guides. Free signup with no credit card. Founding Premium is $17.76/mo if you subscribe before Jan 1, 2027. Process over hype; play responsibly.

name: RakuMovie
tagline: Turn a business photo into a finished promotional video
description: RakuMovie turns a business photo and short brief into a finished vertical promotional video for small businesses. It handles structure, on-screen text, music and narration, so customers can receive a finished file without using a timeline editor. The first 15-second video is free once per business, with no card required. Paid single-video orders and optional monthly plans are available. Public examples marked as fictional are demonstrations, not customer testimonials or evidence of sales results.

name: Novastart
tagline: Novastart brings apps and files onto an infinite canvas where people and AI agents can work together.
description: Infinite canvas OS — Chrome, ChatGPT, Claude, Word, Excel, and files on one whiteboard; shared canvases; AI agents with their own cursors and keyboards.

name: Seedance 2.5 AI
tagline: Create AI videos from text, images, and references
description: Seedance 2.5 AI is a web-based video generator for text prompts, still images, and reference sets. Create clips, adjust aspect ratio, resolution, and duration, then download the result. Generation uses credits; users need a credit pack or membership, and downloads have no watermark.

name: AIChangeHair
tagline: Try hairstyle and color changes on your portrait
description: AIChangeHair is a web-based editor for previewing hairstyle and hair-color changes on a portrait. Choose from presets or describe a custom look, recolor hair, and generate an AI hair report. A free tier offers signup and daily-claim credits; sign-in is required before generation, with paid subscriptions and one-time credit packs available.

name: AIClothSwap
tagline: Preview outfit swaps with AI virtual try-on
description: AIClothSwap is a web-based virtual try-on studio for adults (18+) to preview outfit swaps on a person photo. Upload a person image and a garment or full-look reference to see clothing changes. Higher-quality modes also accept text instructions for outfit, background, and pose edits. A free tier with recurring credits is available; sign-in is required before generation.

name: LarkKit
tagline: Free online tools, done right.
description: LarkKit is a collection of free online tools that run entirely in the browser with no sign-up: building-material calculators (concrete, paver, mulch, decking), a ring size chart, a depreciation schedule calculator, and image tools (SVG to PNG, DPI converter, image splitter, PNG/JPG to SVG). Everything is free with no usage limits.

name: Statementoy
tagline: Review bank and credit-card statements before CSV or Excel export
description: Statementoy converts English USD bank and credit-card statement files in PDF, PNG, or JPEG formats into structured transaction data. Review rows beside the source, check balances, and export CSV or Excel for a manual QuickBooks or Xero CSV workflow.

name: Dearovo
tagline: Natural AI-assisted relationship message writing
description: Dearovo helps people create natural, ready-to-send messages for everyday relationship moments, with situation-aware suggestions plus tone and length controls.

name: Cotizá bien
tagline: Calculá presupuestos freelance según tu objetivo neto, horas, costos y comisiones.
description: Calculadora gratuita para freelancers de Latinoamérica: estimá el precio bruto necesario para cubrir tu ingreso neto, horas, costos directos, comisión de cobro y margen para imprevistos. Funciona en el navegador, sin registro; ofrece además un kit opcional de plantillas editables por ARS 31.300.

name: Sprita
tagline: Create animated sprite sheets from a prompt or character image
description: Sprita is a web-based AI sprite sheet and character animation tool for 2D game development. Start with a text prompt or an existing character image, generate a short motion, then extract, clean, align, and inspect individual frames. Preview the animation and export a fixed-grid PNG sprite sheet. Cloud generation uses credits, while importing, frame extraction, background cleanup, frame inspection, animation preview, and PNG export are available without generation credits. A verified account can complete one Starter-tier sprite project for free. New paid purchases are currently paused.

name: UnfollowKit
tagline: Free TikTok unfollowers tracker with no password or data upload required
description: UnfollowKit helps TikTok creators find accounts that do not follow them back and track follower changes over time. It runs from the browser, does not ask for a TikTok password, and does not require users to upload a TikTok data file.

name: Kydale Outley
tagline: Art to assets
description: I help you turn your art into assets , taking the basic form and monetizing it in multiple ways

name: Mail Tracer
tagline: Email open tracking for Apple Mail on iPhone
description: Know when your emails are opened — without leaving Apple Mail. Mail Tracer is an iOS email tracker with real-time push notifications, open history, and device/location signals. Connect iCloud, Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, AOL, or Exchange through Apple Mail. Free basic tracking available.

name: Yeri AI
tagline: Yeri AI brings still images, reference edits and video ideas together
description: Yeri AI combines a free AI image generator with tools for editing references and trying video concepts. Begin with a description or a source image, then work on composition, style or an effect without moving to a different creative application. The platform includes text-to-image and image-to-image workflows, video creation, photo effects, background removal and image expansion. This AI image generator is useful when a creator needs to explore several visual directions and refine a chosen result. A daily-credit free tier is available; paid plans provide more usage and features. Free image outputs carry a watermark, so review the plan before production use.

name: DefiLPKit
tagline: Concentrated liquidity calculator: net LP yield after impermanent loss and gas
description: DefiLPKit is a free, read-only web calculator for DeFi liquidity providers. Before you add liquidity, model fees earned on Uniswap v3 and Aerodrome concentrated-liquidity pools against impermanent loss and gas costs. No wallet connect, no custody and no signup needed to run scenarios.

name: Podpisat.sk
tagline: Electronic signatures for Slovak businesses
description: Podpisat.sk is a Slovak e-signature service: upload a document, send it for signing, and collect legally valid electronic signatures online without printing or scanning.

name: ScanChess
tagline: Chess OCR: board photos to FEN, handwritten scoresheets to PGN
description: ScanChess is a web tool for over-the-board chess players, coaches and school clubs. Upload a board screenshot, 2D diagram or top-down photo to get an editable FEN, or upload the pages of a handwritten scoresheet to review the moves and export PGN. The PGN/FEN viewers need no account; image recognition needs sign-in and new accounts get 10 free credits, no card.

name: LongShot
tagline: Turn overlapping screenshots into one long image
description: LongShot stitches overlapping screenshots into one long image on iPhone. After one-time setup of the Shortcut, Photos access and Back Tap, double-tap to stitch supported small batches to Photos without opening LongShot. Larger batches or errors may need the app. Overlap is verified before merging. Screenshot processing stays on-device: no image uploads, no account, no ads. Up to 100 screenshots in-app, subject to device limits. 10 free stitches per month, with an optional one-time lifetime unlock for unlimited exports. No subscription.

name: browsergames.top
tagline: A hand-checked directory of persistent browser games: text MMOs, space empires, idle worlds
description: browsergames.top is a directory of persistent browser-based games: the text MMOs, space empires, crime cities, nation sims, football leagues and idle worlds that keep running after you close the tab. Every one of the 363 listings was visited by a person and written up in plain words, with its genre, play style, pricing and the date we last checked it. Closed games are marked as closed. There are no votes to game and no paid rankings: listings are free, and crypto, cash-prize and shady games are left out. Filter by genre or tag, read the guides on the blog, or submit a game you run.

name: Amo Watch
tagline: Movies, series, and live TV — where to watch, in one place.
description: Amo Watch is a free movie, series, and live TV discovery hub with official apps for web, Android, and Smart TV. It checks availability across 100+ sources, offers a 7-day Pro+ trial after email confirm, QR TV login, and personal short links for TiviMate or VLC. Lite starts from $5.19/month; Amo indexes streams without hosting video files.

name: Yila
tagline: Yila research agent for papers, evidence and editable academic outputs
description: Yila is an academic research workspace for developing a question into material that can be checked and revised. Search scholarly papers, read them bilingually and compare their evidence before drafting a review with citations. This research agent also supports data analysis, scientific figures, posters and presentation slides, so a team can work on both its argument and the way it presents results. It is intended for students and researchers who want connected tools rather than scattered notes. Generated analyses and writing still need human review, particularly sources and methods used in formal academic work.

name: Schole
tagline: Legal / SaaS / Productivity
description: AI-powered labor advisor based on Spanish labor law and collective agreements.

name: ProfitPal
tagline: ree profit calculator for small businesses, sellers, freelancers, and entrepreneurs.
description: ProfitPal helps small businesses, online sellers, freelancers, resellers, and entrepreneurs calculate profit, profit margin, markup, ROI, break-even price, and target selling prices while factoring in business expenses.

name: Flowpaja
tagline: Make.com guides and free templates for small-business automations
description: Flowpaja publishes practical Make.com guides for small businesses: how to build common automations, what they cost in Make credits, and how to fix the errors that stop scenarios. Many guides are also in German, Spanish and French, plus a free printable Make error cheat sheet. Four free templates are approved in Make's public gallery (overdue invoice digest, Google Form to Slack, one quote follow-up draft in Gmail, webhook to Sheets with duplicate check). Paid templates are $19 each or $39 for three. Everything runs in your own Make account.

name: Sodo CRM
tagline: WhatsApp CRM for clinics and sales teams
description: Sodo CRM captures leads from Meta ads, web forms and WhatsApp, assigns each lead to the right representative, sends multilingual first messages from the representative’s own WhatsApp number, translates conversations both ways, and sends conversion events back to Meta. It is built for clinics, health tourism teams and call centers that need faster follow-up and a complete shared sales history.

name: TopClicker
tagline: Minecraft 1.8.8 macro & autoclicker tool for Windows
description: TopClicker is a Windows desktop macro/clicker utility for Minecraft 1.8.8: AFK automation, CPS control and Discord alerts. A tool, not a cheat. Purchase on the official site.

name: KonutUzman
tagline: Kira kontratı hazırlama, ücretsiz ev değerleme ve kira takibi — Türk mülk sahipleri için.
description: Kira kontratı hazırlama (rental contract generator), free home valuation, and rent tracking for Turkish landlords. KonutUzman is SaaS for property owners and landlords: online rental contract PDF (kira sözleşmesi), tenant trust score, tax and DASK insurance reminders. First property is free. Not a real-estate agency or listing portal.

name: LatestQR
tagline: Smart QR Creator
description: LatestQR is a free browser-based QR toolkit for creating practical QR codes for URLs, WiFi, PDFs, UPI payments, WhatsApp, Google Maps locations, reviews and other everyday sharing needs.

name: SOFTYTOOLS
tagline: Free Trading & Investment Calculators
description: SOFTYTOOLS is a free collection of online trading and investment calculators designed to help traders and investors make faster, more informed decisions. Calculate position size, risk and reward, leverage, profit and loss, drawdown, ROI, compound growth, and more. No sign-up required.

name: OneLence
tagline: OneLence helps marketing teams find growth opportunities, know what to do next, and grow more efficiently without simply spending more.
description: OneLence helps small marketing teams find new growth opportunities across SEO, GEO, paid social and affiliate marketing, understand what to do next, and improve marketing efficiency without simply increasing spend. It shows how different marketing sources contribute across the customer journey, highlights where there is untapped potential or wasted budget, and recommends where to invest, optimize, test or cut back. By connecting growth opportunities with clear next steps and source-level insights, OneLence helps brands build a more efficient marketing strategy and get more from the channels and budgets they already have.

name: PrintOnceQR
tagline: Create a QR once and change its destination anytime
description: PrintOnceQR is a simple dynamic QR code service for small businesses and makers. Create and print a QR code once, then update its destination later without reprinting menus, flyers, business cards, event materials, or packaging. A free plan is available, with scan analytics and self-service paid plans for higher limits.

name: SaveFromNet
tagline: Download and convert permitted public media
description: SaveFromNet is a free online downloader for public videos, photos and audio from eight supported platforms. Paste a URL to see the formats the source actually offers, then save content you own or have permission to download.

name: PixelToInch
tagline: Convert pixel dimensions to print sizes using PPI
description: PixelToInch is a free browser calculator for converting pixels to inches and checking print sizes at a chosen PPI. Designers, photographers and students can compare image dimensions, calculate required pixel counts for a desired print size and understand how pixel count relates to physical size. Image dimensions are read locally without uploading the file.

name: HoopTrait
tagline: Build a basketball player one trait at a time
description: Player Lab at HoopTrait is a free basketball player builder. Draft eight traits from a player pool, compare the strengths and trade-offs of your build, and save or share the result. An experiment mode lets fans assign traits freely and explore a fictional ten-season career. Independent fan project; game ratings and simulations are not official NBA ratings or predictions.

name: RetroPrompt
tagline: Create retro AI portraits with 1980s photo prompts
description: RetroPrompt offers free, ready-to-copy 1980s photo prompts and a browser studio for creating retro-inspired AI portraits. Explore vintage styles, copy prompts for your preferred image model or try the studio with a reference photo. Guest generation currently allows up to three successful images per browser per UTC day. Results are AI imagery, not historical photographs.

name: Zelvune
tagline: AI video studio for creators, marketers, and small teams
description: Zelvune is an AI video studio that brings leading video models into one workspace. Create cinematic videos, social clips, product ads, animated visuals, and campaign variations from text prompts, images, or reference clips using Seedance, Kling, Veo 3, Grok Imagine, Hailuo, and other models. Compare models side by side, guide generations with prompts and references, and iterate with clear credit estimates. Start with free credits; no credit card is required.

name: ToolVault
tagline: Free tools for real-world problems
description:
ToolVault is being built as a universal online toolbox rather than a single-purpose calculator site. The long-term goal is to help people calculate, convert, generate, analyze, plan and complete tasks from one fast, accessible place.

Tools will be designed for global use wherever possible, with support for different units, currencies, formats and practical requirements. Localized versions can be added later when a calculation depends on country-specific rules or data.

name: FOMOChat
tagline: AI chat and social-proof widget that turns website visitors into leads
description: FOMOChat adds a live group chat to your website with an AI rep trained on your own site content and help docs. It answers visitor questions in real time, shows new visitors that other people are already engaging (social proof), captures leads, and lets your team take over any conversation. Install with one script tag; supports 19 languages and can sync chat to an on-page video or webinar. Free Preview Mode with no credit card (100 lifetime visitors, all features, FOMOchat branding); paid plans start at $29/month.

name: Stivio
tagline: Turn any photo into a living, moving HD video in minutes
description: Stivio is an AI image-to-video generator. Upload any photo and turn it into a living, moving HD video in minutes. Powered by Kling O3, Kling 2.6, Wan 2.6, MiniMax H3 and Seedance models. Shows exact credit cost before generation, outputs 3-30 second HD MP4, auto-refunds credits on failure. Sign in with Google to get 10 free credits, first video free.

name: Delivety
tagline: All-in-one food ordering, POS, kitchen and delivery management platform
description: Delivety is an all-in-one food ordering and delivery management platform for restaurants, cloud kitchens, virtual restaurants, cafés, and delivery marketplaces. It combines online ordering, POS and CRM workflows, kitchen and assembly displays, menu and recipe management, courier tracking, route optimization, reporting, and data export. Teams can use it in any modern browser, launch a hosted ordering website, and connect other systems through its API.

name: tools.zgba.com
tagline: AI Tools Hub — a free, no-signup directory of AI tools and online utilities
description: tools.zgba.com — A free, no-signup AI tools directory with 300+ high-star open-source AI projects from GitHub, 86 free online utilities (image compressor, mortgage calculator, kinship-name calculator, etc.), plus in-depth reviews and side-by-side comparisons. Updated regularly.

name: Pocket Invoice
tagline: Free invoices, estimates and business PDFs, with MCP access
description: Pocket Invoice gives freelancers and small service businesses a free way to create invoices, estimates, quotes, receipts and purchase orders. Create a document online without signing up, add your business and customer details, enter line items and export a PDF. The web, iOS and Android apps can save customers, items and templates, organize multiple companies and record paid or outstanding invoices. For authorized AI workflows, the hosted MCP connection lets an assistant prepare invoice and estimate PDFs and query business records. It uses OAuth, respects company permissions and has been tested with Codex. Sending requires confirmation; recording a payment does not move money. There is no subscription or paid plan.

name: My Look Story
tagline: Explore your look, edit photos and create visuals with AI
description: My Look Story is a photo-first AI workspace for exploring your appearance, editing images, and creating visual content. Start with your own photo to preview hairstyles, create professional headshots, try artistic photo filters, and edit backgrounds. Free hairstyle previews and credit-based AI generation are available. Supported tools offer single-photo and batch workflows. AI results can vary with the input photo and should be reviewed for likeness and unwanted changes before use.

name: Westwood AI Dental Recall
tagline: Managed AI recall calls for UK dental practices.
description: Westwood AI Dental Recall is a managed recall-calling service for UK dental practices. It works alongside each practice's existing process. Calls use an agreed recall list and a practice-approved conversation. The service records call outcomes and agreed appointment times. It sends them through a configured email or webhook handoff. Westwood sets up the campaign, calling windows, and approved call behaviour before calls begin. Practices can review outcomes and costs. Pricing is £500 one-off setup, £150 per month, and approximately 20p per call.

name: Figran
tagline: Scientific illustrations, editable flowcharts and data plots
description: Figran helps researchers, students and educators create scientific illustrations from research descriptions, sketches and reference images, with text-guided revisions. Its separate canvas supports editable flowcharts and CSV-based data plots for explaining scientific mechanisms, experimental workflows and research results in papers, presentations and teaching. Generated illustrations remain raster PNG images; canvas flowcharts and plots support SVG export for signed-in users. Eligible accounts receive limited free credits, with paid plans and credit packs for additional usage. Users should review scientific labels, relationships and journal AI policies. Submitted by an AI assistant authorized by the website owner.

name: FailFlow
tagline: Free date, countdown & calendar calculators
description: FailFlow provides free online date, calendar, countdown and planning tools — no signup required. Calculate days between dates, count down to events, track week numbers, quarters and holidays.

name: Tuck
tagline: Hide and arrange Mac menu bar icons
description: Tuck is a free, GPL-3.0 macOS menu-bar manager. It lets users hide, show, search, and arrange menu bar icons, including a Tuck Bar for notched displays. Tuck has no telemetry and does not require sign-up.

name: Outbound for Mac
tagline: Choose which Mac apps can connect, and to which hosts. Alert
description: Outbound is an outbound application firewall for Mac. It shows which apps reach the internet, where each connection goes, and lets you decide which connections are allowed. Rules and connection history stay local, with no account and no analytics. Outbound is available as a personal one-time purchase with a 30-day trial.

name: Napless
tagline: Free menu bar app: keep your Mac awake for a set time or until you stop. Pro holds it through downloads, calls, exports, backups and agent runs.
description: Napless is a macOS keep-awake app for work that must continue without interruption. Start a timed session or keep your Mac awake while a task runs, then let it sleep when the session is complete. The free app provides timed keep-awake sessions; Napless Pro can watch downloads, calls, exports, backups, and agent runs. Napless supports macOS 13 or later on Apple silicon and Intel Macs.

name: Taijora
tagline: AI BaZi (Chinese astrology) tool for fast chart reading and interpretation
description: Taijora is an AI BaZi (Four Pillars of Destiny) app for Traditional Chinese users. Enter your birth date and time to get a clear BaZi chart and an AI-written reading.

name: NeoEHS
tagline: AI-Powered EHS & ESG Management Software
description: NeoEHS is an AI-powered Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS) and ESG management platform that helps organizations manage workplace safety, risk, incidents, hazards, inspections, audits, compliance, corrective actions, environmental processes, and safety performance in one centralized system. It helps EHS teams digitize workflows, improve visibility, monitor safety actions, and support data-driven safety decisions.

name: Nice One CRM
tagline: Find Leads - turn them into paid work. Get your admin sorted!
description: Nice One CRM is a simple CRM for small businesses that helps you manage enquiries, customers, follow-ups, quotes, invoices and daily tasks in one easy dashboard. It also includes Lead Finder to help you discover new business opportunities and keep potential customers organised.

name: QuickCalcsUS
tagline: 5,000+ free online calculators
description: QuickCalcsUS is a free online calculator library with 5,000+ calculators across 28 categories, including finance, math, health, construction, and unit converters. Every tool is 100% free with no sign-up — just open a calculator, enter your numbers, and get a fast, accurate result in your browser, anytime.

name: Klarivo
tagline: Track and grow how ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini mention your brand
description: Klarivo is an AI search and GenAI brand-visibility platform. It tracks how often and how accurately your brand appears in answers from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and other AI assistants, benchmarks you against competitors, and shows marketers what to change so AI engines cite and recommend them more.

name: Avocadio
tagline: AI video maker for short cinematic clips
description: Avocadio turns prompts into short cinematic videos with Text to Video, Image to Video, starter prompts, and a simple credits flow.

name: Early AF
tagline: Market research and a scored Reddit/X reply queue for solo app builders.
description: Early AF is market research and marketing guidance for solo app builders. Pick a realistic opportunity from dated evidence, understand who needs it, and show up in conversations worth answering yourself. You get a free reviewed daily idea, a research path from real complaints and workarounds to a first experiment, and Reply Radar: a Chrome extension that scores public Reddit (optional X) posts for audience fit and queues them for manual reply. Honest limits: no auto-reply, no DM blasts, not a full marketing suite.

name: Gestión Animal
tagline: Software para criaderos en España
description: Gestión Animal es un software para criaderos en España (animales, camadas, salud, clientes y ventas). Página del producto: https://gestionanimal.es/gestion-animal . Precio: 18,99 € al mes por criadero, IVA incluido.

name: ReelDance
tagline: Multiple AI models for image and video creation
description:
ReelDance is a web platform that brings together multiple AI models for creating images and videos. It gives creators, designers, and marketers a choice of generation models within the same workspace, whether they are developing a still visual or a short video scene.

Users can generate images from text prompts, create videos from written descriptions, or use an existing image as the starting frame for a video. Choose the model and supported generation settings for the task, then preview and download completed results. Possible uses include exploring visual styles, developing product concepts, and creating assets for social content and marketing projects.

Every new user receives 5 free credits on signup. Generation uses credits, and the amount required depends on the selected task and settings.

name: AstroPredict
tagline: AI-powered palm, face, and Vedic astrology readings.
description: AstroPredict combines AI with Hast Samudrika palmistry, Samudrika face reading, and Vedic Jyotish. Start with a free palm scan, face scan, kundli, or daily forecast without signing up. Unlock detailed personal reports with life-area readings, timing, and remedies through one-time purchases.

name: SermonLingo
tagline: Live sermon captions and natural AI translation on every listener’s phone.
description: SermonLingo gives churches live captions in 54 languages and natural AI voice in 13. Guests scan a QR code and follow on their own phones without installing an app or creating an account. Connect a microphone, mixer, or RTMP/SRT stream; export transcripts and subtitles after the service. Start with 4 free hours.

name: DielineMaker
tagline: Create print-ready packaging dielines and 3D mockups in your browser.
description: Generate and customize packaging dielines from 1,024 parametric templates. Design each panel, preview the fold in 3D, and export production-ready PDF, SVG, and DXF files. Includes realistic mockup scenes and print production details.

name: My Property Pages
tagline: Single property websites and WhatsApp lead capture for agents
description: My Property Pages helps real estate agents create a mobile-friendly page for each property and an agent profile that brings their listings together. Property pages support photos, property details, brochures, video and enquiry forms. Agents can share each page in social ads, WhatsApp and their bio, then manage enquiries in a leads inbox with push notifications and one-tap contact actions. The free plan includes two property pages. Paid plans add more pages, follow-up tools, team access and CRM features; the Agency plan supports custom domains and owner reports.

name: Lobbee – Hotel Lobby AI Video Generator
tagline: Turn two portrait photos into a 5–15s Hotel Lobby AI rap video with audio
description: Lobbee is a free-to-try Hotel Lobby AI tool: upload two clear portraits and render a 5–15 second duo rap performance on the orange booth, with original audio. Choose 9:16, 16:9 or 1:1 up to 1080p. Daily check-in credits, then paid packs if you need more. Try the Hotel Lobby AI video generator at https://lobbeeai.com/.

name: GoGallery
tagline: Private client galleries for confirmed photo selections
description: GoGallery is a web-based photo-selection tool for photographers. Upload a session, share protected gallery access, and receive a confirmed final list of client favorites. Clients can browse and choose photos from a phone without installing an app or creating a client account. Galleries show watermarked selection copies while original files stay outside the client-facing gallery. Photographers can organize sessions, track selection status, and receive the final selection by email. Paid Starter and Pro plans are available, starting at $9 per month, with a three-day trial for $1.

name: FacturApp
tagline: Branded invoices and Stripe payment links
description: FacturApp is invoicing software for freelancers and independent businesses. Create branded PDF invoices, save clients and services, manage multiple businesses, and share Stripe payment links. Choose invoice templates and colors for each brand, then export invoices as A4 PDFs. Annual access is listed at US$39.99.

name: SEOLOK
tagline: Google rank tracking and actionable SEO insights in English and Turkish
description: SEOLOK helps small businesses, website owners, SEO freelancers and agencies track Google rankings and turn SEO data into prioritized actions. Its free rank checker measures keyword positions by country, city and device. The platform combines Google Search Console and Google Analytics data with daily keyword tracking, competitor analysis, ranking drop alerts and downloadable PDF reports. Available in English and Turkish, with free tools and paid tracking plans.

name: superagnt_
tagline: One MCP endpoint for any agent: data, scraping, Postgres, memory, queues, and inbox.
description: superagnt_ is an agent toolkit for builders. Connect Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client to one endpoint (https://mcp.superagnt.com/mcp) and your agent gets social and web data (LinkedIn, X, Reddit, YouTube, SEO), lead and company enrichment, web scraping, a real Postgres database, persistent memory, file storage, queues, webhooks, schedules, and an inbox. One API key, credits metered per call, usable over MCP or plain REST.

name: StudyKernel
tagline: IT certification lessons, quizzes and a clear study roadmap
description: StudyKernel helps learners prepare for IT certifications with short lessons, quizzes, explanations and study roadmaps. Courses include CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+ and Microsoft AZ-900. Course lessons, lesson quizzes and module checkpoints are free, with 10 extra practice questions each day. Optional Pro adds unlimited extra practice, flashcards, timed practice sets and detailed topic insights for £6.99/month or £59.99/year. Independent study material; not affiliated with exam vendors.

name: Zigzigo
tagline: Free browser games for a quick play break
description: Zigzigo is a free browser-game portal for people looking for a quick play break. Browse puzzle, arcade, racing, sports and strategy categories, then open a game with its instructions and provider information. No app download or Zigzigo account is required. Individual game providers may show ads. Submitted on behalf of Zigzigo; third-party games remain credited to their providers.

name: One Calculator App
tagline: calculator,  calculators , finance,  education,  developer tools, Subnet calculator, EMI
description: One Calculator App is a comprehensive, free online platform that provides a wide range of accurate and fast calculation tools entirely in your browser. It requires no sign-up and features zero ads, ensuring complete data privacy since all calculations happen locally without storing user inputs.

name: B2B AI SOFT
tagline: AI sales automation for service businesses that responds to leads 24/7 and turns inquiries into qualified CRM leads
description: B2B AI SOFT builds AI sales systems for service businesses. It responds to inbound and social-media leads 24/7, qualifies needs, budget and timeline, stores conversation context and lead status in CRM, and hands qualified opportunities to managers. Suitable for real estate, travel, auto sales, clinics, experts and other service businesses.

name: MapxProp
tagline: Search property in Thailand by location and post sale or rental listings for free
description:
MapxProp helps buyers and renters find property in Thailand by location. It brings together houses, condos, land, monthly rentals and commercial spaces with prices, photos and property details.

Visitors can browse listings on an interactive map, compare nearby properties and explore project and agency pages. Listings include the publisher's contact options so interested visitors can ask questions and arrange viewings directly.

Property owners and agencies can currently publish sale or rental listings for free, without a credit card. MapxProp also publishes Thai guides about preparing listings and comparing properties. Property availability and prices depend on the listing publisher.

name: PlanoNest
tagline: Excel, Google Sheets & Notion templates for budgeting, bookkeeping and business planning
description: PlanoNest is an independent digital template shop with 100+ ready-to-use Excel, Google Sheets and Notion templates for personal budgeting, small-business bookkeeping, business planning and productivity. Every template ships with step-by-step instructions, is delivered as an instant download, and is sold as a one-time purchase via Stripe checkout with a 14-day refund policy.

name: Fabbo
tagline: Turn prompts and reference images into videos and visual assets
description: Fabbo gives creators a browser workspace for AI video and image production. Generate videos from written prompts or reference images, create and edit images, and explore different models and video effects. It suits content creators, designers and teams developing visual ideas. New users can try the studio with free signup credits, with paid plans available for additional generation credits.

name: PandaFileKit
tagline: Free online PDF, image, and file tools with no signup.
description: PandaFileKit helps users finish everyday file tasks quickly: compress PDFs and images, resize photos, convert JPG to PDF, convert PDF pages to images, merge and split PDFs, and prepare upload-ready files from one simple online toolkit.

name: the wired
tagline: a text-focused social network with early web vibes.
description: the wired is an independent, international social network styled like a terminal into a shared digital world. conversations unfold in “layers,” spaces for music, technology, gaming, personal thoughts, or any other topic. explore the collective feed, join a layer, and share text, links, and discoveries. its dark interface and early-web spirit give it a distinctive cyberpunk atmosphere. the community is still small, so activity varies across layers.

name: Cutroom AI Video Editor
tagline: AI video editor that cuts by chat — approve the plan, then render
description: Cutroom is a chat-based AI video editor for creators and teams who want finished cuts without living inside a timeline. Upload your footage and describe the outcome — tighter pacing, filler removal, captions, color, music, or motion overlays. The agent builds a word-aligned edit plan you can preview, and only renders after you approve. Free credits for new accounts; no credit card required.

name: LaunchMyHustle
tagline: Find a local service side hustle and launch a lead-capture page
description: LaunchMyHustle helps beginners choose from 32 local service business ideas, or bring their own idea, and get online with a hosted lead-capture landing page. Ready-made templates, email lead notifications, CSV exports and simple stats help users launch and manage their pages without technical skills. The paid plan is $19 per month for up to five pages, with a 14-day trial that requires a card.

name: Juhe
tagline: AI Home Feng Shui Consultant — upload a floor plan, get form-school scores and a ranked fix list
description:
Juhe (fengshuiroom.com) turns classic yin-yang spatial wisdom into a practical web product. Homeowners and renters capture a room layout—by uploading a floor plan or drawing furniture on a canvas—then receive form-school scores for command position, backing, door rush, pathways, and clutter, plus an ordered checklist of fixes.

It is not a "near me" consultant booking desk and not temple mysticism. Start with Free Home Check; unlock full reports and layout compares with one-time credit packs.

Pricing: Free plan with 10 credits on signup; one-time credit packs $9.90 / $19.90 / $39.90. No subscription.

name: PhotoToPDF
tagline: Combine photos into a PDF privately in your browser
description: PhotoToPDF is a free tool for combining JPG, JPEG and PNG photos into a multi-page PDF. It processes images locally in your browser, without uploading them to a conversion server. Reorder photos, choose A4, US Letter or fit-to-photo page sizes, adjust margins and download without an account or watermark. Useful for receipt photos, photographed homework and document images. It does not provide OCR or edit existing PDFs. Submitted by the PhotoToPDF-team.

name: Beav
tagline: AI workspace for Xiaohongshu creators to research posts, plan topics, and create content.
description: Beav is a desktop workspace for Xiaohongshu (RedNote) creators. Its browser extension saves social posts and media into a local, searchable library; AI features help plan topics and create drafts, covers, and videos.

name: alterac.ai
tagline: Plan, dispatch, and review local coding-agent tasks
description: alterac.ai helps software teams plan, dispatch, and review tasks for configured local coding agents. Use tools such as Codex CLI and Claude Code through compatible local commands. Keep task context, summaries, and review history together while people choose what to publish, whether to continue, and when to accept completed results. Local setup is required. Teams use alterac.ai alongside their editor, Git host, and CI.

name: Vaneform
tagline: Check website traffic, scale, and search visibility.
description: Vaneform is a free website traffic checker. Enter any domain to see estimated monthly visits, growth trends, traffic scale compared with similar sites, and search visibility signals. Useful for founders, marketers and SEOs doing competitor research, link-building outreach, or sizing up a market before building. No signup required.

name: Claimbrand
tagline: Check and watch brand handles and domains
description: Claimbrand checks whether a brand name is available as a social media handle and a domain across supported social networks. Enter a name and the first five results are free. For a one-time $7 Brand Report you get full results plus an ongoing watch for that one name. Pro adds availability reports for multiple names, scheduled watches that target a check every two hours (checks can be delayed), a monitoring timeline, and alerts after a detected change. If you would rather not register handles yourself, account signup on chosen networks is offered as a separate one-time service. There is no sales call and no contract. Claimbrand does not take down or recover accounts, reserve names, or decide whether an account is an impersonator, and a taken handle can belong to a legitimate user. Reporting a profile is done through each platform's own process. Automated coverage varies, and some checks come back inconclusive and need manual confirmation. Claimbrand is not a trademark search and not legal advice.

name: Soul Flow
tagline: Free Human Design chart, daily guidance & an AI coach
description: Soul Flow is a Human Design chart app. Enter your birth date, time and place to get a free BodyGraph that shows your Type, Strategy, Authority, Profile, Centers, Gates and Channels in plain language. Then use it every day with transit insights, rituals, 26 guided lessons and an AI Soul Coach that reads your chart. Available on iOS, Android and web.

name: Overit.sk
tagline: Slovak company lookup and verification
description: Search Slovak companies by IČO or name, view financial statements and check VAT IDs. Company lookup and verification service for Slovakia.

name: KonnectBot
tagline: AI live chat for sales & support
description: KonnectBot is AI live chat software for small businesses and ecommerce teams that want sales and support in one place, without surprise per-resolution AI bills. Agents and AI work in a shared inbox with handoff and departments. On Pro and Enterprise, KonnectBot connects Shopify and WooCommerce so agents can see order and inventory context inside the chat, offer live dual translation in-thread, and take payments in chat via the payment provider. Published flat monthly plans (Free, Starter $24.99, Pro $59, Enterprise $199) with a 14-day trial, no credit card required.

name: Dolaptan
tagline: Cook what's in your fridge before it spoils — 586 recipes, expiring first
description: Dolaptan is a fridge-first recipe app: enter what you have (type, voice, or receipt scan) and it matches 586 dishes, putting soon-to-expire ingredients first. Shows what you have vs missing, shopping list, Weekly Menu, and step-by-step cook mode. No account, pantry on-device, no ads/tracking. Turkish + English. Web live; Android in Play review.

name: Any File Type
tagline: Make files behave
description: Browser-based file conversion and utility platform for images, PDFs, audio, video, documents and data, with compression, PDF page tools, ZIP/GZIP, QR codes, checksums, Base64 and related file utilities.

name: daycrumb
tagline: Three short daily puzzles, about five minutes, free no account.
description: daycrumb is a free daily puzzle site. Every day we put up three short puzzles from seven original games: word, logic and trivia, including our newest, Elbow Room (place one dot in every coloured region). Most take a couple of minutes each, so the whole set fits into about five minutes. No account required. New puzzles every midnight UTC, with an archive of every past day.

name: ReachFast
tagline: Find people already asking for what you sell
description:
ReachFast helps online sellers find people publicly asking for products or services like theirs on X. Users paste in a website or store URL, and ReachFast reads the site to understand what is being sold, who might buy it, and the kinds of questions those buyers ask.

The product scans public X posts and evaluates them for buying intent. Its lead board shows the original post, author, date, and a score for buying heat, so users can focus on people who appear ready to choose a product, request a recommendation, find a vendor, or ask for help deciding. The first scan can read posts from up to the previous two weeks. After that, projects are scanned daily and new leads are added every 24 hours.

Each lead includes a suggested reply based on the person’s question and the user’s product. ReachFast does not post replies or require a social account connection. Instead, clicking a lead opens the real X thread with the reply typed out, and the user decides whether to send it from their own account.

ReachFast is designed for products that people ask about publicly, including stores, SaaS products, freelance services, agencies, and marketplace listings. Users do not need to configure keywords, because the service builds its search from the website content. A project can be refreshed when a website or product changes, and separate products can be managed as separate projects with their own lead boards and daily scans.

The service offers one free first scan without a card. A subscription is needed for new leads to continue arriving each day.

name: caisse.bzh
tagline: French POS software for restaurants, bars and retail shops
description:
caisse.bzh is French-language point-of-sale software published in Brest, France by Webdesign29 / Inklura. It helps restaurants and bars manage sales, table orders, kitchen tickets, reservations, QR menus and split payments. Retail shops can manage product variants, barcodes, inventory and sales reports.

It runs in a web browser or on Android 11+ ARM64 and requires an Internet connection. The interface and documentation are in French. A public demonstration, documentation and API are available on the official website.

The Caisse plan costs €39 excluding VAT per establishment per month for one sales device. Caisse connectée costs €79 excluding VAT per month for two devices and one WooCommerce or PrestaShop connection. An additional device costs €15 excluding VAT per month. Hardware, webshop hosting, payment fees, installation and training are separate.

name: FLUX 3 Image
tagline: Generate and edit images with FLUX 3 and the separate free FLUX.2 model
description: Create and edit images with FLUX 3 Image and FLUX.2 models using text prompts and reference photos. FLUX 3 Image uses credits (2 for 1K, 8 for 2K and 32 for 4K); FLUX.2 [klein] is a separate free model, and monthly plans and one-time credit packs are available.

name: AI Photo Generator Studio
tagline: Generate and edit AI images, including free FLUX.2 without an account
description: AI Photo Generator Studio creates and edits images with a range of AI models, including free FLUX.2 without an account. Premium models use credits; signing in with Google provides free credits that refresh daily, and paid plans add more credits.

name: Lumi Receptionist
tagline: The AI receptionist that understands your business.
description: Lumi is an AI receptionist for small businesses that answers customer questions and handles appointment requests using your real services, prices, staff, schedules, availability, and business rules. Customers get accurate answers and can request appointments without waiting for you to respond.

name: Workalizer
tagline: AI-powered insights for Google Workspace
description: Workalizer turns Google Workspace activity into clear insights: collaboration patterns, meeting load, document activity, and adoption trends. No message or file content access. CSA STAR Level 1. For managers, HR, and leaders. Available on Google Workspace Marketplace.

name: Tell Me Anything
tagline: Free anonymous message link. Get honest messages from anyone.
description: Tell Me Anything is a free anonymous messaging platform. Create a free account, get your personal link, share it, and receive honest thoughts from friends without them revealing their identity. Senders don't need to download an app or make an account. 100% free: you read every message, with no paywall and no "buy hints to see who sent this". Share your link in your Instagram, WhatsApp or TikTok bio for anonymous Q&A and honest feedback. A free alternative to NGL-style apps that charge for hints.

name: weekendflights
tagline: Every weekend's flight price for any route, on one page.
description: Searching flights date by date takes hours. weekendflights shows the round-trip fare for every weekend of the next 328 days (about 47 weekends) on one page, for any route, coloured from deal to high, so you spot the cheapest weekend at a glance. The calendar is free and needs no login. Pro ($29 a year, founding price for the first 500 members, then $59) adds Anywhere: the cheapest destination from your city for each weekend, plus Thursday-to-Monday weekends, departure and return time filters, and Business and First. It also works inside AI assistants through an MCP server. First launched in 2018, when it was #1 Product of the Day on Product Hunt.

name: Capvant
tagline: Capvant is a business funding marketplace that helps SMEs compare competing lending and finance offers in one place.
description: Capvant gives business owners one simple request for comparing business funding options from matched third-party providers. Owners can review offers side by side—including rates, terms, total cost, working-capital, revenue-advance, equipment, and invoice-finance options—before choosing whether to proceed.
