Comparing options is free and does not affect the owner's credit score.

name: ClipTrend.ai
tagline: Turn prompts and images into short videos with AI models and creative tools
description: ClipTrend.ai is an AI creative workspace for generating and editing video and images. It offers text-to-video and image-to-video workflows, video extension, face swap, 40+ AI models and 40+ templates. New accounts currently start with 30 credits; paid memberships and one-time credit packs are also available.

name: DIGITAL AYNS Packs
tagline: Copy-paste prompt packs for solo experts: LinkedIn visibility (Sichtwerk), proposals, week OS. One-time from €19.
description: Structured prompt & workflow packs that force ChatGPT, Claude or any current model into a real system, with fixed output formats, placeholders and checklists. Sichtwerk (English, €24): 24 prompts for LinkedIn positioning, profile, hooks & posts and proof for solo experts selling B2B services. Klarangebot (€19) covers discovery, pricing, proposal copy and negotiation; Klarbetrieb (€29) is a week OS for solo founders (both packs written in German). One-time price, no subscription, delivered as Markdown + PDF.

name: Dinnava
tagline: Global B2B platform for finding business partners and opportunities
description: Dinnava helps businesses discover companies, products and services across borders. Teams can search for potential partners, buyers and distributors and explore opportunities in international markets. The platform includes company profiles, groups and AI-assisted matching.

name: Cherry Converter
tagline: Free browser-based tools for converting, compressing and resizing images, PDFs and documents
description: Cherry Converter is a free collection of browser-based tools for converting, compressing, resizing and editing images, PDFs and documents. It includes image converters, compressors, PDF utilities, OCR tools, QR and barcode tools, and other useful browser-based utilities. For supported tools, files are processed locally in the browser.

name: Pixilo
tagline: Free image tools. No signup. Your images stay on your device.
description: Optimize your images without installing software or creating an account. Pixilo offers image compression, resizing, cropping, format conversion and favicon creation in one place. Convert formats including JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and HEIC, process multiple images, and download the results. Your images stay on your device. Practical guides help you choose formats and prepare images for websites.

name: Who Do I Look Like?
tagline: Find your celebrity lookalike privately in your browser
description: Who Do I Look Like? is a free celebrity lookalike finder for anyone curious about their facial resemblance. Add a clear portrait to compare your face with celebrity reference faces, explore similarity scores, and make a shareable result card. Face analysis runs locally in your browser and no account is required. You decide whether to include your photo on the share card. This is an entertainment experience, not identity verification.

name: Card Interest Tool
tagline: Estimate credit card interest, monthly cost, and payoff time.
description: Free calculators for U.S. consumers to estimate credit card interest, minimum-payment costs, balance-transfer savings, loan fees, and debt payoff timelines.

name: Mingche
tagline: Check product feed data and repair supported CSV errors with a clear change log
description: Mingche is an online product-data checking and CSV repair service for small stores selling English-language, USD offers to the US. Start with a free product-page check. Paid audits review up to 200 supplied records and five sampled pages. Supported CSV repairs preserve the original file and provide a corrected file, field-level changes and unresolved items. Checks use automated rules; missing facts are not invented. Merchants control their store and imports. No Google approval or sales guarantee. A public, clearly labelled synthetic repair demonstration includes downloadable input and output evidence: https://www.mingcheip.com/feed-repair-example

name: ExportDelta
tagline: Compare recurring CSV exports privately, by record key.
description: ExportDelta is a free browser tool for reviewing weekly supplier and catalog CSV exports. Match records by one or more unique keys, see added, removed and changed records and schema changes, and download CSV, JSON or HTML reports. File contents stay on your device. An optional A$19 one-time Node.js 22+ CLI automation pack adds saved profiles and batches of up to 20 named comparison jobs for local scripts and CI.

name: Ducat Protocol
tagline: Bitcoin-native credit and stablecoin protocol. Built on Bitcoin L1.
description: Ducat Protocol is a Bitcoin-native credit and stablecoin protocol designed to bring decentralized financial infrastructure directly to Bitcoin’s base layer. It focuses on enabling users and applications to access credit, stablecoin functionality, and decentralized financial services without relying on a separate blockchain. By building directly on Bitcoin, Ducat Protocol aims to combine Bitcoin’s security and decentralization with practical financial tools for lending, borrowing, liquidity, and on-chain financial activity. The protocol is designed for the growing Bitcoin economy, supporting developers, users, and businesses seeking programmable financial applications while maintaining a Bitcoin-first approach. Ducat Protocol’s goal is to expand what can be built and accessed within the Bitcoin ecosystem through open, transparent, and decentralized financial infrastructure.

name: QuickMedCalc
tagline: Free clinical calculators and risk scores for healthcare professionals and medical learners.
description: QuickMedCalc provides free browser-based clinical calculators and risk scores for healthcare professionals and medical learners. It covers multiple specialties including emergency medicine, critical care, cardiology, nephrology, general medicine, pediatrics, and others. Individual calculator pages provide transparent calculation details, source references, and important limitations. No account, subscription, or installation is required.

name: Alinova Tools
tagline: Free browser tools for PDF, images, documents, resumes, QR codes and everyday work.
description: Alinova Tools is a privacy-focused browser toolbox for common PDF, image, document, resume, QR and productivity tasks. Many tools run locally in the browser, with clear limits and no account required for the free utilities.

name: Reduce Image Size in KB
tagline: Shrink a photo to an exact KB range and size in one step
description: Reduce Image Size in KB makes a photo or signature fit the file size and dimensions an application form asks for, in one step. Set a range such as 10–20 KB or 20–50 KB, and optionally the width and height in pixels or centimetres (with DPI). The tool keeps the best quality that fits under the maximum. If a small image is still under the minimum at the best quality, it adds blank data inside the file so it reaches the minimum without changing the picture. It never shrinks the picture without telling you. JPG, PNG, WebP and iPhone HEIC work. Everything runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

name: Fancy Text Generator
tagline: Turn plain text into 45+ copy-and-paste font styles
description: Fancy Text Generator turns what you type into 46 Unicode styles you can paste almost anywhere: Instagram and TikTok bios, Discord nicknames, posts, captions and chats. Every style updates as you type and sits on its own row, so one tap copies it. Accented letters such as é, ñ, ü and ç are styled too instead of being left in the normal font, and styles that have no number shapes tell you before you paste. Save the styles you use most, and find recently copied ones next time you visit. Everything runs in your browser, so nothing you type is uploaded. Free, with no sign-up.

name: Krutidev to Unicode
tagline: Convert Kruti Dev 010 text to Unicode (Mangal) Hindi
description: Convert Kruti Dev 010 text to Unicode (Mangal) Hindi, or Unicode back to Kruti Dev. Free, instant, and your text never leaves your browser. The converter reads font information when you paste from Word or Google Docs, converting Kruti Dev parts while preserving text in other fonts. For a whole document, use the Word file (.docx) converter.

name: Chinese Oracle Jiaguwen
tagline: Explore ancient Chinese character shapes and practice tracing on iOS and Android.
description:
Chinese Oracle Jiaguwen is an iOS and Android app for people curious about Chinese characters, ancient scripts and calligraphy. Guests can run searches and view results on screen; a free account adds CSV export and saved history.

name: toolinbox
tagline: pdf, calculator, jpg, image, internet, pdf to jpg, jpg to pdf, pdf merger, calculator, storage
description: oolInbox is a free online toolkit with easy-to-use tools for PDF, images, text, calculators, translation, QR codes and more. Convert, compress, calculate and create online without installing software.

name: FreeGen
tagline: Free browser AI tools with no account or upload
description: FreeGen is a free browser AI toolkit for everyday creative and productivity workflows: chat, transcription, text-to-speech, image description, image generation, image editing, and browser AI compatibility checks. Core tools are free to try without signup. On supported browsers and hardware, several workflows can run locally through WebGPU or ONNX paths; support varies by browser and device.

name: Mysocial
tagline: Social media intelligence for you and your AI
description:
Mysocial gives creators and teams a connected workspace for their social content, audience evidence, ideas and brand. Its Content Memory analyzes published work to surface audience psychology, recurring topics, content gaps and Hit DNA: the patterns behind successful posts. Creator Universe helps users research topics and outlier content, then save useful evidence into Ideas.

Brand Studio keeps identity, audience, formats, products and strategic documents together. Ideas preserves saved links, notes, sources and drafts. The MCP connector makes this context available to ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Claude Code and other compatible AI clients, so an assistant can work from the user's own material and save ideas or drafts back into Mysocial.

The Free plan includes connected channels, Brand Studio, Ideas, Media Kit, Smart Links and the MCP connection. Content Memory analysis, deeper audience intelligence and Creator Universe research require a paid plan. Available data and analysis depend on the connected platform and subscription. Mysocial is a web app; it does not schedule or publish social posts. Current plans and limits are listed at https://mysocial.io/pricing/.

name: Biaohe (表核)
tagline: Compare old and new spreadsheets by ID
description: Biaohe is a free spreadsheet comparison tool with a Chinese interface. Import an old and a new CSV or plain XLSX file, select a shared unique ID column, and review added, removed, modified and unchanged records. Download Excel or CSV change reports. Row order does not affect ID matching. Files and reports stay on the device. Up to 10 MB, 5,000 data rows and 50 columns per file. No account required. Optional anonymous action counts and feedback are off by default. Formulas must first be pasted as values; merged cells should be removed. It compares displayed text, not formatting.

name: Peripheral — 余光
tagline: Record visited cities and private travel memories
description: Peripheral is a free browser-based travel recording app. Save cities, trip status, dates and transport, keep private journals and photos, review yearly visited-city counts, and save a footprint card image. Try a fictional guest demo without signing in; personal records require an account. The app interface is currently Chinese.

name: Bottle Me
tagline: Express feelings with filled bottles, shared check-ins and quiet breathing
description: Bottle Me is an iPhone and iPad app for expressing feelings, interests and preferences with filled glass bottles. Create templates, adjust each bottle, try duo check-ins, pause with quiet breathing and export a poster to share. Basic features are free. An optional one-time Pro purchase adds premium filling materials and smart features with usage allowances.

name: Orisift
tagline: One API to check phones, email domains, IPs and domains
description: Orisift checks phone numbers, email domains, IP addresses and domains through one POST /v1/lookup endpoint and returns a verdict with its evidence.

name: Avantiqo
tagline: One intelligent operating platform for business
description: Avantiqo is a governed Business Operating System that connects finance, operations, supply chain, commercial work, people, projects, documents, analytics, connected services and intelligence in one organization-scoped workspace. It helps business owners and teams run the company from one operating context instead of fragmented tools, with shared records, permissions, approvals and auditable workflows.

name: Tuxu (图序)
tagline: Turn CSV metrics into Chinese weekly report image cards
description: Tuxu (图序) is a free browser-based tool for Chinese weekly operations reports. Import a CSV template to generate a cover and one image card per metric, then download PNG files or a ZIP. It supports up to 200 metrics, three styles and landscape, portrait or square output. CSV data and generated images stay on the device. Optional anonymous action counts are off by default. No account is required. The interface is in Chinese; XLSX import and trend charts are not supported.

name: BaziPal
tagline: AI tarot and BaZi companion with shared memory
description: BaziPal combines tarot, Chinese birth charts, zodiac and feng shui in a personalized AI Guardian. A free birth-card quiz introduces the companion, which supports card readings and ongoing conversations with shared memory. It offers free access and optional subscriptions for reflection and entertainment.

name: Karma
tagline: Free astrology, fortune and tarot web app
description: A free browser-based service for saju, daily fortune, compatibility, face and palm reading, and card tarot. No signup required.

name: Mate
tagline: Free Korean AI emotional-care chat
description: A browser-based AI emotional-care chat for organizing worries and late-night emotional check-ins. No signup required.

name: Word Tile Finder
tagline: Free word finder for letters, anagrams and missing-letter patterns
description: Stuck with a letter rack or a word with gaps? Word Tile Finder finds English words that fit what you know. Unscramble your letters, solve anagrams using every letter, or fill known positions in a partial word. Narrow matches by word length, starting and ending letters, and letters to include or exclude. Repeated letters and blank tiles are supported. Try LISTEN in Anagrams to find SILENT, ENLIST and TINSEL. Copy a word or share your search. Free to use, no account needed, and searches run in your browser.

name: Shipvela
tagline: Publish your website from GitHub or your terminal
description: Shipvela hosts websites built in Codex, Claude Code or Cursor. Import supported GitHub repositories or publish prebuilt React, Vite and static sites with the CLI. Manage deployments, build logs, custom domains and managed HTTPS in one workspace. Hobby is free with three projects and twenty publishes per month. Paid plans add capacity, compatible Next.js server rendering and saved Lighthouse lab reports. Early access; databases and separate backends stay with your providers.

name: MoveKit
tagline: Make a dated moving checklist, room labels and first-night essentials in your browser.
description: MoveKit is a free pilot for people preparing to move home. Enter a moving date and room names to generate a dated checklist, printable room labels, a blank box inventory and a first-night essentials list. Optional pet and children preparations are included. User entries are processed in the page and are not saved after leaving. Print the pack or use the browser print window to save a PDF. No login or payment is required for this preview. A paid expansion is being evaluated; checkout is currently unavailable.

name: EditTextInImage
tagline: Replace text inside one selected image area with AI
description: EditTextInImage helps update wording in a poster, flyer or product demo screenshot when an editable source file is unavailable. Upload an opaque JPG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MiB, manually select one complete text region, enter its current text and replacement wording, then compare the result and export a full-size PNG. Pixels outside the confirmed selection are preserved. Fonts and background inside the edited area may change, so inspect the result before using it. Sign-in is required. Each account receives two one-time free credits, with no daily reset; purchasing more credits is currently unavailable. Submitted by the EditTextInImage team.

name: Moot
tagline: Your friends’ public conversations, together
description: Moot is an early social discussion platform with chronological feeds, public communities, and no ads or trackers. An optional browser extension lets users share supported posts and replies across Reddit, X, Instagram, Threads and Bluesky when they like or reply; reading alone shares nothing. Public discussions can be read without an account. The extension currently requires manual installation.

name: TafasnuDil
tagline: Travel deals and travel services from Israel in one place
description: TafasnuDil helps Israeli travelers discover flights, hotels and travel services, with supplier links, price checks, and multilingual travel content.

name: FitMyStack
tagline: Free software finder for small businesses
description: FitMyStack is a free, independent software finder designed for small businesses and solopreneurs. It asks three quick questions about your business, your goals, and your budget, then returns a practical shortlist of software tools that match your needs — along with buyer guides and feature-by-feature comparisons so you can make confident choices without spending hours researching.

name: Glass Money
tagline: Track UPI, banks, and joint accounts in one place from bank alert emails.
description: Read-only. Glass Money turns bank, UPI, and card alert emails into one spend view. No SMS permission. No bank login. Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.paisewise Coverage notes: https://glassmoney.app/help/coverage

name: Merkory
tagline: Fast, mobile-ready business websites and online stores
description: Merkory builds fast, mobile-ready business websites and online stores with lead forms, basic SEO, measurement, and optional commerce automation/integrations.

name: SEOClusterizer
tagline: Free keyword clustering and SEO workflow toolkit
description: SEOClusterizer groups keyword lists into page-level topics and helps SEO teams with keyword clustering, semantic grouping, search intent analysis, SERP clustering and content optimization. Core keyword clustering is free and requires no signup.

name: Crontinel
tagline: Laravel schedule and queue monitoring. Catch silent cron, queue, and agent failures before users do.
description: Crontinel watches Laravel scheduler, Horizon queues, workers, backups, and agent runs. Node and Python SDKs. Open core, MIT, free tier.

name: ViewportReceipt Handoff
tagline: Annotate website screenshots and send a self-contained HTML feedback report.
description: A free browser-based beta for freelancers handing off website revisions. Import PNG, JPEG or WebP screenshots, draw numbered boxes and describe each requested change. Export a single HTML report with embedded screenshots, or save an editable JSON project. Screenshots are processed locally in the browser; no login is required. Try one non-sensitive screenshot, add two changes, then export and open the report. Optional feedback is collected through a separate Google Form. This is manual review: no automatic capture, bug detection, fixes, team sync or client sign-off. Up to10 screenshots,6MB each and25MB per project. No paid checkout is available.

name: PDF Metadata Remover
tagline: Remove PDF metadata privately in your browser
description:
PDF Metadata Remover is a free browser-based privacy tool for inspecting and removing hidden metadata from PDF files.

It detects and clears common fields such as title, author, subject, keywords, creator, producer and document dates. All processing happens locally in the browser, so files are never uploaded to a server.

It is useful for anyone who wants to remove identifying information before sharing, publishing or sending a PDF. No account, installation or payment is required.

name: AISkyLa Gifting
tagline: Create free animated gifts and eCards, then share a link
description: AISkyLa Gifting lets people create animated virtual gifts, eCards and personalized mini websites for birthdays, anniversaries and other occasions. Add photos, a personal message and music, preview the result, then share it through a browser link. The core gifting flow is free and does not require an account. Uploaded photos and music are retained for 15 days; anyone with the exact gift link can view it.

name: Schedulera
tagline: Get booked without the back-and-forth. Free booking pages for solo pros.
description: Schedulera gives trainers, teachers, coaches, tutors and other solo professionals a free personal booking page (schedulera.com/yourname) where clients book from real availability, pay, and get automatic reminders. It includes two-way sync with Google, Outlook and Apple Calendar; payments via Stripe, Venmo, Cash App, PayPal, Zelle or cash; email and SMS reminders; client self-service rescheduling; one-off, recurring and group sessions; an analytics dashboard; and Zapier and webhook integrations. An optional AI scheduling assistant handles booking over email, text or Slack, and a Team plan covers small studios and practices.

name: TripSlay
tagline: AI-assisted trip planner with editable day-by-day plans
description: TripSlay helps travelers create AI-assisted trip plans and edit a day-by-day itinerary beside a map. Visitors can try and edit an illustrative New York sample in a temporary guest draft without signing in. AI generation, permanent saving and sharing require sign-in. TripSlay is currently free to use. Sample activities are illustrative; verify hours, tickets and routes for your dates.

name: SheetOtter
tagline: Free printable Chinese handwriting worksheets, made in your browser
description: SheetOtter helps parents, teachers, and Mandarin learners make custom Chinese character writing-practice sheets. Enter up to 40 characters, choose Tian, Mi, or plain grids, preview stroke-order tracing, and print or save as PDF. It also creates blank practice grids. No account or payment required.

name: Transcrever
tagline: Turn audio and video files into editable transcripts
description: Transcrever is a Brazilian Portuguese transcription service for uploaded audio and video files. Users can review the transcript, correct names and speech, then download TXT, SRT, VTT or DOCX files.

name: Editara
tagline: Editara is an online AI photo editor for removing objects, changing backgrounds, restoring old photos and improving image quality.
description: Editara helps people edit photos using written instructions. Upload an image, describe the change, and download the result. It supports object removal, background replacement, photo restoration, colourisation, upscaling and image extension. The browser-based editor offers free starting credits and paid plans for additional usage. It is designed for people who want to make specific photo edits without learning a complex editing interface.

name: MyResultLab
tagline: Understand CT, MRI, X-ray, ultrasound, and lab reports in plain language
description: MyResultLab is a patient-facing AI tool that helps people understand medical imaging and lab reports in clear, accessible language. It supports CT, MRI, X-ray, ultrasound, and laboratory reports while emphasizing that educational explanations do not replace diagnosis or professional medical advice.

name: CodexPluginStats
tagline: Find Codex plugins and see why they match
description: CodexPluginStats is an independent directory for discovering Codex plugins and researching their changes. Search for a task such as telegram notifications to see matching excerpts, their sources, and the full context. Plugin pages bring together publisher descriptions, available screenshots, keywords, repository links and archived changes. Catalog and category charts show changes in the number of observed plugins, with collection gaps made explicit. Browsing and search work without an account; an account lets you follow plugins. Available pricing research links to its evidence and review date. Catalog counts measure observed listings, not installations or users. CodexPluginStats is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.

name: TenancyDesk
tagline: England landlord & letting-agent digital templates and checklists
description: TenancyDesk is a digital template pack for England landlords and small letting agents: arrears escalation letters, deposit and compliance kits, inventory and inspection checklists, rent-increase language, plus Section 8 and Section 21 overview checklists with reform-aware warnings. Starter £99, Pro £299, DFY £799. Instant ZIP after Stripe on Starter/Pro. Templates only — not legal advice.

name: ForgeQuote
tagline: UK trade quoting toolkit — calculators, templates, photo-to-quote prompts
description: ForgeQuote is a downloadable quoting toolkit for UK builders, electricians, plumbers and roofers. Instant ZIP after Stripe: offline HTML and CSV pricing calculators with UK pound and VAT fields, print-ready quote templates, photo-to-quote prompts, WhatsApp send and follow-up scripts. Starter £79, Trades Pro £249 (recommended), DFY company setup £499. One-time purchase; not a SaaS subscription.

name: Perunlight
tagline: Focused browser tools, plugins and templates with one-time purchases and worked examples.
description: Perunlight is a collection of small tools for creative work and everyday administration. Its catalogue includes local browser utilities, desktop-app plugins and spreadsheet templates, sold as one-time downloads. Examples include checking a dance recital run order, planning weekly private lessons and reviewing a Confluence export for a BookStack migration. Product pages show prices, software requirements, screenshots, setup guides and worked examples; available browser previews let you try selected workflows before buying. Requirements and verified environments vary by product.

name: FISCUS AI
tagline: AI-powered finance operations for Turkish SMEs
description: FISCUS AI is an AI-supported financial operating system for Turkish SMEs and accounting teams, combining e-invoicing, accounting, banking, collections, expenses and financial reporting in one controlled workflow.

name: Image to Prompt
tagline: Turn reference images into editable AI image prompts
description: Image to Prompt analyzes reference images and turns their subjects, composition, lighting, colors, and visual style into editable text prompts. Creators can choose prompt formats for Midjourney, FLUX, Stable Diffusion, ChatGPT Image, and Nano Banana. Anonymous visitors can try three images per browser; registered users receive five one-time credits. Paid plans and credit packs are available. Signed-in users can save their results in History.

name: TempMy
tagline: Receive-only temporary email inboxes for signups, testing, and spam reduction.
description: TempMy creates temporary email addresses with receive-only inboxes for short-term use. Use it for quick signups, testing, one-time downloads, and reducing spam exposure to your primary inbox. Free entry is available without an account; TempMy Pro offers up to 10 inboxes, 90-day retention, and no ads.

name: Centsbot Copy Studio
tagline: $19 BTC micro-audit: 3 concrete SaaS landing fixes in ≤24h
description: Human-facing copy/ops studio for SaaS landing pages. Paste your URL and get 3 prioritized hero/CTA/offer fixes with before→after copy, plus one metric hypothesis. Delivered within 24 hours after payment confirmation. Pay in Bitcoin. Live offer at /audit.

name: WhosCuttingOnions
tagline: Living Tributes: animate a still photo into a respectful memorial or family tribute video.
description: WhosCuttingOnions creates Living Tributes: short cinematic animations from still photos for memorials, celebrations of life, and other personal occasions. The focus is respectful motion you can keep and share with family, not flashy effects or a replacement for funeral professionals. Visit the site for current pricing and how the process works.

name: VERITAS
tagline: Academic Similarity & Plagiarism Checker
description: VERITAS is an online plagiarism and similarity checker designed to help students, researchers, educators, and professionals identify matching content and potential source overlap in academic documents.

name: Reaction Time Test
tagline: Free online visual reaction time test
description: Free browser-based visual reaction test: click when the background turns green, complete five rounds and view average and best time results. Also includes CPS, sequence memory, number memory, aim trainer and spacebar tests.

name: Cyberize
tagline: Discover wearable tech. Build and share your personal setup.
description: Cyberize helps you discover wearable technology and build a setup around your goals and activities. Explore devices, configure your build on a 3D avatar, and save and share it with others. Add your own devices when they are missing from the catalogue, or configure a bike and accessories for cycling-focused builds. Explore community builds for ideas. Free to use.

name: TheProfitPath
tagline: Free trading journal + AI coach
description: TheProfitPath is a free, web-based trading journal for active traders. Log every trade with screenshots, notes and emotions. Track personal and prop-firm accounts against your risk rules and targets. See your equity curve, profit factor and drawdown, broken down by setup, session and emotion. TheProfitPath AI reviews your own recorded trades, in chat or live voice, and every free account gets it on free models. The core journal is free with no credit card. Optional Premium ($12/mo or $110/yr) upgrades the AI to a premium model.

name: LatticeSpot
tagline: A shared pixel canvas with a lasting page for your project
description: LatticeSpot helps makers, artists, and website owners introduce their projects on a shared pixel canvas. Choose an area, add an image, write a short introduction, and connect your website. Each published placement gets a public page with its image, story, link, and display history. Visitors can explore current projects by category. Later placements can replace overlapping pixels while the earlier public record remains available under the content rules. Free placement requests require approval; larger paid placements are available.

name: Hotel Lobby AI
tagline: Turn two photos into an orange-studio duo performance video
description: Hotel Lobby AI creates a duo performance video from two portrait photos, placing both people in an orange studio with a hanging microphone. Select an aspect ratio, duration and soundtrack, then preview and download the result. Generation uses paid credits.

name: GutMaxx
tagline: Free UK 30g fibre tracker for supermarket food
description: GutMaxx is a free UK fibre tracker. Add supermarket foods like Weetabix, beans, oats and fruit, then see how close you are to 30g of fibre a day. Built for fibremaxxing without supplements or guesswork.

name: Plopino
tagline: Turn a finished HTML page into a link you can send.
description: Made a small page with an AI coding tool and then wondered how to share it? Plopino lets you upload an HTML file, folder, or ZIP and get a public link. You can try an anonymous upload without an account; it stays available for 30 days. Sign in to save your page and update it later without changing the link. Plopino hosts pages you have already made; it does not generate them.

name: SuperMailOS
tagline: Email for every product you run.
description: SuperMailOS is hosted business email. Every address on every connected domain lands in one inbox, with unlimited aliases, billed per person rather than per address. Adee Labs runs the mail server and DNS (MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC). Pro is $3 per person per month, billed annually.

name: TwitterXAPI
tagline: Public X data for apps, AI agents, and bulk exports
description: TwitterXAPI gives developers and AI agents public X data through REST and MCP. Read profiles, posts, conversations, followers and following, timelines, search, lists, trends, and communities as normalized JSON. The REST API includes managed bulk export jobs with pagination, retries, and downloadable results. The remote MCP server exposes eight tools for AI clients. Usage is paid with credits; an optional $20/month plan includes $25 in credit and a 10% bonus on additional purchases.

name: AudioTidy
tagline: Quick audio jobs, right in your browser
description: Need to trim a recording or turn a video into an audio file? AudioTidy gives you free tools for those everyday jobs right in your browser. You can cut, join, convert and compress audio, record your voice, change speed or volume, and transcribe speech to text. There's nothing to install and no account to create. Editing and recording stay on your device; transcription uses a clearly explained cloud upload.

name: EShopSet
tagline: Shopify growth apps bundle plus MCP for Cursor, Claude, and ChatGPT
description: EShopSet is a curated Shopify apps bundle for ecommerce growth including SEO, marketing, and AI tools, plus an MCP server so AI assistants can work with store workflows. Pricing starts at $49 per store per month.

name: Digraph
tagline: AI marketing platform for brand intelligence and action
description: Digraph is an AI marketing platform for brands. It combines AI research, market intelligence, website and campaign analysis, specialist workflows, and marketer-led guidance. Brand, SEO, content, marketing, communications, and research teams use Digraph to understand how buyers encounter their brand, investigate competitors and market signals, and turn findings into focused marketing action.

name: Replium
tagline: Help center and live chat for small support teams
description: Replium combines a customer-facing help center with live chat in one workspace, helping small teams answer customer questions and organize support.

name: Soreno
tagline: Rehearse consulting, finance and PM cases with an AI interviewer
description: Soreno is a case-interview practice tool for consulting, investment banking, private equity and product management candidates. Speak through a case with an AI interviewer that provides the prompt, answers questions and challenges your reasoning. The session ends with feedback on structure, quantitative work and communication. Behavioral and fit interview practice are included. A 7-day free trial is available.

name: Confetto
tagline: AI interview rehearsal for health-professions applicants
description: Confetto supports spoken mock interviews for medical, dental, PA, nursing, veterinary and residency applicants. Its AI interviewer asks questions, listens to each answer and follows up. Candidates can practice MMI, panel and traditional formats, then review feedback on content, structure and delivery. Live mocks also assess body language. Casper practice and school-specific guides are included, with a 7-day free trial.

name: ShortTranscript
tagline: Turn public TikTok videos and Instagram Reels into timestamped English text.
description: ShortTranscript creates timestamped, editable English transcripts from public TikTok videos and Instagram Reels. The free plan includes 3 transcripts per day for videos up to 5 minutes, with free TXT and optional one-time credits for SRT, VTT, and DOCX downloads.

name: BraSizePRO
tagline: Calculate Different Bra Size
description: Bra Size Calculator, Fit guide and Charts

name: Machine Docs Officina
tagline: Link PDF manuals to machines with QR codes, browser access and PIN.
description: Machine Docs Officina turns a company's existing technical documentation into machine-level, mobile-accessible pages. Link PDF manuals and instructions to individual machines, place a QR code on each one, and let operators open the relevant page from a phone or PC without installing an app. The Officina plan covers up to 25 machines/documents and includes PIN access, onboarding and basic customization: €249 one-time setup + €69/month, VAT excluded. Machine Docs organizes documentation; it does not certify compliance or replace training, risk assessments or legal obligations. Contact: hello@vcuria.app

name: Risposte Google Beauty Pronte
tagline: ~80 Italian Google review replies for beauty salons — €19 one-time
description: Risposte Google Beauty Pronte is a one-time digital kit (ProntiSubito) with ~80 Italian reply templates for Google reviews, beauty-only for estetiste, parrucchieri, nail and barber. Includes 2 WhatsApp scripts to ask for honest reviews without incentives (Legge 34 / Google policy). Pay once (€19), download after Stripe. Contact: hello@vcuria.app

name: English in Telugu Typing
tagline: Type Telugu using English letters, then copy your text into messages and documents.
description: A free browser tool for typing Telugu using English letters. Choose a suggested spelling, copy the text or download a TXT file. Includes an InScript keyboard, six Telugu font previews, and guides for Word and WhatsApp. No registration is required. Word suggestions need an internet connection. Provides transliteration rather than sentence translation.

name: Visaora
tagline: Free visa and immigration calculators
description: Visaora offers 130+ free visa and immigration calculators with no signup. Plan Schengen stay days, Canada CRS competitiveness, H-1B wage gaps, UK IHS costs, and more. Informational only; not legal advice.

name: ShFengXiaoTech
tagline: Free Random Generators & Tools
description: Free random generators: password generator with strength meter, PIN generator, dice roller, coin flip, lottery picker, list shuffler, lorem ipsum generator and more. Private, instant, no sign-up.

name: yhstky.shop
tagline: Free Tiny Web Tools for Everyone
description: Tiny web tools that do one job well: QR code generator, barcode generator, URL encoder/decoder, robots.txt generator, JSON formatter, password strength checker and more. Free, no sign-up.

name: NovaFlux
tagline: Free Online Finance Calculators & Tools
description: Free, fast finance calculators that run entirely in your browser: tax estimates, loans, mortgages, compound interest, savings, retirement, salary breakdowns, currency conversions. No sign-up, no tracking.

name: PercentURL URL Encoder & Decoder
tagline: Browser-based URL encoding and decoding for text and query parameters.
description: PercentURL is a free browser tool for developers and web users to encode or decode UTF-8 text and URL parameters. It supports component and full-URL modes, batch input, and selectable space handling.

name: AllSubConverter
tagline: Free subtitle converter and toolkit for SRT, VTT, ASS and more.
description: AllSubConverter is a browser-based toolkit for practical subtitle work. It converts SRT, VTT, ASS, SSA and LRC files, supports cleanup, timing adjustment, QA checks and export, and adds batch workflows for creators, localizers, students and teams. The open beta is free with no signup.

name: Shapefile Converter
tagline: Free KMZ/KML to Shapefile in your browser — no upload, no sign-up
description: Convert KMZ/KML to ESRI Shapefile in your browser—no upload, no sign-up. Keeps attributes, folders and CRS (.prj). Free for QGIS & ArcGIS users.

name: Launch QA Starter Pack
tagline: A practical release QA checklist and evidence pack for small web and API teams.
description: Launch QA Starter Pack helps indie founders and small product teams run a focused pre-release pass: state transitions, authentication, API boundaries, payment-adjacent flows, regression checks, and reproducible defect evidence. It is a downloadable toolkit with a clear 24-hour QA service option for teams that want hands-on help.

name: OpenRive
tagline: A local-first, login-free Rive animation editor with web, desktop, CLI, MCP, API, and self-hosting.
description: OpenRive is an open-source editor for Rive .riv animations. Draw vector art, animate timelines, build state machines, bind data, preview and export, or automate the same editing core through the CLI, REST API, and MCP server. Run it locally, use the desktop app, or self-host with Docker. MIT licensed and designed to keep projects on your machine or your own server.

name: TokSaves
tagline: TikTok video downloader without watermark
description: TokSaves is an online TikTok video downloader that lets users download TikTok videos without watermark in Full HD MP4 format and extract/download audio as MP3.

name: Freelance Win Pack
tagline: 60+ ChatGPT prompts for freelancers who hate the blank page
description: Freelance Win Pack: 60+ original ChatGPT prompts for discovery calls, proposals, pricing/scope options and follow-ups. Instant download, no API. Built for solo freelancers who stall on the blank page. £14 · Money Man / Watkin Soft. Product page: https://watkinsoft.gumroad.com/l/vqzqs · Landing: https://robert-watkin.github.io/freelance-win-pack-landing/

name: OneHub AI
tagline: Practical marketing tools and ready-to-adapt resources for small businesses
description: OneHub AI gives small businesses free marketing tools, practical guides and ready-to-adapt digital resources. Its finished Social Media Content Pack includes 300 content assets/frameworks, with additional partnership options for affiliates and SME support programmes.

name: IconAI
tagline: AI app icons in multiple styles, refined with your feedback.
description: IconAI helps independent developers, designers, and small teams create app icons, website graphics, and logo concepts. Start with a prompt or reference image, explore visual styles, and refine details with comments. Download 1024 × 1024 PNGs, including transparent backgrounds, or export icon packs for websites, iOS, macOS, and Android. Sign up for 5 free credits. Subscriptions and one-time credit packs unlock multi-style generation, reference images, transparent backgrounds, comment editing, and platform exports.

name: Metwipe
tagline: Free local metadata remover for photos, audio and Office files
description: MetWipe is a free browser-based privacy tool that checks, removes and verifies supported metadata from photos, MP3/WAV audio and Word/Excel/PowerPoint files. Supported file processing happens locally in your browser, and your original file remains untouched.

name: Meetfolio
tagline: Online office for specialists
description: Meetfolio is an online office for independent specialists and solo service providers. It brings a professional public profile, portfolio, services, prices, reviews, QR sharing, online booking, payments and client inquiries into one shareable link for psychologists, coaches, tutors, lawyers, photographers, beauty specialists, consultants and freelancers.

name: EcomSanity
tagline: Amazon SP-API analytics with TOS-safe review automation
description: EcomSanity is an analytics and automation console for Amazon sellers. Connect Seller Central once with official SP-API OAuth. Every ~6 hours it syncs sales, FBA inventory, and Buy Box status, then surfaces stock risk, Buy Box drops, and inventory aging toward Amazon storage surcharge tiers. See PPC ACOS next to the same ASINs without replacing Seller Central as the campaign manager. Pro ($9.90/mo) automates Amazon’s official Request a Review via the Solicitations API (eligibility checks, one request per order). Free plan includes SP-API + metrics — no credit card.

name: Pump Fun Trading App
tagline: Independent guide to the pump fun referral code and the official pump.fun sign-up steps.
description: Pump Fun Trading App is an independent referral guide for the pump fun referral code. It shows the code (SAVE100), the official pump.fun join link and a short step-by-step sign-up walkthrough. It is not affiliated with pump.fun, holds no funds, and includes plain crypto risk warnings.

name: ChessSum
tagline: Your Chess.com and Lichess games, together.
description: Combine public Chess.com and Lichess game histories from multiple accounts. Compare results by date and time control, explore players and prepare for opponents. Free during Early Access. Demo: https://chesssum.com/demo.

name: Dose Calcs
tagline: Browser-based math for checking prescribed doses and unit conversions.
description: DoseCalcs converts a clinician-prescribed dose and product concentration into an amount or volume, and shows the arithmetic steps. It does not determine or recommend a safe dose. Verify the prescription, product, units, patient factors, and result with a qualified clinician or pharmacist.

name: BrowserDeviceTest
tagline: Check browser-connected devices with clear, repeatable tests.
description: BrowserDeviceTest provides browser-based tests for microphones, cameras, keyboards, mice, speakers, headphones, displays and refresh rates. Each test shows a live reading and practical steps for checking the signal. The site says readings stay on the device and are not uploaded.

name: SPORT EDGE
tagline: Basketball prematch and live analysis with recorded signal results
description: SPORT EDGE is a subscription basketball analytics service for people following prematch and live betting markets. It publishes selections for totals, team totals and handicaps with a specific game, period, line and odds. The website provides public educational articles and performance summaries, while designated current signals are available through paid account access and Telegram. Coverage depends on available games, markets and data; the service does not guarantee outcomes or place bets on behalf of users.

name: RapDuo
tagline: Turn two photos into a lip-synced AI rap video
description: RapDuo turns two photos into a lip-synced AI rap video. Choose a stage, generate an original performance, and preview the result. New users can sign in with Google to receive 3 credits; the first preview is watermarked.

name: SpeechGen
tagline: Create voiceovers for videos and lessons with multilingual voices and one-time credits
description: SpeechGen is an online workspace for preparing narration without recording each line. Select from 5,000+ voices in 150 languages, assign different speakers and fine-tune the script with SSML. The editor includes background music and subtitle-to-audio tools. Download MP3, WAV or FLAC, or use the REST API in your own workflow. A free trial is available, followed by pay-as-you-go credit packs starting at $4.99; a monthly subscription is not required.

name: Coachable
tagline: A practical workspace for coaches and the people they support
description: Coachable brings practitioner discovery, appointment scheduling, goals, notes, secure communication, resources, and supportive communities into one workspace. People can join free, while coaches can manage their client relationships and day-to-day practice without stitching together several unrelated tools.

name: Plainledger Quarterly Set-Aside 2026
tagline: Excel + Google Sheets quarterly tax set-aside for 1099 freelancers
description: Plainledger Quarterly Set-Aside 2026 is a downloadable Excel and Google Sheets money tool for US 1099 freelancers and solopreneurs. Estimate quarterly federal taxes from irregular income and park cash before each IRS payment window—own the file forever, no SaaS login. $29 one-time.

name: OmniLab
tagline: Explore supported chemistry reactions before the lab
description: OmniLab helps chemistry students explore supported reaction pairs in a browser before using real materials. The current free, MIT-licensed release offers 25 chemistry guides and educational predictions. Results are not verified simulations and never replace lab supervision or safety procedures.

name: LiuNengAI
tagline: Chinese task tools and own-account subscription services
description: An independent Chinese-language website offering a free local bug-report builder and ecommerce prompt templates, alongside separate paid ChatGPT subscription recharge for customers own accounts. The free tools do not call AI models or require a purchase. The homepage displays the paid services; free tools are under /guides/. Not affiliated with OpenAI.

name: ChinaAI
tagline: Create AI images and videos with multiple models in one browser workspace
description: ChinaAI is a browser-based creative AI platform for generating and editing images, creating videos from text or images, and exploring 3D generation. It brings multiple AI models into one workspace for designers, marketers, and content creators. The interface supports English and Chinese. New users can try the service with trial credits; paid plans start at $9.99 per month.

name: TrendBriefs
tagline: Fast, careful English explainers for new apps, AI tools, games, software issues, entertainment topics, and internet trends.
description: Fast, careful English explainers for new apps, AI tools, games, software issues, entertainment topics, and internet trends.

name: RechnerWelt24
tagline: RechnerWelt24 kostenlose Online-Rechner für Gehalt
description: RechnerWelt24 bietet praktische Online-Rechner für Finanzen, Gehalt und Alltag. Berechnen Sie Ihr Nettogehalt, vergleichen Sie Gehaltsänderungen oder entdecken Sie, wie Ihr Kapital durch Zinseszinsen wachsen kann. Kostenlos, verständlich und direkt im Browser.

name: CodeGuard AI
tagline: Self-hosted AI code review for GitHub Pull Requests
description: CodeGuard AI is a self-hosted AI code reviewer for GitHub Pull Requests, built with Java 17+ and Spring Boot. It supports OpenAI, Gemini, and Ollama to analyze PRs for bugs, security issues, performance problems, and best-practice violations.

name: 热核算力
tagline: GPT API access with clear model groups and usage billing
description: 热核算力 is a Chinese-language AI API service for developers. It offers GPT GO, PLUS and PRO groups with published model lists and usage-based billing. Developers can create API keys and call OpenAI-compatible Responses and Chat Completions endpoints; a Messages route is available for supported groups. The site also provides Python and Node.js integration guides.

name: Compare Two Lists
tagline: Compare lists and Excel columns locally in your browser.
description: Compare Two Lists compares pasted lists or single columns imported from TXT, CSV, and Excel files. Find values shared by both lists, items present only in either list, and duplicates. Trim whitespace or ignore case while preserving leading zeros. Export results as XLSX, CSV, or TXT. File reading and comparison run locally in the browser, with no account required.

name: SupaPark Merlin
tagline: Live Disney World wait times, crowd forecasts, and AI park planning
description: SupaPark shows live Disney World wait times with SupaPark Real Wait, Lightning Lane and dining intelligence, crowd forecasts, and Merlin — an AI that suggests the smartest park move. Free to start. Independent planning app; not affiliated with Disney.

name: SameSame
tagline: Find similar products across Amazon, Temu and AliExpress from any image
description: SameSame is a free browser extension that unlocks Amazon, Temu, and AliExpress visual search from the page you are already on. Right-click any image to search those stores, use Find similar on product pages, and compare results in a collapsible sidebar. It uses each platform's own image-search APIs rather than a third-party reverse-image site.

name: VendAiQ
tagline: AI-Powered Vending Intelligence for Smarter Operations
description: VendAiQ is an AI-powered vending intelligence solution designed for vending operators. It helps teams understand sales, inventory and day-to-day machine performance across their vending operations. VendAiQ helps identify low-stock machines, underperforming locations, failed transactions and operational priorities, turning vending data into practical insights that support faster, more informed decisions.

name: vNetra
tagline: Smart Vending Management Software for Smarter Operations
description: vNetra is Vendekin's vending management software designed to help operators monitor and manage their day-to-day vending operations. It provides visibility into sales, inventory, stock-outs, payment performance, machine uptime and temperature data across connected vending machines. vNetra also supports route and refill planning, helping vending teams identify issues, manage replenishment and keep track of performance across multiple machines and locations.

name: Stone Match
tagline: AI video-to-music-video — your footage in, a scored story film out
description: Stone Match turns raw video clips into a finished story film. AI matches original music by KIRO STONE to the footage and auto-edits picture to score. Free, no signup, runs in the browser.

name: AI SEO Rainmakers
tagline: AI SEO training for working SEOs, Skool, by Charles Floate.
description: AI SEO Rainmakers is a paid AI SEO training community founded by Charles Floate in August 2026 and published by SEO.Stream. Run on Skool, it teaches working SEOs what ranks in Google and gets cited in AI answers, for clients, their own sites, or both: weekly live calls, courses, tools and CharlesGPT.

name: Stair Calculator
tagline: Design perfect stairs in seconds
description: Free online stair calculator: calculate risers, treads, stringer length and stair angles for perfect stairs. Ideal for builders, contractors, and DIYers.

name: Finamen
tagline: Entiende tus números. Decide con claridad.
description: Finamen es una aplicación web de finanzas personales para personas en Chile. Ayuda a revisar movimientos, leer cartolas bancarias y organizar presupuestos por categoría. Está en etapa de prueba familiar y es gratuita.

name: InstaSPY
tagline: Turn Reel research into original scripts
description: InstaSPY helps creators and social media teams turn public Instagram research into their next original script. Research creators, analyze Reels and transcripts, save useful hooks and source-linked ideas, then draft and revise scripts around your Persona. A free plan includes 10 credits every 30 days; paid checkout is coming soon.

name: GearDex
tagline: Camera gear inventory, shoots and client work in one app
description:
GearDex keeps a full record of every camera, lens, light, filter and drone you own: serial numbers, photos, purchase price, current value, condition, where it lives and the receipts that go with it. Add gear by typing a sentence or dropping in a CSV, then see what your kit is worth today and which records are missing a serial or receipt.

When a job comes in, plan the shoot with call sheets, locations, weather and sun times, and pack from the gear you actually own. Print QR labels, scan items out to a second shooter or a friend, and see who has what and when it's due back. Iris, the built-in AI assistant, answers questions about your kit and checks lens and filter fit, and it never changes a record without your OK.

GearDex also runs the client side: a photography website, client galleries, a client CRM, and on Studio, online booking and invoices paid through your own payment link.

Starter is free for 25 items. Web, Mac and Windows. Every plan can export your data.

Web, Mac 1.3.0 and Windows 1.2.0. Starter free for 25 items; Pro $4/mo or $39/yr; Studio $19/mo or $179/yr.

name: Gateway Information Group — Agent Services
tagline: Website checks and digital products with wallet checkout and private delivery.
description: Gateway Information Group offers on-demand website checks, timestamped readiness reports and digital products for people, developers and agents. Browse services, prices and delivery options at https://gatewayinformationgroup.com/catalog. Agent documentation at https://gatewayinformationgroup.com/developers explains supported USDC-on-Base x402 checkout. Reading terms is free; each purchase requires buyer authorization. Optional creator support is available separately at https://gatewayinformationgroup.com/tip.

name: Build The Pyramid Codes
tagline: Independent Roblox code reports, guides and a build calculator.
description: Independent fan companion for Roblox Build the Pyramid by Janitors Studios. Find reported codes and redemption instructions, beginner guides, and a free calculator for remaining trips, delivery time and measured Speed-versus-Capacity scenarios. Includes source links and English, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese code pages. Source reports are not live redemption tests.

name: Stamp Identifier
tagline: Photo-based stamp identification and collector research
description: Stamp Identifier helps collectors research unfamiliar postage stamps from a photo. Explore likely country and issue details, catalog clues and cautious estimated value ranges. Save scans as collection records. The app is available for iPhone and Android, with free scans included and optional paid upgrades. Results are research aids, not official authentication or appraisal.

name: AUINA
tagline: Digital forms and PDF workflows for teams
description: AUINA helps organizations create reusable digital forms, collect structured submissions from field and office teams, and generate PDF reports. A web app supports form management and review, while an iPhone and iPad app lets existing organization users complete assigned forms, including offline work when enabled.

name: FansStack
tagline: All-in-one creator platform for monetization and direct fan engagement
description: FansStack is a creator platform where creators can build their presence, offer subscriptions, sell paid content, list digital products and services, manage marketplace sales, message fans, participate in communities, and earn through multiple revenue streams. Membership is free, with a flat 20% platform fee on transactions. FansStack focuses on direct creator-to-fan relationships without making creators dependent on constantly changing recommendation algorithms.

name: LaTeX Autofill
tagline: Type meaning inside Obsidian math — get a full LaTeX template
description: LaTeX Autofill is a free MIT Obsidian community plugin for math notes. Inside math blocks, type English or Chinese meaning (integral / 定积分, matrix / 矩阵), press Enter for a full template, then Tab between placeholders. Σ search can insert or copy. Fully offline — no network or AI calls. I'm the developer.

name: AIFaceSwap Video Face Swap
tagline: AI video face swap tool for browser-based creative edits.
description: AIFaceSwap offers online AI face swap tools for images and video. The Video Face Swap workflow helps creators and casual users create face swap videos in the browser with a straightforward process for previews and shareable creative results.

name: MacroKit Video Splitter
tagline: Split videos online into precise clips in your browser.
description: MacroKit provides browser-based media utilities. Its Video Splitter helps creators, marketers, and operators cut videos into smaller clips quickly without installing heavy desktop software. The tool is useful for simple video preparation, content repurposing, and everyday browser-based media workflows.

name: EasyPanel
tagline: Deploy anything on your server.
description: Easypanel is a self-hosted application deployment platform for running apps, databases, Docker images, and Docker Compose projects on your own server. Connect GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket, deploy with automatic SSL, manage databases, monitor CPU, memory, and disk usage, inspect logs, and run shell commands from the browser. It includes automated backups and 750+ one-click applications, including n8n, Supabase, WordPress, Immich, and Nextcloud. Easypanel gives developers and small teams a simpler way to deploy while keeping workloads and data on infrastructure they control.

name: Kins
tagline: A private family memory journal for iPhone and iPad
description: Kins is a private family memory journal being built for iPhone and iPad. It brings photos, videos, voice recordings, words and children's drawings into a growing family story, from pregnancy through childhood and beyond. Parents can save everyday moments alongside milestones, revisit then-and-now comparisons and turn suitable portraits from different ages into a growing-up film. Memories stay on the device and in the family's private iCloud, with no Kins server holding the archive and no behavioural advertising. Families can read and export their archive even after membership ends. Kins is made by a family in Yorkshire, England. The website currently accepts launch notifications ahead of App Store availability.

name: Triptic
tagline: Your whole trip, in minutes.
description: Triptic turns one sentence into a complete trip: real flights, a real place to stay, and every day planned out on a map.

name: Invoicepad
tagline: $9 once · paste line items → invoice/quote PDF · offline in browser
description: Invoicepad turns pasted line items into an invoice or quote PDF, right in your browser, offline. $9 one-time. Not accounting, not QuickBooks, not a subscription, not tax filing.

name: Job Delulu
tagline: English-speaking startup jobs in Europe you can actually get.
description: Job Delulu lists English-speaking startup jobs across Europe, including visa-sponsorship and remote roles. Candidates apply directly with the company. Search startup jobs across Europe and filter for English-speaking roles and employers that sponsor visas.

name: ReelWorkshop
tagline: Turn raw clips into ready-to-post vertical videos
description: ReelWorkshop is a browser studio for short-form compilations. Import, arrange, trim, and preview footage, then export vertical 9:16 H.264 MP4s for TikTok, Reels, Shorts, and similar feeds. Local editing and preview are free; Starter is $19.99/month for cloud storage and export minutes.

name: Infosence
tagline: Discover useful apps and practical AI updates
description: Infosence helps people discover useful apps, AI tools and web services. Visitors can browse service information and read Korean-language AI briefings grounded in official announcements and product documentation. The briefings cover practical availability, pricing, limitations and use cases. Makers can submit their services for review.

name: LinkHonk
tagline: Buy verified link insertions and sponsored articles on real websites.
description: LinkHonk is a marketplace where you browse websites by category and price, then buy a link insertion or sponsored article directly from the publisher. Every placement is verified live before the publisher is paid, with 30-day monitoring included. Secure card payments via Stripe.

name: Hourtick
tagline: Time tracking, tasks and team chat for humans and AI agents
description: Tasks + team chat + time tracking for people and AI agents (MCP). Free forever for unlimited people (500 MB/month). Pro $29/month for 5 GB. No per-seat pricing. No screenshots or employee monitoring.

name: Marketing Star
tagline: Powerful Multichannel marketing platform for SMBs — Email, SMS, WhatsApp, QR, Social & Web Forms.
description:
Marketing Star is a multichannel marketing platform built for small and medium businesses, bringing Email, SMS, WhatsApp, QR Code, Web Forms, Landing Pages, and Social Media together in one place.

It makes multichannel campaigns simple, with visual customer journeys, personalization, A/B testing, real-time analytics, and data enrichment—all without coding.

With flexible monthly and pay-as-you-go pricing, Marketing Star helps growing businesses scale their marketing and is already used across 8+ countries.

name: LigneClaire
tagline: Normalize French supplier CSV catalogues locally, with anomalies kept visible.
description: LigneClaire helps French-speaking resellers prepare supplier catalogues. It normalizes supported French EUR price formats, preserves product references and isolates duplicate or invalid rows. Processing happens locally in the browser: catalogues are not uploaded. Two downloads are included: accepted rows and a complete anomaly report. The free web beta includes useful exports. Limits: UTF-8 CSV/TSV, 5,000 rows and 2 MB. No PDF, native XLSX, OCR, ERP integration or manual correction. An offline package with the application, examples and guide is available for a one-time 19 EUR purchase for French businesses, through PayPal.

name: LeadMino
tagline: Sales CRM for growing teams
description: LeadMino is a sales CRM for growing teams, startups, agencies, and small businesses. It helps manage leads, contacts, companies, deals, activities, follow-ups, and sales pipelines in one workspace. Teams can automate repetitive sales tasks, track opportunities, manage reminders, and use reporting to understand pipeline performance. Optional AI assistance supports selected sales workflows while the core CRM works independently.

name: AgentR
tagline: Prompt → live software with database, hosting, and your domain
description: AgentR is an AI software engineer. Describe the product you want in plain language and get live software — a website or a mobile app — with a real database, hosting, and custom domain support. Built for founders and small teams who need something shipped, not another sandbox.

name: Background Remover
tagline: background remover
description: Remove any photo's background with AI, add a new one, then crop and adjust like a mini editor.

name: usefultooler
tagline: online tools
description: Convert files instantly — no uploads, no accounts, no waiting on a server. Your files never leave your device.

name: Bot Street（波街）
tagline: A marketplace for AI agent services and paid tasks
description: Bot Street (波街) is an online marketplace connecting human clients with AI agents. Clients can publish tasks or purchase agent services; agents can apply for tasks and deliver work. It provides task, service and agent listings. Submitted as a third-party recommendation, not by the product owner. Official website: https://botstreet.io/.

name: Ostrata
tagline: Schema-flexible CRM with Pilot AI & SIREN for French SMBs
description: Headless schema-flexible CRM for French SMBs. Pilot AI, SIREN/INSEE, REST API, webhooks, MCP for Claude/Cursor. EU-hosted. Not invoicing.
